namespace Infragistics.Shared
{
	internal sealed class SR
	{
		private static Infragistics.Shared.SR loader;

		private ResourceManager[] resources;

		private SR()
		{
			string text = "Infragistics.Win.Misc.strings";
			string[] array = text.Split(';');
			int num = 0;
			string[] array2 = array;
			foreach (string text2 in array2)
			{
				if (text2 != null && text2.Length > 0)
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			resources = new ResourceManager[num];
			Assembly assembly = GetType().Assembly;
			int num2 = 0;
			string[] array3 = array;
			foreach (string text3 in array3)
			{
				if (text3 != null && text3.Length > 0)
				{
					resources[num2++] = new ResourceManager(text3, assembly);
				}
			}
		}

		private static Infragistics.Shared.SR GetLoader()
		{
			if (loader == null)
			{
				lock (typeof(Infragistics.Shared.SR))
				{
					if (loader == null)
					{
						loader = new Infragistics.Shared.SR();
					}
				}
			}
			return loader;
		}

		public static string GetString(string name)
		{
			return GetString(null, name);
		}

		public static string GetString(string name, params object[] args)
		{
			return GetString(null, name, args);
		}

		public static string GetString(CultureInfo culture, string name)
		{
			return GetString(culture, name, null);
		}

		public static string GetString(CultureInfo culture, string name, params object[] args)
		{
			return GetStringHelper(allowCustomizedStrings: true, culture, name, args);
		}

		private static string GetStringHelper(bool allowCustomizedStrings, CultureInfo culture, string name, params object[] args)
		{
			string text = null;
			if (allowCustomizedStrings)
			{
				text = global::ResourceCustomizerLocator.Customizer.GetCustomizedString(name);
			}
			if (text == null)
			{
				Infragistics.Shared.SR sR = GetLoader();
				if (sR == null)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				text = sR.GetString(name, culture);
				if (text == null)
				{
					text = string.Empty;
				}
			}
			if (args != null && args.Length > 0 && text.Length > 2)
			{
				try
				{
					text = string.Format(null, text, args);
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			return text;
		}

		private string GetString(string name, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			ResourceManager[] array = resources;
			foreach (ResourceManager resourceManager in array)
			{
				string text = resourceManager.GetString(name, culture);
				if (text != null)
				{
					return text;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static string GetUncustomizedString(string name)
		{
			return GetUncustomizedString(null, name);
		}

		public static string GetUncustomizedString(string name, params object[] args)
		{
			return GetUncustomizedString(null, name, args);
		}

		public static string GetUncustomizedString(CultureInfo culture, string name)
		{
			return GetUncustomizedString(culture, name, null);
		}

		public static string GetUncustomizedString(CultureInfo culture, string name, params object[] args)
		{
			return GetStringHelper(allowCustomizedStrings: false, culture, name, args);
		}

		public static object GetObject(string name)
		{
			return GetObject(null, name);
		}

		public static object GetObject(CultureInfo culture, string name)
		{
			return GetLoader()?.GetObject(name, culture);
		}

		private object GetObject(string name, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			ResourceManager[] array = resources;
			foreach (ResourceManager resourceManager in array)
			{
				object obj = resourceManager.GetObject(name, culture);
				if (obj != null)
				{
					return obj;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.All, AllowMultiple = false, Inherited = true)]
	internal sealed class LocalizedCategoryAttribute : CategoryAttribute
	{
		public LocalizedCategoryAttribute(string category)
			: base(category)
		{
		}

		protected override string GetLocalizedString(string value)
		{
			return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetUncustomizedString(null, value);
		}
	}
	[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.All, AllowMultiple = false, Inherited = true)]
	internal sealed class LocalizedDescriptionAttribute : DescriptionAttribute
	{
		private bool loaded;

		public override string Description
		{
			get
			{
				if (!loaded)
				{
					loaded = true;
					base.DescriptionValue = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetUncustomizedString(null, base.Description);
				}
				return base.Description;
			}
		}

		public LocalizedDescriptionAttribute(string description)
			: base(description)
		{
		}
	}

namespace Infragistics.Win.Misc
{
	public class MiscControlRole : UltraControlRole
	{
		private StyleUtils.ComponentType componentType;

		private string[] cachedRoleNames;

		internal StyleUtils.ComponentType ComponentType => componentType;

		internal MiscControlRole(UltraControlBase ultraCtrl, StyleUtils.ComponentType componentType)
			: base(ultraCtrl, StyleUtils.GetComponentName(componentType))
		{
			this.componentType = componentType;
			((ComponentRole)this).PropertiesCacheCount = 25;
		}

		protected override string[] GetRoleNames()
		{
			if (cachedRoleNames == null)
			{
				cachedRoleNames = StyleUtils.GetSortedRoleNamesForCaching();
			}
			return cachedRoleNames;
		}

		protected override void OnStyleChanged()
		{
			((UltraControlRole)this).OnStyleChanged();
			Component component = ((ComponentRole)this).Component;
			UltraControlBase val = (UltraControlBase)(object)((component is UltraControlBase) ? component : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				if (val is UltraGroupBox ultraGroupBox)
				{
					ultraGroupBox.OnAppStyleChanged();
				}
				else if (val is ControlBase controlBase)
				{
					controlBase.OnAppStyleChanged();
				}
				else if (val is UltraFormattedLinkLabel ultraFormattedLinkLabel)
				{
					ultraFormattedLinkLabel.OnAppStyleChanged();
				}
				else if (val is UltraPrintPreviewControlBase ultraPrintPreviewControlBase)
				{
					ultraPrintPreviewControlBase.OnAppStyleChanged();
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class MiscAssemblyStyleInfo : AssemblyStyleInfo
	{
		public override UIRoleDefinition[] GetRoles()
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			UIRoleDefinition[] roleDefinitions = StyleUtils.GetRoleDefinitions(StyleUtils.ComponentType.All);
			UIRoleDefinition[] uIRoleDefinitions = UltraDesktopAlertRole.Roles.UIRoleDefinitions;
			arrayList.AddRange(roleDefinitions);
			arrayList.AddRange(uIRoleDefinitions);
			UIRoleDefinition[] uIRoleDefinitions2 = UltraNavigationBarRole.Roles.UIRoleDefinitions;
			arrayList.AddRange(uIRoleDefinitions2);
			return arrayList.ToArray(typeof(UIRoleDefinition)) as UIRoleDefinition[];
		}

		private ComponentRoleDefinition CreateComponentRoleDef(StyleUtils.ComponentType componentType)
		{
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0012: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_005b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ComponentRoleDefinition val = new ComponentRoleDefinition(StyleUtils.GetComponentName(componentType), StyleUtils.GetComponentType(componentType));
			Type componentEditorType = StyleUtils.GetComponentEditorType(componentType);
			if (null != componentEditorType)
			{
				val.EditorType = componentEditorType;
			}
			val.RelatedRoles = StyleUtils.GetRoleNames(componentType);
			val.CustomProperties = StyleUtils.GetCustomProperties(componentType);
			val.UsesScrollbars = StyleUtils.UseScrollbars(componentType);
			val.UsesToolTips = StyleUtils.UseToolTips(componentType);
			val.SupportedProperties = StyleUtils.GetSupportedProperties(componentType);
			return val;
		}

		public override ComponentRoleDefinition[] GetComponents()
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			for (int num = 1; num <= 8192; num <<= 1)
			{
				arrayList.Add(CreateComponentRoleDef((StyleUtils.ComponentType)num));
			}
			arrayList.Add(UltraDesktopAlertRole.GetComponentRoleDefinition());
			arrayList.Add(UltraNavigationBarRole.GetComponentRoleDefinition());
			return (ComponentRoleDefinition[])arrayList.ToArray(typeof(ComponentRoleDefinition));
		}
	}

		internal static bool UseControlInfo(UltraControlBase ultraCtrl)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ResolutionOrderInfo resolutionOrder = GetResolutionOrder(ultraCtrl);
			return ((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseControlInfo;
		}

		internal static ResolutionOrderInfo GetResolutionOrder(UltraControlBase ultraCtrl)
		{
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ComponentRole componentRole = GetComponentRole(ultraCtrl);
			return ComponentRole.GetResolutionOrderInfo(componentRole);
		}

		internal static ComponentRole GetComponentRole(UltraControlBase ultraCtrl)
		{
			return ultraCtrl.ComponentRole;
		}

		internal static ComponentRole GetComponentRole(UltraStylableComponent ultraStylableComponent)
		{
			return ultraStylableComponent.ComponentRole;
		}

		internal static UIRole GetRole(UltraControlBase ultraCtrl, Role role)
		{
			ResolutionOrderInfo resOrder;
			return GetRole(ultraCtrl, role, out resOrder);
		}

		internal static UIRole GetRole(ComponentRole componentRole, Role role)
		{
			if (componentRole == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return componentRole.GetRole((int)role);
		}

		internal static UIRole GetRole(UltraControlBase ultraCtrl, Role role, out ResolutionOrderInfo resOrder)
		{
			return GetRole(GetComponentRole(ultraCtrl), role, out resOrder);
		}

		internal static UIRole GetRole(ComponentRole componentRole, Role role, out ResolutionOrderInfo resOrder)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			resOrder = ComponentRole.GetResolutionOrderInfo(componentRole);
			if (componentRole == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return componentRole.GetRole((int)role);
		}

		internal static bool GetCachedPropertyVal(UltraControlBase ultraCtrl, CachedProperty prop, out object val)
		{
			ComponentRole componentRole = GetComponentRole(ultraCtrl);
			if (componentRole != null)
			{
				return componentRole.GetCachedProperty((int)prop, ref val);
			}
			val = null;
			return false;
		}

		internal static object CacheBorderStylePropertyValue(UltraControlBase ultraCtrl, CachedProperty prop, Role eRole, UIElementBorderStyle controlVal, UIElementBorderStyle resolveVal)
		{
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return CacheBorderStylePropertyValue(ultraCtrl, prop, GetRole(ultraCtrl, eRole), controlVal, resolveVal);
		}

		internal static object CacheBorderStylePropertyValue(UltraControlBase ultraCtrl, CachedProperty prop, UIRole role, UIElementBorderStyle controlVal, UIElementBorderStyle resolveVal)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			UIElementBorderStyle roleBorderStyle = GetRoleBorderStyle(ultraCtrl, role);

		internal static void ResolveAppearance(AppearanceBase controlAppearance, UIRole role, RoleState state, ResolutionOrderInfo order, ref AppearanceData appData, ref AppearancePropFlags flags)
		{
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

				role.ResolveAppearance(ref appData, ref flags, state);
			}

			{
				controlAppearance.MergeData(ref appData, ref flags);
			}

				role.ResolveAppearance(ref appData, ref flags, state);
			}
		}

		internal static int GetIndex(ComponentType componentType)
		{
			int i;
			for (i = 0; i < 32; i++)
			{
				if ((1 & ((int)componentType >> i)) != 0)
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return i;
		}

		internal static string[] Combine(string[] arr1, string[] arr2)
		{
			if (arr1 == null || arr1.Length == 0)
			{
				return arr2;
			}
			if (arr2 == null || arr2.Length == 0)
			{
				return arr1;
			}
			string[] array = new string[arr1.Length + arr2.Length];
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < arr1.Length; i++)
			{
				array[num++] = arr1[i];
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < arr2.Length; j++)
			{
				array[num++] = arr2[j];
			}
			return array;
		}

		}

			}
			return array;
		}

		internal static bool IsHottracking(Control ctrl)
		{
			if (ctrl == null || !ctrl.Enabled)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Point pt = ctrl.PointToClient(Control.MousePosition);
			return ctrl.ClientRectangle.Contains(pt);
		}

		{
			//IL_0036: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0058: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			ComponentRole componentRole = stylableObj.ComponentRole;
			object obj = null;
			if (componentRole != null)
			{
				string customPropertyName = GetCustomPropertyName(viewStyleProp);
				if (componentRole.HasProperty(customPropertyName))
				{
					obj = componentRole.GetProperty(customPropertyName);
				}
				if (obj == null || object.Equals(obj, GroupBoxViewStyle.Default))
				{
					ViewStyle viewStyle = componentRole.ViewStyle;
					switch (viewStyle - 2)
					{
					case 0:
						obj = GroupBoxViewStyle.Office2000;
						break;
					case 2:
						obj = GroupBoxViewStyle.Office2003;
						break;
					case 3:
						obj = GroupBoxViewStyle.VisualStudio2005;
						break;
					case 4:
						obj = GroupBoxViewStyle.Office2007;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return obj;
		}

		internal static Role GetSpecificRole(UltraControlBase ctrl, Role eRole)
		{
			Role result = eRole;
			if (eRole == Role.UltraGroupBoxHeader && ctrl is UltraGroupBox ultraGroupBox)
			{
				switch (ultraGroupBox.HeaderPositionResolved)
				{
				case GroupBoxHeaderPosition.TopOnBorder:
				case GroupBoxHeaderPosition.TopInsideBorder:
				case GroupBoxHeaderPosition.TopOutsideBorder:
					result = Role.UltraGroupBoxHeaderHorizontalTop;
					break;
				case GroupBoxHeaderPosition.BottomOnBorder:
				case GroupBoxHeaderPosition.BottomInsideBorder:
				case GroupBoxHeaderPosition.BottomOutsideBorder:
					result = Role.UltraGroupBoxHeaderHorizontalBottom;
					break;
				case GroupBoxHeaderPosition.LeftOnBorder:
				case GroupBoxHeaderPosition.LeftInsideBorder:
				case GroupBoxHeaderPosition.LeftOutsideBorder:
					result = Role.UltraGroupBoxHeaderVerticalLeft;
					break;
				case GroupBoxHeaderPosition.RightOnBorder:
				case GroupBoxHeaderPosition.RightInsideBorder:
				case GroupBoxHeaderPosition.RightOutsideBorder:
					result = Role.UltraGroupBoxHeaderVerticalRight;
					break;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}
	}

		protected virtual bool IsOverHotTrackArea
		{
			get
			{
				if (((Control)this).IsDisposed || ((Control)this).Disposing)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!isMouseOverControl)
				{
					return false;
				}
				Point mousePosition = Control.MousePosition;
				mousePosition = ((Control)this).PointToClient(mousePosition);
				return ((Control)this).ClientRectangle.Contains(mousePosition);
			}
		}

				((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)ControlBasePropertyIds.Appearance);
			}
			else if (HasHotTrackAppearance && hotTrackAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance == propChangeInfo.Source)
			{
				((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).DirtyChildElements();
				((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)ControlBasePropertyIds.HotTrackAppearance);
			}
		}

		}

		public virtual void ResolveAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ResolutionOrderInfo resolutionOrder = StyleUtils.GetResolutionOrder((UltraControlBase)(object)this);
			UIRole mainRole = MainRole;
			if (!((Component)this).DesignMode && ((Control)this).Enabled && ((Control)this).Visible && UseHotTrackingResolved && IsOverHotTrackArea)
			{
				if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseStyleBefore && mainRole != null)
				{
					mainRole.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)4);
				}
				if (HasHotTrackAppearance)
				{
					HotTrackAppearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
				}
				if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseStyleAfter && mainRole != null)
				{
					mainRole.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)4);
				}
				if (!((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)2) && ((ulong)requestedProps & 2uL) != 0)
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).ForeColor = SystemColors.HotTrack;
					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFDuL);
				}
			}
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseStyleBefore && mainRole != null)
			{
				mainRole.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
			}
			if (HasAppearance && ((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseControlInfo)
			{
				Appearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			}
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseStyleAfter && mainRole != null)
			{
				mainRole.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
			}
			ResolveDefaultAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
		}

		protected virtual void ResolveDefaultAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)

		private void ApplyBoundsConstraints(ref Size proposedSize)
		{
			Size minimumSize = ((Control)(object)this).MinimumSize;
			Size maximumSize = ((Control)(object)this).MaximumSize;
			if (maximumSize.Width == 0 || maximumSize.Width == int.MaxValue)

			if (maximumSize.Height == 0 || maximumSize.Height == int.MaxValue)
			{
				maximumSize.Height = 2000000000;
			}
			proposedSize.Width = Math.Max(minimumSize.Width, Math.Min(proposedSize.Width, maximumSize.Width));
			proposedSize.Height = Math.Max(minimumSize.Height, Math.Min(proposedSize.Height, maximumSize.Height));
		}

		internal Size GetImageSize(ref AppearanceData appearance)
		{
			if (!((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)256))
			{

			}

			if (size.IsEmpty)
			{
				Image image = ((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).GetImage(base.ImageList);
				if (image == null)
				{
					return Size.Empty;
				}

			}
			return size;
		}

		}

		private Size CalculateRequiredImageAndTextSize(Size proposedSize)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0063: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			AppearanceData appearance = default(AppearanceData);
			AppearancePropFlags requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)137438953471L;
			ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			HotkeyPrefix hotkeyStyle = HotkeyStyle;
			Size size = GetImageSize(ref appearance);
			if (ReserveImageShadowSpace && ((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)256))
			{
				size.Width += 2;
				size.Height += 2;
			}
			ContentAlignment contentAlignment = AppearanceData.ContentAlignmentFromHVAlign(((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).ImageHAlign, ((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).ImageVAlign);
			string text = ((Control)(object)this).Text;
			Size size2 = proposedSize;
			if (!size.IsEmpty && (int)((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).ImageHAlign != 2)
			{
				size2.Width -= size.Width;
			}
			size2 = ImageAndTextUIElement.CalculateTextSize(text, hotkeyStyle, false, (Control)(object)this, ref appearance, base.WrapText, size2);
			return ImageAndTextUIElement.CalculateImageAndTextSize(size, size2, Size.Empty, Size.Empty, base.Padding, false, (UIElementBorderStyle)1, (Border3DSide)0, contentAlignment);
		}

		public override Size GetPreferredSize(Size proposedSize)
		{
			if (proposedSize.Width == 0 || proposedSize.Width == 1)
			{
				proposedSize.Width = 2000000000;
			}
			if (proposedSize.Height == 0 || proposedSize.Height == 1 || Utilities.GetParent((Control)(object)this) is FlowLayoutPanel)
			{
				proposedSize.Height = 2000000000;
			}
			ApplyBoundsConstraints(ref proposedSize);
			Size proposedSize2 = ((!lastPreferredSize.HasValue || !lastProposedSize.HasValue || !(lastProposedSize == proposedSize)) ? CalculatePreferredSize(proposedSize) : lastPreferredSize.Value);
			ApplyBoundsConstraints(ref proposedSize2);
			lastPreferredSize = proposedSize2;
			lastProposedSize = proposedSize;
			return proposedSize2;
		}

		{

		}

		protected override void OnFontChanged(EventArgs e)
		{
			((UltraControlBase)this).OnFontChanged(e);

		private void SyncSizeToPreferredSize()
		{
			bool flag = shouldUpdateMaximumSize;
			DrawUtility.BeginGraphicsCaching();
			try
			{
				shouldUpdateMaximumSize = false;
				((Control)(object)this).Size = ((Control)(object)this).PreferredSize;
			}
			finally
			{
				DrawUtility.EndGraphicsCaching();
				shouldUpdateMaximumSize = flag;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateMaximumSize(int width)
		{
			if (AutoSizeHeightOnly && shouldUpdateMaximumSize)
			{
				((Control)(object)this).MaximumSize = new Size(width, 0);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnClick(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (isInClickEvent)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				isInClickEvent = true;
				Form form = null;
				try
				{
					form = ((Control)(object)this).FindForm();
				}
				catch
				{
				}
				if (form != null)
				{
					form.DialogResult = DialogResult;
				}
				((UltraControlBase)this).OnClick(EventArgs.Empty);
			}
			finally
			{
				isInClickEvent = false;
			}
		}

		public virtual void PerformClick()
		{
			if (!((Control)(object)this).CanSelect)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (((Control)(object)this).CausesValidation && !((Control)(object)this).Focused)
			{
				ContainerControl containerControl = null;
				try
				{
					containerControl = ((Control)(object)this).GetContainerControl() as ContainerControl;
					while (containerControl != null && containerControl.ActiveControl == null)
					{
						containerControl = containerControl.Parent as ContainerControl;
					}
				}
				catch
				{
				}
				if (containerControl != null && !containerControl.Validate())
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			if (!IsValidationCancelled)
			{
				((Control)(object)this).OnClick(EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

			}
		}

		protected override void ButtonKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Handled || e.KeyCode != Keys.Space)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).GetDescendant(typeof(UltraButtonUIElement)) is UltraButtonUIElement ultraButtonUIElement && (object)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement.ElementWithMouseCapture != ultraButtonUIElement)
			{
				if (!((ButtonUIElementBase)ultraButtonUIElement).IsMouseDown)
				{
					((UIElement)ultraButtonUIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
				}
				((ButtonUIElementBase)ultraButtonUIElement).ButtonState = (UIElementButtonState)3;
				lastKeyDownKeyData = e.KeyData;
			}
			if (!AutoRepeat)
			{
				return;
			}
			DateTime now = DateTime.Now;
			TimeSpan timeSpan = now.Subtract(lastKeyDown);
			if ((passedAutoRepeatDelay && AutoRepeatInterval != -1 && timeSpan.TotalMilliseconds >= (double)AutoRepeatInterval) || (!passedAutoRepeatDelay && timeSpan.TotalMilliseconds >= (double)AutoRepeatDelay))
			{
				if (!passedAutoRepeatDelay && (lastKeyDown != DateTime.MinValue || AutoRepeatDelay <= 0))
				{
					passedAutoRepeatDelay = true;
				}
				lastKeyDown = now;
				((Control)(object)this).OnClick(EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		protected override void ButtonKeyUp(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.KeyCode != Keys.Space)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).GetDescendant(typeof(UltraButtonUIElement)) is UltraButtonUIElement ultraButtonUIElement && (object)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement.ElementWithMouseCapture != ultraButtonUIElement)
			{
				if (!((ButtonUIElementBase)ultraButtonUIElement).IsMouseDown)
				{
					((UIElement)ultraButtonUIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
				}
				ultraButtonUIElement.Reset();
			}
			((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
			ResetAutoRepeatKeyInfo();
			if (!e.Handled && !AutoRepeat && lastKeyDownKeyData.HasValue)
			{
				((Control)(object)this).OnClick(EventArgs.Empty);
				e.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		public override void ResolveAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).GetDescendant(typeof(UltraButtonUIElement)) is UltraButtonUIElement ultraButtonUIElement)
			{
				ResolveAppearance(((ButtonUIElementBase)ultraButtonUIElement).ButtonState, ref appearance, ref requestedProps);

				ResolveAppearance((UIElementButtonState)0, ref appearance, ref requestedProps);

		}

		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, UnmanagedCode = true)]

			switch (reflectedMessage)

			}
			}
		}

				return base.Text;
			}
			set
			{
				base.Text = value;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		public bool IsPlaying => isPlaying;

		[Browsable(false)]
		public bool IsOpen => isOpen;

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Behavior")]
		[Editor("Infragistics.Win.Misc.CommonControls.Design.AVIFileEditor, Infragistics4.Win.v15.1.Design, Version=15.1.20151.1000, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=7dd5c3163f2cd0cb", typeof(UITypeEditor))]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_AnimationControl_P_FileName")]
		[DefaultValue("")]
		public string FileName
		{
			get
			{
				return filename;
			}
			set
			{
				if (filename == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				bool flag = IsPlaying && IsFileAnimation;
				if (IsFileAnimation)
				{
					if (IsPlaying)
					{
						Stop();
					}
					if (IsOpen)
					{
						Close();
					}
				}
				filename = value;
				if (autoPlay || flag)
				{
					Play(value);
				}
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_AnimationControl_P_AutoPlay")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Behavior")]
		[DefaultValue(false)]

			get
			{
				return autoPlay;
			}
			set
			{
				if (autoPlay != value)
				{
					autoPlay = value;
					RecreateControl();
				}
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_AnimationControl_P_AnimationSource")]

		public AnimationType AnimationSource
		{
			get
			{
				return animationSource;

				{
					if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(AnimationType), value))
					{
						throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE__Exception_2"), (int)value, typeof(AnimationType));
					}
					bool flag = IsPlaying;
					Close();
					animationSource = value;
					if (AutoPlay || flag)
					{
						Play();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool IsFileAnimation => animationSource == AnimationType.AviFile;

		private bool IsShellModuleLoaded => hModuleShell != IntPtr.Zero;

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_AnimationControl_P_About")]

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Property Changed")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_AnimationControl_E_StateChanged")]
		public event EventHandler StateChanged
		{
			add
			{
				base.Events.AddHandler(EventStateChanged, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				base.Events.RemoveHandler(EventStateChanged, value);
			}
		}

		public AnimationControl()
		{
			license = Utilities.ValidateLicense(typeof(AnimationControl), this);
			SetStyle(ControlStyles.Selectable, value: false);
			TabStop = false;
		}

		protected override void OnBackColorChanged(EventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnBackColorChanged(e);
			if (IsOpen)
			{
				RecreateControl();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnHandleCreated(EventArgs e)
		{
			isOpen = false;
			isPlaying = false;
			base.OnHandleCreated(e);
			if (AutoPlay)
			{
				Open();
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, UnmanagedCode = true)]
		protected override void ProcessCommandMessage(ref Message m, int notificationCode)
		{
			switch (notificationCode)
			{
			case 1:
				isPlaying = true;
				OnStateChanged(EventArgs.Empty);
				break;
			case 2:
				isPlaying = false;
				OnStateChanged(EventArgs.Empty);
				break;
			}
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			Close();
			UnloadShellLibrary();
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		protected override void RecreateControl()
		{
			bool flag = IsPlaying;
			if (base.IsHandleCreated && IsOpen)
			{
				Close();
				OnStateChanged(EventArgs.Empty);
			}
			base.RecreateControl();
			if (flag && !IsPlaying)
			{
				Play();
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, UnmanagedCode = true)]
		protected override void WndProc(ref Message m)
		{
			if (m.Msg == 132)
			{
				int num = m.LParam.ToInt32();
				int num2 = num & 0xFFFF;
				int num3 = num >> 16;
				Point pt = PointToClient(new Point(num2, num3));
				if (base.ClientRectangle.Contains(pt))
				{
					m.Result = new IntPtr(1);
				}
				else
				{
					m.Result = new IntPtr(18);
				}
				return;
			}
			if (m.Msg == 20 && m.WParam != IntPtr.Zero && !IsOpen)
			{
				Graphics graphics = null;
				PaintEventArgs e = null;
				try
				{
					graphics = Graphics.FromHdc(m.WParam);
					NativeWindowMethods.RECT rect = default(NativeWindowMethods.RECT);
					NativeWindowMethods.GetClientRect(new HandleRef(this, base.Handle), ref rect);
					e = new PaintEventArgs(graphics, rect.ToRectangle());
					OnPaintBackground(e);
					m.Result = new IntPtr(1);
					return;
				}
				finally
				{
					e?.Dispose();
					graphics?.Dispose();
				}
			}
			base.WndProc(ref m);
		}

		private void Open(AnimationType source, string filename)
		{
			if (base.IsHandleCreated && (!IsOpen || source != AnimationSource || (IsFileAnimation && !(filename == this.filename))))
			{
				Close();
				animationSource = source;
				IntPtr zero = IntPtr.Zero;
				if (source == AnimationType.AviFile)
				{
					this.filename = filename;
					zero = NativeWindowMethods.SendMessage(base.Handle, NativeWindowMethods.ACM_OPEN, IntPtr.Zero, filename);
				}
				else
				{
					LoadShellLibrary();
					zero = NativeWindowMethods.SendMessage(base.Handle, NativeWindowMethods.ACM_OPEN, hModuleShell, (IntPtr)(long)source);
				}
				if (zero != IntPtr.Zero)
				{
					isOpen = true;
				}
			}
		}

		public void Open(string filename)
		{
			Open(AnimationType.AviFile, filename);
		}

		public void Open()
		{
			Open(AnimationSource, FileName);
		}

		public void Stop()
		{
			if (IsOpen && base.IsHandleCreated)
			{
				NativeWindowMethods.SendMessage(base.Handle, 1126, IntPtr.Zero, IntPtr.Zero);
				isPlaying = false;
			}
		}

		public void Seek(int frame)
		{
			Play(1, frame, frame);
		}

		public void Close()
		{
			if (IsPlaying)
			{
				Stop();
			}
			if (isOpen && base.IsHandleCreated)
			{
				isOpen = false;
				NativeWindowMethods.SendMessage(base.Handle, NativeWindowMethods.ACM_OPEN, IntPtr.Zero, IntPtr.Zero);
				Invalidate();
			}
		}

		private void Play(AnimationType source, string filename, int repetitions, int startFrame, int endFrame)
		{
			Open(source, filename);
			if (IsOpen && base.IsHandleCreated)
			{
				startFrame = Math.Min(startFrame, 65535);
				endFrame = Math.Min(endFrame, 65535);
				int num = NativeWindowMethods.MakeLong(startFrame, endFrame);
				NativeWindowMethods.SendMessage(base.Handle, 1125, (IntPtr)repetitions, (IntPtr)num);
			}
		}

		public void Play(string filename, int repetitions, int startFrame, int endFrame)
		{
			Play(AnimationType.AviFile, filename, repetitions, startFrame, endFrame);
		}

		public void Play(string filename, int repetitions)
		{
			Play(filename, repetitions, 0, -1);
		}

		public void Play(string filename)
		{
			Play(filename, -1);
		}

		public void Play(int repetitions, int startFrame, int endFrame)
		{
			Play(AnimationSource, FileName, repetitions, startFrame, endFrame);
		}

		public void Play(int repetitions)
		{
			Play(repetitions, 0, -1);
		}

		public void Play()
		{
			Play(-1, 0, -1);
		}

		private void LoadShellLibrary()
		{
			if (!IsShellModuleLoaded)
			{
				hModuleShell = NativeWindowMethods.LoadLibraryEx("shell32.dll", IntPtr.Zero, 2);
			}
		}

		private void UnloadShellLibrary()
		{
			if (IsShellModuleLoaded)
			{
				NativeWindowMethods.FreeLibrary(hModuleShell);
				hModuleShell = IntPtr.Zero;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnStateChanged(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (e == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE__Exception_6"));
			}
			((EventHandler)base.Events[EventStateChanged])?.Invoke(this, e);
		}
	}

		void DirtyControlElement();
	}

		internal bool InitializingDesigner
		{
			get
			{
				return initializingDesigner;
			}
			set
			{
				initializingDesigner = value;
			}
		}

		internal bool InternalDesignMode => ((Component)this).DesignMode;

		internal virtual bool IsFullTrust => false;

		internal virtual bool IsHorizontalScrollbarVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (((ScrollableControl)(object)this).AutoScroll)
				{
					return ((ScrollableControl)this).HScroll;
				}
				return ((ScrollableControl)this).HorizontalScroll.Visible;
			}
		}

		internal virtual bool IsVerticalScrollbarVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (((ScrollableControl)(object)this).AutoScroll)
				{
					return ((ScrollableControl)this).VScroll;
				}
				return ((ScrollableControl)this).VerticalScroll.Visible;
			}
		}

		internal IAutoScrollControl Owner => owner;

		internal virtual bool ShouldInterceptAdjustFormScrollbars
		{
			get
			{
				if (!((Control)this).IsHandleCreated)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!((ScrollableControl)(object)this).AutoScroll)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal virtual bool ShouldUpdateScrollInfo => true;

		internal bool VScrollInternal
		{
			get
			{
				return ((ScrollableControl)this).VScroll;
			}
			set

				((ScrollableControl)this).VScroll = value;
			}
		}

		internal AutoScrollContainerPanel(IAutoScrollControl owner)
		{
			this.owner = owner;
			((Control)this).Margin = new Padding(0);
			((Control)this).ImeMode = ImeMode.Inherit;
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				if (horizontalScrollbarInfo != null)
				{
					((DisposableObject)(object)horizontalScrollbarInfo).Dispose();
					horizontalScrollbarInfo = null;
				}
				if (verticalScrollbarInfo != null)
				{
					((DisposableObject)(object)verticalScrollbarInfo).Dispose();
					verticalScrollbarInfo = null;
				}
			}
			((IGPanel)this).Dispose(disposing);
		}

		public override Size GetPreferredSize(Size proposedSize)
		{
			return Size;
		}

		protected override void SetClientSizeCore(int x, int y)
		{
			throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("AutoScrollContainerPanel_InvalidOperationException_CannotModifyClientSize", ExceptionClassName));
		}

		internal ScrollBarInfo GetHorizontalScrollbarInfo()
		{
			if (!IsFullTrust)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!((Control)this).IsHandleCreated)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (ShouldUpdateScrollInfo)
			{
				if (horizontalScrollbarInfo == null)
				{
					horizontalScrollbarInfo = (ScrollBarInfo)(object)new AutoScrollBarInfo(Owner.Control, Orientation.Horizontal, null);
					horizontalScrollbarInfo.Scroll += OnHorizontalScroll;
					if (Owner.HasScrollBarLook)
					{
						horizontalScrollbarInfo.ScrollBarLook = Owner.ScrollBarLook;
					}
				}
				InitializeScrollInfo(vertical: false, horizontalScrollbarInfo);
			}
			return horizontalScrollbarInfo;
		}

		internal ScrollBarInfo GetVerticalScrollbarInfo()
		{
			if (!IsFullTrust)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!((Control)this).IsHandleCreated)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (ShouldUpdateScrollInfo)
			{
				if (verticalScrollbarInfo == null)
				{
					verticalScrollbarInfo = (ScrollBarInfo)(object)new AutoScrollBarInfo(Owner.Control, Orientation.Vertical, null);
					verticalScrollbarInfo.Scroll += OnVerticalScroll;
					if (Owner.HasScrollBarLook)
					{
						verticalScrollbarInfo.ScrollBarLook = Owner.ScrollBarLook;
					}
				}
				InitializeScrollInfo(vertical: true, verticalScrollbarInfo);
			}
			return verticalScrollbarInfo;
		}

		internal virtual void InitializeScrollInfo(bool vertical, ScrollBarInfo scrollBarInfo)
		{
		}

		internal Size InternalGetPreferredSize(Size proposedSize)
		{
			return ((Control)this).GetPreferredSize(proposedSize);
		}

		internal void InternalSetAutoScroll(bool autoScrollValue)
		{
			if (((IGPanel)this).AutoScroll != autoScrollValue)
			{
				((IGPanel)this).AutoScroll = autoScrollValue;
			}
		}

		internal void InternalSetAutoScrollMargin(Size autoScrollMargin)
		{
			((ScrollableControl)this).AutoScrollMargin = autoScrollMargin;
		}

		internal void InternalSetAutoScrollMinSize(Size autoScrollMinSize)
		{
			if (((ScrollableControl)this).AutoScrollMinSize == autoScrollMinSize)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = allowSetAutoScroll;
			try
			{
				allowSetAutoScroll = true;
				((ScrollableControl)this).AutoScrollMinSize = autoScrollMinSize;
			}
			finally
			{
				allowSetAutoScroll = flag;
			}
		}

		internal void InternalSetAutoSize(bool autoSize)
		{
			((Panel)this).AutoSize = autoSize;
		}

		internal void InternalSetAutoSizeMode(AutoSizeMode autoSizeMode)
		{
			((Panel)this).AutoSizeMode = autoSizeMode;
		}

		internal void InternalSetBackColor(Color color)
		{
			((Control)this).BackColor = color;
		}

		internal void InternalSetBounds(Rectangle bounds)
		{
			InternalSetBounds(bounds, BoundsSpecified.All);
		}

		internal void InternalSetBounds(Rectangle bounds, BoundsSpecified specified)
		{
			bool flag = ((Control)this).Bounds != bounds;
			if (!((Component)this).DesignMode)
			{
				((Control)this).Bounds = bounds;
			}
			else
			{
				((Control)this).SetBounds(bounds.X, bounds.Y, bounds.Width, bounds.Height, specified);
			}
			if (flag && ((Control)this).IsHandleCreated)
			{
				((ScrollableControl)(object)this).AdjustFormScrollbars(((ScrollableControl)(object)this).AutoScroll);
			}
		}

		internal void InternalSetLocation(Point location)
		{
			((Control)this).Location = location;
		}

		internal void InternalSetRightToLeft(RightToLeft rightToLeft)
		{
			((Control)this).RightToLeft = rightToLeft;
		}

		internal void InternalSetSize(Size size)
		{
			((Control)this).Size = size;
		}

		internal void OnScrollBarLookChanged()
		{
			if (Owner.HasScrollBarLook)
			{
				if (horizontalScrollbarInfo != null)
				{
					horizontalScrollbarInfo.ScrollBarLook = Owner.ScrollBarLook;
				}
				if (verticalScrollbarInfo != null)
				{
					verticalScrollbarInfo.ScrollBarLook = Owner.ScrollBarLook;
				}
			}
		}

		internal virtual void UpdateScrollInfo(ScrollEventArgs e, bool vertical, ScrollBarInfo scrollBarInfo)
		{
		}

		private void AdjustInfoForRightToLeftScrolling(bool vertical, ScrollBarInfo scrollBarInfo, ref int newValue, ref ScrollEventType scrollType)
		{
			if (!vertical && Owner.RightToLeft == RightToLeft.Yes)
			{
				int minimum = scrollBarInfo.Minimum;
				int maximumDragValue = scrollBarInfo.MaximumDragValue;
				int num = newValue - minimum;
				num = maximumDragValue - num;
				newValue = num + minimum;
				switch (scrollType)
				{
				case ScrollEventType.First:
					scrollType = ScrollEventType.Last;
					break;
				case ScrollEventType.Last:
					scrollType = ScrollEventType.First;
					break;
				case ScrollEventType.LargeDecrement:
					scrollType = ScrollEventType.LargeIncrement;
					break;
				case ScrollEventType.LargeIncrement:
					scrollType = ScrollEventType.LargeDecrement;
					break;
				case ScrollEventType.SmallDecrement:
					scrollType = ScrollEventType.SmallIncrement;
					break;
				case ScrollEventType.SmallIncrement:
					scrollType = ScrollEventType.SmallDecrement;
					break;
				case ScrollEventType.ThumbPosition:
				case ScrollEventType.ThumbTrack:
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		internal abstract void DirtyOwnerElement();

		private void OnHorizontalScroll(object sender, ScrollEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Type == ScrollEventType.EndScroll || e.Type == ScrollEventType.ThumbPosition || e.OldValue != e.NewValue)
			{
				UpdateScrollInfo(e, vertical: false, horizontalScrollbarInfo);
			}
		}

		private void OnVerticalScroll(object sender, ScrollEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Type == ScrollEventType.EndScroll || e.Type == ScrollEventType.ThumbPosition || e.OldValue != e.NewValue)
			{
				UpdateScrollInfo(e, vertical: true, verticalScrollbarInfo);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class AutoScrollBarInfo : ScrollBarInfo

			: base(owningControl, orientation, appearances)
		{
		}

		internal void InternalOnScroll(ScrollEventArgs e)
		{
			((ScrollBarInfo)this).OnScroll(e);
		}
	}
	internal interface IAutoScrollContainerPanelUnsafe
	{
		void InternalAdjustFormScrollbars(bool enable);

		Point InternalScrollToControl(Control activeControl);

		void InternalWndProc(ref Message m);
	}
	internal class AutoScrollContainerPanelUnsafeHelper
	{
		private bool isAdjustingScrollInfo;

		private AutoScrollContainerPanel panel;

		private IAutoScrollContainerPanelUnsafe panelUnsafe;

		public AutoScrollContainerPanelUnsafeHelper(AutoScrollContainerPanel panel, IAutoScrollContainerPanelUnsafe panelUnsafe)
		{
			this.panel = panel;
			this.panelUnsafe = panelUnsafe;
		}

		internal void AdjustFormScrollbars(bool enable)
		{
			if (!panel.ShouldInterceptAdjustFormScrollbars)
			{
				panelUnsafe.InternalAdjustFormScrollbars(enable);
				FixupScrollbars();
				return;
			}
			panel.Owner.DirtyControlElement();
			if (!panel.InternalDesignMode && panel.Visible)
			{
				NativeWindowMethods.SendMessage(((Control)(object)panel).Handle, 11, IntPtr.Zero, IntPtr.Zero);
			}
			bool flag = isAdjustingScrollInfo;
			try
			{
				isAdjustingScrollInfo = true;
				panelUnsafe.InternalAdjustFormScrollbars(enable);
				FixupScrollbars();
				NativeWindowMethods.ShowScrollBar(((Control)(object)panel).Handle, 3, bShow: false);
			}
			finally
			{
				isAdjustingScrollInfo = flag;
			}
			if (!flag && !panel.InternalDesignMode)
			{
				NativeWindowMethods.SetWindowPos(((Control)(object)panel).Handle.ToInt32(), 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1599);
				if (panel.Visible)
				{
					NativeWindowMethods.SendMessage(((Control)(object)panel).Handle, 11, new IntPtr(1), IntPtr.Zero);
					RedrawWindow();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void InitializeScrollInfo(bool vertical, ScrollBarInfo scrollBarInfo)
		{
			InitializeScrollInfo(vertical, scrollBarInfo, allowRecursion: true);
		}

		private void InitializeScrollInfo(bool vertical, ScrollBarInfo scrollBarInfo, bool allowRecursion)
		{
			if (!((Control)(object)panel).IsHandleCreated)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!((!vertical) ? panel.IsHorizontalScrollbarVisible : panel.IsVerticalScrollbarVisible))
			{
				int minimum = (scrollBarInfo.Maximum = 0);
				scrollBarInfo.Minimum = minimum;
				return;
			}
			NativeWindowMethods.SCROLLINFO lpsi = new NativeWindowMethods.SCROLLINFO
			{
				cbSize = Marshal.SizeOf(typeof(NativeWindowMethods.SCROLLINFO)),
				fMask = 23
			};
			int fnBar = (vertical ? 1 : 0);
			NativeWindowMethods.GetScrollInfo(((Control)(object)panel).Handle, fnBar, ref lpsi);
			if (!scrollBarInfo.IsThumbInDrag)
			{
				scrollBarInfo.Minimum = lpsi.nMin;
				scrollBarInfo.Maximum = lpsi.nMax;
				scrollBarInfo.Value = lpsi.nPos;
				scrollBarInfo.LargeChange = lpsi.nPage;
			}
			if (allowRecursion && scrollBarInfo.Minimum == 0 && scrollBarInfo.Maximum == 0)
			{
				AdjustFormScrollbars(enable: true);
				InitializeScrollInfo(vertical, scrollBarInfo, allowRecursion: false);
				return;
			}
			scrollBarInfo.Enabled = (vertical ? ((ScrollableControl)(object)panel).VerticalScroll.Enabled : ((ScrollableControl)(object)panel).HorizontalScroll.Enabled);
			ScrollEventType scrollType = ScrollEventType.EndScroll;
			int newValue = scrollBarInfo.Value;
			if (!scrollBarInfo.IsThumbInDrag)
			{
				AdjustInfoForRightToLeftScrolling(vertical, scrollBarInfo, ref newValue, ref scrollType);
			}
			scrollBarInfo.Value = newValue;
		}

		internal void RedrawWindow()
		{
			NativeWindowMethods.RedrawWindow(((Control)(object)panel).Handle, IntPtr.Zero, IntPtr.Zero, 1415u);
		}

		internal Point ScrollToControl(Control activeControl)
		{
			panel.Owner.DirtyControlElement();
			return panelUnsafe.InternalScrollToControl(activeControl);
		}

		internal void UpdateCreateParams(CreateParams cp)
		{
			cp.Style = UpdateStyle(cp.Style);
		}

		internal void UpdateScrollInfo(ScrollEventArgs e, bool vertical, ScrollBarInfo scrollBarInfo)
		{
			if (((Control)(object)panel).IsHandleCreated)
			{
				int wMsg = (vertical ? 277 : 276);
				int newValue = e.NewValue;
				ScrollEventType scrollType = e.Type;
				AdjustInfoForRightToLeftScrolling(vertical, scrollBarInfo, ref newValue, ref scrollType);
				int value = (newValue << 16) | (int)scrollType;
				if (e.Type == ScrollEventType.ThumbPosition || e.Type == ScrollEventType.ThumbTrack)
				{
					int fnBar = (vertical ? 1 : 0);
					NativeWindowMethods.SCROLLINFO lpsi = default(NativeWindowMethods.SCROLLINFO);
					lpsi.cbSize = Marshal.SizeOf((object)lpsi);
					lpsi.fMask = 4;
					lpsi.nPos = newValue;
					NativeWindowMethods.SetScrollInfo(((Control)(object)panel).Handle, fnBar, ref lpsi, bRedraw: false);
				}
				NativeWindowMethods.SendMessage(((Control)(object)panel).Handle, wMsg, new IntPtr(value), IntPtr.Zero);
				if (e.Type != ScrollEventType.ThumbTrack)
				{
					InitializeScrollInfo(vertical, scrollBarInfo);
					e.NewValue = scrollBarInfo.Value;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void WndProc(ref Message m)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			switch (m.Msg)
			{
			case 276:
				flag = WmHScroll(ref m);
				break;
			case 522:
				flag = WmMouseWheel(ref m);
				break;
			case 124:
				flag = WmStyleChanging(ref m);
				break;
			case 131:
				flag = WmNCCalcSize(ref m);
				break;
			case 133:
				flag = WmNCPaint(ref m);
				break;
			case 277:
				flag = WmVScroll(ref m);
				break;
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				panelUnsafe.InternalWndProc(ref m);
			}
		}

		private void AdjustInfoForRightToLeftScrolling(bool vertical, ScrollBarInfo scrollBarInfo, ref int newValue, ref ScrollEventType scrollType)
		{
			if (!vertical && panel.Owner.RightToLeft == RightToLeft.Yes)
			{
				int minimum = scrollBarInfo.Minimum;
				int maximumDragValue = scrollBarInfo.MaximumDragValue;
				int num = newValue - minimum;
				num = maximumDragValue - num;
				newValue = num + minimum;
				switch (scrollType)
				{
				case ScrollEventType.First:
					scrollType = ScrollEventType.Last;
					break;
				case ScrollEventType.Last:
					scrollType = ScrollEventType.First;
					break;
				case ScrollEventType.LargeDecrement:
					scrollType = ScrollEventType.LargeIncrement;
					break;
				case ScrollEventType.LargeIncrement:
					scrollType = ScrollEventType.LargeDecrement;
					break;
				case ScrollEventType.SmallDecrement:
					scrollType = ScrollEventType.SmallIncrement;
					break;
				case ScrollEventType.SmallIncrement:
					scrollType = ScrollEventType.SmallDecrement;
					break;
				case ScrollEventType.ThumbPosition:
				case ScrollEventType.ThumbTrack:
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void FixupScrollbars()
		{
			if (((ScrollableControl)(object)panel).AutoScroll)
			{
				Rectangle clientRectangle = ((Control)(object)panel).ClientRectangle;
				Rectangle displayRectangle = ((Control)(object)panel).DisplayRectangle;
				if (panel.HScrollInternal && displayRectangle.Width <= clientRectangle.Width)
				{
					panel.HScrollInternal = false;
				}
				if (panel.VScrollInternal && displayRectangle.Height <= clientRectangle.Height)
				{
					panel.VScrollInternal = false;
				}
			}
		}

		private bool ProcessScrollMessage(ref Message m)
		{
			if (isAdjustingScrollInfo)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ScrollEventType scrollEventType = (ScrollEventType)(m.WParam.ToInt32() & 0xFFFF);
			bool flag = false;
			flag = ((m.Msg != 276) ? panel.IsVerticalScrollbarVisible : panel.IsHorizontalScrollbarVisible);
			if (scrollEventType == ScrollEventType.ThumbTrack && flag)
			{
				return false;
			}
			NativeWindowMethods.SendMessage(((Control)(object)panel).Handle, 11, IntPtr.Zero, IntPtr.Zero);
			panelUnsafe.InternalWndProc(ref m);
			NativeWindowMethods.SendMessage(((Control)(object)panel).Handle, 11, new IntPtr(1), IntPtr.Zero);
			if (panel.DirtyOnNextScrollMessage)
			{
				((UIElement)panel.Owner.ControlElement).DirtyChildElements();
				panel.DirtyOnNextScrollMessage = false;
			}
			RedrawWindow();
			return true;
		}

		private int UpdateStyle(int wsStyle)
		{
			wsStyle &= -3145729;
			return wsStyle;
		}

		private bool WmHScroll(ref Message m)
		{
			return ProcessScrollMessage(ref m);
		}

		private bool WmMouseWheel(ref Message m)
		{
			panel.DirtyOwnerElement();
			return false;
		}

		private bool WmStyleChanging(ref Message m)
		{
			if (m.WParam.ToInt32() != -16)
			{
				return false;
			}
			NativeWindowMethods.StyleStruct styleStruct = (NativeWindowMethods.StyleStruct)Marshal.PtrToStructure(m.LParam, typeof(NativeWindowMethods.StyleStruct));
			styleStruct.styleNew = UpdateStyle(styleStruct.styleNew);
			Marshal.StructureToPtr((object)styleStruct, m.LParam, fDeleteOld: true);
			return false;
		}

		private bool WmNCCalcSize(ref Message m)
		{
			if (m.WParam.ToInt64() != 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			NativeWindowMethods.RECT rectProposed = ((NativeWindowMethods.NCCALCSIZE_PARAMS)m.GetLParam(typeof(NativeWindowMethods.NCCALCSIZE_PARAMS))).rectProposed;
			panelUnsafe.InternalWndProc(ref m);
			NativeWindowMethods.NCCALCSIZE_PARAMS nCCALCSIZE_PARAMS = (NativeWindowMethods.NCCALCSIZE_PARAMS)m.GetLParam(typeof(NativeWindowMethods.NCCALCSIZE_PARAMS));
			nCCALCSIZE_PARAMS.rectProposed = rectProposed;
			Marshal.StructureToPtr((object)nCCALCSIZE_PARAMS, m.LParam, fDeleteOld: false);
			return true;
		}

		private bool WmNCPaint(ref Message m)
		{
			return true;
		}

		private bool WmVScroll(ref Message m)
		{
			return ProcessScrollMessage(ref m);
		}
	}
	public abstract class AutoScrollControlUIElement : ControlUIElementBase
	{
		internal AutoScrollControlUIElement(Control control, IUltraControl ultraControl)
			: base(control, ultraControl)
		{
		}

		internal void PositionHorizontalScrollBar(AutoScrollContainerPanel container, ref Rectangle workRect, UIElementsCollection oldElements)
		{
			ScrollBarInfo horizontalScrollbarInfo = container.GetHorizontalScrollbarInfo();
			if (horizontalScrollbarInfo != null)
			{
				ComponentRole val = ((container.Owner.ControlElement != null) ? container.Owner.ControlElement.ComponentRole : null);
				ScrollBarLook scrollBarLookIfAllocated = horizontalScrollbarInfo.GetScrollBarLookIfAllocated();
				int horizontalScrollBarHeightResolved = ScrollBarLook.GetHorizontalScrollBarHeightResolved(scrollBarLookIfAllocated, val);
				HorizontalScrollBarUIElement horizontalScrollBarUIElement = (HorizontalScrollBarUIElement)UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)oldElements, typeof(HorizontalScrollBarUIElement), true);
				if (horizontalScrollBarUIElement == null)
				{
					horizontalScrollBarUIElement = new HorizontalScrollBarUIElement((UIElement)(object)this, horizontalScrollbarInfo);
				}
				else
				{
					horizontalScrollBarUIElement.Initialize(horizontalScrollbarInfo);
				}
				((UIElement)horizontalScrollBarUIElement).Rect = new Rectangle(workRect.X, workRect.Bottom - horizontalScrollBarHeightResolved, workRect.Width, horizontalScrollBarHeightResolved);
				((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)horizontalScrollBarUIElement);
				workRect.Height -= horizontalScrollBarHeightResolved;
			}
		}

		internal void PositionScrollBars(AutoScrollContainerPanel container, ref Rectangle workRect, bool verticalScrollbarVisible, bool horizontalScrollbarVisible, UIElementsCollection oldElements)
		{
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0025: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (horizontalScrollbarVisible && verticalScrollbarVisible)
			{
				ScrollbarIntersectionUIElement val = (ScrollbarIntersectionUIElement)UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)oldElements, typeof(ScrollbarIntersectionUIElement), true);
				if (val == null)
				{
					val = new ScrollbarIntersectionUIElement((UIElement)(object)this);
				}
				int num;
				int num2;
				if (container != null)
				{
					ScrollBarInfo verticalScrollbarInfo = container.GetVerticalScrollbarInfo();
					ScrollBarLook val2 = ((verticalScrollbarInfo != null) ? verticalScrollbarInfo.GetScrollBarLookIfAllocated() : null);
					ComponentRole val3 = ((container.Owner.ControlElement != null) ? container.Owner.ControlElement.ComponentRole : null);
					num = ScrollBarLook.GetHorizontalScrollBarHeightResolved(val2, val3);
					num2 = ScrollBarLook.GetVerticalScrollBarWidthResolved(val2, val3);
				}
				else
				{
					num = SystemInformation.HorizontalScrollBarHeight;
					num2 = SystemInformation.VerticalScrollBarWidth;
				}
				Rectangle rect = new Rectangle(workRect.Right - num2, workRect.Bottom - num, num2, num);
				((UIElement)val).Rect = rect;
				((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)val);
			}
			if (verticalScrollbarVisible)
			{
				PositionVerticalScrollBar(container, ref workRect, horizontalScrollbarVisible, oldElements);
			}
			if (horizontalScrollbarVisible)
			{
				PositionHorizontalScrollBar(container, ref workRect, oldElements);
			}
		}

		internal void PositionVerticalScrollBar(AutoScrollContainerPanel container, ref Rectangle workRect, bool horizontalScrollbarVisible, UIElementsCollection oldElements)
		{
			ScrollBarInfo verticalScrollbarInfo = container.GetVerticalScrollbarInfo();
			if (verticalScrollbarInfo != null)
			{
				ScrollBarLook scrollBarLookIfAllocated = verticalScrollbarInfo.GetScrollBarLookIfAllocated();
				ComponentRole componentRole = container.Owner.ControlElement.ComponentRole;
				int horizontalScrollBarHeightResolved = ScrollBarLook.GetHorizontalScrollBarHeightResolved(scrollBarLookIfAllocated, componentRole);
				int verticalScrollBarWidthResolved = ScrollBarLook.GetVerticalScrollBarWidthResolved(scrollBarLookIfAllocated, componentRole);
				VeritcalScrollBarUIElement veritcalScrollBarUIElement = (VeritcalScrollBarUIElement)UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)oldElements, typeof(VeritcalScrollBarUIElement), true);
				if (veritcalScrollBarUIElement == null)
				{
					veritcalScrollBarUIElement = new VeritcalScrollBarUIElement((UIElement)(object)this, verticalScrollbarInfo);
				}
				else
				{
					veritcalScrollBarUIElement.Initialize(verticalScrollbarInfo);
				}
				Control control = ((UIElement)this).Control;
				((UIElement)veritcalScrollBarUIElement).Rect = new Rectangle((control.RightToLeft == RightToLeft.Yes) ? workRect.Left : (workRect.Right - verticalScrollBarWidthResolved), workRect.Y, verticalScrollBarWidthResolved, workRect.Height - (horizontalScrollbarVisible ? horizontalScrollBarHeightResolved : 0));
				((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)veritcalScrollBarUIElement);
				if (control.RightToLeft == RightToLeft.Yes)
				{
					workRect.X += verticalScrollBarWidthResolved;
				}
				workRect.Width -= verticalScrollBarWidthResolved;
			}
		}
	}
	[Flags]
	public enum CommonControlClasses
	{
		ListViewClasses = 1,
		TreeViewClasses = 2,

		internal struct RECT
		{
			public int Left;

			public int Top;

			public int Right;

			public int Bottom;

			internal bool IsEmpty
			{
				get
				{
					if (Left == 0 && Top == 0 && Bottom == 0)
					{
						return Right == 0;
					}
					return false;
				}
			}

			internal Rectangle ToRectangle()
			{
				return Rectangle.FromLTRB(Left, Top, Right, Bottom);
			}

			internal static RECT FromRectangle(Rectangle rect)
			{
				RECT result = default(RECT);
				if (rect.IsEmpty)
				{
					return result;
				}
				result.Left = rect.Left;
				result.Top = rect.Top;
				result.Bottom = rect.Bottom;
				result.Right = rect.Right;
				return result;
			}
		}

		internal static Version GetComCtlVersion()
		{
			IntPtr moduleHandle = GetModuleHandle("comctl32.dll");
			if (moduleHandle == IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				return new Version();
			}
			IntPtr procAddress = GetProcAddress(moduleHandle, "DllGetVersion");
			if (procAddress == IntPtr.Zero)
			{
				return new Version();
			}
			DLLVERSIONINFO pdvi = default(DLLVERSIONINFO);
			try
			{
				DllGetVersion(ref pdvi);
				return new Version(pdvi.dwMajorVersion, pdvi.dwMinorVersion, pdvi.dwBuildNumber);
			}
			catch
			{
				return new Version();
			}
		}

		internal static int MakeLong(int lo, int hi)
		{
			return (lo & 0xFFFF) | ((short)hi << 16);
		}

		internal static IntPtr MakeLParam(int lo, int hi)
		{
			return (IntPtr)(((short)hi << 16) | (lo & 0xFFFF));
		}

		internal static int MakeWord(int lo, int hi)
		{
			return (lo & 0xFFFF) | ((hi & 0xFF) << 8);
		}

		internal static int HiByteWord(int word)
		{
			return (word >> 8) & 0xFF;
		}

		internal static int LoByteWord(int word)
		{
			return word & 0xFF;
		}

		internal static int HiWord(int dWord)
		{
			return (dWord >> 16) & 0xFFFF;
		}

		internal static int LoWord(int dWord)
		{
			return dWord & 0xFFFF;
		}
	}

		protected override bool OnMouseUp(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			bool isMouseDownAndOver = ((ButtonUIElementBase)this).IsMouseDownAndOver;
			bool enabled = ((UIElement)this).Enabled;
			bool result = ((ButtonUIElementBase)this).OnMouseUp(e);
			if (enabled && isMouseDownAndOver && SplitButton.HasSplitDropDownButton)
			{
				SplitButton.InvokeClick();
				return true;
			}
			((UIElement)this).DirtyChildElements();
			if (!enabled)
			{
				return result;
			}
			return true;
		}

				: base((Control)(object)dropDownButton)
			{
				this.dropDownButton = dropDownButton;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetChild(int index)
			{
				if (index == 0)
				{
					if (((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)dropDownButton).ControlUIElement).GetDescendant(typeof(SplitButtonUIElement)) is SplitButtonUIElement splitButtonUIElement)
					{
						return ((UIElement)splitButtonUIElement).AccessibilityInstance;
					}
					return null;
				}
				index--;
				if (index == 0)
				{
					if (((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)dropDownButton).ControlUIElement).GetDescendant(typeof(SplitButtonDropDownUIElement)) is SplitButtonDropDownUIElement splitButtonDropDownUIElement)
					{
						return ((UIElement)splitButtonDropDownUIElement).AccessibilityInstance;
					}
					return null;
				}
				return null;
			}

			public override int GetChildCount()
			{
				if (dropDownButton.Style == SplitButtonDisplayStyle.DropDownButtonOnly)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				return 2;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject HitTest(int x, int y)
			{
				AccessibleObject childControlAccessibleObject = ((UltraControlAccessibleObject)this).GetChildControlAccessibleObject(x, y);
				if (childControlAccessibleObject != null)
				{
					return childControlAccessibleObject;
				}
				AccessibleObject accessibleObject = ((UltraControlAccessibleObject)this).HitTest(x, y);
				if ((object)accessibleObject != this)
				{
					return accessibleObject;
				}
				UIElement controlUIElement = (UIElement)(object)((UltraControlBase)dropDownButton).ControlUIElement;
				if (controlUIElement == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return controlUIElement.HitTest(x, y);
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Navigate(AccessibleNavigation navdir)
			{
				switch (navdir)
				{
				case AccessibleNavigation.FirstChild:
					return ((AccessibleObject)(object)this).GetChild(0);
				case AccessibleNavigation.LastChild:
					if (dropDownButton.Style == SplitButtonDisplayStyle.DropDownButtonOnly)
					{
						return ((AccessibleObject)(object)this).GetChild(0);
					}
					return ((AccessibleObject)(object)this).GetChild(1);
				default:
					return ((AccessibleObject)this).Navigate(navdir);
				}
			}
		}

		}

		protected override Size CalculatePreferredSize(Size proposedSize)
		{
			proposedSize.Width -= 13;
			Size result = base.CalculatePreferredSize(proposedSize);
			result.Width += 13;
			return result;
		}

		protected override int CalculateWidthAvailable(int width)
		{
			width = base.CalculateWidthAvailable(width);
			width -= 13;
			return width;
		}

		protected override void ButtonKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!e.Handled)
			{
				if (e.KeyData == Keys.Down && !IsDroppedDown)
				{
					DropDown();
				}
				else if (e.KeyData == Keys.Space && HasSplitDropDownButton)
				{
					if (((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).GetDescendant(typeof(SplitButtonUIElement)) is SplitButtonUIElement splitButtonUIElement && (object)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement.ElementWithMouseCapture != splitButtonUIElement)
					{
						if (!((ButtonUIElementBase)splitButtonUIElement).IsMouseDown)
						{
							((UIElement)splitButtonUIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
						}
						((ButtonUIElementBase)splitButtonUIElement).ButtonState = (UIElementButtonState)3;
					}
				}
				else if (e.KeyData == Keys.Escape && IsDroppedDown)
				{
					CloseUp();
				}
			}
			base.ButtonKeyDown(e);
		}

		protected override void ButtonKeyUp(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.KeyData == Keys.Space)
			{
				if (((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).GetDescendant(typeof(SplitButtonUIElement)) is SplitButtonUIElement splitButtonUIElement && (object)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement.ElementWithMouseCapture != splitButtonUIElement)
				{
					if (!((ButtonUIElementBase)splitButtonUIElement).IsMouseDown)
					{
						((UIElement)splitButtonUIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
					}
					splitButtonUIElement.Reset();
				}
				if (!e.Handled && HasSplitDropDownButton)
				{
					PerformClick();
				}
				((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
			}
			base.ButtonKeyUp(e);
		}

		private void OnPopupProviderClosed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (currentPopupItem != null)
			{
				currentPopupItem.Closed -= OnPopupProviderClosed;
			}
			currentPopupItem = null;
			((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
			OnClosedUp(EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		public virtual void DropDown()
		{
			if (IsDroppedDown || ((Control)(object)this).IsDisposed || ((Control)(object)this).Disposing)
			{
				return;
			}
			CancelEventArgs e = new CancelEventArgs();
			OnDroppingDown(e);
			if (e.Cancel)
			{
				return;
			}
			IPopupItem val = PopupItem;
			if (val == null && PopupItemProvider != null)
			{
				val = PopupItemProvider.GetPopupItem(PopupItemKey);
			}
			if (val != null)
			{
				currentPopupItem = val;
				currentPopupItem.Closed += OnPopupProviderClosed;
				PopupInfo.AlignRight = RightAlignPopupResolved;
				if (PopupInfo.AlignRight)
				{
					PopupInfo.PreferredLocation = ((Control)(object)this).PointToScreen(new Point(((Control)(object)this).Width, ((Control)(object)this).Height));
				}
				else
				{
					PopupInfo.PreferredLocation = ((Control)(object)this).PointToScreen(new Point(0, ((Control)(object)this).Height));
				}
				PopupInfo.ExclusionRect = ((Control)(object)this).RectangleToScreen(((Control)(object)this).DisplayRectangle);
				PopupInfo.SourceControl = (Control)(object)this;
				currentPopupItem.Show(PopupInfo);
				if (currentPopupItem != null && !currentPopupItem.IsDisplayed)
				{
					currentPopupItem.Closed -= OnPopupProviderClosed;
					currentPopupItem = null;
				}
				((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
			}
		}

		public virtual void CloseUp()
		{
			if (IsDroppedDown && currentPopupItem != null)
			{
				currentPopupItem.Close();
			}
		}

		internal void InvokeClick()
		{
			((Control)(object)this).OnClick(EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		protected override bool IsInputKey(Keys keyData)
		{
			if ((keyData & Keys.Down) == Keys.Down)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return ((Control)(object)this).IsInputKey(keyData);
		}

		protected override void OnLeave(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (IsDroppedDown)
			{
				CloseUp();
			}
			((Control)(object)this).OnLeave(e);
		}

		protected override ComponentRole CreateComponentRole()
		{
			return (ComponentRole)(object)new MiscControlRole((UltraControlBase)(object)this, StyleUtils.ComponentType.UltraDropDownButton);
		}

		protected virtual void OnDroppingDown(CancelEventArgs e)
		{
			((CancelEventHandler)((Component)(object)this).Events[EventDroppingDown])?.Invoke(this, e);
		}

		protected virtual void OnClosedUp(EventArgs e)
		{
			((EventHandler)((Component)(object)this).Events[EventClosedUp])?.Invoke(this, e);
		}

		internal void AccessibilityNotifyClientsInternal(AccessibleEvents accEvent, int childID)
		{
			if (!((Control)(object)this).IsDisposed && !((Control)(object)this).Disposing && ((Control)(object)this).IsHandleCreated && (accEvent != AccessibleEvents.Focus || ((Control)(object)this).Focused))
			{
				((Control)(object)this).AccessibilityNotifyClients(accEvent, childID);
			}
		}

		protected override AccessibleObject CreateAccessibilityInstance()
		{
			return (AccessibleObject)(object)new UltraDropDownButtonAccessibleObject(this);
		}

		protected internal virtual AccessibleObject CreateAccessibilityInstance(object relatedObject)
		{
			AccessibleObject result = null;
			if (relatedObject is SplitButtonDropDownUIElement)
			{
				result = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)new SplitButtonDropDownUIElement.SplitButtonDropDownUIElementAccessibleObject(relatedObject as SplitButtonDropDownUIElement)).AccessibleObject;
			}
			else if (relatedObject is SplitButtonUIElement)
			{
				result = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)new SplitButtonUIElement.SplitButtonUIElementAccessibleObject(relatedObject as SplitButtonUIElement)).AccessibleObject;
			}
			return result;
		}
	}

		public bool DrawElement(DrawPhase drawPhase, ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)

			if (((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Element is GroupBoxContentAreaBorderUIElement { GroupBox: not null } groupBoxContentAreaBorderUIElement && groupBoxContentAreaBorderUIElement.GroupBox.BorderStyleResolved != GroupBoxBorderStyle.None)
			{
				groupBoxContentAreaBorderUIElement.DrawSolidBordersHelper(ref drawParams, Border3DSide.Top);
				return true;

				return (DrawPhase)0;
			}
			return (DrawPhase)128;
		}

	[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_UltraPanel")]
	[DefaultEvent("PaintClient")]
	[LicenseProvider(typeof(UltraLicenseProvider))]
	[ToolboxBitmap(typeof(ControlBase), "ToolboxBitmaps.CLR2.UltraPanel.png")]
	[UltraLicense("UltraPanel")]
	[Designer("Infragistics.Win.Misc.Design.UltraPanelDesigner, Infragistics4.Win.v15.1.Design, Version=15.1.20151.1000, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=7dd5c3163f2cd0cb", typeof(IDesigner))]

		protected class PanelAccessibleObject : UltraControlAccessibleObject
		{
			private UltraPanel panel;

			public override AccessibleRole Role
			{
				get
				{
					if (((Control)(object)panel).AccessibleRole != AccessibleRole.Default)
					{
						return ((Control.ControlAccessibleObject)this).Role;
					}
					return AccessibleRole.Client;
				}
			}

			public override AccessibleStates State
			{
				get
				{
					AccessibleStates accessibleStates = AccessibleStates.None;
					if (!((Control)(object)panel).Enabled)
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Unavailable;
					}
					else if (((Control)(object)panel).Visible)
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Focusable;
						if (((Control)(object)panel).ContainsFocus)
						{
							accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Focused;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Invisible;
					}
					if (((AccessibleObject)(object)this).Bounds.IsEmpty)
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Offscreen;
					}
					return accessibleStates;
				}
			}

			public UltraPanel Panel => panel;

			public PanelAccessibleObject(UltraPanel panel)
				: base((Control)(object)panel)
			{
				this.panel = panel;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetChild(int index)
			{
				if (index < 0 || index >= ((AccessibleObject)(object)this).GetChildCount())
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (index == 0)
				{
					return ((Control)(object)panel.ClientArea).AccessibilityObject;
				}
				index--;
				if (index == 0 && panel.ClientArea.IsHorizontalScrollbarVisible)
				{
					UIElement descendant = ((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)panel).ControlUIElement).GetDescendant(typeof(HorizontalScrollBarUIElement));
					if (descendant == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return descendant.AccessibilityInstance;
				}
				index--;
				if (index == 0 && panel.ClientArea.IsVerticalScrollbarVisible)
				{
					UIElement descendant2 = ((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)panel).ControlUIElement).GetDescendant(typeof(VeritcalScrollBarUIElement));
					if (descendant2 == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return descendant2.AccessibilityInstance;
				}
				index--;
				return null;
			}

			public override int GetChildCount()
			{
				int num = 1;
				if (panel.ClientArea.IsFullTrust)
				{
					if (panel.ClientArea.IsHorizontalScrollbarVisible)
					{
						num++;
					}
					if (panel.ClientArea.IsVerticalScrollbarVisible)
					{
						num++;
					}
				}
				return num;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetFocused()
			{
				return ((Control)(object)panel.ClientArea).AccessibilityObject.GetFocused();
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetSelected()
			{
				return ((Control)(object)panel.ClientArea).AccessibilityObject.GetSelected();
			}

			public override AccessibleObject HitTest(int x, int y)
			{
				Rectangle bounds = panel.ClientArea.Bounds;
				if (((Control)(object)panel).RectangleToScreen(bounds).Contains(x, y))
				{
					return ((Control)(object)panel.ClientArea).AccessibilityObject;
				}
				UIElement controlUIElement = (UIElement)(object)((UltraControlBase)panel).ControlUIElement;
				if (controlUIElement == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return controlUIElement.HitTest(x, y);
			}
		}

		public UltraPanel()
		{
			license = Utilities.ValidateLicense(typeof(UltraPanel), this);
			((Control)this).SetStyle(ControlStyles.Selectable, value: false);
			((Control)this).SetStyle(ControlStyles.SupportsTransparentBackColor, value: true);
			((Control)this).SetStyle(ControlStyles.OptimizedDoubleBuffer, value: true);
			((Control)this).SetStyle(ControlStyles.ContainerControl, value: true);
			if (clientArea == null)
			{
				clientArea = CreateClientArea();
			}
			((UltraPanelControlCollection)((Control)this).Controls).InternalAdd((Control)(object)clientArea);
			((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).Rect = ((Control)this).ClientRectangle;
			clientArea.InternalSetBounds(((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).RectInsideBorders);
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				DisposeContextMenu();
				if (controlElement != null)
				{
					((DisposableObject)(object)controlElement).Dispose();
					controlElement = null;
				}
				if (horizontalScrollProperties != null)
				{
					horizontalScrollProperties.SubObjectPropChanged -= SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					horizontalScrollProperties.Dispose();
					horizontalScrollProperties = null;
				}
				if (scrollBarLook != null)
				{
					((SubObjectBase)(object)scrollBarLook).SubObjectPropChanged -= SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					((DisposableObject)(object)scrollBarLook).Dispose();
					scrollBarLook = null;
				}
				if (verticalScrollProperties != null)
				{
					verticalScrollProperties.SubObjectPropChanged -= SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					verticalScrollProperties.Dispose();
					verticalScrollProperties = null;
				}
			}
			((UltraControlBase)this).Dispose(disposing);
		}

		protected override void ScaleControl(SizeF factor, BoundsSpecified specified)
		{
			bool flag = isInScaleControl;
			isInScaleControl = true;
			try
			{
				((Control)this).ScaleControl(factor, specified);
			}
			finally
			{
				isInScaleControl = flag;
			}
		}

		protected override void SetBoundsCore(int x, int y, int width, int height, BoundsSpecified specified)
		{
			int num = width - ((Control)this).Width;
			int num2 = height - ((Control)this).Height;
			((Control)this).SetBoundsCore(x, y, width, height, specified);
			if (isInScaleControl)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (controlElement != null && !((DisposableObject)(object)controlElement).Disposed)
			{
				((UIElement)controlElement).Rect = ((Control)this).ClientRectangle;
			}
			if (num == 0 && num2 == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			int width2 = ((Control)this).Width;
			if (num != 0 && width != width2)
			{
				num = ((num != width - width2) ? (width - width2) : 0);
			}
			int height2 = ((Control)this).Height;
			if (num2 != 0 && height != height2)
			{
				num2 = ((num2 != height - height2) ? (height - height2) : 0);
			}
			if (num != 0 || num2 != 0)
			{
				Rectangle bounds = ClientArea.Bounds;
				bounds.Width += num;
				bounds.Height += num2;
				ClientArea.InternalSetBounds(bounds, specified);
				if (controlElement != null && !((DisposableObject)(object)controlElement).Disposed && ((Control)this).IsHandleCreated)
				{
					((Control)this).BeginInvoke((Delegate)new MethodInvoker(((UIElement)controlElement).VerifyChildElements));
				}
			}
		}

		public void ResolveAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearanceData, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ResolutionOrderInfo resolutionOrder = StyleUtils.GetResolutionOrder((UltraControlBase)(object)this);
			UIRole mainRole = MainRole;
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseStyleBefore && mainRole != null)
			{
				mainRole.ResolveAppearance(ref appearanceData, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
			}
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseControlInfo && HasAppearance)
			{
				Appearance.MergeData(ref appearanceData, ref requestedProps);
			}
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseStyleAfter && mainRole != null)
			{
				mainRole.ResolveAppearance(ref appearanceData, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
			}
			ResolveAppearanceDefaults(ref appearanceData, ref requestedProps);
		}

		protected virtual void OnSubObjectPropChange(PropChangeInfo propChangeInfo)
		{
			if (HasAppearance && propChangeInfo.Source == appearanceHolder.RootAppearance)
			{
				((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)PanelPropertyIds.Appearance);
			}
			else if (propChangeInfo.Source == horizontalScrollProperties)
			{
				((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)PanelPropertyIds.HorizontalScrollProperties, propChangeInfo);
			}
			else if (propChangeInfo.Source == scrollBarLook)
			{
				((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)PanelPropertyIds.ScrollBarLook, propChangeInfo);
			}
			else if (propChangeInfo.Source == verticalScrollProperties)
			{
				((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)PanelPropertyIds.VerticalScrollProperties, propChangeInfo);
			}
		}

				ClientArea.DirtyControlElement();
			}
		}

	{
		private enum ScrollBarChangeType
		{
			AddScrollBar,
			NoChange,
			RemoveScrollBar
		}

		private UltraPanel panel;

		private bool wasShowingHorizontalScrollbarOnLastPosition;

		private bool wasShowingVerticalScrollbarOnLastPosition;

		public override UIElementBorderStyle BorderStyle => panel.BorderStyleResolved;
