		protected override void PositionChildElements()
		{
			UIElementsCollection childElementsCollection = ((UIElement)this).childElementsCollection;
			((UIElement)this).childElementsCollection = null;
			UltraPanelClientArea clientArea = panel.ClientArea;
			Rectangle workRect = ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders;
			ScrollBarLook scrollBarLookIfAllocated = panel.GetScrollBarLookIfAllocated();
			int horizontalScrollBarHeightResolved = ScrollBarLook.GetHorizontalScrollBarHeightResolved(scrollBarLookIfAllocated, ((UltraControlBase)panel).ComponentRole);
			int verticalScrollBarWidthResolved = ScrollBarLook.GetVerticalScrollBarWidthResolved(scrollBarLookIfAllocated, ((UltraControlBase)panel).ComponentRole);
			if (!panel.ShouldDisplayCustomScrollbars)
			{
				clientArea.InternalSetSize(workRect.Size);
				return;
			}
			bool preventDirtyOfControlElement = panel.PreventDirtyOfControlElement;
			try
			{
				panel.PreventDirtyOfControlElement = true;
				Size size = workRect.Size;
				if (wasShowingHorizontalScrollbarOnLastPosition)
				{
					size.Height -= horizontalScrollBarHeightResolved;
				}
				if (wasShowingVerticalScrollbarOnLastPosition)
				{
					size.Width -= verticalScrollBarWidthResolved;
				}
				bool wasScrollBarVisible = wasShowingHorizontalScrollbarOnLastPosition;
				bool wasScrollBarVisible2 = wasShowingVerticalScrollbarOnLastPosition;
				bool isHorizontalScrollbarVisible;
				bool isVerticalScrollbarVisible;
				while (true)
				{
					clientArea.InternalSetSize(size);
					isHorizontalScrollbarVisible = clientArea.IsHorizontalScrollbarVisible;
					isVerticalScrollbarVisible = clientArea.IsVerticalScrollbarVisible;
					ScrollBarChangeType changeType = GetChangeType(wasScrollBarVisible, isHorizontalScrollbarVisible);
					ScrollBarChangeType changeType2 = GetChangeType(wasScrollBarVisible2, isVerticalScrollbarVisible);
					if (changeType == ScrollBarChangeType.NoChange && changeType2 == ScrollBarChangeType.NoChange)
					{
						break;
					}
					switch (changeType)
					{
					case ScrollBarChangeType.AddScrollBar:
						size.Height -= horizontalScrollBarHeightResolved;
						break;
					case ScrollBarChangeType.RemoveScrollBar:
						size.Height += horizontalScrollBarHeightResolved;
						break;
					}
					switch (changeType2)
					{
					case ScrollBarChangeType.AddScrollBar:
						size.Width -= verticalScrollBarWidthResolved;
						break;
					case ScrollBarChangeType.RemoveScrollBar:
						size.Width += verticalScrollBarWidthResolved;
						break;
					}
					wasScrollBarVisible = isHorizontalScrollbarVisible;
					wasScrollBarVisible2 = isVerticalScrollbarVisible;
				}
				wasShowingHorizontalScrollbarOnLastPosition = isHorizontalScrollbarVisible;
				wasShowingVerticalScrollbarOnLastPosition = isVerticalScrollbarVisible;
				PositionScrollBars(clientArea, ref workRect, wasShowingVerticalScrollbarOnLastPosition, wasShowingHorizontalScrollbarOnLastPosition, childElementsCollection);
				clientArea.InternalSetLocation(workRect.Location);
			}
			finally
			{
				panel.PreventDirtyOfControlElement = preventDirtyOfControlElement;
				if (childElementsCollection != null)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < ((ArrayList)(object)childElementsCollection).Count; i++)
					{
						((DisposableObject)(object)childElementsCollection[i])?.Dispose();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private static ScrollBarChangeType GetChangeType(bool wasScrollBarVisible, bool isScrollBarVisible)
		{
			if (wasScrollBarVisible == isScrollBarVisible)
			{
				return ScrollBarChangeType.NoChange;
			}
			if (!isScrollBarVisible)
			{
				return ScrollBarChangeType.RemoveScrollBar;
			}
			return ScrollBarChangeType.AddScrollBar;
		}
	}

		protected override void PositionChildElements()
		{
			((UIElement)this).PositionChildElements();
			UIElementsCollection childElementsCollection = base.childElementsCollection;
			base.childElementsCollection = null;
			if (SplitterOwner.CollapseUIType == CollapseUIType.Button)
			{
				SplitterButtonUIElement splitterButtonUIElement = (SplitterButtonUIElement)UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)childElementsCollection, typeof(SplitterButtonUIElement), true);
				if (splitterButtonUIElement == null)
				{
					splitterButtonUIElement = new SplitterButtonUIElement((UIElement)(object)this, SplitterOwner);
				}
				else
				{
					splitterButtonUIElement.Initialize(SplitterOwner);
				}
				Rectangle rectInsideBorders = ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders;
				if (IsVertical)
				{
					rectInsideBorders.Height = SplitterOwner.ButtonExtent;
				}
				else
				{
					rectInsideBorders.Width = SplitterOwner.ButtonExtent;
				}
				DrawUtility.AdjustHAlign((HAlign)2, ref rectInsideBorders, ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders);
				DrawUtility.AdjustVAlign((VAlign)2, ref rectInsideBorders, ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders);
				((UIElement)splitterButtonUIElement).Rect = rectInsideBorders;
				((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)splitterButtonUIElement);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnCaptureAborted()
		{
			DragCancel();
			((UIElement)this).OnCaptureAborted();
		}

		protected override bool OnMouseDown(MouseEventArgs e, bool adjustableArea, ref UIElement captureMouseForElement)
		{
			if (e.Button == MouseButtons.Left && e.Clicks == 1 && DragStart(new Point(e.X, e.Y)))
			{
				captureMouseForElement = (UIElement)(object)this;
				return true;
			}
			return ((UIElement)this).OnMouseDown(e, adjustableArea, ref captureMouseForElement);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseMove(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			DragMove(new Point(e.X, e.Y));
			((UIElement)this).OnMouseMove(e);
		}

		protected override bool OnMouseUp(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			DragEnd(new Point(e.X, e.Y));
			return ((UIElement)this).OnMouseUp(e);
		}

	internal class SplitDragManager : IDisposable
	{
		private class SplitInfo
		{
			private int orignalExtent;

			private int newExtent;

			private int offset;

			private int minExtent;

			private int maxExtent;

			public int MinExtent
			{
				get
				{
					return minExtent;
				}
				set
				{
					minExtent = value;
				}
			}

			public int MaxExtent
			{
				get
				{
					return maxExtent;
				}
				set
				{
					maxExtent = value;
				}
			}

			public int NewExtent
			{
				get
				{
					return newExtent;
				}
				set
				{
					newExtent = value;
				}
			}

			public int Offset
			{
				get
				{
					return offset;
				}
				set
				{
					offset = value;
				}
			}

			public int OrignalExtent
			{
				get
				{
					return orignalExtent;
				}
				set
				{
					orignalExtent = value;
				}
			}

			internal SplitInfo(int orignalExtent, int newExtent, int offset, int minExtent, int maxExtent)
			{
				this.orignalExtent = orignalExtent;
				this.newExtent = newExtent;
				this.offset = offset;
				this.minExtent = minExtent;
				this.maxExtent = maxExtent;

		private class UltraSplitterMessageFilter : IMessageFilter
		{
			private SplitDragManager splitDragManager;

			internal UltraSplitterMessageFilter(SplitDragManager splitDragManager)
			{
				this.splitDragManager = splitDragManager;
			}

			[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.UnmanagedCode)]
			bool IMessageFilter.PreFilterMessage(ref Message m)
			{
				if (m.Msg < 256 || m.Msg > 265)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (m.Msg == 256 && (int)(long)m.WParam == 27)
				{
					splitDragManager.DragCancel();
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private UltraSplitterUIElement ultraSplitterUIElement;

		private Point mouseOffsetInControlCoords;

		private bool vertical;

		private Rectangle splitterRectOnScreen;

		private DragDropIndicatorManager dragDropIndicatorManager;

		private Bitmap dragPreviewBitmap;

		private UltraSplitterMessageFilter ultraSplitterMessageFilter;

		private SplitInfo splitInfo;

		public bool IsDragging => dragDropIndicatorManager != null;

		private ISplitterOwner SplitterOwner => ultraSplitterUIElement.SplitterOwner;

		private Orientation SplitterOrientation
		{
			get
			{
				if (!ultraSplitterUIElement.IsVertical)
				{
					return Orientation.Horizontal;
				}
				return Orientation.Vertical;
			}
		}

		internal SplitDragManager(UltraSplitterUIElement ultraSplitterUIElement)
		{
			this.ultraSplitterUIElement = ultraSplitterUIElement;
		}

		private int CalculateNewExtent(int originalExtent, int offset)
		{
			offset = ReverseOffSetIfNeccessary(offset);
			return originalExtent + offset;
		}

		private SplitInfo CalculateSplitInfo(ref Point pointInControlCoords)
		{
			int num = ((!vertical) ? (pointInControlCoords.Y - mouseOffsetInControlCoords.Y) : (pointInControlCoords.X - mouseOffsetInControlCoords.X));
			int targetExtent = SplitterOwner.GetTargetExtent();
			int num2 = CalculateNewExtent(targetExtent, num);
			_ = ultraSplitterUIElement.SplitterOwner.SplitterDock;
			int num3 = 0;
			int minExtent = SplitterOwner.MinExtent;
			int maxExtent = SplitterOwner.MaxExtent;
			if (num2 < minExtent)
			{
				num3 = minExtent - num2;
			}
			else if (num2 > maxExtent)
			{
				num3 = maxExtent - num2;
			}
			if (num3 != 0)
			{
				num3 = ReverseOffSetIfNeccessary(num3);
				num += num3;
				num2 = CalculateNewExtent(targetExtent, num);
			}
			return new SplitInfo(targetExtent, num2, num, minExtent, maxExtent);
		}

		private Bitmap CreateDragPreviewImage()
		{
			DisposeDragPreviewImage();
			dragPreviewBitmap = new Bitmap(((UIElement)ultraSplitterUIElement).Rect.Size.Width, ((UIElement)ultraSplitterUIElement).Rect.Size.Height);
			using (Graphics graphics = Graphics.FromImage(dragPreviewBitmap))
			{
				graphics.Clear(SplitterOwner.DragIndicatorColor);
			}
			return dragPreviewBitmap;
		}

		private void DisposeDragPreviewImage()
		{
			if (dragPreviewBitmap != null)
			{
				dragPreviewBitmap.Dispose();
			}
		}

		private void DisposeDragDropIndicatorManager()
		{
			if (dragDropIndicatorManager != null)
			{
				dragDropIndicatorManager.HideDragIndicator();
				((DisposableObject)(object)dragDropIndicatorManager).Dispose();
				dragDropIndicatorManager = null;
			}
		}

		private void DisposeDragResources()
		{
			DisposeMessageFilter();
			DisposeDragDropIndicatorManager();
			DisposeDragPreviewImage();
		}

		private void DisposeMessageFilter()
		{
			if (ultraSplitterMessageFilter != null)
			{
				Utilities.RemoveMessageFilter((IMessageFilter)ultraSplitterMessageFilter);
				ultraSplitterMessageFilter = null;
			}
		}

		private int ReverseOffSetIfNeccessary(int offset)
		{
			switch (ultraSplitterUIElement.SplitterOwner.SplitterDock)
			{
			case DockStyle.Bottom:
			case DockStyle.Right:
				return -offset;
			default:
				return offset;
			}
		}

		public void DragCancel()
		{
			DisposeDragResources();
			SplitterOwner.OnSplitterDragCancelled(new UltraSplitterUIElement.UltraSplitterUIElementDragCancelledInfo(SplitterOrientation));
		}

		public void DragEnd(Point pointInControlCoords)
		{
			SplitterOwner.SetTargetExtent(splitInfo.NewExtent);
			DisposeDragResources();
			UltraSplitterUIElement.UltraSplitterUIElementDragCompletedInfo ultraSplitterUIElementDragCompletedInfo = new UltraSplitterUIElement.UltraSplitterUIElementDragCompletedInfo(SplitterOrientation, pointInControlCoords, splitInfo.OrignalExtent, splitInfo.MinExtent, splitInfo.MaxExtent);
			SplitterOwner.OnSplitterDragCompleted(ultraSplitterUIElementDragCompletedInfo);
		}

		public void DragMove(Point pointInControlCoords)
		{
			Rectangle rectangle = splitterRectOnScreen;
			splitInfo = CalculateSplitInfo(ref pointInControlCoords);
			UltraSplitterUIElement.UltraSplitterUIElementDraggingInfo ultraSplitterUIElementDraggingInfo = new UltraSplitterUIElement.UltraSplitterUIElementDraggingInfo(SplitterOrientation, pointInControlCoords, splitInfo.OrignalExtent, splitInfo.NewExtent, splitInfo.MinExtent, splitInfo.MaxExtent);
			SplitterOwner.OnSplitterDragging(ultraSplitterUIElementDraggingInfo);
			splitInfo.NewExtent = ultraSplitterUIElementDraggingInfo.NewTargetExtent;
			int offset = ultraSplitterUIElementDraggingInfo.NewTargetExtent - ultraSplitterUIElementDraggingInfo.OriginalTargetExtent;
			offset = ReverseOffSetIfNeccessary(offset);
			if (vertical)
			{
				rectangle.Offset(offset, 0);
			}
			else
			{
				rectangle.Offset(0, offset);
			}
			dragDropIndicatorManager.ShowDragIndicator(rectangle.Location);
		}

		public bool DragStart(Point mouseOffsetInControlCoords)
		{
			//IL_0072: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			this.mouseOffsetInControlCoords = mouseOffsetInControlCoords;
			splitterRectOnScreen = ((UIElement)ultraSplitterUIElement).Control.RectangleToScreen(((UIElement)ultraSplitterUIElement).Rect);
			vertical = ultraSplitterUIElement.IsVertical;
			dragDropIndicatorManager = new DragDropIndicatorManager(Point.Empty, (UIElement[])(object)new UIElement[1] { ultraSplitterUIElement }, vertical ? Orientation.Vertical : Orientation.Horizontal, ((UIElement)ultraSplitterUIElement).Control, SplitterOwner.DragIndicatorOpacity);
			Bitmap bitmap = CreateDragPreviewImage();
			dragDropIndicatorManager.InitializeDragIndicator((Image)bitmap);
			ultraSplitterMessageFilter = new UltraSplitterMessageFilter(this);
			Utilities.AddMessageFilter((IMessageFilter)ultraSplitterMessageFilter);
			SplitterOwner.OnSplitterDragStart(new UltraSplitterUIElement.UltraSplitterUIElementDragStartInfo(SplitterOrientation));
			splitInfo = CalculateSplitInfo(ref mouseOffsetInControlCoords);
			return true;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			DisposeDragResources();
		}
	}

		}

		private Image GetDefaultButtonImage()
		{
			string format = "Splitter.Button_Images.Default_UltraSplitterButtonDocked{0}_{1}.png";
			string arg = splitterOwner.SplitterDock.ToString();
			string arg2 = (splitterOwner.Collapsed ? "Collapsed" : "Normal");
			string name = string.Format(format, arg, arg2);
			Type type = ((object)this).GetType();
			Stream manifestResourceStream = type.Module.Assembly.GetManifestResourceStream(type, name);
			return Image.FromStream(manifestResourceStream);
		}

		public void Initialize(ISplitterOwner splitterOwner)
		{
			this.splitterOwner = splitterOwner;
		}

		protected override void OnClick()
		{
			((ButtonUIElementBase)this).OnClick();
			splitterOwner.Toggle();
		}

		protected override void DrawImage(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			Image image = ((AppearanceData)(ref drawParams.AppearanceData)).GetImage((ImageList)null);
			if (image == null)
			{
				image = GetDefaultButtonImage();
			}
			AnimatedImageManager.AnimateImage(image, (UIElement)(object)this);
			((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).DrawImage(image, ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders, false, (ImageAttributes)null);
			((UIElement)this).DrawImage(ref drawParams);
		}

		protected override void ResolveStyleAndControlAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearanceData, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			splitterOwner.ResolveButtonAppearance(ref appearanceData, ref requestedProps, ((ButtonUIElementBase)this).ButtonState);
		}
	}

		internal Color DragIndicatorColorResolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (!StyleUtils.GetCachedPropertyVal((UltraControlBase)(object)this, StyleUtils.CachedProperty.DragIndicatorColor, out var val))
				{
					val = StyleUtils.CachePropertyValue((UltraControlBase)(object)this, StyleUtils.CachedProperty.DragIndicatorColor, DragIndicatorColor, Color.Empty, UltraSplitterUIElement.DEFAULT_DRAGINDICATOR_COLOR);
				}
				Color color = (Color)val;
				if (color != Color.Empty && color.A != byte.MaxValue)
				{
					color = Color.FromArgb(255, color);
				}
				return color;
			}
		}

		internal double DragIndicatorOpacityResolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (!StyleUtils.GetCachedPropertyVal((UltraControlBase)(object)this, StyleUtils.CachedProperty.DragIndicatorOpacity, out var val))
				{
					val = StyleUtils.CachePropertyValue((UltraControlBase)(object)this, StyleUtils.CachedProperty.DragIndicatorOpacity, DragIndicatorOpacity, 0.0, 0.5);
				}
				return (double)val;
			}
		}

		private bool IsHotTracking
		{
			get
			{
				if (UseHotTrackingResolved)
				{
					return containsMouse;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsVertical
		{
			get
			{
				switch (((Control)(object)this).Dock)
				{
				case DockStyle.Left:
				case DockStyle.Right:
					return true;
				case DockStyle.Top:
				case DockStyle.Bottom:
					return false;
				default:
					return true;
				}
			}
		}

		internal virtual UIRole SplitterUIRole => StyleUtils.GetRole((UltraControlBase)(object)this, IsVertical ? StyleUtils.Role.UltraSplitterVertical : StyleUtils.Role.UltraSplitterHorizontal);

		private int MinSizeResolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (MinSize != -1)
				{
					return MinSize;
				}
				return CollapseUIType switch
				{
					CollapseUIType.None => 25, 
					CollapseUIType.Button => 0, 
					_ => 0, 
				};
			}
		}

		private int MaxExtentResolved
		{
			get
			{
				Control control = FindTarget();
				if (control == null)
				{
					return int.MaxValue;
				}
				Control parent = ((Control)this).Parent;
				if (parent == null)
				{
					return int.MaxValue;
				}
				bool isVertical = IsVertical;
				int num = (isVertical ? parent.ClientSize.Width : parent.ClientSize.Height);
				num -= MinExtra;
				DockStyle dock = ((Control)(object)this).Dock;
				if (parent != null)
				{
					Control.ControlCollection controls = parent.Controls;
					for (int i = 0; i < controls.Count; i++)
					{
						Control control2 = controls[i];
						if (control2 != control && IsSameDockOrientation(dock, control2.Dock))
						{
							num -= (isVertical ? control2.Width : control2.Height);
						}
					}
				}
				int num2 = (isVertical ? control.MaximumSize.Width : control.MaximumSize.Height);
				if (num2 > 0)
				{
					num = Math.Min(num2, num);
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		private int MinExtentResolved
		{
			get
			{
				int num = MinSizeResolved;
				Control control = FindTarget();
				if (control != null)
				{
					int val = (IsVertical ? control.MinimumSize.Width : control.MinimumSize.Height);
					num = Math.Max(num, val);
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		internal virtual UIRole SplitterButtonUIRole
		{
			get
			{
				StyleUtils.Role role;
				switch (((Control)(object)this).Dock)
				{
				case DockStyle.Left:
					role = StyleUtils.Role.UltraSplitterButtonDockedLeft;
					break;
				case DockStyle.Top:
					role = StyleUtils.Role.UltraSplitterButtonDockedTop;
					break;
				case DockStyle.Right:
					role = StyleUtils.Role.UltraSplitterButtonDockedRight;
					break;
				case DockStyle.Bottom:
					role = StyleUtils.Role.UltraSplitterButtonDockedBottom;
					break;
				default:
					return null;
				}
				return StyleUtils.GetRole(((UltraControlBase)this).ComponentRole, role);
			}
		}

		internal bool UseHotTrackingResolved
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_002e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0033: Invalid comparison between I4 and Unknown
				//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (!StyleUtils.GetCachedPropertyVal((UltraControlBase)(object)this, StyleUtils.CachedProperty.UseHotTracking, out var val))
				{
					val = StyleUtils.CachePropertyValue((UltraControlBase)(object)this, StyleUtils.CachedProperty.UseHotTracking, UseHotTracking, (object)(DefaultableBoolean)0, (object)(DefaultableBoolean)2);
				}
				return 1 == (int)(DefaultableBoolean)val;
			}
		}

				//IL_000a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (buttonStyle != value)

				}
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public UIElementButtonStyle ButtonStyleResolved
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0058: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_004a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_001d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_002b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0030: Invalid comparison between I4 and Unknown
				if (((UltraControlBase)this).UseOsThemesResolved && XPThemes.IsThemeActive)
				{
					AppearanceData appearance = default(AppearanceData);
					AppearancePropFlags requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)2147483648u;
					ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
					if (3 != (int)((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).ThemedElementAlpha)
					{
						return (UIElementButtonStyle)1;
					}
				}
				if (!StyleUtils.GetCachedPropertyVal((UltraControlBase)(object)this, StyleUtils.CachedProperty.ButtonStyle, out var val))
				{
					val = StyleUtils.CacheButtonStylePropertyValue((UltraControlBase)(object)this, StyleUtils.CachedProperty.ButtonStyle, ButtonRole, ButtonStyle, (UIElementButtonStyle)9);
				}
				return (UIElementButtonStyle)val;
			}
		}

		[DefaultValue(DockStyle.Left)]
		public override DockStyle Dock
		{
			get
			{
				return ((Control)this).Dock;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == DockStyle.None || value == DockStyle.Fill)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_InvalidDockStyle"));
				}
				int num = (IsVertical ? ((Control)this).Width : ((Control)this).Height);
				((Control)this).Dock = value;
				if (IsVertical)
				{
					((Control)this).Width = num;
				}
				else
				{
					((Control)this).Height = num;
				}
				SyncBackColor();
				SafeDirtyChildElements();
			}
		}

		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			license = Utilities.ValidateLicense(typeof(UltraSplitter), this);
			((Control)this).Dock = DockStyle.Left;

			((Control)this).SetStyle(ControlStyles.SupportsTransparentBackColor, value: true);
			SetRestoreExtent();
		}

		void ISplitterOwner.OnSplitterDragStart(UltraSplitterUIElement.UltraSplitterUIElementDragStartInfo ultraSplitterUIElementDragStartInfo)
		{
			SplitterDragStartEventArgs e = new SplitterDragStartEventArgs(FindTarget(), ultraSplitterUIElementDragStartInfo.SplitterOrientation);
			OnSplitterDragStart(e);
		}

		void ISplitterOwner.OnSplitterDragging(UltraSplitterUIElement.UltraSplitterUIElementDraggingInfo ultraSplitterUIElementDraggingInfo)
		{
			Point mouseLocationInParentCoords = GetMouseLocationInParentCoords(ultraSplitterUIElementDraggingInfo.MouseLocation);
			SplitterDraggingEventArgs e = new SplitterDraggingEventArgs(FindTarget(), ultraSplitterUIElementDraggingInfo.SplitterOrientation, mouseLocationInParentCoords, ultraSplitterUIElementDraggingInfo.OriginalTargetExtent, ultraSplitterUIElementDraggingInfo.NewTargetExtent, ultraSplitterUIElementDraggingInfo.MinTargetExtent, ultraSplitterUIElementDraggingInfo.MaxTargetExtent);
			OnSplitterDragging(e);
			ultraSplitterUIElementDraggingInfo.NewTargetExtent = e.NewTargetExtent;
		}

		void ISplitterOwner.OnSplitterDragCompleted(UltraSplitterUIElement.UltraSplitterUIElementDragCompletedInfo ultraSplitterUIElementDragCompletedInfo)
		{
			Point mouseLocationInParentCoords = GetMouseLocationInParentCoords(ultraSplitterUIElementDragCompletedInfo.MouseLocation);
			SplitterDragCompletedEventArgs e = new SplitterDragCompletedEventArgs(FindTarget(), ultraSplitterUIElementDragCompletedInfo.SplitterOrientation, mouseLocationInParentCoords, ultraSplitterUIElementDragCompletedInfo.OriginalTargetExtent, ultraSplitterUIElementDragCompletedInfo.MinTargetExtent, ultraSplitterUIElementDragCompletedInfo.MaxTargetExtent);
			OnSplitterDragCompleted(e);
		}

		private void Collapse()
		{
			SetRestoreExtent();
			int collapsedExtent = GetCollapsedExtent();
			SetTargetExtent(collapsedExtent);
		}

		private Control FindTarget()
		{
			Control parent = ((Control)this).Parent;
			if (parent != null)
			{
				Control.ControlCollection controls = parent.Controls;
				for (int i = 0; i < controls.Count; i++)
				{
					Control control = controls[i];
					if ((object)control == this)
					{
						continue;
					}
					switch (((Control)(object)this).Dock)
					{
					case DockStyle.Top:
						if (control.Bottom == ((Control)this).Top)
						{
							return control;
						}
						break;
					case DockStyle.Bottom:
						if (control.Top == ((Control)this).Bottom)
						{
							return control;
						}
						break;
					case DockStyle.Left:
						if (control.Right == ((Control)this).Left)
						{
							return control;
						}
						break;
					case DockStyle.Right:
						if (control.Left == ((Control)this).Right)
						{
							return control;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private int GetCollapsedExtent()
		{
			return MinExtentResolved;
		}

		private Point GetMouseLocationInParentCoords(Point mouseLocation)
		{

			mouseLocation = ((Control)this).Parent.PointToClient(mouseLocation);
			return mouseLocation;
		}

		private SplitterPropertyIds GetPropertyIdFromAppearanceType(AppearanceType appearanceType)
		{
			return appearanceType switch
			{
				AppearanceType.Normal => SplitterPropertyIds.Appearance, 
				AppearanceType.Collapsed => SplitterPropertyIds.CollapsedAppearance, 
				AppearanceType.HotTracking => SplitterPropertyIds.HotTrackingAppearance, 
				AppearanceType.Button => SplitterPropertyIds.ButtonAppearance, 
				AppearanceType.ButtonCollapsed => SplitterPropertyIds.CollapsedButtonAppearance, 
				AppearanceType.ButtonHotTracking => SplitterPropertyIds.HotTrackingButtonAppearance, 
				AppearanceType.ButtonPressed => SplitterPropertyIds.PressedButtonAppearance, 
				_ => SplitterPropertyIds.Appearance, 
			};
		}

		internal int GetTargetExtent()
		{
			Control control = FindTarget();
			if (control != null)
			{
				switch (((Control)(object)this).Dock)
				{
				case DockStyle.Left:
				case DockStyle.Right:
					return control.Width;
				case DockStyle.Top:
				case DockStyle.Bottom:
					return control.Height;
				}
			}
			return 0;
		}

		private static bool IsSameDockOrientation(DockStyle dockStyle1, DockStyle dockStyle2)
		{
			switch (dockStyle1)
			{
			case DockStyle.Left:
			case DockStyle.Right:
				if (dockStyle2 != DockStyle.Left)
				{
					return dockStyle2 == DockStyle.Right;
				}
				return true;
			case DockStyle.Top:
			case DockStyle.Bottom:
				if (dockStyle2 != DockStyle.Top)
				{
					return dockStyle2 == DockStyle.Bottom;
				}
				return true;
			default:
				if (dockStyle2 != DockStyle.Fill)
				{
					return dockStyle2 == DockStyle.None;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private void Restore()
		{
			if (Collapsed && GetTargetExtent() == restoreExtent)
			{
				restoreExtent = MaxExtentResolved;
			}
			restoreExtent = Math.Min(restoreExtent, MaxExtentResolved);
			SetTargetExtent(restoreExtent);
		}

		private void SafeDirtyChildElements()
		{
			if (!((Control)this).Disposing && !((Control)this).IsDisposed && controlElement != null && !((DisposableObject)(object)controlElement).Disposed)
			{
				((UIElement)controlElement).DirtyChildElements();
			}
		}

		private void SetRestoreExtent()
		{
			int targetExtent = GetTargetExtent();
			if (targetExtent != GetCollapsedExtent())
			{
				restoreExtent = targetExtent;
			}
		}

		internal void SetTargetExtent(int newExtent)
		{
			bool collapsed = Collapsed;
			Control control = FindTarget();

			{
				switch (((Control)(object)this).Dock)
				{

				case DockStyle.Right:
					control.Width = newExtent;
					break;
				case DockStyle.Top:
				case DockStyle.Bottom:
					control.Height = newExtent;
					break;
				}
			}
			SafeDirtyChildElements();
			if (Collapsed != collapsed)
			{
				OnCollapsedChanged(EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

	internal class AnimationManager : IDisposable
	{
		private int animationDuration;

		private AnimationType animationType;

		private List<ControlAnimationBase> animations;

		private TileEventGroup delayedEvents;

		private EventHandler endAnimationCallback;

		private Stopwatch stopwatch;

		private UltraTilePanel tilePanel;

		public AnimationType AnimationType => animationType;

		public bool IsRunning => stopwatch.IsRunning;

		public AnimationManager(UltraTilePanel tilePanel, int animationDuration, AnimationType animationType, EventHandler endAnimationCallback)
		{
			this.animationDuration = animationDuration;
			this.animationType = animationType;
			this.endAnimationCallback = endAnimationCallback;
			animations = new List<ControlAnimationBase>();
			stopwatch = new Stopwatch();
			this.tilePanel = tilePanel;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
		}

		public void AddAnimation(ControlAnimationBase animation)
		{
			if (!stopwatch.IsRunning)
			{
				animations.Add(animation);
			}
		}

		public IEnumerable<Control> GetControls()
		{
			foreach (ControlAnimationBase animation in animations)
			{
				yield return animation.AnimationControl;
			}
		}

		public bool IsBeingAnimated(Control control, out ControlAnimationBase animation)
		{
			animation = null;
			if (!stopwatch.IsRunning)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < animations.Count; i++)
			{
				ControlAnimationBase controlAnimationBase = animations[i];
				if (controlAnimationBase.AnimationControl == control)
				{
					animation = controlAnimationBase;
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void OffsetAnimations(Point offset)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < animations.Count; i++)
			{
				animations[i].Offset(offset);
			}
			PerformAnimationStep();
		}

		public void StartAnimation(TileEventGroup delayedEvents)
		{
			this.delayedEvents = delayedEvents;
			stopwatch.Start();
			tilePanel.TimerForAnimations.Tick += OnTimerTick;
		}

		public void StopAnimatingControl(Control control)
		{
			for (int num = animations.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (animations[num].AnimationControl == control)
				{
					animations.RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
			if (stopwatch.IsRunning && animations.Count == 0)
			{
				EndAnimation();
			}
		}

		private void EndAnimation()
		{
			stopwatch.Stop();
			tilePanel.TimerForAnimations.Tick -= OnTimerTick;
			PerformAnimationStep(1.0);
			endAnimationCallback(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			if (delayedEvents != null)
			{
				delayedEvents.FireEvents();
			}
		}

		private void PerformAnimationStep()
		{
			if (stopwatch.IsRunning)
			{
				double num = (double)stopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds / (double)animationDuration;
				if (1.0 <= num)
				{
					EndAnimation();
				}
				else
				{
					PerformAnimationStep(num);
				}
			}
		}

		private void PerformAnimationStep(double currentProgress)
		{
			((Control)(object)tilePanel).SuspendLayout();
			((Control)(object)tilePanel.TileContainerNormal).SuspendLayout();
			if (tilePanel.IsInLargeMode)
			{
				((Control)(object)tilePanel.TileContainerLarge).SuspendLayout();
			}
			try
			{
				foreach (ControlAnimationBase animation in animations)
				{
					animation.PerformAnimationStep(currentProgress);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				((Control)(object)tilePanel.TileContainerNormal).ResumeLayout();
				if (tilePanel.IsInLargeMode)
				{
					((Control)(object)tilePanel.TileContainerLarge).ResumeLayout();
				}
				((Control)(object)tilePanel).ResumeLayout();
			}
		}

		private void OnTimerTick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (stopwatch.IsRunning)
			{
				PerformAnimationStep();
			}
		}
	}
	internal enum AnimationType
	{
		TileDropped,
		TileReposition,
		TileStateChange,
		ModeChange
	}
	internal abstract class ControlAnimationBase
	{
		private Control animationControl;

		public Control AnimationControl => animationControl;

		protected ControlAnimationBase(Control animationControl)
		{
			this.animationControl = animationControl;
		}

		public abstract void Offset(Point offset);

		public abstract void PerformAnimationStep(double currentProgress);
	}
	internal class BoundsAnimation : ControlAnimationBase
	{
		private Rectangle animationEnd;

		private Rectangle animationStart;

		private double previousAnimationProgress;

		public BoundsAnimation(Control animationControl, Rectangle endBounds)
			: base(animationControl)
		{
			animationStart = animationControl.Bounds;
			animationEnd = endBounds;
		}

		public override void Offset(Point offset)
		{
			animationStart.Offset(offset);
			animationEnd.Offset(offset);
		}

		public override void PerformAnimationStep(double currentProgress)
		{
			int num = animationEnd.X - animationStart.X;
			int num2 = animationEnd.Y - animationStart.Y;
			int num3 = animationEnd.Width - animationStart.Width;
			int num4 = animationEnd.Height - animationStart.Height;
			int x = (int)(currentProgress * (double)num) + animationStart.X;
			int y = (int)(currentProgress * (double)num2) + animationStart.Y;
			int width = (int)(currentProgress * (double)num3) + animationStart.Width;
			int height = (int)(currentProgress * (double)num4) + animationStart.Height;
			previousAnimationProgress = currentProgress;
			base.AnimationControl.Bounds = new Rectangle(x, y, width, height);
		}

		internal void SetEndBounds(Rectangle bounds)
		{
			if (!(animationEnd == bounds))
			{
				Rectangle bounds2 = base.AnimationControl.Bounds;
				animationEnd = bounds;
				int num = bounds2.X - animationEnd.X;
				int num2 = bounds2.Y - animationEnd.Y;
				int num3 = bounds2.Width - animationEnd.Width;
				int num4 = bounds2.Height - animationEnd.Height;
				double num5 = 1.0 - previousAnimationProgress;
				int x = (int)((double)num / num5) + animationEnd.X;
				int y = (int)((double)num2 / num5) + animationEnd.Y;
				int width = (int)((double)num3 / num5) + animationEnd.Width;
				int height = (int)((double)num4 / num5) + animationEnd.Height;
				animationStart = new Rectangle(x, y, width, height);
			}
		}
	}

	internal class Binder : Binder
	{
		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.Demand, SerializationFormatter = true)]
		public override Type BindToType(string assemblyName, string typeName)
		{
			if (assemblyName == null || !assemblyName.StartsWith("Infragistics4.Win.Misc"))
			{
				return ((Binder)this).BindToType(assemblyName, typeName);
			}
			Type type = null;
			try
			{
				assemblyName = typeof(UltraTilePanel).Assembly.FullName;
			}
			catch
			{
				assemblyName = "Infragistics4.Win.UltraWinToolbars.v15.1";
			}
			type = Type.GetType($"{typeName}, {assemblyName}");
			if (type == null)
			{
				return ((Binder)this).BindToType(assemblyName, typeName);
			}
			return type;
		}
	}

	internal class TileEventGroup
	{
		private struct TileEventInfo
		{
			public EventArgs eventArgs;

			public TilePanelEventID eventId;

			public UltraTile tile;
		}

		private List<TileEventInfo> tileEventInfo = new List<TileEventInfo>();

		public void AddEvent(UltraTile tile, TilePanelEventID eventId, EventArgs eventArgs)
		{
			if (tile != null)
			{
				TileEventInfo item = new TileEventInfo
				{
					eventArgs = eventArgs,
					eventId = eventId,
					tile = tile
				};
				tileEventInfo.Add(item);
			}
		}

		public void FireEvents()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < this.tileEventInfo.Count; i++)
			{
				TileEventInfo tileEventInfo = this.tileEventInfo[i];
				tileEventInfo.tile.FireEvent(tileEventInfo.eventId, tileEventInfo.eventArgs);
			}
		}
	}

	public class TileDragOverPositionEventArgs : TileEventArgs
	{
		private bool allowDrop;

		private Point position;

		private UltraTile targetTile;

		public bool AllowDrop
		{
			get
			{
				return allowDrop;
			}
			set
			{
				if (allowDrop != value)
				{
					if (value && targetTile != null && !targetTile.AllowMovingResolved)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("TileDragOverPositionEventArgs_InvalidOperationException_CannotSetAllowDrop"));
					}
					allowDrop = value;
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public Point Position => position;

		private UltraTile TargetTile => targetTile;

		public TileDragOverPositionEventArgs(UltraTile tile, Point position, UltraTile targetTile)
			: this(tile, position, targetTile, (UIAction)0)
		{
		}

		internal TileDragOverPositionEventArgs(UltraTile tile, Point position, UltraTile targetTile, UIAction action)
			: base(tile, action)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			allowDrop = true;
			this.position = position;
			this.targetTile = targetTile;
			if (this.targetTile != null)
			{
				allowDrop = this.targetTile.AllowMovingResolved;
			}
		}
	}

	public abstract class TileCollectionBase : SubObjectBase, ICollection, IEnumerable<UltraTile>, IEnumerable, ISerializable
	{
		private UltraTilePanel tilePanel;

		private List<UltraTile> tiles = new List<UltraTile>();

		bool ICollection.IsSynchronized => ((ICollection)tiles).IsSynchronized;

		object ICollection.SyncRoot => tiles;

		public int Count => tiles.Count;

		public UltraTile this[Control control]
		{
			get
			{
				if (control == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("control");
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < tiles.Count; i++)
				{
					UltraTile ultraTile = tiles[i];
					if (ultraTile.Control == control)
					{
						return ultraTile;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public UltraTile this[int index] => tiles[index];

		public UltraTile this[string name]
		{
			get
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < tiles.Count; i++)
				{
					UltraTile ultraTile = tiles[i];
					if (((Control)(object)ultraTile).Name == name)
					{
						return ultraTile;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal abstract bool DisposesRemovedTilesByDefault { get; }

		internal abstract TilePanelPropertyIds PropertyID { get; }

		internal UltraTilePanel TilePanel => tilePanel;

		internal List<UltraTile> TilesInternal => tiles;

		protected List<UltraTile> List => tiles;

		internal TileCollectionBase(UltraTilePanel tilePanel)
		{
			this.tilePanel = tilePanel;
		}

		protected TileCollectionBase(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				string name;
				if (current.Value is UltraTile)
				{
					UltraTile ultraTile = (UltraTile)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(UltraTile), null);
					if (ultraTile != null)
					{
						List.Add(ultraTile);
					}
				}
				else if ((name = current.Name) != null && name == "Tag")
				{
					DeserializeTag(current);
				}
			}
		}

		void ICollection.CopyTo(Array array, int index)
		{
			((ICollection)tiles).CopyTo(array, index);
		}

		IEnumerator<UltraTile> IEnumerable<UltraTile>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return tiles.GetEnumerator();
		}

		public IEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			return tiles.GetEnumerator();
		}

		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, i.ToString(), this[i]);
			}
		}

		internal abstract void OnTileInserted(int index, UltraTile tile);

		internal abstract void OnTileRemoved(int index, UltraTile tile);

		public virtual void Clear()
		{
			((UltraControlBase)tilePanel).BeginUpdate();
			while (Count > 0)
			{
				InternalRemoveAt(0);
			}
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyID);
			((UltraControlBase)tilePanel).EndUpdate();
		}

		public bool Contains(UltraTile tile)
		{
			if (tile == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("tile");
			}
			return tiles.Contains(tile);
		}

		public int IndexOf(UltraTile tile)
		{
			if (tile == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("tile");
			}
			return tiles.IndexOf(tile);
		}

		internal int GetVisibleIndex(UltraTile tile)
		{
			return GetVisibleIndexHelper(tile, checkState: false, TileState.Normal);
		}

		internal int GetVisibleIndex(UltraTile tile, TileState state)
		{
			return GetVisibleIndexHelper(tile, checkState: true, state);
		}

		private int GetVisibleIndexHelper(UltraTile tile, bool checkState, TileState state)
		{
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				UltraTile ultraTile = this[i];
				if (ultraTile == tile)
				{
					return num;
				}
				if (ultraTile.VisibleInternal && (!checkState || ultraTile.State == state))
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		internal int GetVisibleCount()
		{
			return GetVisibleCountHelper(checkState: false, TileState.Normal);
		}

		internal int GetVisibleCount(TileState state)
		{
			return GetVisibleCountHelper(checkState: true, state);
		}

		private int GetVisibleCountHelper(bool checkState, TileState state)
		{
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				UltraTile ultraTile = this[i];
				if (ultraTile.VisibleInternal && (!checkState || ultraTile.State == state))
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal bool HasVisibleTiles()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				UltraTile ultraTile = this[i];
				if (ultraTile.VisibleInternal)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void Initialize(UltraTilePanel tilePanel)
		{
			this.tilePanel = tilePanel;
		}

		internal void InternalInsert(int index, UltraTile tile)
		{
			if (tile == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("tile");
			}
			if (tiles.Contains(tile))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("tile", Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("TileCollectionBase_ArgumentException_TileAlreadyExists"));
			}
			if (tile.Owner != null && tile.Owner != TilePanel)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("TileCollectionBase_InvalidOperationException_TileAlreadyOwned"));
			}
			tiles.Insert(index, tile);
			OnTileInserted(index, tile);
		}

		internal void InternalRemove(UltraTile tile)
		{
			InternalRemove(tile, DisposesRemovedTilesByDefault);
		}

		internal void InternalRemove(UltraTile tile, bool shouldDispose)
		{
			if (tile == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("tile");
			}
			int num = tiles.IndexOf(tile);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				InternalRemoveAt(num, shouldDispose);
			}
		}

		internal void InternalRemoveAt(int index)
		{
			InternalRemoveAt(index, DisposesRemovedTilesByDefault);
		}

		internal void InternalRemoveAt(int index, bool shouldDispose)
		{
			if (index < 0 || Count <= index)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("index", Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("TileCollectionBase_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_InvalidIndex"));
			}
			UltraTile ultraTile = this[index];
			tiles.RemoveAt(index);
			OnTileRemoved(index, ultraTile);
			if (shouldDispose)
			{
				((Component)(object)ultraTile).Dispose();
			}
		}
	}
	public class LargeTileCollection : TileCollectionBase
	{
		private class IndexInLargeTileCollectionComparer : IComparer<UltraTile>
		{
			public static readonly IndexInLargeTileCollectionComparer Instance = new IndexInLargeTileCollectionComparer();

			private IndexInLargeTileCollectionComparer()
			{
			}

			int IComparer<UltraTile>.Compare(UltraTile x, UltraTile y)
			{
				return x.IndexInLargeTileCollection - y.IndexInLargeTileCollection;
			}
		}

		internal override bool DisposesRemovedTilesByDefault => false;

		internal override TilePanelPropertyIds PropertyID => TilePanelPropertyIds.LargeTiles;

		internal LargeTileCollection(UltraTilePanel tilePanel)
			: base(tilePanel)
		{
		}

		public override void Clear()
		{
			Clear(shouldAnimate: true);
		}

		internal override void OnTileInserted(int index, UltraTile tile)
		{
			if (!((UltraControlBase)base.TilePanel).IsUpdating || tile.IndexInLargeTileCollection < 0)
			{
				tile.IndexInLargeTileCollection = index;
			}
			if (!((UltraControlBase)base.TilePanel).IsUpdating)
			{
				for (int i = index + 1; i < base.Count; i++)
				{
					base[i].IndexInLargeTileCollection++;
				}
			}
			tile.SetStateInternal(TileState.Large);
			if (!((UltraControlBase)base.TilePanel).IsUpdating && !base.TilePanel.DesignModeInternal && tile.VisibleInternal && tile.Control == null)
			{
				bool isVerifyingTileVisibility = base.TilePanel.IsVerifyingTileVisibility;
				try
				{
					base.TilePanel.IsVerifyingTileVisibility = true;
					((Control)(object)tile).Visible = false;
				}
				finally
				{
					base.TilePanel.IsVerifyingTileVisibility = isVerifyingTileVisibility;
				}
			}
			base.TilePanel.VerifyLargeTileVisibility();
		}

		internal override void OnTileRemoved(int index, UltraTile tile)
		{
			if (index == -1)
			{
				return;
			}
			tile.IndexInLargeTileCollection = -1;
			if (!((UltraControlBase)base.TilePanel).IsUpdating)
			{
				for (int i = index; i < base.Count; i++)
				{
					base[i].IndexInLargeTileCollection--;
				}
			}
			tile.SetStateInternal(TileState.Normal);
			base.TilePanel.VerifyLargeTileVisibility();
		}

		public void Clear(bool shouldAnimate)
		{
			if (shouldAnimate && !base.TilePanel.AnimationsEnabledResolved)
			{
				shouldAnimate = false;
			}
			try
			{
				((UltraControlBase)base.TilePanel).BeginUpdate();
				List<UltraTile> list = new List<UltraTile>();
				for (int i = 0; i < base.Count; i++)
				{
					UltraTile ultraTile = base[i];
					TileStateChangingEventArgs e = new TileStateChangingEventArgs(ultraTile, TileState.Normal, (UIAction)0);
					e.ShouldAnimate = shouldAnimate;
					ultraTile.FireEvent(TilePanelEventID.TileStateChanging, e);
					if (!e.Cancel)
					{
						list.Add(ultraTile);
						if (!e.ShouldAnimate)
						{
							shouldAnimate = false;
						}
					}
				}
				bool flag = base.Count == list.Count;
				AnimationType animationType = AnimationType.TileStateChange;
				if (flag)
				{
					animationType = AnimationType.ModeChange;
					base.TilePanel.PrepareForModeChange(shouldAnimate);
				}
				if (shouldAnimate)
				{
					base.TilePanel.OpenAnimationContext(animationType);
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < list.Count; j++)
				{
					UltraTile ultraTile2 = list[j];
					ultraTile2.BeforeChangeToNormalState(this, flag, shouldAnimate);
				}
				base.TilePanel.LayoutTiles(preventSetAutoScroll: false, honorIsUpdating: false);
				TileEventGroup tileEventGroup = new TileEventGroup();
				for (int k = 0; k < list.Count; k++)
				{
					list[k].AfterStateChange(tileEventGroup, TileState.Large, (UIAction)0);
				}
				if (shouldAnimate)
				{
					base.TilePanel.CloseAnimationContext(tileEventGroup);
				}
				else
				{
					tileEventGroup.FireEvents();
				}
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyID);
			}
			finally
			{
				((UltraControlBase)base.TilePanel).EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateTileIndexValues()
		{
			Utilities.SortMergeGeneric<UltraTile>(base.List, (IComparer<UltraTile>)IndexInLargeTileCollectionComparer.Instance);
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Count; i++)
			{
				base[i].IndexInLargeTileCollection = i;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class GridLayoutManager : LayoutManagerBase
	{
		private double actualColumnWidth;

		private double actualRowHeight;

		private int columnCount;

		private int rowCount;

		public double ActualColumnWidth
		{
			get
			{
				return actualColumnWidth;
			}
			set
			{
				actualColumnWidth = value;
			}
		}

		public double ActualRowHeight
		{
			get
			{
				return actualRowHeight;
			}
			set
			{
				actualRowHeight = value;
			}
		}

		public int ColumnCount
		{
			get
			{
				return columnCount;
			}
			set
			{
				columnCount = value;
			}
		}

		public int RowCount
		{
			get
			{
				return rowCount;
			}
			set
			{
				rowCount = value;
			}
		}

		public override Size CalculateMinimumSize(ILayoutContainer container, object containerContext)
		{
			return Size.Empty;
		}

		public override Size CalculatePreferredSize(ILayoutContainer container, object containerContext)
		{
			return Size.Empty;
		}

		public override void LayoutContainer(ILayoutContainer container, object containerContext)
		{
			Rectangle bounds = container.GetBounds(containerContext);
			if (bounds.IsEmpty)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < ((LayoutManagerBase)this).LayoutItems.Count; i++)
			{
				ILayoutItem val = ((LayoutManagerBase)this).LayoutItems[i];
				if (val.IsVisible && ((LayoutManagerBase)this).LayoutItems.GetConstraint(val) is IGridPositionLayoutConstraint { Column: var column } gridPositionLayoutConstraint)
				{
					int num = (column + 1) * 10;
					int x = bounds.X + num + (int)Math.Round((double)column * actualColumnWidth);
					int row = gridPositionLayoutConstraint.Row;
					int num2 = (row + 1) * 10;
					int y = bounds.Y + num2 + (int)Math.Round((double)row * actualRowHeight);
					container.PositionItem(val, new Rectangle(x, y, (int)actualColumnWidth, (int)actualRowHeight), containerContext);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void ValidateConstraintObject(object constraint)
		{
		}

		internal void GetCellDimensions(Rectangle containerBounds, out double actualColumnWidth, out double actualRowHeight)
		{
			Size empty = Size.Empty;
			for (int i = 0; i < ((LayoutManagerBase)this).LayoutItems.Count; i++)
			{
				ILayoutItem val = ((LayoutManagerBase)this).LayoutItems[i];
				TileLayoutItem tileLayoutItem = val as TileLayoutItem;
				if (tileLayoutItem != null)
				{
					tileLayoutItem.AreDraggedTilesVisible = true;
				}
				try
				{
					if (!val.IsVisible)
					{
						continue;
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					if (tileLayoutItem != null)
					{
						tileLayoutItem.AreDraggedTilesVisible = false;
					}
				}
				Size minimumSize = val.MinimumSize;
				empty.Width = Math.Max(empty.Width, minimumSize.Width);
				empty.Height = Math.Max(empty.Height, minimumSize.Height);
			}
			int num = (ColumnCount + 1) * 10;
			double val2 = (double)(containerBounds.Width - num) / (double)ColumnCount;
			actualColumnWidth = Math.Max(val2, empty.Width);
			int num2 = (RowCount + 1) * 10;
			double val3 = (double)(containerBounds.Height - num2) / (double)RowCount;
			actualRowHeight = Math.Max(val3, empty.Height);
		}
	}

					IDesignerHost designerHost = (IDesignerHost)((Component)(object)tileContainerPanel).Site.GetService(typeof(IDesignerHost));
					if (designerHost != null)

						if (designer != null)
						{
							try
							{
								Type type = Type.GetType("Infragistics.Win.Misc.Design.UltraTilePanelDesigner, Infragistics4.Win.v15.1.Design, Version=15.1.20151.1000, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=7dd5c3163f2cd0cb");

	internal class TileLayoutConstraint : IGridPositionLayoutConstraint
	{
		private UltraTile tile;

		public int Column
		{
			get
			{
				if (tile.Owner == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				switch (tile.State)
				{
				default:
					if (!tile.Owner.IsInLargeMode)
					{
						return tile.PositionInNormalMode.X;
					}
					if (tile.Owner.ShouldArrangeNormalTilesVerticallyInLargeMode)
					{
						return 0;
					}
					return tile.Owner.Tiles.GetVisibleIndex(tile, TileState.Normal);
				case TileState.Large:
					if (tile.Owner.LargeTileOrientationResolved == TileOrientation.Vertical)
					{
						return 0;
					}
					return tile.Owner.LargeTiles.GetVisibleIndex(tile);
				}
			}
		}

		public int Row
		{
			get
			{
				if (tile.Owner == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				switch (tile.State)
				{
				default:
					if (!tile.Owner.IsInLargeMode)
					{
						return tile.PositionInNormalMode.Y;
					}
					if (!tile.Owner.ShouldArrangeNormalTilesVerticallyInLargeMode)
					{
						return 0;
					}
					return tile.Owner.Tiles.GetVisibleIndex(tile, TileState.Normal);
				case TileState.Large:
					if (tile.Owner.LargeTileOrientationResolved == TileOrientation.Horizontal)
					{
						return 0;
					}
					return tile.Owner.LargeTiles.GetVisibleIndex(tile);
				}
			}
		}

		public TileLayoutConstraint(UltraTile tile)
		{
			this.tile = tile;
		}
	}

			}
		}

			this.tile = tile;
		}
	}

		internal void InitializeFrom(TileCollection tileCollection)
		{
			Dictionary<string, UltraTile> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, UltraTile>(base.TilesInternal.Count);
			List<UltraTile> list = new List<UltraTile>();
			foreach (UltraTile item in base.TilesInternal)
			{
				string deserializaedControlName = item.DeserializaedControlName;
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(deserializaedControlName))
				{
					dictionary[deserializaedControlName] = item;
				}
				else
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			base.TilesInternal.Clear();
			foreach (UltraTile item2 in tileCollection.TilesInternal)
			{
				string deserializaedControlName2 = item2.DeserializaedControlName;
				UltraTile value = null;
				bool flag = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(deserializaedControlName2) && dictionary.TryGetValue(deserializaedControlName2, out value);
				if (flag)
				{
					dictionary.Remove(deserializaedControlName2);
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					if (list.Count > 0)
					{
						value = list[0];
						list.RemoveAt(0);
					}
					else
					{
						value = new UltraTile();
					}
				}
				value.InitializeFrom(item2);
				InternalInsert(base.Count, value);
			}
			foreach (UltraTile value2 in dictionary.Values)
			{
				list.Add(value2);
			}
			foreach (UltraTile item3 in list)
			{
				OnTileRemoved(-1, item3);
				((Component)(object)item3).Dispose();
			}
			tagValue = tileCollection.tagValue;
		}

		private void OnTileDisposed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is UltraTile tile)
			{
				Remove(tile);
			}
		}

		private void OnTileParentChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is UltraTile ultraTile)
			{
				Control parent = Utilities.GetParent((Control)(object)ultraTile);
				if (parent != null && (object)parent != base.TilePanel && (object)parent != base.TilePanel.TileContainerNormal && (object)parent != base.TilePanel.TileContainerLarge)
				{
					Remove(ultraTile);
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnTilePropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			NotifyPropChange(TilePanelPropertyIds.Tiles, e.ChangeInfo);
		}
	}
	internal static class TilePanelUtilities
	{
		internal static ParsedFormattedTextValue ParseFormattedText(string value, ValueType valueType, bool throwError)
		{
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (value == null || value.Length == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Exception ex = default(Exception);
			ParsedFormattedTextValue result = ParsedFormattedTextValue.Parse((object)value, valueType, ref ex);
			if (ex == null)
			{
				return result;
			}
			if (throwError)
			{
				throw ex;
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

namespace Infragistics.Win.Misc.TilePanel.UIActionNotification
{
	public interface IUIActionNotifier
	{
		event TileHeaderButtonClickedHandler TileHeaderButtonClicked;

		event TileHeaderButtonClickingHandler TileHeaderButtonClicking;
	}
	internal enum TilePanelUINotification
	{
		TileHeaderButtonClicked,
		TileHeaderButtonClicking
	}
	internal class TilePanelUIActionNotifier
	{
		private static readonly object EVENTKEY_TileHeaderButtonClicked = new object();

		private static readonly object EVENTKEY_TileHeaderButtonClicking = new object();

		private UltraTilePanel control;

		private EventHandlerList events = new EventHandlerList();

		public event TileHeaderButtonClickedHandler TileHeaderButtonClicked
		{
			add
			{
				events.AddHandler(EVENTKEY_TileHeaderButtonClicked, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				events.RemoveHandler(EVENTKEY_TileHeaderButtonClicked, value);
			}
		}

		public event TileHeaderButtonClickingHandler TileHeaderButtonClicking
		{
			add
			{
				events.AddHandler(EVENTKEY_TileHeaderButtonClicking, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				events.RemoveHandler(EVENTKEY_TileHeaderButtonClicking, value);
			}
		}

		internal TilePanelUIActionNotifier(UltraTilePanel control)
		{
			this.control = control;
		}

		public void FireEvent(TilePanelUINotification notificationId, EventArgs args)
		{
			if (args == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			switch (notificationId)
			{
			case TilePanelUINotification.TileHeaderButtonClicked:
				if (events[EVENTKEY_TileHeaderButtonClicked] is TileHeaderButtonClickedHandler tileHeaderButtonClickedHandler)
				{
					tileHeaderButtonClickedHandler(control, args as TileHeaderButtonClickedEventArgs);
				}
				break;
			case TilePanelUINotification.TileHeaderButtonClicking:
				if (events[EVENTKEY_TileHeaderButtonClicking] is TileHeaderButtonClickingHandler tileHeaderButtonClickingHandler)
				{
					tileHeaderButtonClickingHandler(control, args as TileHeaderButtonClickingEventArgs);
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			events.Dispose();
		}
	}
	public class TileHeaderButtonClickedEventArgs : UIActionEventArgs
	{
		private TileHeaderButtonType buttonType;

		private UltraTile tile;

		public TileHeaderButtonType ButtonType => buttonType;

		public UltraTile Tile => tile;

		internal TileHeaderButtonClickedEventArgs(UIAction action, UltraTile tile, TileHeaderButtonType buttonType)
			: base(action)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			this.buttonType = buttonType;
			this.tile = tile;
		}
	}
	public delegate void TileHeaderButtonClickedHandler(object sender, TileHeaderButtonClickedEventArgs args);
	public class TileHeaderButtonClickingEventArgs : UIActionCancelableEventArgs
	{
		private TileHeaderButtonType buttonType;

		private UltraTile tile;

		public TileHeaderButtonType ButtonType => buttonType;

		public UltraTile Tile => tile;

		internal TileHeaderButtonClickingEventArgs(UIAction action, UltraTile tile, TileHeaderButtonType buttonType)
			: base(action)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			this.buttonType = buttonType;
			this.tile = tile;
		}
	}
	public delegate void TileHeaderButtonClickingHandler(object sender, TileHeaderButtonClickingEventArgs args);
}

		internal class NormalModeTileComparer : IComparer<UltraTile>
		{
			public static readonly NormalModeTileComparer Instance = new NormalModeTileComparer();

			private NormalModeTileComparer()
			{
			}

			int IComparer<UltraTile>.Compare(UltraTile x, UltraTile y)
			{
				bool flag = !x.IsPositionValid;
				bool flag2 = !y.IsPositionValid;
				if (flag && flag2)
				{
					return x.Owner.Tiles.IndexOf(x) - y.Owner.Tiles.IndexOf(y);
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				if (flag2)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				int num = x.PositionInNormalMode.Y - y.PositionInNormalMode.Y;
				if (num != 0)
				{
					return num;
				}
				return x.PositionInNormalMode.X - y.PositionInNormalMode.X;
			}
		}

		private class TileLayoutEngine : LayoutEngine
		{
			private LayoutEngine layoutEngine;

			private UltraTile tile;

			public TileLayoutEngine(UltraTile tile, LayoutEngine layoutEngine)
			{
				this.layoutEngine = layoutEngine;
				this.tile = tile;
			}

			public override void InitLayout(object child, BoundsSpecified specified)
			{
				layoutEngine.InitLayout(child, specified);
			}

			public override bool Layout(object container, LayoutEventArgs layoutEventArgs)
			{
				bool result = layoutEngine.Layout(container, layoutEventArgs);
				Control control = tile.Control;
				if (control != null && !control.IsDisposed && !control.Disposing)
				{
					Rectangle displayRectangle = ((Control)(object)tile).DisplayRectangle;
					if (control is ToolStrip { Dock: not DockStyle.Fill } toolStrip)
					{
						if (toolStrip.Orientation == Orientation.Horizontal)
						{
							if (toolStrip.Dock == DockStyle.Bottom)
							{
								displayRectangle.Y = displayRectangle.Bottom - control.Height;
							}
							displayRectangle.Height = control.Height;
						}
						else
						{
							if (toolStrip.Dock == DockStyle.Right)
							{
								displayRectangle.X = displayRectangle.Right - control.Width;
							}
							displayRectangle.Width = control.Width;
						}
					}
					control.Bounds = displayRectangle;
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		internal ControlUIElementBase ControlUIElementInternal => ((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement;

		public override Rectangle DisplayRectangle
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0068: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_006d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0072: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				Rectangle displayRectangle = ((Control)this).DisplayRectangle;
				Padding padding = ((UltraControlBase)this).Padding;
				displayRectangle.X += padding.Left;
				displayRectangle.Y += padding.Top;
				displayRectangle.Width -= padding.Horizontal;
				displayRectangle.Height -= padding.Vertical;
				UIElementBorderWidths val = DrawUtility.CalculateBorderWidths(SettingsResolved.BorderStyle);
				displayRectangle.X += ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Left;
				displayRectangle.Width -= ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Left;
				displayRectangle.Y += ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Top;
				displayRectangle.Height -= ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Top;
				displayRectangle.Width -= ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Right;
				displayRectangle.Height -= ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Bottom;
				int headerExtent = SettingsResolved.HeaderExtent;
				switch (SettingsResolved.HeaderPosition)
				{
				case TileHeaderPosition.Top:
					displayRectangle.Y += headerExtent;
					displayRectangle.Height -= headerExtent;
					break;
				case TileHeaderPosition.Bottom:
					displayRectangle.Height -= headerExtent;
					break;
				}
				if (displayRectangle.Width < 0)
				{
					displayRectangle.Width = 0;
				}
				if (displayRectangle.Height < 0)
				{
					displayRectangle.Height = 0;
				}
				return displayRectangle;
			}
		}

						((Control)this).PerformLayout();
						((Control)this).Visible = true;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public UltraTilePanel Owner
		{
			get
			{
				return owner;
			}
			internal set
			{
				if (owner == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (owner != null)
				{
					RemoveLayoutItem();
					owner.LayoutTiles(shouldAnimate: true, AnimationType.TileReposition, null);
				}
				owner = value;
				if (controlElement != null)
				{
					((DisposableObject)(object)controlElement).Dispose();
					controlElement = null;
				}
				SyncTileRegion();
				if (owner != null)
				{
					bool flag = false;
					if (State == TileState.Large && !owner.ShouldSuspendLargeTileCollectionSynchronization)
					{
						LargeTileCollection largeTiles = Owner.LargeTiles;
						largeTiles.InternalInsert(largeTiles.Count, this);
						flag = true;
					}
					Control parentTileContainer = (Control)(object)ParentTileContainer;
					if (owner.IsInModeChangeOperation)
					{
						Owner.InternalAddControl((Control)(object)this);
					}
					else
					{
						((Control)this).Parent = parentTileContainer;
					}
					AddLayoutItem();
					owner.LayoutTiles();
					StyleUtils.DirtyCachedPropertyVals((UltraControlBase)(object)this);
					if (flag)
					{
						Owner.VerifyLargeTileCount(out var _);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					((Control)this).Parent = null;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseDown(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Button == MouseButtons.Left)
			{
				InitializeDragOperation(e.Location);
			}
			bool flag = preventScrollIntoViewWhenSelected;
			try
			{
				preventScrollIntoViewWhenSelected = true;
				((UltraControlBase)this).OnMouseDown(e);
			}
			finally
			{
				preventScrollIntoViewWhenSelected = flag;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseMove(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			((UltraControlBase)this).OnMouseMove(e);
			if (isDragPending)
			{
				if (PreventDragStartOnNextMouseMove)
				{
					lastMouseDownLocation = e.Location;
					PreventDragStartOnNextMouseMove = false;
					return;
				}
				Size dragSize = SystemInformation.DragSize;
				if (dragSize.Width < Math.Abs(e.X - lastMouseDownLocation.X) || dragSize.Height < Math.Abs(e.Y - lastMouseDownLocation.Y))
				{
					isDragPending = false;
					StartDrag(lastMouseDownLocation);
				}
			}
			if (isDragging)
			{
				DragMouseMove(e);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseUp(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			((UltraControlBase)this).OnMouseUp(e);
			isDragPending = false;
			if (isDragging)
			{
				EndDrag();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.ChangeInfo.PropId is TilePanelPropertyIds)
			{
				switch ((TilePanelPropertyIds)(object)e.ChangeInfo.PropId)
				{
				case TilePanelPropertyIds.Caption:
					((Control)this).PerformLayout();
					break;
				case TilePanelPropertyIds.Control:
					if (Owner != null)
					{
						Owner.LayoutTiles();
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			((UltraControlBase)this).OnPropertyChanged(e);
		}

		protected override void OnTextChanged(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (Caption == null)
			{
				CaptionFormatted = TilePanelUtilities.ParseFormattedText(((Control)(object)this).Text, (ValueType)1, throwError: true);
			}
			((Control)this).OnTextChanged(e);
		}

		protected override void SetBoundsCore(int x, int y, int width, int height, BoundsSpecified specified)
		{
			Size size = Size;
			if (width != size.Width || height != size.Height)
			{
				((UltraControlBase)this).Invalidate();
			}
			Rectangle invalidateBounds = GetInvalidateBounds();
			((Control)this).SetBoundsCore(x, y, width, height, specified);
			Rectangle invalidateBounds2 = GetInvalidateBounds();
			InvalidateParent(Rectangle.Union(invalidateBounds, invalidateBounds2));
			if (Size != size)
			{
				SyncTileRegion();
			}
			if (Owner != null && !Owner.IsPerformingTileLayout && !((UltraControlBase)Owner).IsUpdating && ((Component)this).DesignMode)
			{
				IDesignerHost designerHost = (IDesignerHost)((Component)(object)this).Site.GetService(typeof(IDesignerHost));
				if (designerHost != null && designerHost.GetDesigner((IComponent)this) is IUltraTilePanelDesigner ultraTilePanelDesigner)
				{
					ultraTilePanelDesigner.DirtySelectionGlyphs();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void SetVisibleCore(bool value)
		{
			if (!visibleInternal && value && IsPositionValid && Owner != null && Owner.TileFromPositionInNormalMode(PositionInNormalMode, throwErrorInLargeMode: false) != null)
			{
				ResetPosition();
			}
			visibleInternal = value;
			((Control)this).SetVisibleCore(value);
			InvalidateParent(GetInvalidateBounds());
			if (Owner != null && !Owner.IsVerifyingTileVisibility)
			{
				if (!visibleInternal && ((Control)(object)Owner).Controls.Contains((Control)(object)this))
				{
					((Control)this).Parent = (Control)(object)ParentTileContainer;
				}
				Owner.VerifyLargeTileCount(out var countReduced);
				Owner.VerifyLargeTileVisibility();
				if (!countReduced)
				{
					Owner.LayoutTiles();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool SetPositionInNormalMode(Point newPositionInNormalMode, bool shouldAnimate)
		{
			if (Owner != null && !Owner.IsInitializing && !Owner.DesignModeInternal && Owner.IsInLargeMode)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("UltraTile_InvalidOperationException_CannotSetPositionInNormalMode"));
			}
			if (newPositionInNormalMode.X < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("normalStatePosition", newPositionInNormalMode, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("UltraTile_InvalidOperationException_PositionInNormalModeColumnOutOfRange"));
			}
			if (newPositionInNormalMode.Y < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("normalStatePosition", newPositionInNormalMode, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("UltraTile_InvalidOperationException_PositionInNormalModeRowOutOfRange"));
			}
			if (newPositionInNormalMode == PositionInNormalMode)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Owner == null)
			{
				InternalSetPositionInNormalMode(newPositionInNormalMode);
				return true;
			}
			TileMovingEventArgs e = new TileMovingEventArgs(this, newPositionInNormalMode, (UIAction)0);
			e.ShouldAnimate = shouldAnimate;
			FireEvent(TilePanelEventID.TileMoving, e);
			if (e.Cancel)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!e.ShouldAnimate)
			{
				shouldAnimate = false;
			}
			UltraTile ultraTile = Owner.TileFromPositionInNormalMode(newPositionInNormalMode);
			if (ultraTile != null)
			{
				TileMovingEventArgs e2 = new TileMovingEventArgs(ultraTile, PositionInNormalMode, (UIAction)0);
				e2.ShouldAnimate = shouldAnimate;
				FireEvent(TilePanelEventID.TileMoving, e2);
				if (e2.Cancel)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!e2.ShouldAnimate)
				{
					shouldAnimate = false;
				}
				ultraTile.InternalSetPositionInNormalMode(PositionInNormalMode);
			}
			Point oldPosition = PositionInNormalMode;
			InternalSetPositionInNormalMode(newPositionInNormalMode);
			TileEventGroup tileEventGroup = new TileEventGroup();
			TileMovedEventArgs eventArgs = new TileMovedEventArgs(this, oldPosition, (UIAction)0);
			tileEventGroup.AddEvent(this, TilePanelEventID.TileMoved, eventArgs);
			if (ultraTile != null)
			{
				TileMovedEventArgs eventArgs2 = new TileMovedEventArgs(ultraTile, PositionInNormalMode, (UIAction)0);
				tileEventGroup.AddEvent(ultraTile, TilePanelEventID.TileMoved, eventArgs2);
			}
			Owner.LayoutTiles(shouldAnimate, AnimationType.TileReposition, tileEventGroup);
			((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)TilePanelPropertyIds.PositionInNormalMode);
			return true;
		}

		private void SetVisible(bool visible, bool shouldAnimate, UIAction uiAction)
		{
			//IL_004e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00eb: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			bool flag = ((Control)this).Visible;
			if (((Component)this).DesignMode)
			{
				PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(this)["Visible"];
				if (propertyDescriptor != null)
				{
					flag = (bool)propertyDescriptor.GetValue(this);
				}
			}
			if (flag == visible)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (shouldAnimate && !AnimationsEnabledResolved)
			{
				shouldAnimate = false;
			}
			UltraTilePanel ultraTilePanel = Owner;
			if (!visible)
			{
				TileClosingEventArgs e = new TileClosingEventArgs(this, uiAction);
				FireEvent(TilePanelEventID.TileClosing, e);
				if (e.Cancel)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			AnimationType animationType = AnimationType.TileReposition;
			if (ultraTilePanel != null && ultraTilePanel.Tiles.GetVisibleCount(State) == 1)
			{
				animationType = AnimationType.ModeChange;
				Owner.PrepareForModeChange(shouldAnimate);
			}
			if (shouldAnimate)
			{
				ultraTilePanel?.OpenAnimationContext(animationType);
			}
			bool flag2 = false;
			if (((Component)this).DesignMode)
			{
				PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor2 = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(this)["Visible"];
				if (propertyDescriptor2 != null)
				{
					propertyDescriptor2.SetValue(this, visible);
					flag2 = true;
				}
			}
			if (!flag2)
			{
				((Control)this).Visible = visible;
			}
			if (shouldAnimate)
			{
				ultraTilePanel?.CloseAnimationContext(null);
			}
			if (!visible)
			{
				TileClosedEventArgs e2 = new TileClosedEventArgs(this, uiAction);
				FireEvent(TilePanelEventID.TileClosed, e2);
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.InheritanceDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]

		{
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0025: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4

			//IL_0173: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			//IL_01bd: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01db: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!allowMoving)

				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "AllowMoving", allowMoving);

			if ((int)((UltraControlBase)this).AlphaBlendMode != 2)
			{

			}
			Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "PositionInNormalMode", positionInNormalMode);
			if (settings != null && settings.ShouldSerialize())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Settings", settings);
			}
			if (state != TileState.Normal)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "State", state);
			}
			if (((UltraControlBase)this).StyleLibraryName != string.Empty)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "StyleLibraryName", ((UltraControlBase)this).StyleLibraryName);
			}
			if (((UltraControlBase)this).StyleSetName != string.Empty)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "StyleSetName", ((UltraControlBase)this).StyleSetName);
			}
			if (((Control)(object)this).Text.Length != 0)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Text", ((Control)(object)this).Text);
			}
			if ((int)((UltraControlBase)this).TextRenderingMode != 0)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "TextRenderingMode", ((UltraControlBase)this).TextRenderingMode);
			}
			if (!((UltraControlBase)this).UseAppStyling)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "UseAppStyling", ((UltraControlBase)this).UseAppStyling);
			}
			if ((int)((UltraControlBase)this).UseFlatMode != 0)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "UseFlatMode", ((UltraControlBase)this).UseFlatMode);
			}
			if ((int)((UltraControlBase)this).UseOsThemes != 0)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "UseOsThemes", ((UltraControlBase)this).UseOsThemes);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChangeInfo)
		{
			if (((Control)this).IsDisposed || propChangeInfo.Source != settings)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (propChangeInfo.PropId is TilePanelPropertyIds)
			{
				switch ((TilePanelPropertyIds)(object)propChangeInfo.PropId)
				{
				case TilePanelPropertyIds.Appearance:
					SyncBackColor();
					goto default;
				case TilePanelPropertyIds.BorderStyle:
					StyleUtils.DirtyCachedPropertyVals((UltraControlBase)(object)this);
					SyncTileRegion();
					((Control)this).PerformLayout();
					goto default;
				case TilePanelPropertyIds.HeaderAppearance:
				case TilePanelPropertyIds.HeaderExtent:
				case TilePanelPropertyIds.HeaderPosition:
				case TilePanelPropertyIds.ShowCloseButton:
				case TilePanelPropertyIds.ShowStateChangeButton:
					((Control)this).PerformLayout();
					goto default;
				case TilePanelPropertyIds.MaximumSize:
					if (Owner != null)
					{
						Owner.LayoutTiles();
					}
					break;
				case TilePanelPropertyIds.ShowTileShadow:
					if (Owner != null)
					{
						InvalidateParent(GetInvalidateBounds());
						Owner.DirtyControlElement(invalidate: false);
					}
					break;
				default:
					DirtyControlElement();
					break;
				}
			}
			((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)TilePanelPropertyIds.Settings, propChangeInfo);
		}

		internal void FireEvent(TilePanelEventID eventId, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (Owner == null || (!Owner.IsLoading && !Owner.IsInitializing))
			{
				switch (eventId)
				{
				case TilePanelEventID.TileClosed:
					OnClosed((TileClosedEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TilePanelEventID.TileClosing:
					OnClosing((TileClosingEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TilePanelEventID.TileDragged:
					OnDragged((TileDraggedEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TilePanelEventID.TileDragging:
					OnDragging((TileDraggingEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TilePanelEventID.TileDragOverPosition:
					OnDragOverPosition((TileDragOverPositionEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TilePanelEventID.TileDropped:
					OnDropped((TileDroppedEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TilePanelEventID.TileMoved:
					OnMoved((TileMovedEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TilePanelEventID.TileMoving:
					OnMoving((TileMovingEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TilePanelEventID.TileStateChanged:
					OnStateChanged((TileStateChangedEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TilePanelEventID.TileStateChanging:
					OnStateChanging((TileStateChangingEventArgs)e);
					break;
				}
				if (!(e is TileCancelEventArgs { Cancel: not false }) && Owner != null)
				{
					Owner.FireEvent(eventId, e);
				}
			}
		}
