		internal void InitializeFrom(UltraTile tile)
		{
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_013f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0157: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0163: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			allowMoving = tile.allowMoving;
			((UltraControlBase)this).AlphaBlendMode = ((UltraControlBase)tile).AlphaBlendMode;
			backColorInternal = tile.backColorInternal;
			caption = tile.caption;
			CacheCaptionFormatted(caption);
			deserializaedControlName = tile.deserializaedControlName;
			positionInNormalMode = tile.positionInNormalMode;
			if (settings != null)
			{
				settings.SubObjectPropChanged -= SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			settings = tile.settings;
			if (settings != null)
			{
				settings.Initialize(this);
				settings.SubObjectPropChanged += SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (owner != null)
			{
				LargeTileCollection largeTiles = owner.LargeTiles;
				switch (tile.state)
				{
				case TileState.Large:
					if (!largeTiles.Contains(this))
					{
						largeTiles.InternalInsert(largeTiles.Count, this);
					}
					break;
				case TileState.Normal:
					if (largeTiles.Contains(this))
					{
						largeTiles.InternalRemove(this);
					}
					break;
				default:
					state = tile.state;
					break;
				}
				((Control)this).Parent = (Control)(object)ParentTileContainer;
			}
			else
			{
				state = tile.state;
			}
			((UltraControlBase)this).StyleLibraryName = ((UltraControlBase)tile).StyleLibraryName;
			((UltraControlBase)this).StyleSetName = ((UltraControlBase)tile).StyleSetName;
			((Control)(object)this).Text = ((Control)(object)tile).Text;
			((UltraControlBase)this).TextRenderingMode = ((UltraControlBase)tile).TextRenderingMode;
			((UltraControlBase)this).UseAppStyling = ((UltraControlBase)tile).UseAppStyling;
			((UltraControlBase)this).UseFlatMode = ((UltraControlBase)tile).UseFlatMode;
			((UltraControlBase)this).UseOsThemes = ((UltraControlBase)tile).UseOsThemes;
		}

		private bool IsOverDraggableArea(Point point)
		{
			UIElement val = ((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).ElementFromPoint(point);
			if (((Component)this).DesignMode)
			{
				if (val != null && val.GetAncestor(typeof(TileHeaderButtonUIElement)) != null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			if (val == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			UIElement ancestor = val.GetAncestor(typeof(TileHeaderButtonUIElement));
			if (ancestor != null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			UIElement ancestor2 = val.GetAncestor(typeof(TileHeaderUIElement));
			if (ancestor2 != null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void ProcessHeaderButtonClick(TileHeaderButtonType headerButtonType, UIAction action)
		{
			//IL_000a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0045: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01ad: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_010e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			UltraTilePanel ultraTilePanel = Owner;
			if (ultraTilePanel != null)
			{
				TileHeaderButtonClickingEventArgs e = new TileHeaderButtonClickingEventArgs(action, this, headerButtonType);
				ultraTilePanel.UIActionNotifier.FireEvent(TilePanelUINotification.TileHeaderButtonClicking, (EventArgs)(object)e);
				if (((CancelEventArgs)(object)e).Cancel)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			DesignerTransaction designerTransaction = null;
			try
			{
				switch (headerButtonType)
				{
				case TileHeaderButtonType.Close:
					SetVisible(visible: false, shouldAnimate: true, action);
					break;
				case TileHeaderButtonType.StateChange:
				{
					if (ultraTilePanel != null)
					{
						designerTransaction = ultraTilePanel.CreateTransaction(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DesignTime_ChangeTileState"));
					}
					IComponentChangeService componentChangeService = (IComponentChangeService)((Component)(object)this).GetService(typeof(IComponentChangeService));
					if (componentChangeService != null && Owner != null)
					{
						for (int i = 0; i < Owner.Tiles.Count; i++)
						{
							componentChangeService.OnComponentChanging(Owner.Tiles[i], null);
						}
					}
					switch (State)
					{
					case TileState.Large:
						ultraTilePanel?.LargeTiles.Clear();
						break;
					case TileState.Normal:
					{
						PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(this)["State"];
						if (propertyDescriptor != null)
						{
							propertyDescriptor.SetValue(this, TileState.Large);
						}
						else
						{
							SetStateHelper(TileState.Large, action);
						}
						break;
					}
					}
					if (((Component)this).DesignMode)
					{
						((ScrollableControl)(object)ParentTileContainer).ScrollControlIntoView((Control)(object)this);
					}
					if (componentChangeService != null && Owner != null)
					{
						for (int j = 0; j < Owner.Tiles.Count; j++)
						{
							componentChangeService.OnComponentChanged(Owner.Tiles[j], null, null, null);
						}
					}
					designerTransaction?.Commit();
					break;
				}
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				designerTransaction?.Cancel();
				((IUIService)((Component)(object)this).GetService(typeof(IUIService)))?.ShowError(ex);
			}
			if (ultraTilePanel != null)
			{
				TileHeaderButtonClickedEventArgs args = new TileHeaderButtonClickedEventArgs(action, this, headerButtonType);
				ultraTilePanel.UIActionNotifier.FireEvent(TilePanelUINotification.TileHeaderButtonClicked, (EventArgs)(object)args);
			}
		}

					layoutManager.LayoutItems.Remove((ILayoutItem)(object)tileLayoutItem);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ResolveDeserializedControl(List<Control> oldControls)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(deserializaedControlName) || Owner == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < oldControls.Count; i++)
			{
				Control control = oldControls[i];
				if (!(control.Name != deserializaedControlName))
				{
					Control = control;
					oldControls.RemoveAt(i);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool SetStateHelper(TileState value, UIAction action)

		}

		internal bool SetStateHelper(TileState newState, string parameterName, bool shouldAnimate, bool force, UIAction action)
		{
			//IL_006a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0134: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_032d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01dc: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0345: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(TileState), newState))
			{
				throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException(parameterName, (int)newState, typeof(TileState));
			}
			if (State == newState)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Owner == null)
			{
				state = newState;
				return true;
			}
			int maximumVisibleLargeTilesResolved = Owner.MaximumVisibleLargeTilesResolved;
			if (maximumVisibleLargeTilesResolved == 0 && newState == TileState.Large)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (shouldAnimate && !AnimationsEnabledResolved)
			{
				shouldAnimate = false;
			}
			TileStateChangingEventArgs e = new TileStateChangingEventArgs(this, newState, action);
			e.ShouldAnimate = shouldAnimate;
			FireEvent(TilePanelEventID.TileStateChanging, e);
			if (!force && e.Cancel)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!e.ShouldAnimate)
			{
				shouldAnimate = false;
			}
			LargeTileCollection largeTiles = Owner.LargeTiles;
			TileState previousState = State;
			try
			{
				((UltraControlBase)Owner).BeginUpdate();
				bool flag = !Owner.IsAnimationContextOpen;
				switch (newState)
				{
				case TileState.Normal:
				{
					AnimationType animationType2 = AnimationType.TileStateChange;
					if (largeTiles.Count == 1)
					{
						animationType2 = AnimationType.ModeChange;
						Owner.PrepareForModeChange(shouldAnimate);
					}
					if (shouldAnimate && flag)
					{
						Owner.OpenAnimationContext(animationType2);
					}
					BeforeChangeToNormalState(largeTiles, animationType2 == AnimationType.ModeChange, shouldAnimate);
					Owner.LayoutTiles(preventSetAutoScroll: false, honorIsUpdating: false);
					TileEventGroup tileEventGroup2 = new TileEventGroup();
					AfterStateChange(tileEventGroup2, previousState, action);
					if (shouldAnimate)
					{
						if (flag)
						{
							Owner.CloseAnimationContext(tileEventGroup2);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						tileEventGroup2.FireEvents();
					}
					break;
				}
				case TileState.Large:
				{
					if (maximumVisibleLargeTilesResolved == 0)
					{
						return false;
					}
					AnimationType animationType = AnimationType.TileStateChange;
					if (largeTiles.Count == 0)
					{
						animationType = AnimationType.ModeChange;
						Owner.PrepareForModeChange(shouldAnimate);
					}
					if (shouldAnimate && flag)
					{
						Owner.OpenAnimationContext(animationType);
					}
					List<UltraTile> list = new List<UltraTile>(largeTiles);
					int num = 0;
					int num2 = largeTiles.GetVisibleCount();
					List<UltraTile> list2 = new List<UltraTile>();
					while (num < num2 && maximumVisibleLargeTilesResolved - 1 < num2)
					{
						UltraTile ultraTile = largeTiles[num];
						if (!ultraTile.VisibleInternal)
						{
							num++;
							continue;
						}
						TileStateChangingEventArgs e2 = new TileStateChangingEventArgs(ultraTile, TileState.Normal, action);
						e2.ShouldAnimate = shouldAnimate;
						ultraTile.FireEvent(TilePanelEventID.TileStateChanging, e2);
						if (e2.Cancel)
						{
							num++;
							if (num != num2)
							{
								continue;
							}
							if (!force)
							{
								for (int num3 = largeTiles.Count - 1; num3 >= 0; num3--)
								{
									largeTiles.InternalRemoveAt(num3);
								}
								for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
								{
									largeTiles.InternalInsert(i, list[i]);
								}
								if (shouldAnimate && flag)
								{
									Owner.CloseAnimationContext(null);
								}
								return false;
							}
							num--;
						}
						if (!e2.ShouldAnimate)
						{
							shouldAnimate = false;
						}
						if (shouldAnimate)
						{
							ultraTile.PrepareTileForStateChangeAnimation();
						}
						list2.Add(ultraTile);
						largeTiles.InternalRemoveAt(num);
						num2--;
					}
					if (shouldAnimate && animationType == AnimationType.TileStateChange)
					{
						PrepareTileForStateChangeAnimation();
					}
					largeTiles.InternalInsert(largeTiles.Count, this);
					if (!shouldAnimate)
					{
						Control parentTileContainer = (Control)(object)ParentTileContainer;
						((Control)this).Parent = parentTileContainer;
						for (int j = 0; j < list2.Count; j++)
						{
							UltraTile ultraTile2 = list2[j];
							((Control)(object)ultraTile2).Parent = (Control)(object)ultraTile2.ParentTileContainer;
						}
					}
					Owner.LayoutTiles(preventSetAutoScroll: false, honorIsUpdating: false);
					TileEventGroup tileEventGroup = new TileEventGroup();
					AfterStateChange(tileEventGroup, previousState, action);
					for (int k = 0; k < list2.Count; k++)
					{
						list2[k].AfterStateChange(tileEventGroup, TileState.Large, action);
					}
					if (shouldAnimate)
					{
						if (flag)
						{
							Owner.CloseAnimationContext(tileEventGroup);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						tileEventGroup.FireEvents();
					}
					break;
				}
				default:
					return false;
				}
				((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)TilePanelPropertyIds.State);
				return true;
			}
			finally
			{
				((UltraControlBase)Owner).EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		internal void SetStateInternal(TileState value)
		{
			if (state != value)
			{
				IComponentChangeService componentChangeService = (IComponentChangeService)((Component)(object)this).GetService(typeof(IComponentChangeService));
				PropertyDescriptor member = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(this)["State"];
				componentChangeService?.OnComponentChanging(this, member);
				RemoveLayoutItem();
				TileState tileState = state;
				state = value;
				AddLayoutItem();
				componentChangeService?.OnComponentChanged(this, member, tileState, state);
				((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)TilePanelPropertyIds.State);
			}
		}

		internal void ShowToolTip(Control control, string toolTipText, bool showAlways)
		{
			//IL_0059: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0063: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (((Component)this).DesignMode || control == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			HideToolTip();
			if (toolTipText == null || toolTipText.Length == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (showAlways)
			{
				UIPermission uIPermission = new UIPermission(UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows);
				try
				{
					if (Utilities.CanAssert)
					{
						uIPermission.Assert();
					}
					if (Form.ActiveForm == null)
					{
						return;
					}
					CodeAccessPermission.RevertAssert();
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
				}
			}
			if (tooltip == null)
			{
				tooltip = new ToolTip(control, ((UltraControlBase)this).ComponentRole);
			}
			tooltip.ToolTipText = toolTipText;
			tooltip.Show();
			ResetCursorPosition();
		}

		internal void SyncBackColor()

			((Control)this).BackColor = backColor;
		}

			}
			else

			}
		}

		private void AutoScrollDuringDrag(Point currentScreenLocation)
		{
			TileContainerPanel parentTileContainer = ParentTileContainer;
			if (parentTileContainer == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Rectangle rectangle = ((Control)(object)parentTileContainer).RectangleToScreen(((Control)(object)parentTileContainer).ClientRectangle);
			Point empty = Point.Empty;
			if (currentScreenLocation.X < rectangle.Left)
			{
				empty.X = currentScreenLocation.X - rectangle.Left;
			}
			else if (rectangle.Right < currentScreenLocation.X)
			{
				empty.X = currentScreenLocation.X - rectangle.Right;
			}
			if (currentScreenLocation.Y < rectangle.Top)
			{
				empty.Y = currentScreenLocation.Y - rectangle.Top;
			}
			else if (rectangle.Bottom < currentScreenLocation.Y)
			{
				empty.Y = currentScreenLocation.Y - rectangle.Bottom;
			}
			if (empty.IsEmpty)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = empty.X / 30;
			int num2 = empty.Y / 30;
			if (empty.X != 0)
			{
				num += Math.Sign(empty.X);
			}
			if (empty.Y != 0)
			{
				num2 += Math.Sign(empty.Y);
			}
			int horizontalScrollValue = parentTileContainer.HorizontalScrollValue;
			int verticalScrollValue = parentTileContainer.VerticalScrollValue;
			int maximumHorizontalScrollValueDuringTileDrag = parentTileContainer.MaximumHorizontalScrollValueDuringTileDrag;
			int maximumVerticalScrollValueDuringTileDrag = parentTileContainer.MaximumVerticalScrollValueDuringTileDrag;
			int x = 0;
			if (parentTileContainer.IsHorizontalScrollbarVisible)
			{
				if (((Control)(object)this).RightToLeft == RightToLeft.Yes)
				{
					num *= -1;
				}
				x = (parentTileContainer.HorizontalScrollValue = Math.Max(0, Math.Min(horizontalScrollValue + num, maximumHorizontalScrollValueDuringTileDrag)));
			}
			int y = 0;
			if (parentTileContainer.IsVerticalScrollbarVisible)
			{
				y = (parentTileContainer.VerticalScrollValue = Math.Max(0, Math.Min(verticalScrollValue + num2, maximumVerticalScrollValueDuringTileDrag)));
			}
			Point autoScrollPosition = ((ScrollableControl)(object)parentTileContainer).AutoScrollPosition;
			Point autoScrollPosition2 = new Point(x, y);
			if (((Control)(object)this).RightToLeft == RightToLeft.Yes && parentTileContainer.IsHorizontalScrollbarVisible)
			{
				autoScrollPosition2.X = maximumHorizontalScrollValueDuringTileDrag - autoScrollPosition2.X;
			}
			if (autoScrollPosition2.X != -autoScrollPosition.X || autoScrollPosition2.Y != -autoScrollPosition.Y)
			{
				((ScrollableControl)(object)parentTileContainer).AutoScrollPosition = autoScrollPosition2;
				Point offset = new Point(-(autoScrollPosition2.X + autoScrollPosition.X), -(autoScrollPosition2.Y + autoScrollPosition.Y));
				Owner.OffsetCoordinates(offset);
				Owner.DirtyControlElement(invalidate: false);
				((UltraControlBase)Owner).Update();
			}
		}

		private void CacheCaptionFormatted(string captionValue)
		{
			if (captionValue != null)
			{
				CaptionFormatted = TilePanelUtilities.ParseFormattedText(captionValue, (ValueType)0, throwError: true);
			}
			else
			{
				CaptionFormatted = TilePanelUtilities.ParseFormattedText(((Control)(object)this).Text, (ValueType)1, throwError: true);
			}
		}

		private void DragMouseMove(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			Point point = ((Control)this).PointToScreen(e.Location);
			try
			{
				Point point2 = new Point(point.X - startDragMouseScreenLocation.X, point.Y - startDragMouseScreenLocation.Y);
				Location = new Point(startDragTileLocation.X + point2.X, startDragTileLocation.Y + point2.Y);
				Point clientLocation = ((Control)(object)owner).PointToClient(point);
				UltraTile ultraTile = Owner.TileFromPointInNormalMode(clientLocation);
				Owner.GetLogicalPositionInNormalMode(clientLocation, out var position);
				if (draggedOverPositionWhichPreventedDrop == position || position.X < 0 || position.Y < 0 || position == PositionInNormalMode)
				{
					return;
				}
				TileDragOverPositionEventArgs e2 = new TileDragOverPositionEventArgs(this, position, ultraTile, (UIAction)5);
				FireEvent(TilePanelEventID.TileDragOverPosition, e2);
				if (!e2.AllowDrop)
				{
					draggedOverPositionWhichPreventedDrop = position;
					return;
				}
				if (ultraTile != null)
				{
					TileMovingEventArgs e3 = new TileMovingEventArgs(ultraTile, PositionInNormalMode, (UIAction)5);
					ultraTile.FireEvent(TilePanelEventID.TileMoving, e3);
					if (e3.Cancel)
					{
						draggedOverPositionWhichPreventedDrop = position;
						return;
					}
					if (ultraTile.IsAnimating())
					{
						Owner.StopAnimatingTile(ultraTile);
					}
					SwapTiles(this, ultraTile);
					bool flag = e3.ShouldAnimate;
					if (flag && !AnimationsEnabledResolved)
					{
						flag = false;
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						owner.OpenAnimationContext(AnimationType.TileReposition);
					}
					owner.LayoutTiles(preventSetAutoScroll: true, honorIsUpdating: true);
					TileEventGroup tileEventGroup = new TileEventGroup();
					TileMovedEventArgs eventArgs = new TileMovedEventArgs(ultraTile, PositionInNormalMode, (UIAction)5);
					tileEventGroup.AddEvent(ultraTile, TilePanelEventID.TileMoved, eventArgs);
					if (flag)
					{
						owner.CloseAnimationContext(tileEventGroup);
					}
					else
					{
						tileEventGroup.FireEvents();
					}
				}
				else
				{
					InvalidateParent(Owner.GetTileBoundsFromPositionInNormalMode(PositionInNormalMode));
					InternalSetPositionInNormalMode(position);
					InvalidateParent(Owner.GetTileBoundsFromPositionInNormalMode(PositionInNormalMode));
					owner.LayoutTiles(preventSetAutoScroll: true, honorIsUpdating: true);
				}
				draggedOverPositionWhichPreventedDrop = new Point(-1, -1);
			}
			finally
			{
				AutoScrollDuringDrag(point);
			}
		}

		private void EndDrag()
		{
			ParentTileContainer?.OnTileDragEnd();
			isDragging = false;
			TileEventGroup tileEventGroup = new TileEventGroup();
			TileDroppedEventArgs e = new TileDroppedEventArgs(this, dragOldPosition, (UIAction)3);
			tileEventGroup.AddEvent(this, TilePanelEventID.TileDropped, e);
			owner.LayoutTiles(e.ShouldAnimate, AnimationType.TileDropped, tileEventGroup);
			dragOldPosition = new Point(-1, -1);
			draggedOverPositionWhichPreventedDrop = new Point(-1, -1);
		}

		private Rectangle GetInvalidateBounds()
		{
			Rectangle bounds = ((Control)this).Bounds;
			if (SettingsResolved.ShowTileShadow)
			{
				bounds.Width += 4;
				bounds.Height += 4;
			}
			return bounds;
		}

		private void InitializeDragOperation(Point mouseLocation)
		{
			if (AllowMovingResolved && IsOverDraggableArea(mouseLocation) && Owner != null && !Owner.IsInLargeMode && !(Owner.NormalModeDimensions == new Size(1, 1)))
			{
				isDragPending = true;
				lastMouseDownLocation = mouseLocation;
			}
		}

		private void InvalidateParent(Rectangle bounds)
		{
			if (Owner == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Control parentTileContainer = (Control)(object)ParentTileContainer;
			if (parentTileContainer == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (parentTileContainer.Controls.Contains((Control)(object)this))
			{
				parentTileContainer.Invalidate(bounds);
			}
			else if (((Control)(object)Owner).Controls.Contains((Control)(object)this))
			{
				if (Owner.IsInModeChangeOperation)
				{
					((UltraControlBase)Owner).Invalidate(bounds);
				}
				else if (((Control)(object)Owner).IsHandleCreated)
				{
					Rectangle r = ((Control)(object)Owner).RectangleToScreen(bounds);
					((Control)(object)Owner.TileContainerNormal).Invalidate(((Control)(object)Owner.TileContainerNormal).RectangleToClient(r));
					((Control)(object)Owner.TileContainerLarge).Invalidate(((Control)(object)Owner.TileContainerLarge).RectangleToClient(r));
				}
			}
		}

		private static void ResetCursorPosition()
		{
			Utilities.SetCursorPosition(Cursor.Position);
		}

		private void StartDrag(Point dragStartLocation)
		{
			if (Owner != null && !Owner.IsInLargeMode)
			{
				ParentTileContainer?.OnTileDragBegin();
				TileDraggingEventArgs e = new TileDraggingEventArgs(this, (UIAction)5);
				FireEvent(TilePanelEventID.TileDragging, e);
				if (!e.Cancel)
				{
					((Control)this).BringToFront();
					dragOldPosition = PositionInNormalMode;
					isDragging = true;
					startDragMouseScreenLocation = ((Control)this).PointToScreen(dragStartLocation);
					startDragTileLocation = Location;
					Owner.LayoutTiles();
					TileDraggedEventArgs e2 = new TileDraggedEventArgs(this, (UIAction)5);
					FireEvent(TilePanelEventID.TileDragged, e2);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void SwapTiles(UltraTile tile1, UltraTile tile2)
		{
			Point value = tile1.PositionInNormalMode;
			Point value2 = tile2.PositionInNormalMode;
			SwapValues(ref value, ref value2);
			tile1.InternalSetPositionInNormalMode(value);
			tile2.InternalSetPositionInNormalMode(value2);
		}

		private static void SwapValues(ref Point value1, ref Point value2)
		{
			Point point = value1;
			value1 = value2;
			value2 = point;
		}

		private void UnhookControl(Control oldControl)
		{
			if (oldControl == null || !((Control)this).Controls.Contains(oldControl))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (((Component)this).DesignMode)
			{
				Control parent = (Control)(object)ParentTileContainer;
				if (Owner != null)
				{
					Control parent2 = Utilities.GetParent((Control)(object)Owner);
					if (parent2 != null)
					{
						parent = parent2;
					}
				}
				oldControl.Parent = parent;
			}
			else
			{
				oldControl.Parent = null;
			}
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializePositionInNormalMode()
		{
			return positionInNormalMode != DefaultPositionInNormalMode;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeSettings()
		{
			if (settings != null)
			{
				return settings.ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void ResetSettings()
		{
			if (settings != null)
			{
				settings.Reset();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnGestureQueryStatus(GestureQueryStatusEventArgs e)
		{
			for (UIElement val = ((controlElement != null) ? ((UIElement)controlElement).ElementFromPoint(e.Location) : null); val != null; val = val.Parent)
			{
				if (val is TileHeaderUIElement)
				{
					e.Mode = (GestureModes)0;
					break;
				}
			}
			((UltraControlBase)this).OnGestureQueryStatus(e);
		}
	}

		{

			public override AccessibleRole Role
			{
				get
				{
					if (((Control)(object)tilePanel).AccessibleRole != AccessibleRole.Default)
					{
						return ((Control.ControlAccessibleObject)this).Role;
					}
					return AccessibleRole.Client;
				}
			}

			public override AccessibleStates State
			{
				get
				{
					AccessibleStates accessibleStates = AccessibleStates.None;
					if (!((Control)(object)tilePanel).Enabled)
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Unavailable;
					}
					else if (((Control)(object)tilePanel).Visible)
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Focusable;
						if (((Control)(object)tilePanel).ContainsFocus)
						{
							accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Focused;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Invisible;
					}
					if (((AccessibleObject)(object)this).Bounds.IsEmpty)
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Offscreen;
					}
					return accessibleStates;
				}
			}

			public UltraTilePanel TilePanel => tilePanel;

			public TilePanelAccessibleObject(UltraTilePanel tilePanel)
				: base((Control)(object)tilePanel)
			{
				this.tilePanel = tilePanel;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetChild(int index)
			{
				if (index < 0 || index >= ((AccessibleObject)(object)this).GetChildCount())
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (index == 0)
				{
					return ((Control)(object)tilePanel.TileContainerNormal).AccessibilityObject;
				}
				if (tilePanel.IsInLargeMode)
				{
					index--;
					if (index == 0)
					{
						return ((Control)(object)tilePanel.TileContainerLarge).AccessibilityObject;
					}
				}
				if (tilePanel.TileContainerNormal.IsHorizontalScrollbarVisible)
				{
					index--;
					if (index == 0)
					{
						UIElement descendant = ((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)tilePanel).ControlUIElement).GetDescendant(typeof(HorizontalScrollBarUIElement), (object)TilePanel.TileContainerNormal.GetHorizontalScrollbarInfo());
						if (descendant == null)
						{
							return null;
						}
						return descendant.AccessibilityInstance;
					}
				}
				if (tilePanel.TileContainerNormal.IsVerticalScrollbarVisible)
				{
					index--;
					if (index == 0)
					{
						UIElement descendant2 = ((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)tilePanel).ControlUIElement).GetDescendant(typeof(VeritcalScrollBarUIElement), (object)TilePanel.TileContainerNormal.GetVerticalScrollbarInfo());
						if (descendant2 == null)
						{
							return null;
						}
						return descendant2.AccessibilityInstance;
					}
				}
				if (tilePanel.IsInLargeMode)
				{
					if (tilePanel.TileContainerLarge.IsHorizontalScrollbarVisible)
					{
						index--;
						if (index == 0)
						{
							UIElement descendant3 = ((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)tilePanel).ControlUIElement).GetDescendant(typeof(HorizontalScrollBarUIElement), (object)TilePanel.TileContainerLarge.GetHorizontalScrollbarInfo());
							if (descendant3 == null)
							{
								return null;
							}
							return descendant3.AccessibilityInstance;
						}
					}
					if (tilePanel.TileContainerLarge.IsVerticalScrollbarVisible)
					{
						index--;
						if (index == 0)
						{
							UIElement descendant4 = ((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)tilePanel).ControlUIElement).GetDescendant(typeof(VeritcalScrollBarUIElement), (object)TilePanel.TileContainerLarge.GetVerticalScrollbarInfo());
							if (descendant4 == null)
							{
								return null;
							}
							return descendant4.AccessibilityInstance;
						}
					}
				}
				return null;
			}

			public override int GetChildCount()
			{
				int num = 1;
				if (tilePanel.IsInLargeMode)
				{
					num++;
				}
				if (tilePanel.TileContainerNormal.IsFullTrust)
				{
					if (tilePanel.TileContainerNormal.IsHorizontalScrollbarVisible)
					{
						num++;
					}
					if (tilePanel.TileContainerNormal.IsVerticalScrollbarVisible)
					{
						num++;
					}
					if (tilePanel.IsInLargeMode)
					{
						if (tilePanel.TileContainerLarge.IsHorizontalScrollbarVisible)
						{
							num++;
						}
						if (tilePanel.TileContainerLarge.IsVerticalScrollbarVisible)
						{
							num++;
						}
					}
				}
				return num;
			}

				UIElement controlUIElement = (UIElement)(object)((UltraControlBase)tilePanel).ControlUIElement;

			{
				if (value is UltraTile)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("UltraTilePanel_InvalidOperationException_CannotAddTileToControlsCollection"));
				}
				if (value is TileContainerPanel)
				{
					InternalAddControl(value);
					return;
				}
				if (value.GetType().FullName == "Infragistics.Win.UltraWinChart.IGWinTooltip")
				{
					InternalAddControl(value);
					return;
				}
				UltraTile ultraTile2 = tilePanel.CreateTile();
				ultraTile2.Control = value;
				tilePanel.Tiles.Add(ultraTile2);
			}

			public void InternalAddControl(Control control)
			{
				base.Add(control);
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public TileOrientation LargeTileOrientationResolved
		{
			get
			{
				TileOrientation tileOrientation = LargeTileOrientation;
				if (tileOrientation != TileOrientation.Default)
				{
					return tileOrientation;
				}
				switch (LargeTilePositionResolved)
				{
				default:
					return TileOrientation.Vertical;
				case LargeTilePosition.Top:
				case LargeTilePosition.Bottom:
					return TileOrientation.Horizontal;
				}
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_UltraTilePanel_P_MaximumColumns")]
		[DefaultValue(0)]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Layout")]
		public int MaximumColumns
		{
			get
			{
				return maximumColumns;
			}
			set
			{
				if (maximumColumns != value)
				{
					if (value < 0)
					{
						throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("value", Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("UltraTilePanel_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_MaximumColumnsOutOfRange"));
					}
					if (0 < value && value < MinimumColumns)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("UltraTilePanel_InvalidOperationException_MaximumColumnsLessThanMinimumColumns"));
					}
					maximumColumns = value;
					((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)TilePanelPropertyIds.MaximumColumns);
				}
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public int MaximumVisibleLargeTilesResolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (isInitializing)
				{
					return int.MaxValue;
				}
				int num = MaximumVisibleLargeTiles;
				if (num == 0)
				{
					num = 1;
				}
				int val = Tiles.GetVisibleCount() - 1;
				return Math.Max(0, Math.Min(val, num));
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Appearance")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_UltraTilePanel_P_ScrollBarLook")]
		public ScrollBarLook ScrollBarLook
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0013: Expected O, but got Unknown
				if (scrollBarLook == null)
				{
					scrollBarLook = new ScrollBarLook();
					((SubObjectBase)(object)scrollBarLook).SubObjectPropChanged += SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					if (tileContainerNormal != null)
					{
						tileContainerNormal.OnScrollBarLookChanged();
					}
					if (tileContainerLarge != null)
					{
						tileContainerLarge.OnScrollBarLookChanged();
					}
				}
				return scrollBarLook;
			}
			set
			{
				if (scrollBarLook != value)
				{
					if (scrollBarLook != null)
					{
						((SubObjectBase)(object)scrollBarLook).SubObjectPropChanged -= SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					}
					scrollBarLook = value;
					if (scrollBarLook != null)
					{
						((SubObjectBase)(object)scrollBarLook).SubObjectPropChanged += SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					}
					if (tileContainerNormal != null)
					{
						tileContainerNormal.OnScrollBarLookChanged();
					}
					if (tileContainerLarge != null)
					{
						tileContainerLarge.OnScrollBarLookChanged();
					}
					((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)TilePanelPropertyIds.ScrollBarLook);
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool HasScrollBarLook => scrollBarLook != null;

		internal bool AnimationsEnabledResolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (!AnimationsEnabled)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (isInitializing)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (isLoading)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (((Control)this).IsDisposed || ((Control)this).Disposing)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!((Control)this).Visible)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return !((Component)this).DesignMode;
			}
		}

		{

				return false;

		public UltraTilePanel()
		{
			license = Utilities.ValidateLicense(typeof(UltraTilePanel), this);
			((Control)this).SetStyle(ControlStyles.ContainerControl, value: true);
			((Control)this).SetStyle(ControlStyles.Selectable, value: false);
			((Control)this).SetStyle(ControlStyles.SupportsTransparentBackColor, value: true);
			((Control)this).SetStyle(ControlStyles.OptimizedDoubleBuffer, value: true);
			emptyTileAreasBounds = new List<Rectangle>();
			layoutContainerNormal = new TileLayoutContainer(this, TileState.Normal);
			layoutContainerLarge = new TileLayoutContainer(this, TileState.Large);
			layoutManagerNormal = new GridLayoutManager();
			layoutManagerLarge = new GridLayoutManager();
			runningAnimations = new List<AnimationManager>();
		}

		public override void BeginUpdate()
		{
			updateCounter++;
			if (updateCounter <= 1)
			{
				((UltraControlBase)this).BeginUpdate();
				SuspendLargeTileCollectionSynchronization();
			}
		}

		protected override AccessibleObject CreateAccessibilityInstance()
		{
			return (AccessibleObject)(object)new TilePanelAccessibleObject(this);
		}

		protected override ComponentRole CreateComponentRole()
		{
			return (ComponentRole)(object)new UltraTilePanelRole(this);
		}

		protected override Control.ControlCollection CreateControlsInstance()
		{
			return new UltraTilePanelControlCollection(this);
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				DisposeContextMenu();
				if (timerForAnimations != null)
				{
					timerForAnimations.Dispose();
				}
				foreach (AnimationManager runningAnimation in runningAnimations)
				{
					runningAnimation.Dispose();
				}
				runningAnimations.Clear();
				if (currentAnimationContext != null)
				{
					currentAnimationContext.Dispose();
					currentAnimationContext = null;
				}
				if (appearancesManager != null)
				{
					((DisposableObject)(object)appearancesManager).Dispose();
				}
				if (scrollBarLook != null)
				{
					((SubObjectBase)(object)scrollBarLook).SubObjectPropChanged -= SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					scrollBarLook = null;
				}
				ClearBitmapCache();
			}
			((UltraControlBase)this).Dispose(disposing);
		}

		public override void EndUpdate(bool invalidate)
		{
			updateCounter--;
			if (0 < updateCounter)
			{
				return;
			}
			ResumeLargeTileCollectionSynchronization();
			((UltraControlBase)this).EndUpdate(invalidate);
			bool layoutPerformed = false;
			if (!((Component)this).DesignMode)
			{
				VerifyTileVisibility(out layoutPerformed);
			}
			VerifyLargeTileVisibility();
			if (shouldLayoutAfterUpdate)
			{
				shouldLayoutAfterUpdate = false;
				LayoutTiles();
			}
			if (invalidate)
			{
				DirtyDesignerGlyphs();
				((Control)(object)TileContainerNormal).Invalidate();
				if (IsInLargeMode)
				{
					((Control)(object)TileContainerLarge).Invalidate();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnClick(EventArgs e)
		{
			((UltraControlBase)this).OnClick(e);
		}

		protected override void OnCreateControl()
		{
			if (shouldVerifyTileContentSizes)
			{
				shouldVerifyTileContentSizes = false;
				for (int i = 0; i < Tiles.Count; i++)
				{
					UltraTile ultraTile = Tiles[i];
					if (ultraTile.VisibleInternal)
					{
						((Control)(object)ultraTile).PerformLayout();
					}
				}
			}
			((UltraControlBase)this).OnCreateControl();
			SyncBackColor();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseClick(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			((Control)this).OnMouseClick(e);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseDown(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Button == MouseButtons.Right)
			{
				InitializeContextMenu(e.Location);
			}
			((UltraControlBase)this).OnMouseDown(e);
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.ChangeInfo.PropId is TilePanelPropertyIds)
			{
				switch ((TilePanelPropertyIds)(object)e.ChangeInfo.PropId)
				{
				case TilePanelPropertyIds.Appearance:
					SyncBackColor();
					((UltraControlBase)this).Invalidate(true);
					break;
				case TilePanelPropertyIds.BorderStyle:
					StyleUtils.DirtyCachedPropertyVals((UltraControlBase)(object)this);
					LayoutTiles();
					break;
				case TilePanelPropertyIds.DropAreaBorderStyle:
				case TilePanelPropertyIds.EmptyTileAreaBorderStyle:
					StyleUtils.DirtyCachedPropertyVals((UltraControlBase)(object)this);
					break;
				case TilePanelPropertyIds.LargeTileOrientation:
				case TilePanelPropertyIds.LargeTilePosition:
					if (IsInLargeMode)
					{
						LayoutTiles();
					}
					break;
				case TilePanelPropertyIds.MaximumColumns:
				case TilePanelPropertyIds.MaximumRows:
				case TilePanelPropertyIds.MinimumColumns:
				case TilePanelPropertyIds.MinimumRows:
					if (!IsInLargeMode)
					{
						LayoutTiles();
					}
					break;
				case TilePanelPropertyIds.MaximumVisibleLargeTiles:
				{
					VerifyLargeTileCount(out var _);
					break;
				}
				case TilePanelPropertyIds.MinimumTileSize:
					LayoutTiles();
					break;
				case TilePanelPropertyIds.ScrollBarLook:
					LayoutTiles();
					break;
				}
			}
			DirtyControlElement();
			((UltraControlBase)this).OnPropertyChanged(e);
		}

		protected override void OnRightToLeftChanged(EventArgs e)
		{
			((Control)this).OnRightToLeftChanged(e);
			LayoutTiles();
			TileContainerNormal.DirtyOnNextScrollMessage = true;
			if (IsInLargeMode)
			{
				TileContainerLarge.DirtyOnNextScrollMessage = true;
			}
		}

		protected override void SetBoundsCore(int x, int y, int width, int height, BoundsSpecified specified)
		{
			((Control)this).SetBoundsCore(x, y, width, height, specified);
			DirtyControlElement();
			LayoutTiles();
		}

		}

		}

		void ISupportInitialize.EndInit()

				shouldVerifyTileContentSizes = true;
			}
		}

		public UltraTile TileFromPositionInNormalMode(Point positionInNormalMode)
		{
			return TileFromPositionInNormalMode(positionInNormalMode, throwErrorInLargeMode: true);
		}

		internal UltraTile TileFromPositionInNormalMode(Point positionInNormalMode, bool throwErrorInLargeMode)
		{
			if (throwErrorInLargeMode && !IsInitializing && IsInLargeMode)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("UltraTilePanel_InvalidOperationException_GetPositionWhenInLargeMode"));
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < Tiles.Count; i++)
			{
				UltraTile ultraTile = Tiles[i];
				if (ultraTile.VisibleInternal && ultraTile.IsPositionValid && ultraTile.PositionInNormalMode == positionInNormalMode)
				{
					return ultraTile;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected internal virtual UltraTile CreateTile()
		{
			try
			{
				return (UltraTile)Activator.CreateInstance(DefaultTileType);
			}
			catch
			{
				return new UltraTile();
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.InheritanceDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		protected internal virtual void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			//IL_0093: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b1: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a1: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00cf: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00bf: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00dd: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!animationsEnabled)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "AnimationsEnabled", animationsEnabled);
			}
			if (appearances != null && ((DisposableObjectCollectionBase)(object)appearances).Count != 0)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Appearances", appearances);
			}
			if (appearancesManager != null && appearancesManager.ShouldSerialize())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "AppearancesManager", appearancesManager);
			}
			if (backColorInternal != DefaultBackColorInternal)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "BackColorInternal", backColorInternal);
			}
			if ((int)borderStyle != 0)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "BorderStyle", borderStyle);
			}
			if ((int)dropAreaBorderStyle != 0)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "DropAreaBorderStyle", dropAreaBorderStyle);
			}
			if ((int)emptyTileAreaBorderStyle != 0)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "EmptyTileAreaBorderStyle", emptyTileAreaBorderStyle);
			}
			if (largeTileOrientation != TileOrientation.Default)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "LargeTileOrientation", largeTileOrientation);
			}
			if (largeTilePosition != LargeTilePosition.Default)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "LargeTilePosition", largeTilePosition);
			}
			if (maximumColumns != 0)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "MaximumColumns", maximumColumns);
			}
			if (maximumRows != 0)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "MaximumRows", maximumRows);
			}
			if (maximumVisibleLargeTiles != 0)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "MaximumVisibleLargeTiles", maximumVisibleLargeTiles);
			}
			if (minimumColumns != 0)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "MinimumColumns", minimumColumns);
			}
			if (minimumRows != 0)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "MinimumRows", minimumRows);
			}
			if (minimumTileSize != DefaultMinimumTileSize)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "MinimumTileSize", minimumTileSize);
			}
			if (scrollBarLook != null && scrollBarLook.ShouldSerialize())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ScrollBarLook", scrollBarLook);
			}
			if (tiles != null && tiles.Count != 0)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Tiles", tiles);
			}
			if (tileSettings != null && tileSettings.ShouldSerialize())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "TileSettings", tileSettings);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChangeInfo)
		{
			if (((Control)this).IsDisposed)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (propChangeInfo.Source == appearancesManager)
			{
				TilePanelPropertyIds tilePanelPropertyIds = (TilePanelPropertyIds)(object)propChangeInfo.PropId;
				propChangeInfo = propChangeInfo.Trigger;
				((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)tilePanelPropertyIds, propChangeInfo);
			}
			else if (propChangeInfo.Source == tiles)
			{
				if (((Component)this).DesignMode)
				{
					IComponentChangeService componentChangeService = ((Component)(object)this).GetService(typeof(IComponentChangeService)) as IComponentChangeService;
					PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(this)["Tiles"];
					if (componentChangeService != null && propertyDescriptor != null)
					{
						componentChangeService.OnComponentChanging(this, propertyDescriptor);
						componentChangeService.OnComponentChanged(this, propertyDescriptor, null, null);
					}
				}
				((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)TilePanelPropertyIds.Tiles, propChangeInfo);
			}
			else if (propChangeInfo.Source == largeTiles)
			{
				((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)TilePanelPropertyIds.LargeTiles, propChangeInfo);
			}
			else if (propChangeInfo.Source == tileSettings)
			{
				if (propChangeInfo.PropId is TilePanelPropertyIds)
				{
					switch ((TilePanelPropertyIds)(object)propChangeInfo.PropId)
					{
					case TilePanelPropertyIds.Appearance:
					{
						for (int j = 0; j < Tiles.Count; j++)
						{
							Tiles[j].SyncBackColor();
						}
						goto default;
					}
					case TilePanelPropertyIds.BorderStyle:
					{
						for (int k = 0; k < Tiles.Count; k++)
						{
							UltraTile ultraTile = Tiles[k];
							StyleUtils.DirtyCachedPropertyVals((UltraControlBase)(object)ultraTile);
							ultraTile.SyncTileRegion();
							((Control)(object)ultraTile).PerformLayout();
						}
						goto default;
					}
					case TilePanelPropertyIds.HeaderAppearance:
					case TilePanelPropertyIds.HeaderExtent:
					case TilePanelPropertyIds.HeaderPosition:
					case TilePanelPropertyIds.ShowCloseButton:
					case TilePanelPropertyIds.ShowStateChangeButton:
					{
						for (int i = 0; i < Tiles.Count; i++)
						{
							((Control)(object)Tiles[i]).PerformLayout();
						}
						goto default;
					}
					case TilePanelPropertyIds.MaximumSize:
						LayoutTiles();
						break;
					case TilePanelPropertyIds.ShowTileShadow:
						DirtyControlElement();
						break;
					default:
					{
						for (int l = 0; l < Tiles.Count; l++)
						{
							Tiles[l].DirtyControlElement();
						}
						break;
					}
					}
				}
				((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)TilePanelPropertyIds.TileSettings, propChangeInfo);
			}
			else if (propChangeInfo.Source == scrollBarLook)
			{
				((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)TilePanelPropertyIds.ScrollBarLook, propChangeInfo);
			}
			else if (propChangeInfo.Source == appearances)
			{
				((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)TilePanelPropertyIds.Appearances, propChangeInfo);
			}
		}

		internal void AreScrollBarsVisible(TileState containerState, out bool isHorizontalScrollBarPresent, out bool isVerticalScrollBarPresent)
		{
			isVerticalScrollBarPresent = false;
			isHorizontalScrollBarPresent = false;
			Size minimumTileSizeResolved = MinimumTileSizeResolved;
			int resolvedColumnCount = GetResolvedColumnCount(containerState);
			int resolvedRowCount = GetResolvedRowCount(containerState);
			int num = resolvedColumnCount * minimumTileSizeResolved.Width + (resolvedColumnCount + 1) * 10;
			int num2 = resolvedRowCount * minimumTileSizeResolved.Height + (resolvedRowCount + 1) * 10;
			Size size = GetContainerRectangle(containerState).Size;
			ScrollBarLook scrollBarLookIfAllocated = GetScrollBarLookIfAllocated();
			if (size.Width < num)
			{
				isHorizontalScrollBarPresent = true;
				size.Height -= ScrollBarLook.GetHorizontalScrollBarHeightResolved(scrollBarLookIfAllocated, ((UltraControlBase)this).ComponentRole);
			}
			if (size.Height < num2)
			{
				isVerticalScrollBarPresent = true;
				size.Height -= ScrollBarLook.GetVerticalScrollBarWidthResolved(scrollBarLookIfAllocated, ((UltraControlBase)this).ComponentRole);
				if (!isHorizontalScrollBarPresent && size.Width < num)
				{
					isHorizontalScrollBarPresent = true;
					size.Height -= ScrollBarLook.GetHorizontalScrollBarHeightResolved(scrollBarLookIfAllocated, ((UltraControlBase)this).ComponentRole);
				}
			}
		}

		private void ClearBitmapCache()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++)
			{
				if (cachedBitmaps[i] != null)
				{
					cachedBitmaps[i].Dispose();
					cachedBitmaps[i] = null;
				}
				if (cachedBitmapStreams[i] != null)
				{
					cachedBitmapStreams[i].Close();
					cachedBitmapStreams[i] = null;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void CloseAnimationContext(TileEventGroup delayedEvents)
		{
			if (currentAnimationContext != null)
			{
				currentAnimationContext.StartAnimation(delayedEvents);
				runningAnimations.Add(currentAnimationContext);
				currentAnimationContext = null;
				TimerForAnimations.Start();
			}
		}

		internal DesignerTransaction CreateTransaction()
		{
			return CreateTransaction(null);
		}

		internal DesignerTransaction CreateTransaction(string description)
		{
			IDesignerHost designerHost = ((Component)(object)this).GetService(typeof(IDesignerHost)) as IDesignerHost;
			DesignerTransaction designerTransaction = null;
			if (designerHost != null)
			{
				designerTransaction = ((description == null || description.Length <= 0) ? designerHost.CreateTransaction() : designerHost.CreateTransaction(description));
				if (designerTransaction != null)
				{
					((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyDesignEnvironmentOfChange();
				}
			}
			return designerTransaction;
		}

			DirtyControlElement(invalidate: true);
		}

		internal void DirtyControlElement(bool invalidate)
		{
			if (!preventDirtyOfControlElement)
			{
				if (controlElement != null)
				{
					((UIElement)controlElement).DirtyChildElements(invalidate);
				}
				((UIElement)TileContainerNormal.ControlUIElement).DirtyChildElements(invalidate);
				if (IsInLargeMode)
				{
					((UIElement)TileContainerLarge.ControlUIElement).DirtyChildElements(invalidate);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void FireEvent(TilePanelEventID eventId, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (!isLoading)
			{
				switch (eventId)
				{
				case TilePanelEventID.TileClosed:
					OnTileClosed((TileClosedEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TilePanelEventID.TileClosing:
					OnTileClosing((TileClosingEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TilePanelEventID.TileDragged:
					OnTileDragged((TileDraggedEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TilePanelEventID.TileDragging:
					OnTileDragging((TileDraggingEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TilePanelEventID.TileDragOverPosition:
					OnTileDragOverPosition((TileDragOverPositionEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TilePanelEventID.TileDropped:
					OnTileDropped((TileDroppedEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TilePanelEventID.TileMoved:
					OnTileMoved((TileMovedEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TilePanelEventID.TileMoving:
					OnTileMoving((TileMovingEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TilePanelEventID.TileStateChanged:
					OnTileStateChanged((TileStateChangedEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case TilePanelEventID.TileStateChanging:
					OnTileStateChanging((TileStateChangingEventArgs)e);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		internal Image GetCachedBitmap(CachedBitmapIndex index)
		{
			if (cachedBitmaps[(int)index] == null)
			{
				GetBitmap(index, out var image, out var stream);
				cachedBitmaps[(int)index] = image;
				cachedBitmapStreams[(int)index] = stream;
			}
			return cachedBitmaps[(int)index];
		}

		internal static void GetBitmap(CachedBitmapIndex index, out Image image, out Stream stream)
		{
			image = null;
			stream = null;
			string text;
			switch (index)
			{
			default:
				return;
			case CachedBitmapIndex.Close:
				text = "Close.png";
				break;
			case CachedBitmapIndex.CloseHotTrack:
				text = "CloseHotTrack.png";
				break;
			case CachedBitmapIndex.StateChangeLarge:
				text = "StateChangeLarge.png";
				break;
			case CachedBitmapIndex.StateChangeLargeHotTrack:
				text = "StateChangeLargeHotTrack.png";
				break;
			case CachedBitmapIndex.StateChangeNormal:
				text = "StateChangeNormal.png";
				break;
			case CachedBitmapIndex.StateChangeNormalHotTrack:
				text = "StateChangeNormalHotTrack.png";
				break;
			}
			text = "Infragistics.Win.Misc.TilePanel.Images." + text;
			stream = typeof(UltraTilePanel).Module.Assembly.GetManifestResourceStream(text);
			if (stream != null)
			{
				image = Image.FromStream(stream);
			}
		}

		internal Rectangle GetContainerClientRectangle(TileState state)
		{
			Rectangle containerRectangle = GetContainerRectangle(state);
			if (containerRectangle.IsEmpty)
			{
				return containerRectangle;
			}
			if (TileContainerNormal.IsFullTrust)
			{
				AreScrollBarsVisible(state, out var isHorizontalScrollBarPresent, out var isVerticalScrollBarPresent);
				ScrollBarLook scrollBarLookIfAllocated = GetScrollBarLookIfAllocated();
				if (isHorizontalScrollBarPresent)
				{
					containerRectangle.Height -= ScrollBarLook.GetHorizontalScrollBarHeightResolved(scrollBarLookIfAllocated, ((UltraControlBase)this).ComponentRole);
				}
				if (isVerticalScrollBarPresent)
				{
					int verticalScrollBarWidthResolved = ScrollBarLook.GetVerticalScrollBarWidthResolved(scrollBarLookIfAllocated, ((UltraControlBase)this).ComponentRole);
					containerRectangle.Width -= verticalScrollBarWidthResolved;
					if (((Control)(object)this).RightToLeft == RightToLeft.Yes)
					{
						containerRectangle.X += verticalScrollBarWidthResolved;
					}
				}
			}
			return containerRectangle;
		}

		internal Rectangle GetContainerRectangle(TileState state)
		{
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Rectangle clientRectangle = ((Control)this).ClientRectangle;
			UIElementBorderWidths val = DrawUtility.CalculateBorderWidths(BorderStyleResolved);
			clientRectangle.X += ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Left;
			clientRectangle.Y += ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Top;
			clientRectangle.Width -= ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Left + ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Right;
			clientRectangle.Height -= ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Top + ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Bottom;
			int val2;
			switch (LargeTilePositionResolved)
			{
			default:
				val2 = clientRectangle.Width / 2;
				break;
			case LargeTilePosition.Top:
			case LargeTilePosition.Bottom:
				val2 = clientRectangle.Height / 2;
				break;
			}
			int num = Math.Min(200, val2);
			switch (state)
			{
			default:
			{
				if (!IsInLargeMode)
				{
					return clientRectangle;
				}
				Rectangle result2 = clientRectangle;
				switch (LargeTilePositionResolved)
				{
				default:
					result2.X = clientRectangle.Right - num;
					result2.Width = num;
					break;
				case LargeTilePosition.Right:
					result2.Width = num;
					break;
				case LargeTilePosition.Top:
					result2.Y = clientRectangle.Bottom - num;
					result2.Height = num;
					break;
				case LargeTilePosition.Bottom:
					result2.Height = num;
					break;
				}
				return result2;
			}
			case TileState.Large:
			{
				if (!IsInLargeMode)
				{
					return Rectangle.Empty;
				}
				Rectangle containerRectangle = GetContainerRectangle(TileState.Normal);
				Rectangle result = clientRectangle;
				switch (LargeTilePositionResolved)
				{
				default:
					result.Width -= containerRectangle.Width;
					break;
				case LargeTilePosition.Right:
					result.X += containerRectangle.Width;
					result.Width -= containerRectangle.Width;
					break;
				case LargeTilePosition.Top:
					result.Height -= containerRectangle.Height;
					break;
				case LargeTilePosition.Bottom:
					result.Y += containerRectangle.Height;
					result.Height -= containerRectangle.Height;
					break;
				}
				return result;
			}
			}
		}

		internal void GetLogicalPositionInNormalMode(Point clientLocation, out Point position)
		{
			position = new Point(-1, -1);
			if (GetContainerClientRectangle(TileState.Normal).Contains(clientLocation))
			{
				Rectangle displayRectangle = ((Control)(object)TileContainerNormal).DisplayRectangle;
				clientLocation.Offset(-displayRectangle.X, -displayRectangle.Y);
				if (((Control)(object)this).RightToLeft == RightToLeft.Yes)
				{
					ScrollBarLook scrollBarLookIfAllocated = GetScrollBarLookIfAllocated();
					clientLocation.X -= ScrollBarLook.GetVerticalScrollBarWidthResolved(scrollBarLookIfAllocated, ((UltraControlBase)this).ComponentRole);
				}
				position.X = clientLocation.X / (LogicalCellSize.Width + 10);
				position.Y = clientLocation.Y / (LogicalCellSize.Height + 10);
				Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle(position.X * LogicalCellSize.Width + (position.X + 1) * 10, position.Y * LogicalCellSize.Height + (position.Y + 1) * 10, LogicalCellSize.Width, LogicalCellSize.Height);
				if (!rectangle.Contains(clientLocation) || NormalModeDimensions.Width <= position.X || NormalModeDimensions.Height <= position.Y)
				{
					position = new Point(-1, -1);
				}
			}
		}

		internal int GetResolvedColumnCount(TileState state)
		{
			switch (state)
			{
			default:
				if (!IsInLargeMode)
				{
					return NormalModeDimensions.Width;
				}
				if (ShouldArrangeNormalTilesVerticallyInLargeMode)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				return Tiles.GetVisibleCount(TileState.Normal);
			case TileState.Large:
				if (LargeTileOrientationResolved == TileOrientation.Vertical)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				return LargeTiles.GetVisibleCount(TileState.Large);
			}
		}

		internal int GetResolvedRowCount(TileState state)
		{
			switch (state)
			{
			default:
				if (!IsInLargeMode)
				{
					return NormalModeDimensions.Height;
				}
				if (!ShouldArrangeNormalTilesVerticallyInLargeMode)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				return Tiles.GetVisibleCount(TileState.Normal);
			case TileState.Large:
				if (LargeTileOrientationResolved == TileOrientation.Horizontal)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				return LargeTiles.GetVisibleCount(TileState.Large);
			}
		}

		internal Rectangle GetTileBoundsFromPositionInNormalMode(Point positionInNormalMode)
		{
			Rectangle displayRectangle = ((Control)(object)TileContainerNormal).DisplayRectangle;
			int x = displayRectangle.X + positionInNormalMode.X * LogicalCellSize.Width + (positionInNormalMode.X + 1) * 10;
			int y = displayRectangle.Y + positionInNormalMode.Y * LogicalCellSize.Height + (positionInNormalMode.Y + 1) * 10;
			int width = LogicalCellSize.Width + 1;
			int height = LogicalCellSize.Height + 1;
			return new Rectangle(x, y, width, height);
		}

		private static void InternalAddControl(Control parent, Control control)
		{
			Control.ControlCollection controls = parent.Controls;
			if (!(controls is UltraTilePanelControlCollection ultraTilePanelControlCollection))
			{
				controls.Add(control);
			}
			else
			{
				ultraTilePanelControlCollection.InternalAddControl(control);
			}
		}

		internal bool IsTileBeingAnimated(UltraTile tile, out AnimationManager animationManager, out ControlAnimationBase animation)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < runningAnimations.Count; i++)
			{
				AnimationManager animationManager2 = runningAnimations[i];
				if (animationManager2.IsBeingAnimated((Control)(object)tile, out animation))
				{
					animationManager = animationManager2;
					return true;
				}
			}
			animationManager = null;
			animation = null;
			return false;
		}

		internal void LayoutTiles(bool shouldAnimate, AnimationType animationType, TileEventGroup tileEvents)
		{
			if (shouldAnimate && !AnimationsEnabledResolved)
			{
				shouldAnimate = false;
			}
			if (shouldAnimate)
			{
				OpenAnimationContext(animationType);
			}
			LayoutTiles();
			if (shouldAnimate)
			{
				CloseAnimationContext(tileEvents);
			}
			else
			{
				tileEvents?.FireEvents();
			}
		}

		internal void LayoutTiles()
		{
			LayoutTiles(preventSetAutoScroll: false, honorIsUpdating: true);
		}

		internal void LayoutTiles(bool preventSetAutoScroll, bool honorIsUpdating)
		{
			if (isPerformingTileLayout || ((Control)this).IsDisposed || ((Control)this).Disposing)
			{
				return;
			}
			IDesignerHost designerHost = (IDesignerHost)((Component)(object)this).GetService(typeof(IDesignerHost));
			if (designerHost != null && designerHost.Loading)
			{
				if (!shouldLayoutAfterLoadComplete)
				{
					designerHost.LoadComplete += OnDesignerHostLoadComplete;
					shouldLayoutAfterLoadComplete = true;
				}
				return;
			}
			if (honorIsUpdating && ((UltraControlBase)this).IsUpdating)
			{
				shouldLayoutAfterUpdate = true;
				return;
			}
			if (!((Component)this).DesignMode)
			{
				VerifyTileVisibility(out var layoutPerformed);
				if (layoutPerformed)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			VerifyContainerSizes();
			try
			{
				isPerformingTileLayout = true;
				Size clientSize;
				Size size;
				do
				{
					clientSize = ((Control)(object)TileContainerNormal).ClientSize;
					size = (IsInLargeMode ? ((Control)(object)TileContainerLarge).ClientSize : Size.Empty);
					LayoutTiles(TileState.Normal, preventSetAutoScroll);
					if (IsInLargeMode)
					{
						LayoutTiles(TileState.Large, preventSetAutoScroll);
					}
					VerifyContainerSizes();
				}
				while (!(clientSize == ((Control)(object)TileContainerNormal).ClientSize) || (IsInLargeMode && !(size == ((Control)(object)TileContainerLarge).ClientSize)));
				DirtyControlElement(invalidate: false);
				DirtyDesignerGlyphs();
			}
			finally
			{
				isPerformingTileLayout = false;
			}
		}

		internal void OffsetCoordinates(Point offset)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < runningAnimations.Count; i++)
			{
				runningAnimations[i].OffsetAnimations(offset);
			}
			if (currentAnimationContext != null)
			{
				currentAnimationContext.OffsetAnimations(offset);
			}
			dropAreaBounds.Offset(offset);
			for (int j = 0; j < emptyTileAreasBounds.Count; j++)
			{
				Rectangle value = emptyTileAreasBounds[j];
				value.Offset(offset);
				emptyTileAreasBounds[j] = value;
			}
		}

		internal void OnAppStyleChanged()
		{
			StyleUtils.DirtyCachedPropertyVals((UltraControlBase)(object)this);
			SyncBackColor();
			DirtyControlElement();
			for (int i = 0; i < Tiles.Count; i++)
			{
				Tiles[i].OnAppStyleChanged();
			}
			LayoutTiles();
		}

		internal void OpenAnimationContext(AnimationType animationType)
		{
			if (currentAnimationContext == null)
			{
				currentAnimationContext = new AnimationManager(this, animationType switch
				{
					AnimationType.ModeChange => 500, 
					AnimationType.TileStateChange => 500, 
					_ => 100, 
				}, animationType, OnEndAnimation);
			}
		}

		internal void PrepareForModeChange(bool shouldAnimate)
		{
			if (shouldAnimate)
			{
				HideContainer(TileContainerNormal);
				HideContainer(TileContainerLarge);
			}
			LayoutTiles();
		}

		internal static void ReparentControl(Control control, Control oldParent, Control newParent)
		{
			if (oldParent.Controls.Contains(control))
			{
				Rectangle bounds = control.Bounds;
				Rectangle r = oldParent.RectangleToScreen(bounds);
				Rectangle bounds2 = newParent.RectangleToClient(r);
				oldParent.Controls.Remove(control);
				control.Bounds = bounds2;
				InternalAddControl(newParent, control);
			}
		}

		internal void ResolveAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearanceData, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ResolutionOrderInfo resolutionOrder = StyleUtils.GetResolutionOrder((UltraControlBase)(object)this);
			UIRole mainRole = MainRole;
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseStyleBefore && mainRole != null)
			{
				mainRole.ResolveAppearance(ref appearanceData, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
			}
			if (HasAppearance)
			{
				Appearance.MergeData(ref appearanceData, ref requestedProps);
			}
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseStyleAfter && mainRole != null)
			{
				mainRole.ResolveAppearance(ref appearanceData, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
			}
			ResolveAppearanceDefaults(ref appearanceData, ref requestedProps);
		}

		internal void ResolveDropAreaAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearanceData, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)

		internal void ResumeLargeTileCollectionSynchronization()
		{
			suspendLargeTileCollectionSynchronizationCount--;
			if (ShouldSuspendLargeTileCollectionSynchronization || ((Control)this).IsDisposed || ((Control)this).Disposing)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int num = LargeTiles.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				UltraTile tile = LargeTiles[num];
				if (!Tiles.Contains(tile))
				{
					LargeTiles.InternalRemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < Tiles.Count; i++)
			{
				UltraTile ultraTile = Tiles[i];
				if (ultraTile.State == TileState.Large && !LargeTiles.Contains(ultraTile))
				{
					int indexInLargeTileCollection = ultraTile.IndexInLargeTileCollection;
					LargeTiles.InternalInsert(LargeTiles.Count, ultraTile);
					ultraTile.IndexInLargeTileCollection = indexInLargeTileCollection;
				}
			}
			VerifyLargeTileCount(out var _);
			LargeTiles.UpdateTileIndexValues();
		}

		internal void SetTileBounds(UltraTile tile, Rectangle bounds)
		{
			Control parentTileContainer = (Control)(object)tile.ParentTileContainer;
			if (!parentTileContainer.Controls.Contains((Control)(object)tile))
			{
				Rectangle r = parentTileContainer.RectangleToScreen(bounds);
				bounds = ((Control)this).RectangleToClient(r);
			}
			if (IsTileBeingAnimated(tile, out var animationManager, out var animation))
			{
				bool flag = false;
				if (currentAnimationContext != null)
				{
					if (currentAnimationContext.AnimationType == AnimationType.ModeChange)
					{
						StopAnimatingTile(tile);
						flag = true;
					}
					else if (currentAnimationContext.AnimationType == AnimationType.TileStateChange && (animationManager.AnimationType == AnimationType.TileReposition || animationManager.AnimationType == AnimationType.TileDropped))
					{
						StopAnimatingTile(tile);
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					if (animation is BoundsAnimation boundsAnimation)
					{
						boundsAnimation.SetEndBounds(bounds);
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			if (!(((Control)(object)tile).Bounds == bounds))
			{
				if (currentAnimationContext != null)
				{
					currentAnimationContext.AddAnimation(new BoundsAnimation((Control)(object)tile, bounds));
				}
				else
				{
					((Control)(object)tile).Bounds = bounds;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void StopAnimatingTile(UltraTile tile)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < runningAnimations.Count; i++)
			{
				if (runningAnimations[i].IsBeingAnimated((Control)(object)tile, out var _))
				{
					runningAnimations[i].StopAnimatingControl((Control)(object)tile);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void SuspendLargeTileCollectionSynchronization()
		{
			suspendLargeTileCollectionSynchronizationCount++;
		}

		internal UltraTile TileFromPointInNormalMode(Point clientLocation)
		{
			GetLogicalPositionInNormalMode(clientLocation, out var position);
			if (position.X < 0 || position.Y < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return TileFromPositionInNormalMode(position);
		}

		internal void VerifyContainerSizes()
		{
			TileContainerNormal.VerifyBounds();
			if (IsInLargeMode)
			{
				TileContainerLarge.VerifyBounds();
			}
		}

		internal void VerifyLargeTileVisibility()
		{
			if (((UltraControlBase)this).IsUpdating)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (IsInLargeMode)
			{
				if ((currentAnimationContext == null || currentAnimationContext.AnimationType != AnimationType.ModeChange) && !IsInModeChangeOperation)
				{
					TileContainerLarge.Visible = true;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				TileContainerLarge.Visible = false;
			}
		}

		internal void VerifyLargeTileCount(out bool countReduced)
		{
			countReduced = false;
			if (!ShouldSuspendLargeTileCollectionSynchronization)
			{
				int maximumVisibleLargeTilesResolved = MaximumVisibleLargeTilesResolved;
				int extraTiles = LargeTiles.GetVisibleCount() - maximumVisibleLargeTilesResolved;
				if (extraTiles > 0)
				{
					countReduced = true;
					((UltraControlBase)this).BeginUpdate();
					ReduceLargeTiles(ref extraTiles, forceStateChanges: false);
					ReduceLargeTiles(ref extraTiles, forceStateChanges: true);
					((UltraControlBase)this).EndUpdate();
				}
			}
		}

		private void VerifyTileVisibility(out bool layoutPerformed)
		{
			layoutPerformed = false;
			if (isVerifyingTileVisibility)
			{
				return;
			}
			isVerifyingTileVisibility = true;
			bool flag = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < Tiles.Count; i++)
			{
				UltraTile ultraTile = Tiles[i];
				if (ultraTile.VisibleInternal && ultraTile.Control == null)
				{
					((Control)(object)ultraTile).Visible = false;
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				VerifyLargeTileCount(out layoutPerformed);
			}
			isVerifyingTileVisibility = false;
		}

		private void CalculationNormalModeDimensions(List<UltraTile> visibleTiles)
		{
			int val = MinimumColumns;
			int num = MaximumColumns;
			if (num == 0)
			{
				num = int.MaxValue;
			}
			int num2 = MinimumRows;
			int num3 = MaximumRows;
			if (num3 == 0)
			{
				num3 = int.MaxValue;
			}
			double a = Math.Sqrt(visibleTiles.Count);
			int val2 = (int)Math.Ceiling(a);
			int val3 = (int)Math.Ceiling((double)visibleTiles.Count / (double)num3);
			int val4 = int.MaxValue;
			if (0 < num2)
			{
				val4 = (int)Math.Max(1.0, Math.Ceiling((double)visibleTiles.Count / (double)num2));
			}
			int val5 = Math.Max(val, Math.Min(val3, num));
			int val6 = Math.Max(val, Math.Min(val4, num));
			int num4 = Math.Max(val5, Math.Min(val2, val6));
			int val7 = (visibleTiles.Count - 1) / num4 + 1;
			int height = Math.Max(num2, val7);
			normalModeDimensions = new Size(num4, height);
			for (int i = 0; i < visibleTiles.Count; i++)
			{
				UltraTile ultraTile = visibleTiles[i];
				if (NormalModeDimensions.Width <= ultraTile.PositionInNormalMode.X || NormalModeDimensions.Height <= ultraTile.PositionInNormalMode.Y)
				{
					ultraTile.ResetPosition();
				}
			}
		}

		private void LayoutTiles(TileState state, bool preventSetAutoScroll)
		{
			GridLayoutManager layoutManager = GetLayoutManager(state);
			if (state == TileState.Normal)
			{
				for (int num = ((LayoutManagerBase)layoutManager).LayoutItems.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					if (((LayoutManagerBase)layoutManager).LayoutItems[num] is EmptyTileAreaLayoutItem)
					{
						((LayoutManagerBase)layoutManager).LayoutItems.RemoveAt(num);
					}
				}
				DropAreaBounds = Rectangle.Empty;
				EmptyTileAreasBounds.Clear();
			}
			Size oldNormalModeDimensions = NormalModeDimensions;
			TileCollectionBase tileCollectionBase = ((state == TileState.Normal) ? ((TileCollectionBase)Tiles) : ((TileCollectionBase)LargeTiles));
			List<UltraTile> list = new List<UltraTile>();
			for (int i = 0; i < tileCollectionBase.Count; i++)
			{
				UltraTile ultraTile = tileCollectionBase[i];
				if (ultraTile.VisibleInternal && ultraTile.State == state)
				{
					list.Add(ultraTile);
				}
			}
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				if (state == TileState.Normal)
				{
					normalModeDimensions = Size.Empty;
				}
				return;
			}
			if (state == TileState.Normal && !IsInLargeMode)
			{
				if (list.Count > 1)
				{
					list.Sort(UltraTile.NormalModeTileComparer.Instance);
				}
				CalculationNormalModeDimensions(list);
				lastValidNormalModeDimensions = NormalModeDimensions;
				ResetTilePositionsIfDimensionsChanged(oldNormalModeDimensions);
				Dictionary<ILayoutItem, object> dictionary = PositionVisibleTilesInNormalMode(list);
				foreach (KeyValuePair<ILayoutItem, object> item in dictionary)
				{
					((LayoutManagerBase)layoutManager).LayoutItems.Add(item.Key, item.Value);
				}
			}
			TileContainerPanel tileContainer = GetTileContainer(state);
			ILayoutContainer layoutContainer = GetLayoutContainer(state);
			int resolvedColumnCount = GetResolvedColumnCount(state);
			int resolvedRowCount = GetResolvedRowCount(state);
			layoutManager.ColumnCount = resolvedColumnCount;
			layoutManager.RowCount = resolvedRowCount;
			Rectangle bounds = layoutContainer.GetBounds((object)null);
			layoutManager.GetCellDimensions(bounds, out var actualColumnWidth, out var actualRowHeight);
			layoutManager.ActualColumnWidth = actualColumnWidth;
			layoutManager.ActualRowHeight = actualRowHeight;
			Size size = new Size((int)actualColumnWidth, (int)actualRowHeight);
			int num2 = resolvedColumnCount * size.Width + (resolvedColumnCount + 1) * 10;
			int num3 = resolvedRowCount * size.Height + (resolvedRowCount + 1) * 10;
			Size autoScrollMinSize = new Size(num2, num3);
			AreScrollBarsVisible(state, out var isHorizontalScrollBarPresent, out var isVerticalScrollBarPresent);
			if (!preventSetAutoScroll && (isHorizontalScrollBarPresent || isVerticalScrollBarPresent))
			{
				Point autoScrollPosition = ((ScrollableControl)(object)tileContainer).AutoScrollPosition;
				autoScrollPosition.X *= -1;
				autoScrollPosition.Y *= -1;
				Size clientSize = ((Control)(object)tileContainer).ClientSize;
				bool flag = false;
				if (autoScrollPosition.X + clientSize.Width > num2)
				{
					autoScrollPosition.X = Math.Max(0, num2 - clientSize.Width);
					tileContainer.HorizontalScrollValue = autoScrollPosition.X;
					flag = true;
				}
				if (autoScrollPosition.Y + clientSize.Height > num3)
				{
					autoScrollPosition.Y = Math.Max(0, num3 - clientSize.Height);
					tileContainer.VerticalScrollValue = autoScrollPosition.Y;
					flag = true;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					((Control)(object)tileContainer).SuspendLayout();
					Dictionary<Control, Rectangle> dictionary2 = new Dictionary<Control, Rectangle>();
					foreach (Control control3 in tileContainer.Controls)
					{
						dictionary2[control3] = ((Control)(object)tileContainer).RectangleToScreen(control3.Bounds);
					}
					((ScrollableControl)(object)tileContainer).AutoScrollPosition = autoScrollPosition;
					foreach (Control control4 in tileContainer.Controls)
					{
						control4.Bounds = ((Control)(object)tileContainer).RectangleToClient(dictionary2[control4]);
					}
					((Control)(object)tileContainer).ResumeLayout(performLayout: false);
				}
			}
			if (!isHorizontalScrollBarPresent && !isVerticalScrollBarPresent)
			{
				tileContainer.InternalSetAutoScroll(autoScrollValue: false);
			}
			((Control)(object)tileContainer).SuspendLayout();
			((LayoutManagerBase)layoutManager).LayoutContainer(layoutContainer, (object)null);
			((Control)(object)tileContainer).ResumeLayout(performLayout: false);
			if (!preventSetAutoScroll && (isHorizontalScrollBarPresent || isVerticalScrollBarPresent))
			{
				tileContainer.InternalSetAutoScroll(autoScrollValue: true);
				tileContainer.InternalSetAutoScrollMinSize(autoScrollMinSize);
				tileContainer.InternalAdjustFormScrollbars(enable: true);
			}
		}

		private void LoadHelper(Stream stream, bool loadAsBinary)
		{
			((Control)this).SuspendLayout();
			((UltraControlBase)this).BeginUpdate();
			bool designerChangeNotificationsDisabled = ((UltraControlBase)this).DesignerChangeNotificationsDisabled;
			((UltraControlBase)this).DesignerChangeNotificationsDisabled = true;
			try
			{
				isLoading = true;
				List<Control> list = new List<Control>();
				for (int i = 0; i < Tiles.Count; i++)
				{
					UltraTile ultraTile = Tiles[i];
					if (ultraTile != null && ultraTile.Control != null)
					{
						ultraTile.DeserializaedControlName = ultraTile.Control.Name;
						list.Add(ultraTile.Control);
						ultraTile.Control = null;
					}
				}
				IFormatter formatter;
				if (loadAsBinary)
				{
					BinaryFormatter binaryFormatter = new BinaryFormatter();
					binaryFormatter.AssemblyFormat = FormatterAssemblyStyle.Simple;
					formatter = binaryFormatter;
				}
				else
				{
					SoapFormatter soapFormatter = new SoapFormatter();
					soapFormatter.AssemblyFormat = FormatterAssemblyStyle.Simple;
					formatter = soapFormatter;
				}
				formatter.Binder = (SerializationBinder)(object)new Infragistics.Win.Misc.Serialization.Binder();
				UltraTilePanelStreamer ultraTilePanelStreamer;
				try
				{
					ultraTilePanelStreamer = formatter.Deserialize(stream) as UltraTilePanelStreamer;
				}
				catch (Exception innerException)
				{
					throw new ApplicationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DeserializationError"), innerException);
				}
				if (ultraTilePanelStreamer != null)
				{
					InitializeFrom(ultraTilePanelStreamer);
				}
				HookupDeserializedObjects(list);
				for (int j = 0; j < list.Count; j++)
				{
					Control control = list[j];
					control.Visible = false;
					TileContainerNormal.Controls.Add(control);
				}
				StyleUtils.DirtyCachedPropertyVals((UltraControlBase)(object)this);
				DirtyControlElement();
			}
			finally
			{
				isLoading = false;
				((UltraControlBase)this).EndUpdate();
				((Control)this).ResumeLayout(performLayout: true);
				((UltraControlBase)this).DesignerChangeNotificationsDisabled = designerChangeNotificationsDisabled;
			}
		}

				LayoutTiles();

		private void OnEndAnimation(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			AnimationManager animationManager = (AnimationManager)sender;
			switch (animationManager.AnimationType)
			{
			case AnimationType.ModeChange:
				ShowContainer(TileContainerNormal);
				if (IsInLargeMode)
				{
					ShowContainer(TileContainerLarge);
				}
				break;
			case AnimationType.TileStateChange:
				foreach (Control control in animationManager.GetControls())
				{
					if (((Control)this).Controls.Contains(control) && control is UltraTile ultraTile)
					{
						ReparentControl((Control)(object)ultraTile, (Control)(object)this, (Control)(object)ultraTile.ParentTileContainer);
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			animationManager.Dispose();
			runningAnimations.Remove(animationManager);
			if (runningAnimations.Count == 0)
			{
				TimerForAnimations.Stop();
			}
		}
