		private Dictionary<ILayoutItem, object> PositionVisibleTilesInNormalMode(List<UltraTile> visibleTiles)
		{
			Dictionary<ILayoutItem, object> dictionary = new Dictionary<ILayoutItem, object>();
			bool[,] array = new bool[NormalModeDimensions.Width, NormalModeDimensions.Height];
			for (int i = 0; i < visibleTiles.Count; i++)
			{
				UltraTile ultraTile = visibleTiles[i];
				if (ultraTile.IsPositionValid)
				{
					if (ultraTile.IsDragging)
					{
						dictionary.Add((ILayoutItem)(object)new EmptyTileAreaLayoutItem(isDropArea: true), new EmptyTileAreaLayoutConstraint(ultraTile.PositionInNormalMode));
					}
					array[ultraTile.PositionInNormalMode.X, ultraTile.PositionInNormalMode.Y] = true;
				}
			}
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			for (int j = 0; j < visibleTiles.Count; j++)
			{
				UltraTile ultraTile2 = visibleTiles[j];
				if (!ultraTile2.IsPositionValid)
				{
					if (num == NormalModeDimensions.Width)
					{
						num = 0;
						num2++;
					}
					if (!array[num, num2])
					{
						ultraTile2.InternalSetPositionInNormalMode(new Point(num, num2));
						array[num, num2] = true;
					}
					else
					{
						j--;
					}
					num++;
				}
			}
			for (num2 = 0; num2 < NormalModeDimensions.Height; num2++)
			{
				for (num = 0; num < NormalModeDimensions.Width; num++)
				{
					if (!array[num, num2])
					{
						dictionary.Add((ILayoutItem)(object)new EmptyTileAreaLayoutItem(), new EmptyTileAreaLayoutConstraint(new Point(num, num2)));
					}
				}
			}
			return dictionary;
		}

		private void ReduceLargeTiles(ref int extraTiles, bool forceStateChanges)
		{
			int num = 0;
			while (0 < extraTiles && num < LargeTiles.Count)
			{
				UltraTile ultraTile = LargeTiles[num];
				if (ultraTile.VisibleInternal && ultraTile.SetStateHelper(TileState.Normal, "value", shouldAnimate: true, forceStateChanges, (UIAction)0))
				{
					num--;
					extraTiles--;
				}
				num++;
			}
		}

		private void ResetTilePositionsIfDimensionsChanged(Size oldNormalModeDimensions)
		{
			if (oldNormalModeDimensions.IsEmpty)
			{
				oldNormalModeDimensions = lastValidNormalModeDimensions;
			}
			if (NormalModeDimensions != oldNormalModeDimensions)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < Tiles.Count; i++)
				{
					Tiles[i].ResetPosition();
				}
			}
		}

		private void SaveHelper(Stream stream, bool saveAsBinary)
		{
			IFormatter formatter;
			if (saveAsBinary)
			{
				BinaryFormatter binaryFormatter = new BinaryFormatter(null, new StreamingContext(StreamingContextStates.Persistence));
				binaryFormatter.AssemblyFormat = FormatterAssemblyStyle.Simple;
				formatter = binaryFormatter;
			}
			else
			{
				SoapFormatter soapFormatter = new SoapFormatter(null, new StreamingContext(StreamingContextStates.Persistence));
				soapFormatter.AssemblyFormat = FormatterAssemblyStyle.Simple;
				formatter = soapFormatter;
			}
			try
			{
				UltraTilePanelStreamer graph = new UltraTilePanelStreamer(this);
				formatter.Serialize(stream, graph);
			}
			catch (Exception innerException)
			{
				throw new ApplicationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("SerializationError"), innerException);
			}
		}

		private ScrollBarUIElement ScrollBarElementFromPoint(Point location)
		{
			//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0028: Expected O, but got Unknown
			UIElement val = ((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).ElementFromPoint(location);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return (ScrollBarUIElement)val.GetAncestor(typeof(ScrollBarUIElement));
		}

		private void ScrollToRelativePosition(AutoScrollBarInfo scrollBarInfo, int newRelativePosition, int trackRelativeExtent, int thumbRelativeExtent)
		{
			int num = ((ScrollBarInfo)scrollBarInfo).Maximum - ((ScrollBarInfo)scrollBarInfo).Minimum;
			float num2 = (float)num / (float)trackRelativeExtent;
			int num3 = newRelativePosition - thumbRelativeExtent / 2;
			int value = (int)(num2 * (float)num3);
			SetScrollValue(scrollBarInfo, value);
		}

		private static void SetScrollValue(AutoScrollBarInfo scrollBarInfo, int value)
		{
			value = Math.Max(((ScrollBarInfo)scrollBarInfo).Minimum, Math.Min(value, ((ScrollBarInfo)scrollBarInfo).Maximum));
			scrollBarInfo.InternalOnScroll(new ScrollEventArgs(ScrollEventType.ThumbPosition, value));
		}

				}
			}
			panel.Visible = true;
			((Control)(object)panel).Update();
		}

			TileContainerNormal.InternalSetBackColor(color);
			TileContainerLarge.InternalSetBackColor(color);
		}

		private void DirtyTiles()
		{
			foreach (UltraTile tile in Tiles)

				tile.DirtyControlElement();

	public class UltraTilePanelControlUIElement : AutoScrollControlUIElement
	{
		private UltraTilePanel tilePanel;

		public override UIElementBorderStyle BorderStyle => tilePanel.BorderStyleResolved;

		public override UIRole UIRole => tilePanel.MainRole;

		public UltraTilePanelControlUIElement(UltraTilePanel tilePanel)
			: base((Control)(object)tilePanel, (IUltraControl)(object)tilePanel)
		{
			this.tilePanel = tilePanel;
		}

		protected override void DrawBackColor(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			((UIElement)this).DrawBackColor(ref drawParams);
		}

		protected override void InitAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			tilePanel.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			((ControlUIElementBase)this).InitAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
		}

		protected override void OnAfterDraw(ref UIElementDrawParams defaultDrawParams)
		{
			((UIElement)this).OnAfterDraw(ref defaultDrawParams);
			if (!tilePanel.IsInModeChangeOperation)
			{
				return;
			}
			TileCollection tiles = tilePanel.Tiles;
			for (int i = 0; i < tiles.Count; i++)
			{
				UltraTile ultraTile = tiles[i];
				if (((Control)(object)ultraTile).Visible && ultraTile.SettingsResolved.ShowTileShadow && ((Control)(object)ultraTile).Bounds.IntersectsWith(((Control)(object)tilePanel).ClientRectangle))
				{
					DrawUtility.DrawBorderShadow(((UIElementDrawParams)(ref defaultDrawParams)).Graphics, ((UIElementDrawParams)(ref defaultDrawParams)).InvalidRect, ((Control)(object)ultraTile).Bounds, Color.Black, (byte)128, (byte)0, (byte)4);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void PositionChildElements()
		{
			UIElementsCollection childElementsCollection = ((UIElement)this).childElementsCollection;
			((UIElement)this).childElementsCollection = null;
			try
			{
				PositionContainerScrollbars(TileState.Normal, childElementsCollection);
				PositionContainerScrollbars(TileState.Large, childElementsCollection);
			}
			finally
			{
				if (childElementsCollection != null)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < ((ArrayList)(object)childElementsCollection).Count; i++)
					{
						((DisposableObject)(object)childElementsCollection[i])?.Dispose();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void PositionContainerScrollbars(TileState state, UIElementsCollection oldElements)
		{
			TileContainerPanel tileContainer = tilePanel.GetTileContainer(state);
			if (!tileContainer.IsFullTrust || !tileContainer.Visible)
			{
				return;
			}
			Rectangle workRect = tilePanel.GetContainerRectangle(state);
			if (!tilePanel.ShouldDisplayCustomScrollbars)
			{
				tileContainer.InternalSetSize(workRect.Size);
				return;
			}
			bool preventDirtyOfControlElement = tilePanel.PreventDirtyOfControlElement;
			try
			{
				tilePanel.PreventDirtyOfControlElement = true;
				tilePanel.AreScrollBarsVisible(state, out var isHorizontalScrollBarPresent, out var isVerticalScrollBarPresent);
				PositionScrollBars(tileContainer, ref workRect, isVerticalScrollBarPresent, isHorizontalScrollBarPresent, oldElements);
				tileContainer.InternalSetLocation(workRect.Location);
			}
			finally
			{
				tilePanel.PreventDirtyOfControlElement = preventDirtyOfControlElement;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class TileLayoutContainer : ILayoutContainer
	{
		private TileState state;

		private UltraTilePanel tilePanel;

		public TileLayoutContainer(UltraTilePanel tilePanel, TileState state)
		{
			this.tilePanel = tilePanel;
			this.state = state;
		}

		Rectangle ILayoutContainer.GetBounds(object containerContext)
		{
			Control tileContainer = (Control)(object)tilePanel.GetTileContainer(state);
			return new Rectangle(tileContainer.DisplayRectangle.Location, tileContainer.ClientSize);
		}

		void ILayoutContainer.PositionItem(ILayoutItem item, Rectangle rect, object containerContext)
		{
			if (item is EmptyTileAreaLayoutItem emptyTileAreaLayoutItem)
			{
				if (emptyTileAreaLayoutItem.IsDropArea)
				{
					tilePanel.DropAreaBounds = rect;
				}
				else
				{
					tilePanel.EmptyTileAreasBounds.Add(rect);
				}
			}
			else if (item is TileLayoutItem tileLayoutItem)
			{
				tilePanel.LogicalCellSize = rect.Size;
				Size maximumSize = tileLayoutItem.Tile.SettingsResolved.MaximumSize;
				if (0 < maximumSize.Width && maximumSize.Width < rect.Width)
				{
					rect.X += (rect.Width - maximumSize.Width) / 2;
					rect.Width = maximumSize.Width;
				}
				if (0 < maximumSize.Height && maximumSize.Height < rect.Height)
				{
					rect.Y += (rect.Height - maximumSize.Height) / 2;
					rect.Height = maximumSize.Height;
				}
				tilePanel.SetTileBounds(tileLayoutItem.Tile, rect);
			}
		}
	}
	[Serializable]
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
	public sealed class UltraTilePanelStreamer : ISerializable
	{
		private UltraTilePanel tilePanel;

		internal bool animationsEnabled = true;

		internal AppearancesCollection appearances;

		internal AppearancesManager appearancesManager;

		internal Color backColorInternal = UltraTilePanel.DefaultBackColorInternal;

		internal UIElementBorderStyle borderStyle;

	public class UltraTileControlUIElement : ControlUIElementBase
	{
		private UltraTile tile;

		public override UIElementBorderStyle BorderStyle => tile.SettingsResolved.BorderStyle;

		public override UIRole UIRole => tile.MainRole;

		public UltraTileControlUIElement(UltraTile tile)
			: base((Control)(object)tile, (IUltraControl)(((object)tile.Owner) ?? ((object)tile)))
		{
			this.tile = tile;
		}

		protected override void InitAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			tile.SettingsResolved.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			((ControlUIElementBase)this).InitAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
		}

		protected override void PositionChildElements()
		{
			UIElementsCollection childElementsCollection = ((UIElement)this).childElementsCollection;
			((UIElement)this).childElementsCollection = null;
			Rectangle rectInsideBorders = ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders;
			TileHeaderPosition headerPosition = tile.SettingsResolved.HeaderPosition;
			if (headerPosition != TileHeaderPosition.Hidden)
			{
				TileHeaderUIElement tileHeaderUIElement = (TileHeaderUIElement)UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)childElementsCollection, typeof(TileHeaderUIElement), true);
				if (tileHeaderUIElement == null)
				{
					tileHeaderUIElement = new TileHeaderUIElement((UIElement)(object)this);
				}
				int headerExtent = tile.SettingsResolved.HeaderExtent;
				Rectangle rect = rectInsideBorders;
				switch (headerPosition)
				{
				case TileHeaderPosition.Top:
					rect.Height = headerExtent;
					rectInsideBorders.Y += headerExtent;
					rectInsideBorders.Height -= headerExtent;
					break;
				case TileHeaderPosition.Bottom:
					rect.Y = rect.Bottom - headerExtent;
					rect.Height = headerExtent;
					rectInsideBorders.Height -= headerExtent;
					break;
				}
				((UIElement)tileHeaderUIElement).Rect = rect;
				((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)tileHeaderUIElement);
			}
		}

namespace Infragistics.Win.Misc.UltraWinNavigationBar
{
	internal class LocationExpansionManager
	{
		private UltraNavigationBar navigationBar;

		private EventHandler closeUpHandler;

		internal static LocationListItemUIElement hotTrackingItem;

		private bool isInCloseDropDown;

		private UltraNavigationBarLocation lastExpandedLocation;

		public EventHandler CloseUpHandler
		{
			get
			{
				if (closeUpHandler == null)
				{
					closeUpHandler = OnCloseUp;
				}
				return closeUpHandler;
			}
		}

		public UltraNavigationBarLocation ExpandedLocation
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsExpanded())
				{
					return null;
				}
				return navigationBar.LocationsDropDownListControl.ParentLocation;
			}
		}

		public LocationExpansionManager(UltraNavigationBar navigationBar)
		{
			this.navigationBar = navigationBar;
		}

		private void OnCloseUp(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			CloseDropDown(closeDropDownManager: false);
		}

		public bool ExpandLocation(UltraNavigationBarLocation parentLocation)
		{
			if (parentLocation == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("parentLocation");
			}
			LocationUIElement uIElement = parentLocation.UIElement;
			if (uIElement == null)
			{
				navigationBar.SetSelectedLocationHelper(parentLocation, SelectedLocationChangeKind.Expanded, fireEvents: true, notifyPropChange: true);
				uIElement = parentLocation.UIElement;
			}
			if (uIElement == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return ExpandLocation(parentLocation, uIElement.DropDownLocation);
		}

		public bool ExpandLocation(UltraNavigationBarLocation parentLocation, Point screenLocation)
		{
			//IL_00b4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (parentLocation == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("parentLocation");
			}
			if (ExpandedLocation == parentLocation)
			{
				return true;
			}
			navigationBar.SetActiveLocationHelper(null, fireEvents: true, notifyPropChange: true);
			LocationUIElement.ClearHighlightedLocation();
			LocationExpandingEventArgs e = new LocationExpandingEventArgs(parentLocation);
			navigationBar.EventManager.FireEvent(UltraNavigationBarEventIds.LocationExpanding, e);
			if (e.Cancel)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (IsExpanded())
			{
				Collapse();
			}
			if (!parentLocation.HasLocations || parentLocation.Locations.VisibleCountForDropDownList == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			NavigationBarMetrics metrics = navigationBar.Metrics;
			UltraLocationsDropDownListControl locationsDropDownListControl = navigationBar.GetLocationsDropDownListControl(parentLocation);
			Size locationsDropDownListSize = metrics.GetLocationsDropDownListSize(parentLocation);
			DropDownManagerParameters val = default(DropDownManagerParameters);
			((DropDownManagerParameters)(ref val))..ctor((Control)(object)navigationBar, (Control)(object)locationsDropDownListControl, (Control)null, CloseUpHandler, Rectangle.Empty, locationsDropDownListSize, screenLocation, false);
			DropDownManager.DropDown(val);
			bool flag = (object)DropDownManager.GetCurrentDropDownControl((Control)(object)navigationBar) == locationsDropDownListControl;
			if (flag)
			{
				lastExpandedLocation = parentLocation;
				locationsDropDownListControl.ShowShadows();
				((UIElement)navigationBar.UIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
				LocationExpandedEventArgs e2 = new LocationExpandedEventArgs(parentLocation);
				navigationBar.EventManager.FireEvent(UltraNavigationBarEventIds.LocationExpanded, e2);
				navigationBar.NotifyExpandedLocationChanged();
			}
			return flag;
		}

		public bool IsExpanded(UltraNavigationBarLocation location)
		{
			if (location != null)
			{
				return ExpandedLocation == location;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool IsExpanded()
		{
			UltraLocationsDropDownListControl locationsDropDownListControl = navigationBar.LocationsDropDownListControl;
			if (locationsDropDownListControl != null)
			{
				return (object)DropDownManager.GetCurrentDropDownControl((Control)(object)navigationBar) == locationsDropDownListControl;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (IsExpanded())
			{
				DropDownManager.CloseDropDown((Control)(object)navigationBar);
			}
		}

		public void Collapse()
		{
			if (IsExpanded())
			{
				CloseDropDown(closeDropDownManager: true);
			}
			navigationBar.SetActiveLocationHelper(null, fireEvents: true, notifyPropChange: true);
		}

		public void CloseDropDown(bool closeDropDownManager)
		{
			if (isInCloseDropDown)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				isInCloseDropDown = true;
				if (closeDropDownManager)
				{
					DropDownManager.CloseDropDown((Control)(object)navigationBar);
				}
				UltraLocationsDropDownListControl locationsDropDownListControl = navigationBar.LocationsDropDownListControl;
				locationsDropDownListControl.SetParentLocation(null);
				((UIElement)navigationBar.UIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
				LocationCollapsedEventArgs e = new LocationCollapsedEventArgs(lastExpandedLocation);
				navigationBar.EventManager.FireEvent(UltraNavigationBarEventIds.LocationCollapsed, e);
				navigationBar.NotifyExpandedLocationChanged();
			}
			finally
			{
				lastExpandedLocation = null;
				isInCloseDropDown = false;

	internal class LocationsListScrollManager
	{
		private UltraLocationsDropDownListControl listControl;

		private ScrollBarInfo vScrollBar;

		internal ScrollBarInfo VScrollBarInfo
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_002a: Expected O, but got Unknown
				if (vScrollBar == null)
				{
					vScrollBar = new ScrollBarInfo((Control)(object)listControl, Orientation.Vertical, listControl.NavigationBar.Appearances);
					vScrollBar.Scroll += OnVerticalScroll;
					vScrollBar.ValueChanged += OnScrollValueChanged;
				}
				return vScrollBar;
			}
		}

		internal bool HasScrollBarInfo => vScrollBar != null;

		internal int ScrollPosition => VScrollBarInfo.Value;

		internal LocationsListScrollManager(UltraLocationsDropDownListControl listControl)
		{
			this.listControl = listControl;
			Initialize(recalculateMetrics: true);
		}

		internal void Initialize(bool recalculateMetrics)
		{
			VScrollBarInfo.Value = 0;
			if (recalculateMetrics)
			{
				RecalculateMetrics();
			}
		}

		private void RecalculateMetrics()
		{
			UltraNavigationBarLocation parentLocation = listControl.ParentLocation;
			if (parentLocation != null)
			{
				int visibleCountForDropDownList = parentLocation.Locations.VisibleCountForDropDownList;
				int maximumDropDownItemsResolved = parentLocation.MaximumDropDownItemsResolved;
				ScrollBarInfo vScrollBarInfo = VScrollBarInfo;
				vScrollBarInfo.Minimum = 0;
				vScrollBarInfo.SmallChange = 1;
				vScrollBarInfo.Maximum = Math.Max(1, visibleCountForDropDownList - 1);
				vScrollBarInfo.LargeChange = maximumDropDownItemsResolved;
			}
		}

		private void OnVerticalScroll(object sender, ScrollEventArgs args)
		{
			int value = args.NewValue;
			VerifyScrollValue(ref value);
			args.NewValue = value;
			DirtyControlElement();
		}

		private void OnScrollValueChanged(object sender, EventArgs args)
		{
			DirtyControlElement();
		}

		private void VerifyScrollValue(ref int value)
		{
			ScrollBarInfo vScrollBarInfo = VScrollBarInfo;
			value = Math.Min(value, vScrollBarInfo.MaximumDragValue);
			value = Math.Max(value, vScrollBarInfo.Minimum);
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (vScrollBar != null)
			{
				vScrollBar.Scroll -= OnVerticalScroll;
				vScrollBar.ValueChanged -= OnScrollValueChanged;
				((DisposableObject)(object)vScrollBar).Dispose();
				vScrollBar = null;
			}
		}

		public void Scroll(int scrollPosition)
		{
			VerifyScrollValue(ref scrollPosition);
			VScrollBarInfo.Value = scrollPosition;
		}

		public void Scroll(ScrollEventType scrollEventType)
		{
			int value = ScrollPosition;
			switch (scrollEventType)
			{
			case ScrollEventType.SmallIncrement:
				value++;
				break;
			case ScrollEventType.SmallDecrement:
				value--;
				break;
			case ScrollEventType.LargeIncrement:
				value += VScrollBarInfo.LargeChange;
				break;
			case ScrollEventType.LargeDecrement:
				value -= VScrollBarInfo.LargeChange;
				break;
			case ScrollEventType.First:
				value = VScrollBarInfo.Minimum;
				break;
			case ScrollEventType.Last:
				value = VScrollBarInfo.MaximumDragValue;
				break;
			}
			VerifyScrollValue(ref value);
			VScrollBarInfo.Value = value;
		}

		private void DirtyControlElement()
		{
			UIElement uIElement = (UIElement)(object)listControl.UIElement;
			uIElement.DirtyChildElements(false);
			uIElement.VerifyChildElements(true);
			((Control)(object)listControl).Refresh();
		}
	}

		private void HookEditorWithComboEvents(bool hook)
		{
			if (hook)
			{
				((EmbeddableEditorBase)editorWithCombo).BeforeDropDown += OnBeforeDropDown;
				((EmbeddableEditorBase)editorWithCombo).AfterCloseUp += OnAfterCloseUp;
				editorWithCombo.SelectionChangeCommitted += OnSelectionChangeCommitted;
			}
			else
			{
				((EmbeddableEditorBase)editorWithCombo).BeforeDropDown -= OnBeforeDropDown;
				((EmbeddableEditorBase)editorWithCombo).AfterCloseUp -= OnAfterCloseUp;
				editorWithCombo.SelectionChangeCommitted -= OnSelectionChangeCommitted;
			}
		}

		internal void HookEditorEvents(EmbeddableEditorBase editor, bool hook)
		{
			//IL_00c7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00d1: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0036: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0040: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (editor != null)
			{
				if (hook)
				{
					editor.BeforeEnterEditMode += OnBeforeEnterEditMode;
					editor.AfterEnterEditMode += OnAfterEnterEditMode;
					editor.BeforeExitEditMode += new BeforeExitEditModeEventHandler(OnBeforeExitEditMode);
					editor.AfterExitEditMode += OnAfterExitEditMode;
					editor.KeyDown += OnKeyDown;
					editor.KeyPress += OnKeyPress;
					editor.KeyUp += OnKeyUp;
					editor.ValueChanged += OnValueChanged;
				}
				else
				{
					editor.BeforeEnterEditMode -= OnBeforeEnterEditMode;
					editor.AfterEnterEditMode -= OnAfterEnterEditMode;
					editor.BeforeExitEditMode -= new BeforeExitEditModeEventHandler(OnBeforeExitEditMode);
					editor.AfterExitEditMode -= OnAfterExitEditMode;
					editor.KeyDown -= OnKeyDown;
					editor.KeyPress -= OnKeyPress;
					editor.KeyUp -= OnKeyUp;
					editor.ValueChanged -= OnValueChanged;
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnBeforeDropDown(object sender, CancelEventArgs e)
		{
			ValueList val = ValueList;
			val.DropDownListWidth = navigationBar.Metrics.PreviousLocationsDropDownListWidth;
			val.MaxDropDownItems = navigationBar.PreviousLocationsMaxDropDownItems;
			navigationBar.PreviousLocations.PopulateValueList(val, ref previousLocationsCollectionVersion);
			if (((DisposableObjectCollectionBase)(object)val.ValueListItems).Count == 0)
			{
				e.Cancel = true;
			}
		}

		private void OnAfterCloseUp(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			navigationBar.RefreshPreviousLocationsDropDownButton();
		}

		private void OnSelectionChangeCommitted(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			EmbeddableEditorBase val = (EmbeddableEditorBase)((sender is EmbeddableEditorBase) ? sender : null);
			if (val != null && val.IsDroppedDown)
			{
				EndEdit(forceExit: false, applyChanges: true);
			}
		}

		}

		internal void OnKeyUp(object sender, KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			navigationBar.InternalOnKeyUp(e);
		}

		private void OnValueChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
		}

		internal void OnBeforeEnterEditMode(object sender, CancelEventArgs e)
		{
			EmbeddableEditorBase editor = (EmbeddableEditorBase)((sender is EmbeddableEditorBase) ? sender : null);
			navigationBar.ExpansionManager.Collapse();
			string fullPath = navigationBar.SelectedLocation.GetFullPath(FullPathFormat.EditMode);
			CancelableEditModeEventArgs e2 = new CancelableEditModeEventArgs(fullPath, editor);
			navigationBar.EventManager.FireEvent(UltraNavigationBarEventIds.EnteringEditMode, e2);
			e.Cancel = e2.Cancel;
			if (!e.Cancel)
			{
				editModeNavigationPath = e2.NavigationPath;
			}
			else
			{
				HookEditorEvents(editor, hook: false);
			}
		}

		internal void OnAfterEnterEditMode(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			EmbeddableEditorBase val = (EmbeddableEditorBase)((sender is EmbeddableEditorBase) ? sender : null);
			val.Value = editModeNavigationPath;
			val.SelectAll();
			((UIElement)navigationBar.UIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
			EditModeEventArgs e2 = new EditModeEventArgs();
			navigationBar.EventManager.FireEvent(UltraNavigationBarEventIds.EnteredEditMode, e2);
		}

		internal void OnBeforeExitEditMode(object sender, BeforeExitEditModeEventArgs e)
		{
			EmbeddableEditorBase val = (EmbeddableEditorBase)((sender is EmbeddableEditorBase) ? sender : null);
			UltraNavigationBarEventManager eventManager = navigationBar.EventManager;
			ExitingEditModeEventArgs e2 = new ExitingEditModeEventArgs(val.CurrentEditText, val, e.ApplyChanges);
			eventManager.FireEvent(UltraNavigationBarEventIds.ExitingEditMode, e2);
			((CancelEventArgs)(object)e).Cancel = e2.Cancel;
			if (!e.ApplyChanges || ((CancelEventArgs)(object)e).Cancel)
			{
				return;
			}
			editModeNavigationPath = val.CurrentEditText;
			UltraNavigationBarLocation ultraNavigationBarLocation = navigationBar.FromFullPath(editModeNavigationPath);
			if (ultraNavigationBarLocation == null)
			{
				NavigationPathParseErrorEventArgs e3 = new NavigationPathParseErrorEventArgs(editModeNavigationPath);
				eventManager.FireNavigationPathParseErrorEvent(e3);
				if (e3.StayInEditMode)
				{
					val.Value = e3.Path;
					val.SelectAll();
					((CancelEventArgs)(object)e).Cancel = true;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				SelectedLocationChangeKind changeKind = (editorWasDroppedDownWhenExitEditModeWasCalled ? SelectedLocationChangeKind.PreviousLocationSelected : SelectedLocationChangeKind.PathParsed);
				navigationBar.SetSelectedLocationHelper(ultraNavigationBarLocation, changeKind, fireEvents: true, notifyPropChange: true);
				if (e2.AddToPreviousLocations)
				{
					navigationBar.PreviousLocations.Insert(0, ultraNavigationBarLocation);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void OnAfterExitEditMode(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			EmbeddableEditorBase editor = (EmbeddableEditorBase)((sender is EmbeddableEditorBase) ? sender : null);
			HookEditorEvents(editor, hook: false);
			editModeNavigationPath = null;
			((UIElement)navigationBar.UIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
			EditModeEventArgs e2 = new EditModeEventArgs();
			navigationBar.EventManager.FireEvent(UltraNavigationBarEventIds.ExitedEditMode, e2);
		}

		internal void Dispose()
		{
			if (editorWithCombo != null)
			{
				EndEdit(forceExit: true, applyChanges: false);
				HookEditorWithComboEvents(hook: false);
				((DisposableObject)(object)editorWithCombo).Dispose();
				editorWithCombo = null;
			}
			if (embeddableElement != null)
			{
				((DisposableObject)(object)embeddableElement).Dispose();
				embeddableElement = null;
			}
			if (valueList != null)
			{
				((DisposableObject)(object)valueList).Dispose();
				valueList = null;
			}
		}

		internal bool BeginEdit(UltraNavigationBarLocation selectedLocation)
		{
			return BeginEdit(selectedLocation, dropDown: false);
		}

		internal bool BeginEdit(UltraNavigationBarLocation selectedLocation, bool dropDown)
		{
			EditorWithCombo val = EditorWithCombo;
			EmbeddableUIElementBase val2 = GetEmbeddableElement(selectedLocation);
			bool flag = ((EditorWithText)val).EnterEditMode(val2, true);
			if (dropDown && navigationBar.PreviousLocations.Count == 0)
			{
				dropDown = false;
			}
			if (flag && dropDown)
			{
				UIElement uIElement = (UIElement)(object)navigationBar.UIElement;
				if (uIElement != null)
				{
					uIElement.DirtyChildElements(false);
					uIElement.VerifyChildElements();
				}
				((EmbeddableEditorBase)val).DropDown();
			}
			return flag;
		}

		internal bool EndEdit(bool forceExit, bool applyChanges)
		{
			if (editorWithCombo == null || !((EmbeddableEditorBase)editorWithCombo).IsInEditMode)
			{
				return false;
			}
			try
			{
				editorWasDroppedDownWhenExitEditModeWasCalled = ((EmbeddableEditorBase)editorWithCombo).IsDroppedDown;
				return ((EmbeddableEditorBase)editorWithCombo).ExitEditMode(forceExit, applyChanges);
			}
			finally
			{
				editorWasDroppedDownWhenExitEditModeWasCalled = false;
			}
		}

		internal bool DropDown(bool dropDown)
		{
			bool result = false;
			EditorWithCombo val = EditorWithCombo;
			if (((EmbeddableEditorBase)val).IsInEditMode)
			{
				if (dropDown)
				{
					result = ((EmbeddableEditorBase)val).DropDown();
				}
				else
				{
					result = true;
					((EmbeddableEditorBase)val).CloseUp();
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal EmbeddableUIElementBase GetEmbeddableElement(object ownerContext)
		{
			if (embeddableElement == null)
			{
				EditorWithCombo val = EditorWithCombo;
				embeddableElement = ((EmbeddableEditorBase)val).GetEmbeddableElement((UIElement)(object)navigationBar.UIElement, (EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase)(object)this, ownerContext, false, false, false, (EmbeddableUIElementBase)null);
			}
			return embeddableElement;
		}
	}

		internal class AppearancesManager : SubObjectBase
		{
			private AppearanceHolder[] appearanceHolders;

			private PropertyIds[] appearancePropIds;

			private int maxAppearanceCount = -1;

			private ArrayList deserializedAppearances;

			private AppearancesCollection appearanceColl;

			private AppearanceHolder[] AppearanceHolders
			{
				get
				{
					if (appearanceHolders == null)
					{
						appearanceHolders = (AppearanceHolder[])(object)new AppearanceHolder[maxAppearanceCount];
					}
					return appearanceHolders;
				}
			}

			private AppearancesCollection Appearances => appearanceColl;

			internal AppearancesManager(AppearancesCollection appearanceColl, int maxAppearanceCount, PropertyIds[] appearancePropIds)
			{
				Initialize(appearanceColl, maxAppearanceCount, appearancePropIds);
			}

			private void Initialize(AppearancesCollection appearanceColl, int maxAppearanceCount, PropertyIds[] appearancePropIds)
			{
				this.appearanceColl = appearanceColl;
				this.maxAppearanceCount = maxAppearanceCount;
				this.appearancePropIds = appearancePropIds;
				if (appearanceHolders != null && this.maxAppearanceCount != appearanceHolders.Length)
				{
					AppearanceHolder[] array = appearanceHolders;
					appearanceHolders = (AppearanceHolder[])(object)new AppearanceHolder[this.maxAppearanceCount];
					int num = Math.Min(array.Length, appearanceHolders.Length);
					for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
					{
						appearanceHolders[i] = array[i];
					}
				}
			}

			internal AppearanceBase GetAppearance(int index)
			{
				//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0017: Expected O, but got Unknown
				if (AppearanceHolders[index] == null)
				{
					AppearanceHolders[index] = new AppearanceHolder();
					appearanceHolders[index].SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
				AppearanceHolders[index].Collection = Appearances;
				return AppearanceHolders[index].Appearance;
			}

			internal void SetAppearance(int index, AppearanceBase appearance)
			{
				//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0017: Expected O, but got Unknown
				if (AppearanceHolders[index] == null)
				{
					AppearanceHolders[index] = new AppearanceHolder();
					appearanceHolders[index].SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
				if ((appearance != null && !AppearanceHolders[index].HasAppearance) || appearance != AppearanceHolders[index].Appearance)
				{
					AppearanceHolders[index].Collection = Appearances;
					AppearanceHolders[index].Appearance = appearance;
					NotifyPropChange((Enum)(object)appearancePropIds[index], null);
				}
			}

			internal bool ShouldSerializeAppearance(int index)
			{
				if (HasAppearance(index))
				{
					return GetAppearance(index).ShouldSerialize();
				}
				return false;
			}

			internal void ResetAppearance(int index)
			{
				if (HasAppearance(index) && appearanceHolders[index] != null)
				{
					appearanceHolders[index].Reset();
					NotifyPropChange((Enum)(object)appearancePropIds[index]);
				}
			}

			internal bool HasAppearance(int index)
			{
				if (appearanceHolders != null && appearanceHolders[index] != null && appearanceHolders[index].HasAppearance)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}

			internal AppearanceBase GetAppearanceIfAllocated(int index)
			{
				if (appearanceHolders != null)
				{
					AppearanceHolder val = appearanceHolders[index];
					if (val != null && val.HasAppearance)
					{
						return val.Appearance;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}

			internal bool ShouldSerializeAppearances()
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < maxAppearanceCount; i++)
				{
					if (ShouldSerializeAppearance(i))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}

			internal void ResetAppearances()
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < maxAppearanceCount; i++)
				{
					ResetAppearance(i);
				}
			}

			public void Reset()
			{
				ResetAppearances();
			}

			protected internal bool ShouldSerialize()
			{
				return ShouldSerializeAppearances();
			}

			internal void ResolveAppearance(int index, ref AppearanceData appData, ref AppearancePropFlags flags)
			{
				AppearanceBase appearanceIfAllocated = GetAppearanceIfAllocated(index);
				if (appearanceIfAllocated != null)
				{
					appearanceIfAllocated.MergeData(ref appData, ref flags);
				}
			}

			protected override void OnDispose()
			{
				if (appearanceHolders != null)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < appearanceHolders.Length; i++)
					{
						if (appearanceHolders[i] != null)
						{
							appearanceHolders[i].SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
							appearanceHolders[i].Reset();
							appearanceHolders[i] = null;
						}
					}
				}
				base.OnDispose();
			}

			protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
			{
				int num = -1;
				for (int i = 0; i < AppearanceHolders.Length; i++)
				{
					if (HasAppearance(i) && ((object)GetAppearance(i)).Equals(propChange.Source))
					{
						num = i;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (num >= 0 && appearancePropIds != null)
				{
					NotifyPropChange((Enum)(object)appearancePropIds[num], propChange);
				}
				else
				{
					NotifyPropChange(propChange);
				}
			}
		}

		};

		public override Size GetPreferredSize(Size proposedSize)
		{
			if (Size.Empty == proposedSize || (int.MaxValue == proposedSize.Width && int.MaxValue == proposedSize.Height))
			{
				return CalcIdealSize();
			}
			if (proposedSize.Width == 0 || proposedSize.Width == 1)
			{
				proposedSize.Width = 2000000000;
			}
			if (proposedSize.Height == 0 || proposedSize.Height == 1)
			{
				proposedSize.Height = 2000000000;
			}
			return CalcIdealSize(proposedSize);
		}

		internal void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo info)
		{
			if (info.FindSource(typeof(AppearanceBase)) != null || info.FindSource(typeof(AppearanceHolder)) != null || info.Source == appearanceManager)

		internal void RaseTextChangedEvent(EventArgs e)

		}

		internal void FireEvent(EventIds eventId, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (!EventManager.CanFireEvent(eventId))
			{
				return;
			}
			EventManager.IncrementInProgress(eventId);
			try
			{
				FireControlSpecificEvent(eventId, e);
			}
			finally
			{
				EventManager.DecrementInProgress(eventId);
			}
		}

		internal virtual void FireControlSpecificEvent(EventIds eventId, EventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0021: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			switch (eventId)
			{
			case EventIds.LinkClicked:
				OnLinkClicked((LinkClickedEventArgs)e);
				break;
			case EventIds.ParseError:
				OnParseError((ParseErrorEventArgs)e);
				break;
			case EventIds.ValueChanged:
				OnValueChanged(e);
				break;
			}
		}

		internal ParsedFormattedTextValue GetCachedParsedValue()
		{
			if (cachedParsedDataValue != null && object.ReferenceEquals(cachedDataValue, dataValue))
			{
				return cachedParsedDataValue;
			}
			cachedParsedDataValue = Editor.ParseValue(dataValue, EditorOwnerInfo, EditorOwnerContext);
			cachedDataValue = dataValue;
			return cachedParsedDataValue;
		}

		public bool ResolveCustomAreaAppearance(ref AppearanceData appData, ref AppearancePropFlags flags, string customArea)
		{
			AppearancesManager appearancesManager = AppearanceManager;
			switch (customArea)
			{
			case "Link":
				appearancesManager.ResolveAppearance(3, ref appData, ref flags);
				return true;
			case "ActiveLink":
				appearancesManager.ResolveAppearance(1, ref appData, ref flags);
				return true;
			case "HotTrackedLink":
				appearancesManager.ResolveAppearance(2, ref appData, ref flags);
				return true;
			case "VisitedLink":
				appearancesManager.ResolveAppearance(4, ref appData, ref flags);
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		public void ResolveAppearance(ref AppearanceData appData, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			ResolveAppearance(ref appData, ref requestedProps, resolveDefaults: true);
		}

		internal void ResolveAppearance(ref AppearanceData appData, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps, bool resolveDefaults)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ResolutionOrderInfo resolutionOrder = StyleUtils.GetResolutionOrder((UltraControlBase)(object)this);
			UIRole mainRole = StyleUtils.GetMainRole((UltraControlBase)(object)this);
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseStyleBefore || ((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseStyleAfter)
			{
				if (StyleUtils.IsHottracking((Control)(object)this))
				{

				charFormat2.dwMask |= 2;
				if (font.Italic)
				{
					charFormat2.dwEffects |= 2;
				}
				charFormat2.dwMask |= 8;
				if (font.Strikeout)
				{
					charFormat2.dwEffects |= 8;
				}
				charFormat2.dwMask |= 4;
				if (font.Underline)
				{
					charFormat2.dwEffects |= 4;
				}
				charFormat2.dwMask |= 16;
				if (flag)
				{
					charFormat2.wWeight = (short)lOGFONT.lfWeight;
					charFormat2.dwMask |= 4194304;
					int num2 = ColorTranslator.ToWin32(Utilities.GetNonSystemColor(SystemColors.Window));
					charFormat2.dwMask |= 67108864;
					if ((long)(appearancePropFlags & 1) == 0)
					{
						charFormat2.crBackColor = ColorTranslator.ToWin32(((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).BackColor);
					}
					else
					{
						charFormat2.crBackColor = num2;
					}
					charFormat2.dwReserved = 0;
					charFormat2.sStyle = (short)font.Style;
					charFormat2.dwMask |= 524288;
					if (font.Underline)
					{
						charFormat2.bUnderlineType = 1;
					}
					else
					{
						charFormat2.bUnderlineType = 0;
					}
					charFormat2.dwMask |= 8388608;
					charFormat2.bAnimation = 0;
					charFormat2.dwMask |= 262144;
					charFormat2.bRevAuthor = 0;
					charFormat2.dwMask |= 32768;
					charFormat2.bReserved1 = 0;
					charFormat2.dwMask |= 128;
					if (charFormat2.crBackColor == num2)
					{
						charFormat2.dwEffects |= 67108864;
					}
					charFormat2.dwMask |= 8192;
					charFormat2.dwMask |= 2048;
					charFormat2.dwMask |= 256;
					charFormat2.dwMask |= 4096;
					charFormat2.dwMask |= 32;
					charFormat2.dwMask |= 512;
					charFormat2.dwMask |= 16384;
					charFormat2.dwMask |= 1024;
					charFormat2.dwMask |= 64;
					charFormat2.dwMask |= 196608;
				}
				font2?.Dispose();
			}

			private void MergeCharFormatProperty(NativeWindowMethods.CHARFORMAT2 charFormat2, NativeWindowMethods.CHARFORMAT2 mergedCharFormat2, int maskPropFlag, object firstValue, object mergeValue)
			{
				bool flag = IsMaskPropFlagSet(charFormat2, maskPropFlag);
				IsMaskPropFlagSet(mergedCharFormat2, maskPropFlag);
				if (flag && firstValue != mergeValue)
				{
					charFormat2.dwMask &= ~maskPropFlag;
				}
			}

			private void MergeCharFormatProperty(NativeWindowMethods.CHARFORMAT2 charFormat2, NativeWindowMethods.CHARFORMAT2 mergedCharFormat2, int maskPropFlag)
			{
				bool flag = IsMaskPropFlagSet(charFormat2, maskPropFlag);
				IsMaskPropFlagSet(mergedCharFormat2, maskPropFlag);
				int effectsFlag = GetEffectsFlag(maskPropFlag);
				if (flag && !CompareEffects(ref charFormat2, ref mergedCharFormat2, effectsFlag))
				{
					charFormat2.dwMask &= ~maskPropFlag;
				}
			}

			private static bool CompareEffects(ref NativeWindowMethods.CHARFORMAT2 charFormat2, ref NativeWindowMethods.CHARFORMAT2 mergedCharFormat2, int effectsPropFlag)
			{
				bool flag = (charFormat2.dwEffects & effectsPropFlag) == effectsPropFlag;
				bool flag2 = (mergedCharFormat2.dwEffects & effectsPropFlag) == effectsPropFlag;
				return flag == flag2;
			}

			private int GetEffectsFlag(int maskPropFlag)
			{
				return maskPropFlag switch
				{
					128 => 128, 
					1 => 1, 
					8192 => 8192, 
					2048 => 2048, 
					256 => 256, 
					4096 => 4096, 
					2 => 2, 
					32 => 32, 
					512 => 512, 
					16 => 16, 
					16384 => 16384, 
					1024 => 1024, 
					64 => 64, 
					8 => 8, 
					196608 => 131072, 
					4 => 4, 
					_ => 0, 
				};
			}

			private bool IsMaskPropFlagSet(NativeWindowMethods.CHARFORMAT2 charFormat2, int maskPropFlag)
			{
				return (charFormat2.dwMask & maskPropFlag) == maskPropFlag;
			}

			private bool IsEffectsPropFlagSet(NativeWindowMethods.CHARFORMAT2 charFormat2, int effectPropFlag)
			{
				return (charFormat2.dwEffects & effectPropFlag) == effectPropFlag;
			}

			private void MergeCharFormats(NativeWindowMethods.CHARFORMAT2 firstCharFormat2, NativeWindowMethods.CHARFORMAT2 mergeCharFormat2)
			{
				MergeCharFormatProperty(firstCharFormat2, mergeCharFormat2, 262144, firstCharFormat2.bAnimation, mergeCharFormat2.bAnimation);
				MergeCharFormatProperty(firstCharFormat2, mergeCharFormat2, 67108864, firstCharFormat2.crBackColor, mergeCharFormat2.crBackColor);
				MergeCharFormatProperty(firstCharFormat2, mergeCharFormat2, 134217728, firstCharFormat2.bCharSet, mergeCharFormat2.bCharSet);
				MergeCharFormatProperty(firstCharFormat2, mergeCharFormat2, 1073741824, firstCharFormat2.crTextColor, mergeCharFormat2.crTextColor);
				MergeCharFormatProperty(firstCharFormat2, mergeCharFormat2, 536870912, firstCharFormat2.szFaceName, mergeCharFormat2.szFaceName);
				MergeCharFormatProperty(firstCharFormat2, mergeCharFormat2, 1048576, firstCharFormat2.wKerning, mergeCharFormat2.wKerning);
				MergeCharFormatProperty(firstCharFormat2, mergeCharFormat2, 33554432, firstCharFormat2.lcid, mergeCharFormat2.lcid);
				MergeCharFormatProperty(firstCharFormat2, mergeCharFormat2, 268435456, firstCharFormat2.yOffset, mergeCharFormat2.yOffset);
				MergeCharFormatProperty(firstCharFormat2, mergeCharFormat2, 32768, firstCharFormat2.bRevAuthor, mergeCharFormat2.bRevAuthor);
				MergeCharFormatProperty(firstCharFormat2, mergeCharFormat2, int.MinValue, firstCharFormat2.yHeight, mergeCharFormat2.yHeight);
				MergeCharFormatProperty(firstCharFormat2, mergeCharFormat2, 2097152, firstCharFormat2.sSpacing, mergeCharFormat2.sSpacing);
				MergeCharFormatProperty(firstCharFormat2, mergeCharFormat2, 524288, firstCharFormat2.sStyle, mergeCharFormat2.sStyle);
				MergeCharFormatProperty(firstCharFormat2, mergeCharFormat2, 8388608, firstCharFormat2.bUnderlineType, mergeCharFormat2.bUnderlineType);
				MergeCharFormatProperty(firstCharFormat2, mergeCharFormat2, 4194304, firstCharFormat2.wWeight, mergeCharFormat2.wWeight);
				MergeCharFormatProperty(firstCharFormat2, mergeCharFormat2, 128);
				MergeCharFormatProperty(firstCharFormat2, mergeCharFormat2, 1);
				MergeCharFormatProperty(firstCharFormat2, mergeCharFormat2, 8192);
				MergeCharFormatProperty(firstCharFormat2, mergeCharFormat2, 2048);
				MergeCharFormatProperty(firstCharFormat2, mergeCharFormat2, 256);
				MergeCharFormatProperty(firstCharFormat2, mergeCharFormat2, 4096);
				MergeCharFormatProperty(firstCharFormat2, mergeCharFormat2, 2);
				MergeCharFormatProperty(firstCharFormat2, mergeCharFormat2, 32);
				MergeCharFormatProperty(firstCharFormat2, mergeCharFormat2, 512);
				MergeCharFormatProperty(firstCharFormat2, mergeCharFormat2, 16);
				MergeCharFormatProperty(firstCharFormat2, mergeCharFormat2, 16384);
				MergeCharFormatProperty(firstCharFormat2, mergeCharFormat2, 1024);
				MergeCharFormatProperty(firstCharFormat2, mergeCharFormat2, 64);
				MergeCharFormatProperty(firstCharFormat2, mergeCharFormat2, 8);
				MergeCharFormatProperty(firstCharFormat2, mergeCharFormat2, 4);
				MergeCharFormatProperty(firstCharFormat2, mergeCharFormat2, 196608);
			}

		private void EnsureInEditMode()
		{
			if ((!((EditorButtonControlBase)this).HasInternalEditor || !((EmbeddableEditorBase)base.Editor).IsInEditMode) && !((Control)(object)this).Disposing && !((Control)(object)this).IsDisposed && !((Component)(object)this).DesignMode)
			{
				((EmbeddableEditorBase)base.Editor).EnterEditMode((EmbeddableUIElementBase)(object)UIElement.EditorElement);
			}
		}

		internal void ExitEditMode()
		{
			if (base.Editor != null)
			{
				((EmbeddableEditorBase)base.Editor).ExitEditMode(false, true);
			}
		}

		private void CreateSubclasser()
		{
			try
			{
				SecurityPermission securityPermission = new SecurityPermission(SecurityPermissionFlag.UnmanagedCode);
				if (Utilities.CanAssert)
				{
					securityPermission.Assert();
				}
				CreateSubclasserUnsafe();
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
			}
		}

		private void CreateSubclasserUnsafe()
		{
			nativeWindow = new UltraFormattedTextEditorNativeWindow(this);
		}

		protected override void OnHandleCreated(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (!((Control)(object)this).RecreatingHandle)
			{
				CreateSubclasser();
			}
			((EditorButtonControlBase)this).OnHandleCreated(e);
		}
	}

		public ExpandableGroupBoxControlCollection(UltraExpandableGroupBox owner)
			: base((Control)(object)owner)
		{
			this.owner = owner;
		}

		public override void Add(Control ctrl)
		{
			if (base.Count >= 1)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_UltraExpandableGroupBox_0", "ctrl"));
			}
			base.Add(ctrl);
		}

		public override void Remove(Control ctrl)
		{
			if (!((Control)(object)owner).IsDisposed && !((Control)(object)owner).Disposing && !ctrl.IsDisposed && !ctrl.Disposing && ctrl is UltraExpandableGroupBoxPanel && !owner.IsInDesignMode)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_UltraExpandableGroupBox_1", "ctrl"));
			}
			base.Remove(ctrl);
		}
	}
	public class GroupBoxContentAreaBackgroundUIElement : UIElement
	{
		public override Region Region
		{
			get
			{
				if (GroupBox == null || GroupBox.BorderStyleResolved != GroupBoxBorderStyle.Rounded)
				{
					return ((UIElement)this).Region;
				}
				using GraphicsPath graphicsPath = new GraphicsPath();
				Point point = new Point(((UIElement)this).Rect.X + 2, ((UIElement)this).Rect.Y);
				Point point2 = point;
				point2.Offset(-2, 0);
				Point point3 = point2;
				point3.Offset(0, 2);
				graphicsPath.AddPolygon(new Point[3] { point, point2, point3 });
				point = new Point(((UIElement)this).Rect.Right - 3, ((UIElement)this).Rect.Y);
				point2 = point;
				point2.Offset(3, 0);
				point3 = point2;
				point3.Offset(0, 2);
				graphicsPath.AddPolygon(new Point[3] { point, point2, point3 });
				point = new Point(((UIElement)this).Rect.X + 3, ((UIElement)this).Rect.Bottom);
				point2 = point;
				point2.Offset(-3, 0);
				point3 = point2;
				point3.Offset(0, -3);
				graphicsPath.AddPolygon(new Point[3] { point, point2, point3 });
				point = new Point(((UIElement)this).Rect.Right - 3, ((UIElement)this).Rect.Bottom);
				point2 = point;
				point2.Offset(3, 0);
				point3 = point2;
				point3.Offset(0, -3);
				graphicsPath.AddPolygon(new Point[3] { point, point2, point3 });
				Region region = ((UIElement)this).Region;
				region.Exclude(graphicsPath);
				return region;
			}
		}

		protected override bool ClipSelf => true;

		internal GroupBoxContentAreaUIElement ContentArea => ((UIElement)this).Parent as GroupBoxContentAreaUIElement;

		internal UltraGroupBox GroupBox => (((UIElement)this).Parent as GroupBoxContentAreaUIElement).GroupBox;

		public GroupBoxContentAreaBackgroundUIElement(GroupBoxContentAreaUIElement parent)
			: base((UIElement)(object)parent)
		{
		}

		public override void Invalidate()
		{
			((UIElement)this).Invalidate();
			if (GroupBox is UltraExpandableGroupBox ultraExpandableGroupBox)
			{
				((Control)(object)ultraExpandableGroupBox.Panel).Invalidate();
			}
		}

		protected override void InitAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			GroupBox.ResolveContentAreaAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
		}
	}
	public class GroupBoxContentAreaBorderUIElement : UIElement
	{
		public override Border3DSide BorderSides
		{
			get
			{
				if (GroupBox == null)
				{
					return Border3DSide.All;
				}
				GroupBoxBorderStyle borderStyleResolved = GroupBox.BorderStyleResolved;
				if (GroupBox.BordersAreRectangular || borderStyleResolved == GroupBoxBorderStyle.Rounded || borderStyleResolved == GroupBoxBorderStyle.None)
				{
					return Border3DSide.All;
				}
				if (GroupBox.HeaderIsHorizontal)
				{
					if (GroupBox.BordersAreParallel)
					{
						return Border3DSide.Top | Border3DSide.Bottom;
					}
					if (GroupBox.BordersAreHeaderOnly)
					{
						if (GroupBox.HeaderIsOnTop)
						{
							return Border3DSide.Top;
						}
						return Border3DSide.Bottom;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (GroupBox.BordersAreParallel)
					{
						return Border3DSide.Left | Border3DSide.Right;
					}
					if (GroupBox.BordersAreHeaderOnly)
					{
						if (GroupBox.HeaderIsOnLeft)
						{
							return Border3DSide.Left;
						}
						return Border3DSide.Right;
					}
				}
				return Border3DSide.All;
			}
			set
			{
				((UIElement)this).BorderSides = value;
			}
		}

		public override Region Region
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0054: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_005a: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				UltraGroupBox groupBox = GroupBox;
				if (groupBox == null || groupBox.HeaderIsInsideBorder || groupBox.HeaderIsOutsideBorder)
				{
					return ((UIElement)this).Region;
				}
				Region region = null;
				try
				{
					region = new Region(Rectangle.Inflate(((UIElement)this).Rect, 1, 1));
					if (groupBox.UIElement == null || groupBox.UIElement.Header == null)
					{
						return region;
					}
					if ((int)groupBox.HeaderBorderStyleResolved != 1)
					{
						region.Exclude(((UIElement)GroupBox.UIElement.Header).Rect);
					}
					else
					{
						UIElementsCollection childElements = ((UIElement)groupBox.UIElement.Header).ChildElements;
						UIElementEnumerator enumerator = childElements.GetEnumerator();
						try
						{
							while (enumerator.MoveNext())
							{
								UIElement current = enumerator.Current;
								using Region region2 = current.Region;
								region.Exclude(region2);
							}
						}
						finally
						{
							if (enumerator is IDisposable disposable)
							{
								disposable.Dispose();
							}
						}
						if (groupBox is UltraExpandableGroupBox { ExpansionIndicatorResolved: not GroupBoxExpansionIndicator.None, HasCaptionText: not false } ultraExpandableGroupBox)
						{
							ClipSpaceBetweenCaptionAndExpansionIndicator(ultraExpandableGroupBox, region);
						}
					}
					return region;
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
					return ((UIElement)this).Region;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override bool ClipSelf => true;

		internal GroupBoxContentAreaUIElement ContentArea => ((UIElement)this).Parent as GroupBoxContentAreaUIElement;

		internal UltraGroupBox GroupBox => (((UIElement)this).Parent as GroupBoxContentAreaUIElement).GroupBox;

		public GroupBoxContentAreaBorderUIElement(GroupBoxContentAreaUIElement parent)
			: base((UIElement)(object)parent)
		{
		}

		protected override void DrawBackColor(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
		}

		protected override void DrawImageBackground(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
		}

		protected override void DrawBorders(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			switch (GroupBox.BorderStyleResolved)
			{
			case GroupBoxBorderStyle.Rounded:
				DrawRoundedBorders(ref drawParams);
				break;
			case GroupBoxBorderStyle.Header3D:
				DrawHeader3DBorders(ref drawParams);
				break;
			case GroupBoxBorderStyle.HeaderDoubleSolid:
				DrawHeaderDoubleSolidBorders(ref drawParams);
				break;
			case GroupBoxBorderStyle.HeaderSolid:
				DrawHeaderSolidBorders(ref drawParams);
				break;
			case GroupBoxBorderStyle.Parallel3D:
				DrawParallel3DBorders(ref drawParams);
				break;
			case GroupBoxBorderStyle.ParallelDoubleSolid:
				DrawParallelDoubleSolidBorders(ref drawParams);
				break;
			case GroupBoxBorderStyle.ParallelSolid:
				DrawParallelSolidBorders(ref drawParams);
				break;
			case GroupBoxBorderStyle.Rectangular3D:
				DrawRectangular3DBorders(ref drawParams);
				break;
			case GroupBoxBorderStyle.RectangularDoubleSolid:
				DrawRectangularDoubleSolidBorders(ref drawParams);
				break;
			case GroupBoxBorderStyle.RectangularInset:
				DrawRectangularInsetBorders(ref drawParams);
				break;
			case GroupBoxBorderStyle.RectangularRaised:
				DrawRectangularRaisedBorders(ref drawParams);
				break;
			case GroupBoxBorderStyle.RectangularSolid:
				DrawRectangularSolidBorders(ref drawParams);
				break;
			case GroupBoxBorderStyle.None:
				break;
			}
		}

		protected override void InitAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			GroupBox.ResolveContentAreaAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
		}

		private void GetStartAndEndPointsFor3DBorderLine(out Point ptStart, out Point ptEnd, Border3DSide borderSides)
		{
			switch (borderSides)
			{
			case Border3DSide.Top:
				ptStart = new Point(((UIElement)this).Rect.Left + 1, ((UIElement)this).Rect.Top + 1);
				ptEnd = new Point(((UIElement)this).Rect.Right - 2, ((UIElement)this).Rect.Top + 1);
				break;
			case Border3DSide.Bottom:
				ptStart = new Point(((UIElement)this).Rect.Left + 1, ((UIElement)this).Rect.Bottom - 2);
				ptEnd = new Point(((UIElement)this).Rect.Right - 2, ((UIElement)this).Rect.Bottom - 2);
				break;
			case Border3DSide.Left:
				ptStart = new Point(((UIElement)this).Rect.Left + 1, ((UIElement)this).Rect.Top + 1);
				ptEnd = new Point(((UIElement)this).Rect.Left + 1, ((UIElement)this).Rect.Bottom);
				break;
			case Border3DSide.Right:
				ptStart = new Point(((UIElement)this).Rect.Right - 3, ((UIElement)this).Rect.Bottom);
				ptEnd = new Point(((UIElement)this).Rect.Right - 3, ((UIElement)this).Rect.Top + 1);
				break;
			default:
				ptStart = Point.Empty;
				ptEnd = Point.Empty;
				break;
			}
		}

		private Pen GetDarkDarkPen(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			if (((AppearanceData)(ref drawParams.AppearanceData)).BorderColor3DBase != SystemColors.Control)
			{
				return ((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).GetPen((PenType)6, ((AppearanceData)(ref drawParams.AppearanceData)).BorderColor3DBase);
			}
			return SystemPens.ControlDarkDark;
		}

		private Pen GetDarkPen(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			if (((AppearanceData)(ref drawParams.AppearanceData)).BorderColor3DBase != SystemColors.Control)
			{
				return ((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).GetPen((PenType)5, ((AppearanceData)(ref drawParams.AppearanceData)).BorderColor3DBase);
			}
			return SystemPens.ControlDark;
		}

		private Pen GetLightLightPen(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			if (((AppearanceData)(ref drawParams.AppearanceData)).BorderColor3DBase != SystemColors.Control)
			{
				return ((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).GetPen((PenType)4, ((AppearanceData)(ref drawParams.AppearanceData)).BorderColor3DBase);
			}
			return SystemPens.ControlLightLight;
		}

		private Pen GetLightPen(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			if (((AppearanceData)(ref drawParams.AppearanceData)).BorderColor3DBase != SystemColors.Control)
			{
				return ((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).GetPen((PenType)3, ((AppearanceData)(ref drawParams.AppearanceData)).BorderColor3DBase);
			}
			return SystemPens.ControlLight;
		}

		private void Draw3DLine(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams, Point ptStart, Point ptEnd, bool darkLineFirst)
		{
			bool flag = ptStart.Y == ptEnd.Y;
			int dx = ((!flag) ? 1 : 0);
			int dy = (flag ? 1 : 0);
			Pen darkPen = GetDarkPen(ref drawParams);
			Pen lightLightPen = GetLightLightPen(ref drawParams);
			((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.DrawLine(darkLineFirst ? darkPen : lightLightPen, ptStart, ptEnd);
			ptStart.Offset(dx, dy);
			ptEnd.Offset(dx, dy);
			((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.DrawLine(darkLineFirst ? lightLightPen : darkPen, ptStart, ptEnd);
		}

		private void Draw3DBordersHelper(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams, Border3DSide borderSides, bool darkLineFirst)
		{
			GetStartAndEndPointsFor3DBorderLine(out var ptStart, out var ptEnd, borderSides);
			Draw3DLine(ref drawParams, ptStart, ptEnd, darkLineFirst);
		}

		private void DrawHeader3DBorders(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			Draw3DBordersHelper(ref drawParams, ((UIElement)this).BorderSides, darkLineFirst: true);
		}

		private void DrawParallel3DBorders(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			if (GroupBox.HeaderIsHorizontal)
			{
				Draw3DBordersHelper(ref drawParams, Border3DSide.Top, darkLineFirst: true);
				Draw3DBordersHelper(ref drawParams, Border3DSide.Bottom, darkLineFirst: false);
			}
			else
			{
				Draw3DBordersHelper(ref drawParams, Border3DSide.Left, darkLineFirst: true);
				Draw3DBordersHelper(ref drawParams, Border3DSide.Right, darkLineFirst: false);
			}
		}

		private void DrawRectangular3DBorders(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle(((UIElement)this).Rect.X + 1, ((UIElement)this).Rect.Y + 1, ((UIElement)this).Rect.Width - 4, ((UIElement)this).Rect.Height - 4);
			Point pt = new Point(rectangle.Left, rectangle.Top);
			Point point = new Point(rectangle.Right, rectangle.Top);
			Point point2 = new Point(rectangle.Left, rectangle.Bottom);
			Point point3 = new Point(rectangle.Right, rectangle.Bottom);
			Pen darkPen = GetDarkPen(ref drawParams);
			Pen lightLightPen = GetLightLightPen(ref drawParams);
			((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.DrawLine(darkPen, pt, point);
			((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.DrawLine(darkPen, point3, point);
			((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.DrawLine(darkPen, point2, point3);
			((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.DrawLine(darkPen, pt, point2);
			pt.Offset(1, 1);
			point.Offset(1, 0);
			point2.Offset(0, 1);
			point3.Offset(1, 1);
			Point pt2 = point;
			pt2.Offset(-2, 1);
			((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.DrawLine(lightLightPen, pt, pt2);
			((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.DrawLine(lightLightPen, point3, point);
			((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.DrawLine(lightLightPen, point2, point3);
			Point pt3 = point2;
			pt3.Offset(1, -2);
			((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.DrawLine(lightLightPen, pt, pt3);
		}

		private void GetStartAndEndPointsForInnerSolidLine(ref Point ptStart, ref Point ptEnd, Border3DSide borderSides, bool shorten)
		{
			int dx = 0;
			int dy = 0;
			int dx2 = 0;
			int dy2 = 0;
			int num = 2;
			switch (borderSides)
			{
			case Border3DSide.Top:
				if (shorten)
				{
					dx = num;
					dx2 = -num;
				}
				dy = num;
				dy2 = num;
				break;
			case Border3DSide.Bottom:
				if (shorten)
				{
					dx = num;
					dx2 = -num;
				}
				dy = -num;
				dy2 = -num;
				break;
			case Border3DSide.Left:
				dx = num;
				dx2 = num;
				if (shorten)
				{
					dy = num;
					dy2 = -num;
				}
				break;
			case Border3DSide.Right:
				dx = -num;
				dx2 = -num;
				if (shorten)
				{
					dy = -num;
					dy2 = num;
				}
				break;
			default:
				return;
			}
			ptStart.Offset(dx, dy);
			ptEnd.Offset(dx2, dy2);
		}

		private void GetStartAndEndPointsForOuterSolidLine(out Point ptStart, out Point ptEnd, Border3DSide borderSides)
		{
			int y = ((UIElement)this).Rect.Top + 1;
			int x = ((UIElement)this).Rect.Left + 1;
			int x2 = ((UIElement)this).Rect.Right - 2;
			int y2 = ((UIElement)this).Rect.Bottom - 2;
			switch (borderSides)
			{
			case Border3DSide.Top:
				ptStart = new Point(x, y);
				ptEnd = new Point(x2, y);
				break;
			case Border3DSide.Bottom:
				ptStart = new Point(x, y2);
				ptEnd = new Point(x2, y2);
				break;
			case Border3DSide.Left:
				ptStart = new Point(x, y);
				ptEnd = new Point(x, y2);
				break;
			case Border3DSide.Right:
				ptStart = new Point(x2, y2);
				ptEnd = new Point(x2, y);
				break;
			default:
				ptStart = Point.Empty;
				ptEnd = Point.Empty;
				break;
			}
		}

		private void DrawDoubleSolidBordersHelper(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams, Border3DSide borderSide, bool shortenInnerLine)
		{
			GetStartAndEndPointsForOuterSolidLine(out var ptStart, out var ptEnd, borderSide);
			DrawSolidLine(ref drawParams, ptStart, ptEnd, borderSide);
			GetStartAndEndPointsForInnerSolidLine(ref ptStart, ref ptEnd, borderSide, shortenInnerLine);
			DrawSolidLine(ref drawParams, ptStart, ptEnd, borderSide);
		}

		private void DrawHeaderDoubleSolidBorders(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			DrawDoubleSolidBordersHelper(ref drawParams, ((UIElement)this).BorderSides, shortenInnerLine: false);
		}

		private void DrawParallelDoubleSolidBorders(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			if (GroupBox.HeaderIsHorizontal)
			{
				DrawDoubleSolidBordersHelper(ref drawParams, Border3DSide.Top, shortenInnerLine: false);
				DrawDoubleSolidBordersHelper(ref drawParams, Border3DSide.Bottom, shortenInnerLine: false);
			}
			else
			{
				DrawDoubleSolidBordersHelper(ref drawParams, Border3DSide.Left, shortenInnerLine: false);
				DrawDoubleSolidBordersHelper(ref drawParams, Border3DSide.Right, shortenInnerLine: false);
			}
		}

		private void DrawRectangularDoubleSolidBorders(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			Border3DSide[] array = new Border3DSide[4]
			{
				Border3DSide.Top,
				Border3DSide.Right,
				Border3DSide.Bottom,
				Border3DSide.Left
			};
			Border3DSide[] array2 = array;
			foreach (Border3DSide borderSide in array2)
			{
				DrawDoubleSolidBordersHelper(ref drawParams, borderSide, shortenInnerLine: true);
			}
		}

		private void DrawRectangularInsetBorders(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle(((UIElement)this).Rect.X + 1, ((UIElement)this).Rect.Y + 1, ((UIElement)this).Rect.Width - 4, ((UIElement)this).Rect.Height - 3);
			Point location = rectangle.Location;
			Point pt = new Point(rectangle.Right - 1, rectangle.Top);
			Point pt2 = new Point(rectangle.Right, rectangle.Top);
			Point pt3 = new Point(rectangle.Left + 1, rectangle.Top + 1);
			Point pt4 = new Point(rectangle.Right - 2, rectangle.Top + 1);
			Point pt5 = new Point(rectangle.Right - 1, rectangle.Top + 1);
			Point pt6 = new Point(rectangle.Left + 1, rectangle.Bottom - 2);
			Point pt7 = new Point(rectangle.Left, rectangle.Bottom - 1);
			Point pt8 = new Point(rectangle.Left + 1, rectangle.Bottom - 1);
			Point point = new Point(rectangle.Right - 1, rectangle.Bottom - 1);
			Point pt9 = new Point(rectangle.Left, rectangle.Bottom);
			Point point2 = new Point(rectangle.Right, rectangle.Bottom);
			Pen lightLightPen = GetLightLightPen(ref drawParams);
			Pen lightPen = GetLightPen(ref drawParams);
			Pen darkPen = GetDarkPen(ref drawParams);
			Pen darkDarkPen = GetDarkDarkPen(ref drawParams);
			((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.DrawLine(darkDarkPen, pt3, pt4);
			((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.DrawLine(darkDarkPen, pt3, pt6);
			((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.DrawLine(darkPen, location, pt);
			((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.DrawLine(darkPen, location, pt7);
			((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.DrawLine(lightPen, pt8, point);
			((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.DrawLine(lightPen, point, pt5);
			((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.DrawLine(lightLightPen, pt9, point2);
			((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.DrawLine(lightLightPen, point2, pt2);
		}

		private void DrawRectangularRaisedBorders(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle(((UIElement)this).Rect.X + 1, ((UIElement)this).Rect.Y + 1, ((UIElement)this).Rect.Width - 4, ((UIElement)this).Rect.Height - 3);
			Point location = rectangle.Location;
			Point pt = new Point(rectangle.Right - 1, rectangle.Top);
			Point pt2 = new Point(rectangle.Right, rectangle.Top);
			Point pt3 = new Point(rectangle.Left + 1, rectangle.Top + 1);
			Point pt4 = new Point(rectangle.Right - 2, rectangle.Top + 1);
			Point pt5 = new Point(rectangle.Right - 1, rectangle.Top + 1);
			Point pt6 = new Point(rectangle.Left + 1, rectangle.Bottom - 2);
			Point pt7 = new Point(rectangle.Left, rectangle.Bottom - 1);
			Point pt8 = new Point(rectangle.Left + 1, rectangle.Bottom - 1);
			Point point = new Point(rectangle.Right - 1, rectangle.Bottom - 1);
			Point pt9 = new Point(rectangle.Left, rectangle.Bottom);
			Point point2 = new Point(rectangle.Right, rectangle.Bottom);
			Pen lightLightPen = GetLightLightPen(ref drawParams);
			Pen lightPen = GetLightPen(ref drawParams);
			Pen darkPen = GetDarkPen(ref drawParams);
			Pen darkDarkPen = GetDarkDarkPen(ref drawParams);
			((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.DrawLine(lightLightPen, pt3, pt4);
			((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.DrawLine(lightLightPen, pt3, pt6);
			((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.DrawLine(lightPen, location, pt);
			((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.DrawLine(lightPen, location, pt7);
			((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.DrawLine(darkPen, pt8, point);
			((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.DrawLine(darkPen, point, pt5);
			((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.DrawLine(darkDarkPen, pt9, point2);
			((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.DrawLine(darkDarkPen, point2, pt2);
		}

		private void DrawRoundedBorders(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			GetStartAndEndPointsForOuterSolidLine(out var ptStart, out var ptEnd, Border3DSide.Top);
			ptStart.Offset(2, 0);
			ptEnd.Offset(-2, 0);
			DrawSolidLine(ref drawParams, ptStart, ptEnd, Border3DSide.Top);
			ptStart = ptEnd;
			ptStart.Offset(0, 1);
			DrawSolidLine(ref drawParams, ptStart, ptEnd, Border3DSide.Top);
			ptStart.Offset(1, 1);
			ptEnd.Offset(1, 1);
			DrawSolidLine(ref drawParams, ptStart, ptEnd, Border3DSide.Right);
			GetStartAndEndPointsForOuterSolidLine(out ptStart, out ptEnd, Border3DSide.Right);
			ptStart.Offset(0, -2);
			ptEnd.Offset(0, 2);
			DrawSolidLine(ref drawParams, ptStart, ptEnd, Border3DSide.Right);
			ptEnd = ptStart;
			ptEnd.Offset(-1, 0);
			ptStart.Offset(-1, 1);
			DrawSolidLine(ref drawParams, ptStart, ptEnd, Border3DSide.Right);
			ptStart.Offset(-1, 1);
			ptEnd.Offset(-1, 1);
			DrawSolidLine(ref drawParams, ptStart, ptEnd, Border3DSide.Bottom);
			GetStartAndEndPointsForOuterSolidLine(out ptStart, out ptEnd, Border3DSide.Bottom);
			ptStart.Offset(2, 0);
			ptEnd.Offset(-2, 0);
			DrawSolidLine(ref drawParams, ptStart, ptEnd, Border3DSide.Bottom);
			ptEnd = ptStart;
			ptEnd.Offset(0, -1);
			DrawSolidLine(ref drawParams, ptStart, ptEnd, Border3DSide.Bottom);
			ptStart.Offset(-1, -1);
			ptEnd.Offset(-1, -1);
			DrawSolidLine(ref drawParams, ptStart, ptEnd, Border3DSide.Left);
			GetStartAndEndPointsForOuterSolidLine(out ptStart, out ptEnd, Border3DSide.Left);
			ptStart.Offset(0, 2);
			ptEnd.Offset(0, -2);
			DrawSolidLine(ref drawParams, ptStart, ptEnd, Border3DSide.Left);
			ptEnd = ptStart;
			ptEnd.Offset(1, -1);
			ptStart.Offset(1, 0);
			DrawSolidLine(ref drawParams, ptStart, ptEnd, Border3DSide.Left);
			ptStart.Offset(1, -1);
			ptEnd.Offset(1, -1);
			DrawSolidLine(ref drawParams, ptStart, ptEnd, Border3DSide.Top);
		}

		private void DrawHeaderSolidBorders(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			DrawSolidBordersHelper(ref drawParams, ((UIElement)this).BorderSides);
		}

		private void DrawParallelSolidBorders(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			if (GroupBox.HeaderIsHorizontal)
			{
				DrawSolidBordersHelper(ref drawParams, Border3DSide.Top);
				DrawSolidBordersHelper(ref drawParams, Border3DSide.Bottom);
			}
			else
			{
				DrawSolidBordersHelper(ref drawParams, Border3DSide.Left);
				DrawSolidBordersHelper(ref drawParams, Border3DSide.Right);
			}
		}

		private void DrawRectangularSolidBorders(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			Border3DSide[] array = new Border3DSide[4]
			{
				Border3DSide.Top,
				Border3DSide.Right,
				Border3DSide.Bottom,
				Border3DSide.Left
			};
			Border3DSide[] array2 = array;
			foreach (Border3DSide borderSide in array2)
			{
				DrawSolidBordersHelper(ref drawParams, borderSide);
			}
		}

		internal void DrawSolidBordersHelper(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams, Border3DSide borderSide)
		{
			GetStartAndEndPointsForOuterSolidLine(out var ptStart, out var ptEnd, borderSide);
			Pen solidPenToDrawStyledBorderWith = GetSolidPenToDrawStyledBorderWith(ref drawParams, borderSide);
			DrawSolidLine(ref drawParams, ptStart, ptEnd, borderSide, solidPenToDrawStyledBorderWith);
		}

		private void DrawSolidLine(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams, Point ptStart, Point ptEnd, Border3DSide borderSide)
		{
			DrawSolidLine(ref drawParams, ptStart, ptEnd, borderSide, null);
		}

		private void DrawSolidLine(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams, Point ptStart, Point ptEnd, Border3DSide borderSide, Pen pen)
		{
			if (pen == null)
			{
				pen = GetSolidPenToDrawStyledBorderWith(ref drawParams, borderSide);
			}
			((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.DrawLine(pen, ptStart, ptEnd);
		}

		private Pen GetSolidPenToDrawStyledBorderWith(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams, Border3DSide borderSide)
		{
			Pen pen = null;
			GroupBoxViewStyle groupBoxViewStyle = GroupBox?.ViewStyleResolved ?? GroupBoxViewStyle.Default;
			if (GroupBox != null && (((AppearanceData)(ref drawParams.AppearanceData)).BorderColor.IsEmpty || ((AppearanceData)(ref drawParams.AppearanceData)).BorderColor == Color.Transparent) && (groupBoxViewStyle == GroupBoxViewStyle.Office2003 || groupBoxViewStyle == GroupBoxViewStyle.VisualStudio2005))
			{
				switch (borderSide)
				{
				case Border3DSide.Right:
				case Border3DSide.Bottom:
					pen = groupBoxViewStyle switch
					{
						GroupBoxViewStyle.Office2003 => GroupBoxUtil.GetOffice2003DarkPen(ref drawParams), 
						GroupBoxViewStyle.Office2007 => GroupBoxUtil.GetOffice2007DarkPen(ref drawParams), 
						_ => GroupBoxUtil.GetVisualStudio2005DarkPen(ref drawParams), 
					};
					break;
				case Border3DSide.Left:
				case Border3DSide.Top:
					pen = groupBoxViewStyle switch
					{
						GroupBoxViewStyle.Office2003 => GroupBoxUtil.GetOffice2003LightPen(ref drawParams), 
						GroupBoxViewStyle.Office2007 => GroupBoxUtil.GetOffice2007LightPen(ref drawParams), 
						_ => GroupBoxUtil.GetVisualStudio2005LightPen(ref drawParams), 
					};
					break;
				}
			}
			if (pen == null)
			{
				pen = ((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).GetPen((PenType)0, ((AppearanceData)(ref drawParams.AppearanceData)).BorderColor);
			}
			if (pen == null)
			{
				pen = SystemPens.WindowFrame;
			}
			return pen;
		}

		private void ClipSpaceBetweenCaptionAndExpansionIndicator(UltraExpandableGroupBox expandableGrpBox, Region region)
		{
			GroupBoxHeaderUIElement header = expandableGrpBox.UIElement.Header;
			if (header == null || header.ExpansionElem == null || header.CaptionElem == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			Rectangle rect = ((UIElement)header.ExpansionElem).Rect;
			Rectangle rect2 = ((UIElement)header.CaptionElem).Rect;
			if (expandableGrpBox.HeaderIsHorizontal)
			{
				if (Math.Abs(rect.Left - rect2.Right) <= GroupBoxUtil.CaptionOffset || Math.Abs(rect2.Left - rect.Right) <= GroupBoxUtil.CaptionOffset)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			else if (Math.Abs(rect.Top - rect2.Bottom) <= GroupBoxUtil.CaptionOffset || Math.Abs(rect2.Top - rect.Bottom) <= GroupBoxUtil.CaptionOffset)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				int left = Math.Min(rect.Left, rect2.Left);
				int top = Math.Min(rect.Top, rect2.Top);
				int right = Math.Max(rect.Right - 1, rect2.Right - 1);
				int bottom = Math.Max(rect.Bottom - 1, rect2.Bottom - 1);
				region.Exclude(Rectangle.FromLTRB(left, top, right, bottom));
			}
		}
	}
