		protected override bool OnMouseDown(MouseEventArgs e, bool adjustableArea, ref UIElement captureMouseForElement)
		{
			if (e.Button == MouseButtons.Left)
			{
				captureMouseForElement = (UIElement)(object)this;
				ReceivedMouseDown = true;
				((Control)(object)GroupBox)?.Focus();
			}
			return ((UIElement)this).OnMouseDown(e, adjustableArea, ref captureMouseForElement);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter()
		{
			if (GroupBox is UltraExpandableGroupBox { UseHotTrackingResolved: not false })
			{
				((UIElement)this).DirtyChildElements(true);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave()
		{
			if (GroupBox is UltraExpandableGroupBox { UseHotTrackingResolved: not false })
			{
				((UIElement)this).DirtyChildElements(true);
			}
		}

		protected override bool OnMouseUp(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (GroupBox is UltraExpandableGroupBox ultraExpandableGroupBox)
			{
				Point pt = new Point(e.X, e.Y);
				bool flag = ultraExpandableGroupBox.HeaderClickActionResolved == GroupBoxHeaderClickAction.ToggleExpansion && ReceivedMouseDown && ((UIElement)this).Rect.Contains(pt) && e.Button == MouseButtons.Left;
				ReceivedMouseDown = false;
				if (flag)
				{
					DoHeaderClickAction();
				}
			}
			return ((UIElement)this).OnMouseUp(e);
		}

		protected override void PositionChildElements()
		{
			((ArrayList)(object)((UIElement)this).ChildElements).Clear();
			UltraGroupBox groupBox = GroupBox;
			if (groupBox == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Rectangle workRect = ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders;
			if (groupBox.HeaderIsVertical)
			{
				workRect.Inflate(0, -groupBox.InsideHeaderCaptionPadding);
			}
			else
			{
				workRect.Inflate(-groupBox.InsideHeaderCaptionPadding, 0);
			}
			if (groupBox.HasExpansionIndicator)
			{
				ConfigureExpansionIndicator(groupBox, ref workRect);
			}
			ConfigureCaptionElement(groupBox, ref workRect);
			if (groupBox.HasExpansionIndicator)
			{
				Rectangle rect = ((UIElement)ExpansionElem).Rect;
				if (groupBox.HeaderIsHorizontal)
				{
					DrawUtility.AdjustVAlign((VAlign)2, ref rect, ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders);
				}
				else
				{
					DrawUtility.AdjustHAlign((HAlign)2, ref rect, ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders);
				}
				((UIElement)ExpansionElem).Rect = rect;
			}
			Rectangle rect2 = ((UIElement)CaptionElem).Rect;
			if (groupBox.HeaderIsHorizontal)
			{
				DrawUtility.AdjustVAlign((VAlign)2, ref rect2, ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders);
			}
			else
			{
				DrawUtility.AdjustHAlign((HAlign)2, ref rect2, ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders);
			}
			((UIElement)CaptionElem).Rect = rect2;
		}

		internal void DoHeaderClickAction()
		{
			if (GroupBox is UltraExpandableGroupBox ultraExpandableGroupBox && (ultraExpandableGroupBox.GiveFocus() || IsDesignMode))
			{
				ultraExpandableGroupBox.Expanded = !ultraExpandableGroupBox.Expanded;
			}
		}

		private Size CalculateSizeOfImageAndTextElement(Image image, UltraGroupBox groupBox, Rectangle workRect)
		{
			Size size = Size.Empty;
			if (image != null)
			{
				size = image.Size;
			}
			bool headerIsVertical = groupBox.HeaderIsVertical;
			Size result = ImageAndTextUIElement.CalculateImageAndTextSize(size, ((UltraGroupBoxUIElement)(object)((UIElement)this).Parent).CaptionSize, new Size(0, 0), new Size(0, 0), new Size(0, 0), headerIsVertical, (UIElementBorderStyle)1, Border3DSide.All, ContentAlignment.MiddleLeft);
			if (!groupBox.WrapText)
			{
				if (headerIsVertical)
				{
					result.Height = Math.Min(workRect.Height, result.Height);
				}
				else
				{
					result.Width = Math.Min(workRect.Width, result.Width);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void ConfigureCaptionElement(UltraGroupBox groupBox, ref Rectangle workRect)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00be: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00cc: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00da: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b0: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			AppearanceData appData = default(AppearanceData);
			AppearancePropFlags val = (AppearancePropFlags)137438953471L;
			((UIElement)this).InitAppearance(ref appData, ref val);
			Image image = ((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).Image as Image;
			Size size = CalculateSizeOfImageAndTextElement(image, groupBox, workRect);
			ImageAndTextUIElementEx captionElem = CaptionElem;
			captionElem.Text = ((Control)(object)groupBox).Text;
			captionElem.Image = image;
			((UIElement)captionElem).Rect = new Rectangle(workRect.Location, size);
			captionElem.Vertical = groupBox.HeaderIsVertical;
			captionElem.MultiLine = groupBox.WrapText;
			captionElem.WrapText = groupBox.WrapText;
			captionElem.HotkeyPrefix = (groupBox.UseMnemonic ? HotkeyPrefix.Show : HotkeyPrefix.None);
			if (groupBox.ShouldHonorHeaderTextHAlign(ref appData))
			{
				captionElem.TextHAlign = ((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).TextHAlign;
			}
			captionElem.TextVAlign = ((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).TextVAlign;
			captionElem.ImageHAlign = ((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).ImageHAlign;
			captionElem.ImageVAlign = ((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).ImageVAlign;
			ConfigureTextPlacement(groupBox, ref appData);
			if (groupBox.HeaderIsHorizontal)
			{
				PositionHorizontalCaptionElement(groupBox, workRect);
				captionElem.RotateText = false;
			}
			else
			{
				PositionVerticalCaptionElement(groupBox, workRect);
				EnforceVerticalTextOrientation(groupBox);
			}
			((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)captionElem);
		}

		private void ConfigureExpansionIndicator(UltraGroupBox groupBox, ref Rectangle workRect)
		{
			//IL_0204: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_021c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			UltraExpandableGroupBox ultraExpandableGroupBox = groupBox as UltraExpandableGroupBox;
			GroupBoxExpansionIndicatorUIElement expansionElem = ExpansionElem;
			int expansionIndicatorOffsetFromBorder = groupBox.ExpansionIndicatorOffsetFromBorder;
			int expansionIndicatorOffsetFromCaption = groupBox.ExpansionIndicatorOffsetFromCaption;
			if (ultraExpandableGroupBox == null || expansionElem == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (ultraExpandableGroupBox.HeaderIsHorizontal)
			{
				if (ultraExpandableGroupBox.ExpansionIndicatorResolved == GroupBoxExpansionIndicator.Near)
				{
					Point location = workRect.Location;
					location.Offset(expansionIndicatorOffsetFromBorder, 0);
					((UIElement)expansionElem).Rect = new Rectangle(location, groupBox.ExpansionIndicatorSize);
					workRect.X = ((UIElement)expansionElem).Rect.Right - 1 + expansionIndicatorOffsetFromCaption;
				}
				else
				{
					Point location2 = new Point(workRect.Right - 1 - groupBox.ExpansionIndicatorSize.Width - expansionIndicatorOffsetFromBorder, workRect.Y);
					((UIElement)expansionElem).Rect = new Rectangle(location2, groupBox.ExpansionIndicatorSize);
				}
				workRect.Width -= groupBox.ExpansionIndicatorSize.Width + expansionIndicatorOffsetFromBorder + expansionIndicatorOffsetFromCaption;
			}
			else
			{
				if (ultraExpandableGroupBox.ExpansionIndicatorResolved == GroupBoxExpansionIndicator.Near)
				{
					Point location3 = workRect.Location;
					location3.Offset(0, expansionIndicatorOffsetFromBorder);
					((UIElement)expansionElem).Rect = new Rectangle(location3, groupBox.ExpansionIndicatorSize);
					workRect.Y = ((UIElement)expansionElem).Rect.Bottom + expansionIndicatorOffsetFromCaption;
				}
				else
				{
					Point location4 = new Point(workRect.Left, workRect.Bottom - 1 - groupBox.ExpansionIndicatorSize.Height - expansionIndicatorOffsetFromBorder);
					((UIElement)expansionElem).Rect = new Rectangle(location4, groupBox.ExpansionIndicatorSize);
				}
				workRect.Height -= groupBox.ExpansionIndicatorSize.Height + expansionIndicatorOffsetFromBorder + expansionIndicatorOffsetFromCaption;
			}
			((ButtonUIElementBase)expansionElem).HotTracking = ultraExpandableGroupBox.UseHotTrackingResolved;
			((ImageUIElementBase)expansionElem.ImageElem).Image = ultraExpandableGroupBox.ExpansionIndicatorImage;
			if (ultraExpandableGroupBox.ExpansionIndicatorImageIsCustom)
			{
				((ImageUIElementBase)expansionElem.ImageElem).Scaled = true;
			}
			else
			{
				((ImageUIElementBase)expansionElem.ImageElem).Scaled = false;
				((ImageUIElementBase)expansionElem.ImageElem).CenterImage = true;
				ColorMap colorMap = new ColorMap();
				colorMap.OldColor = Color.White;
				colorMap.NewColor = Color.Transparent;
				ColorMap colorMap2 = new ColorMap();
				colorMap2.OldColor = Color.Black;
				if (ultraExpandableGroupBox.ExpansionIndicatorUsesEmbeddedChevronBitmap)
				{
					AppearanceData appearance = default(AppearanceData);
					AppearancePropFlags requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)(((Control)(object)ultraExpandableGroupBox).Enabled ? 2 : 524288);
					ultraExpandableGroupBox.ResolveHeaderAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
					colorMap2.NewColor = (((Control)(object)ultraExpandableGroupBox).Enabled ? ((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).ForeColor : ((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).ForeColorDisabled);
				}
				else
				{
					colorMap2.NewColor = SystemColors.ControlText;
				}
				((ImageUIElementBase)expansionElem.ImageElem).ColorMaps = new ColorMap[2] { colorMap, colorMap2 };
			}
			((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)expansionElem);
		}

		private void ConfigureTextPlacement(UltraGroupBox groupBox, ref AppearanceData appData)
		{
			//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0032: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000f: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (groupBox.HeaderIsVertical)
			{
				if ((int)((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).ImageVAlign != 3)
				{
					CaptionElem.TextPlacement = (TextPlacement)2;
				}
				else
				{
					CaptionElem.TextPlacement = (TextPlacement)1;
				}
			}
			else if ((int)((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).ImageHAlign != 3)
			{
				CaptionElem.TextPlacement = (TextPlacement)4;
			}
			else
			{
				CaptionElem.TextPlacement = (TextPlacement)3;
			}
		}

		private void DrawSolidBorders(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			UltraGroupBox groupBox = GroupBox;
			if (groupBox == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			GroupBoxViewStyle viewStyleResolved = groupBox.ViewStyleResolved;
			bool flag = viewStyleResolved == GroupBoxViewStyle.Office2003;
			bool flag2 = viewStyleResolved == GroupBoxViewStyle.VisualStudio2005;
			if (groupBox.HeaderIsInsideBorder && groupBox.IsExpanded)
			{
				Border3DSide borderSideToDraw = GetBorderSideToDraw(groupBox);
				Pen pen;
				if (flag)
				{
					pen = GroupBoxUtil.GetOffice2003DarkPen(ref drawParams);
				}
				else
				{
					if (!flag2)
					{
						return;
					}
					pen = GroupBoxUtil.GetVisualStudio2005DarkPen(ref drawParams);
				}
				if (pen == null)
				{
					pen = SystemPens.WindowFrame;
				}
				DrawSolidLine(ref drawParams, pen, borderSideToDraw);
			}
			else
			{
				Pen penToDrawBorderSideWith = GetPenToDrawBorderSideWith(ref drawParams, flag, flag2, Border3DSide.Top);
				DrawSolidLine(ref drawParams, penToDrawBorderSideWith, Border3DSide.Top);
				DrawSolidLine(ref drawParams, penToDrawBorderSideWith, Border3DSide.Left);
				penToDrawBorderSideWith = GetPenToDrawBorderSideWith(ref drawParams, flag, flag2, Border3DSide.Right);
				DrawSolidLine(ref drawParams, penToDrawBorderSideWith, Border3DSide.Right);
				DrawSolidLine(ref drawParams, penToDrawBorderSideWith, Border3DSide.Bottom);
			}
		}

		private void DrawSolidLine(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams, Pen pen, Border3DSide borderSide)
		{
			GetStartAndEndPointsFromBorder3DSide(out var ptStart, out var ptEnd, borderSide);
			((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.DrawLine(pen, ptStart, ptEnd);
		}

		private void EnforceVerticalTextOrientation(UltraGroupBox groupBox)
		{
			GroupBoxVerticalTextOrientation verticalTextOrientationUnresolved = groupBox.VerticalTextOrientationUnresolved;
			if (groupBox.HeaderIsOnLeft && (verticalTextOrientationUnresolved == GroupBoxVerticalTextOrientation.Default || verticalTextOrientationUnresolved == GroupBoxVerticalTextOrientation.BottomToTop))
			{
				CaptionElem.RotateText = true;
			}
			else if (verticalTextOrientationUnresolved == GroupBoxVerticalTextOrientation.BottomToTop)
			{
				CaptionElem.RotateText = true;
			}
			else
			{
				CaptionElem.RotateText = false;
			}
		}

		private Border3DSide GetBorderSideToDraw(UltraGroupBox groupBox)
		{
			if (groupBox.HeaderIsOnTop)
			{
				return Border3DSide.Bottom;
			}
			if (groupBox.HeaderIsOnRight)
			{
				return Border3DSide.Left;
			}
			if (groupBox.HeaderIsOnBottom)
			{
				return Border3DSide.Top;
			}
			return Border3DSide.Right;
		}

		private Pen GetPenToDrawBorderSideWith(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams, bool isOffice2003, bool isVS2005, Border3DSide borderSide)
		{
			bool flag = borderSide == Border3DSide.Top || borderSide == Border3DSide.Left;
			if (isOffice2003)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					return GroupBoxUtil.GetOffice2003LightPen(ref drawParams);
				}
				return GroupBoxUtil.GetOffice2003DarkPen(ref drawParams);
			}
			if (isVS2005)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					return GroupBoxUtil.GetVisualStudio2005LightPen(ref drawParams);
				}
				return GroupBoxUtil.GetVisualStudio2005DarkPen(ref drawParams);
			}
			return SystemPens.WindowFrame;
		}

		private void GetStartAndEndPointsFromBorder3DSide(out Point ptStart, out Point ptEnd, Border3DSide borderSide)
		{
			Rectangle rect = ((UIElement)this).Rect;
			switch (borderSide)
			{
			case Border3DSide.Top:
				ptStart = new Point(rect.Left, rect.Top);
				ptEnd = new Point(rect.Right - 1, rect.Top);
				break;
			case Border3DSide.Bottom:
				ptStart = new Point(rect.Left, rect.Bottom - 1);
				ptEnd = new Point(rect.Right - 1, rect.Bottom - 1);
				break;
			case Border3DSide.Left:
				ptStart = new Point(rect.Left, rect.Bottom - 1);
				ptEnd = new Point(rect.Left, rect.Top);
				break;
			case Border3DSide.Right:
				ptStart = new Point(rect.Right - 1, rect.Top);
				ptEnd = new Point(rect.Right - 1, rect.Bottom - 1);
				break;
			default:
				ptStart = Point.Empty;
				ptEnd = Point.Empty;
				break;
			}
		}

		private void PositionHorizontalCaptionElement(UltraGroupBox groupBox, Rectangle workRect)
		{
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0016: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0027: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			GroupBoxCaptionAlignment captionAlignmentResolved = groupBox.CaptionAlignmentResolved;
			HAlign val = (HAlign)0;
			val = (HAlign)(captionAlignmentResolved switch
			{
				GroupBoxCaptionAlignment.Center => 2, 
				GroupBoxCaptionAlignment.Far => 3, 
				_ => 1, 
			});
			Rectangle rect = ((UIElement)CaptionElem).Rect;
			DrawUtility.AdjustHAlign(val, ref rect, workRect);
			((UIElement)CaptionElem).Rect = rect;
		}

		private void PositionVerticalCaptionElement(UltraGroupBox groupBox, Rectangle workRect)
		{
			if (groupBox.HeaderIsOnLeft)
			{
				PositionVerticalLeftCaptionElement(groupBox, workRect);
			}
			else
			{
				PositionVerticalRightCaptionElement(groupBox, workRect);
			}
		}

		private void PositionVerticalCaptionElementOnBottom(UltraGroupBox groupBox, Rectangle workRect)
		{
			Rectangle rect = ((UIElement)CaptionElem).Rect;
			DrawUtility.AdjustVAlign((VAlign)3, ref rect, workRect);
			((UIElement)CaptionElem).Rect = rect;
		}

		private void PositionVerticalCaptionElementOnCenter(UltraGroupBox groupBox, Rectangle workRect)
		{
			Rectangle rect = ((UIElement)CaptionElem).Rect;
			DrawUtility.AdjustVAlign((VAlign)2, ref rect, workRect);
			((UIElement)CaptionElem).Rect = rect;
		}

		private void PositionVerticalCaptionElementOnTop(UltraGroupBox groupBox, Rectangle workRect)
		{
			Rectangle rect = ((UIElement)CaptionElem).Rect;
			DrawUtility.AdjustVAlign((VAlign)1, ref rect, workRect);
			((UIElement)CaptionElem).Rect = rect;
		}

		private void PositionVerticalCaptionElementWhenNearMeansOnBottom(UltraGroupBox groupBox, Rectangle workRect)
		{
			switch (groupBox.CaptionAlignmentResolved)
			{
			case GroupBoxCaptionAlignment.Near:
				PositionVerticalCaptionElementOnBottom(groupBox, workRect);
				break;
			case GroupBoxCaptionAlignment.Far:
				PositionVerticalCaptionElementOnTop(groupBox, workRect);
				break;
			default:
				PositionVerticalCaptionElementOnCenter(groupBox, workRect);
				break;
			}
		}

		private void PositionVerticalCaptionElementWhenNearMeansOnTop(UltraGroupBox groupBox, Rectangle workRect)
		{
			switch (groupBox.CaptionAlignmentResolved)
			{
			case GroupBoxCaptionAlignment.Near:
				PositionVerticalCaptionElementOnTop(groupBox, workRect);
				break;
			case GroupBoxCaptionAlignment.Far:
				PositionVerticalCaptionElementOnBottom(groupBox, workRect);
				break;
			default:
				PositionVerticalCaptionElementOnCenter(groupBox, workRect);
				break;
			}
		}

		private void PositionVerticalLeftCaptionElement(UltraGroupBox groupBox, Rectangle workRect)
		{
			if (groupBox.VerticalTextOrientationUnresolved != GroupBoxVerticalTextOrientation.TopToBottom)
			{
				PositionVerticalCaptionElementWhenNearMeansOnBottom(groupBox, workRect);
			}
			else
			{
				PositionVerticalCaptionElementWhenNearMeansOnTop(groupBox, workRect);
			}
		}

		private void PositionVerticalRightCaptionElement(UltraGroupBox groupBox, Rectangle workRect)
		{
			if (groupBox.VerticalTextOrientationUnresolved == GroupBoxVerticalTextOrientation.BottomToTop)
			{
				PositionVerticalCaptionElementWhenNearMeansOnBottom(groupBox, workRect);
			}
			else
			{
				PositionVerticalCaptionElementWhenNearMeansOnTop(groupBox, workRect);
			}
		}
	}

		internal static bool ShouldUseNewAppearance(AppearanceHolder currentAppHolder, AppearanceBase newApp)
		{
			if (currentAppHolder != null && currentAppHolder.HasAppearance)
			{
				return newApp != currentAppHolder.Appearance;
			}
			return true;
		}

			}
		}

		protected class GroupBoxAccessibleObject : UltraControlAccessibleObject
		{
			private UltraGroupBox groupBox;

			public override string Name
			{
				get
				{
					if (((Control)(object)groupBox).AccessibleName != null)
					{
						return ((Control)(object)groupBox).AccessibleName;
					}
					return ((Control)(object)groupBox).Text;
				}
			}

			public override AccessibleRole Role
			{
				get
				{
					if (((Control)(object)groupBox).AccessibleRole != AccessibleRole.Default)
					{
						return ((Control.ControlAccessibleObject)this).Role;
					}
					return AccessibleRole.Grouping;
				}
			}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public override Rectangle DisplayRectangle
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_010d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0114: Expected O, but got Unknown
				//IL_0161: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0168: Expected O, but got Unknown
				if (UIElement == null)
				{
					return ((Control)this).ClientRectangle;
				}
				((UIElement)UIElement).VerifyChildElements();
				Rectangle rect = ((UIElement)UIElement.ContentArea.BackgroundElem).Rect;
				bool headerIsOnTop = HeaderIsOnTop;
				bool headerIsOnBottom = HeaderIsOnBottom;
				bool headerIsOnLeft = HeaderIsOnLeft;
				bool flag = !headerIsOnTop && !headerIsOnBottom && !headerIsOnLeft;
				bool headerIsOnBorder = HeaderIsOnBorder;
				bool headerIsOutsideBorder = HeaderIsOutsideBorder;
				bool flag2 = headerIsOnLeft || flag;
				bool flag3 = !flag2;
				int borderWidth = BorderWidth;
				int num = 0;
				int num2 = 0;
				int num3 = 0;
				int num4 = 0;
				if (BordersAreHeaderOnly)
				{
					if (headerIsOnTop)
					{
						num3 = borderWidth;
					}
					else if (flag)
					{
						num2 = borderWidth;
					}
					else if (headerIsOnBottom)
					{
						num4 = borderWidth;
					}
					else
					{
						num = borderWidth;
					}
				}
				else if (BordersAreParallel)
				{
					if (flag3)
					{
						num3 = borderWidth;
						num4 = borderWidth;
					}
					else
					{
						num2 = borderWidth;
						num = borderWidth;
					}
				}
				else if (BordersAreRectangular || BorderStyleResolved == GroupBoxBorderStyle.Rounded)
				{
					num3 = borderWidth;
					num4 = borderWidth;
					if (BorderStyleResolved == GroupBoxBorderStyle.Rectangular3D)
					{
						num4++;
					}
					num2 = borderWidth;
					num = borderWidth;
				}
				Margins val = new Margins(num, num3, num2, num4, false);
				if ((BorderStyleResolved == GroupBoxBorderStyle.Header3D || BorderStyleResolved == GroupBoxBorderStyle.Parallel3D || BorderStyleResolved == GroupBoxBorderStyle.Rectangular3D) && 0 < val.Bottom)
				{
					Margins obj = val;
					obj.Bottom -= 1;
				}
				if (BorderStyleResolved == GroupBoxBorderStyle.RectangularInset || BorderStyleResolved == GroupBoxBorderStyle.RectangularRaised)
				{
					val = new Margins(0, 0, 1, 0, false);
				}
				rect = val.AdjustRect(rect, false);
				if (!headerIsOutsideBorder)
				{
					Point location = rect.Location;
					Size size = rect.Size;
					Rectangle rect2 = ((UIElement)UIElement.Header).Rect;
					if (flag3)
					{
						if (headerIsOnTop)
						{
							location.Y = Math.Max(rect2.Bottom, location.Y);
							size.Height -= location.Y - rect.Top;
						}
						else if (rect2.Top < rect.Bottom)
						{
							size.Height -= rect.Bottom - rect2.Top;
						}
					}
					else if (headerIsOnLeft)
					{
						location.X = Math.Max(rect2.Right, location.X);
						size.Width -= location.X - rect.Left;
					}
					else if (rect2.Left < rect.Right)
					{
						size.Width -= rect.Right - rect2.Left;
					}
					rect = new Rectangle(location, size);
				}
				return ContentPadding.AdjustRect(rect, false);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public GroupBoxViewStyle ViewStyleResolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (!StyleUtils.GetCachedPropertyVal((UltraControlBase)(object)this, StyleUtils.CachedProperty.GroupBoxViewStyle, out var val))
				{
					val = StyleUtils.CachePropertyValue((UltraControlBase)(object)this, StyleUtils.CachedProperty.GroupBoxViewStyle, StyleUtils.GetGroupBoxViewStyle((ISupportAppStyling)(object)this, StyleUtils.CachedProperty.GroupBoxViewStyle), ViewStyle, GroupBoxViewStyle.Default, GroupBoxViewStyle.XP);
					GroupBoxViewStyle groupBoxViewStyle = (GroupBoxViewStyle)val;
					if (lastResolvedViewStyle != groupBoxViewStyle)
					{
						OnViewStyleChanged(groupBoxViewStyle);
						lastResolvedViewStyle = groupBoxViewStyle;
					}
				}
				return (GroupBoxViewStyle)val;
			}
		}

		internal bool BordersAreHeaderOnly
		{
			get
			{
				GroupBoxBorderStyle borderStyleResolved = BorderStyleResolved;
				if (borderStyleResolved != GroupBoxBorderStyle.Header3D && borderStyleResolved != GroupBoxBorderStyle.HeaderDoubleSolid)
				{
					return borderStyleResolved == GroupBoxBorderStyle.HeaderSolid;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal bool BordersAreParallel
		{
			get
			{
				GroupBoxBorderStyle borderStyleResolved = BorderStyleResolved;
				if (borderStyleResolved != GroupBoxBorderStyle.Parallel3D && borderStyleResolved != GroupBoxBorderStyle.ParallelDoubleSolid)
				{
					return borderStyleResolved == GroupBoxBorderStyle.ParallelSolid;
				}
				return true;
			}

		internal bool BordersAreRectangular
		{
			get
			{
				GroupBoxBorderStyle borderStyleResolved = BorderStyleResolved;
				if (borderStyleResolved != GroupBoxBorderStyle.Rectangular3D && borderStyleResolved != GroupBoxBorderStyle.RectangularDoubleSolid && borderStyleResolved != GroupBoxBorderStyle.RectangularInset && borderStyleResolved != GroupBoxBorderStyle.RectangularRaised)
				{
					return borderStyleResolved == GroupBoxBorderStyle.RectangularSolid;
				}
				return true;
			}

		internal bool BordersAreRoundedWhenExpanded => GroupBoxBorderStyle.Rounded == BorderStyleResolved;

		internal int BorderWidth
		{
			get
			{
				int result = 0;
				switch (BorderStyleResolved)
				{
				case GroupBoxBorderStyle.None:
					result = 0;
					break;
				case GroupBoxBorderStyle.HeaderSolid:
					result = 1;
					break;
				case GroupBoxBorderStyle.Header3D:
					result = 2;
					break;
				case GroupBoxBorderStyle.HeaderDoubleSolid:
					result = 3;
					break;
				case GroupBoxBorderStyle.ParallelSolid:
					result = 1;
					break;
				case GroupBoxBorderStyle.Parallel3D:
					result = 2;
					break;
				case GroupBoxBorderStyle.ParallelDoubleSolid:
					result = 3;
					break;
				case GroupBoxBorderStyle.RectangularSolid:
					result = 1;
					break;
				case GroupBoxBorderStyle.Rectangular3D:
					result = 2;
					break;
				case GroupBoxBorderStyle.RectangularDoubleSolid:
					result = 3;
					break;
				case GroupBoxBorderStyle.RectangularInset:
				case GroupBoxBorderStyle.RectangularRaised:
					result = 2;
					break;
				case GroupBoxBorderStyle.Rounded:
					result = 2;
					break;
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		internal VAlign HeaderImageVAlignResolved
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0032: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0031: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (HeaderIsHorizontal)
				{
					return (VAlign)2;
				}
				VAlign result = (VAlign)1;
				if (HeaderIsOnLeft && VerticalTextOrientationUnresolved != GroupBoxVerticalTextOrientation.TopToBottom)
				{
					result = (VAlign)3;
				}
				if (HeaderIsOnRight && VerticalTextOrientationUnresolved == GroupBoxVerticalTextOrientation.BottomToTop)
				{
					result = (VAlign)3;
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		internal int HeaderInsideBorderOffset
		{
			get
			{
				GroupBoxViewStyle viewStyleResolved = ViewStyleResolved;
				bool flag = viewStyleResolved == GroupBoxViewStyle.Office2003 || viewStyleResolved == GroupBoxViewStyle.VisualStudio2005;
				if (BorderStyleResolved == GroupBoxBorderStyle.None)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				if (BorderStyleResolved == GroupBoxBorderStyle.Rounded)
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						return 0;
					}
					return 3;
				}
				if (flag && BorderStyleResolved == GroupBoxBorderStyle.RectangularSolid)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				if (!HeaderIsVertical)
				{
					return 2;
				}
				return 3;
			}
		}

		public Size GetPreferredControlSize(Size contentSize)
		{
			UltraGroupBoxUIElement uIElement = UIElement;
			if (uIElement == null)
			{
				return contentSize;
			}
			GroupBoxHeaderUIElement header = uIElement.Header;
			GroupBoxContentAreaUIElement contentArea = uIElement.ContentArea;
			if (header != null && contentArea != null)
			{
				if (HeaderIsHorizontal)
				{
					int num = ((UIElement)header).Rect.Height;
					if (HeaderIsOnBorder)
					{
						num -= BorderWidth;
					}
					contentSize.Height += num;
				}
				else
				{
					int num2 = ((UIElement)header).Rect.Width;
					if (HeaderIsOnBorder)
					{
						num2 -= BorderWidth;
					}
					contentSize.Width += num2;
				}
			}
			contentSize.Width += 2 * BorderWidth + ContentPadding.Left + ContentPadding.Right;
			contentSize.Height += 2 * BorderWidth + ContentPadding.Top + ContentPadding.Bottom;
			return contentSize;
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				if (appearanceHolder != null)
				{
					appearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged -= SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					appearanceHolder = null;
				}
				if (contentAreaAppearanceHolder != null)
				{
					contentAreaAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged -= SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					contentAreaAppearanceHolder = null;
				}
				if (contentPadding != null && !((DisposableObject)(object)contentPadding).Disposed)
				{
					((SubObjectBase)(object)contentPadding).SubObjectPropChanged -= SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					contentPadding = null;
				}
				if (controlElement != null && !((DisposableObject)(object)controlElement).Disposed)
				{
					((DisposableObject)(object)controlElement).Dispose();
					controlElement = null;
				}
				if (headerAppearanceHolder != null)
				{
					headerAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged -= SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					headerAppearanceHolder = null;
				}
				if (license != null)
				{
					license.Dispose();
					license = null;
				}
			}
			((UltraControlBase)this).Dispose(disposing);
		}

		protected override void OnEnabledChanged(EventArgs e)
		{
			((Control)this).OnEnabledChanged(e);
			if (!((Control)this).IsDisposed && ((Control)this).Created && UIElement != null)
			{
				((UIElement)UIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
				((UIElement)UIElement).VerifyChildElements(true);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnFontChanged(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (UIElement != null)
			{
				((UIElement)UIElement).DirtyChildElements(false);
			}
			((UltraControlBase)this).OnFontChanged(e);
		}

		protected override void OnLayout(LayoutEventArgs levent)
		{
			if (UIElement != null)
			{
				((UIElement)UIElement).DirtyChildElements(((Component)this).DesignMode);
			}
			((Control)this).OnLayout(levent);
		}

		protected override void OnResize(EventArgs e)
		{
			bool flag = isResizing;
			try
			{
				isResizing = true;
				if (!((Control)this).Created)
				{
					((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).Rect = ((Control)this).ClientRectangle;
				}
				((UltraControlBase)this).OnResize(e);
			}
			finally
			{
				isResizing = flag;
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChangeInfo)
		{
			if (!IsInitializing)
			{
				((UIElement)UIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
				if (propChangeInfo.Source == ContentPadding)
				{
					StyleUtils.DirtyCachedPropertyVals((UltraControlBase)(object)this);
					((Control)this).PerformLayout();
				}
				if (propChangeInfo.Source is AppearanceBase)
				{
					RefreshPanel();
				}
			}
			if (propChangeInfo.Source is AppearanceBase)
			{
				SyncBackColor();
			}
			((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange(propChangeInfo.PropId, propChangeInfo.Trigger);
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.ChangeInfo.PropId is GroupBoxPropertyIds)
			{
				switch ((GroupBoxPropertyIds)(object)e.ChangeInfo.PropId)
				{
				case GroupBoxPropertyIds.BorderStyle:
				case GroupBoxPropertyIds.CaptionAlignment:
				case GroupBoxPropertyIds.ExpansionIndicator:
				case GroupBoxPropertyIds.ExpansionIndicatorCollapsed:
				case GroupBoxPropertyIds.ExpansionIndicatorExpanded:
				case GroupBoxPropertyIds.HeaderBorderStyle:
				case GroupBoxPropertyIds.HeaderPosition:
				case GroupBoxPropertyIds.HotTracking:
				case GroupBoxPropertyIds.ShowFocus:
				case GroupBoxPropertyIds.VerticalTextOrientation:
				case GroupBoxPropertyIds.ViewStyle:
					StyleUtils.DirtyCachedPropertyVals((UltraControlBase)(object)this);
					break;
				case GroupBoxPropertyIds.Appearance:
					SyncBackColor();
					break;
				}
			}
			((UltraControlBase)this).OnPropertyChanged(e);
		}

		protected override bool ProcessMnemonic(char charCode)
		{
			if (!UseMnemonic || !((Control)this).Enabled || !((Control)this).Visible)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Control.IsMnemonic(charCode, ((Control)(object)this).Text))
			{
				try
				{
					((Control)this).SelectNextControl((Control)(object)this, forward: true, tabStopOnly: false, nested: true, wrap: false);
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		protected void RefreshControlSize()
		{
			if (!isInitializing && this is UltraExpandableGroupBox ultraExpandableGroupBox)
			{
				suppressExpansionEvents = true;
				ultraExpandableGroupBox.SetExpanded(!ultraExpandableGroupBox.Expanded, modifyControlSize: false);
				ultraExpandableGroupBox.SetExpanded(!ultraExpandableGroupBox.Expanded, modifyControlSize: true);
				suppressExpansionEvents = false;
			}
		}

		internal void AdjustAppearanceForHeaderOrientation(Color topColor, Color bottomColor, ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0060: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			{
				get

					{

				: base(expandableGroupBox)
			{
				this.expandableGroupBox = expandableGroupBox;

			}

		public override GroupBoxBorderStyle BorderStyleResolved
		{
			get
			{
				GroupBoxBorderStyle borderStyleResolved = base.BorderStyleResolved;
				if (Expanded)
				{
					return borderStyleResolved;
				}
				switch (borderStyleResolved)
				{
				case GroupBoxBorderStyle.Header3D:
				case GroupBoxBorderStyle.HeaderDoubleSolid:
				case GroupBoxBorderStyle.HeaderSolid:
				case GroupBoxBorderStyle.None:
					return borderStyleResolved;
				case GroupBoxBorderStyle.Parallel3D:
				case GroupBoxBorderStyle.Rectangular3D:
					if (base.HeaderIsInsideBorder)
					{
						return GroupBoxBorderStyle.Rectangular3D;
					}
					return GroupBoxBorderStyle.Header3D;
				case GroupBoxBorderStyle.ParallelDoubleSolid:
				case GroupBoxBorderStyle.RectangularDoubleSolid:
					if (base.HeaderIsInsideBorder)
					{
						return GroupBoxBorderStyle.RectangularDoubleSolid;
					}
					return GroupBoxBorderStyle.HeaderDoubleSolid;
				case GroupBoxBorderStyle.ParallelSolid:
				case GroupBoxBorderStyle.RectangularSolid:
					if (base.HeaderIsInsideBorder)
					{
						return GroupBoxBorderStyle.RectangularSolid;
					}
					return GroupBoxBorderStyle.HeaderSolid;
				case GroupBoxBorderStyle.Rounded:
					if (base.HeaderIsInsideBorder)
					{
						if (base.ViewStyleResolved == GroupBoxViewStyle.Office2000 || base.ViewStyleResolved == GroupBoxViewStyle.XP)
						{
							return GroupBoxBorderStyle.Rounded;
						}
						return GroupBoxBorderStyle.RectangularSolid;
					}
					return GroupBoxBorderStyle.HeaderSolid;
				default:
					return GroupBoxBorderStyle.Header3D;
				}
			}
		}

		private Image ExpansionIndicatorCollapsedUnresolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (!StyleUtils.GetCachedPropertyVal((UltraControlBase)(object)this, StyleUtils.CachedProperty.ExpansionIndicatorCollapsed, out var val))
				{
					val = StyleUtils.CachePropertyValue((UltraControlBase)(object)this, StyleUtils.CachedProperty.ExpansionIndicatorCollapsed, expansionIndicatorCollapsedCustom, null, null);
				}
				return (Image)val;
			}
		}

		internal Image ExpansionIndicatorCollapsedResolved
		{
			get
			{
				Image expansionIndicatorCollapsedUnresolved = ExpansionIndicatorCollapsedUnresolved;
				if (expansionIndicatorCollapsedUnresolved == null)
				{
					if (expansionIndicatorCollapsedDefault == null)
					{
						LoadDefaultCollapsedExpansionIndicatorImage();
					}
					expansionIndicatorCollapsedUnresolved = expansionIndicatorCollapsedDefault;
				}
				return expansionIndicatorCollapsedUnresolved;
			}
		}

		private Image ExpansionIndicatorExpandedUnresolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (!StyleUtils.GetCachedPropertyVal((UltraControlBase)(object)this, StyleUtils.CachedProperty.ExpansionIndicatorExpanded, out var val))
				{
					val = StyleUtils.CachePropertyValue((UltraControlBase)(object)this, StyleUtils.CachedProperty.ExpansionIndicatorExpanded, expansionIndicatorExpandedCustom, null, null);
				}
				return (Image)val;
			}
		}

		internal Image ExpansionIndicatorExpandedResolved
		{
			get
			{
				Image expansionIndicatorExpandedUnresolved = ExpansionIndicatorExpandedUnresolved;
				if (expansionIndicatorExpandedUnresolved == null)
				{
					if (expansionIndicatorExpandedDefault == null)
					{
						LoadDefaultExpandedExpansionIndicatorImage();
					}
					expansionIndicatorExpandedUnresolved = expansionIndicatorExpandedDefault;
				}
				return expansionIndicatorExpandedUnresolved;
			}
		}

		internal Image ExpansionIndicatorImage
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_000f: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				if (!(((int)isExpandedWhileInitializing == 0) ? Expanded : ((int)isExpandedWhileInitializing == 1)))
				{
					return ExpansionIndicatorCollapsedResolved;
				}
				return ExpansionIndicatorExpandedResolved;
			}
		}

		internal bool ExpansionIndicatorImageIsCustom
		{
			get
			{
				if (Expanded)
				{
					return ExpansionIndicatorExpandedUnresolved != null;
				}
				return ExpansionIndicatorCollapsedUnresolved != null;
			}
		}

		internal bool ExpansionIndicatorUsesEmbeddedChevronBitmap
		{
			get
			{
				GroupBoxViewStyle viewStyleResolved = base.ViewStyleResolved;
				if (!ExpansionIndicatorImageIsCustom)
				{
					return viewStyleResolved switch
					{
						GroupBoxViewStyle.Office2003 => !XPThemes.IsThemeActive, 
						GroupBoxViewStyle.VisualStudio2005 => true, 
						_ => false, 
					};
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsInDesignMode => ((Component)(object)this).DesignMode;

		internal bool UseHotTrackingResolved
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0033: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0038: Invalid comparison between I4 and Unknown
				//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0021: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (!StyleUtils.GetCachedPropertyVal((UltraControlBase)(object)this, StyleUtils.CachedProperty.UseHotTracking, out var val))
				{
					val = StyleUtils.CachePropertyValue((UltraControlBase)(object)this, StyleUtils.CachedProperty.UseHotTracking, UseHotTracking, (object)(DefaultableBoolean)0, UseHotTrackingDefault);
				}
				return 1 == (int)(DefaultableBoolean)val;
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldMergeHotTrackingAppearanceSettings
		{
			get
			{
				if (!((Component)(object)this).DesignMode && UseHotTrackingResolved && base.UIElement != null && base.UIElement.Header != null)
				{
					return ((UIElement)base.UIElement.Header).Contains(((Control)(object)this).PointToClient(Control.MousePosition), false);
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private DefaultableBoolean UseHotTrackingDefault
		{
			get
			{
				switch (base.ViewStyleResolved)
				{
				case GroupBoxViewStyle.Office2000:
				case GroupBoxViewStyle.Office2003:
				case GroupBoxViewStyle.VisualStudio2005:
				case GroupBoxViewStyle.XP:
					return (DefaultableBoolean)2;
				case GroupBoxViewStyle.Office2007:
					return (DefaultableBoolean)1;
				default:
					return (DefaultableBoolean)2;
				}
			}
		}

		public event CancelEventHandler ExpandedStateChanging
		{
			add
			{
				((Component)(object)this).Events.AddHandler(EVENT_EXPANDEDSTATECHANGING, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				((Component)(object)this).Events.RemoveHandler(EVENT_EXPANDEDSTATECHANGING, value);
			}
		}

		public UltraExpandableGroupBox()
		{
			TabStop = true;
			((Control)(object)this).SetStyle(ControlStyles.Selectable, value: true);
		}

		public override Size GetPreferredSize(Size proposedSize)
		{
			if (panel != null)
			{
				Size preferredControlSize = GetPreferredControlSize(Size.Empty);
				if (proposedSize.Width != 0)
				{
					proposedSize.Width -= preferredControlSize.Width;
				}
				if (proposedSize.Height != 0)
				{
					proposedSize.Height -= preferredControlSize.Height;
				}
				return GetPreferredControlSize(((Control)(object)panel).GetPreferredSize(proposedSize));
			}
			return ((Control)(object)this).GetPreferredSize(proposedSize);
		}

		internal void SetExpanded(bool value, bool modifyControlSize)
		{
			//IL_0010: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0045: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (base.IsInitializing)
			{
				isExpandedWhileInitializing = (DefaultableBoolean)(value ? 1 : 2);
			}
			else
			{
				if (value == expanded)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (!base.SuppressExpansionEvents)
				{
					CancelEventArgs e = new CancelEventArgs();
					FireEvent(GroupBoxEventId.ExpandedStateChanging, e);
					if (e.Cancel)
					{
						return;
					}
				}
				if (!value && (int)isExpandedWhileInitializing == 0 && !base.SuppressExpansionEvents)
				{
					ExpandedSize = ((Control)(object)this).Size;
				}
				expanded = value;
				if (!base.SuppressExpansionEvents)
				{
					SetPanelVisibility(value);
				}
				if (modifyControlSize)
				{
					ModifyControlSize(useExpandedSize: true);
				}
				((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
				((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).VerifyChildElements(true);
				if (!base.SuppressExpansionEvents)
				{
					((Control)(object)this).PerformLayout();
				}
				((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)GroupBoxPropertyIds.Expanded);
				if (!base.SuppressExpansionEvents)
				{
					FireEvent(GroupBoxEventId.ExpandedStateChanged, EventArgs.Empty);
				}
			}
		}

		internal override void OnViewStyleChanged(GroupBoxViewStyle newValue)
		{
			ResetExpansionIndicatorCollapsedDefault();
			ResetExpansionIndicatorExpandedDefault();
		}

		private void ResetExpansionIndicatorCollapsedDefault()
		{
			if (expansionIndicatorCollapsedDefault != null)
			{
				expansionIndicatorCollapsedDefault.Dispose();
				expansionIndicatorCollapsedDefault = null;
			}
		}

		private void ResetExpansionIndicatorExpandedDefault()
		{
			if (expansionIndicatorExpandedDefault != null)
			{
				expansionIndicatorExpandedDefault.Dispose();
				expansionIndicatorExpandedDefault = null;
			}
		}

		protected override Control.ControlCollection CreateControlsInstance()
		{
			return new ExpandableGroupBoxControlCollection(this);
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				if (expansionIndicatorCollapsedDefault != null)
				{
					expansionIndicatorCollapsedDefault.Dispose();
					expansionIndicatorCollapsedDefault = null;
				}
				if (expansionIndicatorExpandedDefault != null)
				{
					expansionIndicatorExpandedDefault.Dispose();
					expansionIndicatorExpandedDefault = null;
				}
			}
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		protected override bool IsPointDesignTimeActive(Point pt)
		{
			if (base.UIElement != null)
			{
				UIElement val = ((UIElement)base.UIElement).ElementFromPoint(pt);
				if (val != null && val.GetAncestor(typeof(GroupBoxExpansionIndicatorUIElement)) != null)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void OnCreateControl()
		{
			if (!base.IsInitializing)
			{
				CreateContainerControl();
			}
			((UltraControlBase)this).OnCreateControl();
			SetExpandedStateOnceControlIsCreatedAndInitialized();
		}

		protected override void OnEndInit()
		{
			if (Utilities.GetParent((Control)(object)this) != null)
			{
				CreateContainerControl();
			}
			SetExpandedStateOnceControlIsCreatedAndInitialized();
			base.OnEndInit();
		}

		protected virtual void OnExpandedStateChanged(EventArgs e)
		{
			((EventHandler)((Component)(object)this).Events[EVENT_EXPANDEDSTATECHANGED])?.Invoke(this, e);
		}

		protected virtual void OnExpandedStateChanging(EventArgs e)
		{
			((CancelEventHandler)((Component)(object)this).Events[EVENT_EXPANDEDSTATECHANGING])?.Invoke(this, e as CancelEventArgs);
		}

		protected override void OnGotFocus(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (ShowFocus && ExpansionIndicatorResolved != GroupBoxExpansionIndicator.None && base.UIElement != null && base.UIElement.Header != null)
			{
				((UIElement)base.UIElement.Header).DirtyChildElements(true);
			}
			((UltraControlBase)this).OnGotFocus(e);
		}

		protected override void OnKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			((UltraControlBase)this).OnKeyDown(e);
			if (!e.Handled && (e.KeyCode == Keys.Space || e.KeyCode == Keys.Return))
			{
				Expanded = !Expanded;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnLostFocus(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (ShowFocus && ExpansionIndicatorResolved != GroupBoxExpansionIndicator.None && !((Control)(object)this).Disposing && !((Control)(object)this).IsDisposed && base.UIElement != null && base.UIElement.Header != null)
			{
				((UIElement)base.UIElement.Header).DirtyChildElements(true);
			}
			((UltraControlBase)this).OnLostFocus(e);
		}

		protected override void OnResize(EventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0077: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			base.OnResize(e);
			if (!Expanded)
			{
				ModifyControlSize(useExpandedSize: false);
				if (base.HeaderIsHorizontal)
				{
					ExpandedSize = new Size(((Control)(object)this).Size.Width, ExpandedSize.Height);
				}
				else
				{
					ExpandedSize = new Size(ExpandedSize.Width, ((Control)(object)this).Size.Height);
				}
			}
			else if (!base.IsInitializing && (int)isExpandedWhileInitializing == 0)
			{
				ExpandedSize = ((Control)(object)this).Size;
			}
		}

		protected override bool ProcessMnemonic(char charCode)
		{
			if (!base.UseMnemonic || !((Control)(object)this).Enabled || !((Control)(object)this).Visible)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Control.IsMnemonic(charCode, ((Control)(object)this).Text))
			{
				if (GiveFocus())
				{
					Expanded = !Expanded;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void RefreshPanel()
		{
			if (Panel != null && !((Control)(object)Panel).Disposing)
			{
				((Control)(object)Panel).Invalidate();
			}
		}

		protected override ComponentRole CreateComponentRole()
		{
			return (ComponentRole)(object)new MiscControlRole((UltraControlBase)(object)this, StyleUtils.ComponentType.UltraExpandableGroupBox);
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.ChangeInfo.PropId is GroupBoxPropertyIds)
			{
				switch ((GroupBoxPropertyIds)(object)e.ChangeInfo.PropId)
				{
				case GroupBoxPropertyIds.ExpansionIndicator:
				case GroupBoxPropertyIds.ExpansionIndicatorCollapsed:
				case GroupBoxPropertyIds.ExpansionIndicatorExpanded:
					StyleUtils.DirtyCachedPropertyVals((UltraControlBase)(object)this);
					break;
				}
			}
			base.OnPropertyChanged(e);
		}

		protected virtual void OnPanelInitialized()
		{
		}

		internal void FireEvent(GroupBoxEventId eventId, EventArgs args)
		{
			switch (eventId)
			{
			case GroupBoxEventId.ExpandedStateChanged:
				OnExpandedStateChanged(args);
				break;
			case GroupBoxEventId.ExpandedStateChanging:
				OnExpandedStateChanging(args);
				break;
			}
		}

		internal bool GiveFocus()
		{
			if (((Control)(object)this).CanFocus)
			{
				((Control)(object)this).Focus();
				return ((Control)(object)this).Focused;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal override void ResolveHeaderAppearanceInternal(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			ResolutionOrderInfo resOrder;
			UIRole role = StyleUtils.GetRole((UltraControlBase)(object)this, StyleUtils.GetSpecificRole((UltraControlBase)(object)this, StyleUtils.Role.UltraGroupBoxHeader), out resOrder);
			if (ShouldMergeHotTrackingAppearanceSettings)
			{
				if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseStyleBefore && role != null)
				{
					role.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)4);
				}
				if (HasHeaderHotTrackingAppearance && ((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseControlInfo)
				{
					HeaderHotTrackingAppearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
				}
				if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseStyleAfter && role != null)
				{
					role.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)4);
				}
				if (((ulong)requestedProps & 2uL) != 0 && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)2))
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).ForeColor = SystemColors.HotTrack;
					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFDuL);
				}
			}
			if (Expanded)
			{
				if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseStyleBefore && role != null)
				{
					role.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)4194304);
				}
				if (HasHeaderExpandedAppearance && ((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseControlInfo)
				{
					HeaderExpandedAppearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
				}
				if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseStyleAfter && role != null)
				{
					role.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)4194304);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseStyleBefore && role != null)
				{
					role.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)68719476736L);
				}
				if (HasHeaderCollapsedAppearance && ((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseControlInfo)
				{
					HeaderCollapsedAppearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
				}
				if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseStyleAfter && role != null)
				{
					role.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)68719476736L);
				}
			}
			base.ResolveHeaderAppearanceInternal(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
		}

		private void CreateContainerControl()
		{
			UltraExpandableGroupBoxPanel ultraExpandableGroupBoxPanel = panel;
			foreach (Control control in Controls)
			{
				if (control is UltraExpandableGroupBoxPanel)
				{
					panel = control as UltraExpandableGroupBoxPanel;
					if (ultraExpandableGroupBoxPanel == null || panel != ultraExpandableGroupBoxPanel)
					{
						OnPanelInitialized();
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			if (((Component)(object)this).GetService(typeof(IDesignerHost)) is IDesignerHost designerHost)
			{
				panel = designerHost.CreateComponent(typeof(UltraExpandableGroupBoxPanel)) as UltraExpandableGroupBoxPanel;
			}
			else
			{
				panel = new UltraExpandableGroupBoxPanel();
			}
			if (panel != null)
			{
				Controls.Add((Control)(object)panel);
				((Control)(object)panel).Dock = DockStyle.Fill;
				OnPanelInitialized();
			}
		}

		private void LoadDefaultCollapsedExpansionIndicatorImage()
		{
			string text = null;
			text = ((!ExpansionIndicatorUsesEmbeddedChevronBitmap) ? "GroupBox.ExpansionIndicator_Plus.bmp" : "GroupBox.ExpansionIndicator_Chevron.bmp");
			if (text != null)
			{
				Stream manifestResourceStream = typeof(UltraExpandableGroupBox).Module.Assembly.GetManifestResourceStream(typeof(UltraExpandableGroupBox), text);
				Image image = null;
				if (manifestResourceStream != null)
				{
					image = Image.FromStream(manifestResourceStream);
				}
				expansionIndicatorCollapsedDefault = image;
			}
		}

		private void LoadDefaultExpandedExpansionIndicatorImage()
		{
			string text = null;
			text = ((!ExpansionIndicatorUsesEmbeddedChevronBitmap) ? "GroupBox.ExpansionIndicator_Minus.bmp" : "GroupBox.ExpansionIndicator_Chevron.bmp");
			if (text == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Stream manifestResourceStream = typeof(UltraExpandableGroupBox).Module.Assembly.GetManifestResourceStream(typeof(UltraExpandableGroupBox), text);
			Image image = null;
			if (manifestResourceStream != null)
			{
				image = Image.FromStream(manifestResourceStream);
			}
			if (image != null && ExpansionIndicatorUsesEmbeddedChevronBitmap)
			{
				using Bitmap bitmap = new Bitmap(image);
				bitmap.RotateFlip(RotateFlipType.Rotate180FlipNone);
				image = bitmap.Clone() as Image;
			}
			expansionIndicatorExpandedDefault = image;
		}

		private void ModifyControlSize(bool useExpandedSize)
		{
			Size empty = Size.Empty;
			if (Expanded)
			{
				empty = ((!(ExpandedSize != Size.Empty) || base.IsInitializing) ? ((Control)(object)this).Size : ExpandedSize);
			}
			else
			{
				((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).DirtyChildElements(false);
				((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).VerifyChildElements(true);
				int height = ((Control)(object)this).Size.Height;
				int width = ((Control)(object)this).Size.Width;
				if (useExpandedSize && !ExpandedSize.IsEmpty)
				{
					height = ExpandedSize.Height;
					width = ExpandedSize.Width;
				}
				if (base.HeaderIsHorizontal)
				{
					height = ((UIElement)base.UIElement.Header).Rect.Height;
					height = (base.HeaderIsInsideBorder ? (height + (base.BorderWidth * 2 + base.HeaderInsideBorderOffset * 2)) : ((!base.HeaderIsOutsideBorder) ? (height + base.BorderWidth * 2) : (height + (base.BorderWidth + base.HeaderOutsideBorderOffset))));
				}
				else
				{
					width = ((UIElement)base.UIElement.Header).Rect.Width;
					width = (base.HeaderIsInsideBorder ? (width + (base.BorderWidth * 2 + base.HeaderInsideBorderOffset * 2)) : ((!base.HeaderIsOutsideBorder) ? (width + base.BorderWidth * 2) : (width + (base.BorderWidth + base.HeaderOutsideBorderOffset))));
				}
				empty = new Size(width, height);
			}
			TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(this)["Size"].SetValue(this, empty);
		}

		private void SetExpandedStateOnceControlIsCreatedAndInitialized()
		{
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0020: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002f: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0038: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (((Control)(object)this).Created && !base.IsInitializing && (int)isExpandedWhileInitializing != 0)
			{
				Expanded = (int)isExpandedWhileInitializing == 1;
				expanded = (int)isExpandedWhileInitializing == 1;
				isExpandedWhileInitializing = (DefaultableBoolean)0;
			}
		}

		private void SetPanelVisibility(bool makeVisible)
		{
			if (Panel == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!base.IsDesignMode)
			{
				((Control)(object)Panel).Visible = makeVisible;
				((Control)(object)Panel).Dock = DockStyle.Fill;
				return;
			}
			PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(Panel)["Visible"];
			if (makeVisible)
			{
				propertyDescriptor.SetValue(Panel, true);
				((Control)(object)Panel).Dock = DockStyle.Fill;
			}
			else
			{
				propertyDescriptor.SetValue(Panel, false);
				Panel.Location = new Point(-10000, -10000);
				((Control)(object)Panel).Dock = DockStyle.None;
			}
		}

		private void DetermineHorizontalHeaderSize(UltraGroupBox groupBox, GroupBoxContentAreaUIElement contentArea, GroupBoxHeaderUIElement header, Size imageSize, ref AppearanceData appData)
		{
			//IL_010c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			//IL_011c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			int unavailableHorizontalHeaderSpace = GetUnavailableHorizontalHeaderSpace(groupBox, contentArea, header, imageSize, ref appData);
			size.Width -= unavailableHorizontalHeaderSpace;
			Size sizeOfCaption = GetSizeOfCaption(groupBox, ref appData, size, textIsVertical: false);
			Rectangle rect = new Rectangle(new Point(0, 0), ((UIElement)contentArea).RectInsideBorders.Size);

			{
				rect.Height += 2;
			}
			UIElementBorderWidths borderWidths = ((UIElement)header).GetBorderWidths(((UIElement)header).BorderStyle, ((UIElement)header).BorderSides);
			rect.Height += ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref borderWidths)).Top + ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref borderWidths)).Bottom;
			((UIElement)header).Rect = rect;
		}

		private void DetermineVerticalHeaderSize(UltraGroupBox groupBox, GroupBoxContentAreaUIElement contentArea, GroupBoxHeaderUIElement header, Size imageSize, ref AppearanceData appData)

		private Size GetSizeOfCaption(UltraGroupBox groupBox, ref AppearanceData appData, Size availableSpace, bool textIsVertical)
		{
			//IL_00b0: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Font font = null;
			Graphics cachedGraphics = DrawUtility.GetCachedGraphics((Control)(object)groupBox);
			StringFormat stringFormat = null;
			try
			{
				font = (((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).HasFontData ? ((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).CreateFont(((Control)(object)groupBox).Font) : ((Control)(object)groupBox).Font);
				if (font == null)
				{
					font = ((Control)(object)groupBox).Font;
				}
				stringFormat = new StringFormat();
				if (!groupBox.WrapText)
				{
					stringFormat.FormatFlags |= StringFormatFlags.NoWrap;
				}
				if (textIsVertical)
				{
					stringFormat.FormatFlags |= StringFormatFlags.DirectionVertical;
				}
				string text = (groupBox.UseMnemonic ? CaptionTextWithAmpersandsRemoved : ((Control)(object)groupBox).Text);
				if (groupBox.WrapText)
				{
					captionSize = Size.Ceiling(DrawUtility.MeasureString(cachedGraphics, text, font, (SizeF)availableSpace, stringFormat, DrawUtility.GetGdiDrawStringFlags((UIElement)(object)this)));
				}
				else
				{
					captionSize = Size.Ceiling(DrawUtility.MeasureString(cachedGraphics, text, font, PointF.Empty, stringFormat, DrawUtility.GetGdiDrawStringFlags((UIElement)(object)this)));
				}
				if (!textIsVertical)
				{
					if (captionSize.Width > 0)
					{
						captionSize.Width += 2;
					}
				}
				else if (captionSize.Height > 0)
				{
					captionSize.Height += 2;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				DrawUtility.ReleaseCachedGraphics(cachedGraphics);
				if (font != ((Control)(object)groupBox).Font)
				{
					font.Dispose();
				}
				stringFormat?.Dispose();
			}
			return captionSize;
		}

		private void AdjustContentAreaSizeAndLocation(UltraGroupBox groupBox, GroupBoxContentAreaUIElement contentArea, GroupBoxHeaderUIElement header)
		{
			if (!groupBox.HeaderIsInsideBorder)
			{
				Size size = CalculateDeflationSizeForContentArea(groupBox, ((UIElement)header).Rect.Size);
				Rectangle rect = ((UIElement)contentArea).Rect;
				rect.Width -= size.Width;
				rect.Height -= size.Height;
				int num = groupBox.BorderWidth + 1;
				if (rect.Height < num)
				{
					size.Height -= num - rect.Height;
					rect.Height = num;
				}
				else if (rect.Width < num)
				{
					size.Width -= num - rect.Width;
					rect.Width = num;
				}
				if (groupBox.HeaderIsOnTop || groupBox.HeaderIsOnLeft)
				{
					rect.Offset(size.Width, size.Height);
				}
				((UIElement)contentArea).Rect = rect;
			}
		}

		private Size CalculateDeflationSizeForContentArea(UltraGroupBox groupBox, Size headerSize)
		{
			Size empty = Size.Empty;
			if (groupBox.HeaderIsHorizontal)
			{
				if (groupBox.HeaderIsOnBorder)
				{
					empty.Height = headerSize.Height / 2;
				}
				else if (headerSize.Height > 0)
				{
					empty.Height = headerSize.Height + groupBox.HeaderOutsideBorderOffset;
				}
			}
			else if (groupBox.HeaderIsOnBorder)
			{
				empty.Width = headerSize.Width / 2;
			}
			else if (headerSize.Width > 0)
			{
				empty.Width = headerSize.Width + groupBox.HeaderOutsideBorderOffset;
			}
			return empty;
		}

		private void AdjustHeaderLocation(UltraGroupBox groupBox, GroupBoxContentAreaUIElement contentArea, GroupBoxHeaderUIElement header)
		{
			if (groupBox.HeaderIsHorizontal)
			{
				AdjustHorizontalHeaderLocation(groupBox, contentArea, header);
			}
			else
			{
				AdjustVerticalHeaderLocation(groupBox, contentArea, header);
			}
			if (groupBox.HeaderIsInsideBorder)
			{
				AdjustHeaderLocationWhenInsideBorder(groupBox, contentArea, header);
			}
		}

		private void AdjustHorizontalHeaderLocation(UltraGroupBox groupBox, GroupBoxContentAreaUIElement contentArea, GroupBoxHeaderUIElement header)
		{
			if (!groupBox.HeaderSpansEntireContentArea)
			{
				((UIElement)header).Offset(GroupBoxUtil.CaptionOffset, 0);
			}
			else
			{
				((UIElement)header).Offset(1, 0);
			}
			if (groupBox.HeaderIsOnBottom)
			{
				int num = ((Control)(object)groupBox).ClientRectangle.Bottom - ((UIElement)header).Rect.Height;
				int num2 = num - ((UIElement)header).Rect.Top;
				((UIElement)header).Offset(0, num2);
			}
		}

		private void AdjustHeaderLocationWhenInsideBorder(UltraGroupBox groupBox, GroupBoxContentAreaUIElement contentArea, GroupBoxHeaderUIElement header)
		{
			Rectangle rect = ((UIElement)header).Rect;
			GroupBoxViewStyle viewStyleResolved = groupBox.ViewStyleResolved;
			if ((viewStyleResolved == GroupBoxViewStyle.Office2003 || viewStyleResolved == GroupBoxViewStyle.VisualStudio2005 || viewStyleResolved == GroupBoxViewStyle.Office2007) && groupBox.BorderStyleResolved == GroupBoxBorderStyle.Rounded)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (groupBox.BordersAreRectangular)
			{
				if (groupBox.HeaderIsHorizontal)
				{
					rect.Inflate(-groupBox.BorderWidth, 0);
				}
				else
				{
					rect.Inflate(0, -groupBox.BorderWidth);
				}
			}
			if (groupBox.HeaderIsHorizontal)
			{
				if (groupBox.HeaderIsOnTop)
				{
					rect.Offset(0, groupBox.BorderWidth + groupBox.HeaderInsideBorderOffset);
				}
				else
				{
					rect.Offset(0, -groupBox.BorderWidth - groupBox.HeaderInsideBorderOffset);
				}
			}
			else if (groupBox.HeaderIsOnLeft)
			{
				rect.Offset(groupBox.BorderWidth + groupBox.HeaderInsideBorderOffset, 0);
			}
			else
			{
				rect.Offset(-groupBox.BorderWidth - groupBox.HeaderInsideBorderOffset, 0);
			}
			((UIElement)header).Rect = rect;
		}

		private void AdjustVerticalHeaderLocation(UltraGroupBox groupBox, GroupBoxContentAreaUIElement contentArea, GroupBoxHeaderUIElement header)
		{
			if (!groupBox.HeaderSpansEntireContentArea)
			{
				((UIElement)header).Offset(0, GroupBoxUtil.CaptionOffset);
			}
			else
			{
				((UIElement)header).Offset(0, 1);
			}
			if (groupBox.HeaderIsOnRight)
			{
				int num = ((Control)(object)groupBox).ClientRectangle.Right - ((UIElement)header).Rect.Width;
				int num2 = num - ((UIElement)header).Rect.Left;
				((UIElement)header).Offset(num2, 0);
				((UIElement)header).Rect = new Rectangle(((UIElement)header).Rect.X, ((UIElement)header).Rect.Y, ((UIElement)header).Rect.Width, ((UIElement)header).Rect.Height);
			}
		}

		private int GetUnavailableVerticalHeaderSpace(UltraGroupBox groupBox, GroupBoxContentAreaUIElement contentArea, GroupBoxHeaderUIElement header, Size imageSize, ref AppearanceData appData)

		}

					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		Size ILayoutItem.MinimumSize => MinimumSize;

		Size ILayoutItem.PreferredSize => PreferredSize;

		bool ILayoutItem.IsVisible
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_00ce: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (!IncludeInLayout)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (Control.IsDisposed || Control.Disposing)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!Control.Visible)
				{
					Control parent = Utilities.GetParent(Control);
					if (parent == null)
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (parent is UltraGridBagLayoutPanel && parent.Site != null && parent.Site.DesignMode)
					{
						PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(control)["Visible"];
						if (propertyDescriptor != null && false.Equals(propertyDescriptor.GetValue(Control)))
						{
							return false;
						}
					}
					else if (parent.Visible)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				if (Control.Dock != DockStyle.None)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (DropDownManager.IsDropDownControl(Control))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (Control is ILayoutItem)
				{
					return ((ILayoutItem)Control).IsVisible;
				}
				if (Control.GetType().FullName == "Infragistics.Win.UltraWinChart.IGWinTooltip")
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public ControlLayoutItem(Control control)
		{
			if (control == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("control");
			}
			this.control = control;
			includeInLayout = IncludeInLayoutDefault;
			minimumSize = new Size(-1, -1);
			preferredSize = new Size(-1, -1);
		}

		public bool ShouldSerializeMinimumSize()
		{
			if (-1 == minimumSize.Width)
			{
				return -1 != minimumSize.Height;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void ResetMinimumSize()
		{
			MinimumSize = new Size(-1, -1);
		}

		public bool ShouldSerializePreferredSize()
		{
			if (-1 == preferredSize.Width)
			{
				return -1 != preferredSize.Height;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void ResetPreferredSize()
		{
			PreferredSize = new Size(-1, -1);
		}
	}

				ControlLayoutItem controlLayoutItem = (ControlLayoutItem)(object)item;
				PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(controlLayoutItem.Control)["Location"];
				PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor2 = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(controlLayoutItem.Control)["Size"];

				{
					propertyDescriptor.SetValue(controlLayoutItem.Control, rect.Location);
					propertyDescriptor2.SetValue(controlLayoutItem.Control, rect.Size);
				}
				else
				{
					((ILayoutContainer)layoutManager).PositionItem(item, rect, containerContext);
				}
			}

			Rectangle ILayoutContainer.GetBounds(object containerContext)
			{
				return ((ILayoutContainer)layoutManager).GetBounds(containerContext);
			}
		}
