		protected abstract LayoutManagerBase CreateLayoutManager();

		protected virtual void OnControlLayoutItemRemoved(ControlLayoutItem layoutItem)
		{
		}

		protected abstract void InitializeConstraint(ControlLayoutItem layoutItem);

		protected virtual void PerformLayout(bool invalidateLayout, bool invokeControlPerformLayout)
		{
			if (ContainerControl == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (invalidateLayout)
			{
				LayoutManager.InvalidateLayout();
			}
			if (IsLayoutSuspended)
			{
				isLayoutPending = true;
			}
			else if (!IsInitializing)
			{
				if (!invokeControlPerformLayout)
				{
					Control control = ContainerControl;
					control.SuspendLayout();
					LayoutManager.LayoutContainer(LayoutContainerResolved, (object)control);
					control.ResumeLayout(performLayout: true);
				}
				else
				{
					ContainerControl.PerformLayout();
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChangeInfo)
		{
			if (propChangeInfo.Source == margins)
			{
				PerformLayout(invalidateLayout: true);
				((UltraComponentBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)ControlLayoutManagerPropertyIds.Margins, propChangeInfo);
			}
		}

		protected internal ControlLayoutItem GetControlLayoutItem(Control control, bool createIfNull)
		{
			if (Controls.ContainsKey(control))
			{
				return (ControlLayoutItem)Controls[control];
			}
			if (control != null && createIfNull)
			{
				if (!IsInitializing && !IsDesignMode && ContainerControl != null)
				{
					ContainerControl.Controls.Contains(control);
				}
				ControlLayoutItem controlLayoutItem = CreateLayoutItem(control);
				InitializeConstraint(controlLayoutItem);
				Controls.Add(control, controlLayoutItem);
				return controlLayoutItem;
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected virtual void OnContainerControlChanged(Control previousContainerControl, Control newContainerControl)
		{
		}

		private void OnContainerControl_Disposed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			ContainerControl = null;
		}

		private void OnContainerControl_ControlAdded(object sender, ControlEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!suspendAutoCreationOfConstraints)
			{
				if (tempRemoveControlList != null && tempRemoveControlList.Contains(e.Control))
				{
					tempRemoveControlList.Remove(e.Control);
					return;
				}
				TypeDescriptor.Refresh(e.Control);
				AddControlToList(e.Control);
				PerformLayout(invalidateLayout: true);
			}
		}

		private void OnContainerControl_ControlRemoved(object sender, ControlEventArgs e)
		{
			IServiceProvider serviceProvider = ServiceProvider;
			if (serviceProvider != null && serviceProvider.GetService(typeof(IDesignerHost)) is IDesignerHost { InTransaction: not false } designerHost)
			{
				Control control = tempControlBeingRemoved;
				tempControlBeingRemoved = e.Control;
				try
				{
					object[] customAttributes = ((object)this).GetType().GetCustomAttributes(typeof(ProvidePropertyAttribute), inherit: true);
					for (int i = 0; i < customAttributes.Length; i++)
					{
						ProvidePropertyAttribute providePropertyAttribute = customAttributes[i] as ProvidePropertyAttribute;
						PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(e.Control)[providePropertyAttribute.PropertyName];
						if (propertyDescriptor != null && propertyDescriptor.ShouldSerializeValue(e.Control))
						{
							IComponentChangeService componentChangeService = serviceProvider.GetService(typeof(IComponentChangeService)) as IComponentChangeService;
							componentChangeService.OnComponentChanging(e.Control, propertyDescriptor);
							componentChangeService.OnComponentChanged(e.Control, propertyDescriptor, propertyDescriptor.GetValue(e.Control), null);
						}
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					tempControlBeingRemoved = control;
				}
				if (tempRemoveControlList != null)
				{
					tempRemoveControlList.Add(e.Control);
					return;
				}
				tempRemoveControlList = new ArrayList();
				tempRemoveControlList.Add(e.Control);
				designerHost.TransactionClosed += OnDesignerTransactionClosed;
			}
			else
			{
				OnControlRemovedHelper(e.Control);
			}
		}

		private void OnContainerControl_Layout(object sender, LayoutEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!suspendAutoCreationOfConstraints)
			{
				if (e.AffectedControl != null && ContainerControl.Controls.Count == LayoutManager.LayoutItems.Count + 1 && GetControlLayoutItem(e.AffectedControl, createIfNull: false) == null && ContainerControl.Controls.Contains(e.AffectedControl))
				{
					AddControlToList(e.AffectedControl);
				}
				VerifyControlsListOrder();
				PerformLayout(invalidateLayout: true, invokeControlPerformLayout: false);
			}
		}

		private void OnControlRemovedHelper(Control control)
		{
			TypeDescriptor.Refresh(control);
			RemoveControlFromList(control);
			PerformLayout(invalidateLayout: true);
		}

		private void OnDesignerTransactionClosed(object sender, DesignerTransactionCloseEventArgs e)
		{
			((IDesignerHost)sender).TransactionClosed -= OnDesignerTransactionClosed;
			ArrayList arrayList = tempRemoveControlList;
			tempRemoveControlList = null;
			if (arrayList != null && arrayList.Count > 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < arrayList.Count; i++)
				{
					OnControlRemovedHelper(arrayList[i] as Control);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void AddControlToList(Control control)
		{
			ControlLayoutItem controlLayoutItem = GetControlLayoutItem(control, createIfNull: true);
			if (!LayoutManager.LayoutItems.Contains((ILayoutItem)(object)controlLayoutItem))
			{
				LayoutManager.LayoutItems.Add((ILayoutItem)(object)controlLayoutItem, controlLayoutItem.Constraint);
				TypeDescriptor.Refresh(control);
			}
			else
			{
				LayoutManager.LayoutItems.Remove((ILayoutItem)(object)controlLayoutItem);
				LayoutManager.LayoutItems.Add((ILayoutItem)(object)controlLayoutItem, controlLayoutItem.Constraint);
			}
		}

		private void RemoveControlFromList(Control control)
		{
			if (!IsInitializing && Controls.ContainsKey(control))
			{
				ControlLayoutItem controlLayoutItem = (ControlLayoutItem)Controls[control];
				Controls.Remove(control);
				LayoutManager.LayoutItems.Remove((ILayoutItem)(object)controlLayoutItem);
				OnControlLayoutItemRemoved(controlLayoutItem);
			}
		}

		private void ReloadControlsList()
		{
			if (ContainerControl == null)
			{
				if (controls != null)
				{
					int count = controls.Count;
					object[] array = new object[count];
					controls.Keys.CopyTo(array, 0);
					object[] array2 = array;
					for (int i = 0; i < array2.Length; i++)
					{
						Control control = (Control)array2[i];
						RemoveControlFromList(control);
					}
				}
				return;
			}
			Hashtable hashtable = new Hashtable();
			int num = 0;
			for (num = 0; num < ContainerControl.Controls.Count; num++)
			{
				Control control2 = ContainerControl.Controls[num];
				ControlLayoutItem controlLayoutItem = (ControlLayoutItem)(hashtable[control2] = GetControlLayoutItem(control2, createIfNull: true));
				if (!LayoutManager.LayoutItems.Contains((ILayoutItem)(object)controlLayoutItem))
				{
					LayoutManager.LayoutItems.Add((ILayoutItem)(object)controlLayoutItem, controlLayoutItem.Constraint);
					continue;
				}
				LayoutManager.LayoutItems.Remove((ILayoutItem)(object)controlLayoutItem);
				LayoutManager.LayoutItems.Insert(num, (ILayoutItem)(object)controlLayoutItem, controlLayoutItem.Constraint);
			}
			if (controls != null)
			{
				int count2 = controls.Count;
				object[] array3 = new object[count2];
				controls.Keys.CopyTo(array3, 0);
				object[] array4 = array3;
				for (int j = 0; j < array4.Length; j++)
				{
					Control control3 = (Control)array4[j];
					if (!hashtable.ContainsKey(control3))
					{
						RemoveControlFromList(control3);
					}
				}
			}
			controls = hashtable;
			foreach (Control control4 in containerControl.Controls)
			{
				TypeDescriptor.Refresh(control4);
			}
		}

		private void VerifyControlsListOrder()
		{
			if (ContainerControl.Controls.Count != LayoutManager.LayoutItems.Count)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < ContainerControl.Controls.Count; i++)
			{
				Control control = ContainerControl.Controls[i];
				if (!Controls.Contains(control))
				{
					break;
				}
				ControlLayoutItem controlLayoutItem = (ControlLayoutItem)(object)LayoutManager.LayoutItems[i];
				if (control != controlLayoutItem.Control)
				{
					ControlLayoutItem controlLayoutItem2 = (ControlLayoutItem)controls[control];
					object constraint = LayoutManager.LayoutItems.GetConstraint((ILayoutItem)(object)controlLayoutItem2);
					LayoutManager.LayoutItems.Remove((ILayoutItem)(object)controlLayoutItem2);
					LayoutManager.LayoutItems.Insert(i, (ILayoutItem)(object)controlLayoutItem2, constraint);
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnDesignerHostLoadComplete(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			IDesignerHost designerHost = sender as IDesignerHost;
			designerHost.LoadComplete -= OnDesignerHostLoadComplete;
			ReloadControlsList();
			PerformLayout(invalidateLayout: true, invokeControlPerformLayout: true);
		}

		private ControlLayoutManagerBase GetLayoutManagerForControl(Control control)
		{
			if (!(((Component)(object)this).GetService(typeof(IDesignerHost)) is IDesignerHost { Container: not null } designerHost))
			{
				return null;
			}
			foreach (object component in designerHost.Container.Components)
			{
				if (component is ControlLayoutManagerBase controlLayoutManagerBase && controlLayoutManagerBase != this && controlLayoutManagerBase.ContainerControl == control)
				{
					return controlLayoutManagerBase;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private bool AreAllControlsIncludedInLayout()
		{
			if (ContainerControl == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			foreach (Control control in ContainerControl.Controls)
			{
				if (!GetIncludeInLayout(control))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void UpdateContainerControl(Control oldContainerControl, Control newContainerControl)
		{
			if (!(((Component)(object)this).GetService(typeof(IExtenderProviderService)) is IExtenderProviderService extenderProviderService))
			{
				containerControl = newContainerControl;
				if (oldContainerControl != null)
				{
					foreach (Control control in oldContainerControl.Controls)
					{
						TypeDescriptor.Refresh(control);
					}
				}
				if (newContainerControl == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				{
					foreach (Control control2 in newContainerControl.Controls)
					{
						TypeDescriptor.Refresh(control2);
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			extenderProviderService.RemoveExtenderProvider(this);
			if (oldContainerControl != null)
			{
				foreach (Control control3 in oldContainerControl.Controls)
				{
					TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(control3);
				}
			}
			if (newContainerControl != null)
			{
				foreach (Control control4 in newContainerControl.Controls)
				{
					TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(control4);
				}
			}
			containerControl = newContainerControl;
			extenderProviderService.AddExtenderProvider(this);
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Layout")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_ControlLayoutManagerBase_P_MinimumSize")]
		public Size GetMinimumSize(Control control)
		{
			return GetControlLayoutItem(control, createIfNull: false)?.MinimumSize ?? Size.Empty;
		}

		public void SetMinimumSize(Control control, Size size)
		{
			ControlLayoutItem controlLayoutItem = GetControlLayoutItem(control, createIfNull: true);
			if (controlLayoutItem != null && (controlLayoutItem.MinimumSize != size || !controlLayoutItem.ShouldSerializeMinimumSize()))
			{
				controlLayoutItem.MinimumSize = size;
				PerformLayout(invalidateLayout: true);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool ShouldSerializeMinimumSize(Control control)
		{
			return GetControlLayoutItem(control, createIfNull: false)?.ShouldSerializeMinimumSize() ?? false;
		}

		public void ResetMinimumSize(Control control)
		{
			GetControlLayoutItem(control, createIfNull: false)?.ResetMinimumSize();
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_ControlLayoutManagerBase_P_PreferredSize")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Layout")]
		public Size GetPreferredSize(Control control)
		{
			return GetControlLayoutItem(control, createIfNull: false)?.PreferredSize ?? Size.Empty;
		}

		public void SetPreferredSize(Control control, Size size)
		{
			ControlLayoutItem controlLayoutItem = GetControlLayoutItem(control, createIfNull: true);
			if (controlLayoutItem != null && (controlLayoutItem.PreferredSize != size || !controlLayoutItem.ShouldSerializePreferredSize()))
			{
				controlLayoutItem.PreferredSize = size;
				PerformLayout(invalidateLayout: true);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool ShouldSerializePreferredSize(Control control)
		{
			return GetControlLayoutItem(control, createIfNull: false)?.ShouldSerializePreferredSize() ?? false;
		}

		public void ResetPreferredSize(Control control)
		{
			GetControlLayoutItem(control, createIfNull: false)?.ResetPreferredSize();
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_ControlLayoutManagerBase_P_IncludeInLayout")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Layout")]
		public bool GetIncludeInLayout(Control control)
		{
			return GetControlLayoutItem(control, createIfNull: false)?.IncludeInLayout ?? false;
		}

		public void SetIncludeInLayout(Control control, bool includeInLayout)
		{
			ControlLayoutItem controlLayoutItem = GetControlLayoutItem(control, createIfNull: true);
			if (controlLayoutItem != null && controlLayoutItem.IncludeInLayout != includeInLayout)
			{
				controlLayoutItem.IncludeInLayout = includeInLayout;
				PerformLayout(invalidateLayout: true);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool ShouldSerializeIncludeInLayout(Control control)
		{
			ControlLayoutItem controlLayoutItem = GetControlLayoutItem(control, createIfNull: false);
			if (controlLayoutItem != null)
			{
				return controlLayoutItem.IncludeInLayout != controlLayoutItem.IncludeInLayoutDefault;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void ResetIncludeInLayout(Control control)
		{
			ControlLayoutItem controlLayoutItem = GetControlLayoutItem(control, createIfNull: false);
			if (controlLayoutItem != null)
			{
				controlLayoutItem.IncludeInLayout = controlLayoutItem.IncludeInLayoutDefault;
			}
		}

		public void SuspendLayout()
		{
			layoutSuspendedCount++;
		}

		public void ResumeLayout()
		{
			ResumeLayout(processingPendingLayout: true);
		}

		public void ResumeLayout(bool processingPendingLayout)
		{
			if (layoutSuspendedCount > 0)
			{
				layoutSuspendedCount--;
				if (layoutSuspendedCount == 0 && isLayoutPending && processingPendingLayout)
				{
					PerformLayout(invalidateLayout: true, invokeControlPerformLayout: true);
				}
			}
		}

		public void PerformLayout()
		{
			PerformLayout(invalidateLayout: false);
		}

		public void PerformLayout(bool invalidateLayout)
		{
			PerformLayout(invalidateLayout, invokeControlPerformLayout: true);
		}

		internal bool IsValidControlContainer(Control control, bool excludeIfManagedByOtherLayoutMgr)
		{
			if (!((Component)this).DesignMode)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (control == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ContainerControl == control)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ContainerControl is IStatusBar)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (excludeIfManagedByOtherLayoutMgr)
			{
				ControlLayoutManagerBase layoutManagerForControl = GetLayoutManagerForControl(control);
				if (layoutManagerForControl != null && layoutManagerForControl.ContainerControl != null && layoutManagerForControl.AreAllControlsIncludedInLayout())
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (control is UltraGridBagLayoutPanel)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (control is Form || control is Panel || control is System.Windows.Forms.GroupBox)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (control is TabControl)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (control is UltraGroupBox && !(control is UltraExpandableGroupBox))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!(control is ScrollableControl))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (control is ManagedContainerControlBase)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (control is UserControl && ((Component)(object)this).GetService(typeof(IDesignerHost)) is IDesignerHost designerHost)
			{
				foreach (Control control2 in control.Controls)
				{
					if (designerHost.GetDesigner(control2) != null)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void InternalReloadControlList()
		{
			ReloadControlsList();
		}

		internal void SetContainerControl(Control value)
		{
			if (containerControl != value)
			{
				Control previousContainerControl = containerControl;
				if (containerControl != null)
				{
					containerControl.ControlAdded -= OnContainerControl_ControlAdded;
					containerControl.ControlRemoved -= OnContainerControl_ControlRemoved;
					containerControl.Disposed -= OnContainerControl_Disposed;
					containerControl.Layout -= OnContainerControl_Layout;
				}
				UpdateContainerControl(containerControl, value);
				if (!IsInitializing)
				{
					ReloadControlsList();
				}
				if (containerControl != null)
				{
					containerControl.ControlAdded += OnContainerControl_ControlAdded;
					containerControl.ControlRemoved += OnContainerControl_ControlRemoved;
					containerControl.Disposed += OnContainerControl_Disposed;
					containerControl.Layout += OnContainerControl_Layout;
				}
				PerformLayout(invalidateLayout: true);
				OnContainerControlChanged(previousContainerControl, containerControl);
			}
		}

		void ISupportInitialize.BeginInit()
		{
			isInitializing = true;
			OnBeginInit();
		}

		void ISupportInitialize.EndInit()
		{
			isInitializing = false;
			if (!(((Component)(object)this).GetService(typeof(IDesignerHost)) is IDesignerHost { Loading: not false } designerHost))
			{
				ReloadControlsList();
			}
			else
			{
				designerHost.LoadComplete += OnDesignerHostLoadComplete;
			}
			OnEndInit();
		}

		bool IExtenderProvider.CanExtend(object obj)
		{
			Control control = obj as Control;
			if (control == tempControlBeingRemoved)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (control != null && ContainerControl != null && ContainerControl.Controls.Contains(control) && !(control is IDockingArea))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		void ILayoutContainer.PositionItem(ILayoutItem item, Rectangle rect, object containerContext)
		{
			ControlLayoutItem controlLayoutItem = (ControlLayoutItem)(object)item;
			if (controlLayoutItem.Control.AutoSize)
			{
				Size size = rect.Size;
				Size preferredSize = controlLayoutItem.Control.GetPreferredSize(size);
				if (controlLayoutItem.Control is TextBoxBase textBoxBase)
				{
					if (!textBoxBase.Multiline)
					{
						rect.Height = Math.Min(preferredSize.Height, size.Height);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					rect.Width = Math.Min(preferredSize.Width, size.Width);
					rect.Height = Math.Min(preferredSize.Height, size.Height);
				}
			}
			controlLayoutItem.Control.SetBounds(rect.X, rect.Y, rect.Width, rect.Height);
		}

		Rectangle ILayoutContainer.GetBounds(object containerContext)
		{
			Rectangle rectangle = ContainerControl.DisplayRectangle;
			if (margins != null)
			{
				rectangle = margins.AdjustRect(rectangle, false);
			}
			return rectangle;
		}
	}

	public class LayoutControlContainerTypeConverter : ReferenceConverter
	{
		public LayoutControlContainerTypeConverter()
			: base(typeof(Control))
		{
		}

		public override bool GetStandardValuesSupported(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool IsValueAllowed(ITypeDescriptorContext context, object value)
		{
			if (!(context.Instance is ControlLayoutManagerBase controlLayoutManagerBase))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (value == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!(value is Control control))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return controlLayoutManagerBase.IsValidControlContainer(control, excludeIfManagedByOtherLayoutMgr: false);
		}
	}

		private Size GetLayoutItemActualSize(GridBagLayoutItemDimensions gbResizeItemDim, GridBagLayoutItemDimensionsCollection actualItemDims)
		{
			Size empty = Size.Empty;
			int originX = gbResizeItemDim.OriginX;
			int num = gbResizeItemDim.OriginX + gbResizeItemDim.SpanX;
			empty.Width = actualItemDims.ColumnDims[num] - actualItemDims.ColumnDims[originX];
			int originY = gbResizeItemDim.OriginY;
			int num2 = gbResizeItemDim.OriginY + gbResizeItemDim.SpanY;
			empty.Height = actualItemDims.RowDims[num2] - actualItemDims.RowDims[originY];
			return empty;
		}

		internal void GetLayoutResizeItems(ref ILayoutItem resizeItem, Size containerSize, out GridBagLayoutManager gridBagLM, out Size preferredLayoutSize, out GridBagLayoutItemDimensionsCollection preferredItemDims, out GridBagLayoutItemDimensionsCollection actualItemDims, bool recalcPreferredItemDims)
		{
			preferredLayoutSize = Size.Empty;
			gridBagLM = GridBagLayoutManagerComponent.GridBagLayoutManager;
			preferredItemDims = null;
			actualItemDims = null;
			if (resizeItem is ControlLayoutItem)
			{
				preferredLayoutSize = ((LayoutManagerBase)gridBagLM).CalculatePreferredSize((ILayoutContainer)(object)new LayoutContainerCalcSize(), (object)null);
				preferredItemDims = gridBagLM.GetLayoutItemDimensions((ILayoutContainer)(object)new LayoutContainerCalcSize(preferredLayoutSize), (object)null);
				if (recalcPreferredItemDims && gridBagLM != null)
				{
					actualItemDims = null;
				}
				if (containerSize.Width == 0)
				{
					containerSize.Width = preferredLayoutSize.Width;
				}
				if (containerSize.Height == 0)
				{
					containerSize.Height = preferredLayoutSize.Height;
				}
				if (Math.Abs(containerSize.Width - preferredLayoutSize.Width) > 10 || Math.Abs(containerSize.Height - preferredLayoutSize.Height) > 10 || actualItemDims == null)
				{
					actualItemDims = gridBagLM.GetLayoutItemDimensions((ILayoutContainer)(object)new LayoutContainerCalcSize(containerSize), (object)null);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ResizeLayoutItem(ILayoutItem resizeItem, Size containerSize, Point delta)
		{
			ResizeLayoutItemHelper(resizeItem, containerSize, Size.Empty, delta, 0 != delta.X, 0 != delta.Y);
		}

		internal void ResizeLayoutItemHelper(ILayoutItem resizeItem, Size containerSize, Size itemTargetSize, Point delta, bool modifyWidthDimension, bool modifyHeightDimension)
		{
			if (!modifyHeightDimension && !modifyWidthDimension)
			{
				return;
			}
			GridBagLayoutItemDimensionsCollection preferredItemDims = null;
			GridBagLayoutItemDimensionsCollection actualItemDims = null;
			GridBagLayoutManager gridBagLM = null;
			Size preferredLayoutSize = Size.Empty;
			GetLayoutResizeItems(ref resizeItem, containerSize, out gridBagLM, out preferredLayoutSize, out preferredItemDims, out actualItemDims, recalcPreferredItemDims: false);
			if (gridBagLM == null || preferredItemDims == null || actualItemDims == null || resizeItem == null || !actualItemDims.Exists(resizeItem))
			{
				return;
			}
			GridBagLayoutItemDimensions val = actualItemDims[resizeItem];
			int originX = val.OriginX;
			int spanX = val.SpanX;
			int originY = val.OriginY;
			int spanY = val.SpanY;
			Size layoutItemActualSize = GetLayoutItemActualSize(val, actualItemDims);
			if (itemTargetSize.IsEmpty)
			{
				itemTargetSize.Width = layoutItemActualSize.Width + delta.X;
				itemTargetSize.Height = layoutItemActualSize.Height + delta.Y;
			}
			if (!modifyWidthDimension)
			{
				itemTargetSize.Width = layoutItemActualSize.Width;
			}
			if (!modifyHeightDimension)
			{
				itemTargetSize.Height = layoutItemActualSize.Height;
			}
			Size size = itemTargetSize;
			int num = 20;
			int num2 = (modifyWidthDimension ? (size.Width - layoutItemActualSize.Width) : 0);
			int num3 = (modifyHeightDimension ? (size.Height - layoutItemActualSize.Height) : 0);
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				GridBagLayoutItemDimensionsCollection val2 = actualItemDims;
				if (i > 0)
				{
					((LayoutManagerBase)gridBagLM).InvalidateLayout();
					GetLayoutResizeItems(ref resizeItem, containerSize, out gridBagLM, out preferredLayoutSize, out preferredItemDims, out actualItemDims, recalcPreferredItemDims: true);
					SetAutoFitColumnsPreferredSizeOverrides(gridBagLM, actualItemDims, null);
					((LayoutManagerBase)gridBagLM).InvalidateLayout();
					GetLayoutResizeItems(ref resizeItem, containerSize, out gridBagLM, out preferredLayoutSize, out preferredItemDims, out actualItemDims, recalcPreferredItemDims: true);
					val = actualItemDims[resizeItem];
					Size layoutItemActualSize2 = GetLayoutItemActualSize(val, actualItemDims);
					if (modifyWidthDimension)
					{
						if (size.Width == layoutItemActualSize2.Width || 1 + i == num)
						{
							break;
						}
						int num4 = size.Width - layoutItemActualSize2.Width;
						if (num4 == num2)
						{
							num4 = num2 * 2;
						}
						num2 = (modifyWidthDimension ? num4 : 0);
						num3 = (modifyHeightDimension ? (size.Height - layoutItemActualSize2.Height) : 0);
					}
					else if (modifyHeightDimension)
					{
						if (size.Height == layoutItemActualSize2.Height || 1 + i == num)
						{
							break;
						}
						int num5 = size.Height - layoutItemActualSize2.Height;
						if (num5 == num3)
						{
							num5 = num3 * 2;
						}
						num3 = (modifyHeightDimension ? num5 : 0);
						num2 = (modifyWidthDimension ? (size.Width - layoutItemActualSize2.Width) : 0);
					}
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < ((LayoutManagerBase)gridBagLM).LayoutItems.Count; j++)
				{
					ILayoutItem val3 = ((LayoutManagerBase)gridBagLM).LayoutItems[j];
					GridBagLayoutItemDimensions val4 = (val2.Exists(val3) ? val2[val3] : null);
					if (val4 == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					int originX2 = val4.OriginX;
					int spanX2 = val4.SpanX;
					int originY2 = val4.OriginY;
					int spanY2 = val4.SpanY;
					float num6 = 1f;
					float num7 = 1f;
					int num8 = preferredItemDims[val3].Bounds.Width;
					int num9 = preferredItemDims[val3].Bounds.Height;
					int num10 = val4.Bounds.Width;
					int num11 = val4.Bounds.Height;
					if (num8 != num10)
					{
						num6 = (float)num8 / (float)num10;
					}
					if (num9 != num11)
					{
						num7 = (float)num9 / (float)num11;
					}
					bool flag = num2 != 0 && originX2 + spanX2 == originX + spanX;
					bool flag2 = num3 != 0 && originY2 + spanY2 == originY + spanY;
					if (!flag && !flag2)
					{
						continue;
					}
					Size preferredSize = val3.PreferredSize;
					Size minimumSize = val3.MinimumSize;
					if (flag)
					{
						if (num2 < 0)
						{
							preferredSize.Width = Math.Min(preferredSize.Width, (int)((float)num8 + (float)num2 * num6));
						}
						else
						{
							preferredSize.Width = Math.Max(preferredSize.Width, (int)((float)num8 + (float)num2 * num6));
						}
						if (preferredSize.Width < minimumSize.Width)
						{
							preferredSize.Width = minimumSize.Width;
						}
					}
					if (flag2)
					{
						if (num3 < 0)
						{
							preferredSize.Height = Math.Min(preferredSize.Height, (int)((float)num9 + (float)num3 * num7));
						}
						else
						{
							preferredSize.Height = Math.Max(preferredSize.Height, (int)((float)num9 + (float)num3 * num7));
						}
						if (preferredSize.Height < minimumSize.Height)
						{
							preferredSize.Height = minimumSize.Height;
						}
					}
					SetLayoutItemPreferredSize(val3, preferredSize, flag, flag2);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void SendDesignerChangeNotification(Control control, string propertyName, object originalValue, object newValue)
		{
			PropertyDescriptor member = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(control)[propertyName];
			IComponentChangeService componentChangeService = GetService(typeof(IComponentChangeService)) as IComponentChangeService;
			componentChangeService.OnComponentChanging(control, member);
			componentChangeService.OnComponentChanged(control, member, originalValue, newValue);
		}

		private void SetAutoFitColumnsPreferredSizeOverrides(GridBagLayoutManager gblm, GridBagLayoutItemDimensionsCollection itemDims, ILayoutItem exception)
		{
			//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001a: Expected O, but got Unknown
			foreach (ILayoutItem item in (IEnumerable)((LayoutManagerBase)gblm).LayoutItems)
			{
				ILayoutItem val = item;
				if (val != exception)
				{
					GridBagLayoutItemDimensions val2 = (itemDims.Exists(val) ? itemDims[val] : null);
					if (val2 != null)
					{
						SetLayoutItemPreferredSize(val, val2.Bounds.Size, modifyWidth: true, modifyHeight: false);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal void SetLayoutItemPreferredSize(ILayoutItem item, Size size, bool modifyWidth, bool modifyHeight)
		{
			if (item is ControlLayoutItem { Control: var control })
			{
				if (!modifyWidth)
				{
					size.Width = GetPreferredSize(control).Width;
				}
				if (!modifyHeight)
				{
					size.Height = GetPreferredSize(control).Height;
				}
				SetPreferredSize(control, size, sendDesignerChangeNotification: true);
			}
		}

		internal void SetPreferredSize(Control control, Size size, bool sendDesignerChangeNotification)
		{
			Size preferredSize = GetPreferredSize(control);
			GridBagLayoutManagerComponent.SetPreferredSize(control, size);
			if (sendDesignerChangeNotification)
			{
				SendDesignerChangeNotification(control, "PreferredSize", preferredSize, size);
			}
		}

		public override Size GetPreferredSize(Size proposedSize)
		{
			if (proposedSize.Width == 0)
			{
				proposedSize.Width = int.MaxValue;
			}
			if (proposedSize.Height == 0)
			{
				proposedSize.Height = int.MaxValue;
			}
			proposedSize -= base.Padding.Size;
			ILayoutContainer val = (ILayoutContainer)(object)new LayoutContainerCalcSize(proposedSize);
			Size result = ((LayoutManagerBase)gridBagLayoutManagerComponent.GridBagLayoutManager).CalculatePreferredSize(val, (object)null);
			result += base.Padding.Size;
			Size minimumSize = MinimumSize;
			Size maximumSize = MaximumSize;
			if (maximumSize.Width > 0 && result.Width > maximumSize.Width)
			{
				result.Width = maximumSize.Width;
			}
			if (maximumSize.Height > 0 && result.Height > maximumSize.Height)
			{
				result.Height = maximumSize.Height;
			}
			if (minimumSize.Width > result.Width)
			{
				result.Width = minimumSize.Width;
			}
			if (minimumSize.Height > result.Height)
			{
				result.Height = minimumSize.Height;
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override void ScaleControl(SizeF factor, BoundsSpecified specified)
		{
			base.ScaleControl(factor, specified);
			foreach (Control control in base.Controls)
			{
				Size preferredSize = GetPreferredSize(control);
				Size size = new Size((int)((float)preferredSize.Width * factor.Width), (int)((float)preferredSize.Height * factor.Height));
				SetPreferredSize(control, size);
			}
		}

		public static UltraPopupControlContainer FromControl(Control control)
		{
			if (dropDownTable != null && DropDownList.Count > 0)
			{
				ICollection keys = dropDownTable.Keys;
				foreach (Control item in keys)
				{
					if (control == item || IsChildControl(item, control))
					{
						return DropDownList[item] as UltraPopupControlContainer;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static bool IsChildControl(Control control, Control childControl)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < control.Controls.Count; i++)
			{
				Control control2 = control.Controls[i];
				if (childControl == control2)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (IsChildControl(control2, childControl))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public virtual void Show(PopupInfo info)
		{
			//IL_00a2: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00f8: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0133: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (IsDisplayed)
			{
				Close();
			}
			CancelEventArgs e = new CancelEventArgs();
			OnOpening(e);
			if (!e.Cancel && info != null && popupControl != null)
			{
				Control control = info.Owner;
				if (control == null)
				{
					Form form = CreateNullOwnerForm();
					control = form;
					nullOwnerForm = form;
					form.ShowInTaskbar = false;
					form.StartPosition = FormStartPosition.Manual;
					form.Location = new Point(-10000, -10000);
					form.TopMost = true;
					form.Show();
					form.Activate();
				}
				popupOwner = control;
				EventHandler eventHandler = OnDropDownManagerCloseUp;
				Size size = popupControl.Size;
				DropDownPosition position = info.Position;
				sourceControl = info.SourceControl;
				DropDownManagerParameters val = default(DropDownManagerParameters);
				((DropDownManagerParameters)(ref val))..ctor(popupOwner, popupControl, (Control)null, eventHandler, info.ExclusionRect, size, info.PreferredLocation, info.AlignRight);
				((DropDownManagerParameters)(ref val)).ClearExisting = true;
				((DropDownManagerParameters)(ref val)).AutoCloseUp = true;
				((DropDownManagerParameters)(ref val)).IgnoreClicksInExclusionArea = true;
				((DropDownManagerParameters)(ref val)).DropDownPosition = position;
				((DropDownManagerParameters)(ref val)).EatMouseMessageOnAutoCloseup = true;
				((DropDownManagerParameters)(ref val)).DropDownResizeHandleOwner = (IDropDownResizeHandleOwner)(object)this;
				lastExclusionRect = info.ExclusionRect;
				lastLocation = info.PreferredLocation;
				lastRightAlign = info.AlignRight;
				DropDownManager.DropDown(val);
				isDisplayed = DropDownManager.IsDroppedDown(popupOwner);
				if (isDisplayed)
				{
					AddToDropDownList(this, popupControl);
					OnOpened(EventArgs.Empty);
				}
			}
		}

		void IDropDownResizeHandleOwner.ResolveDropDownResizeHandleAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearanceData, ref AppearancePropFlags appearancePropFlags)
		{
			ResolutionOrderInfo resOrder;
			UIRole role = StyleUtils.GetRole(((UltraStylableComponent)this).ComponentRole, StyleUtils.Role.PopupControlContainerDropDownResizeHandle, out resOrder);
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseStyleBefore && role != null)
			{
				role.ResolveAppearance(ref appearanceData, ref appearancePropFlags, (RoleState)1);
			}
			if (HasDropdownResizeHandleAppearance && ((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseControlInfo)
			{
				DropDownResizeHandleAppearance.MergeData(ref appearanceData, ref appearancePropFlags);
			}
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseStyleAfter && role != null)
			{
				role.ResolveAppearance(ref appearanceData, ref appearancePropFlags, (RoleState)1);
			}
		}

		{
			return (ComponentRole)(object)new UltraPopupControlContainerComponentRole(this);
		}

						{
							rectangle2.Width += 2;
							rectangle2.Height += 2;
						}
						Rectangle rect = rectangle2;
						if (flag2)
						{
							rect.Height += pageNumberExtraRowHeight;
						}
						if (rect.Height < rowSize.Height)
						{
							int num4 = (rowSize.Height - rect.Height) / 2;
							rect.Y += num4;
							rectangle2.Y += num4;
						}
						if (rect.IntersectsWith(rectInsideBorders))
						{
							Rectangle pageRect = new Rectangle(num3, rectangle2.Y, size.Width, size.Height);
							PreviewPageFrameUIElement previewPageFrameUIElement = UIElement.ExtractExistingElement(arrayList, typeof(PreviewPageFrameUIElement), true, (object)previewPage) as PreviewPageFrameUIElement;
							if (previewPageFrameUIElement == null)
							{
								previewPageFrameUIElement = new PreviewPageFrameUIElement(this, previewPage);
							}
							else
							{
								previewPageFrameUIElement.Initialize(previewPage);
							}
							((UIElement)previewPageFrameUIElement).Rect = rect;
							previewPageFrameUIElement.PageRect = pageRect;
							if (flag2)
							{
								previewPageFrameUIElement.PageNumberRect = new Rectangle(rect.Left + (rect.Width - pageNumberTextSize.Width) / 2, rect.Bottom - (pageNumberTextSize.Height + 8), pageNumberTextSize.Width, pageNumberTextSize.Height);
							}
							else
							{
								previewPageFrameUIElement.PageNumberRect = Rectangle.Empty;
							}
							if (flag)
							{
								previewPageFrameUIElement.ShadowRightRect = new Rectangle(rectangle2.Right - 2, rectangle2.Top + 2, 2, size.Height);
								previewPageFrameUIElement.ShadowBottomRect = new Rectangle(rectangle2.Left + 2, rectangle2.Bottom - 2, size.Width, 2);
							}
							else
							{
								previewPageFrameUIElement.ShadowRightRect = Rectangle.Empty;
								previewPageFrameUIElement.ShadowBottomRect = Rectangle.Empty;
							}
							((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)previewPageFrameUIElement);
						}
						num3 += rectangle2.Width + 6;
						if (num3 >= rectInsideBorders.Width)
						{
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				num2 += rowSize.Height;
				num2 += 6;
				if (num2 >= rectInsideBorders.Bottom)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			AddPageAreaMessageElement();
		}

		protected override void OnMousePanHorizontal(int delta)
		{
			PreviewControl.ProcessHorizontalMousePan(delta);
		}

		protected override void OnMousePanVertical(int delta)

			PreviewControl.ProcessVerticalMousePan(delta);
		}

		protected override bool OnMouseDown(MouseEventArgs e, bool adjustableArea, ref UIElement captureMouseForElement)
		{
			if (currentMouseAction != PreviewMouseAction.None && ((UIElement)this).HasCapture)
			{
				((UIElement)this).ControlElement.TerminateCapture();
			}
			if (e.Button == MouseButtons.Left)
			{
				mouseDownLocation = new Point(e.X, e.Y);
				ControlUIElementBase controlElement = ((UIElement)this).ControlElement;
				UltraPrintPreviewControlBase ultraPrintPreviewControlBase = ((UIElement)controlElement).Control as UltraPrintPreviewControlBase;
				currentMouseAction = ultraPrintPreviewControlBase.Metrics.PreviewMouseActionResolved;
				if (currentMouseAction != PreviewMouseAction.None)
				{
					mouseDownScrollValueX = ultraPrintPreviewControlBase.Metrics.HorizontalScrollInfo.Value;
					mouseDownScrollValueY = ultraPrintPreviewControlBase.Metrics.VerticalScrollInfo.Value;
					mouseDownZoom = ultraPrintPreviewControlBase.Metrics.VisibleZoom;
					controlElement.CaptureMouseForElement((UIElement)(object)this);
					if ((object)controlElement.ElementWithMouseCapture == this)
					{
						captureMouseForElement = (UIElement)(object)this;
						Cursor.Current = ((UIElement)this).Cursor;
						switch (currentMouseAction)
						{
						case PreviewMouseAction.DynamicZoom:
							if (ultraPrintPreviewControlBase.PageCount > 0)
							{
								pageOffsetInfo = ultraPrintPreviewControlBase.Metrics.CreatePageOffsetInfo(new Point(e.X - ((UIElement)this).Rect.X, e.Y - ((UIElement)this).Rect.Y));
							}
							else
							{
								pageOffsetInfo = null;
							}
							break;
						case PreviewMouseAction.Snapshot:
						{
							UIElement val = ((UIElement)this).ElementFromPoint(new Point(e.X, e.Y));
							if (val is PreviewPageUIElement)
							{
								mouseDownPageNumber = ((PreviewPageUIElement)(object)val).Page.PageNumber - 1;
							}
							snapshotInfo = ultraPrintPreviewControlBase.Metrics.CreateSnapshotInfo(new Point(e.X - ((UIElement)this).Rect.X, e.Y - ((UIElement)this).Rect.Y), val);
							if (snapshotInfo != null)
							{
								maxScrollRange = snapshotInfo.ScrollRange;
							}
							break;
						}
						case PreviewMouseAction.ZoomOut:
						case PreviewMouseAction.ZoomIn:
							if (ultraPrintPreviewControlBase.PageCount > 0)
							{
								maxScrollRange = ultraPrintPreviewControlBase.Metrics.CalculateVisibleAreaScrollRange();
								ProcessMouseMove(e.X, e.Y);
							}
							else
							{
								maxScrollRange = ScrollRange.Empty;
							}
							break;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						OnPreviewMouseActionEnded();
					}
					return true;
				}
			}
			return ((UIElement)this).OnMouseDown(e, adjustableArea, ref captureMouseForElement);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseMove(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (currentMouseAction != PreviewMouseAction.None)
			{
				ProcessMouseMove(e.X, e.Y);
			}
			((UIElement)this).OnMouseMove(e);
		}

		protected override bool OnMouseUp(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			UltraPrintPreviewControlBase previewControl = PreviewControl;
			if (previewControl == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			switch (currentMouseAction)
			{
			case PreviewMouseAction.Snapshot:
				overlayRect = Rectangle.Empty;
				if (mouseDownLocation == new Point(e.X, e.Y) && mouseDownScrollValueX == previewControl.Metrics.HorizontalScrollInfo.Value && mouseDownScrollValueY == previewControl.Metrics.VerticalScrollInfo.Value)
				{
					if (previewControl.Metrics.CopyElementToClipboard((UIElement)(object)this))
					{
						overlayRect = ((UIElement)this).Rect;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					Rectangle selectionRect3 = mouseSelectionRect;
					selectionRect3.Offset(-((UIElement)this).Rect.Left, -((UIElement)this).Rect.Top);
					overlayRect = previewControl.Metrics.ProcessSnapshot(snapshotInfo, selectionRect3);
				}
				if (!overlayRect.Size.IsEmpty)
				{
					System.Windows.Forms.Timer timer = Utilities.CreateTimer();
					timer.Tick += OnOverlayTimerTick;
					timer.Interval = 800;
					timer.Start();
				}
				break;
			case PreviewMouseAction.ZoomIn:
			{
				Rectangle selectionRect2 = mouseSelectionRect;
				selectionRect2.Offset(-((UIElement)this).Rect.Left, -((UIElement)this).Rect.Top);
				previewControl.Metrics.ProcessZoomIn(selectionRect2);
				break;
			}
			case PreviewMouseAction.ZoomOut:
			{
				Rectangle selectionRect = mouseSelectionRect;
				selectionRect.Offset(-((UIElement)this).Rect.Left, -((UIElement)this).Rect.Top);
				previewControl.Metrics.ProcessZoomOut(selectionRect);
				break;
			}
			case PreviewMouseAction.Hand:
			case PreviewMouseAction.DynamicZoom:
				if (mouseDownLocation != new Point(e.X, e.Y) || mouseDownZoom != previewControl.Metrics.VisibleZoom || mouseDownScrollValueX != previewControl.Metrics.HorizontalScrollInfo.Value || mouseDownScrollValueY != previewControl.Metrics.VerticalScrollInfo.Value)
				{
					previewControl.Metrics.AddToViewHistory();
				}
				break;
			}
			OnPreviewMouseActionEnded();
			return ((UIElement)this).OnMouseUp(e);
		}

		private void OnOverlayTimerTick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			System.Windows.Forms.Timer timer = sender as System.Windows.Forms.Timer;
			timer.Tick -= OnOverlayTimerTick;
			timer.Stop();
			timer.Dispose();
			overlayRect = Rectangle.Empty;
			((UIElement)this).Invalidate();
		}

		protected override void OnCaptureAborted()
		{
			OnPreviewMouseActionEnded();
			((UIElement)this).OnCaptureAborted();
		}

		protected override void OnAfterDraw(ref UIElementDrawParams defaultDrawParams)
		{
			//IL_0053: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ce: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01d8: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!mouseSelectionRect.Size.IsEmpty)
			{
				((UIElementDrawParams)(ref defaultDrawParams)).DrawBorders((UIElementBorderStyle)2, Border3DSide.All, SystemColors.WindowFrame, SystemColors.WindowFrame, mouseSelectionRect, ((UIElementDrawParams)(ref defaultDrawParams)).InvalidRect);
			}
			if (!overlayRect.Size.IsEmpty)
			{
				AppearanceData val = default(AppearanceData);
				((AppearanceData)(ref val)).BackColor = Color.FromArgb(170, 0, 0, 0);
				((UIElementDrawParams)(ref defaultDrawParams)).DrawBackColor(ref val, overlayRect, Rectangle.Intersect(overlayRect, ((UIElementDrawParams)(ref defaultDrawParams)).InvalidRect), ((UIElement)this).Enabled, (Blend)null);
				string text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("PrintPreview_Snapshot_Text");
				if (text != null && text.Length > 0)
				{
					SizeF sizeF = DrawUtility.MeasureString(((UIElementDrawParams)(ref defaultDrawParams)).Graphics, text, ((UIElementDrawParams)(ref defaultDrawParams)).Font, (SizeF)overlayRect.Size, DrawUtility.GetGdiDrawStringFlags((UIElement)(object)this));
					sizeF.Height += 4f;
					sizeF.Width += 8f;
					Rectangle rectangle = overlayRect;
					if (sizeF.Height < (float)rectangle.Height)
					{
						rectangle.Y += (rectangle.Height - (int)sizeF.Height) / 2;
						rectangle.Height = (int)sizeF.Height;
					}
					if (sizeF.Width < (float)rectangle.Width)
					{
						rectangle.X += (rectangle.Width - (int)sizeF.Width) / 2;
						rectangle.Width = (int)sizeF.Width;
					}
					((AppearanceData)(ref val)).BackColor = Color.FromArgb(255, 0, 0, 0);
					((UIElementDrawParams)(ref defaultDrawParams)).DrawBackColor(ref val, rectangle, Rectangle.Intersect(rectangle, ((UIElementDrawParams)(ref defaultDrawParams)).InvalidRect), ((UIElement)this).Enabled, (Blend)null);
					rectangle.Offset(3, 2);
					DrawUtility.DrawString(((UIElementDrawParams)(ref defaultDrawParams)).Graphics, text, ((UIElementDrawParams)(ref defaultDrawParams)).Font, (RectangleF)rectangle, Color.White, DrawUtility.GetGdiDrawStringFlags((UIElement)(object)this));
				}
			}
			((UIElement)this).OnAfterDraw(ref defaultDrawParams);
		}

		private void OnPreviewMouseActionEnded()
		{
			if (currentMouseAction != PreviewMouseAction.None)
			{
				mouseSelectionRect = Rectangle.Empty;
				mouseDownZoom = 0.0;
				mouseDownLocation = Point.Empty;
				mouseDownScrollValueX = 0;
				mouseDownScrollValueY = 0;
				currentMouseAction = PreviewMouseAction.None;
				maxScrollRange = ScrollRange.Empty;
				snapshotInfo = null;
				mouseDownPageNumber = -1;
				pageOffsetInfo = null;
				((UIElement)this).Invalidate(false);
				StopTimer();
			}
		}

		private void StartTimer()
		{
			StopTimer();
			timer = Utilities.CreateTimer();
			timer.Tick += OnTimerTick;
			timer.Interval = 500;
			timer.Start();
		}

		private void OnTimerTick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UltraPrintPreviewControlBase previewControl = PreviewControl;
			if (previewControl != null && !((Control)(object)previewControl).IsDisposed)
			{
				if (timer.Interval == 500)
				{
					timer.Interval = 20;
				}
				Point point = ((Control)(object)previewControl).PointToClient(Control.MousePosition);
				Rectangle rect = ((UIElement)this).Rect;
				if (point.X < rect.Left)
				{
					previewControl.Metrics.ScrollHorizontal((ScrollBarAction)3, maxScrollRange);
				}
				else if (point.X >= rect.Right)
				{
					previewControl.Metrics.ScrollHorizontal((ScrollBarAction)2, maxScrollRange);
				}
				if (point.Y < rect.Top)
				{
					previewControl.Metrics.ScrollVertical((ScrollBarAction)3, maxScrollRange);
				}
				else if (point.Y >= rect.Bottom)
				{
					previewControl.Metrics.ScrollVertical((ScrollBarAction)2, maxScrollRange);
				}
				ProcessMouseMove(point.X, point.Y);
			}
		}

		private void StopTimer()
		{
			if (timer != null)
			{
				timer.Stop();
				timer.Tick -= OnTimerTick;
				timer.Dispose();
				timer = null;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			StopTimer();
			((DisposableObject)this).Dispose();
		}

		private void ProcessMouseMove(int x, int y)
		{
			ControlUIElementBase controlElement = ((UIElement)this).ControlElement;
			if (controlElement == null || (object)controlElement.ElementWithMouseCapture != this)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraPrintPreviewControlBase ultraPrintPreviewControlBase = (UltraPrintPreviewControlBase)(object)((UIElement)controlElement).Control;
			switch (currentMouseAction)
			{
			case PreviewMouseAction.Hand:
			{
				int num = mouseDownLocation.X - x;
				int num2 = mouseDownLocation.Y - y;
				int scrollValueX = mouseDownScrollValueX + num;
				int scrollValueY = mouseDownScrollValueY + num2;
				ultraPrintPreviewControlBase.Metrics.Scroll(scrollValueX, scrollValueY, update: true);
				break;
			}
			case PreviewMouseAction.DynamicZoom:
			{
				int num3 = mouseDownLocation.Y - y;
				if (num3 != 0)
				{
					double zoom = ((num3 <= 0) ? (mouseDownZoom * Math.Pow(ultraPrintPreviewControlBase.MinimumZoom / mouseDownZoom, (double)Math.Abs(num3) / (double)Utilities.GetPrimaryScreen().Bounds.Height)) : (mouseDownZoom * Math.Pow(ultraPrintPreviewControlBase.MaximumZoom / mouseDownZoom, (double)num3 / (double)Utilities.GetPrimaryScreen().Bounds.Height)));
					ultraPrintPreviewControlBase.Metrics.SetZoom(zoom);
					ultraPrintPreviewControlBase.Metrics.ScrollUsingPageOffsetInfo(pageOffsetInfo);
					((UltraControlBase)ultraPrintPreviewControlBase).Update();
				}
				break;
			}
			case PreviewMouseAction.Snapshot:
			case PreviewMouseAction.ZoomOut:
			case PreviewMouseAction.ZoomIn:
			{
				if (((UIElement)this).Rect.Contains(x, y))
				{
					StopTimer();
				}
				else if (timer == null)
				{
					StartTimer();
				}
				Size size = new Size(ultraPrintPreviewControlBase.Metrics.HorizontalScrollInfo.Value - mouseDownScrollValueX, ultraPrintPreviewControlBase.Metrics.VerticalScrollInfo.Value - mouseDownScrollValueY);
				Size size2 = new Size(size.Width + (x - mouseDownLocation.X), size.Height + (y - mouseDownLocation.Y));
				Point location = new Point(mouseDownLocation.X - size.Width, mouseDownLocation.Y - size.Height);
				Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle(location, size2);
				if (currentMouseAction != PreviewMouseAction.Snapshot)
				{
					mouseSelectionRect = rectangle;
				}
				else
				{
					Rectangle maxSelectionRect = ultraPrintPreviewControlBase.Metrics.GetMaxSelectionRect(snapshotInfo);
					mouseSelectionRect = Rectangle.Intersect(Utilities.Normalize(rectangle), maxSelectionRect);
				}
				((UltraControlBase)ultraPrintPreviewControlBase).Invalidate();
				break;
			}
			}
		}

		private void AddPageAreaMessageElement()
		{
			string pageAreaMessage = PreviewControl.PageAreaMessage;
			if (pageAreaMessage != null && pageAreaMessage.Length > 0)
			{
				((TextUIElementBase)TextElement).Text = pageAreaMessage;
				((UIElement)TextElement).Rect = ((UIElement)this).Rect;
				((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)TextElement);
			}
		}
	}

	public class PreviewPageRulerUIElement : UIElement
	{
		private UltraPrintPreviewControlBase PreviewControl => ((UIElement)this).Control as UltraPrintPreviewControlBase;

		protected override bool ClipSelf => true;

		public override Region Region => new Region(((UIElement)this).ClipRect);

		public override UIRole UIRole => StyleUtils.GetRole((UltraControlBase)(object)PreviewControl, StyleUtils.Role.PrintPreviewRuler);

		public PreviewPageRulerUIElement(PreviewRulerAreaUIElement parent)
			: base((UIElement)(object)parent)
		{
		}

		protected override void InitAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			if (PreviewControl is UltraPrintPreviewControl ultraPrintPreviewControl)
			{
				ultraPrintPreviewControl.ResolveRulerAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			}
			((UIElement)this).InitAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
		}

		protected override void DrawForeground(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			//IL_0304: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!(((UIElement)((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).ControlElement).Control is UltraPrintPreviewControlBase ultraPrintPreviewControlBase))
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = !((PreviewRulerAreaUIElement)(object)((UIElement)this).Parent).IsVertical;
			ultraPrintPreviewControlBase.Metrics.GetMarginExtent(flag, near: true);
			ultraPrintPreviewControlBase.Metrics.GetMarginExtent(flag, near: false);
			ultraPrintPreviewControlBase.Metrics.GetVisiblePageExtent(flag);
			Color color = ((AppearanceData)(ref drawParams.AppearanceData)).BorderColor;
			if (color.IsEmpty)
			{
				color = Color.Black;
			}
			RectangleF a = ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders;
			RectangleF rectangleF = RectangleF.Intersect(a, ((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).InvalidRect);
			Graphics graphics = ((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics;
			Font font = ((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Font;
			SolidBrush solidBrush = Utilities.CreateSolidBrush(color);
			int rulerPageExtentInHundredthsOfAnInch = ultraPrintPreviewControlBase.Metrics.GetRulerPageExtentInHundredthsOfAnInch(flag);
			if (rulerPageExtentInHundredthsOfAnInch <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			RulerInfo rulerInfo = ultraPrintPreviewControlBase.Metrics.RulerInfo;
			if (rulerInfo.IsTextSizeCalculated)
			{

			float y = a.Y;

				y += a.Height / 2f;
			}
			else

				y += lineMarkerInfo.SingleMarkerExtent;
				x += a.Width / 2f;
			}

							}
							matrix2?.Dispose();
						}
					}
					if (flag)
					{

					}
					else
					{

					}

			}

					}
					else
					{
						float y2 = (pointF4.Y = pointF.Y + (float)l * lineMarkerInfo.SingleMarkerExtent);
						pointF3.Y = y2;
					}
					for (int m = 0; m < lineMarkerInfo.Lines.Length; m++)
					{

							pointF3.Y = y3;
							pointF3.X = pointF.X + num10;
							pointF4.X = pointF2.X - num10;
						}
						if (rectangleF.Contains(RectangleF.FromLTRB(pointF3.X, pointF3.Y, pointF4.X, pointF4.Y)))
						{
							graphics.DrawLine(flag3 ? black : black2, pointF3.X, pointF3.Y, pointF4.X, pointF4.Y);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			solidBrush?.Dispose();
			if (clip != null)

				clip.Dispose();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseMove(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (viewBeingRepositioned && lastMousePoint != new Point(e.X, e.Y))

				Rectangle rectInsideBorders = ((UIElement)this).Parent.RectInsideBorders;
				Rectangle rectangle = mouseDownInsideBorderRect;

				int y = e.Y - mouseDownLocation.Y;
				lastMousePoint = new Point(e.X, e.Y);
				rectangle2.Offset(x, y);

				UltraPrintPreviewThumbnail ultraPrintPreviewThumbnail = ((UIElement)controlElement).Control as UltraPrintPreviewThumbnail;
				bool flag = ultraPrintPreviewThumbnail.ViewBoxDragModeResolved == ViewBoxDragMode.RestrictWithinPage;
				if (flag)

					if (rectangle2.Right > rectInsideBorders.Right)
					{
						rectangle2.X -= rectangle2.Right - rectInsideBorders.Right;

					else if (rectangle2.Left < rectInsideBorders.Left)

		internal bool InternalProcessMouseDown(MouseEventArgs e, bool adjustableArea, ref UIElement captureMouseForElement)
		{
			if (!adjustableArea && e.Button == MouseButtons.Left)
			{
				ControlUIElementBase controlElement = ((UIElement)this).ControlElement;
				if (controlElement != null && ((UIElement)controlElement).Control is UltraPrintPreviewThumbnail)
				{
					UltraPrintPreviewThumbnail ultraPrintPreviewThumbnail = ((UIElement)controlElement).Control as UltraPrintPreviewThumbnail;
					ViewBoxDragMode viewBoxDragMode = ultraPrintPreviewThumbnail?.ViewBoxDragModeResolved ?? ViewBoxDragMode.None;
					if (ultraPrintPreviewThumbnail.PreviewControl != null && (viewBoxDragMode == ViewBoxDragMode.Free || (viewBoxDragMode == ViewBoxDragMode.RestrictWithinPage && Rectangle.Intersect(((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders, ((UIElement)this).Parent.RectInsideBorders) != ((UIElement)this).Parent.RectInsideBorders)))
					{
						viewBeingRepositioned = true;
						mouseDownLocation = new Point(e.X, e.Y);
						lastMousePoint = mouseDownLocation;
						controlElement.CaptureMouseForElement((UIElement)(object)this);
						mouseDownScrollValueX = ultraPrintPreviewThumbnail.PreviewControl.Metrics.HorizontalScrollInfo.Value;
						mouseDownScrollValueY = ultraPrintPreviewThumbnail.PreviewControl.Metrics.VerticalScrollInfo.Value;
						mouseDownInsideBorderRect = ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders;
						if (((UIElement)this).GetAncestor(typeof(PreviewPageUIElement)) is PreviewPageUIElement previewPageUIElement)
						{
							mouseDownPreviewScrollRange = ultraPrintPreviewThumbnail.PreviewControl.Metrics.CalculatePageScrollRange(previewPageUIElement.Page);
						}
						else
						{
							mouseDownPreviewScrollRange = ScrollRange.Empty;
						}
					}
					if ((object)controlElement.ElementWithMouseCapture == this)
					{
						captureMouseForElement = (UIElement)(object)this;
						Cursor.Current = ((UIElement)this).Cursor;
					}
					else
					{
						OnRepositionEnded();
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void OnRepositionEnded()
		{
			viewBeingRepositioned = false;
			mouseDownLocation = Point.Empty;
			mouseDownInsideBorderRect = Rectangle.Empty;
			mouseDownScrollValueX = 0;
			mouseDownScrollValueY = 0;
			lastMousePoint = new Point(0, 0);
			if (((UIElement)this).GetAncestor(typeof(PreviewPageAreaUIElement)) is PreviewPageAreaUIElement previewPageAreaUIElement)
			{
				((UIElement)previewPageAreaUIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
			}
		}

		protected override void PositionChildElements()
		{
			Rectangle rectInsideBorders = ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders;
			UltraPrintPreviewControlBase previewControl = PreviewControl;
			((ArrayList)(object)((UIElement)this).ChildElements).Clear();
			bool isVerticalScrollBarVisible = previewControl.IsVerticalScrollBarVisible;
			bool isHorizontalScrollBarVisible = previewControl.IsHorizontalScrollBarVisible;
			bool flag = isVerticalScrollBarVisible && isHorizontalScrollBarVisible;
			int verticalScrollBarWidth = previewControl.VerticalScrollBarWidth;
			int horizontalScrollBarHeight = previewControl.HorizontalScrollBarHeight;
			if (isVerticalScrollBarVisible)
			{
				int height = (flag ? (rectInsideBorders.Height - horizontalScrollBarHeight) : rectInsideBorders.Height);
				Rectangle rect = new Rectangle(rectInsideBorders.Right - verticalScrollBarWidth, rectInsideBorders.Y, verticalScrollBarWidth, height);
				((UIElement)VerticalScrollBar).Rect = rect;
				((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)VerticalScrollBar);
				if (flag)
				{
					Rectangle rect2 = new Rectangle(rectInsideBorders.Right - verticalScrollBarWidth, rectInsideBorders.Bottom - horizontalScrollBarHeight, verticalScrollBarWidth, horizontalScrollBarHeight);
					((UIElement)ScrollbarIntersectionElement).Rect = rect2;
					((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)ScrollbarIntersectionElement);
				}
				rectInsideBorders.Width -= verticalScrollBarWidth;
			}
			if (isHorizontalScrollBarVisible)
			{
				Rectangle rect3 = new Rectangle(rectInsideBorders.X, rectInsideBorders.Bottom - horizontalScrollBarHeight, rectInsideBorders.Width, horizontalScrollBarHeight);
				((UIElement)HorizontalScrollBar).Rect = rect3;
				((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)HorizontalScrollBar);
				rectInsideBorders.Height -= horizontalScrollBarHeight;
			}
			if (rectInsideBorders.Width > 0 && rectInsideBorders.Height > 0)
			{
				((UIElement)PageAreaElement).Rect = rectInsideBorders;
				((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)PageAreaElement);
			}
		}

		protected override bool OnPreMouseDown(ref MouseMessageInfo msgInfo)
		{
			if (!PreviewControl.IsDesignMode && ((Control)(object)PreviewControl).CanFocus && ((Control)(object)PreviewControl).CanSelect && !((Control)(object)PreviewControl).Focused && PreviewControl.Settings.AcceptsFocus)
			{
				try
				{
					if (DisposableObject.HasSamePublicKey(((object)PreviewControl).GetType()))
					{
						Utilities.FocusControl((Control)(object)PreviewControl);
					}
					else
					{
						((Control)(object)PreviewControl).Focus();
					}
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

			((ControlUIElementBase)this).InitAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			if (Utilities.ShouldSetAppearanceProperty(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (AppearancePropFlags)1073741824) && ((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor == SystemColors.ControlDark)
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BorderColor3DBase = SystemColors.Control;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFEuL);
			}
		}

	public class UltraPreviewPageInfo : SubObjectBase
	{
		private Image image;

		private int pageNumber;

		private Size physicalSize;

		private Rectangle marginBounds;

		public Image Image => image;

		public Size PhysicalSize => physicalSize;

		public Rectangle MarginBounds => marginBounds;

		public int PageNumber => pageNumber;

		internal UltraPreviewPageInfo(int pageNumber, Rectangle marginBounds)
		{
			this.pageNumber = pageNumber;
			this.marginBounds = marginBounds;
		}

		internal void InitializePreviewPageInfo(Image image, Size physicalSize)
		{
			this.image = image;
			this.physicalSize = physicalSize;
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			if (image != null)
			{
				image.Dispose();
				image = null;
			}
			base.OnDispose();
		}
	}
	public class UltraPreviewPageInfoCollection : SubObjectsCollectionBase, IEnumerable
	{
		public class UltraPreviewPageInfoCollectionEnumerator : DisposableObjectEnumeratorBase
		{
			private UltraPreviewPageInfoCollection collection;

			public UltraPreviewPageInfo Current => ((IEnumerator)this).Current as UltraPreviewPageInfo;

			public UltraPreviewPageInfoCollectionEnumerator(UltraPreviewPageInfoCollection collection)
				: base(collection)
			{
				this.collection = collection;
			}
		}

		private bool allPagesHaveSameSize = true;

		private bool allPagesHaveSameMargins = true;

		public UltraPreviewPageInfo this[int index] => GetItem(index) as UltraPreviewPageInfo;

		internal bool AllPagesHaveSameSize => allPagesHaveSameSize;

		internal bool AllPagesHaveSameMargins => allPagesHaveSameMargins;

		public override object[] All
		{
			get
			{
				return base.All;
			}
			set
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
		}

		protected override int InitialCapacity => 50;

		public override bool IsReadOnly => true;

		internal UltraPreviewPageInfoCollection()
		{
		}

		internal UltraPreviewPageInfo Add(int pageNumber, Rectangle marginBounds)
		{
			UltraPreviewPageInfo ultraPreviewPageInfo = new UltraPreviewPageInfo(pageNumber, marginBounds);
			InternalAdd(ultraPreviewPageInfo);
			return ultraPreviewPageInfo;
		}

		internal void CheckForEqualPageSize()
		{
			allPagesHaveSameSize = true;
			allPagesHaveSameMargins = true;
			if (Count <= 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			Size physicalSize = this[0].PhysicalSize;
			Rectangle marginBounds = this[0].MarginBounds;
			for (int i = 1; i < Count; i++)
			{
				if (allPagesHaveSameSize && physicalSize != this[i].PhysicalSize)
				{
					allPagesHaveSameSize = false;
				}
				if (allPagesHaveSameMargins && marginBounds != this[i].MarginBounds)
				{
					allPagesHaveSameMargins = false;
				}
				if (!allPagesHaveSameSize && !allPagesHaveSameMargins)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override object[] CreateArray()
		{
			return new UltraPreviewPageInfo[Count];
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			DisposeCollectionItems();
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new UltraPreviewPageInfoCollectionEnumerator(this);
		}
	}
	internal class UltraPrintPreviewController : PrintController
	{
		private PreviewPrintController printController;

		private bool useAntiAlias;

		private UltraPreviewPageInfoCollection list;

		private int pageNumber;

		private int maximumPageNumber;

		private PointF dpi;

		public bool UseAntiAlias
		{
			get
			{
				return useAntiAlias;
			}
			set
			{
				useAntiAlias = value;
			}
		}

		public UltraPreviewPageInfoCollection PreviewPages
		{
			get
			{
				if (list == null)
				{
					list = new UltraPreviewPageInfoCollection();
				}
				return list;
			}
		}

		public int MaximumPageNumber
		{
			get
			{
				return maximumPageNumber;
			}
			set
			{
				maximumPageNumber = value;
			}
		}

		public PointF Dpi => dpi;

		public override bool IsPreview => true;

		private void SynchronizeLists(PreviewPageInfo[] pageInfo)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < pageInfo.Length; i++)
			{
				list[i].InitializePreviewPageInfo(pageInfo[i].Image, pageInfo[i].PhysicalSize);
			}
			list.CheckForEqualPageSize();
		}

		public override void OnStartPrint(PrintDocument document, PrintEventArgs e)
		{
			printController = new PreviewPrintController();
			list = new UltraPreviewPageInfoCollection();
			pageNumber = 0;
			dpi = PointF.Empty;
			base.OnStartPrint(document, e);
			printController.OnStartPrint(document, e);
		}

		public override Graphics OnStartPage(PrintDocument document, PrintPageEventArgs e)
		{
			if (printController == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			pageNumber++;
			list.Add(pageNumber, e.MarginBounds);
			printController.UseAntiAlias = useAntiAlias;
			Graphics graphics = printController.OnStartPage(document, e);
			if (graphics != null)
			{
				dpi = new PointF(graphics.DpiX, graphics.DpiY);
			}
			return graphics;
		}

		public override void OnEndPage(PrintDocument document, PrintPageEventArgs e)
		{
			if (printController != null)
			{
				printController.OnEndPage(document, e);
				if (maximumPageNumber > 0 && pageNumber >= maximumPageNumber)
				{
					e.HasMorePages = false;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void OnEndPrint(PrintDocument document, PrintEventArgs e)
		{
			if (printController != null)
			{
				printController.OnEndPrint(document, e);
				SynchronizeLists(printController.GetPreviewPageInfo());
				printController = null;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class UltraStatusPrintController : PrintController
	{
		private PrintController printController;

		private int pageNumber;

		private string documentName;

		private UltraStatusPrintDialog dialog;

		private Thread dialogThread;

		private bool dialogCancelled;

		private volatile bool printCancelled;

		private object syncObject = new object();

		private Point dialogCenter = Point.Empty;

		private string dialogTitle;

		private Exception printException;

		private string styleLibraryName = string.Empty;

		private string styleSetName = string.Empty;

		private bool useAppStyling = true;

		private bool IsPrintCancelled => dialogCancelled;

		internal Point DialogCenter
		{
			get
			{
				return dialogCenter;
			}
			set
			{
				dialogCenter = value;
			}
		}

		internal Exception PrintException => printException;

		internal string StyleLibraryName
		{
			get
			{
				return styleLibraryName;
			}
			set
			{
				styleLibraryName = value;
				if (dialog != null)
				{
					((AppStyledDialogBase)dialog).StyleLibraryName = styleLibraryName;
				}
			}
		}

		internal string StyleSetName
		{
			get
			{
				return styleSetName;
			}
			set
			{
				styleSetName = value;
				if (dialog != null)
				{
					((AppStyledDialogBase)dialog).StyleSetName = styleSetName;
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool UseAppStyling
		{
			get
			{
				return useAppStyling;
			}
			set
			{
				useAppStyling = value;
				if (dialog != null)
				{
					((AppStyledDialogBase)dialog).UseAppStyling = useAppStyling;
				}
			}
		}

		public override bool IsPreview => printController.IsPreview;

		public UltraStatusPrintController(PrintController printController)
			: this(printController, null)
		{
		}

		public UltraStatusPrintController(PrintController printController, string dialogTitle)
		{
			if (printController == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException();
			}
			this.printController = printController;
			this.dialogTitle = dialogTitle;
		}

		private void CreateBackgroundThread()
		{
			if (SystemInformation.UserInteractive)
			{
				Monitor.Enter(syncObject);
				try
				{
					printCancelled = false;
					dialogThread = new Thread(StartPrintStatusDialog);
					dialogThread.SetApartmentState(ApartmentState.STA);
					dialogThread.Start();
				}
				finally
				{
					Monitor.Exit(syncObject);
				}
			}
		}

		private void StopBackgroundThread()
		{
			Monitor.Enter(syncObject);
			try
			{
				printCancelled = true;
				if (dialogThread == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				Form form = (Form)(object)dialog;
				if (form != null)
				{
					if (form.IsHandleCreated)
					{
						if (!form.Disposing && !form.IsDisposed)
						{
							form.BeginInvoke(new MethodInvoker(form.Close));
						}
					}
					else
					{
						form.Close();
					}
					dialog = null;
				}
				if (dialogThread.IsAlive)
				{
					dialogThread.Join();
				}
				dialogThread = null;
			}
			finally
			{
				Monitor.Exit(syncObject);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateBackgroundThreadInfo()
		{
			if (printCancelled)
			{
				return;
			}
			Monitor.Enter(syncObject);
			try
			{
				UltraStatusPrintDialog ultraStatusPrintDialog = dialog;
				if (ultraStatusPrintDialog != null && ((Control)(object)ultraStatusPrintDialog).Visible && ((Control)(object)ultraStatusPrintDialog).IsHandleCreated && !((Control)(object)ultraStatusPrintDialog).Disposing && !((Control)(object)ultraStatusPrintDialog).IsDisposed)
				{
					((Control)(object)ultraStatusPrintDialog).BeginInvoke((Delegate)new UltraStatusPrintDialog.InitializePrintDialogDelegate(ultraStatusPrintDialog.Initialize), new object[2] { pageNumber, documentName });
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				Monitor.Exit(syncObject);
			}
		}

		private void StartPrintStatusDialog()
		{
			if (printCancelled)
			{
				return;
			}
			Monitor.Enter(syncObject);
			UltraStatusPrintDialog ultraStatusPrintDialog = null;
			try
			{
				if (!printCancelled)
				{
					Point point = dialogCenter;
					ultraStatusPrintDialog = new UltraStatusPrintDialog();
					((Form)(object)ultraStatusPrintDialog).TopMost = true;
					((Form)(object)ultraStatusPrintDialog).Closed += OnStatusDialogClosed;
					if (dialogTitle != null)
					{
						((Control)(object)ultraStatusPrintDialog).Text = dialogTitle;
					}
					if (!point.IsEmpty)
					{
						((Form)(object)ultraStatusPrintDialog).StartPosition = FormStartPosition.Manual;
						Size size = ((Form)(object)ultraStatusPrintDialog).Size;
						((Form)(object)ultraStatusPrintDialog).Location = new Point(point.X - size.Width / 2, point.Y - size.Height / 2);
					}
					((Control)(object)ultraStatusPrintDialog).Visible = true;
					dialog = ultraStatusPrintDialog;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				Monitor.Exit(syncObject);
			}
			Application.Run((Form)(object)ultraStatusPrintDialog);
			((Component)(object)ultraStatusPrintDialog).Dispose();
		}

		private void OnStatusDialogClosed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Form form = sender as Form;
			form.Closed -= OnStatusDialogClosed;
			dialogCancelled = form.DialogResult == DialogResult.Cancel;
		}

		public override void OnStartPrint(PrintDocument document, PrintEventArgs e)
		{
			try
			{
				base.OnStartPrint(document, e);
				pageNumber = 0;
				dialogCancelled = false;
				printController.OnStartPrint(document, e);
				if (!e.Cancel)
				{
					documentName = document.DocumentName;
					CreateBackgroundThread();
				}
			}
			catch (Win32Exception ex)
			{
				e.Cancel = true;
				printException = ex;
			}
		}

		public override Graphics OnStartPage(PrintDocument document, PrintPageEventArgs e)
		{
			pageNumber++;
			base.OnStartPage(document, e);
			UpdateBackgroundThreadInfo();
			try
			{
				return printController.OnStartPage(document, e);
			}
			finally
			{
				if (IsPrintCancelled)
				{
					e.Cancel = true;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void OnEndPage(PrintDocument document, PrintPageEventArgs e)
		{
			printController.OnEndPage(document, e);
			if (IsPrintCancelled)
			{
				e.Cancel = true;
			}
			base.OnEndPage(document, e);
		}

		public override void OnEndPrint(PrintDocument document, PrintEventArgs e)
		{
			printController.OnEndPrint(document, e);
			if (IsPrintCancelled)
			{
				e.Cancel = true;
			}
			StopBackgroundThread();
			base.OnEndPrint(document, e);
		}
	}
	internal class ExtendedPrintController : StandardPrintController
	{
		private Exception printException;

		public Exception PrintException => printException;

		public override void OnStartPrint(PrintDocument document, PrintEventArgs e)
		{
			try
			{
				base.OnStartPrint(document, e);
			}
			catch (Win32Exception ex)
			{
				e.Cancel = true;
				printException = ex;
			}
		}
	}

		internal bool HasPreviousPage
		{
			get
			{
				if (Control.PageCount == 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return GetCurrentPage() > 0;
			}
		}

		internal bool HasNextPage
		{
			get
			{
				if (Control.PageCount == 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (GetCurrentPage() == Control.PageCount - 1)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (LastPossiblePageInView < Control.PageCount - 1)
				{
					return true;
				}
				int num = PreviewRows.Length - 1;
				if (PreviewRows[num].FirstPage == PreviewRows[num].LastPage)
				{
					return !IsPageFullyInView(PreviewRows[num].LastPage);
				}
				if (IsPageFullyInView(PreviewRows[num].LastPage))
				{
					return !IsPageFullyInView(PreviewRows[num].FirstPage);
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal void OnPropertyChanged(PropChangeInfo pci)
		{
			//IL_01da: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01df: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01e0: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01e2: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_00cf: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00e4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00e9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00f0: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0105: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_010a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (Control.IsInitializing || ((Control)(object)Control).Disposing)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (pci.PropId is UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds)
			{
				switch ((UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds)(object)pci.PropId)
				{
				case UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.Settings:
					if (pci.Trigger != null)
					{
						OnPropertyChanged(pci.Trigger);
						break;
					}
					Dirty(MetricsDirtyStates.All);
					verifyMetricsUpdateHistory = true;
					break;
				case UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.ShowHorizontalScrollBar:
				case UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.ShowVerticalScrollBar:
					Dirty(MetricsDirtyStates.ScrollInfo | MetricsDirtyStates.ClientAreaSizeInfo);
					break;
				case UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.BorderStyle:
				{
					UIElementBorderWidths val = DrawUtility.CalculateBorderWidths(lastBorderStyle, Border3DSide.All, (UIElement)(object)((IUltraControlElement)Control).MainUIElement);
					UIElementBorderWidths val2 = DrawUtility.CalculateBorderWidths(Control.BorderStyleResolved, Border3DSide.All, (UIElement)(object)((IUltraControlElement)Control).MainUIElement);
					if (((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Left != ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val2)).Left || ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Top != ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val2)).Top || ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Right != ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val2)).Right || ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val)).Bottom != ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val2)).Bottom)
					{
						Dirty(MetricsDirtyStates.ClientAreaSizeInfo);
					}
					break;
				}
				case UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.PageNumberDisplayStyle:
					Dirty(MetricsDirtyStates.Layout);
					break;
				case UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.Appearance:
				case UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.PageAppearance:
				case UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.PageNumberAppearance:
				case UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.CurrentPageNumberAppearance:
				case UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.CurrentPageAppearance:
					if (pci.Trigger == null)
					{
						OnFontChanged();
					}
					else if (Utilities.IsFontDataChange(pci.Trigger))
					{
						OnFontChanged();
					}
					break;
				case UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.Zoom:
					if (Control.Settings.ZoomMode == ZoomMode.Standard || Control.Settings.ZoomMode == ZoomMode.AutoFlow)
					{
						verifyMetricsUpdateHistory = true;
						Dirty(MetricsDirtyStates.Layout);
					}
					break;
				case UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.ZoomMode:
				case UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.Columns:
				case UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.Rows:
					verifyMetricsUpdateHistory = true;
					Dirty(MetricsDirtyStates.Layout);
					break;
				case UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.ScrollBarLook:
				case UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.AcceptsFocus:
				case UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.ScrollMode:
				case UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.ScrollTipStyle:
				case UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.MouseAction:
				case UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.DisplayPreviewStatus:
				case UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.AutoGeneratePreview:
				case UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.MousePanning:
				case UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.MaximumPreviewPages:
				case UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.ViewBoxAppearance:
					break;
				}
			}
			else if (pci.PropId is UltraControlPropIds)
			{
				UltraControlPropIds val3 = (UltraControlPropIds)(object)pci.PropId;
				if ((int)val3 == 5)
				{
					Dirty(MetricsDirtyStates.ClientAreaSizeInfo);
				}
			}
		}

		internal ScrollRange CalculatePageScrollRange(UltraPreviewPageInfo page)
		{

		}
