						Point point2 = new Point(rect2.X - rect.X, rect2.Y - rect.Y);
						Point position = Cursor.Position;
						position.X += point2.X;
						position.Y += point2.Y;
						if (Utilities.SetCursorPosition(position))
						{
							e = new MouseEventArgs(mouseArgs.Button, mouseArgs.Clicks, mouseArgs.X + point2.X, mouseArgs.Y + point2.Y, mouseArgs.Delta);
						}
					}
					catch (SecurityException)
					{
					}
				}
				pageElement.ViewBoxElement.InternalProcessMouseDown(e, adjustableArea: false, ref captureMouseForElement);
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void ProcessZoomIn(Rectangle selectionRect)
		{
			selectionRect = Utilities.Normalize(selectionRect);
			if (selectionRect.Width <= 2 || selectionRect.Height <= 2)
			{
				ZoomUsingIncrement(selectionRect.Location, zoomOut: false);
				return;
			}
			selectionRect = Utilities.Normalize(selectionRect);
			selectionRect.Inflate(-1, -1);
			if (selectionRect.Size.IsEmpty)
			{
				return;
			}
			float num = (float)VisibleZoom;
			SizeF sizeF = new SizeF((float)selectionRect.Width / num, (float)selectionRect.Height / num);
			double val = Utilities.Round((double)ActualClientSize.Width / (double)sizeF.Width - 0.0005, 3);
			double val2 = Utilities.Round((double)ActualClientSize.Height / (double)sizeF.Height - 0.0005, 3);
			double zoom = Math.Min(val, val2);
			Point pageAreaLocation = new Point(selectionRect.X + selectionRect.Width / 2, selectionRect.Y + selectionRect.Height / 2);
			PageOffsetInfo offsetInfo = CreatePageOffsetInfo(pageAreaLocation);
			try
			{
				SuspendMetricsHistoryAdditions();
				SetZoom(zoom);
				ScrollUsingPageOffsetInfo(offsetInfo);
				AddToViewHistory();
			}
			finally
			{
				ResumeMetricsHistoryAdditions();
			}
		}

		internal void ProcessZoomOut(Rectangle selectionRect)
		{
			selectionRect = Utilities.Normalize(selectionRect);
			if (selectionRect.Width <= 2 || selectionRect.Height <= 2)
			{
				ZoomUsingIncrement(selectionRect.Location, zoomOut: true);
				return;
			}
			selectionRect = Utilities.Normalize(selectionRect);
			selectionRect.Inflate(-1, -1);
			if (selectionRect.Size.IsEmpty)
			{
				return;
			}
			float num = (float)VisibleZoom;
			SizeF sizeF = new SizeF((float)ActualClientSize.Width / num, (float)ActualClientSize.Height / num);
			double val = Utilities.Round((double)selectionRect.Width / (double)sizeF.Width - 0.0005, 3);
			double val2 = Utilities.Round((double)selectionRect.Height / (double)sizeF.Height - 0.0005, 3);
			double zoom = Math.Max(val, val2);
			Point pageAreaLocation = new Point(selectionRect.X + selectionRect.Width / 2, selectionRect.Y + selectionRect.Height / 2);
			PageOffsetInfo offsetInfo = CreatePageOffsetInfo(pageAreaLocation);
			try
			{
				SuspendMetricsHistoryAdditions();
				SetZoom(zoom);
				ScrollUsingPageOffsetInfo(offsetInfo);
				AddToViewHistory();
			}
			finally
			{
				ResumeMetricsHistoryAdditions();
			}
		}

		internal PageOffsetInfo CreatePageOffsetInfo()
		{
			Size actualClientSize = ActualClientSize;
			if (actualClientSize.Width <= 0 || actualClientSize.Height <= 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return CreatePageOffsetInfo(new Point(actualClientSize.Width / 2, actualClientSize.Height / 2));
		}

		internal PageOffsetInfo CreatePageOffsetInfo(Point pageAreaLocation)
		{
			int num = VisibleFixedRow;
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int num2 = VerticalScrollValue - FixedRows[num].VerticalScrollOrigin;
			Point fixedRowOffset = GetFixedRowOffset(num);
			int previewRowFromScrollPos = GetPreviewRowFromScrollPos(num2 + pageAreaLocation.Y - fixedRowOffset.Y, num);
			int[] closestPagesFromHorizontalOffset = GetClosestPagesFromHorizontalOffset(previewRowFromScrollPos, HorizontalScrollInfo.Value + pageAreaLocation.X - fixedRowOffset.X);
			PageRect[] array = new PageRect[closestPagesFromHorizontalOffset.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < closestPagesFromHorizontalOffset.Length; i++)
			{
				ref PageRect reference = ref array[i];
				reference = new PageRect(closestPagesFromHorizontalOffset[i], GetPageRectangle(closestPagesFromHorizontalOffset[i]));
			}
			int num3 = int.MaxValue;
			PageRect pageRect = array[0];
			pageAreaLocation.Offset(HorizontalScrollInfo.Value, num2);
			for (int j = 0; j < array.Length; j++)
			{
				Rectangle rect = array[j].Rect;
				if (Math.Abs(rect.X - pageAreaLocation.X) < num3 || Math.Abs(rect.Right - pageAreaLocation.X) < num3)
				{
					pageRect = array[j];
					num3 = Math.Min(Math.Abs(rect.X - pageAreaLocation.X), Math.Abs(rect.Right - pageAreaLocation.X));
				}
			}
			Point empty = Point.Empty;
			Point empty2 = Point.Empty;
			Rectangle rect2 = pageRect.Rect;
			if (rect2.Contains(rect2.X, pageAreaLocation.Y))
			{
				empty2.Y = pageAreaLocation.Y - rect2.Y;
			}
			else if (pageAreaLocation.Y < rect2.Y)
			{
				empty.Y = pageAreaLocation.Y - rect2.Y;
			}
			else
			{
				empty.Y = pageAreaLocation.Y - rect2.Bottom;
			}
			if (rect2.Contains(pageAreaLocation.X, rect2.Y))
			{
				empty2.X = pageAreaLocation.X - rect2.X;
			}
			else if (pageAreaLocation.X < rect2.X)
			{
				empty.X = pageAreaLocation.X - rect2.X;
			}
			else
			{
				empty.X = pageAreaLocation.X - rect2.Right;
			}
			return new PageOffsetInfo(pageRect.PageNumber, empty2, empty, FixedRows[num].Zoom);
		}

		internal void ScrollUsingPageOffsetInfo(PageOffsetInfo offsetInfo)
		{
			if (offsetInfo == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			VerifyMetrics(MetricsDirtyStates.All);
			if (FixedRows.Length == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (offsetInfo == PageOffsetInfo.UpperLeftOrigin)
			{
				Scroll(0, 0, update: false, 0);
				return;
			}
			int fixedRowFromPage = GetFixedRowFromPage(offsetInfo.PageNumber);
			Rectangle pageRectangle = GetPageRectangle(offsetInfo.PageNumber);
			Point point = Point.Ceiling(ConvertToDisplaySize(offsetInfo.ScaleableOffset, (float)offsetInfo.OriginalZoom, (float)FixedRows[fixedRowFromPage].Zoom));
			int num = pageRectangle.X + point.X + offsetInfo.NonScalableOffset.X;
			if (offsetInfo.NonScalableOffset.X > 0)
			{
				num += pageRectangle.Width;
			}
			int num2 = FixedRows[fixedRowFromPage].VerticalScrollOrigin + pageRectangle.Top + point.Y + offsetInfo.NonScalableOffset.Y;
			if (offsetInfo.NonScalableOffset.Y > 0)
			{
				num2 += pageRectangle.Height;
			}
			num -= ActualClientSize.Width / 2;
			num2 -= ActualClientSize.Height / 2;
			Scroll(num, num2, update: false, fixedRowFromPage);
		}

		internal void SetZoom(double zoom)
		{
			if (Control.Settings.ZoomMode != ZoomMode.Standard && Control.Settings.ZoomMode != ZoomMode.AutoFlow)
			{
				Control.Settings.ZoomMode = ZoomMode.Standard;
			}
			Control.Settings.Zoom = Control.EnsureZoomIsInRange(zoom);
		}

		internal void AddToViewHistory()
		{
			AddToViewHistory(calledFromVerify: false);
		}

		internal void GoToPreviousView()
		{
			if (CanGoToPreviousView)
			{
				history.MoveBack();
				GoToView((PageHistoryItem)history.Current);
			}
		}

		internal void GoToNextView()
		{
			if (CanGoToNextView)
			{
				history.MoveForward();
				GoToView((PageHistoryItem)history.Current);
			}
		}

		internal void ResetViewHistory(bool keepCurrentEntry)
		{
			if (history != null)
			{
				object current = history.Current;
				history.Clear();
				if (keepCurrentEntry && current != null)
				{
					history.AddItem(current);
				}
				OnViewHistoryChangedHelper();
			}
		}

		internal int GetCurrentPage()
		{
			VerifyMetrics(MetricsDirtyStates.All);
			return lastCurrentPage;
		}

		internal bool SetCurrentPage(int newCurrentPage, bool update)
		{
			VerifyMetrics(MetricsDirtyStates.All);
			int num = newCurrentPage + 1;
			if (num > Control.PageCount || num < 1)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("value", num, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_PropertyValueOutOfRange", "CurrentPage", 1, Control.PageCount));
			}
			GetCurrentPage();
			int fixedRowFromPage = GetFixedRowFromPage(newCurrentPage);
			int pageVerticalScrollValue = GetPageVerticalScrollValue(newCurrentPage);
			int pageHorizontalScrollValue = GetPageHorizontalScrollValue(newCurrentPage);
			pageHorizontalScrollValue -= Control.PageBorderSize.Width / 2;
			pageVerticalScrollValue -= Control.PageBorderSize.Height / 2;
			Scroll(pageHorizontalScrollValue, pageVerticalScrollValue, update, fixedRowFromPage);
			VerifyMetrics(MetricsDirtyStates.All);
			AddToViewHistory();
			if (GetCurrentPage() != newCurrentPage)
			{
				return IsPageFullyInView(newCurrentPage);
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal bool ScrollToPreviousPage()
		{
			VerifyMetrics(MetricsDirtyStates.All);
			if (!HasPreviousPage)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int currentPage = GetCurrentPage();
			if (currentPage <= 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int newCurrentPage = currentPage - 1;
			return SetCurrentPage(newCurrentPage, update: true);
		}

		internal bool ScrollToNextPage()
		{
			VerifyMetrics(MetricsDirtyStates.All);
			if (!HasNextPage)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int currentPage = GetCurrentPage();
			if (currentPage >= Control.PageCount - 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int previewRowFromPage = GetPreviewRowFromPage(currentPage);
			int num = -1;
			Size pageBorderSize = Control.PageBorderSize;
			Rectangle calculatedClientArea = CalculatedClientArea;
			if (currentPage < PreviewRows[previewRowFromPage].LastPage)
			{
				PageRect[] previewRowPageRects = GetPreviewRowPageRects(previewRowFromPage, previewRowFromPage);
				for (int i = 0; i < previewRowPageRects.Length; i++)
				{
					if (previewRowPageRects[i].PageNumber > currentPage)
					{
						Rectangle rect = previewRowPageRects[i].Rect;
						rect.Inflate(-pageBorderSize.Width / 2, -pageBorderSize.Height / 2);
						Rectangle rectangle = rect;
						rectangle.Intersect(calculatedClientArea);
						if (!(rect == rectangle))
						{
							num = previewRowPageRects[i].PageNumber;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (num < 0)
			{
				if (previewRowFromPage >= PreviewRows.Length)
				{
					return false;
				}
				int num2 = previewRowFromPage + 1;
				int lastPreviewRow = FixedRows[GetFixedRowFromPreviewRow(previewRowFromPage)].LastPreviewRow;
				if (lastPreviewRow == previewRowFromPage)
				{
					num = PreviewRows[num2].FirstPage;
				}
				else
				{
					lastPreviewRow = Math.Min(lastPreviewRowInView + 1, lastPreviewRow);
					PageRect[] previewRowPageRects2 = GetPreviewRowPageRects(num2, lastPreviewRow);
					for (int j = 0; j < previewRowPageRects2.Length; j++)
					{
						Rectangle rect2 = previewRowPageRects2[j].Rect;
						rect2.Inflate(-pageBorderSize.Width / 2, -pageBorderSize.Height / 2);
						Rectangle rectangle2 = rect2;
						rectangle2.Intersect(calculatedClientArea);
						if (!(rect2 == rectangle2))
						{
							num = previewRowPageRects2[j].PageNumber;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				if (num < 0)
				{
					int pageVerticalScrollValue = GetPageVerticalScrollValue(PreviewRows[num2].FirstPage);
					if (pageVerticalScrollValue == GetPageVerticalScrollValue(currentPage))
					{
						int fixedRowFromPreviewRow = GetFixedRowFromPreviewRow(previewRowFromPage);
						fixedRowFromPreviewRow++;
						if (fixedRowFromPreviewRow >= FixedRows.Length)
						{
							return false;
						}
						num = PreviewRows[FixedRows[fixedRowFromPreviewRow].FirstPreviewRow].FirstPage;
					}
				}
			}
			return SetCurrentPage(num, update: true);
		}

		internal void EnsurePageIsInView(int pageNumber)
		{
			VerifyMetrics(MetricsDirtyStates.All);
			if (pageNumber < 0 || pageNumber >= Control.PageCount)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
			}
			int currentPage = GetCurrentPage();
			if (currentPage != pageNumber && !IsPageFullyInView(pageNumber))
			{
				SetCurrentPage(pageNumber, update: false);
			}
		}

		internal bool IsPageFullyInView(int pageNumber)
		{
			VerifyMetrics(MetricsDirtyStates.All);
			if (pageNumber < 0 || pageNumber >= Control.PageCount)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
			}
			Rectangle pageRectangle = GetPageRectangle(pageNumber);
			pageRectangle.Inflate(-Control.PageBorderSize.Width / 2, -Control.PageBorderSize.Height / 2);
			Rectangle calculatedClientArea = CalculatedClientArea;
			return Rectangle.Intersect(calculatedClientArea, pageRectangle) == pageRectangle;
		}

		internal bool IsPageInView(int pageNumber)
		{
			VerifyMetrics(MetricsDirtyStates.All);
			if (pageNumber < 0 || pageNumber >= Control.PageCount)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
			}
			Rectangle pageRectangle = GetPageRectangle(pageNumber);
			pageRectangle.Inflate(-Control.PageBorderSize.Width / 2, -Control.PageBorderSize.Height / 2);
			Rectangle calculatedClientArea = CalculatedClientArea;
			return !Rectangle.Intersect(calculatedClientArea, pageRectangle).Size.IsEmpty;
		}

		internal AccessibleObject GetPageAccessibleObject(int pageIndex)
		{
			if (pageIndex < 0 || pageIndex > Control.PageCount - 1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (pageAccessibleObjects == null)
			{
				pageAccessibleObjects = new AccessibleObject[Control.PageCount];
			}
			if (pageAccessibleObjects[pageIndex] == null)
			{
				pageAccessibleObjects[pageIndex] = Control.CreatePageAccessibilityInstance(pageIndex);
			}
			return pageAccessibleObjects[pageIndex];
		}

		internal AccessibleObject Navigate(int pageIndex, AccessibleNavigation navdir)
		{
			VerifyMetrics(MetricsDirtyStates.All);
			switch (navdir)
			{
			case AccessibleNavigation.Up:
			case AccessibleNavigation.Down:
			{
				int num = NavigateUpDownHelper(pageIndex, navdir == AccessibleNavigation.Up);
				if (num < 0 || num >= Control.PageCount)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return GetPageAccessibleObject(num);
			}
			case AccessibleNavigation.Left:
			{
				int previewRowFromPage2 = GetPreviewRowFromPage(pageIndex);
				if (PreviewRows[previewRowFromPage2].FirstPage < pageIndex)
				{
					return GetPageAccessibleObject(pageIndex - 1);
				}
				return null;
			}
			case AccessibleNavigation.Right:
			{
				int previewRowFromPage = GetPreviewRowFromPage(pageIndex);
				if (PreviewRows[previewRowFromPage].LastPage > pageIndex)
				{
					return GetPageAccessibleObject(pageIndex + 1);
				}
				return null;
			}
			case AccessibleNavigation.Next:
				if (pageIndex < Control.PageCount - 1)
				{
					return GetPageAccessibleObject(pageIndex + 1);
				}
				return null;
			case AccessibleNavigation.Previous:
				if (pageIndex > 0)
				{
					return GetPageAccessibleObject(pageIndex - 1);
				}
				return null;
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal int GetMarginExtent(bool isHorizontal, bool near)
		{
			int currentPage = GetCurrentPage();
			if (currentPage < 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			UltraPreviewPageInfo previewPage = Control.GetPreviewPage(currentPage);
			int valueInHundredsOfAnInch = (isHorizontal ? ((!near) ? (previewPage.PhysicalSize.Width - previewPage.MarginBounds.Right) : previewPage.MarginBounds.Left) : ((!near) ? (previewPage.PhysicalSize.Height - previewPage.MarginBounds.Bottom) : previewPage.MarginBounds.Top));
			return ConvertToDisplaySize(valueInHundredsOfAnInch, (float)CurrentZoom, isHorizontal ? Dpi.X : Dpi.Y);
		}

		internal int GetVisiblePageExtent(bool isHorizontal)
		{
			int currentPage = GetCurrentPage();
			if (currentPage < 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			UltraPreviewPageInfo previewPage = Control.GetPreviewPage(currentPage);
			int valueInHundredsOfAnInch = ((!isHorizontal) ? previewPage.MarginBounds.Height : previewPage.MarginBounds.Width);
			return ConvertToDisplaySize(valueInHundredsOfAnInch, (float)CurrentZoom, isHorizontal ? Dpi.X : Dpi.Y);
		}

		internal Rectangle GetCurrentPageRect(bool includeBorder)
		{
			int currentPage = GetCurrentPage();
			if (currentPage < 0)
			{
				return Rectangle.Empty;
			}
			Rectangle pageRectangle = GetPageRectangle(currentPage);
			Rectangle calculatedClientArea = CalculatedClientArea;
			pageRectangle.Offset(-calculatedClientArea.Left, -calculatedClientArea.Top);
			pageRectangle.Offset(ClientAreaOffset);
			if (!includeBorder)
			{
				pageRectangle.Inflate(-Control.PageBorderSize.Width, -Control.PageBorderSize.Height);
			}
			return pageRectangle;
		}

		internal int GetRulerPageExtentInHundredthsOfAnInch(bool isHorizontal)
		{
			int currentPage = GetCurrentPage();
			if (currentPage >= 0 && currentPage < Control.PageCount)
			{
				Size physicalSize = Control.GetPreviewPage(currentPage).PhysicalSize;
				if (!isHorizontal)
				{
					return physicalSize.Height;
				}
				return physicalSize.Width;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		private Rectangle CalculateClientArea(int verticalScrollValue)
		{
			Rectangle result = new Rectangle(Point.Empty, ActualClientSize);
			result.Offset(HorizontalScrollInfo.Value, verticalScrollValue - FixedRows[VisibleFixedRow].VerticalScrollOrigin);
			return result;
		}

		private double CalculateRowZoom(Size availableSize, int firstPage, int columnsPerRow, int rows, bool includeHeight, bool useMarginSize)
		{
			int pageCount = control.PageCount;
			if (pageCount == 0)
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			bool flag = Control.Settings.Rows > 0;
			Size pageBorderSize = control.PageBorderSize;
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			int val = rows * columnsPerRow + firstPage;
			int num3 = Math.Min(pageCount, val);
			bool flag2 = true;
			if (!useMarginSize)
			{
				availableSize.Width -= 6;
				availableSize.Height -= 6;
				if (control.Settings.PageNumberDisplayStyleResolved == PageNumberDisplayStyle.LeftOfRow)
				{
					availableSize.Width -= PageNumberExtraRowWidth;
				}
			}
			int num4 = 0;
			int num5 = 0;
			int num6 = pageBorderSize.Height;
			if (flag2)
			{
				num6 += 2;
			}
			if (control.Settings.PageNumberDisplayStyleResolved == PageNumberDisplayStyle.BelowEachPage)
			{
				num6 += PageNumberExtraRowHeight;
			}
			for (int i = firstPage; i < num3; i += columnsPerRow)
			{
				int num7 = 0;
				int num8 = 0;
				int num9 = 0;
				for (int j = 0; j < columnsPerRow && i + j < num3; j++)
				{
					UltraPreviewPageInfo previewPage = control.GetPreviewPage(i + j);
					Size physicalSize = previewPage.PhysicalSize;
					num7 += physicalSize.Width;
					if (useMarginSize)
					{
						if (j == 0)
						{
							num7 -= previewPage.MarginBounds.Left;
						}
						if (j == columnsPerRow - 1)
						{
							num7 -= physicalSize.Width - previewPage.MarginBounds.Right;
						}
					}
					if (flag2)
					{
						num9 += 2;
					}
					num9 += pageBorderSize.Width;
					if (j > 0)
					{
						num9 += 6;
					}
					num8 = Math.Max(num8, physicalSize.Height);
				}
				if (useMarginSize)
				{
					if (flag2)
					{
						num9 -= 2;
					}
					num9 -= pageBorderSize.Width;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					num5 += num6;
					num += num8;
				}
				else
				{
					num = Math.Max(num, num8);
				}
				if (flag && i > firstPage)
				{
					num5 += 6;
				}
				if (num7 > num2)
				{
					num2 = num7;
					num4 = num9;
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				num5 += num6;
			}
			Size size = new Size(num2, num);
			availableSize.Width -= num4;
			availableSize.Height -= num5;
			int num10 = (int)((float)size.Width / 100f * Dpi.X);
			double num11 = Utilities.Round((double)availableSize.Width / (double)num10 - 0.0005, 3);
			double potentialZoom;
			if (!includeHeight)
			{
				potentialZoom = num11;
			}
			else
			{
				int num12 = (int)((float)size.Height / 100f * Dpi.Y);
				double val2 = Utilities.Round((double)availableSize.Height / (double)num12 - 0.0005, 3);
				potentialZoom = Math.Min(num11, val2);
			}
			return Control.EnsureZoomIsInRange(potentialZoom);
		}

		private void GeneratePreviewLayout(Size availableSize)
		{
			UltraPrintPreviewControlBase ultraPrintPreviewControlBase = Control;
			bool flag = ultraPrintPreviewControlBase.Settings.ZoomMode == ZoomMode.AutoFlow;
			int columnsResolved = ultraPrintPreviewControlBase.ColumnsResolved;
			int rows = ultraPrintPreviewControlBase.Settings.Rows;
			int columns = ultraPrintPreviewControlBase.Settings.Columns;
			int num = ((ultraPrintPreviewControlBase.Settings.Rows == 0) ? ultraPrintPreviewControlBase.PageCount : ultraPrintPreviewControlBase.Settings.Rows);
			bool flag2 = ultraPrintPreviewControlBase.Settings.ZoomMode != ZoomMode.Standard && !flag;
			bool includeHeight = false;
			bool useMarginSize = false;
			switch (ultraPrintPreviewControlBase.Settings.ZoomMode)
			{
			case ZoomMode.WholePage:
				includeHeight = true;
				break;
			case ZoomMode.MarginsWidth:
				useMarginSize = true;
				break;
			}

		private void OnVerticalScroll(object sender, ScrollEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_009b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a1: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_00a9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00af: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0058: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005e: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			switch (e.Type)
			{
			case ScrollEventType.ThumbTrack:
				if (!isScrollTrackValueSet)
				{
					isScrollTrackValueSet = true;
					preScrollTrackMoveValue = VerticalScrollInfo.Value;
				}
				if ((int)Control.ScrollTipStyleResolved == 1)
				{
					int previewRowFromScrollPos2 = GetPreviewRowFromScrollPos(e.NewValue, adjustBasedOnPositionWithinRow: true);
					if (previewRowFromScrollPos2 >= 0)
					{
						Control.ShowScrollTip(previewRows[previewRowFromScrollPos2].FirstPage);
					}
				}
				break;
			case ScrollEventType.ThumbPosition:
				if ((int)Control.ScrollModeResolved == 2)
				{
					if ((int)Control.ScrollTipStyleResolved == 1)
					{
						int previewRowFromScrollPos = GetPreviewRowFromScrollPos(e.NewValue, adjustBasedOnPositionWithinRow: true);
						if (GetFixedRowFromPreviewRow(previewRowFromScrollPos) != VisibleFixedRow)
						{
							e.NewValue = GetPageVerticalScrollValue(previewRows[previewRowFromScrollPos].FirstPage);
						}
					}
					ProcessVertScrollPosChanged(e.NewValue);
					Control.DirtyChildElements(invalidate: true);
				}
				isScrollTrackValueSet = false;
				Control.HideScrollTip();
				break;
			case ScrollEventType.SmallDecrement:
			case ScrollEventType.SmallIncrement:
			case ScrollEventType.LargeDecrement:
			case ScrollEventType.LargeIncrement:
				e.NewValue = AdjustVerticalScrollValueForFixedRows(e.NewValue, ensureSingleFixedRowChange: true);
				break;
			case ScrollEventType.EndScroll:
				isScrollTrackValueSet = false;
				AddToViewHistory();
				break;
			case ScrollEventType.First:
			case ScrollEventType.Last:
				break;
			}
		}

		private int AdjustVerticalScrollValueForFixedRows(int newVertScrollPos, bool ensureSingleFixedRowChange)
		{

			if (ensureSingleFixedRowChange)
			{
				int fixedRowFromScrollPos = GetFixedRowFromScrollPos(num);
				int num2 = VisibleFixedRow;
				if (Math.Abs(num2 - fixedRowFromScrollPos) > 1)
				{
					num = ((fixedRowFromScrollPos >= num2) ? FixedRows[num2 + 1].VerticalScrollOrigin : FixedRows[num2 - 1].VerticalScrollBottom);
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private int AdjustVerticalScrollValueForFixedRows(int newVertScrollPos)
		{
			if (fixedRows.Length <= 1)
			{
				if (fixedRows.Length == 0)
				{
					return newVertScrollPos;
				}
				return Math.Min(FixedRows[0].VerticalScrollBottom, newVertScrollPos);
			}
			int num = VisibleFixedRow;
			int num2 = fixedRows.Length - 1;
			if (newVertScrollPos < fixedRows[num].VerticalScrollOrigin)
			{
				if (newVertScrollPos >= 0 && lastVertScrollValue == fixedRows[num].VerticalScrollOrigin)
				{
					return fixedRows[GetFixedRowFromScrollPos(newVertScrollPos)].VerticalScrollBottom;
				}
				return fixedRows[num].VerticalScrollOrigin;
			}
			if (num == num2)
			{
				return Math.Min(FixedRows[num].VerticalScrollBottom, newVertScrollPos);
			}
			if (num != num2 && newVertScrollPos <= fixedRows[num].VerticalScrollBottom)
			{
				return newVertScrollPos;
			}
			if (lastVertScrollValue == fixedRows[num].VerticalScrollBottom)
			{
				return fixedRows[GetFixedRowFromScrollPos(newVertScrollPos)].VerticalScrollOrigin;
			}
			return fixedRows[num].VerticalScrollBottom;
		}

		private bool IsDirty(MetricsDirtyStates state)
		{
			return (dirtyState & state) != 0;
		}

		internal void Dirty(MetricsDirtyStates state)
		{
			if ((state & MetricsDirtyStates.ClientAreaSizeInfo) == 0)
			{
				StoreCurrentPageOffset();
			}
			dirtyState |= state;
			if ((state & MetricsDirtyStates.PageNumberSizeInfo) != MetricsDirtyStates.None)
			{
				pageNumberExtraRowWidth = 0;
				pageNumberExtraRowHeight = 0;
				pageNumberTextSize = Size.Empty;
				if (Control.Settings.PageNumberDisplayStyleResolved != PageNumberDisplayStyle.None)
				{
					Dirty(MetricsDirtyStates.Layout);
				}
			}
			if ((state & MetricsDirtyStates.RulerInfo) != MetricsDirtyStates.None && UsesRulerInfo)
			{
				RulerInfo.DirtyTextSizeInfo();
				rulerExtent = 0;
				Dirty(MetricsDirtyStates.ClientAreaSizeInfo);
			}
			if ((state & MetricsDirtyStates.ClientAreaSizeInfo) != MetricsDirtyStates.None)
			{
				ResetPageOffsetInfo(startAtTop: false);
				Size size = calculatedClientAreaSize;
				calculatedClientAreaSize = Size.Empty;
				bool flag = true;
				switch (Control.Settings.ZoomMode)
				{
				case ZoomMode.Standard:
					Dirty(MetricsDirtyStates.ScrollInfo);
					flag = false;
					break;
				case ZoomMode.PageWidth:
				case ZoomMode.MarginsWidth:
					if (size.Width == ActualClientSize.Width)
					{
						Dirty(MetricsDirtyStates.VertScrollInfo);
						flag = false;
					}
					break;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					Dirty(MetricsDirtyStates.Layout);
				}
			}
			if ((state & MetricsDirtyStates.PreviewRows) != MetricsDirtyStates.None)
			{
				previewRows = new PreviewRow[0];
				fixedRows = new FixedPreviewRow[0];
			}
			if ((state & MetricsDirtyStates.HorzScrollInfo) != MetricsDirtyStates.None && !base.Disposed && !((Control)(object)Control).Disposing && !((Control)(object)Control).IsDisposed)
			{
				if (state == MetricsDirtyStates.All)
				{
					HorizontalScrollInfo.Initialize(0, 0, 1, 1);
				}
				else
				{
					HorizontalScrollInfo.Enabled = false;
				}
			}
			if ((state & MetricsDirtyStates.VertScrollInfo) != MetricsDirtyStates.None && !base.Disposed && !((Control)(object)Control).Disposing && !((Control)(object)Control).IsDisposed)
			{
				if (state == MetricsDirtyStates.All)
				{
					VerticalScrollInfo.Initialize(0, 0, 1, 1);
				}
				else
				{
					VerticalScrollInfo.Enabled = false;
				}
			}
			Control.DirtyChildElements(invalidate: true);
		}

		private void VerifyMetrics(MetricsDirtyStates state)
		{
			//IL_0121: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0126: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_012d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0142: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0147: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0087: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00bd: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if ((dirtyState & state) == 0 || isInVerifyMetrics)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = isInVerifyMetrics;
			isInVerifyMetrics = true;
			MetricsDirtyStates metricsDirtyStates = dirtyState;
			try
			{
				if ((state & MetricsDirtyStates.PageNumberSizeInfo) != MetricsDirtyStates.None && IsDirty(MetricsDirtyStates.PageNumberSizeInfo))
				{
					CalculatePageNumberSizeInfo();
				}
				if ((state & MetricsDirtyStates.RulerInfo) != MetricsDirtyStates.None && IsDirty(MetricsDirtyStates.RulerInfo))
				{
					if (UsesRulerInfo)
					{
						Graphics cachedGraphics = DrawUtility.GetCachedGraphics((Control)(object)control);
						Font font = ((Control)(object)Control).Font;
						Font font2 = null;
						try
						{
							AppearanceData appearance = default(AppearanceData);
							AppearancePropFlags requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)65011720;
							((UltraPrintPreviewControl)control).ResolveRulerAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
							font2 = ((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).CreateFont(font);
							if (font2 == null)
							{
								font2 = font;
							}
							rulerExtent = Size.Ceiling(DrawUtility.MeasureString(cachedGraphics, "0123456789", font2, DrawUtility.GetGdiDrawStringFlags((UltraControlBase)(object)Control))).Height;
							rulerExtent += 6;
						}
						finally
						{
							DrawUtility.ReleaseCachedGraphics(cachedGraphics);
							if (font2 != font)
							{
								font2.Dispose();
							}
						}
					}
					dirtyState &= ~MetricsDirtyStates.RulerInfo;
				}
				if ((state & MetricsDirtyStates.ClientAreaSizeInfo) != MetricsDirtyStates.None && IsDirty(MetricsDirtyStates.ClientAreaSizeInfo))
				{
					lastBorderStyle = Control.BorderStyleResolved;
					borderWidth = DrawUtility.CalculateBorderWidths(lastBorderStyle, Border3DSide.All, (UIElement)(object)((IUltraControlElement)Control).MainUIElement);
					_ = ActualClientSize;
					dirtyState &= ~MetricsDirtyStates.ClientAreaSizeInfo;
				}
				if ((state & MetricsDirtyStates.PreviewRows) != MetricsDirtyStates.None && IsDirty(MetricsDirtyStates.PreviewRows))
				{
					GeneratePreviewLayout(ActualClientSize);
				}
				if ((state & MetricsDirtyStates.VertScrollInfo) != MetricsDirtyStates.None && IsDirty(MetricsDirtyStates.VertScrollInfo))
				{
					UpdateVerticalScrollInfo(ActualClientSize);
				}
				if ((state & MetricsDirtyStates.HorzScrollInfo) != MetricsDirtyStates.None && IsDirty(MetricsDirtyStates.HorzScrollInfo))
				{
					UpdateHorizontalScrollInfo(ActualClientSize);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				isInVerifyMetrics = flag;
				dirtyState &= ~state;
			}
			if (dirtyState == MetricsDirtyStates.None)
			{
				if (metricsDirtyStates != MetricsDirtyStates.HorzScrollInfo)
				{
					RestorePageOffsetInfo();
				}
				AddToViewHistory(calledFromVerify: true);
			}
			if (isVisPageChangeEventPending && !isInVerifyMetrics)
			{
				OnVisiblePreviewPagesChangedHelper();
			}
			CheckForCurrentZoomChange();
		}

		private int GetFixedRowFromScrollPos(int vertScrollPos)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = fixedRows.Length;
			int num3 = num + num2 - 1;
			while (num <= num3)
			{
				int num4 = num + num3 >> 1;
				if (fixedRows[num4].VerticalScrollOrigin > vertScrollPos)
				{
					num3 = num4 - 1;
					continue;
				}
				if (fixedRows[num4].VerticalScrollBottom < vertScrollPos)
				{
					num = num4 + 1;
					continue;
				}
				return num4;
			}
			return fixedRows.Length - 1;
		}

		private int GetPreviewRowFromScrollPos(int adjustedVertScrollPos, int fixedRow)
		{
			adjustedVertScrollPos += 4;
			int num = fixedRows[fixedRow].FirstPreviewRow;
			int num2 = fixedRows[fixedRow].LastPreviewRow;
			int num3 = num;
			int result = num2;

			{
				int num4 = num + num2 >> 1;
				if (num4 == num3 && previewRows[num4].FixedRowOriginY > adjustedVertScrollPos)
				{
					num2 = num4 - 1;
					continue;
				}
				if (num4 != num3 && previewRows[num4].FixedRowOriginY - 6 > adjustedVertScrollPos)
				{
					num2 = num4 - 1;
					continue;
				}
				if (previewRows[num4].FixedRowOriginY + previewRows[num4].PixelHeight < adjustedVertScrollPos)
				{
					num = num4 + 1;
					continue;
				}
				return num4;
			}
			return result;
		}

			{

		}

		private int GetPageHorizontalScrollValue(int pageNumber)
		{
			if (pageNumber < 0 || pageNumber >= Control.PageCount)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int previewRowFromPage = GetPreviewRowFromPage(pageNumber);
			int fixedRowFromPreviewRow = GetFixedRowFromPreviewRow(previewRowFromPage);
			if (fixedRowFromPreviewRow < 0 || previewRowFromPage < 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int num = (FixedRows[fixedRowFromPreviewRow].PixelWidth - PreviewRows[previewRowFromPage].PixelWidth) / 2;
			num += 4;
			if (Control.Settings.PageNumberDisplayStyleResolved == PageNumberDisplayStyle.LeftOfRow)
			{
				num += PageNumberExtraRowWidth;
			}
			float zoom = (float)fixedRows[fixedRowFromPreviewRow].Zoom;
			int width = Control.PageBorderSize.Width;
			for (int i = previewRows[previewRowFromPage].FirstPage; i < pageNumber; i++)
			{
				num += ConvertToDisplaySize(Control.GetPreviewPage(i).PhysicalSize, zoom).Width;
				num += 6 + width;
				num += 2;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private int GetPageVerticalScrollValue(int previewPage)
		{
			int previewRowFromPage = GetPreviewRowFromPage(previewPage);
			if (previewRowFromPage < 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int fixedRowFromPreviewRow = GetFixedRowFromPreviewRow(previewRowFromPage);
			if (fixedRowFromPreviewRow < 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int num = fixedRows[fixedRowFromPreviewRow].VerticalScrollOrigin + previewRows[previewRowFromPage].FixedRowOriginY;
			if (previewRows[previewRowFromPage].LastPage != previewRows[previewRowFromPage].FirstPage)
			{
				float zoom = (float)FixedRows[fixedRowFromPreviewRow].Zoom;
				int height = ConvertToDisplaySize(Control.GetPreviewPage(previewPage).PhysicalSize, zoom).Height;
				int num2 = 0;
				for (int i = previewRows[previewRowFromPage].FirstPage; i <= previewRows[previewRowFromPage].LastPage; i++)
				{
					num2 = Math.Max(height, ConvertToDisplaySize(Control.GetPreviewPage(i).PhysicalSize, zoom).Height);
				}
				num += (num2 - height) / 2;
			}
			return Math.Min(num, fixedRows[fixedRowFromPreviewRow].VerticalScrollBottom);
		}

		private int GetFixedRowFromPreviewRow(int previewRow)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = fixedRows.Length;
			int num3 = num + num2 - 1;
			while (num <= num3)
			{
				int num4 = num + num3 >> 1;
				if (fixedRows[num4].FirstPreviewRow > previewRow)
				{
					num3 = num4 - 1;
					continue;
				}
				if (fixedRows[num4].LastPreviewRow < previewRow)
				{
					num = num4 + 1;
					continue;
				}
				return num4;
			}
			return -1;
		}

		private int GetPreviewRowFromPage(int pageIndex)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = previewRows.Length;
			int num3 = num + num2 - 1;
			while (num <= num3)
			{
				int num4 = num + num3 >> 1;
				if (previewRows[num4].FirstPage > pageIndex)
				{
					num3 = num4 - 1;
					continue;
				}
				if (previewRows[num4].LastPage < pageIndex)
				{
					num = num4 + 1;
					continue;
				}
				return num4;
			}
			return -1;
		}

		private int GetFixedRowFromPage(int pageNumber)
		{
			int previewRowFromPage = GetPreviewRowFromPage(pageNumber);
			if (previewRowFromPage < 0)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return GetFixedRowFromPreviewRow(previewRowFromPage);
		}

		private ScrollRange GetPageScrollRange(int pageNumber)
		{
			int pageHorizontalScrollValue = GetPageHorizontalScrollValue(pageNumber);
			int pageVerticalScrollValue = GetPageVerticalScrollValue(pageNumber);
			int fixedRowFromPage = GetFixedRowFromPage(pageNumber);
			Size size = ConvertToDisplaySize(Control.GetPreviewPage(pageNumber).PhysicalSize, (float)FixedRows[fixedRowFromPage].Zoom);
			size.Width -= ActualClientSize.Width;
			size.Height -= ActualClientSize.Height;
			return new ScrollRange(pageHorizontalScrollValue, pageVerticalScrollValue, pageHorizontalScrollValue + Math.Max(size.Width, 1) - 1, pageVerticalScrollValue + Math.Max(size.Height, 1) - 1);
		}

		private Rectangle GetPageRectangle(int pageNumber)
		{
			int previewRowFromPage = GetPreviewRowFromPage(pageNumber);
			int fixedRowFromPreviewRow = GetFixedRowFromPreviewRow(previewRowFromPage);
			float zoom = (float)FixedRows[fixedRowFromPreviewRow].Zoom;
			Point fixedRowOffset = GetFixedRowOffset(fixedRowFromPreviewRow);
			int pageHorizontalScrollValue = GetPageHorizontalScrollValue(pageNumber);
			int fixedRowOriginY = PreviewRows[previewRowFromPage].FixedRowOriginY;
			pageHorizontalScrollValue += fixedRowOffset.X;
			fixedRowOriginY += fixedRowOffset.Y;
			Size size = ConvertToDisplaySize(Control.GetPreviewPage(pageNumber).PhysicalSize, zoom);
			Size pageBorderSize = Control.PageBorderSize;
			size += pageBorderSize;
			if (previewRows[previewRowFromPage].LastPage != previewRows[previewRowFromPage].FirstPage)
			{
				int num = size.Height;
				for (int i = previewRows[previewRowFromPage].FirstPage; i <= previewRows[previewRowFromPage].LastPage; i++)
				{
					num = Math.Max(num, ConvertToDisplaySize(Control.GetPreviewPage(i).PhysicalSize, zoom).Height + pageBorderSize.Height);
				}
				fixedRowOriginY += (num - size.Height) / 2;
			}
			return new Rectangle(pageHorizontalScrollValue, fixedRowOriginY, size.Width, size.Height);
		}

		private int[] GetClosestPagesFromHorizontalOffset(int previewRow, int horizontalOffset)
		{
			int fixedRowFromPreviewRow = GetFixedRowFromPreviewRow(previewRow);
			int num = (FixedRows[fixedRowFromPreviewRow].PixelWidth - PreviewRows[previewRow].PixelWidth) / 2;
			num += 4;
			if (Control.Settings.PageNumberDisplayStyleResolved == PageNumberDisplayStyle.LeftOfRow)
			{
				num += PageNumberExtraRowWidth;
			}
			float zoom = (float)fixedRows[fixedRowFromPreviewRow].Zoom;
			int width = Control.PageBorderSize.Width;
			int firstPage = previewRows[previewRow].FirstPage;
			int lastPage = previewRows[previewRow].LastPage;
			if (horizontalOffset <= num || firstPage == lastPage)
			{
				return new int[1] { firstPage };
			}
			for (int i = firstPage; i <= lastPage; i++)
			{
				num += ConvertToDisplaySize(Control.GetPreviewPage(i).PhysicalSize, zoom).Width;
				if (horizontalOffset <= num)
				{
					return new int[1] { i };
				}
				num += width;
				num += 2;
				num += 6;
				if (horizontalOffset < num)
				{
					if (i == lastPage)
					{
						return new int[1] { i };
					}
					return new int[2]
					{
						i,
						i + 1
					};
				}
			}
			return new int[1] { lastPage };
		}

		private Point GetFixedRowOffset(int fixedRow)
		{
			Size actualClientSize = ActualClientSize;
			actualClientSize.Width -= 6;
			actualClientSize.Height -= 6;
			int y = 0;
			int x = 0;
			if (FixedRows[fixedRow].PixelHeight < actualClientSize.Height)
			{
				y = (actualClientSize.Height - FixedRows[fixedRow].PixelHeight) / 2;
			}
			if (FixedRows[fixedRow].PixelWidth < actualClientSize.Width)
			{
				x = (actualClientSize.Width - FixedRows[fixedRow].PixelWidth) / 2;
			}
			return new Point(x, y);
		}

		private void CheckForCurrentZoomChange()
		{

		private void SuspendMetricsHistoryAdditions()
		{
			suspendMetricsHistoryCount++;
		}

		private void ResumeMetricsHistoryAdditions()
		{
			suspendMetricsHistoryCount--;
		}

		private void AddToViewHistory(bool calledFromVerify)
		{
			if (history == null || changingHistoryItems)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (calledFromVerify)
			{
				if (!verifyMetricsUpdateHistory)
				{
					return;
				}
				verifyMetricsUpdateHistory = false;
				if (suspendMetricsHistoryCount > 0 || (((Control)(object)Control).IsHandleCreated && ((Control)(object)Control).Capture) || Control.PageCount == 0)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			PageHistoryItem pageHistoryItem = new PageHistoryItem(HorizontalScrollInfo.Value, VerticalScrollValue, VisibleZoom, Control.Settings.ZoomMode, VisibleFixedRow, Control.Settings.Rows, Control.Settings.Columns);
			if (pageHistoryItem != null)
			{
				PageHistoryItem pageHistoryItem2 = (PageHistoryItem)history.Current;
				if (pageHistoryItem2 == null || pageHistoryItem2.HorizontalScrollPos != pageHistoryItem.HorizontalScrollPos || pageHistoryItem2.VerticalScrollPos != pageHistoryItem.VerticalScrollPos || pageHistoryItem2.ZoomMode != pageHistoryItem.ZoomMode || pageHistoryItem2.Zoom != pageHistoryItem.Zoom || pageHistoryItem2.FixedRow != pageHistoryItem.FixedRow || pageHistoryItem2.Columns != pageHistoryItem.Columns || pageHistoryItem2.Rows != pageHistoryItem.Rows)
				{
					history.AddItem(pageHistoryItem);
					OnViewHistoryChangedHelper();
				}
			}
		}

		private void GoToView(PageHistoryItem pageHistoryItem)
		{
			bool flag = changingHistoryItems;
			changingHistoryItems = true;
			try
			{
				Control.Settings.ZoomMode = pageHistoryItem.ZoomMode;
				Control.Settings.Zoom = pageHistoryItem.Zoom;
				Control.Settings.Columns = pageHistoryItem.Columns;
				Control.Settings.Rows = pageHistoryItem.Rows;
				VerifyMetrics(MetricsDirtyStates.All);
				Scroll(pageHistoryItem.HorizontalScrollPos, pageHistoryItem.VerticalScrollPos, update: false, pageHistoryItem.FixedRow);
				lastVertScrollValue = VerticalScrollInfo.Value;
			}
			finally
			{
				changingHistoryItems = flag;
			}
			OnViewHistoryChangedHelper();
		}

		private void OnViewHistoryChangedHelper()
		{
			if (!isInVerifyMetrics && history != null && Control is UltraPrintPreviewControl)
			{
				((UltraPrintPreviewControl)Control).OnViewHistoryChanged(EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		private PageRect[] GetVisiblePageRects()
		{

		}

		private PageRect[] GetPreviewRowPageRects(int firstPreviewRow, int lastPreviewRow)
		{
			VerifyMetrics(MetricsDirtyStates.All);
			if (firstPreviewRow >= PreviewRows.Length || lastPreviewRow >= PreviewRows.Length)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int num = GetFixedRowFromPreviewRow(firstPreviewRow);
			float zoom = (float)FixedRows[num].Zoom;
			Point fixedRowOffset = GetFixedRowOffset(num);
			PageRect[] array = new PageRect[PreviewRows[lastPreviewRow].LastPage - PreviewRows[firstPreviewRow].FirstPage + 1];
			int num2 = 0;
			for (int i = firstPreviewRow; i <= lastPreviewRow; i++)
			{
				if (i > FixedRows[num].LastPreviewRow)
				{
					num++;
					zoom = (float)FixedRows[num].Zoom;
					fixedRowOffset = GetFixedRowOffset(num);
				}
				int fixedRowOriginY = PreviewRows[i].FixedRowOriginY;
				fixedRowOriginY += fixedRowOffset.Y;
				int num3 = (FixedRows[num].PixelWidth - PreviewRows[i].PixelWidth) / 2;
				num3 += 4;
				if (Control.Settings.PageNumberDisplayStyleResolved == PageNumberDisplayStyle.LeftOfRow)
				{
					num3 += PageNumberExtraRowWidth;
				}
				num3 += fixedRowOffset.X;
				int firstPage = PreviewRows[i].FirstPage;
				int lastPage = PreviewRows[i].LastPage;
				Size[] array2 = new Size[lastPage - firstPage + 1];
				int num4 = 0;
				for (int j = firstPage; j <= lastPage; j++)
				{
					int num5 = j - firstPage;
					ref Size reference = ref array2[num5];
					reference = ConvertToDisplaySize(Control.GetPreviewPage(j).PhysicalSize, zoom);
					array2[num5] += Control.PageBorderSize;
					num4 = Math.Max(num4, array2[num5].Height);
				}
				for (int k = firstPage; k <= lastPage; k++)
				{
					Size size = array2[k - firstPage];
					ref PageRect reference2 = ref array[num2++];
					reference2 = new PageRect(k, new Rectangle(num3, fixedRowOriginY + (num4 - size.Height) / 2, size.Width, size.Height));
					num3 += size.Width + 6;
					num3 += 2;
				}
			}
			return array;
		}

		private int CalculateCurrentPage()
		{
			if (Control.PageCount == 0)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			PageRect[] visiblePageRects = GetVisiblePageRects();
			if (visiblePageRects == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			Rectangle rect = CalculateClientArea(lastVertScrollValue);
			int num = -1;
			int num2 = 0;
			Size pageBorderSize = Control.PageBorderSize;
			for (int i = 0; i < visiblePageRects.Length; i++)
			{
				Rectangle rect2 = visiblePageRects[i].Rect;
				rect2.Inflate(-pageBorderSize.Width / 2, -pageBorderSize.Height / 2);
				Rectangle rectangle = rect2;
				rectangle.Intersect(rect);
				int num3 = rectangle.Width * rectangle.Height;
				if (num3 > num2)
				{
					num2 = num3;
					num = visiblePageRects[i].PageNumber;
					if (rectangle == rect2)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			int num4 = firstPreviewRowInView;
			int num5 = PreviewRows[num4].LastPage - PreviewRows[num4].FirstPage + 1;
			for (int j = 0; j < num5; j++)
			{
				if (visiblePageRects[j].Rect.Right <= rect.X)
				{
					return visiblePageRects[j].PageNumber;
				}
			}
			return visiblePageRects[num5 - 1].PageNumber;
		}

		private void CheckForCurrentPageChange()
		{
			if (!isInVerifyMetrics)
			{
				int num = CalculateCurrentPage();
				if (num != lastCurrentPage)
				{
					lastCurrentPage = num;
					Control.OnCurrentPageChanged(EventArgs.Empty);
				}
			}
		}

		private bool ZoomUsingIncrement(Point pageOffsetLocation, bool zoomOut)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (Control is UltraPrintPreviewControl)
			{
				PageOffsetInfo offsetInfo = CreatePageOffsetInfo(pageOffsetLocation);
				try
				{
					SuspendMetricsHistoryAdditions();
					flag = ((UltraPrintPreviewControl)Control).ChangeZoomUsingIncrements(zoomOut);
					if (flag)
					{
						VerifyMetrics(MetricsDirtyStates.All);
						ScrollUsingPageOffsetInfo(offsetInfo);
						AddToViewHistory();
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					ResumeMetricsHistoryAdditions();
				}
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private int NavigateUpDownHelper(int pageIndex, bool up)
		{
			int previewRowFromPage = GetPreviewRowFromPage(pageIndex);
			int num = (up ? (previewRowFromPage - 1) : (previewRowFromPage + 1));
			if (up && num < 0)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (!up && num >= PreviewRows.Length)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			Rectangle pageRectangle = GetPageRectangle(pageIndex);
			PageRect[] previewRowPageRects = GetPreviewRowPageRects(num, num);
			Rectangle rect = pageRectangle;
			rect.Y = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < previewRowPageRects.Length; i++)
			{
				Rectangle rect2 = previewRowPageRects[i].Rect;
				rect2.Y = 0;
				if (rect2.IntersectsWith(rect))
				{
					return previewRowPageRects[i].PageNumber;
				}
			}
			if (pageRectangle.Left < previewRowPageRects[0].Rect.Left)
			{
				return previewRowPageRects[0].PageNumber;
			}
			if (pageRectangle.Left >= previewRowPageRects[previewRowPageRects.Length - 1].Rect.Right)
			{
				return previewRowPageRects[previewRowPageRects.Length - 1].PageNumber;
			}
			return -1;
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			if (vertScrollInfo != null)
			{
				vertScrollInfo.Scroll -= OnVerticalScroll;
				vertScrollInfo.ValueChanged -= OnVerticalScrollValueChanged;
				((DisposableObject)(object)vertScrollInfo).Dispose();
				vertScrollInfo = null;
			}
			if (horzScrollInfo != null)
			{
				horzScrollInfo.ValueChanged -= OnHorizontalScrollValueChanged;
				horzScrollInfo.Scroll -= OnHorizontalScroll;
				((DisposableObject)(object)horzScrollInfo).Dispose();
				horzScrollInfo = null;
			}
		}

		{

		internal int MaxDepth
		{
			get

				return maxDepth;

				if (value < 1)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
				}
				maxDepth = value;
				RemoveHeadItems(count - maxDepth);
				RemoveTailItems(count - maxDepth);
			}
		}

		public int Count => count;

		internal HistoryList(int maxDepth)
		{
			MaxDepth = maxDepth;
		}

		private void RemoveHeadItems(int count)
		{
			count = Math.Min(count, position);
			if (count > 0)
			{
				HistoryItem nextItem = headItem;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					nextItem = nextItem.NextItem;
				}
				if (nextItem != null)
				{
					nextItem.PreviousItem = null;
				}
				headItem = nextItem;
				this.count -= count;
				if (position - count < 1)
				{
					currentItem = headItem;
					position = 0;
				}
				else
				{
					position -= count;
				}
			}
		}

		private void RemoveTailItems(int count)
		{
			count = Math.Min(this.count - position, count);
			if (count > 0)
			{
				HistoryItem previousItem = tailItem;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					previousItem = previousItem.PreviousItem;
				}
				if (previousItem != null)
				{
					previousItem.NextItem = null;
				}
				tailItem = previousItem;
				this.count -= count;
				if (position - count < 1)
				{
					currentItem = tailItem;
					position = 0;
				}
				else
				{
					position -= count;
				}
			}
		}

		public void AddItem(object item)
		{
			if (position + 1 == maxDepth)
			{
				RemoveHeadItems(1);
			}
			HistoryItem nextItem = new HistoryItem(item, currentItem);
			if (currentItem != null)
			{
				currentItem.NextItem = nextItem;
			}
			else if (headItem == currentItem)
			{
				headItem = nextItem;
			}
			currentItem = nextItem;
			position++;
			count = position + 1;
			tailItem = nextItem;
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			currentItem = (headItem = null);
			position = -1;
			count = 0;
		}

		public void MoveBack()
		{
			if (!CanMoveBack)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			currentItem = currentItem.PreviousItem;
			position--;
		}

		public void MoveForward()
		{
			if (!CanMoveForward)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException();
			}
			currentItem = currentItem.NextItem;
			position++;
		}
	}

	internal class RulerInfo
	{
		private const double PicasPerInch = 6.000472478147885;

		private const double MillimetersPerInch = 25.4;

		private const double CentimetersPerInch = 2.54;

		private const double PointsPerInch = 72.2699595971092;

		private double zoom = 1.0;

		private RulerUnit units;

		private int maxExtentInHundredthsOfInch;

		private PointF dpi;

		private PointF rulerUnitDpi;

		private RulerTextMarker[] textMarkersHorz;

		private RulerTextMarker[] textMarkersVert;

		private PreviewMetrics previewMetrics;

		public double Zoom
		{
			get
			{
				return zoom;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != zoom)
				{
					if (value <= 0.0)
					{
						throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("Zoom", value, string.Format("The '{0}' must be at least 0.", "Zoom"));
					}
					zoom = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public RulerUnit Unit
		{
			get
			{
				return units;
			}
			set
			{
				if (units != value)
				{
					units = value;
					DirtyTextSizeInfo();
				}
			}
		}

		public int MaxExtentInHundredthsOfInch
		{
			get
			{
				return maxExtentInHundredthsOfInch;
			}
			set
			{
				if (maxExtentInHundredthsOfInch != value)
				{
					maxExtentInHundredthsOfInch = value;
					DirtyTextSizeInfo();
				}
			}
		}

		public PointF Dpi
		{
			get
			{
				return dpi;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(value == dpi))
				{
					dpi = value;
					DirtyTextSizeInfo();
				}
			}
		}

		public bool IsTextSizeCalculated
		{
			get
			{
				if (textMarkersHorz != null)
				{
					return textMarkersVert == null;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public RulerTextMarker[] TextMarkersHorz => textMarkersHorz;

		public RulerTextMarker[] TextMarkersVert => textMarkersVert;

		public PointF RulerUnitDpi
		{
			get
			{
				return rulerUnitDpi;
			}
			set
			{
				rulerUnitDpi = value;
			}
		}

		public RulerUnit UnitsResolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (units != RulerUnit.Default)
				{
					return units;
				}
				if (RegionInfo.CurrentRegion.IsMetric)
				{
					return RulerUnit.Centimeters;
				}
				return RulerUnit.Inches;
			}
		}

		public RulerInfo(PreviewMetrics previewMetrics)
		{
			this.previewMetrics = previewMetrics;
		}

		public void DirtyTextSizeInfo()
		{
			textMarkersHorz = null;
			textMarkersVert = null;
		}

		public void CalculateTextSizes(Font font, Graphics g)
		{
			//IL_0042: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a8: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			int[] array = CalculateTextMarkers(horizontal: true);
			textMarkersHorz = new RulerTextMarker[array.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				string text = array[i].ToString();
				ref RulerTextMarker reference = ref textMarkersHorz[i];
				reference = new RulerTextMarker(text, DrawUtility.MeasureString(g, text, font, DrawUtility.GetGdiDrawStringFlags((UltraControlBase)(object)previewMetrics.Control)));
			}
			int[] array2 = CalculateTextMarkers(horizontal: false);
			textMarkersVert = new RulerTextMarker[array2.Length];
			for (int j = 0; j < array2.Length; j++)
			{
				string text2 = array2[j].ToString();
				ref RulerTextMarker reference2 = ref textMarkersVert[j];
				reference2 = new RulerTextMarker(text2, DrawUtility.MeasureString(g, text2, font, DrawUtility.GetGdiDrawStringFlags((UltraControlBase)(object)previewMetrics.Control)));
			}
		}

		private int CalculateUnitsPerMarker()
		{
			return UnitsResolved switch
			{
				RulerUnit.Inches => 1, 
				RulerUnit.Centimeters => 1, 
				RulerUnit.Millimeters => 20, 
				RulerUnit.Points => 36, 
				RulerUnit.Picas => 6, 
				RulerUnit.Pixels => 100, 
				_ => 0, 
			};
		}

		private double UnitsPerInch(bool horizontal)
		{
			return UnitsResolved switch
			{
				RulerUnit.Inches => 1.0, 
				RulerUnit.Centimeters => 2.54, 
				RulerUnit.Millimeters => 25.4, 
				RulerUnit.Points => 72.2699595971092, 
				RulerUnit.Picas => 6.000472478147885, 
				RulerUnit.Pixels => horizontal ? ((int)rulerUnitDpi.X) : ((int)rulerUnitDpi.Y), 
				_ => 0.0, 
			};
		}

		private double CalculateUnitExtentInInches(bool horizontal)
		{
			return 1.0 / UnitsPerInch(horizontal);
		}

		private bool[] CalculateLinesPerMarker()
		{
			return UnitsResolved switch
			{
				RulerUnit.Inches => new bool[8] { false, false, false, true, false, false, false, true }, 
				RulerUnit.Centimeters => new bool[4] { false, true, false, true }, 
				RulerUnit.Millimeters => new bool[8] { false, false, false, true, false, false, false, true }, 
				RulerUnit.Points => new bool[6] { false, false, false, false, false, true }, 
				RulerUnit.Picas => new bool[6] { false, false, false, false, false, true }, 
				RulerUnit.Pixels => new bool[4] { false, true, false, true }, 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		private int[] CalculateTextMarkers(bool horizontal)
		{
			double num = (double)maxExtentInHundredthsOfInch / 100.0;
			double num2 = num * UnitsPerInch(horizontal);
			int num3 = CalculateUnitsPerMarker();
			int num4 = (int)(num2 / (double)num3);
			if (num2 % (double)num3 >= (double)num3 / 2.0)
			{
				num4++;
			}
			int[] array = new int[num4];
			for (int i = 0; i < num4; i++)
			{
				array[i] = (i + 1) * num3;
			}
			return array;
		}

		public RulerLineMarker GetLineMarkerInfo(bool isHorizontal)
		{
			float valueInHundredsOfAnInch = (float)(CalculateUnitExtentInInches(isHorizontal) * 100.0 * (double)CalculateUnitsPerMarker());
			float num = (isHorizontal ? dpi.X : dpi.Y);
			float singleMarkerExtent = ConvertToDisplaySize(valueInHundredsOfAnInch, (float)zoom, num);
			bool[] lines = CalculateLinesPerMarker();
			return new RulerLineMarker(singleMarkerExtent, lines);
		}

		public int GetMarkersCount(bool isHorizontal, int extentInHundredthsOfInch)
		{
			float valueInHundredsOfAnInch = (float)(CalculateUnitExtentInInches(isHorizontal) * 100.0 * (double)CalculateUnitsPerMarker());
			float num = (isHorizontal ? dpi.X : dpi.Y);
			float num2 = ConvertToDisplaySize(valueInHundredsOfAnInch, (float)zoom, num);
			float num3 = ConvertToDisplaySize(extentInHundredthsOfInch, (float)zoom, num);
			int num4 = (int)(num3 / num2);
			if (num3 % num2 > 0f)
			{
				num4++;
			}
			return num4;
		}

		private static float ConvertToDisplaySize(float valueInHundredsOfAnInch, float zoom, float dpi)
		{
			return valueInHundredsOfAnInch / 100f * dpi * zoom;
		}
	}

		private void CreateAppearanceHolder(ref AppearanceHolder appearanceHolder)
		{
			//IL_0005: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (appearanceHolder == null)
			{
				appearanceHolder = new AppearanceHolder();
				appearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
		}

		private void SetAppearanceHolder(ref AppearanceHolder appearanceHolder, AppearanceBase value)
		{
			if (appearanceHolder == null || !appearanceHolder.HasAppearance || value != appearanceHolder.Appearance)
			{
				if (appearanceHolder == null)
				{
					CreateAppearanceHolder(ref appearanceHolder);
				}
				appearanceHolder.Appearance = value;
			}
		}

		private void DisposeAppearanceHolder(ref AppearanceHolder appearanceHolder)
		{
			if (appearanceHolder != null)
			{
				appearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				appearanceHolder.Reset();
				appearanceHolder = null;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			DisposeAppearanceHolder(ref appearanceHolder);
			DisposeAppearanceHolder(ref pageAppearanceHolder);
			DisposeAppearanceHolder(ref pageNumberAppearanceHolder);
			DisposeAppearanceHolder(ref currentPageAppearanceHolder);
			DisposeAppearanceHolder(ref currentPageNumberAppearanceHolder);
			if (scrollBarLook != null)
			{
				((SubObjectBase)(object)scrollBarLook).SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				((DisposableObject)(object)scrollBarLook).Dispose();
				scrollBarLook = null;
			}
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChangeInfo)
		{
			if (HasAppearance && appearanceHolder.RootAppearance == propChangeInfo.Source)
			{
				control.SyncBackColor();
				control.InvalidateElements();
				NotifyPropChange(UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.Appearance, propChangeInfo);
			}
			else if (HasPageAppearance && pageAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance == propChangeInfo.Source)
			{
				control.InvalidateElements();
				NotifyPropChange(UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.PageAppearance, propChangeInfo);
			}
			else if (HasPageNumberAppearance && pageNumberAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance == propChangeInfo.Source)
			{
				control.InvalidateElements();
				NotifyPropChange(UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.PageNumberAppearance, propChangeInfo);
			}
			else if (HasCurrentPageAppearance && currentPageAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance == propChangeInfo.Source)
			{
				control.InvalidateElements();
				NotifyPropChange(UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.CurrentPageAppearance, propChangeInfo);
			}
			else if (HasCurrentPageNumberAppearance && currentPageNumberAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance == propChangeInfo.Source)
			{
				control.InvalidateElements();
				NotifyPropChange(UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.CurrentPageNumberAppearance, propChangeInfo);
			}
			else if (scrollBarLook == propChangeInfo.Source)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.ScrollBarLook, propChangeInfo);
			}
			else
			{
				base.OnSubObjectPropChanged(propChangeInfo);
			}
		}

		protected class PrintPreviewAccessibleObject : UltraControlAccessibleObject
		{
			private UltraPrintPreviewControlBase control;

			public override AccessibleRole Role
			{
				get
				{
					if (((Control)(object)control).AccessibleRole != AccessibleRole.Default)
					{
						return ((Control.ControlAccessibleObject)this).Role;
					}
					return AccessibleRole.Grouping;
				}
			}

			public PrintPreviewAccessibleObject(UltraPrintPreviewControlBase control)
				: base((Control)(object)control)
			{
				this.control = control;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetChild(int index)
			{
				if (index < 0 || index >= ((AccessibleObject)(object)this).GetChildCount())
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (index < control.PageCount)
				{
					return control.Metrics.GetPageAccessibleObject(index);
				}
				index -= control.PageCount;
				if (index < ((UltraControlAccessibleObject)this).GetChildCount())
				{
					return ((UltraControlAccessibleObject)this).GetChild(index);
				}
				index -= ((UltraControlAccessibleObject)this).GetChildCount();
				if (control.IsHorizontalScrollBarVisible)
				{
					if (index == 0)
					{
						if (!(((UltraControlBase)control).ControlUIElement is UltraPrintPreviewControlUIElement ultraPrintPreviewControlUIElement))
						{
							return null;
						}
						return ((UIElement)ultraPrintPreviewControlUIElement.HorizontalScrollBar).AccessibilityInstance;
					}
					index--;
				}
				if (control.IsVerticalScrollBarVisible)
				{
					if (index == 0)
					{
						if (!(((UltraControlBase)control).ControlUIElement is UltraPrintPreviewControlUIElement ultraPrintPreviewControlUIElement2))
						{
							return null;
						}
						return ((UIElement)ultraPrintPreviewControlUIElement2.VerticalScrollBar).AccessibilityInstance;
					}
					index--;
				}
				return null;
			}

			public override int GetChildCount()
			{
				int num = control.PageCount;
				if (control.IsHorizontalScrollBarVisible)
				{
					num++;
				}
				if (control.IsVerticalScrollBarVisible)
				{
					num++;
				}
				return num + ((UltraControlAccessibleObject)this).GetChildCount();
			}

			public override AccessibleObject HitTest(int x, int y)
			{
				AccessibleObject accessibleObject = ((UltraControlAccessibleObject)this).HitTest(x, y);
				if ((object)accessibleObject != this)
				{
					return accessibleObject;
				}
				UIElement controlUIElement = (UIElement)(object)((UltraControlBase)control).ControlUIElement;
				if (controlUIElement == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return controlUIElement.HitTest(x, y);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChangeInfo)
		{
			if (Settings != propChangeInfo.Source)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (propChangeInfo.PropId is UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds)
			{
				switch ((UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds)(object)propChangeInfo.PropId)
				{
				case UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.PageNumberDisplayStyle:
				case UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.BorderStyle:
				case UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.ShowHorizontalScrollBar:
				case UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.ShowVerticalScrollBar:
				case UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.Appearance:
				case UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.PageAppearance:
				case UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.ScrollBarLook:
				case UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.MaximumPreviewPages:
				case UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.PageNumberAppearance:
				case UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.ViewBoxAppearance:
				case UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.CurrentPageNumberAppearance:
				case UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.CurrentPageAppearance:
				case UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.CurrentPreviewPageNumberAppearance:
				case UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.ViewBoxDisplayStyle:
					if (!((Control)this).IsDisposed && !((Control)this).Disposing)
					{
						Metrics.Dirty(MetricsDirtyStates.All);
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.Settings, propChangeInfo);
		}

		internal void ShowScrollTip(int previewPageNumber)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)ScrollTipStyleResolved != 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = toolTip != null;
			ToolTip.ToolTipText = GetScrollTip(GetPreviewPage(previewPageNumber).PageNumber);
			if (flag)
			{
				return;
			}
			UIElement val = null;
			UIElementEnumerator enumerator = ((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).ChildElements.GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					UIElement current = enumerator.Current;
					ScrollBarUIElement val2 = (ScrollBarUIElement)(object)((current is ScrollBarUIElement) ? current : null);
					if (val2 != null && val2.Orientation != Orientation.Horizontal)
					{
						val = (UIElement)(object)val2;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (enumerator is IDisposable disposable)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			if (val == null)
			{
				ToolTip.Show(Control.MousePosition, false);
				return;
			}
			string toolTipText = ToolTip.ToolTipText;
			ToolTip.ToolTipText = GetScrollTip(PageCount * 10);
			ToolTip.SetMargin(3, 3, 3, 3);
			Size size = ToolTip.CalcRequiredSize();
			ToolTip.ToolTipText = toolTipText;
			Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle(Control.MousePosition, size);
			Rectangle rectangle2 = ((Control)this).RectangleToScreen(val.Rect);
			if (rectangle.IntersectsWith(rectangle2))
			{
				rectangle.X -= rectangle.Right - rectangle2.Left + 10;
			}
			ToolTip.Show(rectangle, 0, true, false, false, rectangle2, true, false);
		}

		internal virtual void ResolvePageAppearance(UltraPreviewPageInfo page, ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			ResolutionOrderInfo resOrder;
			UIRole role = StyleUtils.GetRole((UltraControlBase)(object)this, StyleUtils.Role.PrintPreviewPage, out resOrder);
			if (page != null && page.PageNumber == CurrentPage)
			{
				if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseStyleBefore && role != null)
				{
					role.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)16);
				}
				if (Settings.HasCurrentPageAppearance && ((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseControlInfo)
				{
					Settings.CurrentPageAppearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
				}
				if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseStyleAfter && role != null)
				{
					role.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)16);
				}
			}
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseStyleBefore && role != null)
			{
				role.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
			}
			if (Settings.HasPageAppearance && ((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseControlInfo)
			{
				Settings.PageAppearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			}
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseStyleAfter && role != null)
			{
				role.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
			}
			if (Utilities.ShouldSetAppearanceProperty(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (AppearancePropFlags)1))
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor = Color.White;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFEuL);
			}
			if (Utilities.ShouldSetAppearanceProperty(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (AppearancePropFlags)4))
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BorderColor = Color.Black;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFBuL);
			}
		}

		internal void ResolvePageNumberAppearance(bool isCurrentPage, ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{

			if (isCurrentPage)
			{
				if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseStyleBefore && role != null)
				{
					role.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)16);
				}
				if (Settings.HasCurrentPageNumberAppearance && ((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseControlInfo)
				{
					Settings.CurrentPageNumberAppearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
				}
				if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseStyleAfter && role != null)
				{
					role.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)16);
				}
			}
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseStyleBefore && role != null)
			{
				role.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
			}
			if (Settings.HasPageNumberAppearance && ((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseControlInfo)
			{
				Settings.PageNumberAppearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			}
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseStyleAfter && role != null)
			{
				role.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
			}
			ResolveDefaultPageNumberAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
		}

		internal virtual void ResolveDefaultPageNumberAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			if (Utilities.ShouldSetAppearanceProperty(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (AppearancePropFlags)1))
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor = Color.White;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFEuL);
			}
			if (Utilities.ShouldSetAppearanceProperty(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (AppearancePropFlags)4))
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BorderColor = Color.Black;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFBuL);
			}
			if (Utilities.ShouldSetAppearanceProperty(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (AppearancePropFlags)2))
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).ForeColor = Color.Black;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFDuL);
			}
			if (Utilities.ShouldSetAppearanceProperty(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (AppearancePropFlags)16))
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).TextHAlign = (HAlign)2;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFEFuL);
			}
			if (Utilities.ShouldSetAppearanceProperty(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (AppearancePropFlags)32))
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).TextVAlign = (VAlign)2;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFDFuL);
			}
		}

		internal void DirtyChildElements(bool invalidate)
		{
			if (((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement != null)
			{
				((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).DirtyChildElements(invalidate && !((UltraControlBase)this).IsUpdating && ((Control)this).IsHandleCreated);
			}
		}

		internal void InvalidateElements()
		{
			if (!((UltraControlBase)this).IsUpdating && ((Control)this).IsHandleCreated)
			{
				((UltraControlBase)this).Invalidate();
			}
		}

		internal void TerminateCapture()
		{
			if (((Control)this).IsHandleCreated && ((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement != null)
			{
				((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement.TerminateCapture();
			}
		}

		internal void ProcessHorizontalMousePan(int delta)
		{
			ScrollBarInfo horizontalScrollInfo = Metrics.HorizontalScrollInfo;
			int val = horizontalScrollInfo.Value + delta / 3;
			val = Math.Max(horizontalScrollInfo.Minimum, Math.Min(horizontalScrollInfo.MaximumDragValue, val));
			Metrics.ScrollHorizontal(val, update: false);
		}

		internal void ProcessVerticalMousePan(int delta)
		{
			ScrollBarInfo verticalScrollInfo = Metrics.VerticalScrollInfo;
			int val = verticalScrollInfo.Value + delta / 3;
			val = Math.Min(Metrics.VisibleFixedRowScrollBottom, Math.Max(Metrics.VisibleFixedRowScrollTop, val));
			val = Math.Max(verticalScrollInfo.Minimum, Math.Min(verticalScrollInfo.MaximumDragValue, val));
			Metrics.ScrollVertical(val, update: false);
		}

		internal Cursor GetCursor(CursorType cursorType)
		{
			if (cursors == null)
			{
				int length = Enum.GetValues(typeof(CursorType)).Length;
				cursors = new Cursor[length];
				cursorStreams = new Stream[length];
			}
			if (cursors[(int)cursorType] == null)
			{
				string name = null;
				switch (cursorType)
				{
				case CursorType.DynamicZoom:
					name = "Infragistics.Win.Misc.Printing.Cursors.DynamicZoom.cur";
					break;
				case CursorType.HandOpen:
					name = "Infragistics.Win.Misc.Printing.Cursors.HandOpen.cur";
					break;
				case CursorType.HandClosed:
					name = "Infragistics.Win.Misc.Printing.Cursors.HandClosed.cur";
					break;
				case CursorType.SnapShot:
					name = "Infragistics.Win.Misc.Printing.Cursors.SnapShot.cur";
					break;
				case CursorType.ZoomIn:
					name = "Infragistics.Win.Misc.Printing.Cursors.ZoomIn.cur";
					break;
				case CursorType.ZoomOut:
					name = "Infragistics.Win.Misc.Printing.Cursors.ZoomOut.cur";
					break;
				case CursorType.ZoomNotAllowed:
					name = "Infragistics.Win.Misc.Printing.Cursors.NoZoom.cur";
					break;
				}
				Stream manifestResourceStream = typeof(UltraPrintPreviewControlBase).Module.Assembly.GetManifestResourceStream(name);
				if (manifestResourceStream == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				Cursor cursor = new Cursor(manifestResourceStream);
				cursors[(int)cursorType] = cursor;
				cursorStreams[(int)cursorType] = manifestResourceStream;
			}
			return cursors[(int)cursorType];
		}

		internal bool CanZoom(bool zoomOut, out double newZoom)
		{
			newZoom = Metrics.VisibleZoom;
			double[] defaultZoomIncrements = DefaultZoomIncrements;
			Array.Sort(defaultZoomIncrements);
			if (defaultZoomIncrements == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			double visibleZoom = Metrics.VisibleZoom;
			if (visibleZoom < defaultZoomIncrements[0])
			{
				if (zoomOut)
				{
					return false;
				}
				newZoom = defaultZoomIncrements[0];
			}
			else if (visibleZoom > defaultZoomIncrements[defaultZoomIncrements.Length - 1])
			{
				if (!zoomOut)
				{
					return false;
				}
				newZoom = defaultZoomIncrements[defaultZoomIncrements.Length - 1];
			}
			else
			{
				int i;
				for (i = 0; defaultZoomIncrements[i] < visibleZoom; i++)
				{
				}
				if (visibleZoom != defaultZoomIncrements[i])
				{
					i = (zoomOut ? (i - 1) : i);
				}
				else
				{
					if (zoomOut && i == 0)
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (!zoomOut && i == defaultZoomIncrements.Length - 1)
					{
						return false;
					}
					i = (zoomOut ? (i - 1) : (i + 1));
				}
				newZoom = defaultZoomIncrements[i];
			}
			return newZoom != visibleZoom;
		}

		internal bool ChangeZoomUsingIncrements(bool zoomOut)
		{
			if (!CanZoom(zoomOut, out var newZoom))
			{
				return false;
			}
			double visibleZoom = Metrics.VisibleZoom;
			if (visibleZoom != newZoom)
			{
				PageOffsetInfo offsetInfo = Metrics.CreatePageOffsetInfo();
				Metrics.SetZoom(newZoom);
				Metrics.ScrollUsingPageOffsetInfo(offsetInfo);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			Metrics.OnPropertyChanged(e.ChangeInfo);
			PropChangeInfo propChangeInfo = e.ChangeInfo.FindTrigger(null);
			if (propChangeInfo.PropId is UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds)
			{
				switch ((UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds)(object)propChangeInfo.PropId)
				{
				case UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.AcceptsFocus:
				case UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.Settings:
					((Control)this).SetStyle(ControlStyles.Selectable, Settings.AcceptsFocus);
					break;
				case UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.PageNumberDisplayStyle:
				case UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.BorderStyle:
					StyleUtils.DirtyCachedPropertyVals((UltraControlBase)(object)this);
					break;
				}
			}
			((UltraControlBase)this).OnPropertyChanged(e);
		}

		protected override void OnResize(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (!IsInitializing)
			{
				Metrics.OnClientAreaChanged();
			}
			((UltraControlBase)this).OnResize(e);
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				DisposeToolTip();
				if (settings != null)
				{
					settings.SubObjectPropChanged -= SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					settings.Dispose();
					settings = null;
				}
				if (metrics != null)
				{
					metrics.Dispose();
					metrics = null;
				}
				if (cursors != null)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < cursors.Length; i++)
					{
						if (cursors[i] != null)
						{
							cursors[i].Dispose();
						}
					}
					cursors = null;
				}
				if (cursorStreams != null)
				{
					for (int j = 0; j < cursorStreams.Length; j++)
					{
						if (cursorStreams[j] != null)
						{
							cursorStreams[j].Close();
						}
					}
					cursorStreams = null;
				}
				try
				{
					HookUserPreferenceChanged(hook: false);
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			((UltraControlBase)this).Dispose(disposing);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseWheel(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			((Control)this).OnMouseWheel(e);
			if (e is HandledMouseEventArgs e2)
			{
				if (e2.Handled)
				{
					return;
				}
				e2.Handled = true;
			}
			Metrics.ProcessMouseWheelMessage(e);
		}

		protected override void OnFontChanged(EventArgs e)
		{
			Metrics.OnFontChanged();
			((UltraControlBase)this).OnFontChanged(e);
		}

		{
			return !((Control)(object)this).ForeColor.Equals(SystemColors.ControlLightLight);
		}

		public override void ResetForeColor()
		{
			((Control)(object)this).ForeColor = SystemColors.ControlLightLight;
		}

		}

		public override void ResetBackColor()

			((Control)(object)this).BackColor = SystemColors.ControlDark;
		}

		protected override AccessibleObject CreateAccessibilityInstance()
		{
			return (AccessibleObject)(object)new PrintPreviewAccessibleObject(this);
		}

		}

		}

					{

					((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.MouseAction);
				}
			}
