		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public PreviewMouseAction MouseActionResolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (!((Control)(object)this).Focused)
				{
					return mouseAction;
				}
				if (PageCount == 0)
				{
					return PreviewMouseAction.None;
				}
				if (Control.MouseButtons == MouseButtons.Left && ((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement != null && ((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement.ElementWithMouseCapture is PreviewPageAreaUIElement)
				{
					return ((PreviewPageAreaUIElement)(object)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement.ElementWithMouseCapture).CurrentMouseAction;
				}
				switch (mouseAction)
				{
				case PreviewMouseAction.ZoomIn:
					if ((Control.ModifierKeys & Keys.Control) != Keys.None)
					{
						return PreviewMouseAction.ZoomOut;
					}
					if ((Control.ModifierKeys & Keys.Shift) != Keys.None)
					{
						return PreviewMouseAction.DynamicZoom;
					}
					break;
				case PreviewMouseAction.ZoomOut:
					if ((Control.ModifierKeys & Keys.Control) != Keys.None)
					{
						return PreviewMouseAction.ZoomIn;
					}
					if ((Control.ModifierKeys & Keys.Shift) != Keys.None)
					{
						return PreviewMouseAction.DynamicZoom;
					}
					break;
				}
				return mouseAction;
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public UltraPrintPreviewControlStates CurrentState
		{
			get
			{
				UltraPrintPreviewControlStates ultraPrintPreviewControlStates = (UltraPrintPreviewControlStates)0;
				if (PageCount > 0)
				{
					ultraPrintPreviewControlStates |= UltraPrintPreviewControlStates.Pages;
				}
				switch (MouseActionResolved)
				{
				case PreviewMouseAction.None:
					ultraPrintPreviewControlStates |= UltraPrintPreviewControlStates.MouseActionNone;
					break;
				case PreviewMouseAction.Hand:
					ultraPrintPreviewControlStates |= UltraPrintPreviewControlStates.MouseActionHand;
					break;
				case PreviewMouseAction.DynamicZoom:
					ultraPrintPreviewControlStates |= UltraPrintPreviewControlStates.MouseActionDynamicZoom;
					break;
				case PreviewMouseAction.Snapshot:
					ultraPrintPreviewControlStates |= UltraPrintPreviewControlStates.MouseActionSnapshot;
					break;
				case PreviewMouseAction.ZoomIn:
					ultraPrintPreviewControlStates |= UltraPrintPreviewControlStates.MouseActionZoomIn;
					break;
				case PreviewMouseAction.ZoomOut:
					ultraPrintPreviewControlStates |= UltraPrintPreviewControlStates.MouseActionZoomOut;
					break;
				}
				if (HasPreviousView)
				{
					ultraPrintPreviewControlStates |= UltraPrintPreviewControlStates.HasPreviousView;
				}
				if (HasNextView)
				{
					ultraPrintPreviewControlStates |= UltraPrintPreviewControlStates.HasNextView;
				}
				if (base.HasPreviousPage)
				{
					ultraPrintPreviewControlStates |= UltraPrintPreviewControlStates.HasPreviousPage;
				}
				if (base.HasNextPage)
				{
					ultraPrintPreviewControlStates |= UltraPrintPreviewControlStates.HasNextPage;
				}
				return ultraPrintPreviewControlStates;
			}
		}

				((Component)(object)this).Events.AddHandler(EventViewHistoryChanged, value);
			}
			remove
			{
				((Component)(object)this).Events.RemoveHandler(EventViewHistoryChanged, value);
			}
		}

		public UltraPrintPreviewControl()

			license = Utilities.ValidateLicense(typeof(UltraPrintPreviewControl), this);

		public void GeneratePreview(bool recreate)
		{
			if (document == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_DocumentNotSet"));
			}
			if (recreate)
			{
				InvalidatePreviewInfo();
			}
			GeneratePreviewHelper(synchronous: true);
		}

		public void InvalidatePreview()
		{
			InvalidatePreviewInfo();
		}

		public bool PerformAction(UltraPrintPreviewControlAction actionCode)
		{
			if (!KeyActionMappings.IsActionAllowed(actionCode, CurrentState))
			{
				return false;
			}
			int value = base.Metrics.VerticalScrollInfo.Value;
			int value2 = base.Metrics.HorizontalScrollInfo.Value;
			switch (actionCode)
			{
			case UltraPrintPreviewControlAction.ScrollUp:
				base.Metrics.VerticalScrollInfo.PerformAction((ScrollBarAction)3);
				return value != base.Metrics.VerticalScrollInfo.Value;
			case UltraPrintPreviewControlAction.ScrollDown:
				base.Metrics.VerticalScrollInfo.PerformAction((ScrollBarAction)2);
				return value != base.Metrics.VerticalScrollInfo.Value;
			case UltraPrintPreviewControlAction.ScrollPageUp:
				base.Metrics.VerticalScrollInfo.PerformAction((ScrollBarAction)5);
				return value != base.Metrics.VerticalScrollInfo.Value;
			case UltraPrintPreviewControlAction.ScrollPageDown:
				base.Metrics.VerticalScrollInfo.PerformAction((ScrollBarAction)4);
				return value != base.Metrics.VerticalScrollInfo.Value;
			case UltraPrintPreviewControlAction.ScrollToTop:
				base.Metrics.VerticalScrollInfo.PerformAction((ScrollBarAction)0);
				return value != base.Metrics.VerticalScrollInfo.Value;
			case UltraPrintPreviewControlAction.ScrollToBottom:
				base.Metrics.VerticalScrollInfo.PerformAction((ScrollBarAction)1);
				return value != base.Metrics.VerticalScrollInfo.Value;
			case UltraPrintPreviewControlAction.ScrollLeft:
				base.Metrics.HorizontalScrollInfo.PerformAction((ScrollBarAction)3);
				return value2 != base.Metrics.HorizontalScrollInfo.Value;
			case UltraPrintPreviewControlAction.ScrollRight:
				base.Metrics.HorizontalScrollInfo.PerformAction((ScrollBarAction)2);
				return value2 != base.Metrics.HorizontalScrollInfo.Value;
			case UltraPrintPreviewControlAction.ScrollPageLeft:
				base.Metrics.HorizontalScrollInfo.PerformAction((ScrollBarAction)5);
				return value2 != base.Metrics.HorizontalScrollInfo.Value;
			case UltraPrintPreviewControlAction.ScrollPageRight:
				base.Metrics.HorizontalScrollInfo.PerformAction((ScrollBarAction)4);
				return value2 != base.Metrics.HorizontalScrollInfo.Value;
			case UltraPrintPreviewControlAction.ScrollToLeft:
				base.Metrics.HorizontalScrollInfo.PerformAction((ScrollBarAction)0);
				return value2 != base.Metrics.HorizontalScrollInfo.Value;
			case UltraPrintPreviewControlAction.ScrollToRight:
				base.Metrics.HorizontalScrollInfo.PerformAction((ScrollBarAction)1);
				return value2 != base.Metrics.HorizontalScrollInfo.Value;
			case UltraPrintPreviewControlAction.ZoomOut:
			case UltraPrintPreviewControlAction.ZoomIn:
				return ChangeZoomUsingIncrements(actionCode == UltraPrintPreviewControlAction.ZoomOut);
			case UltraPrintPreviewControlAction.PreviousView:
				base.Metrics.GoToPreviousView();
				return true;
			case UltraPrintPreviewControlAction.NextView:
				base.Metrics.GoToNextView();
				return true;
			case UltraPrintPreviewControlAction.ClearViewHistory:
				base.Metrics.ResetViewHistory(keepCurrentEntry: true);
				return true;
			case UltraPrintPreviewControlAction.ScrollToFirstPage:
				base.CurrentPage = 1;
				return true;
			case UltraPrintPreviewControlAction.ScrollToLastPage:
				base.CurrentPage = PageCount;
				return true;
			case UltraPrintPreviewControlAction.ScrollToPreviousPage:
				return base.Metrics.ScrollToPreviousPage();
			case UltraPrintPreviewControlAction.ScrollToNextPage:
				return base.Metrics.ScrollToNextPage();
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		public void Print(bool showStatusDialog)
		{
			PrintDocument printDocument = Document;
			if (printDocument == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			PrintController printController = printDocument.PrintController;
			if (showStatusDialog)
			{
				UltraStatusPrintController ultraStatusPrintController = new UltraStatusPrintController(new StandardPrintController(), Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("UltraStatusPrintDialog_PrintingTitle"));
				ultraStatusPrintController.StyleLibraryName = ((UltraControlBase)this).StyleLibraryName;
				ultraStatusPrintController.StyleSetName = ((UltraControlBase)this).StyleSetName;
				ultraStatusPrintController.UseAppStyling = ((UltraControlBase)this).UseAppStyling;
				printDocument.PrintController = ultraStatusPrintController;
				((UltraStatusPrintController)printDocument.PrintController).DialogCenter = CalculateStatusDialogCenter();
			}
			else
			{
				printDocument.PrintController = new ExtendedPrintController();
			}
			try
			{
				printDocument.Print();
				ExtendedPrintController extendedPrintController = printDocument.PrintController as ExtendedPrintController;
				UltraStatusPrintController ultraStatusPrintController2 = printDocument.PrintController as UltraStatusPrintController;
				if ((extendedPrintController != null && extendedPrintController.PrintException != null) || (ultraStatusPrintController2 != null && ultraStatusPrintController2.PrintException != null))
				{
					string text = ((extendedPrintController == null) ? ultraStatusPrintController2.PrintException.Message : extendedPrintController.PrintException.Message);
					string text2 = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("PrintErrorMessage", text);
					UltraMessageBoxManager.Show((IWin32Window)this, text2, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("PrintErrorCaption"), MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Exclamation);
				}
			}
			catch (Win32Exception ex)
			{
				string text3 = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("PrintErrorMessage", ex.Message);
				UltraMessageBoxManager.Show((IWin32Window)this, text3, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("PrintErrorCaption"), MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Exclamation);
			}
			finally
			{
				printDocument.PrintController = printController;
			}
		}

		internal override void ResolvePageAreaAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			if (Utilities.ShouldSetAppearanceProperty(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (AppearancePropFlags)137438953472L))
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).Cursor = GetPageAreaCursor();
				if (((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).Cursor != null)
				{
					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFDFFFFFFFFFuL);
				}
			}
			base.ResolvePageAreaAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
		}

		internal bool CanPerformMouseAction(PreviewMouseAction action)
		{
			switch (MouseActionResolved)
			{
			default:
				return true;
			case PreviewMouseAction.DynamicZoom:
				return true;
			case PreviewMouseAction.Hand:
			{
				ScrollRange scrollRange = base.Metrics.CalculateVisibleAreaScrollRange();
				if (scrollRange.MaximumHorizontalValue <= 0)
				{
					return scrollRange.MaximumVerticalValue > 0;
				}
				return true;
			}
			case PreviewMouseAction.Snapshot:
				return Utilities.IsClipboardUsagePossible;
			case PreviewMouseAction.ZoomIn:
				return base.Metrics.VisibleZoom < base.MaximumZoomResolved;
			case PreviewMouseAction.ZoomOut:
				return base.Metrics.VisibleZoom > base.MinimumZoomResolved;
			}
		}

		internal void ResolveRulerAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			ResolutionOrderInfo resOrder;
			UIRole role = StyleUtils.GetRole((UltraControlBase)(object)this, StyleUtils.Role.PrintPreviewRuler, out resOrder);
			if ((((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseStyleBefore || ((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseStyleAfter) && role != null)
			{
				role.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
			}
			if (Utilities.ShouldSetAppearanceProperty(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (AppearancePropFlags)1))
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor = Color.White;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFEuL);
			}
			if (Utilities.ShouldSetAppearanceProperty(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (AppearancePropFlags)2))
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).ForeColor = Color.Black;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFDuL);
			}
			if (Utilities.ShouldSetAppearanceProperty(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (AppearancePropFlags)33554432))
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).FontData.SizeInPoints = 7f;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFDFFFFFFuL);
			}
		}

		internal void ResolveRulerAreaAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps, bool isIntersectionArea)
		{
			ResolutionOrderInfo resOrder;
			UIRole role = StyleUtils.GetRole((UltraControlBase)(object)this, isIntersectionArea ? StyleUtils.Role.PrintPreviewRulerAreaIntersection : StyleUtils.Role.PrintPreviewRulerArea, out resOrder);
			if ((((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseStyleBefore || ((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseStyleAfter) && role != null)
			{
				role.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
			}
			if (Utilities.ShouldSetAppearanceProperty(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (AppearancePropFlags)1))
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor = SystemColors.Control;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFEuL);
			}
			if (Utilities.ShouldSetAppearanceProperty(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (AppearancePropFlags)1073741824))
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BorderColor3DBase = SystemColors.Control;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFBFFFFFFFuL);
			}
		}

		private Point CalculateStatusDialogCenter()
		{
			Control topLevelControlHelper = GetTopLevelControlHelper();
			if (topLevelControlHelper == null)
			{
				return Point.Empty;
			}
			return new Point(topLevelControlHelper.Left + topLevelControlHelper.Width / 2, topLevelControlHelper.Top + topLevelControlHelper.Height / 2);
		}

		private void InvalidatePreviewInfo()
		{
			if (!base.IsInitializing)
			{
				if (pageInfo != null)
				{
					pageInfo.Dispose();
					pageInfo = null;
				}
				isPreviewDirty = true;
				printExceptionMsg = null;
				base.Metrics.OnPreviewPagesReset();
				OnPreviewInvalidated(EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		private Control GetTopLevelControlHelper()
		{
			try
			{
				UIPermission uIPermission = new UIPermission(UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows);
				if (Utilities.CanAssert)
				{
					uIPermission.Assert();
				}
				return ((Control)(object)this).TopLevelControl;
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
				return null;
			}
		}

		private void StartDelayedPrint()
		{
			if (!isPreviewGenerationPending)
			{
				isPreviewGenerationPending = true;
				HookAppIdle();
				StartPreviewTimer();
			}
		}

		private void StopDelayedPrint()
		{
			isPreviewGenerationPending = false;
			UnhookAppIdle();
			StopPreviewTimer();
		}

		private void HookAppIdle()
		{
			if (!isIdleHooked && !((Control)(object)this).IsDisposed && !((Control)(object)this).Disposing)
			{
				Application.Idle += OnApplicationIdle;
				isIdleHooked = true;
			}
		}

		private void UnhookAppIdle()
		{
			Application.Idle -= OnApplicationIdle;
			isIdleHooked = false;
		}

		private void StartPreviewTimer()
		{
			StopPreviewTimer();
			if (!((Control)(object)this).IsDisposed && !((Control)(object)this).Disposing)
			{
				if (previewTimer == null)
				{
					previewTimer = Utilities.CreateTimer();
					previewTimer.Tick += OnPreviewTimerTick;
					previewTimer.Interval = 1000;
				}
				previewTimer.Start();
			}
		}

		private void StopPreviewTimer()
		{
			System.Windows.Forms.Timer timer = previewTimer;
			if (timer != null)
			{
				previewTimer = null;
				timer.Tick -= OnPreviewTimerTick;
				timer.Stop();
				timer.Dispose();
			}
		}

		private void OnApplicationIdle(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			bool flag = isPreviewGenerationPending;
			StopDelayedPrint();
			if (flag)
			{
				GeneratePreviewHelper(synchronous: true);
			}
		}

		private void OnPreviewTimerTick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			bool flag = isPreviewGenerationPending;
			StopDelayedPrint();
			if (flag)
			{
				GeneratePreviewHelper(synchronous: true);
			}
		}

		private void GeneratePreviewHelper(bool synchronous)
		{
			if (!isPreviewDirty)
			{
				return;
			}
			isPreviewDirty = false;
			if (((Control)(object)this).IsDisposed || ((Control)(object)this).Disposing)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (document == null || base.IsInitializing)
			{
				pageInfo = null;
				StopDelayedPrint();
				return;
			}
			if (!synchronous)
			{
				isPreviewDirty = true;
				if (((Control)(object)this).IsHandleCreated)
				{
					StartDelayedPrint();
				}
				return;
			}
			StopDelayedPrint();
			PrintDocument printDocument = document;
			PrintController printController = printDocument.PrintController;
			UltraPrintPreviewController ultraPrintPreviewController = new UltraPrintPreviewController();
			ultraPrintPreviewController.UseAntiAlias = useAntiAlias;
			ultraPrintPreviewController.MaximumPageNumber = MaximumPreviewPages;
			if (displayPreviewStatus)
			{
				UltraStatusPrintController ultraStatusPrintController = new UltraStatusPrintController(ultraPrintPreviewController);
				ultraStatusPrintController.DialogCenter = CalculateStatusDialogCenter();
				ultraStatusPrintController.StyleLibraryName = ((UltraControlBase)this).StyleLibraryName;
				ultraStatusPrintController.StyleSetName = ((UltraControlBase)this).StyleSetName;
				ultraStatusPrintController.UseAppStyling = ((UltraControlBase)this).UseAppStyling;
				printDocument.PrintController = ultraStatusPrintController;
			}
			else
			{
				printDocument.PrintController = ultraPrintPreviewController;
			}
			try
			{
				printDocument.Print();
			}
			catch (InvalidPrinterException ex)
			{
				printExceptionMsg = ex.Message;
			}
			catch (ArgumentException ex2)
			{
				printExceptionMsg = ex2.Message;
			}
			pageInfo = ultraPrintPreviewController.PreviewPages;
			base.Metrics.RulerInfo.RulerUnitDpi = ultraPrintPreviewController.Dpi;
			printDocument.PrintController = printController;
			OnPreviewPagesGenerated();
			OnPreviewGenerated(EventArgs.Empty);
		}

		private Cursor GetPageAreaCursor()
		{
			if (!((Control)(object)this).Enabled)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (PageCount == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			switch (MouseActionResolved)
			{
			default:
				return null;
			case PreviewMouseAction.DynamicZoom:
				return GetCursor(CursorType.DynamicZoom);
			case PreviewMouseAction.Hand:
				if (Control.MouseButtons == MouseButtons.Left && ((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement.ElementWithMouseCapture is PreviewPageAreaUIElement)
				{
					return GetCursor(CursorType.HandClosed);
				}
				return GetCursor(CursorType.HandOpen);
			case PreviewMouseAction.Snapshot:
				if (Utilities.IsClipboardUsagePossible)
				{
					return GetCursor(CursorType.SnapShot);
				}
				return null;
			case PreviewMouseAction.ZoomIn:
				if (base.Settings.Zoom == base.MaximumZoomResolved)
				{
					return GetCursor(CursorType.ZoomNotAllowed);
				}
				return GetCursor(CursorType.ZoomIn);
			case PreviewMouseAction.ZoomOut:
				if (base.Settings.Zoom == base.MinimumZoomResolved)
				{
					return GetCursor(CursorType.ZoomNotAllowed);
				}
				return GetCursor(CursorType.ZoomOut);
			}
		}

		private void VerifyCurrentMouseAction()
		{
			if (base.IsInitializing)
			{
				currentMouseAction = mouseAction;
				return;
			}
			PreviewMouseAction mouseActionResolved = MouseActionResolved;
			if (currentMouseAction != mouseActionResolved)
			{
				currentMouseAction = mouseActionResolved;
				((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.MouseAction);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnPreviewGenerated(EventArgs e)
		{
			((EventHandler)((Component)(object)this).Events[EventPreviewGenerated])?.Invoke(this, e);
		}

		internal void OnPreviewInvalidated(EventArgs e)
		{
			((EventHandler)((Component)(object)this).Events[EventPreviewInvalidated])?.Invoke(this, e);
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnViewHistoryChanged(EventArgs e)
		{
			((EventHandler)((Component)(object)this).Events[EventViewHistoryChanged])?.Invoke(this, e);
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnSnapshotCreated(EventArgs e)
		{
			((EventHandler)((Component)(object)this).Events[EventSnapshotCreated])?.Invoke(this, e);
		}

		protected override void OnEndInit()
		{
			InvalidatePreviewInfo();
			base.OnEndInit();
		}

		protected internal override UltraPreviewPageInfo GetPreviewPage(int pageIndex)
		{
			if (PageInfo != null)
			{
				return PageInfo[pageIndex];
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override bool IsPointDesignTimeActive(Point pt)
		{
			switch (MouseActionResolved)
			{
			case PreviewMouseAction.DynamicZoom:
			case PreviewMouseAction.ZoomOut:
			case PreviewMouseAction.ZoomIn:
			{
				UIElement val = ((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).ElementFromPoint(pt);
				if (val != null && val.GetAncestor(typeof(PreviewPageAreaUIElement)) != null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			return ((UltraControlBase)this).IsPointDesignTimeActive(pt);
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				StopDelayedPrint();
				Document = null;
			}
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		protected override void OnHandleCreated(EventArgs e)
		{
			((UltraControlBase)this).OnHandleCreated(e);
			if (isPreviewDirty && autoGeneratePreview)
			{
				StartDelayedPrint();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnLostFocus(EventArgs e)
		{
			VerifyCurrentMouseAction();
			((UltraControlBase)this).OnLostFocus(e);
		}

		protected override void OnKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			((UltraControlBase)this).OnKeyDown(e);
			if (!e.Handled && (e.KeyData == (Keys.ControlKey | Keys.Control) || e.KeyData == (Keys.ShiftKey | Keys.Shift)))
			{
				switch (mouseAction)
				{
				case PreviewMouseAction.ZoomOut:
				case PreviewMouseAction.ZoomIn:
					Utilities.ResetCursorPosition();
					VerifyCurrentMouseAction();
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnKeyUp(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			((Control)(object)this).OnKeyUp(e);
			if (!e.Handled && (e.KeyData == Keys.ControlKey || e.KeyData == Keys.ShiftKey))
			{
				switch (mouseAction)
				{
				case PreviewMouseAction.ZoomOut:
				case PreviewMouseAction.ZoomIn:
					Utilities.ResetCursorPosition();
					VerifyCurrentMouseAction();
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override bool IsInputKey(Keys keyData)
		{
			if (keyData == Keys.ControlKey || keyData == Keys.ShiftKey)
			{
				if (mouseAction != PreviewMouseAction.DynamicZoom && mouseAction != PreviewMouseAction.ZoomIn)
				{
					return mouseAction == PreviewMouseAction.ZoomOut;
				}
				return true;
			}
			if (((KeyActionMappingsBase)KeyActionMappings).IsKeyMapped(keyData, (long)CurrentState))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return ((Control)(object)this).IsInputKey(keyData);
		}

		protected override ComponentRole CreateComponentRole()
		{
			return (ComponentRole)(object)new MiscControlRole((UltraControlBase)(object)this, StyleUtils.ComponentType.UltraPrintPreviewControl);
		}
	}

		{
			get
			{
				return previewControl;
			}
			set
			{
				if (previewControl == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (previewControl != null)
				{
					((Component)(object)previewControl).Disposed -= OnPreviewControlDisposed;
					previewControl.PreviewGenerated -= OnPreviewGenerated;
					previewControl.PreviewInvalidated -= OnPreviewInvalidated;
					previewControl.VisiblePreviewPagesChanged -= OnVisiblePreviewPagesChanged;
					((Control)(object)previewControl).Paint -= OnPreviewPaint;
					previewControl.CurrentPageChanged -= OnPreviewCurrentPageChanged;
				}
				previewControl = value;
				if (previewControl != null)
				{
					((Component)(object)previewControl).Disposed += OnPreviewControlDisposed;
					previewControl.PreviewGenerated += OnPreviewGenerated;
					previewControl.PreviewInvalidated += OnPreviewInvalidated;
					previewControl.VisiblePreviewPagesChanged += OnVisiblePreviewPagesChanged;
					((Control)(object)previewControl).Paint += OnPreviewPaint;
					previewControl.CurrentPageChanged += OnPreviewCurrentPageChanged;
				}
				if (!base.IsInitializing)
				{
					base.Metrics.OnPreviewPagesReset();
					if (value != null)
					{
						base.Metrics.OnPreviewPagesGenerated();
					}
				}
				((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.PreviewControl);
			}
		}

				return false;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public UltraPrintPreviewThumbnailStates CurrentState
		{
			get
			{
				UltraPrintPreviewThumbnailStates ultraPrintPreviewThumbnailStates = (UltraPrintPreviewThumbnailStates)0;
				if (PageCount > 0)
				{
					ultraPrintPreviewThumbnailStates |= UltraPrintPreviewThumbnailStates.Pages;
				}
				if (base.HasPreviousPage)
				{
					ultraPrintPreviewThumbnailStates |= UltraPrintPreviewThumbnailStates.HasPreviousPage;
				}
				if (base.HasNextPage)
				{
					ultraPrintPreviewThumbnailStates |= UltraPrintPreviewThumbnailStates.HasNextPage;
				}
				return ultraPrintPreviewThumbnailStates;
			}
		}

		public bool PerformAction(UltraPrintPreviewThumbnailAction actionCode)
		{
			if (!KeyActionMappings.IsActionAllowed(actionCode, CurrentState))
			{
				return false;
			}
			int value = base.Metrics.VerticalScrollInfo.Value;
			int value2 = base.Metrics.HorizontalScrollInfo.Value;
			switch (actionCode)
			{
			case UltraPrintPreviewThumbnailAction.ScrollUp:
				base.Metrics.VerticalScrollInfo.PerformAction((ScrollBarAction)3);
				return value != base.Metrics.VerticalScrollInfo.Value;
			case UltraPrintPreviewThumbnailAction.ScrollDown:
				base.Metrics.VerticalScrollInfo.PerformAction((ScrollBarAction)2);
				return value != base.Metrics.VerticalScrollInfo.Value;
			case UltraPrintPreviewThumbnailAction.ScrollPageUp:
				base.Metrics.VerticalScrollInfo.PerformAction((ScrollBarAction)5);
				return value != base.Metrics.VerticalScrollInfo.Value;
			case UltraPrintPreviewThumbnailAction.ScrollPageDown:
				base.Metrics.VerticalScrollInfo.PerformAction((ScrollBarAction)4);
				return value != base.Metrics.VerticalScrollInfo.Value;
			case UltraPrintPreviewThumbnailAction.ScrollToTop:
				base.Metrics.VerticalScrollInfo.PerformAction((ScrollBarAction)0);
				return value != base.Metrics.VerticalScrollInfo.Value;
			case UltraPrintPreviewThumbnailAction.ScrollToBottom:
				base.Metrics.VerticalScrollInfo.PerformAction((ScrollBarAction)1);
				return value != base.Metrics.VerticalScrollInfo.Value;
			case UltraPrintPreviewThumbnailAction.ScrollLeft:
				base.Metrics.HorizontalScrollInfo.PerformAction((ScrollBarAction)3);
				return value2 != base.Metrics.HorizontalScrollInfo.Value;
			case UltraPrintPreviewThumbnailAction.ScrollRight:
				base.Metrics.HorizontalScrollInfo.PerformAction((ScrollBarAction)2);
				return value2 != base.Metrics.HorizontalScrollInfo.Value;
			case UltraPrintPreviewThumbnailAction.ScrollPageLeft:
				base.Metrics.HorizontalScrollInfo.PerformAction((ScrollBarAction)5);
				return value2 != base.Metrics.HorizontalScrollInfo.Value;
			case UltraPrintPreviewThumbnailAction.ScrollPageRight:
				base.Metrics.HorizontalScrollInfo.PerformAction((ScrollBarAction)4);
				return value2 != base.Metrics.HorizontalScrollInfo.Value;
			case UltraPrintPreviewThumbnailAction.ScrollToLeft:
				base.Metrics.HorizontalScrollInfo.PerformAction((ScrollBarAction)0);
				return value2 != base.Metrics.HorizontalScrollInfo.Value;
			case UltraPrintPreviewThumbnailAction.ScrollToRight:
				base.Metrics.HorizontalScrollInfo.PerformAction((ScrollBarAction)1);
				return value2 != base.Metrics.HorizontalScrollInfo.Value;
			case UltraPrintPreviewThumbnailAction.ScrollToFirstPage:
				base.CurrentPage = 1;
				return true;
			case UltraPrintPreviewThumbnailAction.ScrollToLastPage:
				base.CurrentPage = PageCount;
				return true;
			case UltraPrintPreviewThumbnailAction.ScrollToPreviousPage:
				return base.Metrics.ScrollToPreviousPage();
			case UltraPrintPreviewThumbnailAction.ScrollToNextPage:
				return base.Metrics.ScrollToNextPage();
			case UltraPrintPreviewThumbnailAction.ZoomOut:
			case UltraPrintPreviewThumbnailAction.ZoomIn:
				return ChangeZoomUsingIncrements(actionCode == UltraPrintPreviewThumbnailAction.ZoomOut);
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		private void CreateAppearanceHolder(ref AppearanceHolder appearanceHolder)
		{
			//IL_0005: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (appearanceHolder == null)
			{
				appearanceHolder = new AppearanceHolder();
				appearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
		}

		private void SetAppearanceHolder(ref AppearanceHolder appearanceHolder, AppearanceBase value)
		{
			if (appearanceHolder == null || !appearanceHolder.HasAppearance || value != appearanceHolder.Appearance)
			{
				if (appearanceHolder == null)
				{
					CreateAppearanceHolder(ref appearanceHolder);
				}
				appearanceHolder.Appearance = value;
			}
		}

		private void DisposeAppearanceHolder(ref AppearanceHolder appearanceHolder)
		{
			if (appearanceHolder != null)
			{
				appearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				appearanceHolder.Reset();
				appearanceHolder = null;
			}
		}

		private void OnPreviewCurrentPageChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			EnsureCurrentPreviewPageIsInView();
		}

		internal void EnsureCurrentPreviewPageIsInView()
		{
			if (PreviewControl != null && PageCount != 0 && (((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement == null || !(((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement.ElementWithMouseCapture is PreviewPageViewBoxUIElement)))
			{
				int currentPage = PreviewControl.CurrentPage;
				base.Metrics.EnsurePageIsInView(currentPage - 1);
			}
		}

		internal void ResolveViewBoxAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			ResolutionOrderInfo resOrder;
			UIRole role = StyleUtils.GetRole((UltraControlBase)(object)this, StyleUtils.Role.PrintPreviewPageViewBox, out resOrder);
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseStyleBefore && role != null)
			{
				role.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
			}
			if (HasViewBoxAppearance && ((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseControlInfo)
			{
				ViewBoxAppearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			}
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseStyleAfter && role != null)
			{
				role.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
			}
			if (Utilities.ShouldSetAppearanceProperty(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (AppearancePropFlags)1))
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor = Color.Transparent;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFEuL);
			}
			if (Utilities.ShouldSetAppearanceProperty(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (AppearancePropFlags)4))
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BorderColor = Color.Red;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFBuL);
			}
		}

		internal override void ResolvePageAppearance(UltraPreviewPageInfo page, ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			if (page != null && page.PageNumber == base.CurrentPage && base.Settings.HasCurrentPageAppearance)
			{
				base.Settings.CurrentPageAppearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			}
			if (page != null && previewControl != null && page.PageNumber == previewControl.CurrentPage && HasCurrentPreviewPageAppearance)
			{
				CurrentPreviewPageAppearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			}
			base.ResolvePageAppearance(page, ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
		}

		internal override void ResolvePageNumberAppearance(int pageNumber, ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			ResolvePageNumberAppearance(pageNumber == base.CurrentPage, previewControl != null && pageNumber == previewControl.CurrentPage, ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
		}

		internal void ResolvePageNumberAppearance(bool currentThumbnailPage, bool currentPrintPreviewPage, ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			ResolutionOrderInfo resOrder;
			UIRole role = StyleUtils.GetRole((UltraControlBase)(object)this, StyleUtils.Role.PrintPreviewPageNumber, out resOrder);
			if (currentThumbnailPage)
			{
				if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseStyleBefore && role != null)
				{
					role.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)16);
				}
				if (base.Settings.HasCurrentPageNumberAppearance && ((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseControlInfo)
				{
					base.Settings.CurrentPageNumberAppearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
				}
				if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseStyleAfter && role != null)
				{
					role.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)16);
				}
			}
			if (currentPrintPreviewPage)
			{
				if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseStyleBefore && role != null)
				{
					role.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)17179869184L);
				}
				if (HasCurrentPreviewPageNumberAppearance && ((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseControlInfo)
				{
					CurrentPreviewPageNumberAppearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
				}
				if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseStyleAfter && role != null)
				{
					role.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)17179869184L);
				}
				if (Utilities.ShouldSetAppearanceProperty(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (AppearancePropFlags)1))
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor = SystemColors.Highlight;
					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFEuL);
				}
				if (Utilities.ShouldSetAppearanceProperty(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (AppearancePropFlags)2))
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).ForeColor = SystemColors.HighlightText;
					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFDuL);
				}
			}
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseStyleBefore && role != null)
			{
				role.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
			}
			if (base.Settings.HasPageNumberAppearance && ((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseControlInfo)
			{
				base.Settings.PageNumberAppearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			}
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseStyleAfter && role != null)
			{
				role.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
			}
			ResolveDefaultPageNumberAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				PreviewControl = null;
				DisposeAppearanceHolder(ref viewBoxAppearanceHolder);
				DisposeAppearanceHolder(ref currentPreviewPageAppearanceHolder);
				DisposeAppearanceHolder(ref currentPreviewPageNumberAppearanceHolder);
			}
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		protected internal override UltraPreviewPageInfo GetPreviewPage(int pageIndex)
		{
			if (PreviewControl == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return PreviewControl.GetPreviewPage(pageIndex);
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChangeInfo)
		{
			if (HasViewBoxAppearance && viewBoxAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance == propChangeInfo.Source)
			{
				InvalidateElements();
				((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.ViewBoxAppearance, propChangeInfo);
			}
			else if (HasCurrentPreviewPageAppearance && currentPreviewPageAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance == propChangeInfo.Source)
			{
				InvalidateElements();
				((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.CurrentPreviewPageAppearance, propChangeInfo);
			}
			else if (HasCurrentPreviewPageNumberAppearance && currentPreviewPageNumberAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance == propChangeInfo.Source)
			{
				InvalidateElements();
				((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)UltraPrintPreviewControlPropertyIds.CurrentPreviewPageNumberAppearance, propChangeInfo);
			}
			else
			{
				base.OnSubObjectPropChanged(propChangeInfo);
			}
		}

		protected override bool IsInputKey(Keys keyData)
		{
			if (((KeyActionMappingsBase)KeyActionMappings).IsKeyMapped(keyData, (long)CurrentState))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return ((Control)(object)this).IsInputKey(keyData);
		}

		protected override ComponentRole CreateComponentRole()
		{
			return (ComponentRole)(object)new MiscControlRole((UltraControlBase)(object)this, StyleUtils.ComponentType.UltraPrintPreviewThumbnail);
		}
	}

			Size buttonSize = metrics.ButtonSize;
			int interButtonSpacing = metrics.InterButtonSpacing;
			DesktopAlertButtonsCollectionBase visibleAlertButtons = windowInfo.VisibleAlertButtons;
			for (int i = 0; i < visibleAlertButtons.Count; i++)

				rect.Size = buttonSize;
				AlertButtonUIElement alertButtonUIElement = UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)childElements, typeof(AlertButtonUIElement), true) as AlertButtonUIElement;

				{
					alertButtonUIElement.Initialize(button);

				}
			}
		}

namespace Infragistics.Win.Misc.UltraWinDesktopAlert
{
	internal class DesktopAlertWindowAnimationManager
	{
		internal class AnimationFrame
		{
			private int frameNumber;

			private float opacity = 1f;

			private Rectangle bounds = Rectangle.Empty;

			private Point offset = Point.Empty;

			internal int FrameNumber => frameNumber;

			internal float Opacity => opacity;

			internal Rectangle Bounds => bounds;

			internal Point Offset => offset;

			internal AnimationFrame(int frameNumber, float opacity, Rectangle bounds, Point offset)
			{
				this.frameNumber = frameNumber;
				this.opacity = opacity;
				this.bounds = bounds;
				this.offset = offset;
			}
		}

		internal class AnimationFrameCollection : CollectionBase
		{
			private int frameCount;

			internal AnimationFrame this[int frameNumber]
			{
				get
				{
					int num = frameNumber - 1;
					if (num < 0 || num >= base.InnerList.Count)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return base.InnerList[num] as AnimationFrame;
				}
			}

			internal int FrameCount => frameCount;

			internal AnimationFrame First => this[1];

			internal AnimationFrame Last => this[frameCount];

			internal Rectangle InitialBounds => First?.Bounds ?? Rectangle.Empty;

			internal float InitialOpacity => First?.Opacity ?? 1f;

			public new int Count
			{
				get
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException();
				}
			}

			internal AnimationFrameCollection(int frameCount)
			{
				Reset(frameCount);
			}

			internal void Reset(int frameCount)
			{
				this.frameCount = frameCount;
				base.InnerList.Clear();
			}

			internal void Add(AnimationFrame animationFrame)
			{
				base.InnerList.Add(animationFrame);
				if (base.InnerList.Count > frameCount)
				{
					throw new Exception("More elements were added to this collection than the number of animation frames it was created for.");
				}
			}

			public new void Clear()
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}

			public override string ToString()
			{
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
				for (int i = 1; i <= frameCount; i++)
				{
					AnimationFrame animationFrame = this[i];
					if (animationFrame != null)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append($"Frame {animationFrame.FrameNumber}: Opacity = {animationFrame.Opacity}, Location = {animationFrame.Bounds.Location}, Size = {animationFrame.Bounds.Size}");
					}
					else
					{
						stringBuilder.Append($"Frame {i}: Null");
					}
				}
				return stringBuilder.ToString();
			}
		}

		private static readonly int FRAME_RATE = 10;

		private static readonly int FRAME_COUNT_SLOW = 50;

		private static readonly int FRAME_COUNT_MEDIUM = 25;

		private static readonly int FRAME_COUNT_FAST = 12;

		private static readonly AnimationScrollDirection defaultAnimationScrollDirectionShow = AnimationScrollDirection.BottomToTop;

		private static readonly AnimationScrollDirection defaultAnimationScrollDirectionAutoClose = AnimationScrollDirection.TopToBottom;

		private UltraDesktopAlert desktopAlert;

		private UltraDesktopAlertWindowInfo windowInfo;

		private System.Windows.Forms.Timer sequenceTimer;

		private System.Windows.Forms.Timer autoCloseTimer;

		private int currentFrame;

		private AnimationSequence animationSequence;

		private Size fullSize = Size.Empty;

		private Point fullLocation = Point.Empty;

		private bool isDisposing;

		private AnimationFrameCollection frames;

		private Bitmap windowImage;

		private bool isDisposed;

		public bool FadeOnShow
		{
			get
			{
				AnimationStyle animationStyleShowResolved = desktopAlert.AnimationStyleShowResolved;
				if (animationStyleShowResolved != AnimationStyle.Fade)
				{
					return animationStyleShowResolved == AnimationStyle.FadeAndScroll;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public bool FadeOnClose
		{
			get
			{
				AnimationStyle animationStyleAutoCloseResolved = desktopAlert.AnimationStyleAutoCloseResolved;
				if (animationStyleAutoCloseResolved != AnimationStyle.Fade)
				{
					return animationStyleAutoCloseResolved == AnimationStyle.FadeAndScroll;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public bool ScrollOnShow
		{
			get
			{
				AnimationStyle animationStyleShowResolved = desktopAlert.AnimationStyleShowResolved;
				if (animationStyleShowResolved != AnimationStyle.Scroll)
				{
					return animationStyleShowResolved == AnimationStyle.FadeAndScroll;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public bool ScrollOnClose
		{
			get
			{
				AnimationStyle animationStyleAutoCloseResolved = desktopAlert.AnimationStyleAutoCloseResolved;
				if (animationStyleAutoCloseResolved != AnimationStyle.Scroll)
				{
					return animationStyleAutoCloseResolved == AnimationStyle.FadeAndScroll;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public int FrameCount => desktopAlert.AnimationSpeedResolved switch
		{
			AnimationSpeed.Slow => FRAME_COUNT_SLOW, 
			AnimationSpeed.Medium => FRAME_COUNT_MEDIUM, 
			AnimationSpeed.Fast => FRAME_COUNT_FAST, 
			_ => throw new NotImplementedException(), 
		};

		public int CurrentFrame => currentFrame;

		private AnimationFrameCollection Frames
		{
			get
			{
				if (frames == null)
				{
					frames = new AnimationFrameCollection(FrameCount);
				}
				return frames;
			}
		}

		private int AutoCloseTimerInterval
		{
			get
			{
				_ = windowInfo.DesktopAlert;
				if (!windowInfo.AutoCloseResolved)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				int autoCloseDelayResolved = windowInfo.DesktopAlertPropertyCache.AutoCloseDelayResolved;
				return Math.Max(autoCloseDelayResolved, 0);
			}
		}

		private float CurrentOpacity
		{
			get
			{
				DesktopAlertWindowFormBase val = windowInfo.UltraDesktopAlertWindow?.Form;
				if (val == null)
				{
					return 1f;
				}
				return (float)((Form)(object)val).Opacity;
			}
		}

		public bool IsAnimating
		{
			get
			{
				if (animationSequence != AnimationSequence.GradualShow)
				{
					return animationSequence == AnimationSequence.GradualClose;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public Point WindowOriginOffset
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsAnimating)
				{
					return Point.Empty;
				}
				AnimationFrameCollection animationFrameCollection = Frames;
				if (currentFrame > 0 && currentFrame <= animationFrameCollection.FrameCount)
				{
					return animationFrameCollection[currentFrame].Offset;
				}
				return Point.Empty;
			}
		}

		public Bitmap WindowImage => windowImage;

		public AnimationScrollDirection AnimationScrollDirectionShowResolved
		{
			get
			{
				AnimationScrollDirection animationScrollDirectionShowResolved = desktopAlert.AnimationScrollDirectionShowResolved;
				if (animationScrollDirectionShowResolved != AnimationScrollDirection.AutoSelect)
				{
					return animationScrollDirectionShowResolved;
				}
				ScreenPosition screenPosition = windowInfo.ScreenPosition;
				AnimationScrollDirection animationScrollDirection = AnimationScrollDirection.Default;
				if (screenPosition == ScreenPosition.Manual)
				{
					Rectangle screenBounds = new Rectangle(fullLocation, fullSize);
					animationScrollDirection = DesktopAlertWindowLocationManager.AnimationScrollDirectionFromBounds(screenBounds, show: true);
				}
				else
				{
					animationScrollDirection = DesktopAlertWindowLocationManager.AnimationScrollDirectionFromScreenPosition(screenPosition, show: true);
				}
				if (animationScrollDirection == AnimationScrollDirection.Default)
				{
					return defaultAnimationScrollDirectionShow;
				}
				return animationScrollDirection;
			}
		}

		public AnimationScrollDirection AnimationScrollDirectionAutoCloseResolved
		{
			get
			{
				AnimationScrollDirection animationScrollDirectionAutoCloseResolved = desktopAlert.AnimationScrollDirectionAutoCloseResolved;
				if (animationScrollDirectionAutoCloseResolved != AnimationScrollDirection.AutoSelect)
				{
					return animationScrollDirectionAutoCloseResolved;
				}
				Rectangle screenBounds = new Rectangle(fullLocation, fullSize);
				AnimationScrollDirection animationScrollDirection = DesktopAlertWindowLocationManager.AnimationScrollDirectionFromBounds(screenBounds, show: false);
				if (animationScrollDirection == AnimationScrollDirection.Default)
				{
					return defaultAnimationScrollDirectionAutoClose;
				}
				return animationScrollDirection;
			}
		}

		public bool IsDisposed => isDisposed;

		internal Point Location
		{
			get
			{
				return fullLocation;
			}
			set
			{
				Point screenLocation = value;
				DesktopAlertWindowLocationManager.VerifyScreenLocation(ref screenLocation, fullSize);
				fullLocation = screenLocation;
			}
		}

		internal DesktopAlertWindowAnimationManager(UltraDesktopAlertWindowInfo windowInfo)
		{
			this.windowInfo = windowInfo;
			desktopAlert = this.windowInfo.DesktopAlert;
			if (desktopAlert == null)
			{
				throw new Exception("The specified UltraDesktopAlertWindowInfo instance is not associated with an UltraDesktopAlert.");
			}
			fullSize = windowInfo.WindowSize;
			Point screenLocation = windowInfo.ScreenLocation;
			if (windowInfo.DesktopAlertPropertyCache.TileMultipleWindows && !DesktopAlertWindowLocationManager.VerifyNoOverlap(ref screenLocation, fullSize, this.windowInfo, desktopAlert.WindowInfoManager.WindowInfoList, show: true))
			{
				windowInfo.Close();
			}
			Location = screenLocation;
			HookEvents(hook: true);
		}

		private void InitializeSequenceTimer(bool start)
		{
			if (start)
			{
				if (sequenceTimer == null)
				{
					sequenceTimer = Utilities.CreateTimer();
					sequenceTimer.Tick += OnSequenceTimerTick;
					sequenceTimer.Interval = FRAME_RATE;
				}
				sequenceTimer.Start();
			}
			else if (sequenceTimer != null)
			{
				sequenceTimer.Tick -= OnSequenceTimerTick;
				sequenceTimer.Stop();
				sequenceTimer.Dispose();
				sequenceTimer = null;
			}
		}

		private void OnSequenceTimerTick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			int frameCount = FrameCount;
			if (currentFrame > frameCount)
			{
				switch (animationSequence)
				{
				case AnimationSequence.GradualClose:
					if (!windowInfo.Pinned)
					{
						StopImmediate();
					}
					else
					{
						animationSequence = AnimationSequence.None;
					}
					break;
				case AnimationSequence.GradualShow:
				{
					animationSequence = AnimationSequence.None;
					UltraDesktopAlertWindowUIElement ultraDesktopAlertWindowUIElement = windowInfo.UltraDesktopAlertWindow?.UIElement;
					if (ultraDesktopAlertWindowUIElement != null)
					{
						((UIElement)ultraDesktopAlertWindowUIElement).DirtyChildElements(false);
					}
					InitializeAutoCloseTimer(start: true);
					break;
				}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ProcessAnimationFrame(currentFrame);
				currentFrame++;
			}
		}

		internal bool InitializeAutoCloseTimer(bool start)
		{
			if (start)
			{
				int autoCloseTimerInterval = AutoCloseTimerInterval;
				if (autoCloseTimerInterval == 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (autoCloseTimer == null)
				{
					autoCloseTimer = Utilities.CreateTimer();
					autoCloseTimer.Tick += OnAutoCloseTimerTick;
					autoCloseTimer.Interval = autoCloseTimerInterval;
				}
				else
				{
					autoCloseTimer.Stop();
				}
				autoCloseTimer.Start();
			}
			else if (autoCloseTimer != null)
			{
				autoCloseTimer.Tick -= OnAutoCloseTimerTick;
				autoCloseTimer.Stop();
				autoCloseTimer.Dispose();

			}

		}

		public void CreateWindowImage()
		{

			{
				windowImage.Dispose();
				windowImage = null;
			}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (isDisposing)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				isDisposing = true;
				InitializeAutoCloseTimer(start: false);
				InitializeSequenceTimer(start: false);
				HookEvents(hook: false);
				if (windowImage != null)
				{
					windowImage.Dispose();
					windowImage = null;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				isDisposing = false;
				isDisposed = true;
			}
		}

		public void Start(AnimationSequence animationSequence)

		}

		public void Start(AnimationSequence animationSequence, bool mouseEnter)
		{
			if (!isDisposed && animationSequence != AnimationSequence.None && animationSequence != AnimationSequence.ImmediateClose)
			{
				UltraDesktopAlertWindow ultraDesktopAlertWindow = windowInfo.UltraDesktopAlertWindow;
				_ = ultraDesktopAlertWindow?.Form;
				this.animationSequence = animationSequence;
				bool flag = this.animationSequence == AnimationSequence.ImmediateShow;
				bool flag2 = this.animationSequence == AnimationSequence.GradualShow;
				bool flag3 = this.animationSequence == AnimationSequence.GradualClose;
				if (flag)
				{
					InitializeAutoCloseTimer(start: false);
					InitializeSequenceTimer(start: false);
					ultraDesktopAlertWindow?.DirtyControlElement();
				}
				if (flag2 || flag3)
				{
					CalculateAnimationFrameInfo(animationSequence);
				}
				currentFrame = 1;
				AnimationFrameCollection animationFrameCollection = Frames;
				float num = (mouseEnter ? 1f : windowInfo.DesktopAlertPropertyCache.OpacityResolved);
				float initialOpacity = (flag ? num : animationFrameCollection.InitialOpacity);
				Rectangle initialBounds = ((flag || flag3) ? new Rectangle(fullLocation, fullSize) : animationFrameCollection.InitialBounds);
				windowInfo.UltraDesktopAlertWindow.Show(initialBounds, initialOpacity);
				if (flag2 || flag3)
				{
					InitializeSequenceTimer(start: true);
				}
				if (flag && !mouseEnter)
				{
					InitializeAutoCloseTimer(start: true);
				}
			}
		}

		private void StopImmediate()

		}

		private void CalculateAnimationFrameInfo(AnimationSequence animationSequence)
		{
			if (animationSequence == AnimationSequence.GradualShow || animationSequence == AnimationSequence.GradualClose)
			{
				_ = Point.Empty;
				_ = Size.Empty;
				_ = Rectangle.Empty;
				AnimationFrameCollection animationFrameCollection = Frames;
				int frameCount = FrameCount;
				Frames.Reset(frameCount);
				for (int i = 1; i <= frameCount; i++)
				{
					int frameNumber = ((animationSequence == AnimationSequence.GradualShow) ? i : (frameCount - (i - 1)));
					AnimationFrame animationFrame = GetAnimationFrame(frameNumber, animationSequence);
					animationFrameCollection.Add(animationFrame);
				}
			}
		}

		private AnimationFrame GetAnimationFrame(int frameNumber, AnimationSequence animationSequence)
		{
			Rectangle bounds = new Rectangle(fullLocation, fullSize);
			float num = 1f;
			int num2;
			switch (animationSequence)
			{
			case AnimationSequence.ImmediateShow:
			case AnimationSequence.ImmediateClose:
				if (animationSequence != AnimationSequence.ImmediateShow)
				{
					return new AnimationFrame(frameNumber, 0f, new Rectangle(fullLocation, Size.Empty), Point.Empty);
				}
				return new AnimationFrame(frameNumber, 1f, bounds, Point.Empty);
			default:
				num2 = 0;
				break;
			case AnimationSequence.GradualShow:
				num2 = 1;
				break;
			}
			bool flag = (byte)num2 != 0;
			bool flag2 = (flag ? ScrollOnShow : ScrollOnClose);
			bool flag3 = (flag ? FadeOnShow : FadeOnClose);
			AnimationScrollDirection animationScrollDirection = AnimationScrollDirection.Default;
			if (flag2)
			{
				animationScrollDirection = (flag ? AnimationScrollDirectionShowResolved : AnimationScrollDirectionAutoCloseResolved);
			}
			bool flag4 = false;
			bool flag5 = false;
			bool flag6 = false;
			bool flag7 = false;
			if (flag2)
			{
				switch (animationScrollDirection)
				{
				case AnimationScrollDirection.BottomLeftToTopRight:
					flag4 = (flag ? true : false);
					flag5 = !flag;
					flag6 = true;
					flag7 = true;
					break;
				case AnimationScrollDirection.BottomRightToTopLeft:
					flag4 = (flag ? true : false);
					flag5 = (flag ? true : false);
					flag6 = true;
					flag7 = true;
					break;
				case AnimationScrollDirection.BottomToTop:
					flag4 = (flag ? true : false);
					flag5 = false;
					flag6 = false;
					flag7 = true;
					break;
				case AnimationScrollDirection.LeftToRight:
					flag4 = false;
					flag5 = !flag;
					flag6 = true;
					flag7 = false;
					break;
				case AnimationScrollDirection.RightToLeft:
					flag4 = false;
					flag5 = (flag ? true : false);
					flag6 = true;
					flag7 = false;
					break;
				case AnimationScrollDirection.TopLeftToBottomRight:
					flag4 = !flag;
					flag5 = !flag;
					flag6 = true;
					flag7 = true;
					break;
				case AnimationScrollDirection.TopRightToBottomLeft:
					flag4 = !flag;
					flag5 = (flag ? true : false);
					flag6 = true;
					flag7 = true;
					break;
				case AnimationScrollDirection.TopToBottom:
					flag4 = !flag;
					flag5 = false;
					flag6 = false;
					flag7 = true;
					break;
				}
			}
			int frameCount = FrameCount;
			float num3 = (float)frameNumber / (float)frameCount;
			Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle(fullLocation, fullSize);
			int num4 = (int)Math.Ceiling((double)rectangle.Width / (double)frameCount);
			int num5 = Math.Min(num4 * frameNumber, rectangle.Width);
			int num6 = (int)Math.Ceiling((double)rectangle.Height / (double)frameCount);
			int num7 = Math.Min(num6 * frameNumber, rectangle.Height);
			Size size = rectangle.Size;
			if (flag6)
			{
				size.Width = num5;
				size.Width = Math.Max(1, num5);
				size.Width = Math.Min(rectangle.Width, num5);
			}
			if (flag7)
			{
				size.Height = num7;
				size.Height = Math.Min(rectangle.Height, num7);
				size.Height = Math.Max(1, num7);
			}
			Point location = rectangle.Location;
			if (flag5)
			{
				location.X = rectangle.Right - size.Width;
			}
			if (flag4)
			{
				location.Y = rectangle.Bottom - size.Height;
			}
			rectangle.Contains(location);
			bounds = new Rectangle(location, size);
			float opacityResolved = desktopAlert.OpacityResolved;
			float val = (flag3 ? (opacityResolved * num3) : opacityResolved);
			num = Math.Min(val, 1f);
			num = Math.Max(val, 0f);
			Point offset = Point.Empty;
			Size size2 = new Size(fullSize.Width - size.Width, fullSize.Height - size.Height);
			if (flag2)
			{
				switch (animationScrollDirection)
				{
				case AnimationScrollDirection.BottomLeftToTopRight:
					offset = (flag ? new Point(size2.Width * -1, 0) : new Point(0, size2.Height * -1));
					break;
				case AnimationScrollDirection.BottomRightToTopLeft:
					offset = (flag ? Point.Empty : new Point(size2.Width * -1, size2.Height * -1));
					break;
				case AnimationScrollDirection.BottomToTop:
					offset = (flag ? Point.Empty : new Point(0, size2.Height * -1));
					break;
				case AnimationScrollDirection.LeftToRight:
					offset = (flag ? new Point(size2.Width * -1, 0) : Point.Empty);
					break;
				case AnimationScrollDirection.RightToLeft:
					offset = (flag ? Point.Empty : new Point(size2.Width * -1, 0));
					break;
				case AnimationScrollDirection.TopLeftToBottomRight:
					offset = (flag ? new Point(size2.Width * -1, size2.Height * -1) : Point.Empty);
					break;
				case AnimationScrollDirection.TopRightToBottomLeft:
					offset = (flag ? new Point(0, size2.Height * -1) : new Point(size2.Width * -1, 0));
					break;
				case AnimationScrollDirection.TopToBottom:
					offset = (flag ? new Point(0, size2.Height * -1) : Point.Empty);
					break;
				}
			}
			return new AnimationFrame(frameNumber, num, bounds, offset);
		}

		private void ProcessAnimationFrame(int frameNumber)
		{
			AnimationFrame animationFrame = Frames[frameNumber];
			if (animationFrame != null)
			{
				float opacity = animationFrame.Opacity;
				Rectangle bounds = animationFrame.Bounds;
				Point offset = animationFrame.Offset;
				Rectangle rectangle = bounds;
				rectangle.Offset(offset);
				UltraDesktopAlertWindow ultraDesktopAlertWindow = windowInfo.UltraDesktopAlertWindow;
				ultraDesktopAlertWindow.PerformAnimation(opacity, bounds);
			}
		}

		private void HookEvents(bool hook)
		{
			UltraDesktopAlertWindow ultraDesktopAlertWindow = windowInfo.UltraDesktopAlertWindow;
			if (hook)
			{
				((Control)(object)ultraDesktopAlertWindow).MouseEnter += OnMouseEnter;
				((Control)(object)ultraDesktopAlertWindow).MouseLeave += OnMouseLeave;
			}
			else
			{
				((Control)(object)ultraDesktopAlertWindow).MouseEnter += OnMouseEnter;
				((Control)(object)ultraDesktopAlertWindow).MouseLeave += OnMouseLeave;
			}
		}

		private void OnMouseEnter(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			animationSequence = AnimationSequence.ImmediateShow;
			InitializeSequenceTimer(start: false);
			Start(animationSequence, mouseEnter: true);
		}

		private void OnMouseLeave(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			float opacityResolved = windowInfo.DesktopAlertPropertyCache.OpacityResolved;
			if (opacityResolved < 1f)
			{
				UltraDesktopAlertWindow ultraDesktopAlertWindow = windowInfo.UltraDesktopAlertWindow;
				Rectangle newBounds = new Rectangle(-1, -1, -1, -1);
				ultraDesktopAlertWindow.PerformAnimation(opacityResolved, newBounds);
			}
			if (windowInfo.AutoCloseResolved && !InitializeAutoCloseTimer(start: true))
			{
				_ = windowInfo.DesktopAlert;
				AnimationStyle animationStyleAutoCloseResolved = windowInfo.DesktopAlertPropertyCache.AnimationStyleAutoCloseResolved;
				windowInfo.BeforeCloseHelper(DesktopAlertCloseReason.AutoCloseTimerElapsed);
			}
		}

		private void ResolveFormattedTextAppearancePhase(DesktopAlertLinkType linkType, FormattedTextLinkStatus linkStatus, AppearanceResolutionPhase phase, AppStylingInfo appStylingInfo, ref AppearanceData appData, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps, FormattedTextUIState state, bool provideUltimateDefaults)
		{
			//IL_0026: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			//IL_0125: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			bool flag = linkType == DesktopAlertLinkType.Caption;

			AppearanceData val = default(AppearanceData);
			AppearanceBase val2 = null;
			switch (phase)
			{
			case AppearanceResolutionPhase.HotTracked:
				if (!flag4)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (appStylingBefore)
				{
					ApplicationStylingUtilities.ResolveAppearance(uIRole, state2, ref appData, ref requestedProps);
				}
				if (useControlInfo)
				{
					if (flag && desktopAlert.HasCaptionHotTrackAppearance)

					}
					else if (flag2 && desktopAlert.HasTextHotTrackAppearance)
					{

					}
					else if (flag3 && desktopAlert.HasFooterTextHotTrackAppearance)

				{
					ProvideStateSpecificLinkAppearanceUltimateDefaults(linkType, linkStatus, FormattedTextUIState.HotTracked, ref appData, ref requestedProps);
				}
				break;
			case AppearanceResolutionPhase.Normal:
				if (appStylingBefore)
				{
					ApplicationStylingUtilities.ResolveAppearance(uIRole, state2, ref appData, ref requestedProps);
				}
				if (useControlInfo)
				{
					if (flag && desktopAlert.HasCaptionAppearance)
					{
						val2 = desktopAlert.CaptionAppearance;
					}
					else if (flag2 && desktopAlert.HasTextAppearance)
					{

					}
					else if (flag3 && desktopAlert.HasFooterTextAppearance)
					{
						val2 = desktopAlert.FooterTextAppearance;
					}

					}

				}
				break;
			case AppearanceResolutionPhase.Final:
			{

				{

				}
				bool flag5 = linkStatus == FormattedTextLinkStatus.HasLink;
				((AppearanceData)(ref val)).BackColor = Color.Transparent;
				((AppearanceData)(ref val)).BackColor2 = Color.Transparent;

				}
				else if (flag3)
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref val)).FontData.Bold = (DefaultableBoolean)2;
					((AppearanceData)(ref val)).TextHAlign = (HAlign)3;
					((AppearanceData)(ref val)).TextVAlign = (VAlign)3;
				}
				if (!flag5)
				{

					}
					else

					}
				}

				}
				else

				}

			}
		}

	[Serializable]
	public class DesktopAlertButtonsModifiableCollectionBase : DesktopAlertButtonsCollectionBase, IList, ICollection, IEnumerable
	{
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public override bool IsReadOnly => false;

		object IList.this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return base.GetItem(index);
			}
			set
			{
				UltraDesktopAlertButton button = value as UltraDesktopAlertButton;
				InternalRemoveAt(index);
				InsertHelper(index, button, notify: true);
			}
		}

		internal DesktopAlertButtonsModifiableCollectionBase(UltraDesktopAlert owningDesktopAlert, bool isMainCollection)
			: base(owningDesktopAlert, isMainCollection)
		{
		}

		public int Add(UltraDesktopAlertButton button)
		{
			InsertHelper(Count, button, notify: true);
			return Count - 1;
		}

		public void AddRange(UltraDesktopAlertButton[] buttons)
		{
			if (buttons == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("buttons");
			}
			int count = Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < buttons.Length; i++)
			{
				UltraDesktopAlertButton button = buttons[i];
				InsertHelper(count + i, button, notify: false);
			}
			NotifyPropChange(DesktopAlertPropertyIds.AlertButtonAdded);
		}

		public void Insert(int index, UltraDesktopAlertButton button)
		{
			InsertHelper(index, button, notify: true);
		}

		public void Remove(UltraDesktopAlertButton button)
		{
			RemoveHelper(button, notify: true);
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			RemoveHelper(base[index], notify: true);
		}

		public virtual void Clear()
		{
			for (int num = Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				RemoveHelper(base[num], notify: false);
			}
			if (isMainCollection)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(DesktopAlertPropertyIds.AlertButtonsCleared);
			}
		}

		internal void InsertHelper(int index, UltraDesktopAlertButton button, bool notify)
		{
			DesktopAlertButtonsCollection collection = button.Collection;
			if (isMainCollection)
			{
				if (collection == this)
				{
					throw new Exception(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DesktopAlertButtonsModifiableCollectionBase_Exception_CannotAddButtonToSameCollection"));
				}
				if (collection != null)
				{
					throw new Exception(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DesktopAlertButtonsModifiableCollectionBase_Exception_CannotAddButtonToDifferentCollection"));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (collection == null)
				{
					throw new Exception(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DesktopAlertVisibleButtonsCollection_Exception_ButtonDoesNotBelongToCollection"));
				}
				if (Contains(button))
				{
					throw new Exception(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DesktopAlertButtonsModifiableCollectionBase_Exception_CannotAddButtonToSameCollection"));
				}
			}
			InternalInsert(index, button);
			OnCollectionModified();
			if (isMainCollection)
			{
				button.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				button.InitCollection(this as DesktopAlertButtonsCollection);
				if (notify)
				{
					NotifyPropChange(DesktopAlertPropertyIds.AlertButtonAdded);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void RemoveHelper(UltraDesktopAlertButton button, bool notify)
		{
			if (isMainCollection)
			{
				button.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			InternalRemove(button);
			button.InitCollection(null);
			OnCollectionModified();
			if (notify && isMainCollection)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(DesktopAlertPropertyIds.AlertButtonRemoved);
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnCollectionModified()
		{
			BumpCollectionVersion();
		}

		int IList.Add(object value)
		{
			if (!(value is UltraDesktopAlertButton button))
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("value");
			}
			return Add(button);
		}

		void IList.Insert(int index, object value)
		{
			if (!(value is UltraDesktopAlertButton button))
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("value");
			}
			Insert(index, button);
		}

		void IList.Remove(object value)
		{
			if (!(value is UltraDesktopAlertButton button))
			{

	[Serializable]
	public class DesktopAlertVisibleButtonsCollection : DesktopAlertButtonsModifiableCollectionBase
	{
		private static readonly int defaultCollectionVersion;

		private UltraDesktopAlertShowWindowInfo showWindowInfo;

		private UltraDesktopAlert desktopAlert;

		public override UltraDesktopAlert DesktopAlert => showWindowInfo.DesktopAlert;

		public UltraDesktopAlertShowWindowInfo ShowWindowInfo => showWindowInfo;

		public override int Count
		{
			get
			{
				VerifyCollection();
				return base.Count;
			}
		}

		public new UltraDesktopAlertButton this[string key]
		{
			get
			{
				VerifyCollection();
				return base.GetItem(key) as UltraDesktopAlertButton;
			}
		}

		public new UltraDesktopAlertButton this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				VerifyCollection();
				return base.GetItem(index) as UltraDesktopAlertButton;
			}
		}

		internal DesktopAlertVisibleButtonsCollection(UltraDesktopAlertShowWindowInfo showWindowInfo)
			: base(null, isMainCollection: false)
		{
			if (showWindowInfo == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("showWindowInfo");
			}
			this.showWindowInfo = showWindowInfo;
			collectionVersion = 0;
		}

		public override void Clear()
		{
			base.Clear();
			OnCollectionModified();
		}

		protected override void OnCollectionModified()
		{
			base.OnCollectionModified();
			if (desktopAlert != null)
			{
				throw new Exception(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DesktopAlertVisibleButtonsCollection_Exception_CannotModifyCollection"));
			}
		}

		internal void VerifyCollection()
		{
			if (desktopAlert == null)
			{
				desktopAlert = showWindowInfo.DesktopAlert;
			}
			if (desktopAlert == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (desktopAlert != null && collectionVersion == defaultCollectionVersion)
			{
				InitializeFrom(desktopAlert, validate: false);
			}
			else
			{
				if (desktopAlert == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				DesktopAlertButtonsCollection alertButtons = desktopAlert.AlertButtons;
				if (collectionVersion == alertButtons.CollectionVersion)
				{
					return;
				}
				ArrayList arrayList = List;
				int count = arrayList.Count;
				for (int num = count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					UltraDesktopAlertButton ultraDesktopAlertButton = arrayList[num] as UltraDesktopAlertButton;
					if (!alertButtons.Contains(ultraDesktopAlertButton) && !ultraDesktopAlertButton.Visible)
					{
						arrayList.Remove(ultraDesktopAlertButton);
					}
				}
				collectionVersion = alertButtons.CollectionVersion;
			}
		}

		public void InitializeFrom(UltraDesktopAlert desktopAlert)
		{
			InitializeFrom(desktopAlert, validate: true);
		}

		private void InitializeFrom(UltraDesktopAlert desktopAlert, bool validate)
		{
			if (desktopAlert == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("desktopAlert");
			}
			if (validate && this.desktopAlert != null)
			{
				throw new Exception(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DesktopAlertVisibleButtonsCollection_Exception_CannotModifyCollection"));
			}
			List.Clear();
			DesktopAlertVisibleButtonsNonModifiableCollection visibleAlertButtons = desktopAlert.VisibleAlertButtons;
			for (int i = 0; i < visibleAlertButtons.Count; i++)
			{
				UltraDesktopAlertButton value = visibleAlertButtons[i];
				List.Add(value);
			}
			collectionVersion = visibleAlertButtons.CollectionVersion;
		}
	}
	internal class DesktopAlertVisibleButtonsNonModifiableCollection : DesktopAlertButtonsCollectionBase
	{
		public override int Count
		{
			get
			{
				VerifyCollection();
				return base.Count;
			}
		}

		public new UltraDesktopAlertButton this[string key]
		{
			get
			{
				VerifyCollection();
				return base.GetItem(key) as UltraDesktopAlertButton;
			}
		}

		public new UltraDesktopAlertButton this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				VerifyCollection();
				return base.GetItem(index) as UltraDesktopAlertButton;
			}
		}

		internal DesktopAlertVisibleButtonsNonModifiableCollection(UltraDesktopAlert desktopAlert)
			: base(desktopAlert, isMainCollection: false)
		{
			collectionVersion = 0;
		}

		internal void VerifyCollection()
		{
			UltraDesktopAlert desktopAlert = DesktopAlert;
			DesktopAlertButtonsCollection alertButtons = desktopAlert.AlertButtons;
			if (collectionVersion == alertButtons.CollectionVersion)
			{
				return;
			}
			ArrayList arrayList = List;
			arrayList.Clear();
			int count = alertButtons.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				UltraDesktopAlertButton ultraDesktopAlertButton = alertButtons[i];
				if (ultraDesktopAlertButton.Visible)
				{
					arrayList.Add(ultraDesktopAlertButton);
				}
			}
			collectionVersion = alertButtons.CollectionVersion;
		}
	}
