	public class UltraDesktopAlertEventManager : EventManagerBase
	{
		internal static readonly object AlertButtonClicked_Event = new object();

		internal static readonly object DesktopAlertClosed_Event = new object();

		internal static readonly object DesktopAlertClosing_Event = new object();

		internal static readonly object DesktopAlertLinkClicked_Event = new object();

		internal static readonly object DropDownButtonClicked_Event = new object();

		private UltraDesktopAlert desktopAlert;

		internal UltraDesktopAlertEventManager(UltraDesktopAlert desktopAlert)
			: base(6)
		{
			this.desktopAlert = desktopAlert;
		}

		internal void FireEvent(DesktopAlertEventIds eventId, EventArgs e)
		{
			switch (eventId)
			{
			case DesktopAlertEventIds.AlertButtonClicked:
				desktopAlert.OnAlertButtonClicked(e as AlertButtonClickedEventArgs);
				break;
			case DesktopAlertEventIds.DesktopAlertClosed:
				desktopAlert.OnDesktopAlertClosed(e as DesktopAlertClosedEventArgs);
				break;
			case DesktopAlertEventIds.DesktopAlertClosing:
				desktopAlert.OnDesktopAlertClosing(e as DesktopAlertClosingEventArgs);
				break;
			case DesktopAlertEventIds.DesktopAlertLinkClicked:
				desktopAlert.OnDesktopAlertLinkClicked(e as DesktopAlertLinkClickedEventArgs);
				break;
			case DesktopAlertEventIds.DropDownButtonClicked:
				desktopAlert.OnDropDownButtonClicked(e as DropDownButtonClickedEventArgs);
				break;
			}
		}
	}
	public class FooterAreaUIElement : DesktopAlertUIElementBase
	{
		public FooterAreaUIElement(UIElement parentElement)
			: base(parentElement)
		{
		}

		protected override void InitAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			if (((ulong)requestedProps & 1uL) == 1)
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor = Color.Transparent;
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackGradientStyle = (GradientStyle)1;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFEuL);
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFEFFFFFFFuL);
			}
		}

		protected override void PositionChildElements()
		{
			//IL_0175: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_017e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0197: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_019e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			UIElementsCollection childElements = ((UIElement)this).ChildElements;
			((UIElement)this).childElementsCollection = null;
			UltraDesktopAlertWindowInfo windowInfo = base.WindowInfo;
			if (windowInfo == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraDesktopAlert desktopAlert = base.DesktopAlert;
			Rectangle rectInsideBorders = ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders;
			DesktopAlertMetricsBase metrics = windowInfo.Metrics;
			Margins margins = metrics.FooterAreaMargins;
			AlertButtonAreaUIElement alertButtonAreaUIElement = UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)childElements, typeof(AlertButtonAreaUIElement), true) as AlertButtonAreaUIElement;
			if (alertButtonAreaUIElement == null)
			{
				alertButtonAreaUIElement = new AlertButtonAreaUIElement((UIElement)(object)this);
			}
			Border3DSide border3DSide = Border3DSide.All;
			border3DSide &= ~Border3DSide.Right;
			Rectangle rect = rectInsideBorders;
			DesktopAlertUtilities.DeflateRect(ref rect, margins, border3DSide);
			rect.Size = metrics.AlertButtonAreaSize;
			rect.Y = rectInsideBorders.Top + rectInsideBorders.Height / 2 - metrics.AlertButtonAreaSize.Height / 2;
			((UIElement)alertButtonAreaUIElement).Rect = rect;
			((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)alertButtonAreaUIElement);
			string footerText = windowInfo.FooterText;
			if (footerText != null && footerText.Length > 0)
			{
				LinkUIElement linkUIElement = UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)childElements, typeof(LinkUIElement), true) as LinkUIElement;
				if (linkUIElement == null)
				{
					linkUIElement = new LinkUIElement((UIElement)(object)this, DesktopAlertLinkType.Footer);
				}
				else
				{
					linkUIElement.Initialize(DesktopAlertLinkType.Footer);
				}
				Size linkSize = Size.Empty;
				metrics.GetFooterAreaHeight(out margins, out linkSize);
				Rectangle rect2 = rectInsideBorders;
				rect2.X = rect.Right;
				rect2.Width = rectInsideBorders.Right - rect2.X;
				border3DSide = Border3DSide.All;
				border3DSide &= ~Border3DSide.Left;
				DesktopAlertUtilities.DeflateRect(ref rect2, margins, border3DSide);
				Rectangle rectToAdjust = rect2;
				rectToAdjust.Size = linkSize;
				AppearanceData appData = default(AppearanceData);
				AppearancePropFlags requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)48;
				desktopAlert.AppearanceManager.ResolveFormattedTextAppearance(DesktopAlertLinkType.Footer, ref appData, ref requestedProps, FormattedTextUIState.Normal);
				DesktopAlertUtilities.AdjustRect(ref rectToAdjust, rect2, ((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).TextHAlign, ((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).TextVAlign);
				((UIElement)linkUIElement).Rect = rectToAdjust;
				((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)linkUIElement);
			}
		}
	}
	public class LinkUIElement : FormattedTextUIElement, IToolTipItem
	{
		private DesktopAlertLinkType linkType;

		private static LinkUIElement hotTrackingElement;

		private FormattedTextLinkStatus linkStatus;

		public DesktopAlertLinkType LinkType => linkType;

		private LinkUIElement AssociatedLinkElement
		{
			get
			{
				UltraDesktopAlert desktopAlert = DesktopAlert;
				if (desktopAlert == null || !IsOffice2007Style)
				{
					return null;
				}
				DesktopAlertLinkType desktopAlertLinkType = DesktopAlertLinkType.None;
				switch (linkType)
				{
				case DesktopAlertLinkType.Caption:
					desktopAlertLinkType = DesktopAlertLinkType.Text;
					break;
				case DesktopAlertLinkType.Text:
					desktopAlertLinkType = DesktopAlertLinkType.Caption;
					break;
				}
				UltraDesktopAlertWindowUIElement ultraDesktopAlertWindowUIElement = ((UIElement)this).ControlElement as UltraDesktopAlertWindowUIElement;
				if (desktopAlertLinkType == DesktopAlertLinkType.None || ultraDesktopAlertWindowUIElement == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return ultraDesktopAlertWindowUIElement.GetLinkElement(desktopAlertLinkType);
			}
		}

		public bool IsHotTracking
		{
			get
			{
				if (hotTrackingElement == this)
				{
					return true;
				}
				LinkUIElement associatedLinkElement = AssociatedLinkElement;
				if (associatedLinkElement != null && hotTrackingElement == associatedLinkElement)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public UltraDesktopAlert DesktopAlert => DesktopAlertControl?.DesktopAlert;

		internal UltraDesktopAlertWindow DesktopAlertControl => ((UIElement)this).Control as UltraDesktopAlertWindow;

		public UltraDesktopAlertWindowInfo WindowInfo => DesktopAlertControl?.WindowInfo;

		public override IToolTipItem ToolTipItem
		{
			get
			{
				return (IToolTipItem)(object)this;
			}
			set
			{
			}
		}

		public override UIRole UIRole
		{
			get
			{
				UltraDesktopAlert desktopAlert = DesktopAlert;
				UltraDesktopAlertRole ultraDesktopAlertRole = ((desktopAlert != null) ? (((UltraStylableComponent)desktopAlert).ComponentRole as UltraDesktopAlertRole) : null);
				UltraDesktopAlertApplicationStylingRole value = UltraDesktopAlertRole.ToRoleId(LinkType);
				if (ultraDesktopAlertRole == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return ((ComponentRole)ultraDesktopAlertRole).GetRole(UltraDesktopAlertRoleInfo.ToInteger(value));
			}
		}

		internal bool IsOffice2007Style => (WindowInfo?.DesktopAlertPropertyCache)?.IsOffice2007Style ?? true;

		public LinkUIElement(UIElement parentElement, DesktopAlertLinkType linkType)
			: base(parentElement)
		{
			Initialize(linkType);
		}

		public void Initialize(DesktopAlertLinkType linkType)
		{
			//IL_006a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0070: Expected O, but got Unknown
			this.linkType = linkType;
			((UIElement)this).PrimaryContext = this.linkType;
			string text = string.Empty;
			UltraDesktopAlertWindowInfo windowInfo = WindowInfo;
			switch (this.linkType)
			{
			case DesktopAlertLinkType.Caption:
				text = windowInfo.CaptionResolved;
				break;
			case DesktopAlertLinkType.Text:
				text = windowInfo.TextResolved;
				break;
			case DesktopAlertLinkType.Footer:
				text = windowInfo.FooterTextResolved;
				break;
			}
			linkStatus = FormattedTextLinkStatus.NoLink;
			_ = text.Length;
			try
			{
				ParsedFormattedTextValue val = (((FormattedTextUIElement)this).Value = new ParsedFormattedTextValue(text));
				linkStatus = (val.IsLink ? FormattedTextLinkStatus.IsLink : ((!val.IsLink && val.ContainsLink) ? FormattedTextLinkStatus.HasLink : FormattedTextLinkStatus.NoLink));
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		protected override void InitAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			InitAppearanceHelper(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, string.Empty);
			((FormattedTextUIElement)this).InitAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFC1FFFF7uL);
		}

		protected override void InitCustomAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps, string customArea)
		{
			InitAppearanceHelper(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, customArea);
			((FormattedTextUIElement)this).InitCustomAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, customArea);
		}

		private void InitAppearanceHelper(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps, string customArea)
		{
			UltraDesktopAlert desktopAlert = DesktopAlert;
			UltraDesktopAlertWindow desktopAlertControl = DesktopAlertControl;
			if (desktopAlert != null && desktopAlertControl != null)
			{
				FormattedTextUIState state = (IsHotTracking ? FormattedTextUIState.HotTracked : FormattedTextUIState.Normal);
				desktopAlert.AppearanceManager.ResolveFormattedTextAppearance(LinkType, linkStatus, ref appearance, ref requestedProps, state);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter()
		{
			hotTrackingElement = this;
			((UIElement)this).OnMouseEnter();
			((UIElement)this).Invalidate();
			LinkUIElement associatedLinkElement = AssociatedLinkElement;
			if (associatedLinkElement != null)
			{
				((UIElement)associatedLinkElement).Invalidate();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave()
		{
			hotTrackingElement = null;
			((FormattedTextUIElement)this).OnMouseLeave();
			((UIElement)this).Invalidate();
			LinkUIElement associatedLinkElement = AssociatedLinkElement;
			if (associatedLinkElement != null)
			{
				((UIElement)associatedLinkElement).Invalidate();
			}
		}

		public override object GetContext(Type type, bool checkParentElementContexts)
		{
			if (type == typeof(DesktopAlertLinkType))
			{
				return LinkType;
			}
			return ((UIElement)this).GetContext(type, checkParentElementContexts);
		}

		protected override void OnLinkClicked(LinkClickedEventArgs e)
		{
			DesktopAlert?.OnLinkClick(LinkType, WindowInfo, e);
			((FormattedTextUIElement)this).OnLinkClicked(e);
		}

		ToolTipInfo IToolTipItem.GetToolTipInfo(Point mousePosition, UIElement element, UIElement previousToolTipElement, ToolTipInfo toolTipInfo)
		{
			//IL_0098: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			bool isOffice2007Style = IsOffice2007Style;
			string toolTipText = string.Empty;
			string arg = (isOffice2007Style ? DesktopAlertStyle.Office2007.ToString() : DesktopAlertStyle.WindowsLiveMessenger.ToString());
			switch (linkType)
			{
			case DesktopAlertLinkType.Caption:
				toolTipText = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString($"DesktopAlertLinkUIElement_Caption_ToolTipText_{arg}");
				break;
			case DesktopAlertLinkType.Text:
				toolTipText = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString($"DesktopAlertLinkUIElement_Text_ToolTipText_{arg}");
				break;
			case DesktopAlertLinkType.Footer:
				toolTipText = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString($"DesktopAlertLinkUIElement_Footer_ToolTipText_{arg}");
				break;
			}
			((ToolTipInfo)(ref toolTipInfo)).ToolTipText = toolTipText;
			((ToolTipInfo)(ref toolTipInfo)).DisplayStyle = (ToolTipDisplayStyle)(IsOffice2007Style ? 3 : 0);
			return toolTipInfo;
		}

	internal class DesktopAlertImageManager : IDisposable
	{
		private static readonly string imageFolderName = "UltraDesktopAlert.Icons";

		private Type owningType;

		private Bitmap[] bitmaps = new Bitmap[ImageCount];

		private static int ImageCount => Enum.GetNames(typeof(ImageName)).Length;

		internal DesktopAlertImageManager(Type owningType)
		{
			this.owningType = owningType;
		}

		private Icon GetIcon(ImageName iconName)
		{
			string name = $"{imageFolderName}.{iconName.ToString()}.ICO";
			Stream manifestResourceStream = owningType.Module.Assembly.GetManifestResourceStream(owningType, name);
			Icon result = null;
			if (manifestResourceStream != null)
			{
				result = new Icon(manifestResourceStream);
				manifestResourceStream.Close();
			}
			return result;
		}

		public Bitmap GetBitmap(ImageName imageName)
		{
			if (bitmaps[(int)imageName] == null)
			{
				if (imageName == ImageName.GripIndicator || imageName == ImageName.CloseButton_Office2007 || imageName == ImageName.CloseButton_WindowsLiveMessenger || imageName == ImageName.DropDownButton || imageName == ImageName.PinButton || imageName == ImageName.UnpinButton)
				{
					string name = $"{imageFolderName}.{imageName.ToString()}.bmp";
					Stream manifestResourceStream = owningType.Module.Assembly.GetManifestResourceStream(owningType, name);
					bitmaps[(int)imageName] = Image.FromStream(manifestResourceStream) as Bitmap;
				}
				else
				{
					Icon icon = GetIcon(imageName);
					if (icon != null)
					{
						bitmaps[(int)imageName] = DrawUtility.IconToBitmap(icon);
						icon.Dispose();
					}
				}
			}
			return bitmaps[(int)imageName];
		}

		void IDisposable.Dispose()
		{
			int imageCount = ImageCount;
			for (int i = 0; i < imageCount; i++)
			{
				if (bitmaps[i] != null)
				{
					bitmaps[i].Dispose();
					bitmaps[i] = null;
				}
			}
		}
	}

	}

			Size size = image.Size;
			Size buttonImageSizeResolved = desktopAlert.ButtonImageSizeResolved;
			size.Width = Math.Min(size.Width, buttonImageSizeResolved.Width);
			size.Height = Math.Min(size.Height, buttonImageSizeResolved.Height);
			desktopAlertImageUIElementBase = UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)childElements, typeof(DesktopAlertImageUIElementBase), true) as DesktopAlertImageUIElementBase;

		protected override void OnClick()
		{
			UltraDesktopAlertWindowInfo windowInfo = base.WindowInfo;
			if (windowInfo != null)
			{
				windowInfo.SetPinnedHelper(!windowInfo.Pinned, updateUI: false, verifyAutoCloseTimer: false);
				((UIElement)this).DirtyChildElements(true);
			}
			base.OnClick();
		}

			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Behavior")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("UltraDesktopAlert_P_FixedSize")]
		public Size FixedSize
		{
			get
			{
				return fixedSize;
			}
			set
			{
				if (fixedSize != value)
				{
					if (value.Width < 0 || value.Height < 0)
					{
						throw new Exception(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("UltraDesktopAlert_Exception_NegativeSize", "FixedSize"));
					}
					fixedSize = value;
					((UltraComponentBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)DesktopAlertPropertyIds.FixedSize);
				}
			}
		}

		internal Size FixedSizeResolved
		{
			get
			{
				Size size = FixedSize;
				Size minimumWindowSize = DesktopAlertMetricsBase.minimumWindowSize;
				int width = ((size.Width != 0) ? Math.Max(size.Width, minimumWindowSize.Width) : 0);
				int height = ((size.Height != 0) ? Math.Max(size.Height, minimumWindowSize.Height) : 0);
				return new Size(width, height);
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("UltraDesktopAlert_P_MainImageAreaBorderColor")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Appearance")]
		public Color MainImageAreaBorderColor
		{
			get
			{
				return mainImageAreaBorderColor;
			}
			set
			{
				if (mainImageAreaBorderColor != value)
				{
					mainImageAreaBorderColor = value;
					((UltraComponentBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)DesktopAlertPropertyIds.MainImageAreaBorderColor);
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public Color MainImageAreaBorderColorResolved
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0063: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_006b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				Color result = MainImageAreaBorderColor;
				if (!result.IsEmpty)
				{
					return result;
				}
				Color color = MainImageAreaBorderColor;
				UltraDesktopAlertRole ultraDesktopAlertRole = ((UltraStylableComponent)this).ComponentRole as UltraDesktopAlertRole;
				object propertyValue = ultraDesktopAlertRole.GetPropertyValue(UltraDesktopAlertApplicationStylingCustomProperty.MainImageAreaBorderColor, color);
				if (propertyValue is Color { IsEmpty: false })
				{
					return (Color)propertyValue;
				}
				if (IsOffice2007Style)
				{
					return Color.Transparent;
				}
				AppearanceData appData = default(AppearanceData);
				AppearancePropFlags requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)4;
				AppearanceManager.ResolveWindowAppearance(DesktopAlertAppearanceManager.ResolveWindowAppearanceContext.ControlBorders, ref appData, ref requestedProps);
				if (!((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).BorderColor.IsEmpty)
				{
					return ((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).BorderColor;
				}
				return DesktopAlertAppearanceManager.WindowsLiveMessengerColors.ControlOuterBorderColor;
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public DesktopAlertStyle StyleResolved
		{
			get
			{
				DesktopAlertStyle desktopAlertStyle = Style;
				UltraDesktopAlertRole ultraDesktopAlertRole = ((UltraStylableComponent)this).ComponentRole as UltraDesktopAlertRole;
				object propertyValue = ultraDesktopAlertRole.GetPropertyValue(UltraDesktopAlertApplicationStylingCustomProperty.Style, desktopAlertStyle);
				if (propertyValue is DesktopAlertStyle)
				{
					return (DesktopAlertStyle)propertyValue;
				}
				if (desktopAlertStyle != DesktopAlertStyle.WindowsLiveMessenger)
				{
					return DesktopAlertStyle.Office2007;
				}
				return DesktopAlertStyle.WindowsLiveMessenger;
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public float OpacityResolved
		{
			get
			{
				float num = Opacity;
				if (num != defaultOpacity)
				{
					return num;
				}
				if (!IsOffice2007Style)
				{
					return 1f;
				}
				return 0.8f;
			}
		}

		private AppearanceBase GetAppearance(int index)
		{
			//IL_0037: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (index < 0 || index >= APPEARANCE_PROPERTY_COUNT)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (appearanceHolder == null)
			{
				appearanceHolder = (AppearanceHolder[])(object)new AppearanceHolder[APPEARANCE_PROPERTY_COUNT];
			}
			if (appearanceHolder[index] == null)
			{
				appearanceHolder[index] = new AppearanceHolder();
				appearanceHolder[index].SubObjectPropChanged += SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (appearanceHolder[index].Collection == null)
			{
				appearanceHolder[index].Collection = Appearances;
			}
			return appearanceHolder[index].Appearance;
		}

		private bool SetAppearance(int index, AppearanceBase value)
		{
			//IL_0037: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (index < 0 || index >= APPEARANCE_PROPERTY_COUNT)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (appearanceHolder == null)
			{
				appearanceHolder = (AppearanceHolder[])(object)new AppearanceHolder[APPEARANCE_PROPERTY_COUNT];
			}
			if (appearanceHolder[index] == null)
			{
				appearanceHolder[index] = new AppearanceHolder();
				appearanceHolder[index].SubObjectPropChanged += SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (appearanceHolder[index].Collection == null)
			{
				appearanceHolder[index].Collection = Appearances;
			}
			if (value != appearanceHolder[index].Appearance)
			{
				appearanceHolder[index].Appearance = value;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool GetHasAppearance(int index)
		{
			if (index < 0 || index >= APPEARANCE_PROPERTY_COUNT)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (appearanceHolder != null && appearanceHolder[index] != null)
			{
				return appearanceHolder[index].HasAppearance;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool GetShouldSerializeAppearance(int index)
		{
			if (index < 0 || index >= APPEARANCE_PROPERTY_COUNT)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (GetHasAppearance(index))
			{
				return appearanceHolder[index].ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetAppearance(int index)
		{
			if (index >= 0 && index < APPEARANCE_PROPERTY_COUNT && GetHasAppearance(index))
			{
				appearanceHolder[index].Reset();
			}
		}

		private void DisposeAppearances()
		{
			if (appearanceHolder == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < APPEARANCE_PROPERTY_COUNT; i++)
			{
				AppearanceHolder val = appearanceHolder[i];
				if (val != null)
				{
					val.SubObjectPropChanged -= SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					if (val.HasAppearance)
					{
						((DisposableObject)(object)val.Appearance).Dispose();
					}
					appearanceHolder[i] = null;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				if (windowInfoManager != null)
				{
					windowInfoManager.Dispose();
					windowInfoManager = null;
				}
				DisposeAppearances();
				if (imageManager != null)
				{
					IDisposable disposable = imageManager;
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
				if (alertButtons != null)
				{
					alertButtons.SubObjectPropChanged -= SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					alertButtons.Dispose();
					alertButtons = null;
				}
			}
			((UltraStylableComponent)this).Dispose(disposing);
		}

		public UltraDesktopAlertWindowInfo Show(UltraDesktopAlertShowWindowInfo windowInfo)
		{
			if (windowInfo == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("windowInfo");
			}
			string key = windowInfo.Key;
			if (key != null && key.Length > 0)
			{
				DesktopAlertWindowInfoManager desktopAlertWindowInfoManager = WindowInfoManager;
				desktopAlertWindowInfoManager.VerifyKeyDoesNotExist(key);
			}
			UltraDesktopAlertWindowInfo ultraDesktopAlertWindowInfo = new UltraDesktopAlertWindowInfo(this, windowInfo);
			ultraDesktopAlertWindowInfo.Show();
			return ultraDesktopAlertWindowInfo;
		}

		protected virtual void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			DesktopAlertPropertyIds desktopAlertPropertyIds = DesktopAlertPropertyIds.Undefined;
			if (appearanceHolder != null)
			{
				if (appearanceHolder[APPEARANCE_INDEX] != null && propChange.Source == appearanceHolder[APPEARANCE_INDEX].RootAppearance)
				{
					desktopAlertPropertyIds = DesktopAlertPropertyIds.Appearance;
				}
				else if (appearanceHolder[BUTTONAPPEARANCE_INDEX] != null && propChange.Source == appearanceHolder[BUTTONAPPEARANCE_INDEX].RootAppearance)
				{
					desktopAlertPropertyIds = DesktopAlertPropertyIds.ButtonAppearance;
				}
				else if (appearanceHolder[BUTTONHOTTRACKAPPEARANCE_INDEX] != null && propChange.Source == appearanceHolder[BUTTONHOTTRACKAPPEARANCE_INDEX].RootAppearance)
				{
					desktopAlertPropertyIds = DesktopAlertPropertyIds.ButtonHotTrackAppearance;
				}
				else if (appearanceHolder[BUTTONPRESSEDAPPEARANCE_INDEX] != null && propChange.Source == appearanceHolder[BUTTONPRESSEDAPPEARANCE_INDEX].RootAppearance)
				{
					desktopAlertPropertyIds = DesktopAlertPropertyIds.ButtonPressedAppearance;
				}
				else if (appearanceHolder[CAPTIONAREAAPPEARANCE_INDEX] != null && propChange.Source == appearanceHolder[CAPTIONAREAAPPEARANCE_INDEX].RootAppearance)
				{
					desktopAlertPropertyIds = DesktopAlertPropertyIds.CaptionAreaAppearance;
				}
				else if (appearanceHolder[GRIPAREAAPPEARANCE_INDEX] != null && propChange.Source == appearanceHolder[GRIPAREAAPPEARANCE_INDEX].RootAppearance)
				{
					desktopAlertPropertyIds = DesktopAlertPropertyIds.GripAreaAppearance;
				}
			}
			if (alertButtons != null && propChange.Source == alertButtons)
			{
				desktopAlertPropertyIds = (DesktopAlertPropertyIds)(object)propChange.PropId;
			}
			if (desktopAlertPropertyIds != DesktopAlertPropertyIds.Undefined)
			{
				((UltraComponentBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)desktopAlertPropertyIds, propChange);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnPropertyChanged(e.ChangeInfo);
			((UltraComponentBase)this).OnPropertyChanged(e);
		}

		internal void OnPropertyChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			PropChangeInfo propChangeInfo = propChange.FindTrigger(null);
			DesktopAlertPropertyIds desktopAlertPropertyIds = ((propChangeInfo != null) ? ((DesktopAlertPropertyIds)(object)propChangeInfo.PropId) : DesktopAlertPropertyIds.Undefined);
			DesktopAlertPropertyIds desktopAlertPropertyIds2 = ((propChange != null) ? ((DesktopAlertPropertyIds)(object)propChange.PropId) : DesktopAlertPropertyIds.Undefined);
			if (desktopAlertPropertyIds != DesktopAlertPropertyIds.Undefined)
			{
				switch (desktopAlertPropertyIds)
				{
				case DesktopAlertPropertyIds.Visible:
				case DesktopAlertPropertyIds.AlertButtonAdded:
				case DesktopAlertPropertyIds.AlertButtonRemoved:
				case DesktopAlertPropertyIds.AlertButtonsCleared:
					AlertButtons.BumpCollectionVersion();
					break;
				case DesktopAlertPropertyIds.Style:
				case DesktopAlertPropertyIds.MainImageAreaBorderColor:
					((UltraStylableComponent)this).ComponentRole.ClearCachedPropertyValues();
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void OnButtonClick(DesktopAlertButtonType buttonType, UltraDesktopAlertButton button, UltraDesktopAlertWindowInfo windowInfo, Rectangle clientRect)
		{
			bool flag = true;
			DesktopAlertCloseReason closeReason = DesktopAlertCloseReason.Undefined;
			switch (buttonType)
			{
			case DesktopAlertButtonType.AlertButton:
			{
				AlertButtonClickedEventArgs e2 = new AlertButtonClickedEventArgs(button, windowInfo, closeWindow: true);
				EventManager.FireEvent(DesktopAlertEventIds.AlertButtonClicked, e2);
				closeReason = DesktopAlertCloseReason.AlertButtonClicked;
				flag = e2.CloseWindow;
				break;
			}
			case DesktopAlertButtonType.CloseButton:
				closeReason = DesktopAlertCloseReason.CloseButtonClicked;
				flag = true;
				break;
			case DesktopAlertButtonType.DropDownButton:
			{
				Control desktopAlertWindow = windowInfo.DesktopAlertWindow;
				Rectangle buttonScreenRect = desktopAlertWindow.RectangleToScreen(clientRect);
				DropDownButtonClickedEventArgs e = new DropDownButtonClickedEventArgs(windowInfo, buttonScreenRect);
				EventManager.FireEvent(DesktopAlertEventIds.DropDownButtonClicked, e);
				flag = false;
				break;
			}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				windowInfo.BeforeCloseHelper(closeReason);
			}
		}

		internal void OnLinkClick(DesktopAlertLinkType linkType, UltraDesktopAlertWindowInfo windowInfo, LinkClickedEventArgs linkClickedArgs)
		{
			DesktopAlertLinkClickedEventArgs e = new DesktopAlertLinkClickedEventArgs(windowInfo, linkClickedArgs, linkType, closeWindow: true);
			EventManager.FireEvent(DesktopAlertEventIds.DesktopAlertLinkClicked, e);
			if (e.CloseWindow)
			{
				windowInfo.BeforeCloseHelper(DesktopAlertCloseReason.LinkClicked);
			}
		}

		public static ParsedFormattedTextValue ParsedFormattedText(string text, out Exception exception)
		{
			return ParsedFormattedTextValue.Parse((object)text, (ValueType)0, ref exception);
		}

		internal static void VerifyFormattedText(ref string text)
		{
			Exception exception = null;
			ParsedFormattedTextValue val = ParsedFormattedText(text, out exception);
			if (val == null)
			{
				val = ParsedFormattedTextValue.Parse((object)text, (ValueType)1, ref exception);
				text = ((val != null) ? ((object)val).ToString() : string.Empty);
			}
		}

	[TypeConverter(typeof(UltraDesktopAlertButtonTypeConverter))]

		public sealed class UltraDesktopAlertButtonTypeConverter : TypeConverter
		{
			public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
			}

			public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_13"));
				}
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor) && value is UltraDesktopAlertButton)
				{
					ConstructorInfo constructor = value.GetType().GetConstructor(new Type[0]);
					if (constructor != null)
					{
						return new InstanceDescriptor(constructor, new object[0], isComplete: false);
					}
				}
				return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
			}
		}

				if (appearanceHolder == null)
				{
					appearanceHolder = new AppearanceHolder();
					appearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
				if (appearanceHolder.Collection == null && DesktopAlert != null)
				{
					appearanceHolder.Collection = DesktopAlert.Appearances;
				}
				return appearanceHolder.Appearance;
			}
			set
			{
				//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0013: Expected O, but got Unknown
				if (appearanceHolder == null)
				{
					appearanceHolder = new AppearanceHolder();
					appearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
				if (appearanceHolder.Collection == null && DesktopAlert != null)
				{
					appearanceHolder.Collection = DesktopAlert.Appearances;
				}
				if (value != appearanceHolder.Appearance)
				{
					appearanceHolder.Appearance = value;
					NotifyPropChange(DesktopAlertPropertyIds.Appearance);
				}
			}

				return toolTipText.Length > 0;

			return false;

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			DesktopAlertPropertyIds desktopAlertPropertyIds = DesktopAlertPropertyIds.Undefined;
			if (propChange.Source is AppearanceBase && HasAppearance && propChange.Source == appearanceHolder.RootAppearance)
			{
				desktopAlertPropertyIds = DesktopAlertPropertyIds.Appearance;
			}
			else if (propChange.PropId is DesktopAlertPropertyIds)
			{
				desktopAlertPropertyIds = (DesktopAlertPropertyIds)(object)propChange.PropId;
			}
			if (desktopAlertPropertyIds != DesktopAlertPropertyIds.Undefined)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(desktopAlertPropertyIds, propChange);
			}
			base.OnSubObjectPropChanged(propChange);
		}

		public bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeAppearance() && !ShouldSerializeEnabled() && !ShouldSerializeKey() && !ShouldSerializeTag() && !ShouldSerializeToolTipText())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeVisible();
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			ResetAppearance();
			ResetEnabled();
			ResetKey();
			ResetTag();
			ResetToolTipText();
			ResetVisible();
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			if (appearanceHolder != null)
			{
				appearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				appearanceHolder = null;
			}
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		internal void PerformAnimation(float newOpacity, Rectangle newBounds)
		{
			Size size = newBounds.Size;
			Point location = newBounds.Location;
			Rectangle bounds = ((Control)this).Bounds;
			bounds = ((Control)this).RectangleToScreen(bounds);
			bool flag = size.Width >= 0 && size.Height >= 0 && (size.Width != bounds.Width || size.Height != bounds.Height);
			bool flag2 = location.X >= 0 && location.Y >= 0 && (location.X != bounds.X || location.Y != bounds.Y);
			if (flag || flag2)
			{
				BoundsSpecified boundsSpecified = BoundsSpecified.None;
				boundsSpecified = (BoundsSpecified)((int)boundsSpecified | (flag ? 12 : 0));
				boundsSpecified = (BoundsSpecified)((int)boundsSpecified | (flag2 ? 3 : 0));
				((Control)(object)Form).SetBounds(location.X, location.Y, size.Width, size.Height, boundsSpecified);
				UltraDesktopAlertWindowUIElement uIElement = UIElement;
				((UIElement)uIElement).DirtyChildElements(false);
				((UIElement)uIElement).VerifyChildElements();
				((Control)(object)this).Refresh();
			}
			if (newOpacity > 0f && form != null)
			{
				((Form)(object)form).Opacity = newOpacity;
			}
		}

		internal void Show(Rectangle initialBounds, float initialOpacity)
		{
			DesktopAlertWindowFormBase val = Form;
			val.ShowWindow(initialBounds, initialOpacity);
			((Control)(object)val).LocationChanged += OnFormLocationChanged;
			((UltraControlBase)this).Invalidate();
			((UltraControlBase)this).Update();
		}

		private void OnFormLocationChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender is Form { IsDisposed: false, Disposing: false } form && windowInfo != null && !windowInfo.Disposed && !windowInfo.IsAnimating && windowInfo.AnimationManager.Location != form.Location)
			{
				windowInfo.AnimationManager.Location = form.Location;
			}
		}

		internal void Close()
		{
			if (form != null)
			{
				((Form)(object)form).Close();
				if (!((Control)(object)form).Disposing)
				{
					((Component)(object)form).Dispose();
				}
				form = null;
			}
		}

		internal void MoveWindow(Point screenPos)
		{
			if (form != null)
			{
				((Form)(object)form).Location = screenPos;
			}
		}

		internal void DirtyControlElement()
		{
			DirtyControlElement(refresh: true);
		}

		internal void DirtyControlElement(bool refresh)
		{
			UIElement uIElement = (UIElement)(object)UIElement;
			if (uIElement != null)
			{
				uIElement.DirtyChildElements(false);
				uIElement.VerifyChildElements();
				if (refresh)
				{
					((Control)(object)this).Refresh();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing && windowInfo != null)
			{
				windowInfo.Dispose();
			}
			((UltraControlBase)this).Dispose(disposing);
		}

		internal void SetPinnedHelper(bool newValue, bool updateUI, bool verifyAutoCloseTimer)
		{
			if (newValue == pinned)
			{
				return;
			}
			pinned = newValue;
			if (updateUI && PinButtonVisible)
			{
				UltraDesktopAlertWindowUIElement ultraDesktopAlertWindowUIElement = UltraDesktopAlertWindow?.UIElement;
				if (ultraDesktopAlertWindowUIElement != null && ((UIElement)ultraDesktopAlertWindowUIElement).GetDescendant(typeof(PinButtonUIElement)) is PinButtonUIElement pinButtonUIElement)
				{
					((UIElement)pinButtonUIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
				}
			}
			if (verifyAutoCloseTimer)
			{
				Point pt = desktopAlertWindow.PointToClient(Control.MousePosition);
				if (!desktopAlertWindow.ClientRectangle.Contains(pt))
				{
					animationManager.InitializeAutoCloseTimer(start: true);
				}
			}
		}

		public void Close()
		{
			BeforeCloseHelper(DesktopAlertCloseReason.Programmatic);
		}

		internal void BeforeCloseHelper(DesktopAlertCloseReason closeReason)
		{
			if (isInBeforeCloseHelper)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				isInBeforeCloseHelper = true;
				UltraDesktopAlert desktopAlert = DesktopAlert;
				UltraDesktopAlertResolvedPropertyCache ultraDesktopAlertResolvedPropertyCache = DesktopAlertPropertyCache;
				DesktopAlertWindowAnimationManager desktopAlertWindowAnimationManager = AnimationManager;
				bool flag = closeReason == DesktopAlertCloseReason.AutoCloseTimerElapsed && ultraDesktopAlertResolvedPropertyCache.AnimationStyleAutoCloseResolved != AnimationStyle.None;
				DesktopAlertClosingEventArgs e = new DesktopAlertClosingEventArgs(this, closeReason);
				desktopAlert.EventManager.FireEvent(DesktopAlertEventIds.DesktopAlertClosing, e);
				if (e.Cancel && closeReason != DesktopAlertCloseReason.Disposed)
				{
					desktopAlertWindowAnimationManager.Start(AnimationSequence.ImmediateShow);
				}
				else if (flag)
				{
					desktopAlertWindowAnimationManager.Stop();
				}
				else
				{
					AfterCloseHelper();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				isInBeforeCloseHelper = false;
			}
		}

		internal void AfterCloseHelper()
		{
			if (isInAfterCloseHelper)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				isInAfterCloseHelper = true;
				UltraDesktopAlert desktopAlert = DesktopAlert;
				UltraDesktopAlertWindow.Close();
				DesktopAlertClosedEventArgs e = new DesktopAlertClosedEventArgs(this);
				desktopAlert.EventManager.FireEvent(DesktopAlertEventIds.DesktopAlertClosed, e);
			}
			finally
			{
				Dispose();
				isInAfterCloseHelper = true;
			}
		}

		internal void Show()
		{
			UltraDesktopAlert desktopAlert = DesktopAlert;
			UltraDesktopAlertResolvedPropertyCache ultraDesktopAlertResolvedPropertyCache = DesktopAlertPropertyCache;
			AnimationSequence animationSequence = ((ultraDesktopAlertResolvedPropertyCache.AnimationStyleShowResolved != AnimationStyle.None) ? AnimationSequence.GradualShow : AnimationSequence.ImmediateShow);
			DesktopAlertWindowInfoManager windowInfoManager = desktopAlert.WindowInfoManager;
			try
			{
				if (!ultraDesktopAlertResolvedPropertyCache.AllowMultipleWindows)
				{
					windowInfoManager.CloseAll();
				}
				windowInfoManager.Register(this);
				DesktopAlertWindowAnimationManager desktopAlertWindowAnimationManager = AnimationManager;
				if (!base.Disposed)
				{
					desktopAlertWindowAnimationManager.CreateWindowImage();
					PlaySound();
					desktopAlertWindowAnimationManager.Start(animationSequence);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				Dispose();
				throw ex;
			}
		}

		private void PlaySound()
		{
			//IL_0087: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0090: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0092: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ad: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			object beep = Sound;
			if (beep == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			SoundPlayer soundPlayer = null;
			bool flag = beep is SystemSound || beep is SystemSounds || beep is SoundEvents;
			if (beep is string || beep is Stream)
			{
				try
				{
					soundPlayer = ((!(beep is string)) ? new SoundPlayer(beep as Stream) : new SoundPlayer(beep as string));
					soundPlayer.Play();
					soundPlayer.Dispose();
					flag = false;
				}
				catch
				{
					beep = SystemSounds.Beep;
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				SystemSound systemSound = null;
				if (beep is SoundEvents val)
				{
					SoundEvents val2 = val;
					systemSound = (int)val2 switch
					{
						0 => SystemSounds.Asterisk, 
						1 => SystemSounds.Exclamation, 
						3 => SystemSounds.Hand, 
						4 => SystemSounds.Question, 
						_ => SystemSounds.Beep, 
					};
				}
				else
				{
					systemSound = beep as SystemSound;
				}
				systemSound?.Play();
			}
		}

		internal void InitializeFrom(UltraDesktopAlertShowWindowInfo showWindowInfo)
		{
			owningDesktopAlert = showWindowInfo.DesktopAlert;
			caption = showWindowInfo.Caption;
			data = showWindowInfo.Data;
			footerText = showWindowInfo.FooterText;
			key = showWindowInfo.Key;
			image = showWindowInfo.Image;
			pinned = showWindowInfo.Pinned;
			pinButtonVisible = showWindowInfo.PinButtonVisible;
			sound = showWindowInfo.Sound;
			text = showWindowInfo.Text;
			screen = showWindowInfo.Screen;
			screenLocation = showWindowInfo.ScreenLocation;
			screenPosition = showWindowInfo.ScreenPositionResolved;
			visibleAlertButtons = (showWindowInfo.HasCreatedVisibleAlertButtonsCollection ? showWindowInfo.VisibleAlertButtons : null);
			desktopAlertPropertyCache = new UltraDesktopAlertResolvedPropertyCache(owningDesktopAlert);
			touchMetricsEnabled = showWindowInfo.TouchMetricsEnabledResolved;
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			UltraDesktopAlertWindow ultraDesktopAlertWindow = UltraDesktopAlertWindow;
			if (ultraDesktopAlertWindow != null)
			{
				ultraDesktopAlertWindow.Close();
				((Component)(object)ultraDesktopAlertWindow).Dispose();
				desktopAlertWindow = null;
			}
			if (animationManager != null)
			{
				animationManager.Dispose();
			}
			if (this.WindowInfoDisposed != null)
			{
				this.WindowInfoDisposed(this);
			}
		}

		internal void Move(Point screenPos)
		{
			Size windowSize = WindowSize;
			DesktopAlertWindowLocationManager.VerifyScreenLocation(ref screenPos, windowSize, autoAlign: true);
			UltraDesktopAlertWindow ultraDesktopAlertWindow = UltraDesktopAlertWindow;
			if (ultraDesktopAlertWindow != null && (!DesktopAlertPropertyCache.TileMultipleWindows || DesktopAlertWindowLocationManager.VerifyNoOverlap(ref screenPos, windowSize, this, DesktopAlert.WindowInfoManager.WindowInfoList, show: false)))
			{
				AnimationManager.Location = screenPos;
				ultraDesktopAlertWindow.MoveWindow(screenPos);
			}
		}

		internal FormattedTextLinkStatus GetLinkStatus(DesktopAlertLinkType linkType)
		{
			//IL_0041: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0047: Expected O, but got Unknown
			string text = string.Empty;
			switch (linkType)
			{
			case DesktopAlertLinkType.Caption:
				text = CaptionResolved;
				break;
			case DesktopAlertLinkType.Text:
				text = TextResolved;
				break;
			case DesktopAlertLinkType.Footer:
				text = FooterTextResolved;
				break;
			}
			if (text.Length > 0)
			{
				try
				{
					ParsedFormattedTextValue val = new ParsedFormattedTextValue(text);
					return val.IsLink ? FormattedTextLinkStatus.IsLink : ((!val.IsLink && val.ContainsLink) ? FormattedTextLinkStatus.HasLink : FormattedTextLinkStatus.NoLink);
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			return FormattedTextLinkStatus.NoLink;
		}
	}

		{
			UltraDesktopAlertWindowInfo ultraDesktopAlertWindowInfo = ((desktopAlertWindow != null) ? desktopAlertWindow.WindowInfo : null);

			UIElementsCollection childElements = ((UIElement)this).ChildElements;

				}
				Rectangle empty = Rectangle.Empty;
				empty = new Rectangle(Point.Empty, ultraDesktopAlertWindowInfo.WindowSize);
				empty.Offset(animationManager.WindowOriginOffset);
				((UIElement)windowImageUIElement).Rect = empty;
				((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)windowImageUIElement);
			}
			else
			{
				((UIElement)this).childElementsCollection = null;
				if (ultraDesktopAlertWindowInfo.DesktopAlertPropertyCache.IsOffice2007Style)
				{
					PositionChildElementsOffice2007(ultraDesktopAlertWindowInfo, childElements);
				}
				else
				{
					PositionChildElementsWindowsLiveMessenger(ultraDesktopAlertWindowInfo, childElements);
				}
			}
		}

		private void PositionChildElementsOffice2007(UltraDesktopAlertWindowInfo windowInfo, UIElementsCollection oldElements)
		{
			Rectangle rectInsideBorders = ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders;
			Rectangle rectangle = rectInsideBorders;
			_ = windowInfo.Metrics;
			GripAreaUIElement gripAreaUIElement = null;
			gripAreaUIElement = UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)oldElements, typeof(GripAreaUIElement), true) as GripAreaUIElement;
			if (gripAreaUIElement == null)
			{
				gripAreaUIElement = new GripAreaUIElement(this);
			}
			Rectangle rect = rectInsideBorders;
			rect.Height = Office2007Metrics.GripAreaHeight;
			((UIElement)gripAreaUIElement).Rect = rect;
			((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)gripAreaUIElement);
			rectangle.Y += rect.Height;
			rectangle.Height -= rect.Height;
			WindowClientAreaUIElement windowClientAreaUIElement = null;
			windowClientAreaUIElement = UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)oldElements, typeof(WindowClientAreaUIElement), true) as WindowClientAreaUIElement;
			if (windowClientAreaUIElement == null)
			{
				windowClientAreaUIElement = new WindowClientAreaUIElement(this);
			}
			Rectangle rect2 = rectangle;
			((UIElement)windowClientAreaUIElement).Rect = rect2;
			((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)windowClientAreaUIElement);
		}

		private void PositionChildElementsWindowsLiveMessenger(UltraDesktopAlertWindowInfo windowInfo, UIElementsCollection oldElements)
		{
			Rectangle rectInsideBorders = ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders;
			Rectangle rectangle = rectInsideBorders;
			WindowsLiveMessengerMetrics windowsLiveMessengerMetrics = windowInfo.Metrics as WindowsLiveMessengerMetrics;
			CaptionAreaUIElement captionAreaUIElement = null;
			captionAreaUIElement = UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)oldElements, typeof(CaptionAreaUIElement), true) as CaptionAreaUIElement;
			if (captionAreaUIElement == null)
			{
				captionAreaUIElement = new CaptionAreaUIElement((UIElement)(object)this);
			}
			Rectangle rect = rectInsideBorders;
			rect.Size = windowsLiveMessengerMetrics.CaptionAreaSize;
			((UIElement)captionAreaUIElement).Rect = rect;
			((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)captionAreaUIElement);
			rectangle.Y += rect.Height;
			rectangle.Height -= rect.Height;
			WindowClientAreaUIElement windowClientAreaUIElement = null;
			windowClientAreaUIElement = UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)oldElements, typeof(WindowClientAreaUIElement), true) as WindowClientAreaUIElement;
			if (windowClientAreaUIElement == null)

			}

			((UIElement)windowClientAreaUIElement).Rect = rect2;
			((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)windowClientAreaUIElement);
		}

		protected override bool OnMouseDown(MouseEventArgs e, bool adjustableArea, ref UIElement captureMouseForElement)
		{
			lastLeftButtonDown = new Point(-1, -1);
			if (e.Button == MouseButtons.Left)
			{
				UltraDesktopAlert desktopAlert = desktopAlertWindow.DesktopAlert;
				if (desktopAlert != null && desktopAlert.AllowMoveResolved)
				{
					captureMouseForElement = (UIElement)(object)this;
					lastLeftButtonDown = new Point(e.X, e.Y);
				}
			}
			return ((UIElement)this).OnMouseDown(e, adjustableArea, ref captureMouseForElement);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseMove(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (lastLeftButtonDown.X >= 0)
			{
				UltraDesktopAlertWindowInfo ultraDesktopAlertWindowInfo = ((desktopAlertWindow != null) ? desktopAlertWindow.WindowInfo : null);
				if (ultraDesktopAlertWindowInfo != null)
				{
					UltraDesktopAlert desktopAlert = desktopAlertWindow.DesktopAlert;
					if (desktopAlert != null && desktopAlert.AllowMoveResolved && (object)((ControlUIElementBase)this).ElementWithMouseCapture == this)
					{
						Point mousePosition = Control.MousePosition;
						mousePosition.Offset(lastLeftButtonDown.X * -1, lastLeftButtonDown.Y * -1);
						ultraDesktopAlertWindowInfo.Move(mousePosition);
					}
				}
			}
			((UIElement)this).OnMouseMove(e);
		}

		internal LinkUIElement GetLinkElement(DesktopAlertLinkType linkType)
		{
			return ((UIElement)this).GetDescendant(typeof(LinkUIElement), (object)linkType) as LinkUIElement;
		}
	}

		private static readonly string anchorSubString = "<a";

		internal static void DeflateRect(ref Rectangle rect, Margins margins)
		{
			DeflateRect(ref rect, margins, Border3DSide.All);
		}

		internal static void DeflateRect(ref Rectangle rect, Margins margins, Border3DSide sides)
		{
			if (margins != null)
			{
				bool flag = (sides & Border3DSide.Top) == Border3DSide.Top;
				bool flag2 = (sides & Border3DSide.Left) == Border3DSide.Left;
				bool flag3 = (sides & Border3DSide.Right) == Border3DSide.Right;
				bool flag4 = (sides & Border3DSide.Bottom) == Border3DSide.Bottom;
				int num = 0;
				int num2 = 0;
				if (flag)
				{
					num2 += margins.Top;
				}
				if (flag4)
				{
					num2 += margins.Bottom;
				}
				if (flag2)
				{
					num += margins.Left;
				}
				if (flag3)
				{
					num += margins.Right;
				}
				rect.X += (flag2 ? margins.Left : 0);
				rect.Y += (flag ? margins.Top : 0);
				rect.Width -= num;
				rect.Height -= num2;
			}
		}

		internal static void AdjustRect(ref Rectangle rectToAdjust, Rectangle containingRect, HAlign hAlign, VAlign vAlign)
		{
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001f: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			//IL_0056: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0057: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0058: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0068: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			rectToAdjust.Location = containingRect.Location;
			switch (hAlign - 2)
			{
			case 1:
				rectToAdjust.X = containingRect.Right - rectToAdjust.Width;
				break;
			case 0:
				rectToAdjust.X += containingRect.Width / 2 - rectToAdjust.Width / 2;
				break;
			}
			switch (vAlign - 2)
			{
			case 1:
				rectToAdjust.Y = containingRect.Bottom - rectToAdjust.Height;
				break;
			case 0:
				rectToAdjust.Y += containingRect.Height / 2 - rectToAdjust.Height / 2;
				break;
			}
			rectToAdjust.X = Math.Max(rectToAdjust.X, containingRect.X);
			rectToAdjust.Width = Math.Min(rectToAdjust.Width, containingRect.Width);
			rectToAdjust.Y = Math.Max(rectToAdjust.Y, containingRect.Y);
			rectToAdjust.Height = Math.Min(rectToAdjust.Height, containingRect.Height);
		}

		internal static AppearancePropFlags RemoveAppearancePropFlags(ref AppearancePropFlags sourcePropFlags, AppearancePropFlags propsToRemove)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0003: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0004: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000d: Expected I8, but got Unknown
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			propsToRemove &= sourcePropFlags;
			sourcePropFlags = (AppearancePropFlags)(long)(sourcePropFlags & ~propsToRemove);
			return propsToRemove;
		}

		internal static void RestoreAppearancePropFlags(ref AppearancePropFlags sourcePropFlags, AppearancePropFlags propsToRestore)
		{
			//IL_0003: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0004: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Expected I8, but got Unknown
			sourcePropFlags = (AppearancePropFlags)(long)(sourcePropFlags | propsToRestore);
		}

		internal static string FormatTime(DateTime time)
		{
			return $"{time.Minute}:{time.Second}.{time.Millisecond / 100}";
		}

		internal static Size GetResolvedSize(Size actualValue, Size minSize)
		{
			if (actualValue == Size.Empty)
			{
				return actualValue;
			}
			int width = Math.Max(actualValue.Width, minSize.Width);
			int height = Math.Max(actualValue.Height, minSize.Height);
			return new Size(width, height);
		}

		internal static string TextToLink(string text)
		{
			if (text == null || text.Length == 0)
			{
				return text;
			}
			if (!text.Contains(anchorSubString))
			{
				return $"<a>{text}</a>";
			}
			return text;
		}

	internal class DesktopAlertWindowInfoManager
	{
		private UltraDesktopAlert desktopAlert;

		private ArrayList windowInfoList;

		private bool dirtyWindowInfoList;

		private List<UltraDesktopAlertWindowInfo> openWindowsList;

		internal ArrayList WindowInfoList
		{
			get
			{
				if (windowInfoList == null)
				{
					windowInfoList = new ArrayList(5);
				}
				return windowInfoList;
			}
		}

		internal bool HasOpenWindows
		{
			get
			{
				if (windowInfoList != null)
				{
					return windowInfoList.Count > 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal List<UltraDesktopAlertWindowInfo> OpenWindowsList
		{
			get
			{
				if (openWindowsList == null)
				{
					openWindowsList = new List<UltraDesktopAlertWindowInfo>(5);
				}
				if (dirtyWindowInfoList)
				{
					openWindowsList.Clear();
					if (HasOpenWindows)
					{
						ArrayList arrayList = WindowInfoList;
						foreach (UltraDesktopAlertWindowInfo item in arrayList)
						{
							openWindowsList.Add(item);
						}
					}
					dirtyWindowInfoList = false;
				}
				return openWindowsList;
			}
		}

		public UltraDesktopAlertWindowInfo this[string key]
		{
			get
			{
				if (key == null || key.Length == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				ArrayList arrayList = WindowInfoList;
				for (int i = 0; i < arrayList.Count; i++)
				{
					if (arrayList[i] is UltraDesktopAlertWindowInfo { Key: { Length: >0 } key2 } ultraDesktopAlertWindowInfo && string.Compare(key, key2, ignoreCase: true) == 0)
					{
						return ultraDesktopAlertWindowInfo;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal DesktopAlertWindowInfoManager(UltraDesktopAlert desktopAlert)
		{
			this.desktopAlert = desktopAlert;
		}

		public bool Register(UltraDesktopAlertWindowInfo windowInfo)
		{
			if (windowInfo == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (desktopAlert.IsInitializing)
			{
				throw new Exception(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("UltraDesktopAlert_Exception_CannotShowWindowWhenInitializing"));
			}
			if (Exists(windowInfo))
			{
				return false;
			}
			AddRemoveWindowInfoList(windowInfo, remove: false);
			windowInfo.WindowInfoDisposed += OnWindowInfoDisposed;
			return true;
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			if (windowInfoList == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraDesktopAlertWindowInfo[] array = WindowInfoList.ToArray(typeof(UltraDesktopAlertWindowInfo)) as UltraDesktopAlertWindowInfo[];
			foreach (UltraDesktopAlertWindowInfo ultraDesktopAlertWindowInfo in array)
			{
				if (ultraDesktopAlertWindowInfo != null && !ultraDesktopAlertWindowInfo.Disposed)
				{
					ultraDesktopAlertWindowInfo.BeforeCloseHelper(DesktopAlertCloseReason.Disposed);
				}
			}
			if (windowInfoList != null)
			{
				windowInfoList.Clear();
				windowInfoList = null;
			}
		}

		public bool Exists(UltraDesktopAlertWindowInfo windowInfo)
		{
			if (windowInfo == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (windowInfoList == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return windowInfoList.Contains(windowInfo);
		}

		public bool Exists(string key)
		{
			return this[key] != null;
		}

		public bool Close(string key)
		{
			UltraDesktopAlertWindowInfo ultraDesktopAlertWindowInfo = this[key];
			if (ultraDesktopAlertWindowInfo != null)
			{
				return Close(ultraDesktopAlertWindowInfo);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool Close(UltraDesktopAlertWindowInfo windowInfo)
		{
			if (windowInfo == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			windowInfo.BeforeCloseHelper(DesktopAlertCloseReason.Programmatic);
			return Exists(windowInfo);
		}

		public void CloseAll()
		{
			UltraDesktopAlertWindowInfo[] array = WindowInfoList.ToArray(typeof(UltraDesktopAlertWindowInfo)) as UltraDesktopAlertWindowInfo[];
			foreach (UltraDesktopAlertWindowInfo ultraDesktopAlertWindowInfo in array)
			{
				if (ultraDesktopAlertWindowInfo != null && !ultraDesktopAlertWindowInfo.Disposed)
				{
					ultraDesktopAlertWindowInfo.BeforeCloseHelper(DesktopAlertCloseReason.Programmatic);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void VerifyKeyDoesNotExist(string key)
		{
			if (key != null && key.Length > 0 && Exists(key))
			{
				throw new Exception(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("UltraDesktopAlertWindowInfo_Exception_DuplicateKey", key));
			}
		}

		private void AddRemoveWindowInfoList(UltraDesktopAlertWindowInfo windowInfo, bool remove)
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = WindowInfoList;
			if (remove)
			{
				if (arrayList.Contains(windowInfo))
				{
					arrayList.Remove(windowInfo);
					dirtyWindowInfoList = true;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				arrayList.Add(windowInfo);
				dirtyWindowInfoList = true;
			}
		}

		private void OnWindowInfoDisposed(UltraDesktopAlertWindowInfo windowInfo)
		{
			AddRemoveWindowInfoList(windowInfo, remove: true);
		}
	}
	internal class DesktopAlertWindowLocationManager
	{
		internal class ProximitySortComparer : IComparer
		{
			private Point centerPoint = Point.Empty;

			internal ProximitySortComparer(Point centerPoint)
			{
				this.centerPoint = centerPoint;
			}

			int IComparer.Compare(object x, object y)
			{
				if (x == null && y == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				if (x != null && y == null)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				if (x == null && y != null)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				Rectangle rectangle = (Rectangle)x;
				Rectangle rectangle2 = (Rectangle)y;
				Point point = new Point(rectangle.X + rectangle.Width / 2, rectangle.Y + rectangle.Height / 2);
				Point point2 = new Point(rectangle2.X + rectangle2.Width / 2, rectangle2.Y + rectangle2.Height / 2);
				int distanceBetweenPoints = GetDistanceBetweenPoints(centerPoint, point);
				int distanceBetweenPoints2 = GetDistanceBetweenPoints(centerPoint, point2);
				if (distanceBetweenPoints > 0 && distanceBetweenPoints == distanceBetweenPoints2)
				{
					int num = ((point.X >= centerPoint.X && point.Y <= centerPoint.Y) ? 1 : ((point.X >= centerPoint.X && point.Y >= centerPoint.Y) ? 2 : ((point.X <= centerPoint.X && point.Y >= centerPoint.Y) ? 3 : 4)));
					int num2 = ((point2.X >= centerPoint.X && point2.Y <= centerPoint.Y) ? 1 : ((point2.X >= centerPoint.X && point2.Y >= centerPoint.Y) ? 2 : ((point2.X <= centerPoint.X && point2.Y >= centerPoint.Y) ? 3 : 4)));
					if (num >= num2)
					{
						if (num <= num2)
						{
							return 0;
						}
						return 1;
					}
					return -1;
				}
				if (distanceBetweenPoints >= distanceBetweenPoints2)
				{
					if (distanceBetweenPoints <= distanceBetweenPoints2)
					{
						return 0;
					}
					return 1;
				}
				return -1;
			}

			private static int GetDistanceBetweenPoints(Point point1, Point point2)
			{
				int num = ((point1.X > point2.X) ? (point1.X - point2.X) : ((point1.X < point2.X) ? (point2.X - point1.X) : 0));
				int num2 = ((point1.Y > point2.Y) ? (point1.Y - point2.Y) : ((point1.Y < point2.Y) ? (point2.Y - point1.Y) : 0));
				if (num == 0 && num2 == 0)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				if (num == 0 && num2 != 0)
				{
					return num2;
				}
				if (num != 0 && num2 == 0)
				{
					return num;
				}
				double num3 = Math.Pow(num, 2.0);
				double num4 = Math.Pow(num2, 2.0);
				return (int)Math.Sqrt(num3 + num4);
			}
		}

		[Flags]
		internal enum RectangleEdges
		{
			None = 0,
			Top = 1,
			Left = 2,
			Right = 4,
			Bottom = 8,
			All = 0xF
		}

		private static Size AUTO_ALIGNMENT_THRESHOLD = new Size(16, 16);

		public static Point GetScreenLocation(UltraDesktopAlertWindowInfo windowInfo, ScreenPosition screenPosition, Size windowSize)
		{
			return GetScreenLocation(windowInfo, screenPosition, windowSize, Utilities.GetPrimaryScreen());
		}

		public static Point GetScreenLocation(UltraDesktopAlertWindowInfo windowInfo, ScreenPosition screenPosition, Size windowSize, Screen screen)
		{
			screen = ((screen != null) ? screen : Utilities.GetPrimaryScreen());
			Rectangle workingArea = screen.WorkingArea;
			Point result = Point.Empty;
			switch (screenPosition)
			{
			case ScreenPosition.Manual:
				throw new Exception("DesktopAlertWindowLocationManager.GetScreenLocation cannot be called with a screenPosition of 'Manual'.");
			case ScreenPosition.Default:
			case ScreenPosition.BottomRight:
				result = new Point(workingArea.Right, workingArea.Bottom);
				result.X -= windowSize.Width;
				result.Y -= windowSize.Height;
				break;
			case ScreenPosition.BottomLeft:
				result = new Point(workingArea.Left, workingArea.Bottom);
				result.Y -= windowSize.Height;
				break;
			case ScreenPosition.TopLeft:
				result = new Point(workingArea.Left, workingArea.Top);
				break;
			case ScreenPosition.TopRight:
				result = new Point(workingArea.Right, workingArea.Top);
				result.X -= windowSize.Width;
				break;
			case ScreenPosition.Center:
				result = new Point(workingArea.Left, workingArea.Top);
				result.X += workingArea.Width / 2;
				result.Y += workingArea.Height / 2;
				result.X -= windowSize.Width / 2;
				result.Y -= windowSize.Height / 2;
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static bool VerifyScreenLocation(ref Point screenLocation, Size windowSize)
		{
			return VerifyScreenLocation(ref screenLocation, windowSize, autoAlign: false);
		}

		public static bool VerifyScreenLocation(ref Point screenLocation, Size windowSize, bool autoAlign)
		{
			Point point = screenLocation;
			Screen screen = null;
			int num = 0;
			bool flag = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < Screen.AllScreens.Length; i++)
			{
				Screen screen2 = Screen.AllScreens[i];
				Rectangle workingArea = screen2.WorkingArea;
				if (autoAlign && screenLocation.X >= workingArea.X && screenLocation.X < workingArea.Right && screenLocation.Y >= workingArea.Bottom)
				{
					screenLocation.Y = workingArea.Bottom - 1;
				}
				if (workingArea.Contains(screenLocation))
				{
					screen = screen2;
					if (autoAlign && workingArea.Contains(Control.MousePosition))
					{
						Size aUTO_ALIGNMENT_THRESHOLD = AUTO_ALIGNMENT_THRESHOLD;
						Rectangle rectangle = workingArea;
						rectangle.Inflate(aUTO_ALIGNMENT_THRESHOLD.Width * -1, aUTO_ALIGNMENT_THRESHOLD.Height * -1);
						Rectangle rect = new Rectangle(screenLocation, windowSize);
						if (!rectangle.Contains(rect))
						{
							flag = true;
							if (rect.Left < rectangle.Left)
							{
								screenLocation.X = workingArea.Left;
							}
							else if (rect.Right > rectangle.Right)
							{
								screenLocation.X = workingArea.Right - windowSize.Width;
							}
							if (rect.Top < rectangle.Top)
							{
								screenLocation.Y = workingArea.Top;
							}
							else if (rect.Bottom > rectangle.Bottom)
							{
								screenLocation.Y = workingArea.Bottom - windowSize.Height;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				num = Math.Max(num, workingArea.Right);
			}
			if (!flag && screen != null)
			{
				_ = screen.Bounds;
				Rectangle workingArea2 = screen.WorkingArea;
				screenLocation.X = Math.Min(screenLocation.X, num - windowSize.Width);
				screenLocation.Y = Math.Min(screenLocation.Y, workingArea2.Bottom - windowSize.Height);
			}
			if (screenLocation.X == point.X)
			{
				return screenLocation.Y != point.Y;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static AnimationScrollDirection AnimationScrollDirectionFromScreenPosition(ScreenPosition screenPosition, bool show)
		{
			AnimationScrollDirection result = AnimationScrollDirection.Default;
			switch (screenPosition)
			{
			case ScreenPosition.TopLeft:
			case ScreenPosition.TopRight:
				result = (show ? AnimationScrollDirection.TopToBottom : AnimationScrollDirection.BottomToTop);
				break;
			case ScreenPosition.BottomLeft:
			case ScreenPosition.BottomRight:
				result = (show ? AnimationScrollDirection.BottomToTop : AnimationScrollDirection.TopToBottom);
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static AnimationScrollDirection AnimationScrollDirectionFromBounds(Rectangle screenBounds, bool show)
		{
			Rectangle workingArea = Screen.GetWorkingArea(screenBounds);
			bool flag = workingArea.Left == screenBounds.Left;
			bool flag2 = workingArea.Top == screenBounds.Top;
			bool flag3 = workingArea.Right == screenBounds.Right;
			bool flag4 = workingArea.Bottom == screenBounds.Bottom;
			if (!flag2)
			{
				if (!flag4)
				{
					if (!flag)
					{
						if (!flag3)
						{
							return AnimationScrollDirection.Default;
						}
						if (!show)
						{
							return AnimationScrollDirection.LeftToRight;
						}
						return AnimationScrollDirection.RightToLeft;
					}
					if (!show)
					{
						return AnimationScrollDirection.RightToLeft;
					}
					return AnimationScrollDirection.LeftToRight;
				}
				if (!show)
				{
					return AnimationScrollDirection.TopToBottom;
				}
				return AnimationScrollDirection.BottomToTop;
			}
			if (!show)
			{
				return AnimationScrollDirection.BottomToTop;
			}
			return AnimationScrollDirection.TopToBottom;
		}

		public static bool VerifyNoOverlap(ref Point screenLocation, Size windowSize, UltraDesktopAlertWindowInfo windowInfo, ArrayList openWindows, bool show)
		{
			return VerifyNoOverlap(ref screenLocation, windowSize, windowInfo, openWindows, show, Orientation.Vertical);

		public static bool VerifyNoOverlap(ref Point screenLocation, Size windowSize, UltraDesktopAlertWindowInfo windowInfo, ArrayList openWindows, bool show, Orientation bias)
		{
			if (windowInfo == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (openWindows == null || openWindows.Count < 2)
			{
				return true;
			}
			ScreenPosition screenPosition = (show ? windowInfo.ScreenPosition : ScreenPosition.Default);
			if (screenPosition == ScreenPosition.Center || screenPosition == ScreenPosition.Manual)
			{
				return VerifyNoOverlapCenterOrManual(ref screenLocation, windowSize, windowInfo, openWindows);
			}
			bool result = false;
			Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle(screenLocation, windowSize);
			Rectangle rectToMove = rectangle;
			Rectangle workingArea = Screen.GetWorkingArea(rectToMove);
			bool flag = bias == Orientation.Horizontal;
			bool flag2 = !flag;
			bool flag3 = flag && (screenPosition == ScreenPosition.BottomLeft || screenPosition == ScreenPosition.TopLeft);
			bool flag4 = flag && (screenPosition == ScreenPosition.BottomRight || screenPosition == ScreenPosition.TopRight);
			bool flag5 = flag2 && (screenPosition == ScreenPosition.TopLeft || screenPosition == ScreenPosition.TopRight);
			bool flag6 = flag2 && (screenPosition == ScreenPosition.BottomLeft || screenPosition == ScreenPosition.BottomRight);
			bool flag7 = screenPosition == ScreenPosition.TopLeft || screenPosition == ScreenPosition.TopRight;
			bool flag8 = screenPosition == ScreenPosition.BottomLeft || screenPosition == ScreenPosition.BottomRight;
			bool flag9 = screenPosition == ScreenPosition.TopLeft || screenPosition == ScreenPosition.BottomLeft;
			if (show && (flag4 || flag3 || flag6 || flag5))
			{
				while (!Rectangle.Intersect(rectToMove, workingArea).IsEmpty)
				{
					bool flag10 = false;
					bool flag11 = true;
					for (int i = 0; i < openWindows.Count; i++)
					{
						if (!(openWindows[i] is UltraDesktopAlertWindowInfo { Disposed: false } ultraDesktopAlertWindowInfo) || ultraDesktopAlertWindowInfo == windowInfo)
						{
							continue;
						}
						Rectangle bounds = ultraDesktopAlertWindowInfo.Bounds;
						if (!Rectangle.Intersect(rectToMove, bounds).IsEmpty)
						{
							if (flag)
							{
								flag11 = false;
								rectToMove.X = (flag4 ? (bounds.Left - (rectToMove.Width + 1)) : (bounds.Right + 1));
								bool flag12 = flag4 && rectToMove.X < workingArea.X;
								bool flag13 = flag3 && rectToMove.Right > workingArea.Right;
								if (flag12 || flag13)
								{
									if (flag7)
									{
										rectToMove.Y = bounds.Bottom + 1;
									}
									else
									{
										rectToMove.Y = bounds.Top - (rectToMove.Height + 1);
									}
									rectToMove.X = (flag12 ? (workingArea.Right - (rectToMove.Width + 1)) : workingArea.Left);
								}
								if ((flag7 && rectToMove.Bottom > workingArea.Bottom) || (flag8 && rectToMove.Top < workingArea.Top))
								{
									flag10 = true;
									break;
								}
							}
							else
							{
								flag11 = false;
								rectToMove.Y = (flag6 ? (bounds.Top - (rectToMove.Height + 1)) : (bounds.Bottom + 1));
								bool flag14 = flag6 && rectToMove.Y < workingArea.Y;
								bool flag15 = flag5 && rectToMove.Bottom > workingArea.Bottom;
								if (flag14 || flag15)
								{
									if (flag9)
									{
										rectToMove.X = bounds.Right + 1;
									}
									else
									{
										rectToMove.X = bounds.Left - (rectToMove.Width + 1);
									}
									rectToMove.Y = (flag14 ? (workingArea.Bottom - (rectToMove.Height + 1)) : workingArea.Top);
								}
								if ((flag7 && rectToMove.Bottom > workingArea.Bottom) || (flag8 && rectToMove.Top < workingArea.Top))
								{
									flag10 = true;
									break;
								}
							}
						}
						Screen screen = Screen.FromPoint(rectToMove.Location);
						if (screen == null || !screen.WorkingArea.Contains(rectToMove))
						{
							return false;
						}
					}
					if (flag10 || flag11)
					{
						if (flag11)
						{
							screenLocation = rectToMove.Location;
						}
						result = flag11;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			else

				{
					if (!(openWindows[j] is UltraDesktopAlertWindowInfo { Disposed: false } ultraDesktopAlertWindowInfo2) || ultraDesktopAlertWindowInfo2 == windowInfo)

		private static bool VerifyNoOverlapCenterOrManual(ref Point screenLocation, Size windowSize, UltraDesktopAlertWindowInfo windowInfo, ArrayList openWindows)
		{
			if (windowInfo == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (windowInfo.ScreenPosition != ScreenPosition.Center && windowInfo.ScreenPosition != ScreenPosition.Manual)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle(screenLocation, windowSize);
			Rectangle rect = rectangle;
			Rectangle workingArea = Screen.GetWorkingArea(rect);
			Point centerPoint = new Point(rectangle.X + rectangle.Width / 2, rectangle.Y + rectangle.Height / 2);
			Size size = new Size(windowSize.Width + 1, windowSize.Height + 1);
			int num = (rectangle.X - workingArea.X) % size.Width;
			int num2 = (rectangle.Y - workingArea.Y) % size.Height;
			Point location = new Point((size.Width - num) * -1, (size.Height - num2) * -1);
			int capacity = ((windowSize.Width != 0 && windowSize.Height != 0) ? (workingArea.Width / size.Width * (workingArea.Height / size.Height)) : 0);
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList(capacity);
			Rectangle rectangle2 = new Rectangle(location, size);
			bool flag = false;
			while (!flag)
			{
				if (rectangle2.Left >= workingArea.Left && rectangle2.Top >= workingArea.Top && rectangle2.Right < workingArea.Right && rectangle2.Bottom < workingArea.Bottom)
				{
					arrayList.Add(rectangle2);
				}
				rectangle2.X += rectangle2.Width;
				if (rectangle2.Right > workingArea.Right)
				{
					rectangle2.Y += rectangle2.Height;
					if (rectangle2.Bottom < workingArea.Bottom)
					{
						rectangle2.X = location.X;
					}
				}
				flag = rectangle2.Right > workingArea.Right && rectangle2.Bottom > workingArea.Bottom;
			}
			ProximitySortComparer comparer = new ProximitySortComparer(centerPoint);
			arrayList.Sort(comparer);
			for (int i = 0; i < arrayList.Count; i++)
			{
				Rectangle rectangle3 = (Rectangle)arrayList[i];
				Rectangle a = rectangle3;
				a.Inflate(-1, -1);
				bool flag2 = true;
				for (int j = 0; j < openWindows.Count; j++)
				{
					if (openWindows[j] is UltraDesktopAlertWindowInfo ultraDesktopAlertWindowInfo && ultraDesktopAlertWindowInfo != windowInfo)
					{
						Rectangle bounds = ultraDesktopAlertWindowInfo.Bounds;
						if (!Rectangle.Intersect(a, bounds).IsEmpty)
						{
							flag2 = false;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				if (flag2)
				{
					screenLocation = rectangle3.Location;
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool MoveRect(ref Rectangle rectToMove, Rectangle intersectingRect, Rectangle[] openWindows)
		{
			RectangleEdges excludedEdges = RectangleEdges.None;
			bool flag = MoveRect(ref rectToMove, intersectingRect, ref excludedEdges);
			if (flag)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < openWindows.Length; i++)
				{
					Rectangle rectangle = openWindows[i];
					if (!rectangle.IsEmpty && rectangle.IntersectsWith(rectToMove))
					{
						flag = false;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private static bool MoveRect(ref Rectangle rectToMove, Rectangle intersectingRect, ref RectangleEdges excludedEdges)
		{
			if (excludedEdges == RectangleEdges.All)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Rectangle rectangle = rectToMove;
			int num = ((rectangle.Bottom > intersectingRect.Top && rectangle.Bottom < intersectingRect.Bottom) ? (rectangle.Bottom - intersectingRect.Top) : 65535);
			int num2 = ((rectangle.Right > intersectingRect.Left && rectangle.Right < intersectingRect.Right) ? (rectangle.Right - intersectingRect.Left) : 65535);
			int num3 = ((rectangle.Left < intersectingRect.Right && rectangle.Left > intersectingRect.Left) ? (intersectingRect.Right - rectangle.Left) : 65535);
			int num4 = ((rectangle.Top < intersectingRect.Bottom && rectangle.Top > intersectingRect.Top) ? (intersectingRect.Bottom - rectangle.Top) : 65535);
			bool flag = num < 65535 && num <= num2 && num <= num3 && num <= num4;
			bool flag2 = !flag && num2 < 65535 && num2 <= num && num2 <= num3 && num2 <= num4;
			bool flag3 = !flag && !flag2 && num3 < 65535 && num3 <= num && num3 <= num2 && num3 <= num4;
			bool flag4 = !flag && !flag2 && !flag3 && num4 < 65535 && num4 <= num && num4 <= num2 && num4 <= num3;
			bool flag5 = (excludedEdges & RectangleEdges.Top) == RectangleEdges.Top;
			bool flag6 = (excludedEdges & RectangleEdges.Left) == RectangleEdges.Left;
			bool flag7 = (excludedEdges & RectangleEdges.Right) == RectangleEdges.Right;
			bool flag8 = (excludedEdges & RectangleEdges.Bottom) == RectangleEdges.Bottom;
			if (flag && flag5)
			{
				flag = false;
				if (!flag8)
				{
					flag4 = true;
				}
				else if (!flag6)
				{
					flag2 = true;
				}
				else if (!flag7)
				{
					flag3 = true;
				}
			}
			else if (flag2 && flag6)
			{
				flag2 = false;
				if (!flag7)
				{
					flag3 = true;
				}
				else if (!flag8)
				{
					flag4 = true;
				}
				else if (!flag5)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			else if (flag3 && flag7)
			{
				flag3 = false;
				if (!flag6)
				{
					flag2 = true;
				}
				else if (!flag5)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				else if (!flag8)
				{
					flag4 = true;
				}
			}
			else if (flag4 && flag8)
			{
				flag4 = false;
				if (!flag5)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				else if (!flag7)
				{
					flag2 = true;
				}
				else if (!flag6)
				{
					flag3 = true;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				rectangle.Y = intersectingRect.Top - (rectangle.Height + 1);
			}
			else if (flag2)
			{
				rectangle.X = intersectingRect.Left - (rectangle.Width + 1);
			}
			else if (flag3)
			{
				rectangle.X = intersectingRect.Right + 1;
			}
			else if (flag4)
			{
				rectangle.Y = intersectingRect.Bottom + 1;
			}
			RectangleEdges nonVisibleEdges = RectangleEdges.None;
			if (!IsRectangleFullyVisible(rectangle, out nonVisibleEdges))
			{
				if (excludedEdges == nonVisibleEdges)
				{
					return false;
				}
				excludedEdges |= nonVisibleEdges;
				return MoveRect(ref rectToMove, intersectingRect, ref excludedEdges);
			}
			rectToMove = rectangle;
			return true;
		}

		private static bool IsRectangleFullyVisible(Rectangle rectangle, out RectangleEdges nonVisibleEdges)
		{
			nonVisibleEdges = RectangleEdges.None;
			if (Screen.AllScreens.Length == 1)
			{
				return Screen.AllScreens[0].WorkingArea.Contains(rectangle);
			}
			Point location = rectangle.Location;
			Point point = new Point(rectangle.Left, rectangle.Bottom - 1);
			Point point2 = new Point(rectangle.Right - 1, rectangle.Top);
			Point point3 = new Point(rectangle.Right - 1, rectangle.Bottom - 1);
			Screen screen = Screen.FromPoint(location);
			Screen screen2 = Screen.FromPoint(point2);
			Screen screen3 = Screen.FromPoint(point);
			Screen screen4 = Screen.FromPoint(point3);
			Rectangle rectangle2 = screen?.WorkingArea ?? Rectangle.Empty;
			Rectangle rectangle3 = screen2?.WorkingArea ?? Rectangle.Empty;
			Rectangle rectangle4 = screen3?.WorkingArea ?? Rectangle.Empty;
			Rectangle rectangle5 = screen4?.WorkingArea ?? Rectangle.Empty;
			bool flag = screen != null && screen2 != null && location.Y >= rectangle2.Top && point2.Y >= rectangle3.Top;
			bool flag2 = screen != null && screen3 != null && location.X >= rectangle2.Left && point.X >= rectangle4.Left;
			bool flag3 = screen2 != null && screen4 != null && point2.X < rectangle3.Right && point3.X < rectangle5.Right;
			bool flag4 = screen3 != null && screen4 != null && point.Y < rectangle4.Bottom && point3.Y < rectangle5.Bottom;
			nonVisibleEdges |= ((!flag) ? RectangleEdges.Top : RectangleEdges.None);
			nonVisibleEdges |= (RectangleEdges)((!flag2) ? 2 : 0);
			nonVisibleEdges |= (RectangleEdges)((!flag3) ? 4 : 0);
			nonVisibleEdges |= (RectangleEdges)((!flag4) ? 8 : 0);
			return nonVisibleEdges == RectangleEdges.None;
		}
	}

		{
			appStylingInfo.Initialize(UltraNavigationBarApplicationStylingRole.NavigationBarControlArea);

			int num = 1;

			bool flag2 = (state & ControlUIState.HotTracked) == ControlUIState.HotTracked;

				{
