		private void ResolveControlAppearancePhase(AppearanceResolutionPhase phase, ref AppearanceData appData, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps, ControlUIState state)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0036: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00d8: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0078: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_013d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00de: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0143: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0115: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_017d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			RoleState val = (RoleState)1;
			bool useControlInfo = appStylingInfo.UseControlInfo;
			bool appStylingBefore = appStylingInfo.AppStylingBefore;
			bool appStylingAfter = appStylingInfo.AppStylingAfter;
			UIRole uIRole = appStylingInfo.UIRole;
			AppearanceData val2 = default(AppearanceData);
			AppearanceBase val3 = null;
			VistaColorScheme._Control control = navigationBar.DefaultColors.Control;
			switch (phase)
			{

				val = (RoleState)4;

				}

					}

					}
				}
				if (appStylingAfter)
				{
					ApplicationStylingUtilities.ResolveAppearance(uIRole, val, ref appData, ref requestedProps);
				}
				((AppearanceData)(ref val2)).BackColor = control.HotTrackBackColor;
				AppearanceData.Merge(ref appData, ref val2, ref requestedProps);
				break;
			case AppearanceResolutionPhase.EditMode:
				val = (RoleState)32;

					}

					}

				break;
			case AppearanceResolutionPhase.Normal:
				val = (RoleState)1;
				if (appStylingBefore)
				{
					ApplicationStylingUtilities.ResolveAppearance(uIRole, val, ref appData, ref requestedProps);
				}
				if (useControlInfo)

				break;

			case AppearanceResolutionPhase.Control:
				break;
			}

		public void ResolveLocationAppearance(UltraNavigationBarLocation location, LocationElementKind context, ref AppearanceData appData, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps, LocationUIState state, bool provideUltimateDefaults, bool resolveForMeasurement)
		{
			bool flag = context != LocationElementKind.DropDownButton && ((ulong)requestedProps & 0x2000000uL) == 33554432;

			{
				location = null;

				((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).FontData.Underline = (DefaultableBoolean)1;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFF7FFFFFuL);

			appStylingInfo.Initialize(context switch
			{
				LocationElementKind.ListItem => UltraNavigationBarApplicationStylingRole.NavigationBarLocationListItem,

		internal static AppearanceBase AppearanceFromPhase(UltraNavigationBarLocation location, AppearanceResolutionPhase phase)
		{
			if (location == null || !location.HasSettings)
			{
				return null;
			}
			UltraNavigationBarLocationSettings settings = location.Settings;
			if (settings == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			AppearanceBase result = null;
			switch (phase)
			{
			case AppearanceResolutionPhase.Active:
				result = (settings.HasActiveAppearance ? settings.ActiveAppearance : null);
				break;
			case AppearanceResolutionPhase.Selected:
				result = (settings.HasSelectedAppearance ? settings.SelectedAppearance : null);
				break;
			case AppearanceResolutionPhase.HotTracked:
				result = (settings.HasHotTrackAppearance ? settings.HotTrackAppearance : null);
				break;
			case AppearanceResolutionPhase.Pressed:
				result = (settings.HasPressedAppearance ? settings.PressedAppearance : null);
				break;
			case AppearanceResolutionPhase.Normal:
				result = (settings.HasAppearance ? settings.Appearance : null);
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

			}
			return result;
		}

	public abstract class LocationButtonUIElementBase : NavigationBarButtonUIElementBase, IAccessibleEntity
	{
		public LocationUIElement LocationElement => ((UIElement)this).parentElement as LocationUIElement;

		internal abstract LocationButtonKind ButtonKind { get; }

		internal virtual bool DrawsOuterRightBorder => true;

		public UltraNavigationBarLocation Location => LocationElement?.Location;

		public LocationUIState State
		{
			get
			{
				LocationUIState locationUIState = LocationUIState.Normal;
				LocationUIElement locationElement = LocationElement;
				if (locationElement == null)
				{
					return LocationUIState.Normal;
				}
				locationUIState |= locationElement.HotTrackingState;
				locationUIState |= locationElement.PressedState;
				UltraNavigationBarLocation location = Location;
				if (location != null && location.IsButtonActive)
				{
					locationUIState |= LocationUIState.ButtonActive;
				}
				if (location != null && location.IsExpanded)
				{
					locationUIState |= LocationUIState.Expanded;
				}
				return locationUIState;
			}
		}

		public override UIElementButtonStyle ButtonStyle => (UIElementButtonStyle)9;

		private LocationElementKind AppearanceResolutionContext
		{
			get
			{
				if (ButtonKind != LocationButtonKind.Text)
				{
					return LocationElementKind.DropDownButton;
				}
				return LocationElementKind.TextButton;
			}
		}

		internal override UltraNavigationBarApplicationStylingRole RoleId
		{
			get
			{
				LocationElementKind appearanceResolutionContext = AppearanceResolutionContext;
				if (appearanceResolutionContext != LocationElementKind.TextButton)
				{
					return UltraNavigationBarApplicationStylingRole.NavigationBarLocationDropDownButton;
				}
				return UltraNavigationBarApplicationStylingRole.NavigationBarLocationTextButton;
			}
		}

		internal virtual bool IsTextFullyVisible => false;

		protected override bool DrawsFocusRect
		{
			get
			{
				UltraNavigationBar navigationBar = base.NavigationBar;
				if (navigationBar == null || !navigationBar.DrawsFocusRectResolved)
				{
					return false;
				}
				UltraNavigationBarLocation location = Location;
				LocationUIState state = Location.State;
				if ((state & LocationUIState.ButtonActive) != LocationUIState.ButtonActive)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (ButtonKind != LocationButtonKind.Text)
				{
					return !location.HasTextButton;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public override UIElementBorderStyle BorderStyle => (UIElementBorderStyle)4;

		public override Rectangle RectInsideBorders
		{
			get
			{
				LocationUIState state = State;
				Margins val = (((state & LocationUIState.Pressed) == LocationUIState.Pressed) ? NavigationBarMetrics.LocationButtonBordersPressed : NavigationBarMetrics.LocationButtonBordersHotTracked);
				Rectangle rect = ((UIElement)this).Rect;
				bool drawsOuterRightBorder = DrawsOuterRightBorder;
				int left = val.Left;
				int num = (drawsOuterRightBorder ? val.Right : (val.Right - 1));
				rect.X += left;
				rect.Width -= left + num;
				rect.Y += val.Top;
				rect.Height -= val.Height;
				return rect;
			}
		}

		bool IAccessibleEntity.Collapsed => (State & LocationUIState.Expanded) == 0;

		bool IAccessibleEntity.Expanded => (State & LocationUIState.Expanded) == LocationUIState.Expanded;

		bool IAccessibleEntity.Focused
		{
			get
			{
				UltraNavigationBar navigationBar = base.NavigationBar;
				if (navigationBar == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return ((AccessibleObject)(object)navigationBar.NavigationBarAccessibilityObject).GetFocused() == ((UIElement)this).AccessibilityInstance;
			}
		}

		bool IAccessibleEntity.HotTracked => LocationUIElement.hotTrackingButton == this;

		bool IAccessibleEntity.Pressed => (State & LocationUIState.Pressed) == LocationUIState.Pressed;

		bool IAccessibleEntity.Visible => Location.VisibleResolved;

		AccessibleRole IAccessibleEntity.AccessibleRole
		{
			get
			{
				if (ButtonKind != LocationButtonKind.DropDown)
				{
					return AccessibleRole.PushButton;
				}
				return AccessibleRole.ButtonDropDown;
			}
		}

		string IAccessibleEntity.DisplayName
		{
			get
			{
				string name = ((ButtonKind == LocationButtonKind.DropDown) ? "LocationDropDownButtonUIElementAccessibleObject_DisplayName" : "LocationTextButtonUIElementAccessibleObject_DisplayName");
				return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString(name);
			}
		}

		string IAccessibleEntity.Name => Location.DisplayTextResolved;

		string IAccessibleEntity.Description => Location.GetFullPath(FullPathFormat.AllAncestors);

		string IAccessibleEntity.DefaultAction
		{
			get
			{
				if (ButtonKind != LocationButtonKind.DropDown)
				{
					return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("NavigationBarButtonElementAccessibleObject_DefaultAction");
				}
				return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LocationDropDownButtonElementAccessibleObject_DefaultAction");
			}
		}

		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			AppearanceData appearanceData = drawParams.AppearanceData;
			Graphics graphics = ((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics;
			Color borderColor = ((AppearanceData)(ref appearanceData)).BorderColor;
			Color borderColor2 = ((AppearanceData)(ref appearanceData)).BorderColor2;
			if (!(borderColor == Color.Transparent) || !(borderColor2 == Color.Transparent))
			{
				LocationUIState state = State;
				bool flag = (state & LocationUIState.Pressed) == LocationUIState.Pressed;
				bool isHotTracking = (state & LocationUIState.TextButtonHotTracked) == LocationUIState.TextButtonHotTracked || (state & LocationUIState.DropDownButtonHotTracked) == LocationUIState.DropDownButtonHotTracked || (state & LocationUIState.ButtonActive) == LocationUIState.ButtonActive;
				bool drawsOuterRightBorder = DrawsOuterRightBorder;
				Color middleColor = (flag ? VistaColorScheme._LocationButton.GetPressedBorderColorMiddle(borderColor2) : Color.Empty);
				Color innerColor = (flag ? VistaColorScheme._LocationButton.GetPressedBorderColorInner(borderColor2) : VistaColorScheme._LocationButton.GetHotTrackBorderColorInner(borderColor2));
				NavigationBarUtilities.Draw.DrawButtonBordersHelper(graphics, ((UIElement)this).Rect, borderColor, middleColor, innerColor, flag, isHotTracking, drawsOuterRightBorder);
			}
		}

		void IAccessibleEntity.DoDefaultAction()
		{
			if (ButtonKind == LocationButtonKind.Text)
			{
				((UIElement)this).OnClick();
				return;
			}
			UltraNavigationBar navigationBar = base.NavigationBar;
			if (navigationBar != null)
			{
				navigationBar.OnLocationElementClick(Location, LocationElementKind.DropDownButton, (UIElement)(object)this);
				((UIElement)this).DirtyChildElements(true);
			}
		}
	}

namespace Infragistics.Win.Misc.UltraWinNavigationBar

	public class UltraNavigationBarEventManager : EventManagerBase
	{
		private UltraNavigationBar navigationBar;

		private static int[] beforeEvents = null;

		private static int[] afterEvents = null;

		internal static readonly object EVENT_MOUSEENTERELEMENT = new object();

		internal static readonly object EVENT_MOUSELEAVEELEMENT = new object();

		internal static readonly object EVENT_ACTIONBUTTONCLICKED = new object();

		internal static readonly object EVENT_ENTERINGEDITMODE = new object();

		internal static readonly object EVENT_ENTEREDEDITMODE = new object();

		internal static readonly object EVENT_EXITINGEDITMODE = new object();

		internal static readonly object EVENT_EXITEDEDITMODE = new object();

		internal static readonly object EVENT_INITIALIZELOCATIONS = new object();

		internal static readonly object EVENT_LOCATIONACTIVELOCATIONCHANGING = new object();

		internal static readonly object EVENT_LOCATIONACTIVELOCATIONCHANGED = new object();

		internal static readonly object EVENT_LOCATIONEXPANDING = new object();

		internal static readonly object EVENT_LOCATIONEXPANDED = new object();

		internal static readonly object EVENT_SELECTEDLOCATIONCHANGING = new object();

		internal static readonly object EVENT_SELECTEDLOCATIONCHANGED = new object();

		internal static readonly object EVENT_NAVIGATIONPATHPARSEERROR = new object();

		internal static readonly object EVENT_LOCATIONCOLLAPSED = new object();

		internal static readonly object EVENT_LOCATIONTOOLTIPDISPLAYING = new object();

		internal static readonly object EVENT_ACTIONBUTTONTOOLTIPDISPLAYING = new object();

		internal static readonly object EVENT_PREVIOUSLOCATIONSDROPDOWNBUTTONTOOLTIPDISPLAYING = new object();

		internal UltraNavigationBar NavigationBar => navigationBar;

		public int[] AfterEvents
		{
			get
			{
				if (afterEvents == null)
				{
					afterEvents = new int[6] { 4, 6, 4, 9, 11, 13 };
				}
				return afterEvents;
			}
		}

		public int[] BeforeEvents
		{
			get
			{
				if (beforeEvents == null)
				{
					beforeEvents = new int[9] { 3, 5, 3, 8, 10, 12, 16, 17, 18 };
				}
				return beforeEvents;
			}
		}

		public UltraNavigationBarEventManager(UltraNavigationBar navigationBar)
			: base(19)
		{
			this.navigationBar = navigationBar;
		}

		public bool InProgress(UltraNavigationBarEventIds eventId)
		{
			return InProgress((int)eventId);
		}

		public bool IsEnabled(UltraNavigationBarEventIds eventId)
		{
			return IsEnabled((int)eventId);
		}

		public void Enable(UltraNavigationBarEventIds eventId)
		{
			SetEnabled((int)eventId, enabled: true);
		}

		public void Disable(UltraNavigationBarEventIds eventId)
		{
			SetEnabled((int)eventId, enabled: false);
		}

		public bool IsEnabled(EventGroups eventGroup)
		{
			return eventGroup switch
			{
				EventGroups.AllEvents => base.AllEventsEnabled, 
				EventGroups.BeforeEvents => IsEnabled(BeforeEvents), 
				EventGroups.AfterEvents => IsEnabled(AfterEvents), 
				_ => false, 
			};
		}

		public void Enable(EventGroups eventGroup)
		{
			switch (eventGroup)
			{
			case EventGroups.AllEvents:
				base.AllEventsEnabled = true;
				break;
			case EventGroups.BeforeEvents:
				SetEnabled(BeforeEvents, enabled: true);
				break;
			case EventGroups.AfterEvents:
				SetEnabled(AfterEvents, enabled: true);
				break;
			}
		}

		public void Disable(EventGroups eventGroup)
		{
			switch (eventGroup)
			{
			case EventGroups.AllEvents:
				base.AllEventsEnabled = true;
				break;
			case EventGroups.BeforeEvents:
				SetEnabled(BeforeEvents, enabled: false);
				break;
			case EventGroups.AfterEvents:
				SetEnabled(AfterEvents, enabled: false);
				break;
			}
		}

		internal void IncrementInProgress(UltraNavigationBarEventIds eventId)
		{
			IncrementInProgress((int)eventId);
		}

		internal void DecrementInProgress(UltraNavigationBarEventIds eventId)
		{
			DecrementInProgress((int)eventId);
		}

		internal bool CanFireEvent(UltraNavigationBarEventIds eventId)
		{
			return IsEnabled(eventId);
		}

		internal void FireEvent(UltraNavigationBarEventIds id, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (!CanFireEvent(id) || !Enum.IsDefined(typeof(UltraNavigationBarEventIds), id))
			{
				return;
			}
			IncrementInProgress(id);
			try
			{
				switch (id)
				{
				case UltraNavigationBarEventIds.ActionButtonClicked:
					navigationBar.OnActionButtonClicked((ActionButtonEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case UltraNavigationBarEventIds.EnteringEditMode:
					navigationBar.OnEnteringEditMode((CancelableEditModeEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case UltraNavigationBarEventIds.EnteredEditMode:
					navigationBar.OnEnteredEditMode((EditModeEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case UltraNavigationBarEventIds.ExitingEditMode:
					navigationBar.OnExitingEditMode((ExitingEditModeEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case UltraNavigationBarEventIds.ExitedEditMode:
					navigationBar.OnExitedEditMode((EditModeEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case UltraNavigationBarEventIds.InitializeLocations:
					navigationBar.OnInitializeLocations((InitializeLocationsEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case UltraNavigationBarEventIds.ActiveLocationChanging:
					navigationBar.OnActiveLocationChanging((ActiveLocationChangingEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case UltraNavigationBarEventIds.ActiveLocationChanged:
					navigationBar.OnActiveLocationChanged((ActiveLocationChangedEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case UltraNavigationBarEventIds.LocationExpanding:
					navigationBar.OnLocationExpanding((LocationExpandingEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case UltraNavigationBarEventIds.LocationExpanded:
					navigationBar.OnLocationExpanded((LocationExpandedEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case UltraNavigationBarEventIds.SelectedLocationChanging:
					navigationBar.OnSelectedLocationChanging((SelectedLocationChangingEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case UltraNavigationBarEventIds.SelectedLocationChanged:
					navigationBar.OnSelectedLocationChanged((SelectedLocationChangedEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case UltraNavigationBarEventIds.NavigationPathParseError:
					navigationBar.OnNavigationPathParseError((NavigationPathParseErrorEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case UltraNavigationBarEventIds.LocationCollapsed:
					navigationBar.OnLocationCollapsed((LocationCollapsedEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case UltraNavigationBarEventIds.LocationToolTipDisplaying:
					navigationBar.OnLocationToolTipDisplaying((LocationToolTipDisplayingEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case UltraNavigationBarEventIds.ActionButtonToolTipDisplaying:
					navigationBar.OnActionButtonToolTipDisplaying((ActionButtonToolTipDisplayingEventArgs)e);
					break;
				case UltraNavigationBarEventIds.PreviousLocationsDropDownButtonToolTipDisplaying:
					navigationBar.OnPreviousLocationsDropDownButtonToolTipDisplaying((ToolTipDisplayingEventArgs)e);
					break;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				DecrementInProgress(id);
			}
		}

		internal void FireNavigationPathParseErrorEvent(NavigationPathParseErrorEventArgs args)
		{
			FireEvent(UltraNavigationBarEventIds.NavigationPathParseError, args);
			if (args.DisplayErrorMessage)
			{
				UltraMessageBoxManager.Show(args.ErrorMessage, args.ErrorMessageCaption, MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand);
			}
		}
	}

	public class NavigationPathParseErrorEventArgs : EventArgs
	{
		private string path = string.Empty;

		private string invalidText = string.Empty;

		private bool displayErrorMessage = true;

		private string errorMessage = string.Empty;

		private string errorMessageCaption = string.Empty;

		private bool stayInEditMode = true;

		public string InvalidText => invalidText;

		public string Path
		{
			get
			{
				return path;
			}
			set
			{
				path = value;
			}
		}

		public bool DisplayErrorMessage
		{
			get
			{
				return displayErrorMessage;
			}
			set
			{
				displayErrorMessage = value;
			}
		}

		public string ErrorMessage
		{
			get
			{
				if (errorMessage == null || errorMessage.Length <= 0)
				{
					return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("NavigationPathParseErrorEventArgs_DefaultErrorMessage", invalidText);
				}
				return errorMessage;
			}
			set
			{
				errorMessage = value;
			}
		}

		public string ErrorMessageCaption
		{
			get
			{
				if (errorMessageCaption == null || errorMessageCaption.Length <= 0)
				{
					return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("NavigationPathParseErrorEventArgs_DefaultErrorMessageCaption");
				}
				return errorMessageCaption;
			}
			set
			{
				errorMessageCaption = value;
			}
		}

		public bool StayInEditMode
		{
			get
			{
				return stayInEditMode;
			}
			set
			{
				stayInEditMode = value;
			}
		}

		public NavigationPathParseErrorEventArgs(string path)
		{
			this.path = path;
			invalidText = this.path;
		}
	}

	internal class NavigationBarImageManager : IDisposable
	{
		private static readonly string imageFolderName = "UltraNavigationBar.Images";

		private Bitmap[] bitmaps = new Bitmap[ImageCount];

		private static ColorMap WhiteToTransparentColorMap
		{
			get
			{
				ColorMap colorMap = new ColorMap();
				colorMap.OldColor = Color.White;
				colorMap.NewColor = Color.Transparent;
				return colorMap;
			}
		}

		private static int ImageCount => Enum.GetNames(typeof(ImageName)).Length - 1;

		internal NavigationBarImageManager()
		{
		}

		public Bitmap GetBitmap(ImageName imageName)
		{
			if (imageName == ImageName.Undefined)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (bitmaps[(int)imageName] == null)
			{
				string name = $"{imageFolderName}.{imageName.ToString()}.bmp";
				Type typeFromHandle = typeof(UltraNavigationBar);
				Stream manifestResourceStream = typeFromHandle.Module.Assembly.GetManifestResourceStream(typeFromHandle, name);
				bitmaps[(int)imageName] = Image.FromStream(manifestResourceStream) as Bitmap;
			}
			return bitmaps[(int)imageName];
		}

		public static Size GetImageSize(ImageName imageName)
		{
			Size result = Size.Empty;
			switch (imageName)
			{
			case ImageName.ChevronLeft:
				result = new Size(8, 5);
				break;
			case ImageName.DropDownButtonDown:
				result = new Size(8, 5);
				break;
			case ImageName.DropDownButtonRight:
				result = new Size(5, 7);
				break;
			case ImageName.PreviousLocationsDropDown:
			case ImageName.PreviousLocationsDropDownEditMode:
				result = new Size(9, 6);
				break;
			case ImageName.Folder:
				result = new Size(16, 16);
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static ColorMap[] GetColorMaps(ImageName imageName, Color foreColor)
		{
			ColorMap[] result = null;
			if (foreColor.IsEmpty)
			{
				foreColor = Color.Black;
			}
			switch (imageName)
			{
			case ImageName.ChevronLeft:
			case ImageName.PreviousLocationsDropDownEditMode:
				result = new ColorMap[2]
				{
					WhiteToTransparentColorMap,
					ColorMapFromColors(Color.Black, foreColor)
				};
				break;
			case ImageName.DropDownButtonDown:
			case ImageName.DropDownButtonRight:
				result = new ColorMap[3]
				{
					WhiteToTransparentColorMap,
					ColorMapFromColors(Color.Red, Color.FromArgb(16, Color.Black)),
					ColorMapFromColors(Color.Black, foreColor)
				};
				break;
			case ImageName.PreviousLocationsDropDown:
				result = new ColorMap[5]
				{
					WhiteToTransparentColorMap,
					ColorMapFromColors(Color.Red, Color.FromArgb(240, Color.White)),
					ColorMapFromColors(Color.FromArgb(0, 255, 0), Color.FromArgb(192, Color.White)),
					ColorMapFromColors(Color.FromArgb(0, 0, 255), Color.FromArgb(128, Color.White)),
					ColorMapFromColors(Color.Black, foreColor)
				};
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private static ColorMap ColorMapFromColors(Color oldColor, Color newColor)
		{
			ColorMap colorMap = new ColorMap();
			colorMap.OldColor = oldColor;
			colorMap.NewColor = newColor;
			return colorMap;
		}

		void IDisposable.Dispose()
		{
			int imageCount = ImageCount;
			for (int i = 0; i < imageCount; i++)
			{
				if (bitmaps[i] != null)
				{
					bitmaps[i].Dispose();
					bitmaps[i] = null;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal enum ImageName
	{
		Undefined = -1,
		Folder,
		ChevronLeft,
		DropDownButtonDown,
		DropDownButtonRight,
		PreviousLocationsDropDown,
		PreviousLocationsDropDownEditMode
	}
	internal interface ISubObjectOwner
	{
		UltraNavigationBar Control { get; }

		void DirtyLocationTextButtonMetrics();
	}

	public class LocationUIElement : NavigationBarUIElementBase
	{
		internal static LocationButtonUIElementBase hotTrackingButton;

		private List<LocationButtonUIElementBase> buttonElements;

		public UltraNavigationBarLocation Location => ((UIElement)this).PrimaryContext as UltraNavigationBarLocation;

		internal LocationUIState HotTrackingState
		{
			get
			{
				UltraNavigationBar navigationBar = NavigationBar;
				if (navigationBar != null && navigationBar.ExpandedLocation != null)
				{
					return LocationUIState.Normal;
				}
				if (hotTrackingButton != null && hotTrackingButton.LocationElement == this)
				{
					if (!(hotTrackingButton is LocationTextButtonUIElement))
					{
						return LocationUIState.DropDownButtonHotTracked;
					}
					return LocationUIState.TextButtonHotTracked;
				}
				return LocationUIState.Normal;
			}
		}

		internal LocationUIState PressedState
		{
			get
			{
				UltraNavigationBar navigationBar = NavigationBar;
				if (navigationBar != null && navigationBar.ExpandedLocation == Location)
				{
					return LocationUIState.Pressed;
				}
				if (buttonElements != null)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < buttonElements.Count; i++)
					{
						LocationButtonUIElementBase locationButtonUIElementBase = buttonElements[i];
						if (((ButtonUIElementBase)locationButtonUIElementBase).IsMouseDownAndOver)
						{
							return LocationUIState.Pressed;
						}
					}
				}
				return LocationUIState.Normal;
			}
		}

		internal Point DropDownLocation
		{
			get
			{
				UltraNavigationBar navigationBar = NavigationBar;
				if (navigationBar == null)
				{
					return Point.Empty;
				}
				LocationDropDownButtonUIElement locationDropDownButtonUIElement = ((UIElement)this).GetDescendant(typeof(LocationDropDownButtonUIElement)) as LocationDropDownButtonUIElement;
				Rectangle rectangle = locationDropDownButtonUIElement?.ScreenRect ?? base.ScreenRect;
				int dx = ((locationDropDownButtonUIElement != null) ? navigationBar.Metrics.LocationsDropDownListHorizontalOffset : 0);
				int height = rectangle.Height;
				Point location = rectangle.Location;
				location.Offset(dx, height);
				return location;
			}
		}

		internal override UltraNavigationBarApplicationStylingRole RoleId => UltraNavigationBarApplicationStylingRole.NavigationBarButton;

		public override UIRole UIRole => null;

		}

			((UIElement)this).OnMouseEnter();

			UltraNavigationBar navigationBar = NavigationBar;
			UltraNavigationBarLocation ultraNavigationBarLocation = navigationBar?.ExpandedLocation;
			if (ultraNavigationBarLocation != null && ultraNavigationBarLocation != location)

				Point dropDownLocation = DropDownLocation;

			}

		private void InvalidateButtonElements()
		{
			if (buttonElements != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < buttonElements.Count; i++)
				{
					((UIElement)buttonElements[i]).DirtyChildElements(true);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void PositionChildElements()
		{
			UIElementsCollection childElements = ((UIElement)this).ChildElements;
			((UIElement)this).childElementsCollection = null;
			UltraNavigationBarLocation location = Location;
			Rectangle rectInsideBorders = ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders;
			LocationTextButtonUIElement locationTextButtonUIElement = null;
			LocationDropDownButtonUIElement locationDropDownButtonUIElement = null;
			buttonElements = new List<LocationButtonUIElementBase>(2);
			int textButtonWidth = 0;
			int dropDownButtonWidth = 0;
			location.GetButtonSize(out textButtonWidth, out dropDownButtonWidth);
			bool flag = textButtonWidth > 0;
			bool flag2 = dropDownButtonWidth > 0;
			if (flag)
			{
				Rectangle rect = rectInsideBorders;
				rect.Width = textButtonWidth;
				locationTextButtonUIElement = ((!(UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)childElements, typeof(LocationTextButtonUIElement), true) is LocationTextButtonUIElement locationTextButtonUIElement2)) ? new LocationTextButtonUIElement(this) : locationTextButtonUIElement2);
				((UIElement)locationTextButtonUIElement).Rect = rect;
				((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)locationTextButtonUIElement);
				buttonElements.Add(locationTextButtonUIElement);
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				Rectangle rect2 = rectInsideBorders;
				rect2.X += textButtonWidth;
				rect2.Width = dropDownButtonWidth;
				locationDropDownButtonUIElement = ((!(UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)childElements, typeof(LocationDropDownButtonUIElement), true) is LocationDropDownButtonUIElement locationDropDownButtonUIElement2)) ? new LocationDropDownButtonUIElement(this) : locationDropDownButtonUIElement2);
				((UIElement)locationDropDownButtonUIElement).Rect = rect2;
				((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)locationDropDownButtonUIElement);
				buttonElements.Add(locationDropDownButtonUIElement);
			}
		}

		private static void SetHighlightedLocation(LocationButtonUIElementBase elementBeingEntered, LocationButtonUIElementBase elementBeingLeft)
		{
			if (elementBeingEntered is LocationTextButtonUIElement && ((UIElement)elementBeingEntered).GetContext(typeof(UltraNavigationBarLocation)) is UltraNavigationBarLocation { IsRootLocation: not false })
			{
				elementBeingEntered = null;
			}
			hotTrackingButton = elementBeingEntered;
			UltraNavigationBar ultraNavigationBar = ((elementBeingEntered != null) ? (((UIElement)elementBeingEntered).Control as UltraNavigationBar) : ((elementBeingLeft != null) ? (((UIElement)elementBeingLeft).Control as UltraNavigationBar) : null));
			if (ultraNavigationBar != null)
			{
				UltraNavigationBarLocation ultraNavigationBarLocation2 = ((elementBeingLeft != null) ? (((UIElement)elementBeingLeft).GetContext(typeof(UltraNavigationBarLocation)) as UltraNavigationBarLocation) : null);
				UltraNavigationBarLocation ultraNavigationBarLocation3 = ((elementBeingEntered != null) ? (((UIElement)elementBeingEntered).GetContext(typeof(UltraNavigationBarLocation)) as UltraNavigationBarLocation) : null);
				if (ultraNavigationBarLocation3 != ultraNavigationBarLocation2)
				{
					ultraNavigationBar.SetActiveLocationHelper(ultraNavigationBarLocation3, fireEvents: true, notifyPropChange: true);
				}
			}
		}

		internal static void ClearHighlightedLocation()
		{
			hotTrackingButton = null;
		}
	}

		public List<UltraNavigationBarLocation> NonVisibleSelectedLocations
		{
			get
			{
				if (nonVisibleSelectedLocations == null)
				{
					List<UltraNavigationBarLocation> selectedLocations = navigationBar.SelectedLocations;
					int num = ((selectedLocations.Count > 1) ? 1 : 0);
					List<UltraNavigationBarLocation> list = null;
					if (!NavigationPathFullyVisible)
					{
						int widthRequired = 0;
						int width = ((UIElement)navigationBar.UIElement).RectInsideBorders.Width;
						width = GetWidthAvailableForSelectedLocations(width);
						list = GetVisibleSelectedLocations(width, out widthRequired);
						num = selectedLocations.Count - list.Count + 1;
					}
					nonVisibleSelectedLocations = new List<UltraNavigationBarLocation>(num);
					if (num > 1)
					{
						for (int num2 = selectedLocations.Count - 1; num2 > 0; num2--)
						{
							UltraNavigationBarLocation ultraNavigationBarLocation = selectedLocations[num2];
							if (!list.Contains(ultraNavigationBarLocation) && !ultraNavigationBarLocation.Parent.IsRootLocation)
							{
								nonVisibleSelectedLocations.Add(ultraNavigationBarLocation);
							}
						}
					}
					if (selectedLocations.Count > 1)
					{
						nonVisibleSelectedLocations.Add(navigationBar.RootLocation);
					}
				}
				return nonVisibleSelectedLocations;
			}
		}

		public Size GetLocationButtonTextSize(UltraNavigationBarLocation location)
		{
			//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0030: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			navigationBar.AppearanceManager.ResolveLocationAppearance(null, LocationElementKind.TextButton, ref appData, ref requestedProps, LocationUIState.Normal, provideUltimateDefaults: false, resolveForMeasurement: true);

		public List<UltraNavigationBarLocation> GetVisibleSelectedLocations(int availableWidth, out int widthRequired)
		{
			widthRequired = 0;
			List<UltraNavigationBarLocation> list = new List<UltraNavigationBarLocation>(1);
			UltraNavigationBarRootLocation rootLocation = navigationBar.RootLocation;
			list.Add(rootLocation);
			widthRequired += rootLocation.Size.Width;
			UltraNavigationBar.SelectedLocationsList selectedLocations = navigationBar.SelectedLocations;
			for (int num = selectedLocations.Count - 1; num > 0; num--)
			{
				UltraNavigationBarLocation ultraNavigationBarLocation = selectedLocations[num];
				int width = ultraNavigationBarLocation.Size.Width;
				widthRequired += width;
				if (widthRequired <= availableWidth)
				{
					list.Insert(1, ultraNavigationBarLocation);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		public int GetWidthAvailableForSelectedLocations(int widthInsideBorders)
		{
			int num = widthInsideBorders;
			num -= SelectedLocationImageAreaSize.Width;
			num -= PreviousLocationsDropDownButtonWidth;
			num -= ActionButtonAreaWidth;
			return num - 48;
		}

		public Size MeasureString(string text, ref AppearanceData appearance)
		{
			Font font = null;
			Font font2 = ((Control)(object)navigationBar).Font;
			if (((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasFontData)
			{
				font = ((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).CreateFont(font2);
				if (font != null)
				{
					font2 = font;
				}
			}
			int val = (int)Math.Ceiling((double)font2.Height);
			Size result = Size.Empty;
			using (Graphics graphics = ((Control)(object)navigationBar).CreateGraphics())
			{
				result = Size.Ceiling(DrawUtility.MeasureString(graphics, text, font));
			}
			result.Height = Math.Max(val, result.Height);
			font?.Dispose();
			return result;
		}

		public void DirtyAll()
		{
			DirtyLocationButtonTextHeight();
			DirtyLocationListItemTextHeight();
			DirtyNavigationPathFullyVisible();
		}

		{
			locationButtonTextHeight = 0;
		}

		public void DirtyLocationListItemTextHeight()
		{
			locationListItemTextHeight = 0;
		}

		public void DirtyNavigationPathFullyVisible()
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			navigationPathFullyVisible = (DefaultableBoolean)0;
			nonVisibleSelectedLocations = null;
		}

		public Margins GetPreviousLocationsDropDownButtonBorders(bool isPressed)
		{
			if (navigationBar.PreviousLocationsDropDownButtonHasInnerRightBorder)
			{
				if (!isPressed)
				{
					return ButtonBordersHotTracked;
				}
				return ButtonBordersPressed;
			}
			if (!isPressed)
			{
				return ButtonBordersHotTrackedNoRightEdge;
			}
			return ButtonBordersPressedNoRightEdge;
		}

		public Margins GetActionButtonBorders(UltraNavigationBarActionButton button, bool isPressed)
		{
			NavigationBarActionButtonsCollection actionButtons = navigationBar.ActionButtons;
			int num = actionButtons.VisibleMembers.IndexOf(button);
			if (num < actionButtons.VisibleCount - 1)
			{
				if (!isPressed)
				{
					return ButtonBordersHotTracked;
				}
				return ButtonBordersPressed;
			}
			if (!isPressed)
			{
				return ButtonBordersHotTrackedNoRightEdge;
			}
			return ButtonBordersPressedNoRightEdge;
		}

		public Size GetLocationsDropDownListSize(UltraNavigationBarLocation parentLocation)
		{
			if (parentLocation == null || !parentLocation.HasLocations)
			{
				return Size.Empty;
			}
			int maximumDropDownItemsResolved = parentLocation.MaximumDropDownItemsResolved;
			int visibleCount = parentLocation.Locations.VisibleCount;
			int num = (parentLocation.IsRootLocation ? navigationBar.Metrics.NonVisibleSelectedLocations.Count : 0);
			visibleCount += num;
			visibleCount = Math.Min(maximumDropDownItemsResolved, visibleCount);
			int locationListItemHeight = LocationListItemHeight;
			Size locationsDropDownListBorders = LocationsDropDownListBorders;
			Size locationsDropDownListPadding = LocationsDropDownListPadding;
			int num2 = locationListItemHeight * visibleCount;
			if (num > 0)
			{
				num2 += 2;
				num2 += LocationsDropDownListHorizontalSeparatorPadding.Height;
			}
			int num3 = 250;
			num2 += locationsDropDownListPadding.Height * 2;
			num3 += locationsDropDownListPadding.Width * 2;
			num2 += locationsDropDownListBorders.Height * 2;
			num3 += locationsDropDownListBorders.Width * 2;
			return new Size(num3, num2);
		}
	}

		protected NavigationBarActionButtonsCollection(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				if (current.Value is UltraNavigationBarActionButton)
				{
					if (Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(UltraNavigationBarActionButton), null) is UltraNavigationBarActionButton button)
					{
						AddHelper(button, notify: false);
					}
					continue;
				}
				switch (current.Name)
				{
				case "Count":
					initialCapacity = Math.Max(initialCapacity, (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), initialCapacity));
					break;
				case "Tag":
					DeserializeTag(info, "Tag");
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.Demand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Count", Count);
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				UltraNavigationBarActionButton value = GetItem(i) as UltraNavigationBarActionButton;
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, i.ToString(), value);
			}
			SerializeTag(info);
		}

		internal int AddHelper(UltraNavigationBarActionButton button, bool notify)
		{
			InsertHelper(Count, button, notify);
			return Count - 1;
		}

		internal void InsertHelper(int index, UltraNavigationBarActionButton button, bool notify)
		{
			VerifyButtonCanBelongToCollection(button);
			InternalInsert(index, button);
			button.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			button.InitParentCollection(this);
			OnCollectionChanged();
			if (notify)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(NavigationBarPropertyIds.ItemAdded);
			}
		}

		internal void RemoveHelper(int index, bool notify)
		{
			UltraNavigationBarActionButton ultraNavigationBarActionButton = this[index];
			ultraNavigationBarActionButton.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			InternalRemoveAt(index);
			ultraNavigationBarActionButton.OnRemovedFromCollection();
			OnCollectionChanged();
			if (notify)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(NavigationBarPropertyIds.ItemRemoved);
			}
		}

		private void VerifyButtonCanBelongToCollection(UltraNavigationBarActionButton button)
		{
			if (button == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("button");
			}
			NavigationBarActionButtonsCollection parentCollection = button.ParentCollection;
			if (parentCollection != null)
			{
				if (parentCollection != this)
				{
					throw new Exception(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("NavigationBarActionButtonsCollection_Exception_CannotAddToDifferentCollection"));
				}
				if (Contains(button))
				{
					throw new Exception(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("NavigationBarActionButtonsCollection_Exception_CannotAddToSameCollection"));
				}
			}
		}

		private void ClearHelper(bool notify, bool dispose)
		{
			int count = Count;
			for (int num = count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				UltraNavigationBarActionButton ultraNavigationBarActionButton = this[num];
				RemoveHelper(num, notify: false);
				if (dispose)
				{
					ultraNavigationBarActionButton.Dispose();
				}
			}
			if (notify && count > 0)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(NavigationBarPropertyIds.CollectionCleared);
			}
		}

			ResetVisibleMembers();
		}

		}

		{

		public class DefaultSortComparer : IComparer<UltraNavigationBarLocation>, IComparer
		{
			private SortOrder sortOrder;

			public DefaultSortComparer(SortOrder sortOrder)
			{
				this.sortOrder = sortOrder;
			}

			int IComparer<UltraNavigationBarLocation>.Compare(UltraNavigationBarLocation locationX, UltraNavigationBarLocation locationY)
			{
				if (sortOrder == SortOrder.None)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return CompareLocations(sortOrder, locationX, locationY);
			}

			int IComparer.Compare(object x, object y)
			{
				if (sortOrder == SortOrder.None)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				UltraNavigationBarLocation locationX = x as UltraNavigationBarLocation;
				UltraNavigationBarLocation locationY = y as UltraNavigationBarLocation;
				return CompareLocations(sortOrder, locationX, locationY);
			}
		}

		internal class InternalDefaultSortComparer : IComparer
		{
			private SortOrder sortOrder;

			public InternalDefaultSortComparer(SortOrder sortOrder)
			{
				this.sortOrder = sortOrder;
			}

			int IComparer.Compare(object x, object y)
			{
				if (sortOrder == SortOrder.None)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				UltraNavigationBarLocation locationX = x as UltraNavigationBarLocation;
				UltraNavigationBarLocation locationY = y as UltraNavigationBarLocation;
				return CompareLocations(sortOrder, locationX, locationY);
			}
		}

		public class VisibleLocationsCollection : ReadOnlyCollectionBase
		{
			private class VisibleLocationsEnumerator : IEnumerator
			{
				private int position = -1;

				private VisibleLocationsCollection collection;

				object IEnumerator.Current
				{
					get
					{
						if (position < 0)
						{
							return null;
						}
						return collection[position];
					}
				}

				internal VisibleLocationsEnumerator(VisibleLocationsCollection collection)
				{
					this.collection = collection;
				}

				bool IEnumerator.MoveNext()
				{
					if (position < collection.Count - 1)
					{
						position++;
						return true;
					}
					return false;
				}

				void IEnumerator.Reset()
				{
					position = -1;
				}
			}

			private List<UltraNavigationBarLocation> visibleMembers;

			private NavigationBarLocationsCollection locationsCollection;

			private SortOrder lastSortOrder;

			private VisibleLocationsEnumerator enumerator;

			public override int Count
			{
				get
				{
					VerifyCollection();
					return visibleMembers.Count;
				}
			}

			public UltraNavigationBarLocation this[int index]
			{
				get
				{
					VerifyCollection();
					return visibleMembers[index];
				}
			}

			private IEnumerator Enumerator
			{
				get
				{
					if (enumerator == null)
					{
						enumerator = new VisibleLocationsEnumerator(this);
					}
					return enumerator;
				}
			}

			internal List<UltraNavigationBarLocation> VisibleMembersForDropDownList
			{
				get
				{
					VerifyCollection();
					UltraNavigationBarLocation ultraNavigationBarLocation = ((locationsCollection != null) ? locationsCollection.Parent : null);
					if (ultraNavigationBarLocation == null || !ultraNavigationBarLocation.IsRootLocation)
					{
						return visibleMembers;
					}
					UltraNavigationBar navigationBar = ultraNavigationBarLocation.NavigationBar;
					List<UltraNavigationBarLocation> nonVisibleSelectedLocations = navigationBar.Metrics.NonVisibleSelectedLocations;
					if (nonVisibleSelectedLocations == null || nonVisibleSelectedLocations.Count == 0)
					{
						return visibleMembers;
					}
					List<UltraNavigationBarLocation> list = new List<UltraNavigationBarLocation>(nonVisibleSelectedLocations.Count + visibleMembers.Count);
					list.AddRange(nonVisibleSelectedLocations);
					list.AddRange(visibleMembers);
					return list;
				}
			}

			internal VisibleLocationsCollection(NavigationBarLocationsCollection locationsCollection)
			{
				this.locationsCollection = locationsCollection;
			}

			private void VerifyCollection()
			{
				if (visibleMembers != null)
				{
					return;
				}
				int count = locationsCollection.Count;
				visibleMembers = new List<UltraNavigationBarLocation>(count);
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					UltraNavigationBarLocation ultraNavigationBarLocation = locationsCollection[i];
					if (ultraNavigationBarLocation != null && ultraNavigationBarLocation.Visible)
					{
						visibleMembers.Add(ultraNavigationBarLocation);
					}
				}
				visibleMembers.Sort(new DefaultSortComparer(SortOrder.Ascending));
			}

			internal void Reset()
			{
				visibleMembers = null;
				lastSortOrder = SortOrder.None;
			}

			internal int IndexOf(UltraNavigationBarLocation location)
			{
				VerifyCollection();
				return visibleMembers.IndexOf(location);
			}

			public void Sort(SortOrder sortOrder)
			{
				if (sortOrder != SortOrder.None && sortOrder != lastSortOrder)
				{
					lastSortOrder = sortOrder;
					VerifyCollection();
					visibleMembers.Sort(new DefaultSortComparer(sortOrder));
				}
			}

			public void Sort(IComparer<UltraNavigationBarLocation> sortComparer)
			{
				VerifyCollection();
				lastSortOrder = SortOrder.None;
				visibleMembers.Sort(sortComparer);
			}

			public override IEnumerator GetEnumerator()
			{
				return Enumerator;
			}
		}

		protected NavigationBarLocationsCollection(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				if (current.Value is UltraNavigationBarLocation)
				{
					if (Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(UltraNavigationBarLocation), null) is UltraNavigationBarLocation location)
					{
						AddHelper(NavigationBar, location, notify: false);
					}
					continue;
				}
				switch (current.Name)
				{
				case "Count":
					initialCapacity = Math.Max(initialCapacity, (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), initialCapacity));
					break;
				case "Tag":
					DeserializeTag(info, "Tag");
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.Demand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Count", Count);
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				UltraNavigationBarLocation value = GetItem(i) as UltraNavigationBarLocation;
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, i.ToString(), value);
			}
			SerializeTag(info);
		}

		private void Initialize()
		{
			if (!isInitialized)
			{
				UltraNavigationBar navigationBar = NavigationBar;
				if (navigationBar != null)
				{
					isInitialized = true;
					InitializeLocationsEventArgs e = new InitializeLocationsEventArgs(parentLocation);
					navigationBar.EventManager.FireEvent(UltraNavigationBarEventIds.InitializeLocations, e);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (Count <= 0)
			{
				return ShouldSerializeTag();
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal int AddHelper(UltraNavigationBar navigationBar, UltraNavigationBarLocation location, bool notify)
		{
			InsertHelper(navigationBar, Count, location, notify);
			return Count - 1;
		}

		internal void InsertHelper(UltraNavigationBar navigationBar, int index, UltraNavigationBarLocation location, bool notify)
		{
			VerifyLocationCanBelongToCollection(location);
			if (navigationBar != null)
			{
				VerifyAgainstPathSeparator(location, navigationBar);
			}
			InternalInsert(index, location);
			location.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			location.InitParentCollection(this);
			OnCollectionChanged();
			if (notify)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(NavigationBarPropertyIds.ItemAdded);
			}
		}

		internal void RemoveHelper(int index, bool notify)
		{
			UltraNavigationBarLocation ultraNavigationBarLocation = this[index];
			ultraNavigationBarLocation.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			InternalRemoveAt(index);
			ultraNavigationBarLocation.OnRemovedFromCollection();
			OnCollectionChanged();
			if (notify)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(NavigationBarPropertyIds.ItemRemoved);
			}
		}

		private void VerifyLocationCanBelongToCollection(UltraNavigationBarLocation location)
		{
			if (location == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("location");
			}
			if (location.IsRootLocation)
			{
				throw new Exception(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("NavigationBarLocationsCollection_Exception_CannotAddRootLocationToCollection"));
			}
			NavigationBarLocationsCollection parentCollection = location.ParentCollection;
			if (parentCollection != null)
			{
				if (parentCollection != this)
				{
					throw new Exception(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("NavigationBarLocationsCollection_Exception_CannotAddToDifferentCollection"));
				}
				if (Contains(location))
				{
					throw new Exception(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("NavigationBarLocationsCollection_Exception_CannotAddToSameCollection"));
				}
			}
		}

		private void ClearHelper(bool notify, bool dispose)
		{
			int count = Count;
			for (int num = count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				UltraNavigationBarLocation ultraNavigationBarLocation = this[num];
				RemoveHelper(num, notify: false);
				if (dispose)
				{
					ultraNavigationBarLocation.Dispose();
				}
			}
			if (notify && count > 0)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(NavigationBarPropertyIds.CollectionCleared);
			}
		}

			NotifyPropChange(NavigationBarPropertyIds.Locations, propChange);
		}

		internal void OnCollectionChanged()
		{
			collectionVersion++;
			if (collectionVersion == int.MaxValue)
			{
				collectionVersion = 0;
			}
			ResetVisibleMembers();
		}

		public void Reset(bool reInitialize)
		{
			Clear();
			if (reInitialize)
			{
				isInitialized = false;
			}
		}

				IComparer<UltraNavigationBarLocation> sortComparer = new DefaultSortComparer(sortOrder);
				Sort(sortComparer);
			}
		}

			Sort(sortComparer);
		}

		{
			Sort(sortComparer);
		}

		internal static void VerifyAgainstPathSeparator(UltraNavigationBarLocation location, UltraNavigationBar navigationBar)
		{
			if (location == null || navigationBar == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			location.VerifyTextAgainstPathSeparator(navigationBar);
			if (location.HasLocations)
			{
				NavigationBarLocationsCollection locations = location.Locations;
				int count = locations.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					UltraNavigationBarLocation location2 = locations[i];
					VerifyAgainstPathSeparator(location2, navigationBar);
				}
			}
		}

		int IList.Add(object value)
		{
			if (!(value is UltraNavigationBarLocation location))
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("location");
			}
			return AddHelper(NavigationBar, location, notify: true);
		}

		{

			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("value");
			}
			InsertHelper(NavigationBar, index, location, notify: true);
		}

		{
			if (!(value is UltraNavigationBarLocation ultraNavigationBarLocation))
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("location");
			}
			RemoveHelper(ultraNavigationBarLocation.Index, notify: true);
		}

		{
			Clear();
		}

		void IList.RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			RemoveAt(index);
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			base.OnDispose();
			ClearHelper(notify: false, dispose: true);
		}

		private static int CompareLocations(SortOrder sortOrder, UltraNavigationBarLocation locationX, UltraNavigationBarLocation locationY)
		{
			if (locationX == locationY)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (locationX == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (locationY == null)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			int num = locationX.TextResolved.CompareTo(locationY.TextResolved);
			return num * ((sortOrder != SortOrder.Descending) ? 1 : (-1));
		}

		bool IList.Contains(object P_0)
		{
			return Contains(P_0);
		}

	public class NavigationBarPreviousLocationsCollection : SubObjectsCollectionBase
	{
		public class UltraNavigationBarLocationEnumerator : DisposableObjectEnumeratorBase
		{

		[Serializable]
		internal class PreviousLocationsStreamer : ISerializable
		{
			private List<string> fullPaths;

			private int count;

			internal List<string> FullPaths => fullPaths;

			internal PreviousLocationsStreamer(NavigationBarPreviousLocationsCollection previousLocations)
			{
				if (previousLocations == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("previousLocations");
				}
				int num = previousLocations.Count;
				fullPaths = new List<string>(num);
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					UltraNavigationBarLocation ultraNavigationBarLocation = previousLocations[i];
					fullPaths.Add(ultraNavigationBarLocation.GetFullPath(FullPathFormat.EditMode));
				}
				count = num;
			}

			protected PreviousLocationsStreamer(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			{
				if (fullPaths != null)
				{
					fullPaths.Clear();
				}
				SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
					string name;
					if (current.Name.StartsWith("FullPath"))
					{
						if (fullPaths == null)
						{
							fullPaths = new List<string>(count);
						}
						if (Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), null) is string item)
						{
							fullPaths.Add(item);
						}
					}
					else if ((name = current.Name) != null && name == "Count")
					{
						count = Math.Max(count, (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), count));
					}
				}
			}

			[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.Demand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
			void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Count", count);
				for (int i = 0; i < fullPaths.Count; i++)
				{
					string value = fullPaths[i];
					string name = $"FullPath_{i}";
					Utils.SerializeProperty(info, name, value);
				}
			}
		}

				UltraNavigationBarLocation ultraNavigationBarLocation = ((navigationBar != null) ? navigationBar.FromFullPath(fullPath) : null);
				if (ultraNavigationBarLocation == null || !Contains(ultraNavigationBarLocation))
				{
					throw new IndexOutOfRangeException();
				}
				return ultraNavigationBarLocation;
			}

			this.navigationBar = navigationBar;

		private void VerifyCollection()
		{
			if (navigationBar == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = navigationBar.versionManager.LocationsCollectionVersion;
			if (locationsCollectionVersion == num)
			{
				return;
			}
			locationsCollectionVersion = num;
			ArrayList arrayList = List;
			for (int num2 = arrayList.Count - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
			{
				if (arrayList[num2] is UltraNavigationBarLocation ultraNavigationBarLocation && ultraNavigationBarLocation.NavigationBar != navigationBar)
				{
					arrayList.RemoveAt(num2);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void VerifyCollectionSize()
		{
			if (navigationBar == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			VerifyCollection();
			int count = Count;
			int previousLocationsMaxItems = navigationBar.PreviousLocationsMaxItems;
			if (previousLocationsMaxItems > 0)
			{
				for (int num = count - 1; num >= previousLocationsMaxItems; num--)
				{
					RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (Count <= 0)
			{
				return ShouldSerializeTag();
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal int AddHelper(UltraNavigationBarLocation location, bool notify)
		{
			InsertHelper(Count, location, notify);
			return Count - 1;
		}

		internal void InsertHelper(int index, UltraNavigationBarLocation location, bool notify)
		{
			if (Contains(location))
			{
				Remove(location);
				index = Math.Min(index, Count);
			}
			VerifyLocationCanBelongToCollection(location);
			InternalInsert(index, location);
			VerifyCollectionSize();
			OnCollectionChanged();
			if (notify)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(NavigationBarPropertyIds.ItemAdded);
			}
		}

		internal void RemoveHelper(UltraNavigationBarLocation location, bool notify)
		{
			InternalRemove(location);
			OnCollectionChanged();
			if (notify)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(NavigationBarPropertyIds.ItemRemoved);
			}
		}

		private void VerifyLocationCanBelongToCollection(UltraNavigationBarLocation location)
		{
			if (location == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("location");
			}
			UltraNavigationBar ultraNavigationBar = location.NavigationBar;
			if (ultraNavigationBar != NavigationBar)
			{
				throw new Exception(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("NavigationBarPreviousLocationsCollection_Exception_MustBeAssociatedWithSameControl"));
			}
		}

		private void LoadHelper(Stream stream, bool loadAsBinary)

			}

			}
		}

		{

					{

					}
				}
			}
			if (Count > 0)
			{

			}
		}

			internal bool PerformKeyAction(Enum actionCode, bool shiftKeyDown, bool ctlKeyDown)

			public bool PerformAction(UltraNavigationBarAction actionCode)

			public bool PerformAction(UltraNavigationBarAction actionCode, bool shift, bool control)
			{
				bool result = true;
				UltraNavigationBarLocation activeLocation = navigationBar.ActiveLocation;
				UltraNavigationBarLocation expandedLocation = navigationBar.ExpandedLocation;
				bool flag = expandedLocation != null;
				UltraNavigationBarUIElement uIElement = navigationBar.UIElement;
				UltraLocationsDropDownListControl ultraLocationsDropDownListControl = (flag ? navigationBar.LocationsDropDownListControl : null);
				NavigationBarEditorOwner editorOwner = navigationBar.EditorOwner;
				switch (actionCode)
				{
				case UltraNavigationBarAction.ActivateFirstLocation:
				case UltraNavigationBarAction.ActivateLastLocation:
				case UltraNavigationBarAction.ActivateNextLocation:
				case UltraNavigationBarAction.ActivatePreviousLocation:
				case UltraNavigationBarAction.PageUp:
				case UltraNavigationBarAction.PageDown:
				{
					bool flag3 = actionCode == UltraNavigationBarAction.ActivateFirstLocation;
					bool flag4 = actionCode == UltraNavigationBarAction.ActivateLastLocation;
					bool flag5 = actionCode == UltraNavigationBarAction.ActivateNextLocation;
					bool flag6 = actionCode == UltraNavigationBarAction.ActivatePreviousLocation;
					bool flag7 = actionCode == UltraNavigationBarAction.PageUp;
					bool flag8 = actionCode == UltraNavigationBarAction.PageDown;
					UltraNavigationBarLocation activeLocation2 = null;
					if (flag7 || flag8)
					{
						activeLocation2 = activeLocation;
						ScrollEventType eventType = (flag7 ? ScrollEventType.LargeDecrement : ScrollEventType.LargeIncrement);
						ultraLocationsDropDownListControl.Scroll(ref activeLocation2, eventType);
					}
					else
					{
						int num = -1;
						int num2 = -1;
						if (!flag)
						{
							List<LocationUIElement> locationElements = uIElement.LocationElements;
							if (locationElements.Count > 0)
							{
								if (flag3)
								{
									activeLocation2 = locationElements[0].Location;
								}
								else if (flag4)
								{
									activeLocation2 = locationElements[locationElements.Count - 1].Location;
								}
								else if (activeLocation != null && (flag5 || flag6))
								{
									num2 = locationElements.IndexOf(activeLocation.UIElement);
									num = (flag5 ? (num2 + 1) : (num2 - 1));
									num = Math.Max(num, 0);
									num = Math.Min(num, locationElements.Count - 1);
									activeLocation2 = locationElements[num].Location;
								}
							}
						}
						else if (ultraLocationsDropDownListControl != null && expandedLocation != null)
						{
							List<UltraNavigationBarLocation> visibleMembersForDropDownList = expandedLocation.Locations.VisibleMembers.VisibleMembersForDropDownList;
							if (visibleMembersForDropDownList.Count > 0)
							{
								if (flag3)
								{
									activeLocation2 = visibleMembersForDropDownList[0];
								}
								else if (flag4)
								{
									activeLocation2 = visibleMembersForDropDownList[visibleMembersForDropDownList.Count - 1];
								}
								else if (activeLocation != null)
								{
									int num3 = visibleMembersForDropDownList.IndexOf(activeLocation);
									num = (flag5 ? (num3 + 1) : (num3 - 1));
									num = Math.Max(num, 0);
									num = Math.Min(num, visibleMembersForDropDownList.Count - 1);
									activeLocation2 = visibleMembersForDropDownList[num];
								}
							}
						}
					}
					if (activeLocation2 != null)
					{
						navigationBar.SetActiveLocationHelper(activeLocation2, fireEvents: true, notifyPropChange: true, (!flag) ? LocationElementKind.TextButton : LocationElementKind.ListItem, byKeyboard: true);
						if (flag)
						{
							ultraLocationsDropDownListControl?.BringIntoView(activeLocation2);
						}
						UltraControlBase val = null;
						val = (UltraControlBase)((!flag || ultraLocationsDropDownListControl == null) ? ((object)navigationBar) : ((object)ultraLocationsDropDownListControl));
						val.Update();
					}
					break;
				}
				case UltraNavigationBarAction.ExpandActiveLocation:
					if (activeLocation != null)
					{
						navigationBar.ExpansionManager.ExpandLocation(activeLocation);
					}
					break;
				case UltraNavigationBarAction.CloseLocationsDropDownList:
					if (expandedLocation != null)
					{
						navigationBar.ExpansionManager.Collapse();
					}
					break;
				case UltraNavigationBarAction.SelectActiveLocation:
					if (activeLocation != null)
					{
						navigationBar.SetSelectedLocationHelper(activeLocation, SelectedLocationChangeKind.ChildLocationSelected, fireEvents: true, notifyPropChange: true);
					}
					break;
				case UltraNavigationBarAction.OpenPreviousLocationsDropDownList:
					if (editorOwner.BeginEdit(navigationBar.SelectedLocation, dropDown: true))
					{
						editorOwner.DropDown(dropDown: true);
					}
					break;
				case UltraNavigationBarAction.ClosePreviousLocationsDropDownList:
				{
					EditorWithCombo editorWithCombo = navigationBar.EditorOwner.EditorWithCombo;
					if (((EmbeddableEditorBase)editorWithCombo).IsInEditMode && ((EmbeddableEditorBase)editorWithCombo).IsDroppedDown)
					{
						editorOwner.DropDown(dropDown: false);
					}
					break;
				}
				case UltraNavigationBarAction.EnterEditMode:
				case UltraNavigationBarAction.ExitEditModeCommit:
				case UltraNavigationBarAction.ExitEditModeCancel:
				{
					bool flag2 = actionCode == UltraNavigationBarAction.EnterEditMode;
					bool applyChanges = actionCode == UltraNavigationBarAction.ExitEditModeCommit;
					_ = editorOwner.EditorWithCombo;
					if (flag2)
					{
						editorOwner.BeginEdit(navigationBar.SelectedLocation);
					}
					else
					{
						editorOwner.EndEdit(forceExit: false, applyChanges);
					}
					break;
				}
				}
				return result;
			}

			public bool ProcessKeyboardSearch(char newCharacter)
			{
				bool flag = true;
				DateTime now = DateTime.Now;
				if ((int)now.Subtract(lastKeyPressTimeStamp).TotalMilliseconds > KEYBOARD_LATENCY_THRESHOLD)
				{
					keyboardSearchString = string.Empty;
				}
				else
				{
					flag = false;
				}
				lastKeyPressTimeStamp = now;
				UltraNavigationBarLocation expandedLocation = navigationBar.ExpandedLocation;
				UltraNavigationBarLocation ultraNavigationBarLocation = ((expandedLocation != null) ? navigationBar.ActiveLocation : null);
				if (!navigationBar.IsInEditMode)
				{
					keyboardSearchString += newCharacter;
					if (!flag && ultraNavigationBarLocation != null && DoesStringMatch(ultraNavigationBarLocation, keyboardSearchString))
					{
						return false;
					}
					UltraNavigationBarLocation ultraNavigationBarLocation2 = ChildLocationFromString(expandedLocation, ultraNavigationBarLocation, keyboardSearchString);
					if (ultraNavigationBarLocation2 != null)
					{
						navigationBar.SetActiveLocationHelper(ultraNavigationBarLocation2, fireEvents: true, notifyPropChange: true, LocationElementKind.ListItem);
						navigationBar.LocationsDropDownListControl.BringIntoView(ultraNavigationBarLocation2);
					}
					return ultraNavigationBarLocation2 != null;
				}
				return false;
			}

			private UltraNavigationBarLocation ChildLocationFromString(UltraNavigationBarLocation parentLocation, UltraNavigationBarLocation activeLocation, string text)
			{
				if (text == null || text.Length == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				List<UltraNavigationBarLocation> list = ((parentLocation != null && parentLocation.HasLocations) ? parentLocation.Locations.VisibleMembers.VisibleMembersForDropDownList : null);
				if (list == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				int num = ((activeLocation != null) ? list.IndexOf(activeLocation) : (-1));
				num++;
				if (num >= list.Count)
				{
					num = 0;
				}
				bool flag = num > 0;
				UltraNavigationBarLocation ultraNavigationBarLocation = LocationFromString(list, num, text);
				if (ultraNavigationBarLocation == null && flag)
				{
					ultraNavigationBarLocation = LocationFromString(list, 0, text);
				}
				return ultraNavigationBarLocation;
			}

			private UltraNavigationBarLocation LocationFromString(List<UltraNavigationBarLocation> locations, int startIndex, string text)
			{
				if (text == null || text.Length == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				for (int i = startIndex; i < locations.Count; i++)
				{
					UltraNavigationBarLocation ultraNavigationBarLocation = locations[i];
					if (DoesStringMatch(ultraNavigationBarLocation, text))
					{
						return ultraNavigationBarLocation;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}

			private bool DoesStringMatch(UltraNavigationBarLocation location, string text)
			{
				StringComparison comparisonType = StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase;
				string displayTextResolved = location.DisplayTextResolved;
				if (displayTextResolved == null || displayTextResolved.Length == 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				int length = Math.Min(displayTextResolved.Length, text.Length);
				return string.Compare(displayTextResolved, 0, text, 0, length, comparisonType) == 0;
			}
		}

		internal class NavigationBarAccessibleObject : UltraControlAccessibleObject
		{
			private UltraNavigationBar navigationBar;

			private AccessibleObject focusedItem;

			public override string Name
			{
				get
				{
					string name = ((Control.ControlAccessibleObject)this).Name;
					if (name != null && name.Length > 0)
					{
						return name;
					}
					return ((Control)(object)navigationBar).Name;
				}
				set
				{
					((Control.ControlAccessibleObject)this).Name = value;
				}
			}

			public override AccessibleRole Role
			{
				get
				{
					if (((Control)(object)navigationBar).AccessibleRole != AccessibleRole.Default)
					{
						return ((Control.ControlAccessibleObject)this).Role;
					}
					return AccessibleRole.Default;
				}
			}

			public override AccessibleStates State
			{
				get
				{
					AccessibleStates accessibleStates = AccessibleStates.None;
					if (!((Control)(object)navigationBar).Enabled)
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Unavailable;
					}
					else if (((Control)(object)navigationBar).Visible)
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Focusable;
						if (((Control)(object)navigationBar).Focused)
						{
							accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Focused;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Invisible;
					}
					if (((AccessibleObject)(object)this).Bounds.IsEmpty)
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Offscreen;
					}
					return accessibleStates;
				}
			}

			public override string Description
			{
				get
				{
					string arg = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("NavigationBarAccessibleObject_DisplayName");
					return $"{arg} ({((AccessibleObject)(object)this).Name})";
				}
			}

			public NavigationBarAccessibleObject(UltraNavigationBar navigationBar)
				: base((Control)(object)navigationBar)
			{
				this.navigationBar = navigationBar;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetChild(int index)
			{
				List<UIElement> list = navigationBar.UIElement?.AccessibleElements;
				if (list == null || index < 0 || index >= list.Count)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return list[index].AccessibilityInstance;
			}

			public override int GetChildCount()
			{
				return (navigationBar.UIElement?.AccessibleElements)?.Count ?? 0;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetFocused()
			{
				UIElement val = (UIElement)(object)navigationBar.ActiveLocation?.UIElement;
				if (val != null)
				{
					LocationButtonUIElementBase locationButtonUIElementBase = val.GetDescendant(typeof(LocationTextButtonUIElement)) as LocationTextButtonUIElement;
					locationButtonUIElementBase = ((locationButtonUIElementBase == null) ? (val.GetDescendant(typeof(LocationDropDownButtonUIElement)) as LocationDropDownButtonUIElement) : locationButtonUIElementBase);
					if (locationButtonUIElementBase != null)
					{
						return ((UIElement)locationButtonUIElementBase).AccessibilityInstance;
					}
				}
				EmbeddableUIElementBase val2 = (navigationBar.IsInEditMode ? navigationBar.Editor.ElementBeingEdited : null);
				if (val2 == null)
				{
					if (!((Control)(object)navigationBar).Focused)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return focusedItem;
				}
				return ((UIElement)val2).AccessibilityInstanceResolved;
			}

			internal void SetFocused(AccessibleObject focusedItem)
			{
				this.focusedItem = focusedItem;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetSelected()
			{
				return ((AccessibleObject)(object)this).GetFocused();
			}

			public override AccessibleObject HitTest(int x, int y)
			{
				AccessibleObject childControlAccessibleObject = ((UltraControlAccessibleObject)this).GetChildControlAccessibleObject(x, y);
				if (childControlAccessibleObject != null)
				{
					return childControlAccessibleObject;
				}
				AccessibleObject accessibleObject = ((UltraControlAccessibleObject)this).HitTest(x, y);
				if ((object)accessibleObject != this)
				{
					return accessibleObject;
				}
				if (!(((Control.ControlAccessibleObject)this).Owner is UltraNavigationBar ultraNavigationBar))
				{
					return null;
				}
				UIElement uIElement = (UIElement)(object)ultraNavigationBar.UIElement;
				if (uIElement == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return uIElement.HitTest(x, y);
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Navigate(AccessibleNavigation navdir)
			{
				int childCount = ((AccessibleObject)(object)this).GetChildCount();
				if (childCount == 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return navdir switch
				{
					AccessibleNavigation.FirstChild => ((AccessibleObject)(object)this).GetChild(0), 
					AccessibleNavigation.LastChild => ((AccessibleObject)(object)this).GetChild(childCount - 1), 
					_ => ((AccessibleObject)this).Navigate(navdir), 
				};
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public UltraNavigationBarLocation ExpandedLocation
		{
			get
			{
				if (locationExpansionManager == null || !locationExpansionManager.IsExpanded())
				{
					return null;
				}
				return locationExpansionManager.ExpandedLocation;
			}
			set
			{
				UltraNavigationBarLocation expandedLocation = ExpandedLocation;
				if (value == expandedLocation)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (value == null)
				{
					ExpansionManager.Collapse();
					return;
				}
				if (value.NavigationBar == null || value.NavigationBar != this)
				{
					throw new Exception(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("UltraNavigationBar_Exception_ExpandedLocation"));
				}
				ExpansionManager.ExpandLocation(value);
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Behavior")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("UltraNavigationBar_P_ImageSize")]
		public Size ImageSize
		{
			get
			{
				return imageSize;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != imageSize)
				{
					imageSize = value;
					((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)NavigationBarPropertyIds.ImageSize);
				}
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public Size ImageSizeResolved
		{
			get
			{
				Size result = ImageSize;
				if (result.IsEmpty)
				{
					return defaultImageSizeActual;
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("UltraNavigationBar_P_PathSeparator")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Behavior")]
		public string PathSeparator
		{
			get
			{
				if (pathSeparator != null)
				{
					return pathSeparator;
				}
				return string.Empty;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != pathSeparator)
				{
					if (value == null || value.Length == 0)
					{
						throw new Exception(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("UltraNavigationBar_Exception_PathSeparatorCannotBeEmpty"));
					}
					pathSeparator = value;
					try
					{
						NavigationBarLocationsCollection.VerifyAgainstPathSeparator(RootLocation, this);
					}
					catch
					{
						throw new Exception(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("UltraNavigationBar_Exception_PathSeparator", value));
					}
					((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)NavigationBarPropertyIds.PathSeparator);
				}
			}
		}

		internal Image SelectedLocationImage
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0042: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0067: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				Image image = null;
				UltraNavigationBarLocation selectedLocation = SelectedLocation;
				NavigationBarAppearanceManager navigationBarAppearanceManager = AppearanceManager;
				AppearanceData appData = default(AppearanceData);
				AppearancePropFlags requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)256;
				navigationBarAppearanceManager.ResolveSelectedLocationImageForAppStyling(ref appData, ref requestedProps, before: true, after: false);
				image = ((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).Image as Image;
				if (image == null)
				{
					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)256;
					navigationBarAppearanceManager.ResolveLocationAppearance(selectedLocation, LocationElementKind.TextButton, ref appData, ref requestedProps, LocationUIState.Normal);
					image = ((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).Image as Image;
				}
				if (image == null)
				{
					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)256;
					navigationBarAppearanceManager.ResolveSelectedLocationImageForAppStyling(ref appData, ref requestedProps, before: false, after: true);
					image = ((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).Image as Image;
				}
				if (image == null)
				{
					image = ImageManager.GetBitmap(Infragistics.Win.Misc.UltraWinNavigationBar.ImageName.Folder);
				}
				return image;
			}
		}

		internal ControlUIState State
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsDesignMode)
				{
					return ControlUIState.Normal;
				}
				bool flag = UIElement?.IsHotTracking ?? false;
				ControlUIState controlUIState = ControlUIState.Normal;
				if (flag)
				{
					controlUIState |= ControlUIState.HotTracked;
				}
				if (editorOwner != null && editorOwner.IsInEditMode)
				{
					controlUIState |= ControlUIState.EditMode;
				}
				return controlUIState;
			}
		}

		private int CalculateAutoSizeHeight()
		{
			int locationButtonTextHeight = Metrics.LocationButtonTextHeight;
			locationButtonTextHeight += NavigationBarMetrics.LocationButtonTextPadding.Height;
			locationButtonTextHeight += NavigationBarMetrics.LocationButtonBorders.Height;
			int height = ImageSizeResolved.Height;

			}

			{
				return true;

			{
				SelectedLocationChangedEventArgs e2 = new SelectedLocationChangedEventArgs(location);

		{
			if (((UltraControlBase)this).IsUpdating || IsInitializing)
			{
				return;
			}
			NavigationBarMetrics navigationBarMetrics = Metrics;
			PropChangeInfo propChangeInfo = propChange.FindTrigger(null);
			Enum obj = (Enum)((propChangeInfo != null) ? propChangeInfo.PropId : ((object)NavigationBarPropertyIds.Undefined));
			NavigationBarPropertyIds navigationBarPropertyIds = ((propChangeInfo != null && propChangeInfo.PropId is NavigationBarPropertyIds) ? ((NavigationBarPropertyIds)(object)propChangeInfo.PropId) : NavigationBarPropertyIds.Undefined);
			bool flag = propChangeInfo.Source is NavigationBarLocationsCollection && navigationBarPropertyIds == NavigationBarPropertyIds.ItemAdded;
			bool flag2 = propChangeInfo.Source is NavigationBarLocationsCollection && navigationBarPropertyIds == NavigationBarPropertyIds.ItemRemoved;
			bool flag3 = propChangeInfo.Source is NavigationBarLocationsCollection && navigationBarPropertyIds == NavigationBarPropertyIds.CollectionCleared;
			if (flag || flag2 || flag3)
			{
				versionManager.BumpLocationsCollectionVersion();

			bool flag4 = propChangeInfo.Source is NavigationBarActionButtonsCollection && navigationBarPropertyIds == NavigationBarPropertyIds.ItemAdded;
			bool flag5 = propChangeInfo.Source is NavigationBarActionButtonsCollection && navigationBarPropertyIds == NavigationBarPropertyIds.ItemRemoved;
			bool flag6 = propChangeInfo.Source is NavigationBarActionButtonsCollection && navigationBarPropertyIds == NavigationBarPropertyIds.CollectionCleared;
			if (flag4 || flag5 || flag6)
			{
				navigationBarMetrics.DirtyNavigationPathFullyVisible();
