		public UltraNavigationBarLocation FromFullPath(string fullPath)
		{
			UltraNavigationBarLocation[] array = null;
			return FromFullPath(fullPath, ref array);
		}

		internal UltraNavigationBarLocation FromFullPath(string fullPath, ref UltraNavigationBarLocation[] selectedLocations)
		{
			List<UltraNavigationBarLocation> list = new List<UltraNavigationBarLocation>();
			UltraNavigationBarLocation result = FromFullPathHelper(fullPath, list);
			selectedLocations = ((list != null && list.Count > 0) ? list.ToArray() : null);
			return result;
		}

		internal UltraNavigationBarLocation FromFullPathHelper(string fullPath, List<UltraNavigationBarLocation> selectedLocations)
		{
			if (fullPath == null || fullPath.Length == 0)
			{
				return RootLocation;
			}
			string[] separator = new string[1] { PathSeparator };
			bool flag = false;
			if (fullPath.StartsWith("\\\\"))
			{
				fullPath = fullPath.Substring("\\\\".Length);
				flag = true;
			}
			string[] fullPaths = fullPath.Split(separator, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
			if (fullPaths == null || fullPaths.Length == 0 || fullPaths[0] == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (flag && fullPaths.Length > 0)
			{
				fullPaths[0] = "\\\\" + fullPaths[0];
			}
			UltraNavigationBarLocation ultraNavigationBarLocation = RootLocation.LocationFromText(fullPaths[0], recursive: true);
			if (ultraNavigationBarLocation == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			bool flag2 = false;
			if (ultraNavigationBarLocation != null)
			{
				flag2 = BuildDescendantLocationPath(ultraNavigationBarLocation, ref fullPaths, selectedLocations);
			}
			if (!flag2 || selectedLocations == null || selectedLocations.Count <= 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return selectedLocations[selectedLocations.Count - 1];
		}

		private bool BuildDescendantLocationPath(UltraNavigationBarLocation parent, ref string[] fullPaths, List<UltraNavigationBarLocation> selectedLocations)
		{
			BuildDescendantLocationPathHelper(parent, ref fullPaths, selectedLocations);
			return fullPaths.Length == 0;
		}

		private void BuildDescendantLocationPathHelper(UltraNavigationBarLocation parent, ref string[] fullPaths, List<UltraNavigationBarLocation> selectedLocations)
		{
			if (fullPaths.Length > 0)
			{
				selectedLocations.Add(parent);
				int num = fullPaths.Length - 1;
				string[] array = new string[num];
				if (array.Length > 0)
				{
					Array.Copy(fullPaths, 1, array, 0, num);
				}
				fullPaths = array;
			}
			if (fullPaths.Length == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			NavigationBarLocationsCollection navigationBarLocationsCollection = (parent.HasLocations ? parent.Locations : null);
			if (navigationBarLocationsCollection == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			int count = navigationBarLocationsCollection.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (fullPaths.Length == 0)
				{
					break;
				}
				UltraNavigationBarLocation ultraNavigationBarLocation = navigationBarLocationsCollection[i];
				if (ultraNavigationBarLocation.TextEquals(fullPaths[0]))
				{
					flag = true;
					BuildDescendantLocationPathHelper(ultraNavigationBarLocation, ref fullPaths, selectedLocations);
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool NavigateToHelper(ref string path, bool fireNavigationPathParseErrorEvent, bool displayErrorMessage)
		{
			UltraNavigationBarLocation ultraNavigationBarLocation = FromFullPath(path);
			if (ultraNavigationBarLocation == null)
			{
				if (fireNavigationPathParseErrorEvent)
				{
					NavigationPathParseErrorEventArgs e = new NavigationPathParseErrorEventArgs(path);
					e.DisplayErrorMessage = displayErrorMessage;
					EventManager.FireNavigationPathParseErrorEvent(e);
					path = e.Path;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return SetSelectedLocationHelper(ultraNavigationBarLocation, SelectedLocationChangeKind.PathParsed, fireEvents: true, notifyPropChange: true);
		}

		internal void OnLocationElementClick(UltraNavigationBarLocation location, LocationElementKind elementKind, UIElement element)
		{
			switch (elementKind)
			{
			case LocationElementKind.TextButton:
				if (location.IsRootLocation && location == SelectedLocation)
				{
					EditorOwner.BeginEdit(location);
				}
				else
				{
					SetSelectedLocationHelper(location, SelectedLocationChangeKind.TextButtonClicked, fireEvents: true, notifyPropChange: true);
				}
				break;
			case LocationElementKind.ListItem:
				SetSelectedLocationHelper(location, SelectedLocationChangeKind.ChildLocationSelected, fireEvents: true, notifyPropChange: true);
				ExpansionManager.Collapse();
				break;
			case LocationElementKind.DropDownButton:
			{
				LocationUIElement locationUIElement = ((element is LocationDropDownButtonUIElement locationDropDownButtonUIElement) ? locationDropDownButtonUIElement.LocationElement : null);
				if (locationUIElement != null)
				{
					ExpansionManager.ExpandLocation(location, locationUIElement.DropDownLocation);
				}
				break;
			}
			}
		}

		protected override bool IsInputKey(Keys keyData)
		{
			if (KeyActionManager.IsInputKey(keyData))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return ((Control)this).IsInputKey(keyData);
		}

		protected override bool IsInputChar(char charCode)
		{
			if ((Control.ModifierKeys & Keys.Alt) == Keys.Alt)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override void OnKeyPress(KeyPressEventArgs eventArgs)
		{
			((UltraControlBase)this).OnKeyPress(eventArgs);
			if (!eventArgs.Handled && !IsInEditMode && ExpandedLocation != null && !((Control)this).IsDisposed && KeyActionManager.ProcessKeyboardSearch(eventArgs.KeyChar))
			{
				eventArgs.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		internal void DisplayPreviousLocationsDropDownButtonToolTip(Point screenLocation)
		{
			ToolTipDisplayingEventArgs e = new ToolTipDisplayingEventArgs(PreviousLocationsSettings.DropDownButtonToolTipText, screenLocation);
			EventManager.FireEvent(UltraNavigationBarEventIds.PreviousLocationsDropDownButtonToolTipDisplaying, e);
			string text = (e.Cancel ? string.Empty : e.ToolTipText);
			screenLocation = e.ScreenLocation;
			if (text.Length > 0)
			{
				DisplayToolTip(text, screenLocation);
			}
		}

		internal void RefreshPreviousLocationsDropDownButton()
		{
			UIElement descendant = ((UIElement)UIElement).GetDescendant(typeof(PreviousLocationsDropDownButtonUIElement));
			if (descendant != null)
			{
				descendant.DirtyChildElements(false);
				descendant.VerifyChildElements(true);
				descendant.Invalidate(true);
			}
		}

		public bool EnterEditMode()
		{
			if (IsInEditMode)
			{
				return true;
			}
			bool flag = ((Control)(object)this).Focused || ((Control)this).Focus();
			if (flag)
			{
				flag = EditorOwner.BeginEdit(SelectedLocation);
			}
			return flag;
		}

		public bool ExitEditMode(bool applyChanges)
		{
			if (IsInEditMode)
			{
				return EditorOwner.EndEdit(forceExit: false, applyChanges);
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void VerifyAutoHeight()
		{
			if (((Control)(object)this).AutoSize)
			{
				int height = CalculateAutoSizeHeight();
				Rectangle bounds = ((Control)this).Bounds;
				((Control)(object)this).SetBoundsCore(bounds.X, bounds.Y, bounds.Width, height, BoundsSpecified.Height);
			}
		}

		private AppearanceBase GetAppearance(int index)
		{
			//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			int appearancePropertyCount = AppearancePropertyCount;
			if (index < 0 || index >= appearancePropertyCount)
			{
				return null;
			}
			CreateAppearanceHolderArray(appearancePropertyCount);
			if (appearanceHolder[index] == null)
			{
				appearanceHolder[index] = new AppearanceHolder();
				appearanceHolder[index].SubObjectPropChanged += SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			appearanceHolder[index].Collection = Appearances;
			return appearanceHolder[index].Appearance;
		}

		private bool SetAppearance(int index, AppearanceBase value)
		{
			//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			int appearancePropertyCount = AppearancePropertyCount;
			if (index < 0 || index >= appearancePropertyCount)
			{
				return false;
			}
			CreateAppearanceHolderArray(appearancePropertyCount);
			if (appearanceHolder[index] == null)
			{
				appearanceHolder[index] = new AppearanceHolder();
				appearanceHolder[index].SubObjectPropChanged += SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			else
			{
				appearanceHolder[index].SubObjectPropChanged -= SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			appearanceHolder[index].Collection = Appearances;
			if (value != appearanceHolder[index].Appearance)
			{
				appearanceHolder[index].Appearance = value;
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void CreateAppearanceHolderArray(int propertyCount)
		{
			if (appearanceHolder == null)
			{
				appearanceHolder = (AppearanceHolder[])(object)new AppearanceHolder[propertyCount];
			}
		}

		private bool GetHasAppearance(int index)
		{
			int appearancePropertyCount = AppearancePropertyCount;
			if (index < 0 || index >= appearancePropertyCount)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (appearanceHolder != null && appearanceHolder[index] != null)
			{
				return appearanceHolder[index].HasAppearance;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool GetShouldSerializeAppearance(int index)
		{
			int appearancePropertyCount = AppearancePropertyCount;
			if (index < 0 || index >= appearancePropertyCount)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (GetHasAppearance(index))
			{
				return appearanceHolder[index].ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ResetAppearance(int index)
		{
			int appearancePropertyCount = AppearancePropertyCount;
			if (index >= 0 && index < appearancePropertyCount && GetHasAppearance(index))
			{
				appearanceHolder[index].Reset();
			}
		}

		private void DisposeAppearances()
		{
			if (appearanceHolder == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int appearancePropertyCount = AppearancePropertyCount;
			for (int i = 0; i < appearancePropertyCount; i++)
			{
				AppearanceHolder val = appearanceHolder[i];
				if (val != null)
				{
					val.SubObjectPropChanged -= SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					if (val.HasAppearance)
					{
						((DisposableObject)(object)val.Appearance).Dispose();
					}
					appearanceHolder[i] = null;
				}
			}
		}

		public override void EndUpdate(bool invalidate)
		{
			Metrics.DirtyAll();
			((UltraControlBase)this).EndUpdate(invalidate);
		}

		internal void AccessibilityNotifyClientsInternal(AccessibleEvents accEvent, int childID)
		{
			if (!((Control)this).IsDisposed && !((Control)this).Disposing && ((Control)this).IsHandleCreated)
			{
				bool flag = ((Control)this).ContainsFocus || (locationsDropDownListControl != null && ((Control)(object)locationsDropDownListControl).Focused);
				if (accEvent != AccessibleEvents.Focus || flag)
				{
					((Control)this).AccessibilityNotifyClients(accEvent, childID);
				}
			}
		}

	[Serializable]
	[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("UltraNavigationBarActionButton_ClassDescription")]
	[TypeConverter(typeof(UltraNavigationBarActionButtonTypeConverter))]
	public class UltraNavigationBarActionButton : KeyedSubObjectBase, ISerializable, ISubObjectOwner
	{
		public sealed class UltraNavigationBarActionButtonTypeConverter : TypeConverter
		{
			public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
			}

			public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("destinationType");
				}
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor) && value is UltraNavigationBarActionButton)
				{
					ConstructorInfo constructor = value.GetType().GetConstructor(new Type[0]);
					if (constructor != null)
					{
						return new InstanceDescriptor(constructor, new object[0], isComplete: false);
					}
				}
				return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
			}
		}

		private static readonly bool defaultVisible = true;

		private UltraNavigationBarActionButtonSettings settings;

		private string toolTipText = string.Empty;

		private bool visible = defaultVisible;

		private NavigationBarActionButtonsCollection parentCollection;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public UltraNavigationBar NavigationBar
		{
			get
			{
				if (parentCollection == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return parentCollection.NavigationBar;
			}
		}

		internal NavigationBarActionButtonsCollection ParentCollection => parentCollection;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[MergableProperty(false)]
		public int Index => parentCollection?.IndexOf(this) ?? (-1);

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("UltraNavigationBarActionButton_P_Settings")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Appearance")]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		public UltraNavigationBarActionButtonSettings Settings
		{
			get
			{
				if (settings == null)
				{
					settings = new UltraNavigationBarActionButtonSettings(this);
					settings.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
				return settings;
			}
		}

		internal bool HasSettings
		{
			get
			{
				if (settings != null)
				{
					return settings.ShouldSerializeHelper();
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("UltraNavigationBarActionButton_P_ToolTipText")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Behavior")]
		public string ToolTipText
		{
			get
			{
				if (toolTipText != null)
				{
					return toolTipText;
				}
				return string.Empty;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != toolTipText)
				{
					toolTipText = value;
					NotifyPropChange(NavigationBarPropertyIds.ToolTipText);
				}
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Behavior")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("UltraNavigationBarActionButton_P_Visible")]
		public bool Visible
		{
			get
			{
				return visible;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != visible)
				{
					visible = value;
					if (parentCollection != null)
					{
						parentCollection.ResetVisibleMembers();
					}
					NotifyPropChange(NavigationBarPropertyIds.Visible);
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool HasInnerRightBorder
		{
			get
			{
				UltraNavigationBar navigationBar = NavigationBar;
				if (navigationBar == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				int num = navigationBar.ActionButtons.VisibleMembers.IndexOf(this);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					return num < navigationBar.ActionButtons.VisibleCount - 1;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public ActionButtonUIElement UIElement
		{
			get
			{
				UltraNavigationBarUIElement ultraNavigationBarUIElement = NavigationBar?.UIElement;
				if (ultraNavigationBarUIElement == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return ((UIElement)ultraNavigationBarUIElement).GetDescendant(typeof(ActionButtonUIElement), (object)this) as ActionButtonUIElement;
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public NavigationBarButtonUIState State
		{
			get
			{
				UltraNavigationBar navigationBar = NavigationBar;
				if (navigationBar == null || navigationBar.IsDesignMode)
				{
					return NavigationBarButtonUIState.Normal;
				}
				ActionButtonUIElement uIElement = UIElement;
				return uIElement.State;
			}
		}

			return false;
		}

			if (settings != null)

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]

		{
			if (toolTipText != null)
			{
				return toolTipText.Length > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]

		{
			ToolTipText = null;
		}

			Visible = defaultVisible;
		}

		{
			parentCollection = null;
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			if (propChange.Source == settings)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(NavigationBarPropertyIds.Settings, propChange);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			if (settings != null)
			{
				settings.Dispose();
				settings = null;
			}
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		internal void DisplayToolTip(Point screenLocation)
		{
			UltraNavigationBar navigationBar = NavigationBar;
			if (navigationBar != null)
			{
				string text = ToolTipText;
				ActionButtonToolTipDisplayingEventArgs e = new ActionButtonToolTipDisplayingEventArgs(text, screenLocation, this);
				navigationBar.EventManager.FireEvent(UltraNavigationBarEventIds.ActionButtonToolTipDisplaying, e);
				text = (e.Cancel ? string.Empty : e.ToolTipText);
				screenLocation = e.ScreenLocation;
				if (text.Length > 0)
				{
					navigationBar.DisplayToolTip(text, screenLocation);
				}
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.Demand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			if (ShouldSerializeKey())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Key", Key);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeSettings())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Settings", Settings);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeToolTipText())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ToolTipText", ToolTipText);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeVisible())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Visible", Visible);
			}
		}

		protected UltraNavigationBarActionButton(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				switch (current.Name)
				{
				case "Key":
					Key = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), Key);
					break;
				case "Settings":
					settings = (UltraNavigationBarActionButtonSettings)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(UltraNavigationBarButtonAppearances), settings);
					break;
				case "ToolTipText":
					toolTipText = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), toolTipText);
					break;
				case "Visible":
					visible = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), visible);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		{
			public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
			}

			public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("destinationType");
				}
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor) && value is UltraNavigationBarLocation)
				{
					ConstructorInfo constructor = value.GetType().GetConstructor(new Type[0]);
					if (constructor != null)
					{
						return new InstanceDescriptor(constructor, new object[0], isComplete: false);
					}
				}
				return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public LocationUIElement UIElement
		{
			get
			{
				UltraNavigationBarUIElement ultraNavigationBarUIElement = NavigationBar?.UIElement;
				if (ultraNavigationBarUIElement == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return ((UIElement)ultraNavigationBarUIElement).GetDescendant(typeof(LocationUIElement), (object)this) as LocationUIElement;
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public LocationUIState State
		{
			get
			{
				UltraNavigationBar navigationBar = NavigationBar;
				if (navigationBar == null || navigationBar.IsDesignMode)
				{
					return LocationUIState.Normal;
				}
				LocationUIState locationUIState = LocationUIState.Normal;
				LocationUIElement uIElement = UIElement;
				if (uIElement != null)
				{
					locationUIState |= uIElement.HotTrackingState;
					locationUIState |= uIElement.PressedState;
				}
				if (navigationBar.ActiveLocation == this)
				{
					locationUIState = (LocationUIState)((int)locationUIState | ((navigationBar.ExpandedLocation == null) ? 4 : 128));
				}
				UltraNavigationBarLocation expandedLocation = navigationBar.ExpandedLocation;
				if (expandedLocation != null)
				{
					if (expandedLocation == this)
					{
						locationUIState |= LocationUIState.Expanded;
					}
					else if (expandedLocation == Parent)
					{
						LocationListItemUIElement hotTrackingItem = LocationExpansionManager.hotTrackingItem;
						if (hotTrackingItem != null && hotTrackingItem.Location == this)
						{
							locationUIState |= LocationUIState.ListItemHotTracked;
						}
					}
				}
				if (navigationBar.SelectedLocations.IsSelected(this))
				{
					locationUIState |= LocationUIState.Selected;
				}
				return locationUIState;
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public int Level
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsRootLocation)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				if (parentCollection == null)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				int num = 0;
				UltraNavigationBarLocation ultraNavigationBarLocation = this;
				while (!ultraNavigationBarLocation.IsRootLocation)
				{
					num++;
					ultraNavigationBarLocation = ultraNavigationBarLocation.Parent;
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

				NotifyPropertyChange(NavigationBarPropertyIds.Settings, propChange);
			}
			else if (propChange.Source == locations)
			{
				NotifyPropertyChange(NavigationBarPropertyIds.Locations, propChange);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			base.OnObjectPropChanged(propChange);
			if (NavigationBar != null && propChange.PropId is NotifyId && (NotifyId)(object)propChange.PropId == NotifyId.Key)
			{
				OnTextRelatedPropertyChanged(verifyAgainstPathSeparator: true);
			}
		}

		private void NotifyPropertyChange(NavigationBarPropertyIds propId)
		{
			NotifyPropertyChange(propId, new PropChangeInfo(this, propId, null));
		}

		private void NotifyPropertyChange(NavigationBarPropertyIds propId, PropChangeInfo trigger)
		{
			switch (propId)
			{
			case NavigationBarPropertyIds.DisplayText:
			case NavigationBarPropertyIds.Settings:
			case NavigationBarPropertyIds.Text:
			{
				bool verifyAgainstPathSeparator = propId == NavigationBarPropertyIds.Text || propId == NavigationBarPropertyIds.DisplayText;
				OnTextRelatedPropertyChanged(verifyAgainstPathSeparator);
				break;
			}
			}
			NotifyPropChange(propId, trigger);
		}

		private void OnTextRelatedPropertyChanged(bool verifyAgainstPathSeparator)
		{
			UltraNavigationBar navigationBar = NavigationBar;
			if (verifyAgainstPathSeparator && navigationBar != null)
			{
				VerifyTextAgainstPathSeparator(navigationBar);
			}
			versionNumbers.DirtyTextSizeVersions();
			if (navigationBar != null && IsSelected)
			{
				navigationBar.Metrics.DirtyNavigationPathFullyVisible();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			if (settings != null)
			{
				settings.Dispose();
				settings = null;
			}
			if (locations != null)
			{
				locations.Dispose();
				locations = null;
			}
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		public string GetFullPath(FullPathFormat format)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			GetFullPathHelper(stringBuilder, terminalLocation: true, format == FullPathFormat.AllAncestors);
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		private bool GetFullPathHelper(StringBuilder sb, bool terminalLocation, bool includeAllAncestors)
		{
			if (!includeAllAncestors && !terminalLocation && !IncludeTextInFullPathResolved)
			{
				return false;
			}
			UltraNavigationBar navigationBar = NavigationBar;
			string arg = (terminalLocation ? string.Empty : ((navigationBar != null) ? navigationBar.PathSeparator : "\\"));
			string textResolved = TextResolved;
			string text = ((textResolved.Length > 0) ? $"{textResolved}{arg}" : string.Empty);
			if (text.Length > 0)
			{
				sb.Insert(0, text);
			}
			return Parent?.GetFullPathHelper(sb, terminalLocation: false, includeAllAncestors) ?? false;
		}

		internal bool TextEquals(string text)
		{
			return LocationFromText(text, recursive: false) == this;
		}

		internal UltraNavigationBarLocation LocationFromText(string text, bool recursive)
		{
			return LocationFromText(text, recursive, ignoreCase: true);
		}

		private UltraNavigationBarLocation LocationFromText(string text, bool recursive, bool ignoreCase)
		{
			StringComparison stringComparison = (ignoreCase ? StringComparison.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase : StringComparison.CurrentCulture);
			string[] comparisonStrings = ComparisonStrings;
			if (DoAnyStringsMatch(text, comparisonStrings, stringComparison))
			{
				return this;
			}
			if (IncludeTextInFullPathResolved)
			{
				return null;
			}
			UltraNavigationBarLocation ultraNavigationBarLocation = null;
			NavigationBarLocationsCollection navigationBarLocationsCollection = ((recursive && HasLocations) ? Locations : null);
			if (navigationBarLocationsCollection != null)
			{
				int count = navigationBarLocationsCollection.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					UltraNavigationBarLocation ultraNavigationBarLocation2 = navigationBarLocationsCollection[i];
					ultraNavigationBarLocation = ultraNavigationBarLocation2.LocationFromText(text, recursive: true, ignoreCase);
					if (ultraNavigationBarLocation != null)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return ultraNavigationBarLocation;
		}

		private static bool DoAnyStringsMatch(string text, string[] comparisonStrings, StringComparison stringComparison)
		{
			foreach (string b in comparisonStrings)
			{
				if (string.Equals(text, b, stringComparison))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal Size GetButtonSize(out int textButtonWidth, out int dropDownButtonWidth)
		{
			bool isTextFullyVisible = true;
			return GetButtonSize(out textButtonWidth, out dropDownButtonWidth, out isTextFullyVisible);
		}

		internal Size GetButtonSize(out int textButtonWidth, out int dropDownButtonWidth, out bool isTextFullyVisible)
		{
			textButtonWidth = (dropDownButtonWidth = 0);
			isTextFullyVisible = false;
			UltraNavigationBar navigationBar = NavigationBar;
			if (navigationBar == null)
			{
				return Size.Empty;
			}
			bool hasTextButton = false;
			bool hasText = false;
			bool hasImage = false;
			GetTextButtonInfo(out hasTextButton, out hasText, out hasImage);
			int buttonTextSizeVersion = versionNumbers.ButtonTextSizeVersion;
			int locationTextSizeVersion = navigationBar.versionManager.LocationTextSizeVersion;
			if (cachedButtonTextSize.IsEmpty || buttonTextSizeVersion != locationTextSizeVersion)
			{
				versionNumbers.SyncButtonTextSizeVersion(locationTextSizeVersion);
				cachedButtonTextSize = navigationBar.Metrics.GetLocationButtonTextSize(this);
			}
			Margins locationButtonTextPadding = NavigationBarMetrics.LocationButtonTextPadding;
			Size size = new Size(cachedButtonTextSize.Width + locationButtonTextPadding.Width, cachedButtonTextSize.Height + locationButtonTextPadding.Height);
			Size imageSizeResolved = navigationBar.ImageSizeResolved;
			Margins locationButtonImagePadding = NavigationBarMetrics.LocationButtonImagePadding;
			imageSizeResolved.Width += locationButtonImagePadding.Width;
			imageSizeResolved.Height += locationButtonImagePadding.Height;
			int num = (hasImage ? imageSizeResolved.Width : 0);
			textButtonWidth = (hasText ? size.Width : 0);
			textButtonWidth += num;
			int maximumTextButtonWidthResolved = MaximumTextButtonWidthResolved;
			textButtonWidth = Math.Min(textButtonWidth, maximumTextButtonWidthResolved);
			isTextFullyVisible = maximumTextButtonWidthResolved == 0 || size.Width <= maximumTextButtonWidthResolved;
			dropDownButtonWidth = (HasDropDownButton ? 11 : 0);
			Size locationButtonBorders = NavigationBarMetrics.LocationButtonBorders;
			if (textButtonWidth > 0)
			{
				textButtonWidth += locationButtonBorders.Width;
				textButtonWidth -= (TextButtonDrawsOuterRightBorder ? 1 : 0);
			}
			if (dropDownButtonWidth > 0)
			{
				dropDownButtonWidth += locationButtonBorders.Width;
			}
			Size empty = Size.Empty;
			empty.Width = textButtonWidth + dropDownButtonWidth;
			empty.Height = Math.Max(imageSizeResolved.Height, size.Height);
			empty.Height += locationButtonBorders.Height;
			return empty;
		}

		internal Size GetListItemSize()
		{
			int textAreaWidth = 0;
			return GetListItemSize(out textAreaWidth);
		}

		internal Size GetListItemSize(out int textAreaWidth)
		{
			textAreaWidth = 0;
			UltraNavigationBar navigationBar = NavigationBar;
			if (navigationBar == null)
			{
				return Size.Empty;
			}
			int listItemTextSizeVersion = versionNumbers.ListItemTextSizeVersion;
			int locationTextSizeVersion = navigationBar.versionManager.LocationTextSizeVersion;
			if (cachedListItemTextSize.IsEmpty || listItemTextSizeVersion != locationTextSizeVersion)
			{
				versionNumbers.SyncListItemTextSizeVersion(locationTextSizeVersion);
				cachedListItemTextSize = navigationBar.Metrics.GetLocationListItemTextSize(this);
			}
			Margins locationListItemTextPadding = NavigationBarMetrics.LocationListItemTextPadding;
			Size size = new Size(cachedListItemTextSize.Width + locationListItemTextPadding.Width, cachedListItemTextSize.Height + locationListItemTextPadding.Height);
			textAreaWidth = cachedListItemTextSize.Width;
			Size imageSizeResolved = navigationBar.ImageSizeResolved;
			Margins locationListItemImagePadding = NavigationBarMetrics.LocationListItemImagePadding;
			imageSizeResolved.Width += locationListItemImagePadding.Width;
			imageSizeResolved.Height += locationListItemImagePadding.Height;
			Margins locationListItemBorders = NavigationBarMetrics.LocationListItemBorders;
			int num = 2;
			Size empty = Size.Empty;
			empty.Width = size.Width + imageSizeResolved.Width + num;
			empty.Height = Math.Max(imageSizeResolved.Height, size.Height);
			empty.Height += locationListItemBorders.Height;
			return empty;
		}

		public bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeDisplayText() && !ShouldSerializeIncludeTextInFullPath() && !ShouldSerializeKey() && !ShouldSerializeLocations() && !ShouldSerializeSettings() && !ShouldSerializeTag() && !ShouldSerializeText() && !ShouldSerializeToolTipText())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeVisible();
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			ResetDisplayText();
			ResetIncludeTextInFullPath();
			ResetKey();
			ResetLocations();
			ResetSettings();
			ResetTag();
			ResetText();
			ResetToolTipText();
			ResetVisible();
		}

		internal void DisplayToolTip(LocationElementKind elementKind, bool isFullyVisible, Point screenLocation)
		{
			UltraNavigationBar navigationBar = NavigationBar;
			if (navigationBar != null)
			{
				string text = string.Empty;
				switch (elementKind)
				{
				case LocationElementKind.DropDownButton:
					text = (HasTextButton ? string.Empty : (HasToolTipText ? ToolTipText : DisplayTextResolved));
					break;
				case LocationElementKind.TextButton:
				case LocationElementKind.ListItem:
					text = (HasToolTipText ? ToolTipText : ((!isFullyVisible) ? DisplayTextResolved : string.Empty));
					break;
				}
				LocationToolTipDisplayingEventArgs e = new LocationToolTipDisplayingEventArgs(text, screenLocation, this, elementKind, isFullyVisible);
				navigationBar.EventManager.FireEvent(UltraNavigationBarEventIds.LocationToolTipDisplaying, e);
				text = (e.Cancel ? string.Empty : e.ToolTipText);
				screenLocation = e.ScreenLocation;
				if (text.Length > 0)
				{
					navigationBar.DisplayToolTip(text, screenLocation);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void VerifyTextAgainstPathSeparator(UltraNavigationBar navigationBar)
		{
			if (navigationBar == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			string pathSeparator = navigationBar.PathSeparator;
			string[] comparisonStrings = ComparisonStrings;
			foreach (string text in comparisonStrings)
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					int num = 0;
					if (CanStartWithNetworkPrefix && text.StartsWith("\\\\"))
					{
						num += "\\\\".Length;
					}
					if (text.IndexOf(pathSeparator, num) >= 0)
					{
						throw new Exception(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("UltraNavigationBar_Exception_LocationTextCannotContainSeparator"));
					}
				}
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.Demand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			if (ShouldSerializeDisplayText())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "DisplayText", DisplayText);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeIncludeTextInFullPath())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "IncludeTextInFullPath", IncludeTextInFullPath);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeKey())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Key", Key);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeLocations())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Locations", Locations);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeSettings())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Settings", Settings);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeTag())
			{
				SerializeTag(info);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeText())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Text", Text);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeToolTipText())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ToolTipText", ToolTipText);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeVisible())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Visible", Visible);
			}
		}

		protected UltraNavigationBarLocation(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				switch (current.Name)
				{
				case "DisplayText":
					displayText = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), displayText);
					break;
				case "IncludeTextInFullPath":
					includeTextInFullPath = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), includeTextInFullPath);
					break;
				case "Key":
					Key = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), Key);
					break;
				case "Locations":
					locations = (NavigationBarLocationsCollection)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(NavigationBarLocationsCollection), locations);
					break;
				case "Settings":
					settings = (UltraNavigationBarLocationSettings)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(UltraNavigationBarLocationSettings), settings);
					break;
				case "Tag":
					tagValue = Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(object), tagValue);
					break;
				case "Text":
					text = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), text);
					break;
				case "ToolTipText":
					toolTipText = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), toolTipText);
					break;
				case "Visible":
					visible = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), visible);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		void ISubObjectOwner.DirtyLocationTextButtonMetrics()
		{
			versionNumbers.DirtyButtonTextSizeVersion();
		}
	}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			base.OnSubObjectPropChanged(propChange);
			NavigationBarPropertyIds navigationBarPropertyIds = NavigationBarPropertyIds.Undefined;
			int appearancePropertyCount = base.AppearancePropertyCount;
			int num = appearancePropertyCount;
			int num2 = appearancePropertyCount + 1;
			int num3 = appearancePropertyCount + 2;
			if (appearanceHolder != null)

	public class UltraNavigationBarUIElement : ControlUIElementBase
	{
		private const int OUTER_BORDER_OPACITY = 96;

		private const int MIDDLE_BORDER_OPACITY_LIGHT = 40;

		private const int MIDDLE_BORDER_OPACITY_DARK = 144;

		private const int INNER_BORDER_OPACITY = 240;

		private UltraNavigationBar navigationBar;

		private bool isMouseOver;

		protected override bool ClipChildren => true;

		public override UIRole UIRole => ((navigationBar != null) ? (((UltraControlBase)navigationBar).ComponentRole as UltraNavigationBarRole) : null)?.FromRoleId(UltraNavigationBarApplicationStylingRole.NavigationBarControlArea);

		internal bool IsHotTracking => isMouseOver;

		internal List<LocationUIElement> LocationElements
		{
			get
			{
				UIElementsCollection childElements = ((UIElement)this).ChildElements;
				int count = ((ArrayList)(object)childElements).Count;
				List<LocationUIElement> list = new List<LocationUIElement>(navigationBar.SelectedLocations.Count);
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					if (childElements[i] is LocationUIElement item)
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
				}
				return list;
			}
		}

		internal List<UIElement> AccessibleElements
		{
			get
			{
				UIElementsCollection childElements = ((UIElement)this).ChildElements;
				bool isInEditMode = navigationBar.IsInEditMode;
				UltraNavigationBarLocation expandedLocation = navigationBar.ExpandedLocation;
				int count = ((ArrayList)(object)childElements).Count;
				int num = (isInEditMode ? 1 : (navigationBar.SelectedLocations.Count * 2));
				num += navigationBar.ActionButtons.Count;
				num += (navigationBar.PreviousLocationsDropDownButtonVisible ? 1 : 0);
				if (expandedLocation != null)
				{
					int visibleCountForDropDownList = expandedLocation.Locations.VisibleCountForDropDownList;
					int maximumDropDownItemsResolved = expandedLocation.MaximumDropDownItemsResolved;
					num += Math.Min(visibleCountForDropDownList, maximumDropDownItemsResolved);
					num += ((visibleCountForDropDownList > maximumDropDownItemsResolved) ? 1 : 0);
				}
				List<UIElement> list = new List<UIElement>(num);
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					if (isInEditMode && childElements[i] is EmbeddableUIElementBase)
					{
						list.Add(childElements[i]);
					}
					else if (!isInEditMode && childElements[i] is LocationUIElement locationUIElement)
					{
						LocationTextButtonUIElement locationTextButtonUIElement = ((UIElement)locationUIElement).GetDescendant(typeof(LocationTextButtonUIElement)) as LocationTextButtonUIElement;
						LocationDropDownButtonUIElement locationDropDownButtonUIElement = ((UIElement)locationUIElement).GetDescendant(typeof(LocationDropDownButtonUIElement)) as LocationDropDownButtonUIElement;
						if (locationTextButtonUIElement != null)
						{
							list.Add((UIElement)(object)locationTextButtonUIElement);
						}
						if (locationDropDownButtonUIElement != null)
						{
							list.Add((UIElement)(object)locationDropDownButtonUIElement);
						}
						if (expandedLocation == null || expandedLocation != locationUIElement.Location)
						{
							continue;
						}
						UltraLocationsDropDownListControlUIElement ultraLocationsDropDownListControlUIElement = navigationBar.LocationsDropDownListControl?.UIElement;
						if (ultraLocationsDropDownListControlUIElement != null)
						{
							List<UIElement> accessibleElements = ultraLocationsDropDownListControlUIElement.AccessibleElements;
							if (accessibleElements != null)
							{
								list.AddRange(accessibleElements);
							}
						}
						continue;
					}
					if (childElements[i] is PreviousLocationsDropDownButtonUIElement item)
					{
						list.Add((UIElement)(object)item);
					}
					if (childElements[i] is ActionButtonUIElement item2)
					{
						list.Add((UIElement)(object)item2);
					}
				}
				return list;
			}
		}

		{

			{

				rect.Width -= controlBorders.Width;
				rect.Y += controlBorders.Top;
				rect.Height -= controlBorders.Height;
				return rect;
			}
		}

		protected override void PositionChildElements()
		{
			UIElementsCollection childElements = ((UIElement)this).ChildElements;
			((UIElement)this).childElementsCollection = null;
			NavigationBarMetrics metrics = navigationBar.Metrics;
			Rectangle rectInsideBorders = ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders;
			Rectangle rectangle = rectInsideBorders;
			int previousLocationsDropDownButtonWidth = metrics.PreviousLocationsDropDownButtonWidth;
			int actionButtonAreaWidth = metrics.ActionButtonAreaWidth;
			NavigationBarEditorOwner editorOwner = navigationBar.EditorOwner;
			bool isInEditMode = editorOwner.IsInEditMode;
			UltraNavigationBarLocation selectedLocation = navigationBar.SelectedLocation;
			if (navigationBar.SelectedLocationImageVisibleResolved)
			{
				SelectedLocationImageAreaUIElement selectedLocationImageAreaUIElement = UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)childElements, typeof(SelectedLocationImageAreaUIElement), true) as SelectedLocationImageAreaUIElement;
				if (selectedLocationImageAreaUIElement == null)
				{
					selectedLocationImageAreaUIElement = new SelectedLocationImageAreaUIElement(this);
				}
				Size selectedLocationImageAreaSize = metrics.SelectedLocationImageAreaSize;
				selectedLocationImageAreaSize.Height = Math.Max(selectedLocationImageAreaSize.Height, rectInsideBorders.Height);
				Rectangle rect = rectangle;
				rect.Size = selectedLocationImageAreaSize;
				((UIElement)selectedLocationImageAreaUIElement).Rect = rect;
				((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)selectedLocationImageAreaUIElement);
				rectangle.X += selectedLocationImageAreaSize.Width;
				rectangle.Width -= selectedLocationImageAreaSize.Width;
			}
			if (isInEditMode)
			{
				int num = rectangle.Width - (previousLocationsDropDownButtonWidth + actionButtonAreaWidth);
				Size size = new Size(num, rectInsideBorders.Height);
				Rectangle rect2 = rectangle;
				rect2.Size = size;
				_ = editorOwner.EditorWithCombo;
				EmbeddableUIElementBase embeddableElement = editorOwner.GetEmbeddableElement(selectedLocation);
				((UIElement)embeddableElement).Rect = rect2;
				((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)embeddableElement);
				rectangle.X += num;
				rectangle.Width -= num;
			}
			else
			{
				int widthAvailableForSelectedLocations = metrics.GetWidthAvailableForSelectedLocations(rectInsideBorders.Width);
				int widthRequired = 0;
				List<UltraNavigationBarLocation> visibleSelectedLocations = metrics.GetVisibleSelectedLocations(widthAvailableForSelectedLocations, out widthRequired);
				for (int i = 0; i < visibleSelectedLocations.Count; i++)
				{
					UltraNavigationBarLocation ultraNavigationBarLocation = visibleSelectedLocations[i];
					Size size2 = ultraNavigationBarLocation.Size;
					size2.Height = rectInsideBorders.Height;
					Rectangle rect3 = rectangle;
					rect3.Size = size2;
					LocationUIElement locationUIElement = UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)childElements, typeof(LocationUIElement), true, (object)ultraNavigationBarLocation) as LocationUIElement;
					if (locationUIElement == null)
					{
						locationUIElement = new LocationUIElement((UIElement)(object)this, ultraNavigationBarLocation);
					}
					else
					{
						locationUIElement.Initialize(ultraNavigationBarLocation);
					}
					((UIElement)locationUIElement).Rect = rect3;
					((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)locationUIElement);
					rectangle.X += size2.Width;
					rectangle.Width -= size2.Width;
				}
				NavigationBarEditModeClickAreaUIElement navigationBarEditModeClickAreaUIElement = UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)childElements, typeof(NavigationBarEditModeClickAreaUIElement), true) as NavigationBarEditModeClickAreaUIElement;
				if (navigationBarEditModeClickAreaUIElement == null)
				{
					navigationBarEditModeClickAreaUIElement = new NavigationBarEditModeClickAreaUIElement(this);
				}
				Rectangle rect4 = rectangle;
				rect4.Width -= previousLocationsDropDownButtonWidth;
				rect4.Width -= actionButtonAreaWidth;
				((UIElement)navigationBarEditModeClickAreaUIElement).Rect = rect4;
				((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)navigationBarEditModeClickAreaUIElement);
				rectangle.X += rect4.Width;
				rectangle.Width -= rect4.Width;
			}
			if (navigationBar.PreviousLocationsDropDownButtonVisible)
			{
				PreviousLocationsDropDownButtonUIElement previousLocationsDropDownButtonUIElement = UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)childElements, typeof(PreviousLocationsDropDownButtonUIElement), true) as PreviousLocationsDropDownButtonUIElement;
				if (previousLocationsDropDownButtonUIElement == null)
				{
					previousLocationsDropDownButtonUIElement = new PreviousLocationsDropDownButtonUIElement(this);
				}
				Size size3 = new Size(previousLocationsDropDownButtonWidth, rectInsideBorders.Height);
				Rectangle rect5 = rectangle;
				rect5.Size = size3;
				((UIElement)previousLocationsDropDownButtonUIElement).Rect = rect5;
				((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)previousLocationsDropDownButtonUIElement);
				rectangle.X += size3.Width;
				rectangle.Width -= size3.Width;
			}
			NavigationBarActionButtonsCollection actionButtons = navigationBar.ActionButtons;
			if (actionButtons.VisibleCount <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			Size imageSizeResolved = navigationBar.ImageSizeResolved;
			Margins actionButtonImagePadding = NavigationBarMetrics.ActionButtonImagePadding;
			Size buttonBorders = NavigationBarMetrics.ButtonBorders;
			imageSizeResolved.Width += actionButtonImagePadding.Width;
			imageSizeResolved.Width += buttonBorders.Width;
			imageSizeResolved.Height = rectInsideBorders.Height;
			NavigationBarActionButtonsCollection.VisibleActionButtonsCollection visibleMembers = actionButtons.VisibleMembers;
			for (int j = 0; j < visibleMembers.Count; j++)
			{
				UltraNavigationBarActionButton actionButton = visibleMembers[j];
				ActionButtonUIElement actionButtonUIElement = UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)childElements, typeof(ActionButtonUIElement), true) as ActionButtonUIElement;
				if (actionButtonUIElement == null)
				{
					actionButtonUIElement = new ActionButtonUIElement((UIElement)(object)this, actionButton);
				}
				else
				{
					actionButtonUIElement.Initialize(actionButton);
				}
				Rectangle rect6 = rectangle;
				rect6.Size = imageSizeResolved;
				((UIElement)actionButtonUIElement).Rect = rect6;
				((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)actionButtonUIElement);
				rectangle.X += imageSizeResolved.Width;
				rectangle.Width -= imageSizeResolved.Width;
			}
		}

		protected override bool OnPreMouseDown(ref MouseMessageInfo msgInfo)
		{
			UltraNavigationBar ultraNavigationBar = navigationBar;
			if (((Control)(object)ultraNavigationBar).Enabled && !((Control)(object)ultraNavigationBar).ContainsFocus)
			{
				try
				{
					if (DisposableObject.HasSamePublicKey(((object)ultraNavigationBar).GetType()))
					{
						Utilities.FocusControl((Control)(object)ultraNavigationBar);
					}
					else
					{
						((Control)(object)ultraNavigationBar).Focus();
					}
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool PerformKeyAction(Enum actionCode, bool shiftKeyDown, bool ctlKeyDown)
		{
			return navigationBar.PerformKeyAction(actionCode, shiftKeyDown, ctlKeyDown);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter()
		{
			isMouseOver = true;
			((UIElement)this).OnMouseEnter();
			((UIElement)this).Invalidate(true);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave()
		{
			isMouseOver = false;
			((UIElement)this).OnMouseLeave();
			((UIElement)this).Invalidate(true);
		}

		internal LocationButtonUIElementBase LocationButtonElementFromPoint(Point point)
		{
			UIElement val = ((UIElement)this).ElementFromPoint(point);
			LocationButtonUIElementBase locationButtonUIElementBase = null;
			while (val != null)
			{
				locationButtonUIElementBase = val as LocationButtonUIElementBase;
				if (locationButtonUIElementBase != null)
				{
					break;
				}
				val = val.Parent;
			}
			return locationButtonUIElementBase;
		}
	}

			internal static void DrawControlBorders(Graphics gr, Rectangle rect, Color baseColor, int baseAlpha, Color bottomColor, int cornerSize, bool outermost)
			{
				if (baseColor.IsEmpty)
				{
					return;
				}
				baseAlpha = Math.Min(baseAlpha, 255);
				baseAlpha = Math.Max(baseAlpha, 0);
				Color color = Color.FromArgb(baseAlpha, baseColor);
				bool flag = !bottomColor.IsEmpty;
				if (bottomColor.IsEmpty)
				{
					bottomColor = color;
				}
				cornerSize = Math.Max(cornerSize, 1);
				cornerSize = Math.Min(cornerSize, 2);
				using (Pen pen = new Pen(color))
				{
					gr.DrawLine(pen, new Point(rect.Left + cornerSize, rect.Top), new Point(rect.Right - cornerSize, rect.Top));
				}
				using (Pen pen2 = new Pen(bottomColor))
				{
					gr.DrawLine(pen2, new Point(rect.Left + cornerSize, rect.Bottom), new Point(rect.Right - cornerSize, rect.Bottom));
				}
				Point point = new Point(rect.Left, rect.Top + cornerSize);
				Point point2 = new Point(rect.Left, rect.Bottom - cornerSize);
				Brush brush = null;
				brush = ((!flag) ? ((Brush)new SolidBrush(color)) : ((Brush)new LinearGradientBrush(point2: new Point(point.X, point.Y - 1), point1: point2, color1: bottomColor, color2: color)));
				Pen pen3 = new Pen(brush);
				if (flag)
				{
					gr.DrawLine(pen3, point2, point);
				}
				else
				{
					gr.DrawLine(pen3, point, point2);
				}
				point.Offset(rect.Width, 0);
				point2.Offset(rect.Width, 0);
				gr.DrawLine(pen3, point, point2);
				pen3.Dispose();
				brush.Dispose();
				float opacityScalar = (outermost ? 0.4285f : 0.667f);
				float num = (outermost ? 0.7857f : 0.85f);
				Color color2 = AdjustOpacity(color, opacityScalar);
				Color color3 = AdjustOpacity(color, num);
				Bitmap bitmap = new Bitmap(cornerSize, cornerSize);
				Bitmap bitmap2 = new Bitmap(cornerSize, cornerSize);
				Bitmap bitmap3 = new Bitmap(cornerSize, cornerSize);
				Bitmap bitmap4 = new Bitmap(cornerSize, cornerSize);
				if (cornerSize == 1)
				{
					Color color4 = Color.FromArgb(22, Color.Black);
					bitmap.SetPixel(0, 0, color4);
					bitmap2.SetPixel(0, 0, color4);
					bitmap3.SetPixel(0, 0, color4);
					bitmap4.SetPixel(0, 0, color4);
				}
				else
				{
					bitmap.SetPixel(0, 0, color2);
					bitmap.SetPixel(1, 0, color3);
					bitmap.SetPixel(0, 1, color3);
					bitmap.SetPixel(1, 1, Color.Transparent);
					bitmap2.SetPixel(0, 0, color3);
					bitmap2.SetPixel(1, 0, color2);
					bitmap2.SetPixel(0, 1, Color.Transparent);
					bitmap2.SetPixel(1, 1, color3);
					if (!outermost)
					{
						num *= 0.5f;
						opacityScalar = 0f;
					}
					color2 = AdjustOpacity(bottomColor, opacityScalar);
					color3 = AdjustOpacity(bottomColor, num);
					bitmap3.SetPixel(0, 0, color3);
					bitmap3.SetPixel(1, 0, Color.Transparent);
					bitmap3.SetPixel(0, 1, color2);
					bitmap3.SetPixel(1, 1, color3);
					bitmap4.SetPixel(0, 0, Color.Transparent);
					bitmap4.SetPixel(1, 0, color3);
					bitmap4.SetPixel(0, 1, color3);
					bitmap4.SetPixel(1, 1, color2);
				}
				int num2 = cornerSize - 1;
				gr.DrawImageUnscaled(bitmap, rect.Location);
				gr.DrawImageUnscaled(bitmap2, new Point(rect.Right - num2, rect.Top));
				gr.DrawImageUnscaled(bitmap3, new Point(rect.Left, rect.Bottom - num2));
				gr.DrawImageUnscaled(bitmap4, new Point(rect.Right - num2, rect.Bottom - num2));
				bitmap.Dispose();
				bitmap2.Dispose();
				bitmap3.Dispose();
				bitmap4.Dispose();
			}

			internal static void DrawLocationListItemBorders(Graphics gr, Rectangle rect, Color baseColor, bool outer)
			{
				if (!baseColor.IsEmpty)
				{
					int num = 2;
					using (Pen pen = new Pen(baseColor))
					{
						gr.DrawLine(pen, new Point(rect.Left + num, rect.Top), new Point(rect.Right - num, rect.Top));
					}
					using (Pen pen2 = new Pen(baseColor))
					{
						gr.DrawLine(pen2, new Point(rect.Left, rect.Top + num), new Point(rect.Left, rect.Bottom - num));
					}
					using (Pen pen3 = new Pen(baseColor))
					{
						gr.DrawLine(pen3, new Point(rect.Left + num, rect.Bottom), new Point(rect.Right - num, rect.Bottom));
					}
					using (Pen pen4 = new Pen(baseColor))
					{
						gr.DrawLine(pen4, new Point(rect.Right, rect.Top + num), new Point(rect.Right, rect.Bottom - num));
					}
					float opacityScalar = (outer ? 0.75f : 1.5f);
					Color color = (outer ? AdjustOpacity(baseColor, opacityScalar) : Color.Transparent);
					Color color2 = (outer ? AdjustOpacity(color, opacityScalar) : AdjustOpacity(baseColor, opacityScalar));
					Bitmap bitmap = new Bitmap(num, num);
					Bitmap bitmap2 = new Bitmap(num, num);
					Bitmap bitmap3 = new Bitmap(num, num);
					Bitmap bitmap4 = new Bitmap(num, num);
					bitmap.SetPixel(0, 0, Color.Transparent);
					bitmap.SetPixel(1, 0, color2);
					bitmap.SetPixel(0, 1, color2);
					bitmap.SetPixel(1, 1, color);
					bitmap2.SetPixel(0, 0, color2);
					bitmap2.SetPixel(1, 0, Color.Transparent);
					bitmap2.SetPixel(0, 1, color);
					bitmap2.SetPixel(1, 1, color2);
					bitmap3.SetPixel(0, 0, color2);
					bitmap3.SetPixel(1, 0, color);
					bitmap3.SetPixel(0, 1, Color.Transparent);
					bitmap3.SetPixel(1, 1, color2);
					bitmap4.SetPixel(0, 0, color);
					bitmap4.SetPixel(1, 0, color2);
					bitmap4.SetPixel(0, 1, color2);
					bitmap4.SetPixel(1, 1, Color.Transparent);
					int num2 = num - 1;
					gr.DrawImageUnscaled(bitmap, rect.Location);
					gr.DrawImageUnscaled(bitmap2, new Point(rect.Right - num2, rect.Top));
					gr.DrawImageUnscaled(bitmap3, new Point(rect.Left, rect.Bottom - num2));
					gr.DrawImageUnscaled(bitmap4, new Point(rect.Right - num2, rect.Bottom - num2));
					bitmap.Dispose();
					bitmap2.Dispose();
					bitmap3.Dispose();
					bitmap4.Dispose();
				}
			}

			public static Color AdjustOpacity(Color baseColor, float opacityScalar)
			{
				int val = (int)((double)(int)baseColor.A * (double)opacityScalar);
				val = Math.Min(val, 255);
				val = Math.Max(val, 0);
				return Color.FromArgb(val, baseColor.R, baseColor.G, baseColor.B);
			}

			internal static void AdjustRect(ref Rectangle rectToAdjust, Rectangle containingRect, HAlign hAlign, VAlign vAlign)
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0030: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0031: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0032: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0034: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0042: Expected I4, but got Unknown
				//IL_0079: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_007a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_007b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_007d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_008b: Expected I4, but got Unknown
				rectToAdjust.X = (((int)hAlign == 0) ? rectToAdjust.X : containingRect.X);
				rectToAdjust.Y = (((int)vAlign == 0) ? rectToAdjust.Y : containingRect.Y);
				switch (hAlign - 2)
				{
				case 1:
					rectToAdjust.X = containingRect.Right - rectToAdjust.Width;
					break;
				case 0:
					rectToAdjust.X += containingRect.Width / 2 - rectToAdjust.Width / 2;
					break;
				}
				switch (vAlign - 2)
				{
				case 1:
					rectToAdjust.Y = containingRect.Bottom - rectToAdjust.Height;
					break;
				case 0:
					rectToAdjust.Y += containingRect.Height / 2 - rectToAdjust.Height / 2;
					break;
				}
			}

			internal static void DrawButtonBordersHelper(Graphics gr, Rectangle rect, Color outerColor, Color middleColor, Color innerColor, bool isPressed, bool isHotTracking, bool hasOuterRightBorder)
			{
				DrawButtonBordersHelper(gr, rect, outerColor, middleColor, innerColor, isPressed, isHotTracking, hasOuterRightBorder, hasInnerRightBorder: true);
			}

			internal static void DrawButtonBordersHelper(Graphics gr, Rectangle rect, Color outerColor, Color middleColor, Color innerColor, bool isPressed, bool isHotTracking, bool hasOuterRightBorder, bool hasInnerRightBorder)
			{
				DrawButtonBordersHelper(gr, rect, outerColor, middleColor, innerColor, isPressed, isHotTracking, hasOuterRightBorder, hasInnerRightBorder, forceVerticalBorderFullHeight: false);
			}

			internal static void DrawButtonBordersHelper(Graphics gr, Rectangle rect, Color outerColor, Color middleColor, Color innerColor, bool isPressed, bool isHotTracking, bool hasOuterRightBorder, bool hasInnerRightBorder, bool forceVerticalBorderFullHeight)
			{
				Rectangle rectangle = rect;
				rectangle.Width--;
				rectangle.Height--;
				Pen pen = new Pen(outerColor);
				Pen pen2 = ((!middleColor.IsEmpty) ? new Pen(middleColor) : null);
				Pen pen3 = new Pen(innerColor);
				Point empty = Point.Empty;
				Point empty2 = Point.Empty;
				empty = rectangle.Location;
				empty2 = empty;
				empty2.Offset(0, rectangle.Height);
				gr.DrawLine(pen, empty, empty2);
				if (hasOuterRightBorder)
				{
					empty.Offset(rectangle.Width, 0);
					empty2.Offset(rectangle.Width, 0);
					gr.DrawLine(pen, empty, empty2);
				}
				Rectangle rect2 = rect;
				if (isHotTracking || isPressed || forceVerticalBorderFullHeight)
				{
					rect2.X++;
					rect2.Width -= 2;
				}
				rect2.Height--;
				if (hasOuterRightBorder)
				{
					rect2.Width--;
				}
				if (!hasInnerRightBorder)
				{
					rect2.Width++;
				}
				if (!isPressed && !isHotTracking)
				{
					empty = new Point(rect2.Left, rect2.Top);
					empty2 = new Point(rect2.Right, rect2.Top);
					gr.DrawLine(pen3, empty, empty2);
					empty.Offset(0, rect2.Height);
					empty2.Offset(0, rect2.Height);
					gr.DrawLine(pen3, empty, empty2);
				}
				else if (!isPressed)
				{
					gr.DrawRectangle(pen3, rect2);
				}
				else
				{
					empty = new Point(rect2.Left, rect2.Top);
					empty2 = new Point(rect2.Left, rect2.Bottom);
					gr.DrawLine(pen2, empty, empty2);
					empty = new Point(rect2.Left, rect2.Top);
					empty2 = new Point(rect2.Right, rect2.Top);
					gr.DrawLine(pen2, empty, empty2);
					empty = new Point(rect2.Left + 1, rect2.Top + 1);
					empty2 = new Point(rect2.Left + 1, rect2.Bottom);
					gr.DrawLine(pen3, empty, empty2);
					int num = 1;
					empty = new Point(rect2.Left + num, rect2.Top + 1);
					empty2 = new Point(rect2.Right, rect2.Top + 1);
					gr.DrawLine(pen3, empty, empty2);
				}
				pen?.Dispose();
				pen2?.Dispose();
				pen3?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		internal static bool IsVista => Environment.OSVersion.Version.Major >= 6;

		internal static Margins EmptyMargins => new Margins(0, 0, 0, 0, false);

		internal static Point CursorLocationWithToolTipOffset
		{
			get
			{
				Point mousePosition = Control.MousePosition;
				mousePosition.Offset(0, 20);
				return mousePosition;
			}
		}

		[DllImport("dwmapi", CharSet = CharSet.Auto, ExactSpelling = true)]
		private static extern IntPtr DwmGetColorizationColor(ref uint colorization, ref bool opaque);

		internal static bool GetColorizationColor(out Color color)
		{
			color = Color.Empty;
			bool result = false;
			if (IsVista)
			{
				try
				{
					bool opaque = false;
					uint colorization = 0u;
					DwmGetColorizationColor(ref colorization, ref opaque);
					color = Color.FromArgb((int)colorization);
					result = !color.IsEmpty;
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	internal class ColorSchemeBase
	{
		public static readonly Color DefaultBaseColor = Color.FromArgb(67, 109, 149);

		private Color baseColor = Color.Empty;

		private bool isDefault;

		public Color BaseColor => baseColor;

		public bool IsDefault => isDefault;

		internal ColorSchemeBase(Color baseColor)
		{
			this.baseColor = baseColor;
			isDefault = object.Equals(baseColor, DefaultBaseColor);
		}

		protected Color ColorFromBaseColor(float luminosityFactor)
		{
			return ColorFromBaseColor(1f, 1f, luminosityFactor);
		}

		protected Color ColorFromBaseColor(float hueFactor, float saturationFactor, float luminosityFactor)
		{
			_ = BaseColor;
			return AdjustHSL(BaseColor, hueFactor, saturationFactor, luminosityFactor);
		}

		protected static Color AdjustHSL(Color color, float hueFactor, float saturationFactor, float luminosityFactor)
		{
			float hue = color.GetHue();
			float saturation = color.GetSaturation();
			float brightness = color.GetBrightness();
			hue *= hueFactor;
			saturation *= saturationFactor;
			brightness *= luminosityFactor;
			return XPItemColor.ColorFromHLS(hue, brightness, saturation);
		}

		internal static Color GetBaseColor(VistaColorization colorScheme)
		{
			Color result = DefaultBaseColor;
			switch (colorScheme)
			{
			case VistaColorization.UseOsSetting:
			{
				Color color = Color.Empty;
				if (NavigationBarUtilities.GetColorizationColor(out color))
				{
					result = color;
				}
				break;
			}
			case VistaColorization.Graphite:
				result = Color.FromArgb(25, 32, 40);
				break;
			case VistaColorization.Blue:
				result = Color.FromArgb(24, 80, 184);
				break;
			case VistaColorization.Teal:
				result = Color.FromArgb(34, 115, 138);
				break;
			case VistaColorization.Red:
				result = Color.FromArgb(153, 42, 52);
				break;
			case VistaColorization.Orange:
				result = Color.FromArgb(190, 108, 38);
				break;
			case VistaColorization.Pink:
				result = Color.FromArgb(120, 82, 145);
				break;
			case VistaColorization.Frost:
				result = Color.FromArgb(205, 216, 220);
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}
	}

	public sealed class PropertyNameUITypeEditor : UITypeEditorListBase
	{
		protected override object[] GetListItems(ITypeDescriptorContext context, IServiceProvider provider, object value, ref object currentEntry)
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			ArrayList arrayList2 = new ArrayList();
			if (context.Instance is ValidationSettings)
			{
				arrayList2.Add(context.Instance);
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (ValidationSettings item in (Array)context.Instance)
				{
					arrayList2.Add(item);
				}
			}
			arrayList = GetCommonPropertyList(arrayList2);
			if (arrayList.Contains(value))
			{
				currentEntry = value;
			}
			return arrayList.ToArray();
		}

		protected override object ValidateEditItem(ITypeDescriptorContext context, IServiceProvider provider, object value, object selectedEntry)
		{
			return selectedEntry;
		}

		internal static ArrayList GetCommonPropertyList(ArrayList validationSettingsArray)
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			ValidationSettings validationSettings = validationSettingsArray[0] as ValidationSettings;
			Control control = validationSettings?.Control;
			if (control == null)
			{
				return arrayList;
			}
			PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(validationSettings.Control);
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor item in properties)
			{
				if (item.Attributes[typeof(BindableAttribute)] is BindableAttribute { Bindable: not false })
				{
					arrayList.Add(item.Name);
				}
			}
			for (int i = 1; i < validationSettingsArray.Count; i++)
			{
				control = ((validationSettingsArray[i] is ValidationSettings validationSettings2) ? validationSettings2.Control : null);
				if (control == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				properties = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(control);
				for (int num = arrayList.Count - 1; num > 0; num--)
				{
					string name = (string)arrayList[num];
					PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor2 = properties.Find(name, ignoreCase: true);
					if (propertyDescriptor2 == null)
					{
						arrayList.RemoveAt(num);
					}
					else if (!(propertyDescriptor2.Attributes[typeof(BindableAttribute)] is BindableAttribute { Bindable: not false }))
					{
						arrayList.RemoveAt(num);
					}
				}
			}
			arrayList.Sort();
			return arrayList;
		}

		internal static ArrayList GetCommonPropertyList(ValidationSettings validationSettings)
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			arrayList.Add(validationSettings);
			return GetCommonPropertyList(arrayList);
		}
	}

	public class SoundPropertyUITypeEditor : UITypeEditor

	}
