	public delegate void ValidatingHandler(object sender, ValidatingEventArgs e);
	public delegate void ValidationErrorHandler(object sender, ValidationErrorEventArgs e);
	public class ValidatingEventArgs : EventArgs
	{
		private bool isValid = true;

		private ValidationTrigger validationTrigger;

		private ValidationSettings validationSettings;

		private object value;

		private object entity;

		private ValidationStatus status;

		internal object Entity => entity;

		public Control Control => entity as Control;

		public EmbeddableEditorBase Editor
		{
			get
			{
				object obj = entity;
				return (EmbeddableEditorBase)((obj is EmbeddableEditorBase) ? obj : null);
			}
		}

		public bool IsValid
		{
			get
			{
				return isValid;
			}
			set
			{
				isValid = value;
			}
		}

		public ValidationSettings ValidationSettings => validationSettings;

		public ValidationTrigger ValidationTrigger => validationTrigger;

		public object Value => value;

		public ValidationStatus Status => status;

		public ValidatingEventArgs(object entity, ValidationSettings validationSettings, object value, bool isValid, ValidationTrigger validationTrigger, ValidationStatus status)
		{
			if (validationSettings == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("validationSettings");
			}
			if (entity == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("entity");
			}
			this.entity = entity;
			this.validationSettings = validationSettings;
			this.value = value;
			this.isValid = isValid;
			this.validationTrigger = validationTrigger;
			this.status = status;
		}
	}
	public class ValidationErrorEventArgs : EventArgs
	{
		private NotificationSettings notificationSettings;

		private Validation validation;

		private object entity;

		public bool IsSingleEntityValidation => entity != null;

		public Validation Validation => validation;

		public NotificationSettings NotificationSettings
		{
			get
			{
				if (notificationSettings == null)
				{
					return NotificationSettings.Empty;
				}
				return notificationSettings;
			}
		}

		internal object Entity => entity;

		public Control Control => entity as Control;

		public EmbeddableEditorBase Editor
		{
			get
			{
				object obj = entity;
				return (EmbeddableEditorBase)((obj is EmbeddableEditorBase) ? obj : null);
			}
		}

		public ValidationErrorEventArgs(Validation validation, object entity, NotificationSettings notificationSettings)
		{
			if (validation == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("validation");
			}
			this.entity = entity;
			this.validation = validation;
			this.notificationSettings = notificationSettings;
		}

		public ValidationErrorEventArgs(Validation validation)
			: this(validation, null, null)
		{
		}
	}
	public class UltraValidatorEventManager : EventManagerBase
	{
		internal static readonly object Validating_Event = new object();

		internal static readonly object ValidationError_Event = new object();

		private UltraValidator validator;

		internal UltraValidatorEventManager(UltraValidator validator)
			: base(3)
		{
			this.validator = validator;
		}

		internal void FireEvent(ValidatorEventIds eventId, EventArgs e)
		{
			switch (eventId)
			{
			case ValidatorEventIds.Validating:
				validator.OnValidating(e as ValidatingEventArgs);
				break;
			case ValidatorEventIds.ValidationError:
				validator.OnValidationError(e as ValidationErrorEventArgs);
				break;
			}
		}
	}
	[PermissionSet(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Name = "FullTrust")]
	[PermissionSet(SecurityAction.InheritanceDemand, Name = "FullTrust")]
	public class MessageBoxIconTypeEditor : UITypeEditor
	{
		internal class MessageBoxIconListBox : ListBox
		{
			private IWindowsFormsEditorService edSvc;

			private bool isPopulating;

			public MessageBoxIconListBox(IWindowsFormsEditorService edSvc)
			{
				this.edSvc = edSvc;
				Populate();
			}

			protected override void OnClick(EventArgs e)
			{
				base.OnClick(e);
				if (!isPopulating)
				{
					edSvc.CloseDropDown();
				}
			}

			protected override void OnKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
			{
				base.OnKeyDown(e);
				if (e.KeyCode == Keys.Return)
				{
					edSvc.CloseDropDown();
				}
			}

			private bool Populate()
			{
				try
				{
					isPopulating = true;
					base.Items.Clear();
					Type typeFromHandle = typeof(MessageBoxIcon);
					string[] names = Enum.GetNames(typeFromHandle);
					List<MessageBoxIconWrapper> list = new List<MessageBoxIconWrapper>(5);
					int i = 0;
					for (int num = names.Length; i < num; i++)
					{
						string text = names[i];
						try
						{
							MessageBoxIcon messageBoxIcon = (MessageBoxIcon)Enum.Parse(typeFromHandle, text);
							MessageBoxIconWrapper messageBoxIconWrapper = null;
							for (int j = 0; j < list.Count; j++)
							{
								if (list[j].value == messageBoxIcon)
								{
									messageBoxIconWrapper = list[j];
									break;
								}
							}
							if (messageBoxIconWrapper == null)
							{
								messageBoxIconWrapper = new MessageBoxIconWrapper(messageBoxIcon);
								list.Add(messageBoxIconWrapper);
							}
							messageBoxIconWrapper.AppendName(text);
						}
						catch
						{
						}
					}
					for (int k = 0; k < list.Count; k++)
					{
						base.Items.Add(list[k]);
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					isPopulating = false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal class MessageBoxIconWrapper
		{
			internal MessageBoxIcon value;

			private string displayName = string.Empty;

			internal MessageBoxIconWrapper(MessageBoxIcon value)
			{
				this.value = value;
			}

			internal void AppendName(string name)
			{
				string arg = (string.IsNullOrEmpty(displayName) ? string.Empty : "/");
				displayName = $"{displayName}{arg}{name}";
			}

			public override string ToString()
			{
				return displayName;
			}
		}

		private IWindowsFormsEditorService edSvc;

		private MessageBoxIconListBox lstValues;

		private MessageBoxIconListBox Control
		{
			get
			{
				if (lstValues == null)
				{
					lstValues = new MessageBoxIconListBox(edSvc);
					lstValues.BorderStyle = BorderStyle.None;
					lstValues.Size = new Size(200, 100);
				}
				return lstValues;
			}
		}

		public override UITypeEditorEditStyle GetEditStyle(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			return UITypeEditorEditStyle.DropDown;
		}

		public override object EditValue(ITypeDescriptorContext context, IServiceProvider provider, object value)
		{
			edSvc = (IWindowsFormsEditorService)provider.GetService(typeof(IWindowsFormsEditorService));
			ListBox control = Control;
			edSvc.DropDownControl(control);
			value = ((control.SelectedItem is MessageBoxIconWrapper messageBoxIconWrapper) ? messageBoxIconWrapper.value : MessageBoxIcon.None);
			return value;
		}
	}
	[Serializable]
	[TypeConverter(typeof(NotificationSettingsTypeConverter))]
	public class NotificationSettings : SubObjectBase, ISerializable
	{
		public sealed class NotificationSettingsTypeConverter : ExpandableObjectConverter
		{
			public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
			}

			public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_13"));
				}
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor) && value is NotificationSettings)
				{
					ConstructorInfo constructor = value.GetType().GetConstructor(new Type[0]);
					if (constructor != null)
					{
						return new InstanceDescriptor(constructor, new object[0], isComplete: false);
					}
				}
				return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
			}
		}

		public sealed class SoundPropertyTypeConverter : TypeConverter
		{
			public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(string))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
			}

			public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_13"));
				}
				if (destinationType == typeof(string))
				{
					if (value is SystemSound)
					{
						SoundEditor.SystemSoundConstants systemSoundConstants = SoundEditor.ToSystemSoundConstant(value as SystemSound);
						return systemSoundConstants.ToString();
					}
					if (value == null || (value is string && string.IsNullOrEmpty((string)value)))
					{
						return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("SoundEditor_None");
					}
				}
				return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
			}
		}

		private NotificationAction action;

		private string caption = string.Empty;

		private Image image;

		private object sound;

		private string text = string.Empty;

		private static NotificationSettings emptyValue;

		private bool isReadOnly;

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_ValidatorNotification")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("NotificationSettings_P_Action")]
		public NotificationAction Action
		{
			get
			{
				if (!isReadOnly)
				{
					return action;
				}
				return NotificationAction.None;
			}
			set
			{
				if (isReadOnly)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("NotificationSettings_Exception_ReadOnly"));
				}
				if (value != action)
				{
					action = value;
					NotifyPropChange(ValidatorPropertyIds.Action);
				}
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_ValidatorNotification")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("NotificationSettings_P_Caption")]
		public string Caption
		{
			get
			{
				if (isReadOnly)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				if (caption != null)
				{
					return caption;
				}
				return string.Empty;
			}
			set
			{
				if (isReadOnly)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("NotificationSettings_Exception_ReadOnly"));
				}
				if (value != caption)
				{
					caption = value;
					NotifyPropChange(ValidatorPropertyIds.Caption);
				}
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("NotificationSettings_P_Caption")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_ValidatorNotification")]
		public Image Image
		{
			get
			{
				if (!isReadOnly)
				{
					return image;
				}
				return null;
			}
			set
			{
				if (isReadOnly)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("NotificationSettings_Exception_ReadOnly"));
				}
				if (value != image)
				{
					image = value;
					NotifyPropChange(ValidatorPropertyIds.Image);
				}
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("NotificationSettings_P_Sound")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_ValidatorNotification")]
		[Editor(typeof(SoundPropertyUITypeEditor), typeof(UITypeEditor))]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(SoundPropertyTypeConverter))]
		public object Sound
		{
			get
			{
				if (isReadOnly)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (sound is SoundEditor.SystemSoundConstants)
				{
					return SoundEditor.ToSystemSound((SoundEditor.SystemSoundConstants)sound);
				}
				return sound;
			}
			set
			{
				if (isReadOnly)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("NotificationSettings_Exception_ReadOnly"));
				}
				if (value != sound)
				{
					if (value is string { Length: 0 })
					{
						value = null;
					}
					if (!ValidatorUtilities.IsValidSound(value))
					{
						throw new Exception(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("NotificationSettings_Exception_SoundNotValid"));
					}
					sound = value;
					NotifyPropChange(ValidatorPropertyIds.Sound);
				}
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible)]
		public string SoundAsString
		{
			get
			{
				if (sound == null)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				return sound.ToString();
			}
			set
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
				{
					sound = null;
					return;
				}
				bool flag = false;
				try
				{
					object obj = Enum.Parse(typeof(SoundEditor.SystemSoundConstants), value);
					if (obj is SoundEditor.SystemSoundConstants)
					{
						flag = true;
						sound = SoundEditor.ToSystemSound((SoundEditor.SystemSoundConstants)obj);
					}
				}
				catch
				{
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					sound = value;
				}
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_ValidatorNotification")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("NotificationSettings_P_Text")]
		public string Text
		{
			get
			{
				if (isReadOnly)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				if (text != null)
				{
					return text;
				}
				return string.Empty;
			}
			set
			{
				if (isReadOnly)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("NotificationSettings_Exception_ReadOnly"));
				}
				if (value != text)
				{
					text = value;
					NotifyPropChange(ValidatorPropertyIds.Text);
				}
			}
		}

		internal static NotificationSettings Empty
		{
			get
			{
				if (emptyValue == null)
				{
					emptyValue = new NotificationSettings(isReadOnly: true);
				}
				return emptyValue;
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public NotificationSettings()
		{
		}

		private NotificationSettings(bool isReadOnly)
			: this()
		{
			this.isReadOnly = isReadOnly;
		}

		internal NotificationSettings(NotificationAction action, string caption, string text, Image image, object sound)
		{
			Initialize(action, caption, text, image, sound);
		}

		internal void Initialize(NotificationAction action, string caption, string text, Image image, object sound)
		{
			this.action = action;
			this.caption = caption;
			this.text = text;
			this.image = image;
			this.sound = sound;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeAction()
		{
			return Action != NotificationAction.Default;
		}

		public void ResetAction()
		{
			Action = NotificationAction.Default;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeCaption()
		{
			return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(caption);
		}

		public void ResetCaption()
		{
			Caption = string.Empty;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeImage()
		{
			return image != null;
		}

		public void ResetImage()
		{
			Image = null;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeSound()
		{
			return sound != null;
		}

		public void ResetSound()
		{
			Sound = null;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeSoundAsString()
		{
			if (sound == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (sound is string { Length: 0 })
			{
				return false;
			}
			return sound != null;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeText()
		{
			return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(text);
		}

		public void ResetText()
		{
			Text = string.Empty;
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			NotifyPropChange(ValidatorPropertyIds.NotificationSettings, propChange);
		}

		public bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeAction() && !ShouldSerializeCaption() && !ShouldSerializeImage() && !ShouldSerializeSound() && !ShouldSerializeText())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeTag();
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			ResetAction();
			ResetCaption();
			ResetImage();
			ResetSound();
			ResetText();
			ResetTag();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return string.Format(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("NotificationSettings_ToString_Action", action));
		}

		internal static void Notify(UltraValidator ultraValidator, object entity, object value, ValidationSettings validationSettings, NotificationSettings notificationSettings)
		{
			if (entity == null || validationSettings == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			NotificationAction notificationAction = notificationSettings.Action;
			string text = notificationSettings.Caption;
			string text2 = notificationSettings.Text;
			Image image = notificationSettings.Image;
			object obj = notificationSettings.Sound;
			if (notificationAction != NotificationAction.None)
			{
				if (obj != null)
				{
					ValidatorUtilities.PlaySound(obj);
				}
				else if (notificationAction == NotificationAction.SoundOnly)
				{
					SystemSounds.Beep.Play();
				}
			}
			switch (notificationAction)
			{
			case NotificationAction.MessageBox:
			{
				MessageBoxIcon messageBoxIcon = ultraValidator.MessageBoxIcon;
				MessageBoxButtons messageBoxButtons = MessageBoxButtons.OK;
				Form form = ValidatorUtilities.GetForm(entity as Control);
				UltraMessageBoxManager.Show((IWin32Window)form, text2, text, messageBoxButtons, messageBoxIcon);
				break;
			}
			case NotificationAction.BalloonTip:
			{
				Rectangle rectangle = Rectangle.Empty;
				Control control2 = ((entity is Control) ? (entity as Control) : null);
				if (control2 == null)
				{
					EmbeddableEditorBase val = (EmbeddableEditorBase)((entity is EmbeddableEditorBase) ? entity : null);
					if (val != null)
					{
						EmbeddableUIElementBase elementBeingEdited = val.ElementBeingEdited;
						if (elementBeingEdited != null)
						{
							control2 = elementBeingEdited.Owner.GetControl(elementBeingEdited.OwnerContext);
							rectangle = ((UIElement)elementBeingEdited).Rect;
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					rectangle = new Rectangle(Point.Empty, control2.Size);
				}
				if (control2 != null)
				{
					UltraToolTipInfo toolTipInfo = ultraValidator.GetToolTipInfo(text, text2, image);
					Point p = new Point(rectangle.Right, rectangle.Top);
					Point screenLocation = control2.PointToScreen(p);
					ultraValidator.ShowBalloonTip(toolTipInfo, control2, screenLocation);
				}
				break;
			}
			case NotificationAction.Image:
				if (entity is Control)
				{
					validationSettings.ShowErrorImage(text, text2, image);
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.Demand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			if (ShouldSerializeAction())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Action", Action);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeCaption())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Caption", Caption);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeImage())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Image", Image);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeSound())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Sound", sound);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeText())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Text", Text);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeTag())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Tag", Tag);
			}
		}

		protected NotificationSettings(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				switch (current.Name)
				{
				case "Action":
					action = (NotificationAction)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(NotificationAction), action);
					break;
				case "Caption":
					caption = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), caption);
					break;
				case "Image":
					image = (Image)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(Image), image);
					break;
				case "Sound":
					sound = Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(object), sound);
					break;
				case "Text":
					text = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), text);
					break;
				case "Tag":
					tagValue = Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(object), tagValue);
					break;
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
namespace Infragistics.Win.Misc.Design
{
	public class SoundEditor : Form
	{
		internal enum SystemSoundConstants
		{
			Asterisk,
			Beep,
			Exclamation,
			Hand,
			Question
		}

		private bool isInOnCheckBoxCheckedChanged;

		private bool initialValueWasNull;

		private bool removeSound;

		private IContainer components;

		private System.Windows.Forms.GroupBox grpSystemSounds;

		private CheckBox chkUseSystemSounds;

		private ComboBox cboSystemSounds;

		private System.Windows.Forms.GroupBox grpFileOrURL;

		private TextBox txtFileOrURL;

		private CheckBox chkUseFileOrURL;

		private Button cmdPlay;

		private Button cmdOk;

		private Button cmdCancel;

		private Button cmdBrowse;

		private Button cmdRemoveSound;

		public string Value
		{
			get
			{
				if (removeSound)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				if (chkUseSystemSounds.Checked)
				{
					if (cboSystemSounds.SelectedIndex >= 0)
					{
						SystemSoundConstants systemSoundConstants = (SystemSoundConstants)cboSystemSounds.SelectedItem;
						return systemSoundConstants.ToString();
					}
					return string.Empty;
				}
				if (chkUseFileOrURL.Checked)
				{
					return txtFileOrURL.Text;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public SoundEditor(object initialValue)
		{
			InitializeComponent();
			InitializeUI(initialValue);
		}

		private void UpdateButtonEnabledStates()
		{
			bool flag = chkUseSystemSounds.Checked;
			if ((chkUseFileOrURL.Checked && txtFileOrURL.Text.Length > 0) || (flag && cboSystemSounds.SelectedItem != null))
			{
				cmdPlay.Enabled = true;
				cmdOk.Enabled = true;
			}
			else
			{
				cmdPlay.Enabled = false;
				cmdOk.Enabled = false;
			}
			cmdCancel.Enabled = true;
			cmdRemoveSound.Enabled = !initialValueWasNull;
		}

		private void InitializeUI(object initialValue)
		{
			IList<Button> list = new Button[5] { cmdPlay, cmdOk, cmdCancel, cmdBrowse, cmdRemoveSound };
			IList<CheckBox> list2 = new CheckBox[2] { chkUseSystemSounds, chkUseFileOrURL };
			Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("SoundEditor_Title");
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				Button button = list[i];
				string name = $"SoundEditor_{button.Name}_Text";
				button.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString(name);
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < list2.Count; j++)
			{
				CheckBox checkBox = list2[j];
				string name2 = $"SoundEditor_{checkBox.Name}_Text";
				checkBox.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString(name2);
			}
			grpSystemSounds.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("SoundEditor_grpSystemSounds_Text");
			grpFileOrURL.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("SoundEditor_grpFileOrURL_Text");
			base.AcceptButton = cmdOk;
			base.CancelButton = cmdCancel;
			initialValueWasNull = initialValue == null;
			txtFileOrURL.Text = string.Empty;
			PopulateSystemSoundsCombo(null);
			for (int k = 0; k < list.Count; k++)
			{
				list[k].Click -= OnButtonClick;
				list[k].Click += OnButtonClick;
			}
			for (int l = 0; l < list2.Count; l++)
			{
				list2[l].CheckedChanged -= OnCheckBoxCheckedChanged;
				list2[l].CheckedChanged += OnCheckBoxCheckedChanged;
			}
			txtFileOrURL.TextChanged -= OnTextBoxTextChanged;
			txtFileOrURL.TextChanged += OnTextBoxTextChanged;
			if (initialValue != null)
			{
				SystemSound systemSound = initialValue as SystemSound;
				string text = ((systemSound == null) ? (initialValue as string) : null);
				if (text != null)
				{
					try
					{
						SystemSoundConstants constant = (SystemSoundConstants)Enum.Parse(typeof(SystemSoundConstants), text);
						systemSound = ToSystemSound(constant);
						text = null;
					}
					catch
					{
					}
				}
				if (text != null)
				{
					txtFileOrURL.Text = text;
					chkUseFileOrURL.Checked = true;
				}
				else if (systemSound != null)
				{
					cboSystemSounds.SelectedItem = ToSystemSoundConstant(systemSound);
					chkUseSystemSounds.Checked = true;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				chkUseSystemSounds.Checked = true;
			}
			UpdateButtonEnabledStates();
		}

		private void OnTextBoxTextChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			TextBox textBox = sender as TextBox;
			if (textBox == txtFileOrURL)
			{
				UpdateButtonEnabledStates();
			}
		}

		private void OnButtonClick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (sender == cmdOk || sender == cmdCancel || sender == cmdRemoveSound)
			{
				if (sender == cmdRemoveSound)
				{
					removeSound = true;
				}
				base.DialogResult = ((sender == cmdOk || sender == cmdRemoveSound) ? DialogResult.OK : DialogResult.Cancel);
				Close();
			}
			else if (sender == cmdPlay)
			{
				if (chkUseSystemSounds.Checked)
				{
					SystemSoundConstants constant = (SystemSoundConstants)cboSystemSounds.SelectedItem;
					SystemSound systemSound = ToSystemSound(constant);
					systemSound.Play();
				}
				else
				{
					if (!chkUseFileOrURL.Checked)
					{
						return;
					}
					string soundLocation = txtFileOrURL.Text;
					using SoundPlayer soundPlayer = new SoundPlayer(soundLocation);
					try
					{
						soundPlayer.Play();
					}
					catch
					{
						SystemSounds.Beep.Play();
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (sender != cmdBrowse)
				{
					return;
				}
				using OpenFileDialog openFileDialog = new OpenFileDialog();
				openFileDialog.Title = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("SoundEditor_OpenFileDialog_Text");
				openFileDialog.DefaultExt = ".WAV";
				string arg = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("SoundEditor_OpenFileDialog_Filter");
				openFileDialog.Filter = $"{arg}|*.WAV";
				string text = txtFileOrURL.Text;
				if (text.Length > 0 && File.Exists(text))
				{
					openFileDialog.FileName = text;
				}
				DialogResult dialogResult = openFileDialog.ShowDialog(this);
				if (dialogResult == DialogResult.OK)
				{
					txtFileOrURL.Text = openFileDialog.FileName;
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnCheckBoxCheckedChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (isInOnCheckBoxCheckedChanged)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				isInOnCheckBoxCheckedChanged = true;
				CheckBox checkBox = sender as CheckBox;
				CheckBox checkBox2 = ((checkBox == chkUseSystemSounds) ? chkUseFileOrURL : chkUseSystemSounds);
				bool flag = checkBox?.Checked ?? false;
				checkBox2.Checked = !flag;
				if (checkBox == chkUseSystemSounds)
				{
					cboSystemSounds.Enabled = true;
					txtFileOrURL.Enabled = false;
					cmdBrowse.Enabled = false;
				}
				else if (checkBox == chkUseFileOrURL)
				{
					txtFileOrURL.Enabled = true;
					cmdBrowse.Enabled = true;
					cboSystemSounds.Enabled = false;
				}
				UpdateButtonEnabledStates();
			}
			finally
			{
				isInOnCheckBoxCheckedChanged = false;
			}
		}

		private void PopulateSystemSoundsCombo(SystemSound initialValue)
		{
			if (initialValue == null)
			{
				initialValue = SystemSounds.Beep;
			}
			cboSystemSounds.Items.Clear();
			Array values = Enum.GetValues(typeof(SystemSoundConstants));
			int num = -1;
			for (int i = 0; i < values.Length; i++)
			{
				SystemSoundConstants systemSoundConstants = (SystemSoundConstants)i;
				cboSystemSounds.Items.Add(systemSoundConstants);
				if (num == -1 && initialValue != null && initialValue == ToSystemSound(systemSoundConstants))
				{
					num = i;
				}
			}
			cboSystemSounds.SelectedIndex = num;
		}

		internal static SystemSound ToSystemSound(SystemSoundConstants constant)
		{
			return constant switch
			{
				SystemSoundConstants.Asterisk => SystemSounds.Asterisk, 
				SystemSoundConstants.Beep => SystemSounds.Beep, 
				SystemSoundConstants.Exclamation => SystemSounds.Exclamation, 
				SystemSoundConstants.Hand => SystemSounds.Hand, 
				SystemSoundConstants.Question => SystemSounds.Question, 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		internal static SystemSoundConstants ToSystemSoundConstant(SystemSound systemSound)
		{
			if (systemSound == SystemSounds.Asterisk)
			{
				return SystemSoundConstants.Asterisk;
			}
			if (systemSound == SystemSounds.Beep)
			{
				return SystemSoundConstants.Beep;
			}
			if (systemSound == SystemSounds.Exclamation)
			{
				return SystemSoundConstants.Exclamation;
			}
			if (systemSound == SystemSounds.Hand)
			{
				return SystemSoundConstants.Hand;
			}
			return SystemSoundConstants.Question;
		}

		{
			if (disposing && components != null)
			{
				components.Dispose();
			}
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

namespace Infragistics.Win.Misc

	public class Validation
	{
		private DefaultableBoolean isValid;

		private ValidationResultsCollection results;

		private ValidationResultsCollection errors;

		private ValidationTrigger trigger;

		private static Validation validInstance;

		public bool IsValid
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0046: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_004c: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				//IL_000a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0036: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if ((int)isValid == 0)
				{
					isValid = (DefaultableBoolean)1;
					int i = 0;
					for (int count = results.Count; i < count; i++)
					{
						ValidationResult validationResult = results[i];
						if (validationResult.Status != ValidationStatus.Valid)
						{
							isValid = (DefaultableBoolean)2;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				if ((int)isValid != 1)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public ValidationResultsCollection Results => results;

		public ValidationResultsCollection Errors
		{
			get
			{
				if (errors == null)
				{
					errors = new ValidationResultsCollection();
					int i = 0;
					for (int count = results.Count; i < count; i++)
					{
						ValidationResult validationResult = results[i];
						if (!validationResult.IsValid)
						{
							errors.Add(validationResult);
						}
					}
				}
				return errors;
			}
		}

		public ValidationTrigger Trigger => trigger;

		internal static Validation Valid
		{
			get
			{
				if (validInstance == null)
				{
					ValidationResultsCollection validationResultsCollection = new ValidationResultsCollection(allowModification: false);
					validInstance = new Validation(validationResultsCollection, ValidationTrigger.Default);
				}
				return validInstance;
			}
		}

		internal Validation(ValidationResultsCollection results, ValidationTrigger trigger)
		{
			if (results == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("results");
			}
			this.results = results;
			this.trigger = trigger;
		}

		internal static Validation FromValidationResult(ValidationResult result, ValidationTrigger trigger)
		{
			if (result == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException();
			}
			ValidationResultsCollection validationResultsCollection = new ValidationResultsCollection();
			validationResultsCollection.Add(result);
			return new Validation(validationResultsCollection, trigger);
		}
	}
	internal class ValidationManager
	{
		internal class _ValidationSettingsTable
		{
			private Dictionary<Control, ValidationSettings> controls;

			private Dictionary<EmbeddableEditorBase, Control> editors;

			public ValidationSettings this[Control control]
			{
				get
				{
					if (!controls.ContainsKey(control))
					{
						return null;
					}
					return controls[control];
				}
			}

			public ValidationSettings this[EmbeddableEditorBase editor]
			{
				get
				{
					Control control = null;
					if (editors.ContainsKey(editor))
					{
						control = editors[editor];
					}
					if (control == null || !controls.ContainsKey(control))
					{
						return null;
					}
					return controls[control];
				}
			}

			internal _ValidationSettingsTable(Dictionary<Control, ValidationSettings> controls, Dictionary<EmbeddableEditorBase, Control> editors)
			{
				this.controls = controls;
				this.editors = editors;
			}
		}

		private UltraValidator ultraValidator;

		private Dictionary<Control, ValidationSettings> controls;

		private Dictionary<EmbeddableEditorBase, Control> editors;

		private _ValidationSettingsTable validationSettingsTable;

		private ValidationResult unusedValidationResult;

		private System.Windows.Forms.Timer errorImageBlinkTimer;

		public _ValidationSettingsTable ValidationSettingsTable
		{
			get
			{
				if (validationSettingsTable == null)
				{
					validationSettingsTable = new _ValidationSettingsTable(Controls, Editors);
				}
				return validationSettingsTable;
			}
		}

		public Dictionary<Control, ValidationSettings> Controls
		{
			get
			{
				if (controls == null)
				{
					controls = new Dictionary<Control, ValidationSettings>();
				}
				return controls;
			}
		}

		public Dictionary<EmbeddableEditorBase, Control> Editors
		{
			get
			{
				if (editors == null)
				{
					editors = new Dictionary<EmbeddableEditorBase, Control>();
				}
				return editors;
			}
		}

		public IExtenderProvider IExtenderProvider => ultraValidator;

		public System.Windows.Forms.Timer ErrorImageBlinkTimer
		{
			get
			{
				if (errorImageBlinkTimer == null)
				{
					errorImageBlinkTimer = Utilities.CreateTimer();
				}
				return errorImageBlinkTimer;
			}
		}

		internal ValidationManager(UltraValidator ultraValidator)
		{
			if (ultraValidator == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("ultraValidator");
			}
			this.ultraValidator = ultraValidator;
		}

		public ValidationSettings GetValidationSettings(Control control)
		{
			VerifyValidationSettings(control);
			Dictionary<Control, ValidationSettings> dictionary = Controls;
			if (!dictionary.ContainsKey(control))
			{
				AddControl(control, null);
			}
			return dictionary[control];
		}

		public void SetValidationSettings(Control control, ValidationSettings validationSettings)
		{
			if (validationSettings != null)
			{
				ValidationSettings validationSettings2 = GetValidationSettings(control);
				if (object.ReferenceEquals(validationSettings2, validationSettings))
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			VerifyValidationSettings(control);
			RemoveControl(control);
			AddControl(control, validationSettings);
		}

		private void VerifyValidationSettings(Control control)
		{
			if (control == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("control");
			}
			if (!IExtenderProvider.CanExtend(control))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("UltraValidator_Extender_CannotExtendValidationSettings"), "control");
			}
			if (control.Disposing || control.IsDisposed)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("UltraValidator_Extender_CannotExtendValidationSettingsForDisposedControl"), "control");
			}
		}

		public bool ShouldSerializeValidationSettings(Control control)
		{
			return ((controls != null && controls.ContainsKey(control)) ? controls[control] : null)?.ShouldSerialize() ?? false;
		}

		public void ResetValidationSettings(Control control)
		{
			((controls != null && controls.ContainsKey(control)) ? controls[control] : null)?.Reset();
		}

		public void Dispose()
		{
			RemoveControls();
			if (errorImageBlinkTimer != null)
			{
				errorImageBlinkTimer.Stop();
				errorImageBlinkTimer.Tick -= OnErrorImageBlinkTimerTick;
				errorImageBlinkTimer = null;
			}
		}

		internal void HookEvents(bool unhookFirst)
		{
			Dictionary<Control, ValidationSettings> dictionary = Controls;
			foreach (KeyValuePair<Control, ValidationSettings> item in dictionary)
			{
				Control key = item.Key;
				if (unhookFirst)
				{
					HookEvents(key, register: false);
				}
				HookEvents(key, register: true);
			}
		}

		internal void HookEvents(Control control, bool register)
		{
			//IL_01f4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01fe: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_021b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0225: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0195: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_019f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (ultraValidator.IsInitializing)
			{
				return;
			}
			EmbeddableEditorBase val = null;
			EmbeddableEditorBase val2 = null;
			if ((control.Disposing || control.IsDisposed) && editors != null)
			{
				foreach (KeyValuePair<EmbeddableEditorBase, Control> editor in editors)
				{
					if (editor.Value == control)
					{
						EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase defaultOwner = editor.Key.DefaultOwner;
						Control control2 = ((defaultOwner != null) ? defaultOwner.GetControl((object)null) : null);
						if (control2 == control && val == null)
						{
							val = editor.Key;
						}
						else
						{
							val2 = editor.Key;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				IProvidesEmbeddableEditor val3 = (IProvidesEmbeddableEditor)(object)((control is IProvidesEmbeddableEditor) ? control : null);
				val = ((val3 != null) ? val3.Editor : null);
				val2 = ((val3 != null) ? ValidatorUtilities.GetControlEditor(control) : null);
			}
			Dictionary<Control, ValidationSettings> dictionary = Controls;
			ValidationSettings validationSettings = (dictionary.ContainsKey(control) ? dictionary[control] : null);
			ValidationTrigger validationTriggerResolved = validationSettings.ValidationTriggerResolved;
			string validationPropertyNameResolved = validationSettings.ValidationPropertyNameResolved;
			string validationPropertyName = validationSettings.ValidationPropertyName;
			bool flag = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(validationPropertyName);
			Delegate handler = new EventHandler(OnValidationPropertyChanged);
			bool flag2 = validationTriggerResolved == ValidationTrigger.OnPropertyValueChanged;
			if (register)
			{
				control.Disposed += OnControlDisposed;
				switch (validationTriggerResolved)
				{
				case ValidationTrigger.OnValidating:
				case ValidationTrigger.OnPropertyValueChanged:
					control.Validating += OnControlValidating;
					if (flag2)
					{
						if (!flag && val2 != null)
						{
							val2.ValueChanged += OnEditorValueChanged;
						}
						else
						{
							ValidatorUtilities.HookPropertyChanged(control, validationPropertyNameResolved, hook: true, handler);
						}
					}
					if (val != null)
					{
						val.BeforeExitEditMode += new BeforeExitEditModeEventHandler(OnEditorBeforeExitEditMode);
						if (flag2)
						{
							val.ValueChanged += OnEditorValueChanged;
						}
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				control.Disposed -= OnControlDisposed;
				control.Validating -= OnControlValidating;
				ValidatorUtilities.HookPropertyChanged(control, validationPropertyNameResolved, hook: false, handler);
				if (val != null)
				{
					val.BeforeExitEditMode -= new BeforeExitEditModeEventHandler(OnEditorBeforeExitEditMode);
					val.ValueChanged -= OnEditorValueChanged;
				}
				if (val2 != null)
				{
					val2.BeforeExitEditMode -= new BeforeExitEditModeEventHandler(OnEditorBeforeExitEditMode);
					val2.ValueChanged -= OnEditorValueChanged;
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnControlDisposed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Control control = sender as Control;
			if (unusedValidationResult != null && unusedValidationResult.ValidationSettings.Control == control)
			{
				unusedValidationResult.Initialize(ValidationStatus.Valid, null, null);
			}
			RemoveControl(control);
		}

		private void OnControlValidating(object sender, CancelEventArgs e)
		{
			Control control = sender as Control;
			ValidationSettings validationSettings = ValidationSettingsTable[control];
			if (!VerifyValidationSettings(validationSettings, "OnControlValidating"))
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = validationSettings.RetainFocusOnError;
			switch (validationSettings.ValidationTriggerResolved)
			{
			case ValidationTrigger.OnValidating:
			{
				object controlPropertyValue = validationSettings.GetControlPropertyValue();
				ValidationResult validationResult = ValidationHelper(ultraValidator, controlPropertyValue, control, validationSettings, ValidationTrigger.OnValidating, fireValidating: true, fireValidationError: true, isSingleEntity: true, editorValueIsValid: true);
				bool isValid = validationResult.IsValid;
				flag = flag && !isValid;
				if (isValid)
				{
					validationSettings.HideErrorImage();
				}
				break;
			}
			case ValidationTrigger.OnPropertyValueChanged:
				flag &= validationSettings.LastValidationStatusControl != ValidationStatus.Valid;
				break;
			}
			e.Cancel = flag;
			if (!flag)
			{
				ultraValidator.HideBalloonTip();
			}
		}

		private void OnValidationPropertyChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Control control = sender as Control;
			ValidationSettings validationSettings = ValidationSettingsTable[control];
			if (!VerifyValidationSettings(validationSettings, "OnValidationPropertyChanged"))
			{
				return;
			}
			object controlPropertyValue = validationSettings.GetControlPropertyValue();
			if (control.ContainsFocus)
			{
				ultraValidator.HideBalloonTip();
				ValidationResult validationResult = ValidationHelper(ultraValidator, controlPropertyValue, control, validationSettings, ValidationTrigger.OnPropertyValueChanged, fireValidating: true, fireValidationError: true, isSingleEntity: true, editorValueIsValid: true);
				if (validationResult.IsValid)
				{
					validationSettings.HideErrorImage();
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnEditorBeforeExitEditMode(object sender, BeforeExitEditModeEventArgs e)
		{
			EmbeddableEditorBase val = (EmbeddableEditorBase)((sender is EmbeddableEditorBase) ? sender : null);
			ValidationSettings validationSettings = ValidationSettingsTable[val];
			if (!VerifyValidationSettings(validationSettings, "OnEditorBeforeExitEditMode"))
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = validationSettings.RetainFocusOnError;
			switch (validationSettings.ValidationTriggerResolved)
			{
			case ValidationTrigger.OnValidating:
			{
				if (!e.ApplyChanges)
				{
					flag = false;
					break;
				}
				bool isValid = val.IsValid;
				object value = (isValid ? val.Value : null);
				ValidationResult validationResult = ValidationHelper(ultraValidator, value, val, validationSettings, ValidationTrigger.OnValidating, fireValidating: true, fireValidationError: true, isSingleEntity: true, isValid);
				flag &= !validationResult.IsValid;
				break;
			}
			case ValidationTrigger.OnPropertyValueChanged:
				flag &= validationSettings.LastValidationStatusEditor != ValidationStatus.Valid;
				break;
			}
			((CancelEventArgs)(object)e).Cancel = flag;
			if (!flag)
			{
				ultraValidator.HideBalloonTip();
			}
		}

		private void OnEditorValueChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			ultraValidator.HideBalloonTip();
			EmbeddableEditorBase val = (EmbeddableEditorBase)((sender is EmbeddableEditorBase) ? sender : null);
			ValidationSettings validationSettings = ValidationSettingsTable[val];
			if (VerifyValidationSettings(validationSettings, "OnEditorBeforeExitEditMode"))
			{
				bool isValid = val.IsValid;
				object value = (isValid ? val.Value : null);
				object obj = val;
				Control control = Editors[val];
				IProvidesEmbeddableEditor val2 = (IProvidesEmbeddableEditor)(object)((control != null) ? ((control is IProvidesEmbeddableEditor) ? control : null) : null);
				if (val2 != null && val2.Editor != val)
				{
					obj = control;
				}
				ValidationResult validationResult = ValidationHelper(ultraValidator, value, obj, validationSettings, ValidationTrigger.OnPropertyValueChanged, fireValidating: true, fireValidationError: true, isSingleEntity: true, isValid);
				bool isValid2 = validationResult.IsValid;
				bool flag = validationSettings.LastValidationStatusEditor == ValidationStatus.Valid;
				if (isValid2 != flag)
				{
					EmbeddableUIElementBase elementBeingEdited = val.ElementBeingEdited;
					validationSettings.RefreshErrorAppearance(elementBeingEdited, invalidate: true);
				}
				validationSettings.LastValidationStatusEditor = validationResult.Status;
				if (isValid2 && obj == control)
				{
					validationSettings.HideErrorImage();
				}
			}
		}

		private void AddControl(Control control, ValidationSettings validationSettings)
		{
			Dictionary<Control, ValidationSettings> dictionary = Controls;
			Dictionary<EmbeddableEditorBase, Control> dictionary2 = Editors;
			if (dictionary.ContainsKey(control))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (validationSettings == null)
			{
				validationSettings = new ValidationSettings(this.ultraValidator, control);
			}
			else
			{
				UltraValidator ultraValidator = validationSettings.UltraValidator;
				if (ultraValidator != null && ultraValidator != this.ultraValidator)
				{
					throw new Exception(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("UltraValidator_Exception_ValidationSettingsAlreadyAssociatedWithValidator"));
				}
				Control control2 = validationSettings.Control;
				if (control2 != null && control2 != control)

			Validation validation = null;
			return ValidationHelper(ultraValidator, value, entity, validationSettings, trigger, fireValidating, fireValidationError, isSingleEntity, editorValueIsValid, out validation);
		}

		internal static ValidationResult ValidationHelper(UltraValidator ultraValidator, object value, object entity, ValidationSettings validationSettings, ValidationTrigger trigger, bool fireValidating, bool fireValidationError, bool isSingleEntity, bool editorValueIsValid, out Validation validation)
		{
			return ValidationHelper(ultraValidator, value, entity, validationSettings, trigger, fireValidating, fireValidationError, isSingleEntity, editorValueIsValid, out validation, null);
		}

		internal static ValidationResult ValidationHelper(UltraValidator ultraValidator, object value, object entity, ValidationSettings validationSettings, ValidationTrigger trigger, bool fireValidating, bool fireValidationError, bool isSingleEntity, bool editorValueIsValid, out Validation validation, ValidationResult validationResult)
		{
			validation = null;
			if (validationSettings == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (ultraValidator.validationInProgress)
			{
				return null;
			}
			try
			{
				ultraValidator.validationInProgress = true;
				ValidationStatus validationStatus = ValidationStatus.Valid;
				bool flag = false;
				if (trigger == ValidationTrigger.Programmatic || validationSettings.EnabledResolved)
				{
					bool isRequired = validationSettings.IsRequired;
					bool flag2 = !editorValueIsValid || ValidatorUtilities.IsNullOrEmpty(value, validationSettings.EmptyValueCriteriaResolved);
					bool flag3 = true;
					bool flag4 = false;
					if (!editorValueIsValid)
					{
						flag3 = false;
						validationStatus = ValidationStatus.EditorValueInvalid;
					}
					else
					{
						if (!flag2)
						{
							Type dataType = validationSettings.DataType;
							if (dataType != null)
							{
								object obj = ValueConstraint.ValueToDataValue(value, dataType, (IFormatProvider)null, (string)null);
								if (obj == null)
								{
									flag4 = true;
									flag3 = false;
								}
								else
								{
									value = obj;
								}
							}
							if (value != null)
							{
								ICondition condition = validationSettings.Condition;
								if (condition != null)
								{
									flag = !condition.Matches(value, (IConditionContextProvider)null);
									flag3 = !flag;
								}
							}
						}
						if (flag2)
						{
							flag3 = !isRequired;
						}
						if (flag4)
						{
							validationStatus = ValidationStatus.ConversionFailure;
						}
						else if (flag)
						{
							validationStatus = ValidationStatus.ConditionFailure;
						}
						else if (isRequired && flag2)
						{
							validationStatus = ValidationStatus.ValueNullOrEmpty;
						}
					}
					if (fireValidating)
					{
						ValidatingEventArgs e = new ValidatingEventArgs(entity, validationSettings, value, flag3, trigger, validationStatus);
						ultraValidator.EventManager.FireEvent(ValidatorEventIds.Validating, e);
						if (flag3 && !e.IsValid)
						{
							validationStatus = ValidationStatus.ProgrammaticFailure;
						}
					}
				}
				if (entity is Control && isSingleEntity)
				{
					validationSettings.LastValidationStatusControl = validationStatus;
				}
				ValidationResult validationResult2 = null;
				if (validationResult != null)
				{
					validationResult.Initialize(validationStatus, validationSettings, value);
					validationResult2 = validationResult;
				}
				else
				{
					validationResult2 = new ValidationResult(validationStatus, validationSettings, value);
				}
				if (fireValidationError && !validationResult2.IsValid)
				{
					validation = Validation.FromValidationResult(validationResult2, trigger);
					NotificationSettings resolvedNotificationSettings = validationSettings.GetResolvedNotificationSettings(value, validationStatus);
					ValidationErrorEventArgs e2 = new ValidationErrorEventArgs(validation, entity, resolvedNotificationSettings);
					ultraValidator.EventManager.FireEvent(ValidatorEventIds.ValidationError, e2);
					if (!validationResult2.IsValid)
					{
						NotificationSettings.Notify(ultraValidator, entity, value, validationResult2.ValidationSettings, e2.NotificationSettings);
					}
					EmbeddableEditorBase val = (EmbeddableEditorBase)((entity is EmbeddableEditorBase) ? entity : null);
					EmbeddableUIElementBase val2 = ((val != null && val.IsInEditMode) ? val.ElementBeingEdited : null);
					if (val2 != null)
					{
						((UIElement)val2).DirtyChildElements(false);
					}
				}
				return validationResult2;
			}
			finally
			{
				ultraValidator.validationInProgress = false;
			}
		}

		internal static bool IsValid(UltraValidator ultraValidator, object value, ValidationSettings validationSettings)
		{
			ValidationManager validationManager = ultraValidator?.ValidationManager;
			if (validationManager == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (validationManager.unusedValidationResult == null)
			{
				validationManager.unusedValidationResult = new ValidationResult(ValidationStatus.Valid, validationSettings, value);
			}
			else
			{
				validationManager.unusedValidationResult.Initialize(ValidationStatus.Valid, validationSettings, value);
			}
			Validation validation = null;
			ValidationResult validationResult = ValidationHelper(ultraValidator, value, validationSettings.Control, validationSettings, ValidationTrigger.Default, fireValidating: false, fireValidationError: false, isSingleEntity: true, editorValueIsValid: true, out validation, validationManager.unusedValidationResult);
			return validationResult.IsValid;
		}

		public static Validation ValidateControls(UltraValidator ultraValidator, List<Control> controls, bool fireValidatingEvent, bool fireValidationErrorEvent)
		{
			if (ultraValidator == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("ultraValidator");
			}
			ValidationManager validationManager = ultraValidator.ValidationManager;
			ValidationResultsCollection validationResultsCollection = new ValidationResultsCollection();
			for (int i = 0; i < controls.Count; i++)
			{
				Control control = controls[i];
				ValidationSettings validationSettings = validationManager.Controls[control];
				if (validationSettings != null)
				{
					object controlPropertyValue = validationSettings.GetControlPropertyValue();
					ValidationResult validationResult = ValidationHelper(ultraValidator, controlPropertyValue, control, validationSettings, ValidationTrigger.Programmatic, fireValidatingEvent, fireValidationError: false, isSingleEntity: false, editorValueIsValid: true);
					if (validationResult.IsValid)
					{
						validationSettings.HideErrorImage();
					}
					validationResultsCollection.Add(validationResult);
				}
			}
			Validation validation = new Validation(validationResultsCollection, ValidationTrigger.Programmatic);
			if (fireValidationErrorEvent && !validation.IsValid)
			{
				ValidationErrorEventArgs e = new ValidationErrorEventArgs(validation);
				ultraValidator.EventManager.FireEvent(ValidatorEventIds.ValidationError, e);
			}
			return validation;
		}

		public static void NotifyForMultipleEntityValidation(UltraValidator ultraValidator, Validation validation, bool showErrorImage, bool showMessageBox)
		{
			if (ultraValidator == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("ultraValidator");
			}
			if (validation == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("validation");
			}
			if (validation.IsValid || (!showErrorImage && !showMessageBox))
			{
				return;
			}
			ValidationResultsCollection errors = validation.Errors;
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = (showMessageBox ? new StringBuilder() : null);
			if (stringBuilder != null)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("Validate_ErrorNotificationMessageHeader"));
				stringBuilder.Append(Environment.NewLine);
				stringBuilder.Append(Environment.NewLine);
			}
			Form form = null;
			bool flag = false;
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = errors.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				ValidationResult validationResult = errors[i];
				ValidationSettings validationSettings = validationResult.ValidationSettings;
				object value = validationResult.Value;
				string caption = string.Empty;
				string text = string.Empty;
				Image image = null;
				validationSettings.ResolveNotificationProperties(value, ref caption, ref text, ref image);
				if (showMessageBox)
				{
					if (i == 0)
					{
						form = ValidatorUtilities.GetForm(validationSettings.Control);
					}
					Control control = validationSettings.Control;
					if (control != null && (control.Visible || ultraValidator.ValidateHiddenControls))
					{
						stringBuilder.AppendLine(text);
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				if (showErrorImage)
				{
					validationSettings.ShowErrorImage(caption, text, image);
				}
			}
			if (showMessageBox && flag)
			{
				string text2 = stringBuilder.ToString();
				string messageBoxCaption = ultraValidator.MessageBoxCaption;
				UltraMessageBoxManager.Show((IWin32Window)form, text2, messageBoxCaption, MessageBoxButtons.OK, ultraValidator.MessageBoxIcon);
			}
		}

			{

					ControlUIElementBase mainUIElement = val.MainUIElement;
					if (mainUIElement != null)
					{
						((UIElement)mainUIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
						list2?.Add(control2);
					}
				}
			}
			if (list2 != null)
			{
				int j = 0;
				for (int count2 = list2.Count; j < count2; j++)
				{
					list2[j].Refresh();
				}
			}
		}

		public void OnErrorImageChanged()
		{
			if (ultraValidator.IsDesignMode)
			{
				return;
			}
			Dictionary<Control, ValidationSettings> dictionary = Controls;
			foreach (KeyValuePair<Control, ValidationSettings> item in dictionary)
			{
				ValidationSettings value = item.Value;
				if (value.IsErrorImageVisible)
				{
					value.RefreshErrorImage();
				}
			}
		}

		public void OnErrorAppearanceChanged()
		{

			foreach (KeyValuePair<Control, ValidationSettings> item in dictionary)

		}

		public void OnErrorImageBlinkPropertyChanged(ErrorImageBlinkStyle blinkStyle, int blinkRate)
		{
			switch (blinkStyle)
			{
			case ErrorImageBlinkStyle.Always:
			{
				System.Windows.Forms.Timer timer = ErrorImageBlinkTimer;
				timer.Tick -= OnErrorImageBlinkTimerTick;
				timer.Interval = blinkRate;
				timer.Enabled = true;
				timer.Tick += OnErrorImageBlinkTimerTick;
				break;
			}
			case ErrorImageBlinkStyle.Never:
			{
				if (errorImageBlinkTimer != null)
				{
					errorImageBlinkTimer.Enabled = false;
					errorImageBlinkTimer.Tick -= OnErrorImageBlinkTimerTick;
					errorImageBlinkTimer.Dispose();
					errorImageBlinkTimer = null;
				}
				Dictionary<Control, ValidationSettings> dictionary = Controls;
				{
					foreach (KeyValuePair<Control, ValidationSettings> item in dictionary)
					{
						ValidationSettings value = item.Value;
						value.SetErrorImageVisibility(value: true);
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			}
		}

		private void OnErrorImageBlinkTimerTick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Dictionary<Control, ValidationSettings> dictionary = Controls;
			foreach (KeyValuePair<Control, ValidationSettings> item in dictionary)
			{
				ValidationSettings value = item.Value;
				value.ToggleErrorImageVisibility();
			}
		}
	}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				if (errorAppearanceHolder != null)
				{
					errorAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged -= SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					errorAppearanceHolder = null;
				}
				if (validationGroups != null)
				{
					validationGroups.SubObjectPropChanged -= SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					validationGroups.Dispose();
					validationGroups = null;
				}
				if (notificationSettings != null)
				{
					notificationSettings.SubObjectPropChanged -= SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					notificationSettings.Dispose();
					notificationSettings = null;
				}
				HideBalloonTip(dispose: true);
				if (validationManager != null)
				{
					validationManager.Dispose();
					validationManager = null;
				}
				if (defaultErrorImage != null)
				{
					defaultErrorImage.Dispose();
					defaultErrorImage = null;
				}
			}
			((Component)this).Dispose(disposing);
		}

		protected virtual void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			ValidatorPropertyIds validatorPropertyIds = ValidatorPropertyIds.Undefined;
			if (errorAppearanceHolder != null && propChange.Source == errorAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance)
			{
				validatorPropertyIds = ValidatorPropertyIds.ErrorAppearance;
			}
			OnPropertyChanged(propChange);
			if (validatorPropertyIds != ValidatorPropertyIds.Undefined)
			{
				((UltraComponentBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)validatorPropertyIds, propChange);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			OnPropertyChanged(e.ChangeInfo);
			((UltraComponentBase)this).OnPropertyChanged(e);
		}

		internal void OnPropertyChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			PropChangeInfo propChangeInfo = propChange.FindTrigger(null);
			if (propChangeInfo != null && propChangeInfo.PropId is ValidatorPropertyIds)
			{
				ValidatorPropertyIds validatorPropertyIds = (ValidatorPropertyIds)(object)propChangeInfo.PropId;
				switch (validatorPropertyIds)
				{
				case ValidatorPropertyIds.ValidationTrigger:
				case ValidatorPropertyIds.ValidationPropertyName:
				{
					if (IsInitializing || ((Component)this).DesignMode)
					{
						break;
					}
					if (validationInProgress)
					{
						string text = validatorPropertyIds.ToString();
						throw new Exception(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("UltraValidator_Exception_CannotChangePropertyValueWhileValidating", text));
					}
					Control control = ((propChangeInfo.Source is ValidationSettings validationSettings) ? validationSettings.Control : null);
					ValidationManager validationManager = ValidationManager;
					if (control != null)
					{
						if (validationManager.Controls.ContainsKey(control))
						{
							validationManager.HookEvents(control, register: false);
							validationManager.HookEvents(control, register: true);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						validationManager.HookEvents(unhookFirst: true);
					}
					break;
				}
				case ValidatorPropertyIds.ValidationGroupAdded:
				case ValidatorPropertyIds.ValidationGroupRemoved:
				case ValidatorPropertyIds.ValidationGroupsCollectionCleared:
					DirtyValidationGroupControlListVersion();
					break;
				case ValidatorPropertyIds.ErrorImageAlignment:
				case ValidatorPropertyIds.ErrorImagePadding:
				case ValidatorPropertyIds.ErrorImageSize:
				case ValidatorPropertyIds.ErrorImageTransparentColor:
					ValidationManager.OnErrorImageChanged();
					break;
				case ValidatorPropertyIds.ErrorImageBlinkRate:
				case ValidatorPropertyIds.ErrorImageBlinkStyle:
					if (!IsInitializing)
					{
						ValidationManager.OnErrorImageBlinkPropertyChanged(ErrorImageBlinkStyleResolved, ErrorImageBlinkRate);
					}
					break;
				case ValidatorPropertyIds.ErrorAppearance:
					if (!((Component)this).DesignMode)
					{
						ValidationManager.OnErrorAppearanceChanged();
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			else if (propChangeInfo != null && propChangeInfo.PropId is AppearancePropIds && !((Component)this).DesignMode)
			{
				if (propChange.Source is ValidationSettings validationSettings2)
				{
					validationSettings2.RefreshErrorAppearance(invalidate: true, checkErrorAppearance: false);
				}
				else
				{
					ValidationManager.OnErrorAppearanceChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ResolveErrorAppearance(ValidationSettings validationSettings, bool isProvidedEditor, EmbeddableUIElementBase embeddableElement, ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			//IL_0171: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01a0: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0183: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01ad: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_018c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01c4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0188: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01bb: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01c0: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!ShouldMergeErrorAppearance(validationSettings, embeddableElement))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (validationSettings != null && validationSettings.HasErrorAppearance)
			{
				validationSettings.ErrorAppearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			}
			if (isProvidedEditor && ((ulong)requestedProps & 0x100uL) == 256 && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)256) && validationSettings != null && validationSettings.HasNotificationSettings)
			{
				Image image = validationSettings.NotificationSettings.Image;
				if (image != null)
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).Image = image;
					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFEFFuL);
				}
			}
			if (HasErrorAppearance)
			{
				ErrorAppearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			}
			if (isProvidedEditor && ((ulong)requestedProps & 0x100uL) == 256 && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)256) && validationSettings != null && HasNotificationSettings)
			{
				Image image2 = NotificationSettings.Image;
				if (image2 != null)
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).Image = image2;
					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFEFFuL);
				}
			}
			if (isProvidedEditor && ((ulong)requestedProps & 0x100uL) == 256 && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)256))
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).Image = DefaultErrorImage;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFEFFuL);
			}
			bool flag = ((ulong)requestedProps & 0x40uL) == 64 && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)64);
			bool flag2 = ((ulong)requestedProps & 0x80uL) == 128 && !((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)128);
			if (!flag && !flag2)
			{
				return;
			}
			ErrorIconAlignment errorIconAlignment = ErrorImageAlignment;
			if (flag)
			{
				HAlign val = (HAlign)0;
				val = ((errorIconAlignment != ErrorIconAlignment.MiddleRight && errorIconAlignment != ErrorIconAlignment.BottomRight && errorIconAlignment != ErrorIconAlignment.TopRight) ? ((HAlign)1) : ((HAlign)3));
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).ImageHAlign = val;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFBFuL);
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				VAlign val2 = (VAlign)0;
				switch (errorIconAlignment)
				{
				case ErrorIconAlignment.MiddleLeft:
				case ErrorIconAlignment.MiddleRight:
					val2 = (VAlign)2;
					break;
				case ErrorIconAlignment.TopLeft:
				case ErrorIconAlignment.TopRight:
					val2 = (VAlign)1;
					break;
				default:
					val2 = (VAlign)3;
					break;
				}
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).ImageVAlign = val2;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFF7FuL);
			}
		}

		public Validation Validate()
		{
			return Validate(showErrorImage: true, showMessageBox: true);
		}

		public Validation Validate(bool showErrorImage)
		{
			return Validate(showErrorImage, showMessageBox: true);
		}

		public Validation Validate(bool showErrorImage, bool showMessageBox)
		{
			VerifyValidationNotInProgress();
			List<Control> controlList = ValidationManager.GetControlList();
			Validation validation = ValidationManager.ValidateControls(this, controlList, fireValidatingEvent: true, fireValidationErrorEvent: true);
			ValidationManager.NotifyForMultipleEntityValidation(this, validation, showErrorImage, showMessageBox);
			return validation;
		}

		public Validation Validate(Control control)
		{
			if (control == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("control");
			}
			ValidationManager validationManager = ValidationManager;
			ValidationSettings validationSettings = validationManager.ValidationSettingsTable[control];
			if (validationSettings == null)
			{
				throw new Exception(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("UltraValidator_Exception_Validate_ControlNotAssociated"));
			}
			VerifyValidationNotInProgress();
			Validation validation = null;
			object controlPropertyValue = validationSettings.GetControlPropertyValue();
			ValidationResult validationResult = ValidationManager.ValidationHelper(this, controlPropertyValue, control, validationSettings, ValidationTrigger.Programmatic, fireValidating: true, fireValidationError: true, isSingleEntity: true, editorValueIsValid: true, out validation);
			if (validationResult.IsValid)
			{
				validationSettings.HideErrorImage();
			}
			return validation;
		}

		public Validation Validate(ValidationGroup validationGroup)
		{
			return Validate(validationGroup, showErrorImage: true, showMessageBox: true);
		}

		public Validation Validate(ValidationGroup validationGroup, bool showErrorImage)
		{
			return Validate(validationGroup, showErrorImage, showMessageBox: true);
		}

		public Validation Validate(ValidationGroup validationGroup, bool showErrorImage, bool showMessageBox)
		{
			if (validationGroup == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("validationGroup");
			}
			if (validationGroups == null || !validationGroups.Contains(validationGroup))
			{
				throw new Exception(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("UltraValidator_Exception_Validate_ValidationGroupNotAssociated"));
			}
			VerifyValidationNotInProgress();
			if (!validationGroup.Enabled)
			{
				return Validation.Valid;
			}
			List<Control> controls = validationGroup.Controls;
			Validation validation = ValidationManager.ValidateControls(this, controls, fireValidatingEvent: true, fireValidationErrorEvent: true);
			ValidationManager.NotifyForMultipleEntityValidation(this, validation, showErrorImage, showMessageBox);
			return validation;
		}

		public Validation Validate(string validationGroupKey)
		{
			return Validate(validationGroupKey, showErrorImage: true, showMessageBox: true);
		}

		public Validation Validate(string validationGroupKey, bool showErrorImage)
		{
			return Validate(validationGroupKey, showErrorImage, showMessageBox: true);
		}

		public Validation Validate(string validationGroupKey, bool showErrorImage, bool showMessageBox)
		{
			if (validationGroupKey == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("validationGroupKey");
			}
			if (validationGroupKey.Length == 0 || validationGroups == null || !validationGroups.Exists(validationGroupKey))
			{
				throw new Exception(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("UltraValidator_Exception_Validate_ValidationGroupNotFound"));
			}
			ValidationGroup validationGroup = validationGroups[validationGroupKey];
			return Validate(validationGroup, showErrorImage, showMessageBox);
		}

		private void VerifyValidationNotInProgress()
		{
			if (IsValidationInProgress)
			{
				throw new Exception(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("UltraValidator_Exception_Validate_ValidationAlreadyInProgress"));
			}
		}

		internal void OnValidationSettingsAttached(ValidationSettings validationSettings, bool attach)
		{
			if (validationSettings != null)
			{
				if (attach)
				{
					validationSettings.SubObjectPropChanged += SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
				else
				{
					validationSettings.SubObjectPropChanged -= SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
			}
		}

		internal UltraToolTipInfo GetToolTipInfo(string title, string text, Image image)
		{
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0013: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (toolTipInfo == null)
			{
				toolTipInfo = new UltraToolTipInfo();
			}
			toolTipInfo.Appearance.Image = image;
			toolTipInfo.ToolTipText = text;
			toolTipInfo.ToolTipTitle = title;
			return toolTipInfo;
		}

		internal void ShowBalloonTip(UltraToolTipInfo toolTipInfo, Control control, Point screenLocation)
		{
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0019: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (toolTipManager == null)
			{
				toolTipManager = new UltraToolTipManager(((Component)this).Container);
				toolTipManager.DisplayStyle = (ToolTipDisplayStyle)2;
				toolTipManager.AutoPopDelay = 0;
			}
			if (toolTipHost == null)
			{
				toolTipHost = new Panel();
				toolTipHost.Visible = false;
			}
			toolTipManager.SetUltraToolTip((Control)toolTipHost, toolTipInfo);
			toolTipManager.ShowToolTip((Control)toolTipHost, screenLocation);
		}

		internal void HideBalloonTip()
		{
			HideBalloonTip(dispose: false);
		}

		internal void HideBalloonTip(bool dispose)
		{
			if (toolTipManager != null)
			{
				toolTipManager.HideToolTip();
			}
			if (dispose)
			{
				if (toolTipManager != null)
				{
					((Component)(object)toolTipManager).Dispose();
					toolTipManager = null;
				}
				if (toolTipInfo != null)
				{
					((DisposableObject)(object)toolTipInfo).Dispose();
					toolTipInfo = null;
				}
				if (toolTipHost != null)
				{
					toolTipHost.Dispose();
					toolTipHost = null;
				}
			}
		}

		private static bool ShouldMergeErrorAppearance(ValidationSettings validationSettings, EmbeddableUIElementBase embeddableElement)
		{
			switch (validationSettings?.MergeErrorAppearanceCriteria ?? MergeErrorAppearanceCriteria.Always)
			{
			default:
				return true;
			case MergeErrorAppearanceCriteria.Never:
				return false;
			case MergeErrorAppearanceCriteria.NotInEditMode:
				if (embeddableElement != null)
				{
					return !embeddableElement.IsInEditMode;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnValidating(ValidatingEventArgs e)
		{
			if (((UltraComponentBase)this).Events[UltraValidatorEventManager.Validating_Event] is ValidatingHandler validatingHandler)
			{
				validatingHandler(this, e);
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnValidationError(ValidationErrorEventArgs e)
		{

		bool IUltraValidator.IsValueValid(Control extendee, object value, bool isProvidedEditor)
		{
			if (((Component)this).DesignMode)
			{
				return true;
			}
			ValidationManager validationManager = ValidationManager;
			Dictionary<Control, ValidationSettings> controls = validationManager.Controls;
			ValidationSettings validationSettings = (controls.ContainsKey(extendee) ? controls[extendee] : null);
			if (validationSettings == null || !validationSettings.EnabledResolved)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!isProvidedEditor && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(validationSettings.ValidationPropertyName))
			{
				value = validationSettings.GetControlPropertyValue();
			}
			return ValidationManager.IsValid(this, value, validationSettings);
		}

		void IUltraValidator.ResolveErrorAppearance(Control extendee, bool isProvidedEditor, EmbeddableUIElementBase embeddableElement, ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			if (!((Component)this).DesignMode)
			{
				ValidationManager validationManager = ValidationManager;
				ValidationSettings validationSettings = validationManager.Controls[extendee];
				if (validationSettings != null)
				{
					ResolveErrorAppearance(validationSettings, isProvidedEditor, embeddableElement, ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
				}
			}
		}

		bool IUltraValidator.ShouldValidate(EmbeddableUIElementBase embeddableElement, out Control extendee, out bool isProvidedEditor)
		{
			extendee = null;
			isProvidedEditor = false;
			if (embeddableElement == null || ((Component)this).DesignMode)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (IsValidationInProgress)
			{
				return false;
			}
			EmbeddableEditorBase editor = embeddableElement.Editor;
			ValidationManager validationManager = ValidationManager;
			Dictionary<EmbeddableEditorBase, Control> editors = validationManager.Editors;
			Dictionary<Control, ValidationSettings> controls = validationManager.Controls;
			ValidationSettings validationSettings = null;
			Control control = (editors.ContainsKey(editor) ? editors[editor] : null);
			IProvidesEmbeddableEditor val = (IProvidesEmbeddableEditor)(object)((control is IProvidesEmbeddableEditor) ? control : null);
			isProvidedEditor = control != null && editor == val.Editor;
			validationSettings = ((control != null && controls.ContainsKey(control)) ? controls[control] : null);
			if (validationSettings == null)
			{
				EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase owner = embeddableElement.Owner;
				object ownerContext = embeddableElement.OwnerContext;
				control = owner.GetControl(ownerContext);
				validationSettings = (controls.ContainsKey(control) ? controls[control] : null);
			}
			bool flag = validationSettings?.EnabledResolved ?? false;
			extendee = (flag ? control : null);
			if (flag)
			{
				return extendee != null;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

	internal static class ValidatorUtilities
