		internal static bool IsNullOrEmpty(object value, EmptyValueCriteria criteria)
		{
			if (criteria == EmptyValueCriteria.Default)
			{
				return value == null;
			}
			if (value == null || value == DBNull.Value)
			{
				return true;
			}
			bool result = false;
			switch (criteria)
			{
			case EmptyValueCriteria.Null:
				result = false;
				break;
			case EmptyValueCriteria.NullOrEmptyString:
				result = value is string text2 && text2.Length == 0;
				break;
			case EmptyValueCriteria.NullOrMinValue:
				if (value is string { Length: 0 })
				{
					result = true;
				}
				result = IsMinValue(value);
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		[ReflectionPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand)]
		private static bool IsMinValue(object value)
		{
			if (value == null || value == DBNull.Value)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Type type = value.GetType();
			MemberInfo[] array = type.FindMembers(MemberTypes.Field, BindingFlags.Static | BindingFlags.Public, null, null);
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				FieldInfo fieldInfo = array[i] as FieldInfo;
				if (!(fieldInfo == null) && fieldInfo != null && string.Equals(fieldInfo.Name, "MinValue"))
				{
					object value2 = fieldInfo.GetValue(fieldInfo);
					return object.Equals(value, value2);
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static bool DoesPropertyExist(Control control, string propertyName)
		{
			if (control == null || propertyName == null || propertyName.Length == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Type type = control.GetType();
			return type.GetProperty(propertyName) != null;
		}

		internal static bool HookPropertyChanged(Control control, string propertyName, bool hook, Delegate handler)
		{
			if (control == null || propertyName == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			EventDescriptorCollection events = TypeDescriptor.GetEvents(control);
			string name = $"{propertyName}Changed";
			EventDescriptor eventDescriptor = events[name];
			if (eventDescriptor == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(eventDescriptor.EventType == typeof(EventHandler)))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (hook)
			{
				eventDescriptor.AddEventHandler(control, handler);
			}
			else
			{
				eventDescriptor.RemoveEventHandler(control, handler);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool PlaySound(object sound)
		{
			//IL_008b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0090: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0091: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0092: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0094: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00af: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			if (!IsValidSound(sound))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (sound != null)
			{
				SoundPlayer soundPlayer = null;
				bool flag = sound is SystemSound || sound is SystemSounds || sound is SoundEvents;
				if (sound is string || sound is Stream)
				{
					try
					{
						soundPlayer = ((!(sound is string)) ? new SoundPlayer(sound as Stream) : new SoundPlayer(sound as string));
						soundPlayer.Play();
						soundPlayer.Dispose();
						flag = false;
					}
					catch
					{
						sound = SystemSounds.Beep;
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					SystemSound systemSound = null;
					if (sound is SoundEvents val)
					{
						SoundEvents val2 = val;
						systemSound = (int)val2 switch
						{
							0 => SystemSounds.Asterisk, 
							1 => SystemSounds.Exclamation, 
							3 => SystemSounds.Hand, 
							4 => SystemSounds.Question, 
							_ => SystemSounds.Beep, 
						};
					}
					else
					{
						systemSound = sound as SystemSound;
					}
					systemSound?.Play();
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static bool IsValidSound(object value)
		{
			if (value != null && !(value is string) && !(value is Stream) && !(value is SystemSound) && !(value is SoundEvents) && !(value is SoundEditor.SystemSoundConstants))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public static Point GetErrorImageBounds(UltraValidator ultraValidator, Rectangle controlBounds)
		{
			//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0026: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0049: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0073: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0078: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0082: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0084: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0087: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_00c0: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c2: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (ultraValidator == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("ultraValidator");
			}
			ErrorIconAlignment errorImageAlignment = ultraValidator.ErrorImageAlignment;
			int errorImagePadding = ultraValidator.ErrorImagePadding;
			Size errorImageSizeResolved = ultraValidator.ErrorImageSizeResolved;
			HAlign val = (HAlign)0;
			VAlign val2 = (VAlign)0;
			switch (errorImageAlignment)
			{
			case ErrorIconAlignment.TopLeft:
			case ErrorIconAlignment.MiddleLeft:
			case ErrorIconAlignment.BottomLeft:
				val = (HAlign)1;
				break;
			default:
				val = (HAlign)3;
				break;
			}
			switch (errorImageAlignment)
			{
			case ErrorIconAlignment.TopLeft:
			case ErrorIconAlignment.TopRight:
				val2 = (VAlign)1;
				break;
			case ErrorIconAlignment.MiddleLeft:
			case ErrorIconAlignment.MiddleRight:
				val2 = (VAlign)2;
				break;
			case ErrorIconAlignment.BottomLeft:
			case ErrorIconAlignment.BottomRight:
				val2 = (VAlign)3;
				break;
			}
			int y = (((int)val2 == 3) ? (controlBounds.Bottom - errorImageSizeResolved.Height) : (((int)val2 == 2) ? (controlBounds.Top + controlBounds.Height / 2 - errorImageSizeResolved.Height / 2) : controlBounds.Top));
			int x = (((int)val == 3) ? (controlBounds.Right + errorImagePadding) : (controlBounds.Left - errorImageSizeResolved.Width - errorImagePadding));
			return new Point(x, y);
		}

		public static PictureBoxSizeMode GetSizeMode(Size imageSize, Image image)
		{
			Size size = image?.Size ?? imageSize;
			return (size.Width != imageSize.Width || size.Height != imageSize.Height) ? PictureBoxSizeMode.StretchImage : PictureBoxSizeMode.Normal;
		}

		public static Form GetForm(Control control)
		{
			if (control == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			try
			{
				UIPermission uIPermission = new UIPermission(UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows);
				if (Utilities.CanAssert)
				{
					uIPermission.Assert();
				}
				return control.FindForm();
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
				return null;
			}
		}

		private static EmbeddableUIElementBase GetEditorControlEmbeddableElement(Control control)
		{
			if (!(control is IProvidesEmbeddableEditor) || !(control is IUltraControlElement))
			{
				return null;
			}
			IUltraControlElement val = (IUltraControlElement)(object)((control is IUltraControlElement) ? control : null);
			ControlUIElementBase val2 = ((val != null) ? val.MainUIElement : null);
			if (val2 != null)
			{
				UIElement descendant = ((UIElement)val2).GetDescendant(typeof(EmbeddableUIElementBase));
				EmbeddableUIElementBase val3 = (EmbeddableUIElementBase)(object)((descendant is EmbeddableUIElementBase) ? descendant : null);
				if (val3 == null)
				{
					((UIElement)val2).DirtyChildElements(false);
					((UIElement)val2).VerifyChildElements(true);
					UIElement descendant2 = ((UIElement)val2).GetDescendant(typeof(EmbeddableUIElementBase));
					val3 = (EmbeddableUIElementBase)(object)((descendant2 is EmbeddableUIElementBase) ? descendant2 : null);
				}
				return val3;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static void RemoveAssociatedEditors(Control control, Dictionary<EmbeddableEditorBase, Control> table)
		{
			IProvidesEmbeddableEditor val = (IProvidesEmbeddableEditor)(object)((control is IProvidesEmbeddableEditor) ? control : null);
			if (control == null || val == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<EmbeddableEditorBase> list = new List<EmbeddableEditorBase>();
			foreach (KeyValuePair<EmbeddableEditorBase, Control> item in table)
			{
				if (item.Value == control)
				{
					list.Add(item.Key);
				}
			}
			foreach (EmbeddableEditorBase item2 in list)
			{
				if (table.ContainsKey(item2))
				{
					table.Remove(item2);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	[Serializable]
	[TypeConverter(typeof(ValidationGroupTypeConverter))]
	public class ValidationGroup : KeyedSubObjectBase, ISerializable
	{
		public sealed class ValidationGroupTypeConverter : TypeConverter
		{
			public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (destinationType == typeof(string))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
			}

			public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_13"));
				}
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor) && value is ValidationGroup)
				{
					ValidationGroup validationGroup = value as ValidationGroup;
					ConstructorInfo constructor = value.GetType().GetConstructor(new Type[1] { typeof(string) });
					if (constructor != null)
					{
						return new InstanceDescriptor(constructor, new object[1] { validationGroup.Key }, isComplete: false);
					}
				}
				else if (destinationType == typeof(string))
				{
					if (value is ValidationGroup validationGroup2)
					{
						return validationGroup2.Key;
					}
					return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ValidationGroupTypeConverter_None");
				}
				return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
			}

			public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
			{
				if (sourceType == typeof(string))
				{
					UltraValidator ultraValidator = UltraValidatorFromTypeDescriptorContext(context);
					if (ultraValidator != null)
					{
						return ultraValidator.ValidationGroups.Count > 0;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return base.CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
			}

			public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
			{
				string text = value as string;
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					ValidationGroupsCollection validationGroupsCollection = UltraValidatorFromTypeDescriptorContext(context)?.ValidationGroups;
					if (validationGroupsCollection != null && validationGroupsCollection.Exists(text))
					{
						return validationGroupsCollection[text];
					}
					return base.ConvertFrom(context, culture, value);
				}
				return null;
			}

			internal static UltraValidator UltraValidatorFromTypeDescriptorContext(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
			{
				return ((context != null) ? (context.Instance as ValidationSettings) : null)?.UltraValidator;
			}
		}

		[PermissionSet(SecurityAction.InheritanceDemand, Name = "linkcheck", Unrestricted = true)]
		[PermissionSet(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Name = "linkcheck", Unrestricted = true)]
		public class ValidationGroupUITypeEditor : UITypeEditor
		{
			internal class ValidationGroupsListBox : ListBox
			{
				private IWindowsFormsEditorService edSvc;

				private UltraValidator ultraValidator;

				private bool isPopulating;

				public ValidationGroupsListBox(IWindowsFormsEditorService edSvc, UltraValidator ultraValidator, ValidationGroup initialValue)
				{
					this.edSvc = edSvc;
					this.ultraValidator = ultraValidator;
					Populate(initialValue);
				}

				protected override void OnClick(EventArgs e)
				{
					base.OnClick(e);
					if (!isPopulating)
					{
						edSvc.CloseDropDown();
					}
				}

				protected override void OnKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
				{
					base.OnKeyDown(e);
					if (e.KeyCode == Keys.Return)
					{
						edSvc.CloseDropDown();
					}
				}

				private bool Populate(ValidationGroup initialValue)
				{
					try
					{
						isPopulating = true;
						base.Items.Clear();
						ValidationGroupsCollection validationGroups = ultraValidator.ValidationGroups;
						int selectedIndex = -1;
						int i = 0;
						for (int count = validationGroups.Count; i < count; i++)
						{
							ValidationGroup validationGroup = validationGroups[i];
							base.Items.Add(validationGroup.Key);
							if (validationGroup == initialValue)
							{
								selectedIndex = i;
							}
						}
						SelectedIndex = selectedIndex;
					}
					finally
					{
						isPopulating = false;
					}
					return true;
				}
			}

			private IWindowsFormsEditorService edSvc;

			public override UITypeEditorEditStyle GetEditStyle(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
			{
				return UITypeEditorEditStyle.DropDown;
			}

			public override object EditValue(ITypeDescriptorContext context, IServiceProvider provider, object value)
			{
				edSvc = (IWindowsFormsEditorService)provider.GetService(typeof(IWindowsFormsEditorService));
				UltraValidator ultraValidator = ValidationGroupTypeConverter.UltraValidatorFromTypeDescriptorContext(context);
				if (ultraValidator != null)
				{
					ListBox listBox = new ValidationGroupsListBox(edSvc, ultraValidator, value as ValidationGroup);
					edSvc.DropDownControl(listBox);
					string text = listBox.SelectedItem as string;
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
					{
						ValidationGroupsCollection validationGroups = ultraValidator.ValidationGroups;
						if (validationGroups.Exists(text))
						{
							return validationGroups[text];
						}
					}
				}
				return base.EditValue(context, provider, value);
			}
		}

		private void VerifyControls()
		{
			UltraValidator ultraValidator = UltraValidator;
			int num = ultraValidator?.ValidationGroupControlListVersion ?? controlsVersion;
			if (controlsVersion == num)
			{
				return;
			}
			controlsVersion = num;
			Dictionary<Control, ValidationSettings> dictionary = ultraValidator.ValidationManager.Controls;
			Controls.Clear();
			foreach (KeyValuePair<Control, ValidationSettings> item2 in dictionary)
			{
				Control item = item2.Key;
				ValidationSettings value = item2.Value;
				if (value != null && value.ValidationGroup == this)
				{
					controls.Add(item);
				}
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.Demand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			if (ShouldSerializeEnabled())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Enabled", Enabled);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeTag())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Tag", Tag);
			}
		}

		protected ValidationGroup(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				switch (current.Name)
				{
				case "Enabled":
					enabled = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), enabled);
					break;
				case "Tag":
					tagValue = Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(object), tagValue);
					break;
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public class ValidationGroupsCollection : KeyedSubObjectsCollectionBase, ISerializable, IList, ICollection, IEnumerable

				: base(groups)
			{
			}
		}

		private int initialCapacity = 5;

		private int collectionVersion;

		private UltraValidator ultraValidator;

		public bool IsFixedSize => false;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		protected override int InitialCapacity => initialCapacity;

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public override bool IsReadOnly => false;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public UltraValidator UltraValidator => ultraValidator;

		public override int Count => base.Count;

		public ValidationGroup this[string key] => base.GetItem(key) as ValidationGroup;

		object IList.this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return base.GetItem(index);
			}
			set
			{
				ValidationGroup validationGroup = value as ValidationGroup;
				RemoveAt(index);
				InsertHelper(index, validationGroup, notify: true);
			}
		}

		internal ValidationGroupsCollection(UltraValidator ultraValidator)
		{
			InitUltraValidator(ultraValidator);
		}

		protected ValidationGroupsCollection(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				if (current.Value is ValidationGroup)
				{
					if (Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(ValidationGroup), null) is ValidationGroup validationGroup)
					{
						AddHelper(validationGroup, notify: false);
					}
					continue;
				}
				switch (current.Name)
				{
				case "Count":
					initialCapacity = Math.Max(initialCapacity, (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), initialCapacity));
					break;
				case "Tag":
					DeserializeTag(info, "Tag");
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.Demand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Count", Count);
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				ValidationGroup value = GetItem(i) as ValidationGroup;
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, i.ToString(), value);
			}
			SerializeTag(info);
		}

		internal void InitUltraValidator(UltraValidator ultraValidator)
		{
			this.ultraValidator = ultraValidator;
		}

		protected internal virtual bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (Count <= 0)
			{
				return ShouldSerializeTag();
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal int AddHelper(ValidationGroup group, bool notify)
		{
			InsertHelper(Count, group, notify);
			return Count - 1;
		}

		internal void InsertHelper(int index, ValidationGroup group, bool notify)
		{
			VerifyGroupCanBelongToCollection(group);
			try
			{
				InternalInsert(index, group);
			}
			catch
			{
				if (Exists(group.Key))
				{
					throw new Exception(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ValidationGroupsCollection_KeyMustBeUnique", group.Key));
				}
			}
			group.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			group.InitParentCollection(this);
			OnCollectionChanged();
			if (notify)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(ValidatorPropertyIds.ValidationGroupAdded);
			}
		}

		internal void RemoveHelper(int index, bool notify)
		{
			ValidationGroup validationGroup = this[index];
			validationGroup.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			InternalRemoveAt(index);
			validationGroup.OnRemovedFromCollection();
			OnCollectionChanged();
			if (notify)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(ValidatorPropertyIds.ValidationGroupRemoved);
			}
		}

		private void VerifyGroupCanBelongToCollection(ValidationGroup group)
		{
			if (group == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("group");
			}
			if (Contains(group))
			{
				throw new Exception(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ValidationGroupsCollection_Exception_CannotAddToSameCollection"));
			}
			ValidationGroupsCollection parentCollection = group.ParentCollection;
			if (parentCollection != null && parentCollection != this)
			{
				throw new Exception(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ValidationGroupsCollection_Exception_CannotBelongToMoreThanOneCollection"));
			}
		}

		public int Add(ValidationGroup group)
		{
			return AddHelper(group, notify: true);
		}

		public ValidationGroup Add(string key)
		{
			ValidationGroup validationGroup = new ValidationGroup(key);
			AddHelper(validationGroup, notify: true);
			return validationGroup;
		}

		public void Insert(int index, ValidationGroup group)
		{
			InsertHelper(index, group, notify: true);
		}

		public void Remove(ValidationGroup value)
		{
			int index = IndexOf(value);
			RemoveHelper(index, notify: true);
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			RemoveHelper(index, notify: true);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			ClearHelper(notify: true, dispose: false);
		}

		private void ClearHelper(bool notify, bool dispose)
		{
			int count = Count;
			for (int num = count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				ValidationGroup validationGroup = this[num];
				RemoveHelper(num, notify: false);
				if (dispose)
				{
					validationGroup.Dispose();
				}
			}
			if (notify && count > 0)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(ValidatorPropertyIds.ValidationGroupsCollectionCleared);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			NotifyPropChange(ValidatorPropertyIds.ValidationGroups, propChange);
		}

		internal void OnCollectionChanged()
		{
			collectionVersion++;
			if (collectionVersion == int.MaxValue)
			{
				collectionVersion = 0;
			}
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			Clear();
			ResetTag();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return string.Empty;
		}

		int IList.Add(object value)
		{
			if (!(value is ValidationGroup validationGroup))
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("group");
			}
			return AddHelper(validationGroup, notify: true);
		}

		void IList.Insert(int index, object value)
		{
			if (!(value is ValidationGroup validationGroup))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("value");
			}
			InsertHelper(index, validationGroup, notify: true);
		}

		void IList.Remove(object value)
		{
			if (!(value is ValidationGroup value2))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("value");
			}
			RemoveHelper(IndexOf(value2), notify: true);
		}

		void IList.Clear()
		{
			Clear();
		}

		void IList.RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			RemoveAt(index);
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			base.OnDispose();
			ClearHelper(notify: false, dispose: true);
		}

		bool IList.Contains(object P_0)
		{
			return Contains(P_0);
		}
	}

	public class ValidationResultsCollection : ReadOnlyCollectionBase
	{
		public class ValidationResultsEnumerator : IEnumerator
		{
			private int position = -1;

			private ValidationResultsCollection collection;

			object IEnumerator.Current
			{
				get
				{
					if (position < 0)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return collection[position];
				}
			}

			public ValidationResultsEnumerator(ValidationResultsCollection collection)
			{
				this.collection = collection;
			}

			bool IEnumerator.MoveNext()
			{
				if (position < collection.Count - 1)
				{
					position++;
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}

			void IEnumerator.Reset()
			{
				position = -1;
			}
		}

		private List<ValidationResult> list;

		private bool allowModification = true;

		private List<ValidationResult> List
		{
			get
			{
				if (list == null)
				{
					list = new List<ValidationResult>();
				}
				return list;
			}
		}

		public override int Count
		{
			get
			{
				if (!allowModification)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return List.Count;
			}
		}

		public ValidationResult this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				if (list == null)
				{
					throw new IndexOutOfRangeException();
				}
				return list[index];
			}
		}

		internal ValidationResultsCollection()
			: this(allowModification: true)
		{
		}

		internal ValidationResultsCollection(bool allowModification)
		{
			this.allowModification = allowModification;
		}

		internal void Add(ValidationResult validationResult)
		{
			if (!allowModification)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot modify collection.");
			}
			List.Add(validationResult);
		}

		internal void Remove(ValidationResult validationResult)
		{
			List.Remove(validationResult);
		}

		internal void Clear()
		{
			List.Clear();
		}
	}

			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))

					return true;
				}
				return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);

			public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_Exception_13"));
				}
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor) && value is ValidationSettings)
				{
					ValidationSettings validationSettings = value as ValidationSettings;
					ConstructorInfo constructor = value.GetType().GetConstructor(new Type[2]
					{
						typeof(UltraValidator),
						typeof(Control)
					});
					if (constructor != null)
					{
						return new InstanceDescriptor(constructor, new object[2] { validationSettings.UltraValidator, validationSettings.Control }, isComplete: false);
					}
				}
				return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
			}
		}

		[Editor(typeof(ValidationGroup.ValidationGroupUITypeEditor), typeof(UITypeEditor))]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("ValidationSettings_P_ValidationGroup")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Misc")]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public ValidationGroup ValidationGroup
		{
			get
			{
				if (this.validationGroup != null)
				{
					return this.validationGroup;
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(validationGroupKey))
				{
					UltraValidator ultraValidator = UltraValidator;
					ValidationGroup validationGroup = ValidationGroupFromKey(validationGroupKey, ultraValidator);
					if (validationGroup != null)
					{
						SetValidationGroup(validationGroup);
						validationGroupKey = null;
					}
				}
				return this.validationGroup;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == validationGroup)
				{
					return;
				}
				validationGroupKey = null;
				if (value != null)
				{
					UltraValidator ultraValidator = UltraValidator;
					if (ultraValidator != null && ultraValidator.IsDesignMode)
					{
						validationGroupKey = value.Key;
					}
				}
				if (value != null && (this.ultraValidator == null || !this.ultraValidator.ValidationGroups.Contains(value)))
				{
					throw new Exception(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ValidationSettings_Exception_ValidationGroup"));
				}
				SetValidationGroup(value);
				NotifyPropChange(ValidatorPropertyIds.ValidationGroup);
			}
		}

		internal void ResolveNotificationProperties(object value, ref NotificationAction action, ref string caption, ref string text, ref Image image, ref object sound, ValidationStatus status)
		{
			UltraValidator ultraValidator = UltraValidator;
			NotificationSettings notificationSettings = (HasNotificationSettings ? NotificationSettings : null);
			NotificationSettings notificationSettings2 = ((ultraValidator != null && ultraValidator.HasNotificationSettings) ? ultraValidator.NotificationSettings : null);
			action = NotificationAction.Default;
			caption = null;
			text = null;
			image = null;
			sound = null;
			if (notificationSettings != null)
			{
				action = notificationSettings.Action;
				caption = notificationSettings.Caption;
				text = notificationSettings.Text;
				image = notificationSettings.Image;
				sound = notificationSettings.Sound;
			}
			if (notificationSettings2 != null)
			{
				action = ((action == NotificationAction.Default) ? notificationSettings2.Action : action);
				caption = ((caption == null) ? notificationSettings2.Caption : caption);
				text = ((text == null) ? notificationSettings2.Text : text);
				image = ((image == null) ? notificationSettings2.Image : image);
				sound = ((sound == null) ? notificationSettings2.Sound : sound);
			}
			if (action == NotificationAction.Default)
			{
				action = NotificationAction.Image;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(caption))
			{
				caption = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("NotificationSettings_DefaultCaption");
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
			{
				if (status == ValidationStatus.ConversionFailure)
				{
					Type type = ((dataType != null) ? dataType : typeof(object));
					text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("NotificationSettings_DefaultText_ConversionFailure", value, type);
				}
				else if (ValidatorUtilities.IsNullOrEmpty(value, EmptyValueCriteriaResolved))
				{
					text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("NotificationSettings_DefaultText_RequiredValueMissing");
				}
				else
				{
					text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("NotificationSettings_DefaultText", value);
				}
			}
			if (image == null)
			{
				image = ultraValidator.DefaultErrorImage;
			}
		}

		private bool ShowErrorImage(string caption, string text, Image image, bool show)
		{
			Control control = Control;
			if (control == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!show)
			{
				if (errorImageControl == null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				errorImageControl.HideErrorImage();
				return true;
			}
			UltraValidator ultraValidator = UltraValidator;
			if (ultraValidator == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Control control2 = null;
			try
			{
				control2 = control.Parent;
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			if (control2 == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Size errorImageSizeResolved = ultraValidator.ErrorImageSizeResolved;
			Color errorImageTransparentColor = ultraValidator.ErrorImageTransparentColor;
			if (errorImageControl == null)
			{
				errorImageControl = ErrorImageControl.CreateInstance(Control, UltraValidator);
			}
			errorImageControl.SetImage(image, errorImageSizeResolved, errorImageTransparentColor);
			PictureBoxSizeMode sizeMode = ValidatorUtilities.GetSizeMode(errorImageSizeResolved, image);
			errorImageControl.Size = errorImageSizeResolved;
			errorImageControl.SizeMode = sizeMode;
			UltraToolTipInfo val = SetErrorImageToolTipInfo(caption, text);
			ultraValidator.ToolTipManager.SetUltraToolTip((Control)errorImageControl, val);
			Rectangle bounds = control.Bounds;
			Point errorImageBounds = ValidatorUtilities.GetErrorImageBounds(ultraValidator, bounds);
			errorImageControl.Location = errorImageBounds;
			errorImageControl.ShowErrorImage();
			return true;
		}

		private UltraToolTipInfo SetErrorImageToolTipInfo(string caption, string text)
		{
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

		internal bool RefreshErrorImage()
		{
			if (!IsErrorImageVisible)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (errorImageToolTipInfo == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			string toolTipTitle = errorImageToolTipInfo.ToolTipTitle;
			string toolTipText = errorImageToolTipInfo.ToolTipText;
			Image image = errorImageControl.Image;
			HideErrorImage();
			ShowErrorImage(toolTipTitle, toolTipText, image);
			return true;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerialize())
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			bool flag = Enabled;
			if (!flag)
			{
				return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ValidationSettings_ToString_Enabled", flag);
			}
			bool flag2 = IsRequired;
			if (flag2)
			{
				return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ValidationSettings_ToString_IsRequired", flag2);
			}
			ICondition val = Condition;
			if (val != null)
			{
				return ((object)val).GetType().Name;
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.Demand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			if (ShouldSerializeCondition())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Condition", Condition);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeDataType())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "DataType", dataType);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeEnabled())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Enabled", enabled);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeEmptyValueCriteria())

				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "EmptyValueCriteria", emptyValueCriteria);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeErrorAppearance())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ErrorAppearance", errorAppearanceHolder);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeIsRequired())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "IsRequired", isRequired);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeNotificationSettings())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "NotificationSettings", notificationSettings);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeRetainFocusOnError())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "RetainFocusOnError", retainFocusOnError);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeValidationTrigger())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ValidationTrigger", validationTrigger);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeValidationGroup())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ValidationGroupKey", ValidationGroup.Key);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeValidationPropertyName())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ValidationPropertyName", ValidationPropertyName);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeTag())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Tag", Tag);
			}
		}

		protected ValidationSettings(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			//IL_0157: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0161: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_01f9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0203: Expected O, but got Unknown
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				switch (current.Name)
				{
				case "Condition":
					condition = (ICondition)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(ICondition), condition);
					break;
				case "DataType":
					dataType = (Type)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(Type), dataType);
					break;
				case "Enabled":
					enabled = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), enabled);
					break;
				case "EmptyValueCriteria":
					emptyValueCriteria = (EmptyValueCriteria)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(EmptyValueCriteria), emptyValueCriteria);
					break;
				case "ErrorAppearance":
					errorAppearanceHolder = (AppearanceHolder)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(AppearanceHolder), errorAppearanceHolder);
					break;
				case "IsRequired":
					isRequired = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), isRequired);
					break;
				case "NotificationSettings":
					notificationSettings = (NotificationSettings)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(NotificationSettings), notificationSettings);
					break;
				case "RetainFocusOnError":
					retainFocusOnError = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), retainFocusOnError);
					break;
				case "ValidationTrigger":
					validationTrigger = (ValidationTrigger)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(ValidationTrigger), validationTrigger);
					break;
				case "ValidationGroupKey":
					validationGroupKey = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), validationGroupKey);
					break;
				case "ValidationPropertyName":
					validationPropertyName = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), validationPropertyName);
					break;
				case "Tag":
					tagValue = Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(object), tagValue);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

			}

		internal static ErrorImageControl CreateInstance(Control control, UltraValidator ultraValidator)
		{
			ErrorImageControl errorImageControl = new ErrorImageControl();
			errorImageControl.control = control;
			errorImageControl.ultraValidator = ultraValidator;
			errorImageControl.HookControlEvents(hook: true);
			return errorImageControl;
		}

		private void HookControlEvents(bool hook)
		{
			if (control != null)
			{
				if (hook)
				{
					control.VisibleChanged += OnControlVisibleChanged;
					control.SizeChanged += OnControlBoundsChanged;
					control.LocationChanged += OnControlBoundsChanged;
				}
				else
				{
					control.VisibleChanged -= OnControlVisibleChanged;
					control.SizeChanged -= OnControlBoundsChanged;
					control.LocationChanged -= OnControlBoundsChanged;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void SetImage(Image image, Size imageSize, Color transparentColor)
		{
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0026: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (image != base.Image)
			{
				base.Image = image;
			}
			if (imageRegion == null)
			{
				imageRegion = new ImageRegion(image, transparentColor, imageSize);
			}
			else
			{
				if (image != imageRegion.ShapeImage)
				{
					imageRegion.ShapeImage = image;
				}
				if (imageSize != imageRegion.ShapeSize)
				{
					imageRegion.ShapeSize = imageSize;
				}
				if (transparentColor != imageRegion.TransparentColor)
				{
					imageRegion.TransparentColor = transparentColor;
				}
			}
			Region region = imageRegion.Region;
			if (base.Region != region)
			{
				base.Region = region;
			}
		}

		internal bool SetParentSafe(Control parent)
		{
			containerControl = null;
			try
			{
				base.Parent = parent;
				containerControl = parent;
			}
			catch
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (imageRegion != null)
			{
				((DisposableObject)(object)imageRegion).Dispose();
				imageRegion = null;
			}
			HookControlEvents(hook: false);
			control = null;
			containerControl = null;
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		protected override void OnDoubleClick(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (IsControlAlive)
			{
				control.Select();
			}
			base.OnDoubleClick(e);
		}

		internal void SetErrorImageVisibility(bool value)
		{
			if (!base.IsDisposed && !base.Disposing && IsControlVisible)
			{
				SetVisibility(value);
			}
		}

		internal void ToggleErrorImageVisibility()
		{
			if (!base.IsDisposed && !base.Disposing && IsControlVisible && containerControl != null)
			{
				if (isMouseOver)
				{
					SetVisibility(visible: true);
				}
				else
				{
					base.Visible = !base.Visible;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ShowErrorImage()
		{
			ShowErrorImageHelper(show: true);
		}

		internal void HideErrorImage()
		{
			ShowErrorImageHelper(show: false);
		}

		internal bool ShowErrorImageHelper(bool show)
		{
			if (this.control == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			hasError = show;
			if (!show)
			{
				SetParentSafe(null);
				return true;
			}
			Control control = null;
			try
			{
				control = this.control.Parent;
			}
			catch
			{
			}
			if (control == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			containerControl = control;
			if (!SetParentSafe(control))
			{
				return false;
			}
			SetVisibility(this.control.Visible);
			return true;
		}

		private void SetVisibility(bool visible)
		{
			base.Visible = visible;
			if (visible)
			{
				BringToFront();
			}
		}

		private void OnControlVisibleChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Control control = sender as Control;
			if (this.control != null)
			{
				bool visible = control.Visible;
				SetVisibility(visible);
			}
		}

		private void OnControlBoundsChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Control control = sender as Control;
			if (this.control != null)
			{
				Point errorImageBounds = ValidatorUtilities.GetErrorImageBounds(ultraValidator, control.Bounds);
				base.Location = errorImageBounds;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class Utilities
	{
		private static bool failedToSetCursorPosition = false;

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static bool? canAssert;

		internal static bool IsClipboardUsagePossible => Thread.CurrentThread.GetApartmentState() == ApartmentState.STA;

		public static bool CanAssert
		{
			get
			{
				if (!canAssert.HasValue)
				{
					try
					{
						UIPermission uIPermission = new UIPermission(UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows);
						uIPermission.Assert();
						canAssert = true;
					}
					catch (InvalidOperationException)
					{
						canAssert = false;
					}
				}
				return canAssert.Value;
			}
		}

		private Utilities()
		{
		}

		internal static UltraLicense ValidateLicense(Type type, object instance)
		{
			try
			{
				return LicenseManager.Validate(type, instance) as UltraLicense;
			}
			catch (FileNotFoundException)
			{
				return null;
			}
		}

		public static void VerifyIsValidEnum(Type enumType, int value)
		{
			if (!Enum.IsDefined(enumType, value))
			{
				throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException("value", value, enumType);
			}
		}

		public static bool IsFontDataChange(PropChangeInfo propChangeInfo)
		{
			//IL_004a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0050: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0052: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0054: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005a: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (propChangeInfo == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (propChangeInfo.PropId is FontDataPropIds)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (propChangeInfo.Source is AppearanceBase && propChangeInfo.Trigger != null)
			{
				return IsFontDataChange(propChangeInfo.Trigger);
			}
			if (!(propChangeInfo.PropId is AppearancePropIds))
			{
				return false;
			}
			AppearancePropIds val = (AppearancePropIds)(object)propChangeInfo.PropId;
			if ((int)val != 4)
			{
				return (int)val == 1001;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static bool ShouldSetAppearanceProperty(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps, AppearancePropFlags appearanceProperty)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet(appearanceProperty))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return (AppearancePropFlags)(requestedProps & appearanceProperty) == appearanceProperty;
		}

		internal static Rectangle Normalize(Rectangle rectangle)
		{
			if (rectangle.Width >= 0 && rectangle.Height >= 0)
			{
				return rectangle;
			}
			int x = Math.Min(rectangle.Left, rectangle.Right + 1);
			int y = Math.Min(rectangle.Top, rectangle.Bottom + 1);
			return new Rectangle(x, y, Math.Abs(rectangle.Width), Math.Abs(rectangle.Height));
		}

		internal static void ResetCursorPosition()
		{
			SetCursorPosition(Cursor.Position);
		}

		internal static double Round(double value)
		{
			return Round(value, useBankersRounding: true);
		}

		internal static double Round(double value, bool useBankersRounding)
		{
			return Round(value, 0, useBankersRounding);
		}

		internal static double Round(double value, int decimalPlaces)
		{
			return Round(value, decimalPlaces, useBankersRounding: true);
		}

		internal static double Round(double value, int decimalPlaces, bool useBankersRounding)
		{
			if (useBankersRounding)
			{
				return Math.Round(value, decimalPlaces);
			}
			double num = Math.Pow(10.0, decimalPlaces);
			double num2 = value * num + ((value < 0.0) ? (-0.5) : 0.5);
			num2 = ((num2 >= 0.0) ? Math.Floor(num2) : Math.Ceiling(num2));
			return num2 / num;
		}

		internal static bool SetCursorPosition(Point screenPosition)
		{
			if (failedToSetCursorPosition)
			{
				return false;
			}
			try
			{
				Cursor.Position = screenPosition;
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
				try
				{
					NativeWindowMethods.SetCursorPosApi(screenPosition);
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
					failedToSetCursorPosition = true;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static bool FocusControl(Control control)
		{
			try
			{
				return control.Focus();
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
				try
				{
					if (control.CanFocus)
					{
						NativeWindowMethods.SetFocusApi(control.Handle);
					}
				}
				catch (SecurityException)
				{
				}
			}
			return control.Focused;
		}

		internal static Control GetParent(Control control)
		{
			if (control == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			try
			{
				UIPermission uIPermission = new UIPermission(UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows);
				if (CanAssert)
				{
					uIPermission.Assert();
				}
				return control.Parent;
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static object GetWeakReferenceTarget(WeakReference weakRef)
		{
			try
			{
				if (weakRef == null || !weakRef.IsAlive)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return weakRef.Target;
			}
			catch (InvalidOperationException)
			{
				return null;
			}
		}
	}
